# Wine reference run of GOG S3.EXE (2026-11-05)

What the original game does at runtime, observed under wine. Use it as the spec for the HLE layer.
All facts here are OBSERVED in the trace unless marked HYPOTHESIS. Raw logs were deleted (too big); the
summaries are in `scratch/wine-*` (gitignored, local only).

## Setup (how to repeat)

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| wine | 11.21, `WINEARCH=win64` prefix, 32-bit game via WoW64. No mono/gecko (`WINEDLLOVERRIDES="mscoree,mshtml="` at `wineboot -i`). Prefix ≈ 380 MB |
| Prefix | `scratch/wineprefix`; `C:\S3` is a **symlink** to `game-files/gog-s3-ultimate` (no copy) |
| Display | `Xvfb :77 -screen 0 1024x768x16`, run with `DISPLAY=:77` and `WAYLAND_DISPLAY` unset |
| Virtual desktop | **Required.** `HKCU\Software\Wine\Explorer` `Desktop=Default`, `...\Explorer\Desktops` `Default=1024x768` (`scratch/wine-desktop.reg`). Without it Xvfb cannot change mode and the game shows *"DirectDraw Error DDERR_UNSUPPORTED occured at CDirectDraw::DDSetDisplayMode"* and stops |
| Registry | `regs.cmd` converted to `scratch/wine-s3.reg` (keys under `HKLM\SOFTWARE\Wow6432Node\...` = 32-bit view), imported with `wine regedit /S` |
| Launch | `scratch/wine-run.sh "<WINEDEBUG>" <log>` (cd `C:\S3`, `wine S3.EXE`, log capped with `head -c 300M`) |
| Relay filter | `+relay` on everything is ~300 MB in 45 s. `RelayFromInclude` did **not** filter in wine 11 WoW64. What worked: `HKCU\Software\Wine\Debug\RelayInclude` = the game's static imports minus hot ones (Tls*, Heap*, Enter/LeaveCriticalSection, Interlocked*, Get/SetLastError), then keep only calls whose `ret=` is inside S3.EXE (`0x400000-0x800000`) or `_INMM.dll`. Script: `tools/wine_relay_summary.py <log> [start] [end] [out] [regex]` |
| Input | `xdotool` on display :77 (Escape skips the intro; clicks by absolute coords in the 800x600 menu) |

## Result: it runs

| Step | What happened | Screenshot (local) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| No virtual desktop | MessageBox `DDERR_UNSUPPORTED ... CDirectDraw::DDSetDisplayMode` | `scratch/wine-shot2.png` |
| Start (+3 s) | Intro AVI plays (Blue Byte / Roman temple, Indeo 5 via MCI "Wine MCI-AVI player" window, 640x480 area at top-left) | `scratch/wine-shot4.png` |
| Escape | **Main menu**, 800x600x16: Tutorial, Campaign, Mission CD Campaign, Amazon Campaign, Campaign: Normal, Single Player: Scenario, Multi-player LAN / Internet, Load Game, Online Help, Tips & Tricks, Credits, Exit Game. "Gold Edition" logo, "Version 1.60" | `scratch/wine-shot5.png` |
| Single Player: Scenario (1st run) | **"Please enter your Settlers III serial number"** dialog (see serial section). Typing the GOG key `0497-2584-2194-4356-2336` + OK was accepted | `scratch/wine-r6.png` |
| Game Setup | Map dialog (Random / Single Player Map / Multi-player Map / User), team settings | `scratch/wine-r8.png`, `wine-d4.png` |
| OK, OK | Random map 384 and "Beginner I" both start; briefing screen (English + German text), then the **in-game view at 640x480x16** with settlers, castle, minimap, menus | `scratch/wine-r11.png`, `wine-d6.png`, `wine-d7.png` |

Startup to main menu is ~3 s plus the intro length. The game was never stopped by a CD check.

## Serial number / XOR decoder keys (resolves unknowns #1)

| Key | Value | Access |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `HKLM\Software\BlueByte\Siedler3\1.0\General` | `SingleNumber` (REG_SZ) | read at startup (size query, then data); written after the serial dialog: 0x61 bytes (96 chars + NUL) |
| `HKCR\CLSID\{0e9f8400-d9a5-11cf-8f4d00804880b189}` | `Seed` (REG_DWORD) | key opened at startup (twice); created by the serial dialog with `Seed` = random DWORD (we got `0x6a0f`) |

Note the GUID is **malformed on purpose** (no dash between `8f4d` and `00804880b189`), so it looks like a COM class key.

- Fresh GOG registry (no HKCR key): `RegOpenKeyExA(HKCR, "CLSID\{0e9f8400-...}")` returns 2 (not found) → the menu works,
  but **"Single Player"/campaign asks for the serial**. After entering it the game writes `SingleNumber` **encrypted**
  (the encoder is not NOPed in GOG, only the decoder at file offset `0xFE72`) and `Seed`.
- Plain-text GOG `SingleNumber` **plus** any `HKCR\...\Seed` value: no prompt (tested in run 2).
- **Port rule:** our fake registry must contain both `HKLM\...\General\SingleNumber` = the `regs.cmd` text and
  `HKCR\CLSID\{0e9f8400-d9a5-11cf-8f4d00804880b189}\Seed` = any DWORD. If the game writes `SingleNumber` again
  (encrypted), the GOG exe cannot read it back (HYPOTHESIS: then it would ask again), so do not persist that write;
  keep the plain value.

## Registry values read (in order)

All under `HKLM\Software\BlueByte\Siedler3\1.0\General` (note the spelling `BlueByte`; Windows is case-insensitive,
our fake registry must be too), opened with `KEY_ALL_ACCESS` (0xF003F). Each value is read with the usual two-call
pattern (size query with NULL buffer, then data).

1. `SingleNumber`
2. `HKCR\CLSID\{0e9f8400-...}` (open only)
3. `Playername`, `ClanFlag`, `NoAlpha`, `NoFlip` (missing → default), `SystemBackBuffer` (missing → default),
   `WaitVBlank`, `GDIMouse`, `Resolution`, `FogSpeed`, `ScrollMode`, `ScrollSpeed`, `BuildHelp`, `SoundFormat`,
   `CDAudio` (2×), `Intro`, `VideoFormat`, `MessageLevel`, `GameZoneSelection`, `FirstLogon`, `Font`, `FontSize`,
   `BannerId`, `BannerSubId`, `Mission`, `Plus`, `Gold`, `Tips&Tricks`, `Newbie`, `Language`
4. reopen `General`: `Campaigns`, `CampaignsPlus` (REG_BINARY)
5. `HKCR\CLSID\{0e9f8400-...}` again
6. `HKLM\...\Siedler3\1.0\Index Server` (missing, OK)
7. `RegCreateKeyExA HKLM\...\Siedler3\1.0\Patches`: `InPatch` (missing), `Convert` (REG_SZ), `RegQueryInfoKeyA`

Not read at all: `HKLM\SOFTWARE\Bluebyte\S3Editor`, `S3PLUSCD`, `App Paths\s3.exe`.
Written (after the serial dialog / settings): `SingleNumber`, `Seed`, `Playername`, `ClanFlag`, `WaitVBlank`,
`Resolution`, `Intro`, `GDIMouse`, `GameZoneSelection`, `FirstLogon`, `Font`, `FontSize`, `BannerId`, `BannerSubId`,
`Newbie` … (17 `RegSetValueExA` in total). The fake registry must accept writes (keep them in memory or a file
next to the save games).

## DLLs loaded (S3.EXE process, in order)

Static/implicit: `S3.EXE` (native, at `0x400000`), kernelbase, kernel32, msvcrt, **`libogg-0.dll`, `libvorbis-0.dll`,
`libvorbisfile-3.dll`** (native, from the game dir, pulled in by `_INMM.dll`), ucrtbase, sechost, advapi32, gdi32,
user32, msacm32, ole32 (+combase, rpcrt4), WINMM, **`_INMM.dll`** (native, GOG winmm wrapper), shell32, imm32,
comctl32.

Dynamic, in order: `dinput.dll` (+hid), `opengl32`/`wined3d` (wine internals), `ddraw.dll`, `dplayx.dll` (DirectPlay
COM probe at startup), `dsound.dll` (+mmdevapi), `wsock32.dll` (+ws2_32, iphlpapi), `msvfw32.dll` + `mciavi32.dll` +
**`ir50_32.dll`** (native Indeo 5 codec from the game dir; unloaded when the intro closes).

Not loaded: `ProtectCD.dll`, `wininet.dll`, `comdlg32.dll`, `s3.dll` (Settlers United), `d3dx9_43.dll`.

## Files opened

| When | Files | How |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Startup | `C:\S3\Gfx\siedler3_60.f8007e01f.dat` (FindFirstFile probe) | |
| Startup | 19 `MoveFileA` of old multiplayer map names in `Map\Multi\` (e.g. `A256-2_Quick3.map` → `A256-2-Quick3.map`, `448-2-Island 3.map` → `448-2-island_3.map`). All **failed** (files do not exist in the GOG install) → nothing changed | patch/convert step |
| Startup (`_INMM`) | `MUSIC\Track00.ogg` … `Track65.ogg` (at least) probed; 13 files exist | `_INMM` maps CD tracks to ogg |
| Loading (thread 2) | `Gfx\siedler3_00..17, 20..27, 30..37, 40..48, 60, 61 .f8007e01f.dat` (44 files) | `CreateFileA` + `GetFileSize` + `CreateFileMappingA` + **`MapViewOfFile`** (memory-mapped, read-only) |
| Loading | `Snd\siedler3_00.dat`, `Snd\siedler3_01.dat` | same, memory-mapped |
| Intro | `S3\Add\001\01_00_00.dat` (an AVI despite the extension) | MCI `AVIVideo` |
| Map dialog | `FindFirstFile` over `Map\Single\` (and the others) | |
| Game start | `Map\Single\Beginner I.MAP`; Gfx and Snd files are mapped again; `MUSIC\Track07.ogg` (in-game music) | |

The **Gfx file name encodes the pixel format**: `f8007e01f` = R `0xF800`, G `0x07E0`, B `0x001F` (RGB565, the mode
wine reported). HYPOTHESIS: with a 555 primary the game would open `*.f7c03e01f.dat`; the port should report RGB565.

No file was opened for writing; the game directory listing (mtimes) was identical before and after all runs.
Nothing was written to `Save\` (we did not save).

## DirectDraw

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Creation | `CoCreateInstance` → IDirectDraw2 (`{b3a6f3e0-…}`), `Initialize(NULL)`; done 3× (probe, menu, game) |
| Probe | first object: `SetCooperativeLevel(NULL, DDSCL_NORMAL)` only, then released |
| Cooperative level | `DDSCL_FULLSCREEN | DDSCL_EXCLUSIVE | DDSCL_ALLOWREBOOT` (0x13) on the main window |
| Enumeration | `DirectDrawEnumerateA` (via GetProcAddress) from the render thread |
| Display modes | **800x600x16** for intro/menus/setup, **640x480x16** in game (registry `Resolution`=0). `SetDisplayMode(w,h,16,0,0)`; called again on every screen change. `GetDisplayMode` once before the game |
| Surfaces (menu) | Primary: caps `DDSCAPS_PRIMARYSURFACE` only (**no back buffer, no flip chain**), 800x600, pitch 1600, RGB565. Offscreen: `DDSCAPS_OFFSCREENPLAIN`, 800x600 |
| Surfaces (game) | Primary 640x480; offscreen `OFFSCREENPLAIN|SYSTEMMEMORY` 640x480 (back buffer); offscreen `OFFSCREENPLAIN|SYSTEMMEMORY` **536x582** (scrolling world buffer) |
| Interfaces | Surfaces are QI'd to IDirectDrawSurface3 (`{da044e00-69b2-11d0-a1d5-00aa00b8dfbb}`) |
| Palette / clipper | none (16-bit; `SetPalette(NULL)` only during release). No `Flip`, no `GetAttachedSurface` called |
| Menu frame | draw into the 800x600 offscreen with `Lock(flags DDLOCK_WAIT)` + **`GetDC`/`ReleaseDC`** (GDI text, ~630 times), then `BltFast(primary, 0,0, offscreen, full rect, DDBLTFAST_WAIT)` only when something changed (21 times in the menu) |
| Game frame | per frame: `Lock` 536x582 buffer (`DDLOCK_WRITEONLY` 0x20), 4× `Blt` from it to the 640x480 back buffer (the buffer wraps around: 4 quadrants), `Lock` back buffer (`DDLOCK_WAIT`, sprites/UI by CPU), `WaitForVerticalBlank(DDWAITVB_BLOCKBEGIN)`, `Blt(primary, (0,0)-(640,480), backbuffer)` flags `0x1020200` = `DDBLT_WAIT|DDBLT_ROP|DDBLT_ASYNC` (SRCCOPY). Also `GetBltStatus` |
| Clear | `Blt` with `DDBLT_COLORFILL|DDBLT_ASYNC|DDBLT_WAIT` (0x1000600) on primary / offscreen |

Port implication: no flipping, no palette. Present = copy the primary (RGB565) to the screen after each `Blt`/`BltFast`
to the primary. `WaitForVerticalBlank` is the frame pacer (registry `WaitVBlank`=1). GetDC on a surface needs a GDI
text renderer into RGB565 memory.

## DirectSound

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Creation | `DirectSoundCreate` (GetProcAddress), `SetCooperativeLevel(hwnd, DSSCL_PRIORITY)` |
| Primary | `DSBCAPS_PRIMARYBUFFER|DSBCAPS_CTRLVOLUME`, `SetFormat` PCM **stereo 22050 Hz 16-bit**, `Play` |
| Secondary | `DSBCAPS_CTRLFREQUENCY|CTRLPAN|CTRLVOLUME|LOCSOFTWARE` (flags 0xE8), PCM **mono 22050 Hz 16-bit**, sizes 33939 … 251792 bytes (one buffer per sample) |
| Use | `Lock` whole buffer once, copy sample, `Unlock`; `DuplicateSoundBuffer` for overlapping plays; `SetVolume`, `SetPan`, `Play(0,0,0)` (one-shot, no looping), `GetStatus` polling |

Music is **not** DirectSound: `_INMM.dll` decodes `MUSIC\TrackNN.ogg` with libvorbisfile and plays it through
`waveOutOpen` from its own thread (the game thinks it is CD audio, registry `CDAudio`=2).

## DirectInput

`DirectInputCreateA` (version 0x0300), one device: **`GUID_SysMouse`** (`{6f1d2b60-d5a0-11cf-bfc7-444553540000}`),
`SetDataFormat(c_dfDIMouse)` (X, Y, Z axes + 4 buttons), `SetCooperativeLevel(hwnd, DISCL_FOREGROUND|DISCL_NONEXCLUSIVE)`,
`SetProperty(DIPROP_BUFFERSIZE, 128)`, `Acquire`, then buffered `GetDeviceData` (16-byte DIDEVICEOBJECTDATA, called
with `DIGDD_PEEK` first). No keyboard device: the keyboard comes from window messages. Created 3× (startup probe, menu, game).

## MCI (intro video)

Sent with `mciSendStringA` (through `_INMM`, forwarded to winmm):

```
open AVIVideo!.\S3\Add\001\01_00_00.dat alias test
status test window handle
window test handle <hwnd of the game window>
play test window notify
close test wait          (after Escape or at the end)
```

So the intro is in `S3\Add\001\` (resolves unknowns #4). The port can skip it (registry `Intro`=0 or answer
`open` with an error), or decode Indeo 5 later.

## Threads and timing

| Thread | Start | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| main (0120) | entry | creates the window (`"Siedler3 Window Class"`, title `S3`, style `0x90C80000`, ex-style `WS_EX_TOPMOST`, 1024x768 = screen size from `GetSystemMetrics`), a hidden `"CDAUDIO CALLBACKWINDOW"`, runs a **`GetMessageA`** loop (only 1 `PeekMessageA`) |
| 2 × at menu start | `CreateThread(…, 0x622805 /*CRT _beginthreadex*/, …, CREATE_SUSPENDED)` + `ResumeThread` | one is the render/UI thread (loads ddraw, Gfx, Snd, fonts, menu); `SetThreadPriority` 2 (HIGHEST) / 0 toggled around loading |
| 3 × at game start | same | game logic, AI (OutputDebugString "COMP_FoodForMines …", "Center - player: 1, group: N"), render |
| `_INMM` | `CreateThread(…, 0x6ad41280, …)` | music |

Sync: `SetEvent` (~74 k), `WaitForSingleObject` (~42 k), `WaitForMultipleObjects` (~38 k), `ResetEvent` (~5 k)
in ~4 min, so the threads hand off every frame. Timing: `QueryPerformanceCounter`/`Frequency`, `Sleep`, and
`CreateWaitableTimerA`/`SetWaitableTimer`/`CancelWaitableTimer` resolved with GetProcAddress (HYPOTHESIS: frame
timer). **`timeSetEvent` was never called** (wine `+mmtime` showed nothing). `timeGetTime` goes through `_INMM`
(native, not visible in the relay log).

C++ exceptions: `RaiseException(0xE06D7363)` (MSVC throw) ~36 times, all caught by the game — normal control flow.
The CPU emulator must support SEH (`fs:[0]` chain) and `RtlUnwind`.

## CD checks / ProtectCD

`ProtectCD.dll` is never loaded (confirms unknowns #2). `GetVolumeInformationA` is never called. `GetDriveTypeA` is
called ~16 times with `"C:\"` and with the odd path `".\\"` (from `0x413840`); it returned `DRIVE_FIXED` (3) and
the game was happy. HLE: return `DRIVE_FIXED` for everything.

## Network at startup

`wsock32.dll` is loaded at startup and `socket, bind, getsockname, htonl, htons, inet_addr, ntohs, inet_ntoa,
WSAGetLastError, gethostbyname, WSAStartup, WSACleanup, sendto, recvfrom, select, shutdown, closesocket` are resolved
with GetProcAddress (HYPOTHESIS: LAN game discovery). A DirectPlay COM object is created (dplayx loaded) once at startup.
Stubs that fail cleanly should be enough for single player.

## Win32 calls from the game (counts, whole session ≈ 4 min: intro, menu, setup, ~1 min in game)

Hot functions were excluded from the trace (TlsGetValue/TlsSetValue, HeapAlloc/Free/ReAlloc/Size,
Enter/LeaveCriticalSection, Interlocked*, Get/SetLastError, IsBad*Ptr, GetCurrentThread(Id), lstrlenA/lstrcpyA,
RtlUnwind) — these are called very often too.

| DLL | Called (count) |
| --- | --- |
| kernel32 | SetEvent 74314, WaitForSingleObject 42187, WaitForMultipleObjects 37839, ResetEvent 4805, QueryPerformanceCounter 1000, Sleep 267, CloseHandle 196, WideCharToMultiByte 155, CreateFileA/GetFileSize/CreateFileMappingA/MapViewOfFile 141 each, GetLocaleInfoW 116, UnmapViewOfFile 94, MultiByteToWideChar 60, GetProcAddress 48, RaiseException 36, SetCurrentDirectoryA 30, OutputDebugStringA 27, MoveFileA 19, GetDriveTypeA 16, CreateEventA 15, GetFileAttributesA 14, FindFirstFileA 13, GetModuleHandleA 12, GetCurrentDirectoryA 12, LoadLibraryA 11, QueryPerformanceFrequency 10, VirtualAlloc 7, SetThreadPriority 7, FindClose 7, CreateThread 6, GetStringTypeW 5, LCMapStringW 5, FormatMessageA 5, LocalFree 5, ResumeThread 5, GetModuleFileNameA 4, GetSystemTime 4, GetStdHandle 3, GetFileType 3, GetCPInfo 3, GetLocalTime 3, GetLocaleInfoA 3, GetStartupInfoA 2, GetTimeZoneInformation 2, CompareStringW 2, SetFilePointer 2, and 1× each: GetVersion, GetVersionExA, HeapCreate, TlsAlloc, SetHandleCount, GetCommandLineA, GetEnvironmentStringsW, FreeEnvironmentStringsW, GetACP, SetUnhandledExceptionFilter, GetUserDefaultLCID, IsValidCodePage, IsValidLocale, CreateMutexA, CreateSemaphoreA, ReleaseSemaphore |
| user32 | IntersectRect 6363, DrawTextA 1364, IsRectEmpty 1233, PtInRect 304, GetWindowLongA 232, GetMessageA 126, TranslateMessage 125, DispatchMessageA 125, GetMessagePos 75, SetCursor 63, LoadCursorA 29, ClientToScreen 22, PostMessageA 19, SetRect 7, BeginPaint/EndPaint 4, ShowCursor 4, PostThreadMessageA 4, SendMessageA 3, GetSystemMetrics 2, LoadIconA 2, CreateWindowExA 2, ShowWindow 2, and 1×: PeekMessageA, RegisterClassA, RegisterClassExA, SetWindowLongA, GetClientRect, MoveWindow, SendMessageTimeoutA, GetDC, ReleaseDC |
| gdi32 | SetTextColor 3043, SelectObject 2940, DeleteObject 2792, CreateRectRgn 2782, SelectClipRgn 2782, SetBkMode 2779, TextOutA 874, GetTextExtentPoint32A 735, GetTextMetricsA 654, MoveToEx 103, LineTo 103, GetTextExtentExPointA 39, CreateFontIndirectA 11, GetStockObject 6, GetDeviceCaps 2 (index 90 = LOGPIXELSY), CreatePen 2, GdiFlush 2, CreateDIBSection 1 |
| advapi32 | RegQueryValueExA 73, RegSetValueExA 17, RegCloseKey 9, RegOpenKeyExA 8, RegCreateKeyExA 4, RegQueryInfoKeyA 1, GetUserNameA 1 |

Never called in this session (from the static import list): CreateProcessA, CopyFileA, DeleteFileA, CreateDirectoryA,
WriteFile, GetTempFileNameA, VirtualProtect, VirtualQuery, ClipCursor, MsgWaitForMultipleObjects, wvsprintfA,
MessageBoxA (only on the DDERR error), DestroyWindow, RegDeleteKeyA, RegEnum*, CoCreateGuid. Saving a game,
multiplayer and campaign were not exercised.

GDI text is drawn on DirectDraw surface DCs: per text item the pattern is `CreateRectRgn` + `SelectClipRgn` +
`SelectObject(font)` + `SetBkMode(TRANSPARENT)` + `SetTextColor` + `TextOutA`/`DrawTextA` + `DeleteObject`.
Fonts: 4 `CreateFontIndirectA` at menu start (face from registry `Font` = "MS Sans Serif", height from `FontSize`)
and 3 more for the game UI.

## Open / not done

- Save/load, campaign, multiplayer not traced.
- `timeGetTime`/`timeBeginPeriod` calls go to `_INMM.dll` (native), so their counts are unknown.
- Which waitable-timer functions are really called (only GetProcAddress seen).

# Settlers United (SU)

Community launcher/patch for S3 and S4 (settlers-united.com). Electron app installed at `C:\Program Files\Settlers United`.
Update feed: `https://files.settlers-united.com` (generic provider, `stable` channel).

## Components (local copy: `game-files/settlers-united-launcher/resources/`)

| Path | What |
| --- | --- |
| `app.asar` | Electron UI: `main.prod.js`, `dist/renderer.prod.js` (list with `bunx @electron/asar list`) |
| `bin/s3u.exe` (5.3 MB) | S3 starter/injector — HYPOTHESIS |
| `bin/s3.dll` (15.7 MB) | S3 hook layer (newer than the 1.47 MB `s3.dll` in the game dir). Game-dir `s3.dll` imports `d3d9`, `gdiplus`, `winhttp`, `dbghelp`, `IMM32`, MSVC 14 runtime → D3D9 renderer + ImGui overlay + screenshots + crash reporting (Sentry/crashpad) |
| `bin/s3.ai.dll` | AI replacement/extension — HYPOTHESIS |
| `bin/s3_assets.bin`, `bin/s3_artifacts/`, `bin/s3/` | SU assets |
| `bin/settlers-united.dll` | shared core (lobby/network?) |
| `bin/wireguard/` | VPN for multiplayer (DirectPlay over virtual LAN) |
| `bin/ffmpeg.exe`, NAudio*.dll, NetTopologySuite, Newtonsoft.Json | recording / .NET helpers |
| `bin/s4*` | Settlers 4 equivalents (not our concern) |

In the game dir SU added: `s3_united.exe` ([exe-variants](../game-files/exe-variants.md)), `s3.dll`, `d3dx9_43.dll`,
`mfc140.dll`, `ucrtbase.dll`, `crashpad_handler.exe`, `.sentry-native/`, `imgui.ini`, `s3Scripts/`, `s3ce.exe` + `res/*.po`,
and modified `GFX/Siedler3_25.f8007e01f.dat` (backup `.original`).

## End-of-game statistics (checked 2026-11-08, read as data)

- Game-dir `s3.dll` strings (`0x1121e0..0x112308`): "Points", "Settlers", "Buildings", "Mine", "Gold", "Mana",
  "Soldiers", "Battles", ImGui ids `#gamestats-open` / `#gamestats-container`, "View Extended Game Stats", "Stats",
  "Count", "Game Time"; `res/s3ce.*.po` also translates "food" and these keys. So SU adds a button on the
  statistics screen that opens an ImGui window with per-category charts (count against game time); HYPOTHESIS:
  sampled during the game from the game's statistics counters (we did not run SU).
- Launcher (`app.asar`): game state `EndStatistic`; statistics images saved to `Pictures/Settlers United/Settlers 3
  Statistics/` (timestamp `%Y-%m-%d_%H.%M.%S` in `s3.dll`) and listed in a launcher page ("There are no statistics
  available yet. Play a game.").
- Our own equivalent: [menu-layout.md "Statistics over time"](../porting/menu-layout.md). Not done: saving the
  statistics as images.

## Relevance to the port

- SU proves the original exe can be wrapped: rendering moved to D3D9 by hooking DirectDraw. We do the same idea at the API layer (HLE).
- SU's bug fixes are inside its DLLs (closed source). We must not ship them. Our port targets the **plain GOG S3.EXE** first.
- Open: list which known S3 bugs SU fixes so we can decide whether to re-implement any as in-memory patches. ([unknowns](../reverse-engineering/unknowns.md) #9)

# Tooling on this PC (for this project)

Checked 2026-11-05.

## Reverse engineering

| Tool | Where | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| REA MCP (`mcp__rea__*`) 6.5.0 | `~/.local/bin/rea` | Load the `reverse-engineer-anything` skill first. Backend: Ghidra 12.1.2 at `/opt/ghidra` (JDK 21). |
| Ghidra zip (backup) | `~/Projects/reverse-engineering/tools/ghidra.zip` | Same Ghidra, not needed while `/opt/ghidra` exists |
| rizin, objdump, python-pefile | system | `tools/pe_imports.py` uses pefile |
| wine 11.x + wine-mono + winetricks | system | Run S3.EXE on Linux as reference; `WINEDEBUG=+relay,+ddraw,+dsound,+dinput` for API traces. Working setup (Xvfb + wine virtual desktop required, relay filtering): [wine-trace](reverse-engineering/wine-trace.md) |
| Blockheads RE workspace | `~/Projects/reverse-engineering/` | Other project. `docs/REA_USAGE.md` has general REA + gdb tips |

**REA sharing rule.** `~/Projects/reverse-engineering/docs/REA_USAGE.md` describes a setup where **one REA server
is shared by many agents**. In that setup, `open_binary` on another target or `close_binary` breaks their Ghidra session.
In a normal Claude Code session the REA server is a stdio child of **this** session (check `binary_session` →
`server_identity.server.started_at` ≈ session start). Then opening/closing S3.EXE is safe. If in doubt, check before
calling `open_binary`. S3.EXE auto-analysis takes about 1-2 minutes.

## Android

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| SDK | `~/Android/Sdk` (emulator, cmdline-tools/latest, build-tools 35/36, platforms 34-37, NDK 27.2.12479018) |
| adb | Windows (since 2026-11-06): `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Android\Sdk\platform-tools\adb.exe` (not on PATH; SDK has build-tools 36.0.0, platforms 35/37, NDK 27.2). Old WSL: `/opt/android-sdk/platform-tools/adb` |
| System images | android-30 and android-35 `google_apis` **x86_64** |
| Existing AVDs | `bhmod_m7_api30`, `bhmod_m9_api30`, `bhwt_api30`, `fold_compat_30/35`, `kabuk_api35`, `pulsar_api35` — they belong to other projects; **do not reuse or kill them** |
| Running now | `bhwt_api30` headless on `emulator-5600` (Blockheads world-tool). Leave it alone |
| Our AVD | `s3_api35` (ours): API 35 x86_64, pixel_6, 3 GB RAM, 6 GB data, console port 5610 (`emulator-5610`). Managed by `port/scripts/run-emulator.sh`, see [porting/android.md](porting/android.md) |

ABI notes: the API 30 x86_64 image reports `x86_64,x86,arm64-v8a,armeabi-v7a,armeabi` (it has ARM translation).
The API 35 image reports only `x86_64`. Plan: build our app for **arm64-v8a + x86_64**, test x86_64 on the emulator,
and test arm64 on a real phone or the API 30 image.

Create our own AVD when needed (no root required):

```
~/Android/Sdk/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/avdmanager create avd -n s3_api35 \
  -k "system-images;android-35;google_apis;x86_64" -d pixel_6
~/Android/Sdk/emulator/emulator -avd s3_api35 -port 5610 -gpu host &   # use a free port, not 5600
adb -s emulator-5610 ...
```

REA also has adb tools (`list_adb_devices`, `install_adb_package`, `capture_adb_screen`, `read_adb_logcat`).

## Build tools

cmake, ninja, Java (system), Rust via rustup, bun. Frida is **not** installed.

## Real test phone (2026-11-05)

- **Samsung Galaxy Z Fold4 (SM-F936B)**, Android 14, arm64-v8a, **rooted** (user-confirmed). Reached over wireless adb
  (`adb devices` shows e.g. `10.0.0.50:<port>`; the port changes when wireless debugging is restarted).
- Install and push files: `ADB_SERIAL=<ip:port> port/scripts/run-emulator.sh install push launch`.
  Samsung/Android 14 refuses directories created by `adb push` under `Android/data` (`secure_mkdirs() failed`);
  the script creates them with `adb shell mkdir -p` first.
- Root is for debugging only (e.g. `su -c simpleperf`, reading other app dirs). Do not depend on it for normal installs.
  Ask the user before changing system settings with root.
- The cover screen is narrow and portrait (904x2229). Test on the inner screen (unfolded) or in landscape.

[workspace]

    "crates/s3-frontend",
    "crates/s3-net",
    "crates/s3-relay",
    "crates/s3-ios",
]

[workspace.package]

edition = "2021"
license = "GPL-3.0-or-later"
publish = false

[workspace.dependencies]
s3-mem = { path = "crates/s3-mem" }
s3-cpu = { path = "crates/s3-cpu" }
s3-runtime = { path = "crates/s3-runtime" }
s3-pe = { path = "crates/s3-pe" }
s3-win32 = { path = "crates/s3-win32" }
s3-dx = { path = "crates/s3-dx" }
s3-frontend = { path = "crates/s3-frontend", default-features = false }
s3-engine = { path = "crates/s3-engine" }
s3-mods = { path = "crates/s3-mods" }
s3-net = { path = "crates/s3-net" }
iced-x86 = { version = "1.21", default-features = false, features = ["std", "decoder", "instr_info", "intel"] }
libc = "0.2"
log = "0.4"

# The interpreter is unusably slow without optimisation; keep tests/dev builds fast too.
[profile.dev]
opt-level = 1

[profile.dev.package."*"]
opt-level = 3

[profile.release]
opt-level = 3
debug = 1
panic = "unwind"

# perf-cpu: the interpreter's handlers and run loop must inline into each other (docs/porting/performance.md).
[profile.release.package.s3-cpu]
codegen-units = 1

```

`port/README.md`:

```md
# Settlers III port — host runtime (Rust)

Runs the user's own GOG `S3.EXE` with an x86-32 interpreter plus high-level emulation of Win32/DirectX.
No game files are included or needed to build; tests use hand-assembled snippets.

- Architecture, memory map, thunk ABI, how to add an HLE function: [`../docs/porting/architecture.md`](../docs/porting/architecture.md)
- Project index: [`../AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md)

```sh
export CARGO_TARGET_DIR=$PWD/target
cargo build -j 4 && cargo test -j 4
./target/debug/s3run --headless --max-seconds 20 --game-dir <gog install> --data-dir <writable dir>
```

License: GPL-3.0-or-later. Not affiliated with Ubisoft / Blue Byte.

```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- Settlers 3 Port: NativeActivity + libs3android.so, plus one small Java service (GameService, background play).
     No game files are packaged. -->
<manifest xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    package="com.settlers3port.app"

    <!-- Online multiplayer: WebSocket connection to our relay (docs/porting/multiplayer.md). -->

`port/android/java/com/settlers3port/app/GameService.java`:

```java
// Settlers 3 Port: foreground service that keeps the process running while a game continues in the background
// (docs/porting/android.md "Background play"). Started and fed from Rust (bgservice.rs) with plain intents:
//   START  (startForegroundService) extra game_ms: ongoing "running" notification with a chronometer
//   UPDATE (startService)           extra game_ms: re-sync the chronometer (game speed, in-game pause)
//   EVENT  (startService)           extra text: one "Game events" notification (lines separated by '\n')
//   stopService: removes the ongoing notification and the event notifications.
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
package com.settlers3port.app;

import android.app.Notification;
import android.app.NotificationChannel;
import android.app.NotificationManager;
import android.app.PendingIntent;
import android.app.Service;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.content.pm.ServiceInfo;
import android.os.Build;
import android.os.IBinder;
import android.os.PowerManager;

public class GameService extends Service {
    static final String ACTION_START = "com.settlers3port.app.START";
    static final String ACTION_UPDATE = "com.settlers3port.app.UPDATE";
    static final String ACTION_EVENT = "com.settlers3port.app.EVENT";
    static final String CH_RUNNING = "running";
    // "events" (first version) had no vibration; a channel's settings cannot change once created, so it is
    // replaced by "events_vibrate" (deleted in channels()).
    static final String CH_EVENTS_OLD = "events";
    static final String CH_EVENTS = "events_vibrate";
    // Same as CH_EVENTS without vibration (setting "Vibration" in the game menus).
    static final String CH_EVENTS_QUIET = "events_quiet";
    static final String GROUP_EVENTS = "com.settlers3port.app.EVENTS";
    static final int ID_RUNNING = 1;
    static final int ID_EVENTS_FIRST = 100;

    private PowerManager.WakeLock wakeLock;
    private int nextEventId = ID_EVENTS_FIRST;
    private long gameMs;

    @Override
    public IBinder onBind(Intent intent) {
        return null;
    }

    @Override
    public int onStartCommand(Intent intent, int flags, int startId) {
        String action = intent != null ? intent.getAction() : null;
        channels();
        if (action == null || ACTION_START.equals(action)) {
            gameMs = intent != null ? intent.getLongExtra("game_ms", 0) : 0;
            Notification n = running();
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 34) {
                startForeground(ID_RUNNING, n, ServiceInfo.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_TYPE_SPECIAL_USE);
            } else {
                startForeground(ID_RUNNING, n);
            }
            if (wakeLock == null) {
                PowerManager pm = (PowerManager) getSystemService(POWER_SERVICE);
                wakeLock = pm.newWakeLock(PowerManager.PARTIAL_WAKE_LOCK, "s3port:game");
                wakeLock.setReferenceCounted(false);
                wakeLock.acquire();
            }
        } else if (ACTION_UPDATE.equals(action)) {
            gameMs = intent.getLongExtra("game_ms", gameMs);
            nm().notify(ID_RUNNING, running());
        } else if (ACTION_EVENT.equals(action)) {
            String text = intent.getStringExtra("text");
            if (text != null && !text.isEmpty()) {
                event(text, intent.getLongExtra("vibrate", 1) != 0);
            }
        }
        return START_NOT_STICKY;
    }

    @Override
    public void onTaskRemoved(Intent rootIntent) {
        // Swiped away from the recent apps: the user closed the game.
        stopSelf();
        android.os.Process.killProcess(android.os.Process.myPid());
    }

    @Override
    public void onDestroy() {
        if (wakeLock != null) {
            wakeLock.release();
            wakeLock = null;
        }
        stopForeground(STOP_FOREGROUND_REMOVE);
        NotificationManager nm = nm();
        for (int id = ID_EVENTS_FIRST; id < nextEventId; id++) {
            nm.cancel(id);
        }
        super.onDestroy();
    }

    private NotificationManager nm() {
        return (NotificationManager) getSystemService(NOTIFICATION_SERVICE);
    }

    private void channels() {
        NotificationManager nm = nm();
        if (nm.getNotificationChannel(CH_RUNNING) == null) {
            NotificationChannel c = new NotificationChannel(CH_RUNNING, "Game running", NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_LOW);
            c.setDescription("Shown while a game keeps running in the background");
            c.setShowBadge(false);
            nm.createNotificationChannel(c);
        }
        if (nm.getNotificationChannel(CH_EVENTS_QUIET) == null) {
            NotificationChannel c = new NotificationChannel(CH_EVENTS_QUIET, "Game events (no vibration)", NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_DEFAULT);
            c.setDescription("Game messages while in the background, when vibration is off in the game menu");
            c.enableVibration(false);
            c.setVibrationPattern(new long[] {0});
            nm.createNotificationChannel(c);
        }
        if (nm.getNotificationChannel(CH_EVENTS) == null) {
            NotificationChannel c = new NotificationChannel(CH_EVENTS, "Game events", NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_DEFAULT);
            c.setDescription("Messages of the game (e.g. resources found) while it runs in the background");
            c.enableVibration(true);
            nm.createNotificationChannel(c);
        }
        if (nm.getNotificationChannel(CH_EVENTS_OLD) != null) {
            nm.deleteNotificationChannel(CH_EVENTS_OLD);
        }
    }

    private int icon() {
        int id = getResources().getIdentifier("ic_notify", "drawable", getPackageName());
        return id != 0 ? id : android.R.drawable.ic_media_play;
    }

    private PendingIntent openApp() {
        Intent i = getPackageManager().getLaunchIntentForPackage(getPackageName());
        if (i == null) {
            i = new Intent();
            i.setClassName(this, "android.app.NativeActivity");
        }
        i.addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK | Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_RESET_TASK_IF_NEEDED);
        return PendingIntent.getActivity(this, 0, i, PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE | PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT);
    }

    private Notification running() {
        Notification.Builder b = new Notification.Builder(this, CH_RUNNING);
        if (android.os.Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 31) {
            // Android 12+ delays foreground-service notifications by up to 10 s unless asked to show at once.
            b.setForegroundServiceBehavior(Notification.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_IMMEDIATE);
        }
        return b
            .setSmallIcon(icon())
            .setContentTitle("S3 Mobile — running")
            .setContentText("Tap to return")
            .setUsesChronometer(true)
            .setShowWhen(true)
            .setWhen(System.currentTimeMillis() - gameMs)
            .setOngoing(true)
            .setOnlyAlertOnce(true)
            .setCategory(Notification.CATEGORY_SERVICE)
            .setContentIntent(openApp())
            .build();
    }

    private void event(String text, boolean vibrate) {
        String[] lines = text.split("\n");
        Notification.Builder b = new Notification.Builder(this, vibrate ? CH_EVENTS : CH_EVENTS_QUIET)
            .setSmallIcon(icon())
            .setContentTitle(lines.length == 1 ? "S3 Mobile" : "S3 Mobile — " + lines.length + " messages")
            .setContentText(lines[lines.length - 1])
            .setAutoCancel(true)
            .setGroup(GROUP_EVENTS)
            .setCategory(Notification.CATEGORY_EVENT)
            .setContentIntent(openApp());
        if (lines.length > 1) {
            Notification.InboxStyle st = new Notification.InboxStyle();
            for (String l : lines) {
                st.addLine(l);
            }
            b.setStyle(st);
        } else {
            b.setStyle(new Notification.BigTextStyle().bigText(text));
        }
        nm().notify(nextEventId++, b.build());
    }
}

`port/crates/s3-android/src/android.rs`:

```rs
//! NativeActivity glue (android-activity): lifecycle, window, input, AAudio. Presentation runs on the render
//! thread in `present` (EGL/GLES).
//! Platform-independent logic lives in `frontend`, `touch`, `layout`, `screen`, `audio`, `keys`.

use s3_mods::display::Viewport;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, Ordering};
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

use android_activity::input::{InputEvent, KeyAction, KeyMapChar, MotionAction, ToolType};
use android_activity::{AndroidApp, InputStatus, MainEvent, PollEvent, WindowManagerFlags};
use ndk::audio::{
    AudioCallbackResult, AudioDirection, AudioFormat, AudioPerformanceMode, AudioSharingMode, AudioStream,
    AudioStreamBuilder,
};
use s3_runtime::{HostEvent, MouseButton};

use crate::audio::{AudioRing, OUT_CHANNELS, OUT_RATE};
use crate::background::{Background, NOT_IN_GAME_PAUSE_MS};
use crate::bgservice;
use crate::frontend::{run_engine, EngineEnd, Shared};
use crate::launcher::{Launcher, Request, Touch};
use jni::objects::JValue;
use jni::{jni_sig, jni_str};
use crate::present::Presenter;
use crate::touch::{pointer_events, Action, PointerFilter};
use crate::uithread::UiThread;

fn open_audio(ring: Arc<AudioRing>, dead: Arc<AtomicBool>) -> Option<AudioStream> {
    let r2 = ring.clone();
    let res = AudioStreamBuilder::new().and_then(|b| {
        b.direction(AudioDirection::Output)
            .format(AudioFormat::PCM_I16)
            .channel_count(OUT_CHANNELS as i32)
            .sample_rate(OUT_RATE as i32)
            .sharing_mode(AudioSharingMode::Shared)
            .performance_mode(AudioPerformanceMode::None)
            .data_callback(Box::new(move |_s, data, frames| {
                let out = unsafe { std::slice::from_raw_parts_mut(data as *mut i16, frames as usize * OUT_CHANNELS) };
                r2.pop_into(out);
                AudioCallbackResult::Continue
            }))
            .error_callback(Box::new(move |_s, e| {
                log::warn!("AAudio error callback: {e:?}");
                dead.store(true, Ordering::Release);
            }))
            .open_stream()
    });
    match res {
        Ok(s) => {
            log::info!(
                "AAudio: {} Hz, {} ch, burst {} frames, buffer {} frames",
                s.sample_rate(),
                s.channel_count(),
                s.frames_per_burst(),
                s.buffer_size_in_frames()
            );
            if let Err(e) = s.request_start() {
                log::warn!("AAudio start: {e:?}");
            }
            ring.running.store(true, Ordering::Release);
            Some(s)
        }
        Err(e) => {
            log::warn!("AAudio unavailable ({e:?}); running without sound");
            None
        }
    }
}

/// Frame cap while a game runs in the background (docs/porting/android.md "Background play").
const BACKGROUND_FPS: u32 = 10;

fn now_ms(t0: Instant) -> u64 {
    t0.elapsed().as_millis() as u64
}

#[no_mangle]
fn android_main(app: AndroidApp) {
    android_logger::init_once(
        android_logger::Config::default().with_max_level(log::LevelFilter::Info).with_tag("s3port"),
    );
    std::panic::set_hook(Box::new(|info| {
        log::error!("PANIC: {info}");
    }));
    log::info!("S3 Mobile {} starting", env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION"));
    app.set_window_flags(WindowManagerFlags::FULLSCREEN | WindowManagerFlags::KEEP_SCREEN_ON, WindowManagerFlags::empty());
    crate::wifilock::install(&app);
    let ui_thread = UiThread::new(&app);
    if let Some(u) = &ui_thread {
        u.immersive();
    }
    let kb_visible = Arc::new(Mutex::new(false));

    let base = app
        .external_data_path()
        .or_else(|| app.internal_data_path())
        .unwrap_or_else(|| "/sdcard/Android/data/com.settlers3port.app/files".into());
    let data_dir = base.join("data");
    // `<data dir>/game-dir.txt` (debug / tests) points the game dir elsewhere.
    let game_dir = crate::launcher::game_dir_override(&data_dir, base.join("game"));
    let _ = std::fs::create_dir_all(&game_dir);
    log::info!("game dir: {} (copy your own install here); data dir: {}", game_dir.display(), data_dir.display());

    let data_dir_ui = data_dir.clone();
    let waker = app.create_waker();
    let shared = Shared::new(Box::new(move || waker.wake()));
    // Launcher first (docs/porting/android.md "Launcher"); the engine thread starts on Play and ends with the game.
    let mut launcher = Launcher::new(game_dir.clone(), data_dir.clone());
    let mut in_launcher = true;
    let mut launcher_drawn: Option<(u32, u32, u64)> = None;
    let mut launcher_dirty = true;
    let mut engine_thread: Option<std::thread::JoinHandle<()>> = None;
    let mut reqs: Vec<Request> = Vec::new();
    // `am start ... --ez play true` (scripts): skip the launcher once when the files are there.
    let autoplay = Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false));
    let mut autoplay_checked = false;
    if let Some(u) = &ui_thread {
        let a = autoplay.clone();
        u.run("intent extras", Box::new(move |env, act| {
            let intent = env.call_method(act, jni_str!("getIntent"), jni_sig!("()Landroid/content/Intent;"), &[])?.l()?;
            if !intent.is_null() {
                let key = env.new_string("play")?;
                let v = env
                    .call_method(&intent, jni_str!("getBooleanExtra"), jni_sig!("(Ljava/lang/String;Z)Z"), &[JValue::Object(&key), JValue::Bool(false)])?
                    .z()?;
                a.store(v, Ordering::Release);
            }
            Ok(())
        }));
    }
    let start_t = Instant::now();

    let audio_dead = Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false));
    let mut audio = open_audio(shared.audio.clone(), audio_dead.clone());

    let t0 = Instant::now();
    // Render thread (EGL/GLES presenter, docs/porting/display.md): the engine never waits for the display.
    let presenter = Presenter::start(shared.clone());
    // Refresh rate asked from the window manager (preferredDisplayModeId / preferredRefreshRate), per setting.
    let mut prefs_hz: Option<u32> = None;
    let mut kb_checked = 0u64;
    let mut finishing = false;
    // Fingers -> raw pointer events; gestures are recognized by s3-mods on the engine thread.
    let mut pointers = PointerFilter::default();
    let mut quit = false;
    let mut paused = false;
    let mut touches_logged = 0u32;
    // Viewport frozen while two or more fingers are down: a pinch switches the render size every few frames, and
    // mapping each finger move through the newest viewport made the measured finger distance (game pixels) jump
    // with every switch, so the zoom went back and forth. With one mapping per gesture the distance ratio is the
    // real one on screen.
    let mut pinch_vp: Option<Viewport> = None;
    // Background play: Some while the app is in the background and the game keeps running (foreground service +
    // notifications); `bg_out_of_game` = since when the game is no longer in a game (then pause like in menus).
    let mut bg: Option<Background> = None;
    let mut bg_out_of_game: Option<u64> = None;
    let mut asked_permission = false;

    while !quit {
        let mut wait = 250;
        if *kb_visible.lock().unwrap() {
            wait = wait.min(1000);
        }
        app.poll_events(Some(Duration::from_millis(wait)), |event| match event {
            PollEvent::Main(main) => match main {
                MainEvent::InitWindow { .. } => {
                    if let Some(u) = &ui_thread {
                        u.immersive();
                    }
                    prefs_hz = None;
                    shared.density_dpi.store(app.config().density().unwrap_or(0), std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed);
                    presenter.set_window(app.native_window());
                }
                MainEvent::TerminateWindow { .. } => presenter.set_window(None),
                MainEvent::WindowResized { .. } | MainEvent::ConfigChanged { .. } => {
                    // Folding / unfolding changes the density too.
                    shared.density_dpi.store(app.config().density().unwrap_or(0), std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed);
                    presenter.set_window(app.native_window());
                }
                MainEvent::RedrawNeeded { .. } | MainEvent::ContentRectChanged { .. } => presenter.invalidate(),
                MainEvent::Pause => {
                    paused = true;
                    if shared.in_game.load(Ordering::Acquire) {
                        // In a game: keep it running (foreground service, notifications). Sound is muted.
                        let gm = shared.game_ms.load(Ordering::Acquire);
                        log::info!("lifecycle: pause -> background play (game time {} s)", gm / 1000);
                        shared.bg_lines.lock().unwrap().clear();
                        shared.background.store(true, Ordering::Release);
                        crate::frontend::background_fps(Some(BACKGROUND_FPS));
                        bgservice::start(&app, gm);
                        let mut b = Background::default();
                        b.begin(now_ms(t0), gm);
                        bg = Some(b);
                        bg_out_of_game = None;
                    } else {
                        log::info!("lifecycle: pause");
                        shared.set_paused(true);
                    }
                    if let Some(s) = &audio {
                        let _ = s.request_pause();
                    }
                }
                MainEvent::Resume { .. } => {
                    log::info!("lifecycle: resume");
                    paused = false;
                    if bg.take().is_some() {
                        log::info!("background play: back in the foreground (game time {} s)", shared.game_ms.load(Ordering::Acquire) / 1000);
                        shared.background.store(false, Ordering::Release);
                        crate::frontend::background_fps(None);
                        bgservice::stop(&app);
                    }
                    shared.set_paused(false);
                    // Drop sound queued before the pause (it would play late).
                    shared.audio.clear();
                    if let Some(s) = &audio {
                        let _ = s.request_start();
                    }
                    presenter.invalidate();
                }
                MainEvent::LostFocus => log::info!("lifecycle: lost focus"),
                MainEvent::GainedFocus => {
                    log::info!("lifecycle: gained focus");
                    // Notifications for background play (Android 13+): asked once per install, in the menus.
                    if !asked_permission && !shared.in_game.load(Ordering::Acquire) {
                        asked_permission = true;
                        if let Some(u) = &ui_thread {
                            bgservice::ask_notification_permission(u, &data_dir_ui);
                        }
                    }
                    // The system shows the bars again after dialogs / app switches.
                    if let Some(u) = &ui_thread {
                        u.immersive();
                    }
                }
                MainEvent::LowMemory => log::warn!("lifecycle: low memory"),
                MainEvent::Destroy => {
                    log::info!("lifecycle: destroy");
                    quit = true;
                }
                _ => {}
            },
            _ => {}
        });

        // Input.
        if let Ok(mut iter) = app.input_events_iter() {
            loop {
                let read = iter.next(|event| match event {
                    InputEvent::MotionEvent(me) if in_launcher => {
                        // Launcher: the first finger only, in window pixels.
                        let t = match me.action() {
                            MotionAction::Down => Touch::Down,
                            MotionAction::Move => Touch::Move,
                            MotionAction::Up => Touch::Up,
                            MotionAction::Cancel => Touch::Cancel,
                            _ => return InputStatus::Handled,
                        };
                        let p = me.pointer_at_index(0);
                        if t == Touch::Down {
                            log::info!("launcher: touch at ({:.0},{:.0})", p.x(), p.y());
                        }
                        if let Some(r) = launcher.touch(t, p.x() as i32, p.y() as i32) {
                            reqs.push(r);
                        }
                        launcher_dirty = true;
                        InputStatus::Handled
                    }
                    InputEvent::KeyEvent(ke) if in_launcher => {
                        let code: u32 = ke.key_code().into();
                        if ke.action() != KeyAction::Down {
                            return InputStatus::Handled;
                        }
                        launcher_dirty = true;
                        if code == 4 {
                            // Back: sub-page -> Home; on Home close the app.
                            match launcher.back() {
                                (true, r) => reqs.extend(r),
                                (false, _) => reqs.push(Request::Quit),
                            }
                            return InputStatus::Handled;
                        }
                        let mapped = crate::keys::android_to_vk(code);
                        let uni = match app.device_key_character_map(ke.device_id()).and_then(|m| m.get(ke.key_code(), ke.meta_state())) {
                            Ok(KeyMapChar::Unicode(c)) => Some(c),
                            _ => None,
                        };
                        match crate::keys::char_for_key(mapped, uni) {
                            Some(c) => {
                                reqs.extend(launcher.char(c));
                                InputStatus::Handled
                            }
                            None => InputStatus::Unhandled,
                        }
                    }
                    InputEvent::MotionEvent(me) => {
                        // Screen -> game: the presenter's viewport (display mode), or the CPU fallback letterbox.
                        let Some(cur_vp) = *shared.viewport.lock().unwrap() else { return InputStatus::Handled };
                        let vp = match me.action() {
                            MotionAction::PointerDown => *pinch_vp.get_or_insert(cur_vp),
                            MotionAction::Up | MotionAction::Cancel => pinch_vp.take().unwrap_or(cur_vp),
                            _ => pinch_vp.unwrap_or(cur_vp),
                        };
                        let lb = *shared.letterbox.lock().unwrap();
                        let to_game = |x: f32, y: f32| match &lb {
                            Some(l) => l.window_to_game(x, y),
                            None => vp.window_to_game(x, y),
                        };
                        let idx = me.pointer_index();
                        let p = me.pointer_at_index(idx);
                        let win = (p.x(), p.y());
                        let game = to_game(win.0, win.1);
                        // Game + window position (window-layer UI hit-tests in window pixels).
                        let pos = |x: f32, y: f32| {
                            let g = to_game(x, y);
                            (g.0, g.1, x.max(0.0) as i32, y.max(0.0) as i32)
                        };
                        if p.tool_type() == ToolType::Mouse {
                            // Real mouse (ChromeOS, DeX, emulator with a mouse device): map directly.
                            shared.push_event(HostEvent::MouseMove { x: game.0, y: game.1 });
                            let b = me.button_state();
                            let btn = match me.action() {
                                MotionAction::ButtonPress | MotionAction::ButtonRelease => {
                                    let bs: u32 = me.action_button().into();
                                    if bs & 2 != 0 { Some(MouseButton::Right) } else if bs & 4 != 0 { Some(MouseButton::Middle) } else { Some(MouseButton::Left) }
                                }
                                _ => None,
                            };
                            if let Some(button) = btn {
                                let down = me.action() == MotionAction::ButtonPress;
                                log::info!("mouse {button:?} {} at game {game:?}", if down { "down" } else { "up" });
                                shared.push_event(HostEvent::MouseButton { button, down });
                            }
                            let _ = b;
                            return InputStatus::Handled;
                        }
                        let action = match me.action() {
                            MotionAction::Down => Action::Down,
                            MotionAction::PointerDown => Action::PointerDown,
                            MotionAction::Move => Action::Move,
                            MotionAction::PointerUp => Action::PointerUp,
                            MotionAction::Up => Action::Up,
                            MotionAction::Cancel => Action::Cancel,
                            _ => return InputStatus::Handled,
                        };
                        if action == Action::Down && touches_logged < 1000 {
                            touches_logged += 1;
                            log::info!("touch down at window ({:.0},{:.0}) -> game {:?}", win.0, win.1, game);
                        }
                        let all: Vec<(i32, crate::touch::Pos)> =
                            me.pointers().map(|q| (q.pointer_id(), pos(q.x(), q.y()))).collect();
                        for ev in pointer_events(action, (p.pointer_id(), pos(win.0, win.1)), &all) {
                            if pointers.keep(&ev) {
                                shared.push_event(ev);
                            }
                        }
                        InputStatus::Handled
                    }
                    InputEvent::KeyEvent(ke) => {
                        let code: u32 = ke.key_code().into();
                        let down = match ke.action() {
                            KeyAction::Down => true,
                            KeyAction::Up => false,
                            _ => return InputStatus::Unhandled,
                        };
                        let mapped = crate::keys::android_to_vk(code);
                        // Text: the character the key produces with its meta state (soft keyboard, adb input text).
                        let uni = if down {
                            match app.device_key_character_map(ke.device_id()).and_then(|m| m.get(ke.key_code(), ke.meta_state())) {
                                Ok(KeyMapChar::Unicode(c)) => Some(c),
                                _ => None,
                            }
                        } else {
                            None
                        };
                        let ch = if down { crate::keys::char_for_key(mapped, uni) } else { None };
                        let vk = mapped.or_else(|| uni.and_then(crate::keys::vk_for_char));
                        if vk.is_none() && ch.is_none() {
                            return InputStatus::Unhandled;
                        }
                        if ke.repeat_count() == 0 || !down {
                            log::info!("key {code} -> vk {vk:x?} char {ch:x?} {}", if down { "down" } else { "up" });
                        }
                        if let Some(vk) = vk {
                            shared.push_event(HostEvent::Key { vk, down });
                        }
                        if let Some(c) = ch {
                            shared.push_event(HostEvent::Char(c));
                        }
                        InputStatus::Handled
                    }
                    _ => InputStatus::Unhandled,
                });
                if !read {
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        let buzz = std::mem::take(&mut *shared.haptic.lock().unwrap());
        if let Some(&ms) = buzz.iter().max() {
            bgservice::vibrate(&app, ms);
        }
        if shared.keyboard_req.swap(false, Ordering::AcqRel) {
            log::info!("three-finger tap: toggle soft keyboard");
            if let Some(u) = &ui_thread {
                u.soft_keyboard(None, kb_visible.clone());
            }
        }
        {
            let t = now_ms(t0);
            // While the keyboard is believed open, check once a second whether the user closed it.
            if *kb_visible.lock().unwrap() && t >= kb_checked + 1000 {
                kb_checked = t;
                if let Some(u) = &ui_thread {
                    u.refresh_keyboard(kb_visible.clone());
                }
            }
            // Display cutout + high refresh display mode (window manager side; the presenter also asks the surface).
            let hz = shared.display.lock().unwrap().refresh_hz;
            if prefs_hz != Some(hz) && ui_thread.is_some() {
                prefs_hz = Some(hz);
                if let Some(u) = &ui_thread {
                    u.display_prefs(hz, shared.clone());
                }
            }
        }
        if audio_dead.swap(false, Ordering::AcqRel) {
            log::info!("AAudio: reopening stream");
            drop(audio.take());
            audio = open_audio(shared.audio.clone(), audio_dead.clone());
            if paused {
                if let Some(s) = &audio {
                    let _ = s.request_pause();
                }
            }
        }

        // Background play: post new game messages (rate limited), keep the chronometer in sync, and pause like in
        // the menus once the game is over.
        if let Some(b) = &mut bg {
            let t = now_ms(t0);
            let lines = std::mem::take(&mut *shared.bg_lines.lock().unwrap());
            b.push(lines);
            if let Some(l) = b.due(t) {
                log::info!("background play: notify {l:?}");
                bgservice::event(&app, &l, shared.vibrate_messages.load(Ordering::Acquire));
            }
            if shared.in_game.load(Ordering::Acquire) {
                bg_out_of_game = None;
                if let Some(g) = b.drift(t, shared.game_ms.load(Ordering::Acquire)) {
                    log::info!("background play: game time {} s (chronometer re-synced)", g / 1000);
                    bgservice::update(&app, g);
                }
            } else if t.saturating_sub(*bg_out_of_game.get_or_insert(t)) > NOT_IN_GAME_PAUSE_MS {
                log::info!("background play: no longer in a game; pausing");
                bg = None;
                shared.background.store(false, Ordering::Release);
                crate::frontend::background_fps(None);
                bgservice::stop(&app);
                shared.set_paused(true);
            }
        }

        // The engine run ended (Exit Game, error): back to the launcher.
        if engine_thread.is_some() {
            if let Some(end) = shared.engine_end.lock().unwrap().take() {
                if let Some(t) = engine_thread.take() {
                    let _ = t.join();
                }
                log::info!("launcher: engine ended ({}{})", end.title, if end.exited { ", game exited" } else { "" });
                if bg.take().is_some() {
                    shared.background.store(false, Ordering::Release);
                    crate::frontend::background_fps(None);
                    bgservice::stop(&app);
                }
                shared.in_game.store(false, Ordering::Release);
                shared.frame.lock().unwrap().fb = None;
                launcher.message = Some(if end.exited {
                    ("The game was closed. Tap Play to start it again.".to_string(), false)
                } else {
                    let first = end.body.lines().next().unwrap_or("").to_string();
                    (format!("{}: {first}", end.title), true)
                });
                launcher.reload_settings();
                launcher.recheck();
                in_launcher = true;
                launcher_drawn = None;
                launcher_dirty = true;
                if finishing {
                    quit = true;
                }
            }
        }

        if in_launcher && !finishing {
            if !autoplay_checked && start_t.elapsed() > Duration::from_millis(300) {
                autoplay_checked = true;
                if autoplay.load(Ordering::Acquire) && launcher.ready() {
                    log::info!("launcher: autoplay (intent extra play=true)");
                    reqs.push(Request::Play);
                }
            }
            for r in std::mem::take(&mut reqs) {
                log::info!("launcher: {r:?}");
                match r {
                    Request::Play if engine_thread.is_none() => {
                        shared.engine_end.lock().unwrap().take();
                        shared.guest_exited.store(false, Ordering::Release);
                        shared.events.lock().unwrap().clear();
                        shared.frame.lock().unwrap().fb = None;
                        shared.set_status(crate::frontend::Phase::Starting, "Starting", "Loading the game ...");
                        if *kb_visible.lock().unwrap() {
                            if let Some(u) = &ui_thread {
                                u.soft_keyboard(Some(false), kb_visible.clone());
                            }
                        }
                        let sh = shared.clone();
                        let (g, d) = (launcher.game_dir().to_path_buf(), data_dir.clone());
                        engine_thread = Some(
                            std::thread::Builder::new()
                                .name("s3-engine".into())
                                .stack_size(16 << 20)
                                .spawn(move || {
                                    let end = run_engine(sh.clone(), g, d).unwrap_or(EngineEnd {
                                        title: "Stopped".into(),
                                        body: String::new(),
                                        exited: false,
                                    });
                                    *sh.engine_end.lock().unwrap() = Some(end);
                                    (sh.wake)();
                                })
                                .expect("spawn engine thread"),
                        );
                        in_launcher = false;
                        shared.set_launcher(None);
                    }
                    Request::Play => {}
                    Request::Keyboard(show) => {
                        if let Some(u) = &ui_thread {
                            u.soft_keyboard(Some(show), kb_visible.clone());
                        }
                    }
                    // iOS only (folder picker).
                    Request::PickFolder | Request::UseAppFolder => {}
                    Request::Quit => {
                        finishing = true;
                        launcher.stop_upload();
                        match &ui_thread {
                            Some(u) => u.finish(),
                            None => quit = true,
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if in_launcher {
            launcher_dirty |= launcher.tick();
            let size = app.native_window().map(|w| (w.width().max(1) as u32, w.height().max(1) as u32));
            if let Some((w, h)) = size {
                let hz = f32::from_bits(shared.refresh_hz.load(Ordering::Relaxed));
                launcher.refresh_hz = if hz > 0.0 { hz.round() as u32 } else { 0 };
                let key = (w, h, shared.density_dpi.load(Ordering::Relaxed) as u64);
                if launcher_dirty || launcher_drawn.map(|d| (d.0, d.1)) != Some((w, h)) {
                    launcher_dirty = false;
                    let list = launcher.draw(w, h, key.2 as u32);
                    if launcher_drawn != Some((w, h, list.hash)) {
                        launcher_drawn = Some((w, h, list.hash));
                        shared.set_launcher(Some(Arc::new(list)));
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    log::info!("shutting down");
    if bg.is_some() {
        bgservice::stop(&app);
    }
    drop(presenter);
    shared.request_quit();
    if let Some(s) = audio.take() {
        let _ = s.request_stop();
    }
    if let Some(t) = engine_thread.take() {
        let _ = t.join();
    }
    log::info!("bye");
    if finishing {
        // Quit from the launcher: end the process too, so the next launch starts from a clean state.
        std::process::exit(0);
    }
}

```

`port/crates/s3-android/src/bgservice.rs`:

```rs
//! Background play (docs/porting/android.md "Background play"): drives the Java `GameService` (the only Java
//! code of the app, `port/android/java`) with plain intents over JNI.
//!
//! - [`start`]: `startForegroundService(START, game_ms)`, called synchronously from the activity thread while the
//!   `Pause` event is handled (the activity is still visible, so Android 12+ allows the start);
//! - [`update`]: re-sync the chronometer (game speed / in-game pause make game time drift from wall time);
//! - [`event`]: post one "Game events" notification (lines joined with `\n`);
//! - [`stop`]: `stopService` (removes the ongoing and the event notifications);
//! - [`ask_notification_permission`]: `POST_NOTIFICATIONS` runtime request (Android 13+), once per install.

use std::path::Path;

use android_activity::AndroidApp;
use jni::objects::{JObject, JValue};
use jni::{jni_sig, jni_str, Env, JavaVM};

const SERVICE: &str = "com.settlers3port.app.GameService";

fn with_activity(app: &AndroidApp, name: &str, f: impl for<'a> FnOnce(&mut Env<'a>, &JObject<'a>) -> jni::errors::Result<()>) {
    let vm = unsafe { JavaVM::from_raw(app.vm_as_ptr() as *mut _) };
    let activity = app.activity_as_ptr() as usize;
    let r = vm.attach_current_thread(|env: &mut Env| -> jni::errors::Result<()> {
        let act = unsafe { JObject::from_raw(env, activity as jni::sys::jobject) };
        let r = f(env, &act);
        if env.exception_check() {
            env.exception_describe();
            env.exception_clear();
        }
        r
    });
    match r {
        Ok(()) => log::info!("bgservice: {name} ok"),
        Err(e) => log::warn!("bgservice: {name} failed: {e:?}"),
    }
}

/// `new Intent().setClassName(activity, GameService).setAction(action)`.
fn intent<'a>(env: &mut Env<'a>, act: &JObject<'a>, action: Option<&str>) -> jni::errors::Result<JObject<'a>> {
    let it = env.new_object(jni_str!("android/content/Intent"), jni_sig!("()V"), &[])?;
    let cls = env.new_string(SERVICE)?;
    env.call_method(
        &it,
        jni_str!("setClassName"),
        jni_sig!("(Landroid/content/Context;Ljava/lang/String;)Landroid/content/Intent;"),
        &[JValue::Object(act), JValue::Object(&cls)],
    )?;
    if let Some(a) = action {
        let a = env.new_string(format!("com.settlers3port.app.{a}"))?;
        env.call_method(&it, jni_str!("setAction"), jni_sig!("(Ljava/lang/String;)Landroid/content/Intent;"), &[JValue::Object(&a)])?;
    }
    Ok(it)
}

fn put_long<'a>(env: &mut Env<'a>, it: &JObject<'a>, key: &str, v: i64) -> jni::errors::Result<()> {
    let k = env.new_string(key)?;
    env.call_method(it, jni_str!("putExtra"), jni_sig!("(Ljava/lang/String;J)Landroid/content/Intent;"), &[JValue::Object(&k), JValue::Long(v)])?;
    Ok(())
}

/// Start the foreground service with the ongoing notification (chronometer at `game_ms`).
pub fn start(app: &AndroidApp, game_ms: u64) {
    with_activity(app, "start", |env, act| {
        let it = intent(env, act, Some("START"))?;
        put_long(env, &it, "game_ms", game_ms as i64)?;
        env.call_method(act, jni_str!("startForegroundService"), jni_sig!("(Landroid/content/Intent;)Landroid/content/ComponentName;"), &[JValue::Object(&it)])?;
        Ok(())
    });
}

/// Re-sync the chronometer of the running service.
pub fn update(app: &AndroidApp, game_ms: u64) {
    with_activity(app, "update", |env, act| {
        let it = intent(env, act, Some("UPDATE"))?;
        put_long(env, &it, "game_ms", game_ms as i64)?;
        env.call_method(act, jni_str!("startService"), jni_sig!("(Landroid/content/Intent;)Landroid/content/ComponentName;"), &[JValue::Object(&it)])?;
        Ok(())
    });
}

/// One "Game events" notification with these lines.
pub fn event(app: &AndroidApp, lines: &[String], vibrate: bool) {
    let text = lines.join("\n");
    with_activity(app, "event", |env, act| {
        let it = intent(env, act, Some("EVENT"))?;
        put_long(env, &it, "vibrate", vibrate as i64)?;
        let k = env.new_string("text")?;
        let v = env.new_string(&text)?;
        env.call_method(&it, jni_str!("putExtra"), jni_sig!("(Ljava/lang/String;Ljava/lang/String;)Landroid/content/Intent;"), &[JValue::Object(&k), JValue::Object(&v)])?;
        env.call_method(act, jni_str!("startService"), jni_sig!("(Landroid/content/Intent;)Landroid/content/ComponentName;"), &[JValue::Object(&it)])?;
        Ok(())
    });
}

/// Short vibration (touch feedback, game message), `ms` milliseconds (API 26+ `VibrationEffect`).
pub fn vibrate(app: &AndroidApp, ms: u32) {
    let vm = unsafe { JavaVM::from_raw(app.vm_as_ptr() as *mut _) };
    let activity = app.activity_as_ptr() as usize;
    let r = vm.attach_current_thread(|env: &mut Env| -> jni::errors::Result<()> {
        let act = unsafe { JObject::from_raw(env, activity as jni::sys::jobject) };
        let name = env.new_string("vibrator")?;
        let r = env
            .call_method(&act, jni_str!("getSystemService"), jni_sig!("(Ljava/lang/String;)Ljava/lang/Object;"), &[JValue::Object(&name)])
            .and_then(|v| v.l())
            .and_then(|v| {
                if v.is_null() {
                    return Ok(());
                }
                let eff = env
                    .call_static_method(
                        jni_str!("android/os/VibrationEffect"),
                        jni_str!("createOneShot"),
                        jni_sig!("(JI)Landroid/os/VibrationEffect;"),
                        &[JValue::Long(ms as i64), JValue::Int(-1)],
                    )?
                    .l()?;
                env.call_method(&v, jni_str!("vibrate"), jni_sig!("(Landroid/os/VibrationEffect;)V"), &[JValue::Object(&eff)])?;
                Ok(())
            });
        if env.exception_check() {
            env.exception_describe();
            env.exception_clear();
        }
        r
    });
    if let Err(e) = r {
        log::warn!("vibrate failed: {e:?}");
    }
}

/// Stop the service (its notifications go with it).
pub fn stop(app: &AndroidApp) {
    with_activity(app, "stop", |env, act| {
        let it = intent(env, act, None)?;
        env.call_method(act, jni_str!("stopService"), jni_sig!("(Landroid/content/Intent;)Z"), &[JValue::Object(&it)])?;
        Ok(())
    });
}

/// Ask for `POST_NOTIFICATIONS` (Android 13+) once per install (marker file in the data dir). Runs on the UI
/// thread job queue.
pub fn ask_notification_permission(ui: &crate::uithread::UiThread, data_dir: &Path) {
    let marker = data_dir.join("notification-permission-asked.txt");
    if marker.exists() {
        return;
    }
    let _ = std::fs::create_dir_all(data_dir);
    let _ = std::fs::write(&marker, "1\n");
    ui.run("notification permission", Box::new(|env, act| {
        let sdk = env.get_static_field(jni_str!("android/os/Build$VERSION"), jni_str!("SDK_INT"), jni_sig!("I"))?.i()?;
        if sdk < 33 {
            return Ok(());
        }
        let perm = env.new_string("android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS")?;
        let granted = env
            .call_method(act, jni_str!("checkSelfPermission"), jni_sig!("(Ljava/lang/String;)I"), &[JValue::Object(&perm)])?
            .i()?;
        log::info!("notification permission: granted={}", granted == 0);
        if granted != 0 {
            let arr = env.new_object_array(1, jni_str!("java/lang/String"), &perm)?;
            env.call_method(act, jni_str!("requestPermissions"), jni_sig!("([Ljava/lang/String;I)V"), &[JValue::Object(&arr), JValue::Int(1)])?;
        }
        Ok(())
    }));
}
