```rs
    pub fn emit(&mut self, w: u32) {
        self.code.push(w);
    }

    /// Current position in instructions.
    pub fn pos(&self) -> usize {
        self.code.len()
    }

    pub fn label(&mut self) -> Label {
        self.labels.push(None);
        Label(self.labels.len() as u32 - 1)
    }

    pub fn bind(&mut self, l: Label) {
        debug_assert!(self.labels[l.0 as usize].is_none());
        self.labels[l.0 as usize] = Some(self.code.len() as u32);
    }

    pub fn is_bound(&self, l: Label) -> bool {
        self.labels[l.0 as usize].is_some()
    }

    fn fix(&mut self, l: Label, f: Fix) {
        self.fixups.push((self.code.len(), l, f));
    }

    /// Resolve label fixups. Panics if a label is unbound or out of range (a compiler bug).
    pub fn finish(&mut self) {
        for &(at, l, f) in &self.fixups {
            let target = self.labels[l.0 as usize].expect("unbound JIT label");
            let d = target as i64 - at as i64;
            let w = &mut self.code[at];
            match f {
                Fix::B26 => {
                    assert!((-(1 << 25)..(1 << 25)).contains(&d));
                    *w |= (d as u32) & 0x03FF_FFFF;
                }
                Fix::B19 => {
                    assert!((-(1 << 18)..(1 << 18)).contains(&d));
                    *w |= ((d as u32) & 0x7FFFF) << 5;
                }
                Fix::B14 => {
                    assert!((-(1 << 13)..(1 << 13)).contains(&d));
                    *w |= ((d as u32) & 0x3FFF) << 5;
                }
            }
        }
        self.fixups.clear();
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ arithmetic

    fn addsub_imm(&mut self, base: u32, d: R, n: R, imm: u32) {
        if imm < 4096 {
            self.emit(base | (imm << 10) | (n << 5) | d);
        } else {
            assert!(imm & 0xFFF == 0 && imm < (1 << 24), "addsub imm {imm:#x}");
            self.emit(base | (1 << 22) | ((imm >> 12) << 10) | (n << 5) | d);
        }
    }

    /// `add wd, wn, #imm` (imm < 4096 or a multiple of 4096 below 2^24). `n`/`d` 31 = wsp.
    pub fn add_wi(&mut self, d: R, n: R, imm: u32) {
        self.addsub_imm(0x1100_0000, d, n, imm);
    }
    pub fn sub_wi(&mut self, d: R, n: R, imm: u32) {
        self.addsub_imm(0x5100_0000, d, n, imm);
    }
    pub fn subs_wi(&mut self, d: R, n: R, imm: u32) {
        self.addsub_imm(0x7100_0000, d, n, imm);
    }
    pub fn adds_wi(&mut self, d: R, n: R, imm: u32) {
        self.addsub_imm(0x3100_0000, d, n, imm);
    }
    pub fn cmp_wi(&mut self, n: R, imm: u32) {
        self.subs_wi(ZR, n, imm);
    }
    pub fn add_xi(&mut self, d: R, n: R, imm: u32) {
        self.addsub_imm(0x9100_0000, d, n, imm);
    }
    pub fn sub_xi(&mut self, d: R, n: R, imm: u32) {
        self.addsub_imm(0xD100_0000, d, n, imm);
    }
    pub fn cmp_xi(&mut self, n: R, imm: u32) {
        self.addsub_imm(0xF100_0000, ZR, n, imm);
    }

    /// Shifted-register form: shift 0 = lsl, 1 = lsr, 2 = asr.
    fn addsub_reg(&mut self, base: u32, d: R, n: R, m: R, shift: u32, amount: u32) {
        self.emit(base | (shift << 22) | (m << 16) | (amount << 10) | (n << 5) | d);
    }
    pub fn add_w(&mut self, d: R, n: R, m: R) {
        self.addsub_reg(0x0B00_0000, d, n, m, 0, 0);
    }
    pub fn sub_w(&mut self, d: R, n: R, m: R) {
        self.addsub_reg(0x4B00_0000, d, n, m, 0, 0);
    }
    pub fn subs_w(&mut self, d: R, n: R, m: R) {
        self.addsub_reg(0x6B00_0000, d, n, m, 0, 0);
    }
    pub fn adds_w(&mut self, d: R, n: R, m: R) {
        self.addsub_reg(0x2B00_0000, d, n, m, 0, 0);
    }
    /// `add wd, wn, wm, lsl #s`.
    pub fn add_w_lsl(&mut self, d: R, n: R, m: R, s: u32) {
        self.addsub_reg(0x0B00_0000, d, n, m, 0, s);
    }
    pub fn cmp_w(&mut self, n: R, m: R) {
        self.subs_w(ZR, n, m);
    }
    /// `sub wd, wn, wm, lsl #s`.
    pub fn sub_w_lsl(&mut self, d: R, n: R, m: R, s: u32) {
        self.addsub_reg(0x4B00_0000, d, n, m, 0, s);
    }
    /// `cmp wn, wm, lsl #s`.
    pub fn cmp_w_lsl(&mut self, n: R, m: R, s: u32) {
        self.addsub_reg(0x6B00_0000, ZR, n, m, 0, s);
    }
    /// `cmn wn, wm, lsl #s`.
    pub fn cmn_w_lsl(&mut self, n: R, m: R, s: u32) {
        self.addsub_reg(0x2B00_0000, ZR, n, m, 0, s);
    }
    pub fn neg_w(&mut self, d: R, m: R) {
        self.sub_w(d, ZR, m);
    }
    /// `add xd, xn, xm, lsl #s`.
    pub fn add_x_lsl(&mut self, d: R, n: R, m: R, s: u32) {
        self.addsub_reg(0x8B00_0000, d, n, m, 0, s);
    }
    pub fn sub_x(&mut self, d: R, n: R, m: R) {
        self.addsub_reg(0xCB00_0000, d, n, m, 0, 0);
    }
    /// `cmp xn, wm, sxtw` (extended register).
    pub fn cmp_x_sxtw(&mut self, n: R, m: R) {
        self.emit(0xEB20_0000 | (m << 16) | (6 << 13) | (n << 5) | ZR);
    }

    fn logic_reg(&mut self, base: u32, d: R, n: R, m: R, shift: u32, amount: u32) {
        self.emit(base | (shift << 22) | (m << 16) | (amount << 10) | (n << 5) | d);
    }
    pub fn and_w(&mut self, d: R, n: R, m: R) {
        self.logic_reg(0x0A00_0000, d, n, m, 0, 0);
    }
    pub fn bic_w(&mut self, d: R, n: R, m: R) {
        self.logic_reg(0x0A20_0000, d, n, m, 0, 0);
    }
    pub fn orr_w(&mut self, d: R, n: R, m: R) {
        self.logic_reg(0x2A00_0000, d, n, m, 0, 0);
    }
    /// `orr wd, wn, wm, lsl #s`.
    pub fn orr_w_lsl(&mut self, d: R, n: R, m: R, s: u32) {
        self.logic_reg(0x2A00_0000, d, n, m, 0, s);
    }
    pub fn eor_w(&mut self, d: R, n: R, m: R) {
        self.logic_reg(0x4A00_0000, d, n, m, 0, 0);
    }
    /// `eor wd, wn, wm, lsr #s`.
    pub fn eor_w_lsr(&mut self, d: R, n: R, m: R, s: u32) {
        self.logic_reg(0x4A00_0000, d, n, m, 1, s);
    }
    pub fn ands_w(&mut self, d: R, n: R, m: R) {
        self.logic_reg(0x6A00_0000, d, n, m, 0, 0);
    }
    pub fn tst_w(&mut self, n: R, m: R) {
        self.ands_w(ZR, n, m);
    }
    pub fn mvn_w(&mut self, d: R, m: R) {
        self.logic_reg(0x2A20_0000, d, ZR, m, 0, 0);
    }
    pub fn mov_w(&mut self, d: R, m: R) {
        if d != m {
            self.orr_w(d, ZR, m);
        }
    }
    pub fn mov_x(&mut self, d: R, m: R) {
        if d != m {
            self.logic_reg(0xAA00_0000, d, ZR, m, 0, 0);
        }
    }

    fn logic_imm(&mut self, base: u32, d: R, n: R, v: u32) -> bool {
        match logic_imm32(v) {
            Some(f) => {
                self.emit(base | f | (n << 5) | d);
                true
            }
            None => false,
        }
    }
    /// `and wd, wn, #v` if encodable (returns false and emits nothing otherwise).
    pub fn try_and_wi(&mut self, d: R, n: R, v: u32) -> bool {
        self.logic_imm(0x1200_0000, d, n, v)
    }
    pub fn try_orr_wi(&mut self, d: R, n: R, v: u32) -> bool {
        self.logic_imm(0x3200_0000, d, n, v)
    }
    pub fn try_eor_wi(&mut self, d: R, n: R, v: u32) -> bool {
        self.logic_imm(0x5200_0000, d, n, v)
    }
    pub fn try_tst_wi(&mut self, n: R, v: u32) -> bool {
        self.logic_imm(0x7200_0000, ZR, n, v)
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ moves

    pub fn movz_w(&mut self, d: R, imm16: u32, hw: u32) {
        self.emit(0x5280_0000 | (hw << 21) | ((imm16 & 0xFFFF) << 5) | d);
    }
    pub fn movk_w(&mut self, d: R, imm16: u32, hw: u32) {
        self.emit(0x7280_0000 | (hw << 21) | ((imm16 & 0xFFFF) << 5) | d);
    }
    pub fn movn_w(&mut self, d: R, imm16: u32, hw: u32) {
        self.emit(0x1280_0000 | (hw << 21) | ((imm16 & 0xFFFF) << 5) | d);
    }
    /// `wd = v` (1-2 instructions).
    pub fn mov_wi(&mut self, d: R, v: u32) {
        let lo = v & 0xFFFF;
        let hi = v >> 16;
        if hi == 0 {
            self.movz_w(d, lo, 0);
        } else if lo == 0 {
            self.movz_w(d, hi, 1);
        } else if hi == 0xFFFF {
            self.movn_w(d, !v & 0xFFFF, 0);
        } else if lo == 0xFFFF {
            self.movn_w(d, (!v >> 16) & 0xFFFF, 1);
        } else if self.logic_imm(0x3200_0000, d, ZR, v) {
            // orr wd, wzr, #v
        } else {
            self.movz_w(d, lo, 0);
            self.movk_w(d, hi, 1);
        }
    }
    /// `xd = v` (1-4 instructions).
    pub fn mov_xi(&mut self, d: R, v: u64) {
        let mut first = true;
        for hw in 0..4 {
            let part = ((v >> (16 * hw)) & 0xFFFF) as u32;
            if part == 0 {
                continue;
            }
            if first {
                self.emit(0xD280_0000 | (hw << 21) | (part << 5) | d);
                first = false;
            } else {
                self.emit(0xF280_0000 | (hw << 21) | (part << 5) | d);
            }
        }
        if first {
            self.emit(0xD280_0000 | d);
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ bitfield

    fn bfm(&mut self, base: u32, d: R, n: R, immr: u32, imms: u32) {
        self.emit(base | (immr << 16) | (imms << 10) | (n << 5) | d);
    }
    /// `ubfx wd, wn, #lsb, #width`.
    pub fn ubfx_w(&mut self, d: R, n: R, lsb: u32, width: u32) {
        self.bfm(0x5300_0000, d, n, lsb, lsb + width - 1);
    }
    /// `sbfx wd, wn, #lsb, #width`.
    pub fn sbfx_w(&mut self, d: R, n: R, lsb: u32, width: u32) {
        self.bfm(0x1300_0000, d, n, lsb, lsb + width - 1);
    }
    /// `bfi wd, wn, #lsb, #width` (insert the low `width` bits of wn at `lsb`).
    pub fn bfi_w(&mut self, d: R, n: R, lsb: u32, width: u32) {
        self.bfm(0x3300_0000, d, n, (32 - lsb) & 31, width - 1);
    }
    /// `lsl wd, wn, #s` (s in 1..=31).
    pub fn lsl_wi(&mut self, d: R, n: R, s: u32) {
        self.bfm(0x5300_0000, d, n, (32 - s) & 31, 31 - s);
    }
    pub fn lsr_wi(&mut self, d: R, n: R, s: u32) {
        self.bfm(0x5300_0000, d, n, s, 31);
    }
    pub fn asr_wi(&mut self, d: R, n: R, s: u32) {
        self.bfm(0x1300_0000, d, n, s, 31);
    }
    /// `lsr xd, xn, #s`.
    pub fn lsr_xi(&mut self, d: R, n: R, s: u32) {
        self.bfm(0xD340_0000, d, n, s, 63);
    }
    pub fn uxtb_w(&mut self, d: R, n: R) {
        self.ubfx_w(d, n, 0, 8);
    }
    pub fn uxth_w(&mut self, d: R, n: R) {
        self.ubfx_w(d, n, 0, 16);
    }
    pub fn sxtb_w(&mut self, d: R, n: R) {
        self.sbfx_w(d, n, 0, 8);
    }
    pub fn sxth_w(&mut self, d: R, n: R) {
        self.sbfx_w(d, n, 0, 16);
    }

    /// Variable shifts (count mod 32): `lslv/lsrv/asrv wd, wn, wm`.
    pub fn lslv_w(&mut self, d: R, n: R, m: R) {
        self.emit(0x1AC0_2000 | (m << 16) | (n << 5) | d);
    }
    pub fn lsrv_w(&mut self, d: R, n: R, m: R) {
        self.emit(0x1AC0_2400 | (m << 16) | (n << 5) | d);
    }
    pub fn asrv_w(&mut self, d: R, n: R, m: R) {
        self.emit(0x1AC0_2800 | (m << 16) | (n << 5) | d);
    }
    pub fn lslv_x(&mut self, d: R, n: R, m: R) {
        self.emit(0x9AC0_2000 | (m << 16) | (n << 5) | d);
    }
    pub fn lsrv_x(&mut self, d: R, n: R, m: R) {
        self.emit(0x9AC0_2400 | (m << 16) | (n << 5) | d);
    }
    pub fn asrv_x(&mut self, d: R, n: R, m: R) {
        self.emit(0x9AC0_2800 | (m << 16) | (n << 5) | d);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ select / mul

    pub fn csel_w(&mut self, d: R, n: R, m: R, c: Cond) {
        self.emit(0x1A80_0000 | (m << 16) | ((c as u32) << 12) | (n << 5) | d);
    }
    pub fn csinc_w(&mut self, d: R, n: R, m: R, c: Cond) {
        self.emit(0x1A80_0400 | (m << 16) | ((c as u32) << 12) | (n << 5) | d);
    }
    /// `cset wd, c` (wd = c ? 1 : 0).
    pub fn cset_w(&mut self, d: R, c: Cond) {
        self.csinc_w(d, ZR, ZR, c.invert());
    }
    pub fn mul_w(&mut self, d: R, n: R, m: R) {
        self.emit(0x1B00_0000 | (m << 16) | (ZR << 10) | (n << 5) | d);
    }
    /// `smull xd, wn, wm`.
    pub fn smull(&mut self, d: R, n: R, m: R) {
        self.emit(0x9B20_0000 | (m << 16) | (ZR << 10) | (n << 5) | d);
    }
    /// `udiv xd, xn, xm`.
    pub fn udiv_x(&mut self, d: R, n: R, m: R) {
        self.emit(0x9AC0_0800 | (m << 16) | (n << 5) | d);
    }
    /// `sdiv xd, xn, xm`.
    pub fn sdiv_x(&mut self, d: R, n: R, m: R) {
        self.emit(0x9AC0_0C00 | (m << 16) | (n << 5) | d);
    }
    /// `msub xd, xn, xm, xa` (xd = xa - xn * xm).
    pub fn msub_x(&mut self, d: R, n: R, m: R, a: R) {
        self.emit(0x9B00_8000 | (m << 16) | (a << 10) | (n << 5) | d);
    }
    /// `sxtw xd, wn`.
    pub fn sxtw_x(&mut self, d: R, n: R) {
        self.emit(0x9340_7C00 | (n << 5) | d);
    }
    /// `orr xd, xn, xm, lsl #s`.
    pub fn orr_x_lsl(&mut self, d: R, n: R, m: R, s: u32) {
        self.logic_reg(0xAA00_0000, d, n, m, 0, s);
    }
    /// `cmp xn, xm`.
    pub fn cmp_x(&mut self, n: R, m: R) {
        self.addsub_reg(0xEB00_0000, ZR, n, m, 0, 0);
    }
    /// `umull xd, wn, wm`.
    pub fn umull(&mut self, d: R, n: R, m: R) {
        self.emit(0x9BA0_0000 | (m << 16) | (ZR << 10) | (n << 5) | d);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ memory

    /// Unsigned-offset load/store; `size` 1/2/4/8 bytes, `off` in bytes (multiple of size, < 4096*size).
    fn ldst_uoff(&mut self, base: u32, t: R, n: R, off: u32, size: u32) {
        assert!(off % size == 0 && off / size < 4096, "ldst offset {off}");
        self.emit(base | ((off / size) << 10) | (n << 5) | t);
    }
    pub fn ldr_w(&mut self, t: R, n: R, off: u32) {
        self.ldst_uoff(0xB940_0000, t, n, off, 4);
    }
    pub fn str_w(&mut self, t: R, n: R, off: u32) {
        self.ldst_uoff(0xB900_0000, t, n, off, 4);
    }
    pub fn ldr_x(&mut self, t: R, n: R, off: u32) {
        self.ldst_uoff(0xF940_0000, t, n, off, 8);
    }
    pub fn str_x(&mut self, t: R, n: R, off: u32) {
        self.ldst_uoff(0xF900_0000, t, n, off, 8);
    }
    pub fn ldrb(&mut self, t: R, n: R, off: u32) {
        self.ldst_uoff(0x3940_0000, t, n, off, 1);
    }
    pub fn strb(&mut self, t: R, n: R, off: u32) {
        self.ldst_uoff(0x3900_0000, t, n, off, 1);
    }
    pub fn strh(&mut self, t: R, n: R, off: u32) {
        self.ldst_uoff(0x7900_0000, t, n, off, 2);
    }

    /// Register-offset load/store `[xn, wm, uxtw]`: `base` selects size/kind.
    fn ldst_reg_uxtw(&mut self, base: u32, t: R, n: R, m: R) {
        self.emit(base | (m << 16) | (2 << 13) | (n << 5) | t);
    }
    /// Guest load of `size` bytes (zero-extended; `signed` sign-extends 1/2-byte loads to 32 bits):
    /// `ldr{b,h,sb,sh} wt, [xbase, wa, uxtw]`.
    pub fn ld_guest(&mut self, t: R, base: R, a: R, size: u32, signed: bool) {
        let op = match (size, signed) {
            (1, false) => 0x3860_0800,
            (1, true) => 0x38E0_0800,
            (2, false) => 0x7860_0800,
            (2, true) => 0x78E0_0800,
            _ => 0xB860_0800,
        };
        self.ldst_reg_uxtw(op, t, base, a);
    }
    /// Guest store of `size` bytes: `str{b,h} wt, [xbase, wa, uxtw]`.
    pub fn st_guest(&mut self, t: R, base: R, a: R, size: u32) {
        let op = match size {
            1 => 0x3820_0800,
            2 => 0x7820_0800,
            _ => 0xB820_0800,
        };
        self.ldst_reg_uxtw(op, t, base, a);
    }
    /// `ldr xt, [xn, xm, lsl #3]`.
    pub fn ldr_x_idx(&mut self, t: R, n: R, m: R) {
        self.emit(0xF860_0800 | (m << 16) | (3 << 13) | (1 << 12) | (n << 5) | t);
    }

    /// `stp/ldp` with signed offset; `x` = 64-bit registers.
    fn ldstp(&mut self, base: u32, t1: R, t2: R, n: R, off: i32, x: bool) {
        let sc = if x { 8 } else { 4 };
        assert!(off % sc == 0 && (-64..64).contains(&(off / sc)), "ldp/stp offset {off}");
        let imm7 = ((off / sc) as u32) & 0x7F;
        self.emit(base | (imm7 << 15) | (t2 << 10) | (n << 5) | t1);
    }
    pub fn stp_w(&mut self, t1: R, t2: R, n: R, off: i32) {
        self.ldstp(0x2900_0000, t1, t2, n, off, false);
    }
    pub fn ldp_w(&mut self, t1: R, t2: R, n: R, off: i32) {
        self.ldstp(0x2940_0000, t1, t2, n, off, false);
    }
    pub fn stp_x(&mut self, t1: R, t2: R, n: R, off: i32) {
        self.ldstp(0xA900_0000, t1, t2, n, off, true);
    }
    pub fn ldp_x(&mut self, t1: R, t2: R, n: R, off: i32) {
        self.ldstp(0xA940_0000, t1, t2, n, off, true);
    }
    /// `stp xt1, xt2, [xn, #off]!`.
    pub fn stp_x_pre(&mut self, t1: R, t2: R, n: R, off: i32) {
        self.ldstp(0xA980_0000, t1, t2, n, off, true);
    }
    /// `ldp xt1, xt2, [xn], #off`.
    pub fn ldp_x_post(&mut self, t1: R, t2: R, n: R, off: i32) {
        self.ldstp(0xA8C0_0000, t1, t2, n, off, true);
    }
    /// `ldr xt, <label>` (PC-relative literal).
    pub fn ldr_x_lit(&mut self, t: R, l: Label) {
        self.fix(l, Fix::B19);
        self.emit(0x5800_0000 | t);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ branches

    pub fn b(&mut self, l: Label) {
        self.fix(l, Fix::B26);
        self.emit(0x1400_0000);
    }
    pub fn b_cond(&mut self, c: Cond, l: Label) {
        self.fix(l, Fix::B19);
        self.emit(0x5400_0000 | c as u32);
    }
    pub fn cbz_w(&mut self, t: R, l: Label) {
        self.fix(l, Fix::B19);
        self.emit(0x3400_0000 | t);
    }
    pub fn cbz_x(&mut self, t: R, l: Label) {
        self.fix(l, Fix::B19);
        self.emit(0xB400_0000 | t);
    }
    pub fn cbnz_w(&mut self, t: R, l: Label) {
        self.fix(l, Fix::B19);
        self.emit(0x3500_0000 | t);
    }
    /// `tbz/tbnz wt, #bit, label`.
    pub fn tbz(&mut self, t: R, bit: u32, l: Label) {
        self.fix(l, Fix::B14);
        self.emit(0x3600_0000 | ((bit & 31) << 19) | t);
    }
    pub fn tbnz(&mut self, t: R, bit: u32, l: Label) {
        self.fix(l, Fix::B14);
        self.emit(0x3700_0000 | ((bit & 31) << 19) | t);
    }
    pub fn br(&mut self, n: R) {
        self.emit(0xD61F_0000 | (n << 5));
    }
    pub fn blr(&mut self, n: R) {
        self.emit(0xD63F_0000 | (n << 5));
    }
    pub fn ret(&mut self) {
        self.emit(0xD65F_03C0);
    }
    pub fn brk(&mut self) {
        self.emit(0xD420_0000);
    }

    /// Emit a 64-bit literal (8-byte aligned) at a label.
    pub fn literal64(&mut self, l: Label, v: u64) {
        if self.code.len() % 2 != 0 {
            self.emit(0xD503_201F); // nop (alignment)
        }
        self.bind(l);
        self.emit(v as u32);
        self.emit((v >> 32) as u32);
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    /// Reference encodings from the ARM ARM (checked with clang/llvm-objdump).
    #[test]
    fn encodings() {
        let mut a = Asm::new();
        a.try_and_wi(0, 1, 0xFF); // and w0, w1, #0xff
        a.add_wi(2, 3, 4); // add w2, w3, #4
        a.sub_wi(2, 3, 0x1000); // sub w2, w3, #1, lsl #12
        a.cmp_wi(16, 0x10000); // cmp w16, #16, lsl #12
        a.ldr_w(19, 27, 8); // ldr w19, [x27, #8]
        a.ld_guest(1, 28, 16, 4, false); // ldr w1, [x28, w16, uxtw]
        a.st_guest(1, 28, 16, 1); // strb w1, [x28, w16, uxtw]
        a.bfi_w(19, 11, 8, 8); // bfi w19, w11, #8, #8
        a.ubfx_w(0, 19, 8, 8); // ubfx w0, w19, #8, #8
        a.lsl_wi(0, 1, 24); // lsl w0, w1, #24
        a.cset_w(5, Cond::Lo); // cset w5, lo
        a.mov_wi(3, 0x7e8dec); // mov w3, #0x8dec ; movk w3, #0x7e, lsl #16
        a.stp_x_pre(29, 30, SP, -16); // stp x29, x30, [sp, #-16]!
        a.ldp_x_post(29, 30, SP, 16); // ldp x29, x30, [sp], #16
        assert_eq!(
            a.code,
            vec![
                0x1200_1C20,
                0x1100_1062,
                0x5140_0462,
                0x7140_421F,
                0xB940_0B73,
                0xB870_4B81,
                0x3830_4B81,
                0x3318_1D73,
                0x5308_3E60,
                0x5308_1C20,
                0x1A9F_27E5,
                0x5291_BD83,
                0x72A0_0FC3,
                0xA9BF_7BFD,
                0xA8C1_7BFD,
            ]
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn logic_immediates() {
        // Decode N:immr:imms back and compare (32-bit, N = 0).
        fn decode(f: u32) -> u32 {
            let immr = (f >> 16) & 0x3f;
            let imms = (f >> 10) & 0x3f;
            let len = 31 - ((!imms) & 0x3f | 0x40).leading_zeros() as i32 + 26; // highest set bit of (~imms & 0x3f)
            let _ = len;
            let mut size = 32u32;
            while size > 1 && (imms & size) != 0 && size != 32 {
                size >>= 1;
            }
            // Element size from the leading ones of imms.
            let esize = if imms & 0x20 == 0 {
                32
            } else if imms & 0x10 == 0 {
                16
            } else if imms & 0x08 == 0 {
                8
            } else if imms & 0x04 == 0 {
                4
            } else {
                2
            };
            let s = imms & (esize - 1);
            let r = immr & (esize - 1);
            let ones: u64 = (1u64 << (s + 1)) - 1;
            let m: u64 = if esize == 32 { 0xFFFF_FFFF } else { (1u64 << esize) - 1 };
            let elt = if r == 0 { ones } else { ((ones >> r) | (ones << (esize - r))) & m };
            let mut v = 0u64;
            let mut p = 0;
            while p < 32 {
                v |= elt << p;
                p += esize;
            }
            v as u32
        }
        for v in
            [0xFFu32, 0xFFFF, 0x10, 0x40, 0x8D5, 0x8000_0000, 0xFFFF_FF00, 0x5555_5555, 0x0F0F_0F0F, 0x7FFF_FFFF, 0xFFF]
        {
            match logic_imm32(v) {
                Some(f) => assert_eq!(decode(f), v, "{v:#x}"),
                None => assert!(v == 0x8D5, "{v:#x} should encode"),
            }
        }
        // Random bit patterns: whenever an encoding is returned it must decode to the value.
        let mut x = 0x1234_5678u32;
        for _ in 0..100_000 {
            x ^= x << 13;
            x ^= x >> 17;
            x ^= x << 5;
            if let Some(f) = logic_imm32(x) {
                assert_eq!(decode(f), x);
            }
        }
    }
}

```

`port/crates/s3-cpu/src/jit/compile.rs`:

```rs
//! Block compiler: one decoded [`Block`] -> AArch64 code (see `mod.rs` for the model).
//!
//! Every native translation mirrors the interpreter's fast handler for the same form (`fast.rs`), which by its
//! contract equals `exec::step`. Only instructions whose `Op` uses a fast handler are translated natively (so
//! `cur_ip`, which only the generic path maintains, stays identical); everything else calls the interpreter.
//!
//! Register use: x19..x26 guest EAX..EDI, x27 `Cpu`, x28 guest memory base, x13 remaining budget,
//! x9/x10/x11 lazy-flag operands la/lb/lr (x9 = status bits in the `Eager` state), x12 lcf,
//! x14/x15/x17 temporaries, x16 address temporary, x0..x8 more temporaries.

use iced_x86::{Code, ConditionCode, FlowControl, Instruction, Mnemonic, OpKind};

use super::a64::{Asm, Cond, Label, R, SP, ZR};
use super::*;
use crate::fast::{self, Op, E_BASE, E_BI, E_DISP};
use crate::flags::lk;
use crate::{fl, layout, Block};

const CPU: R = 27;
const MEM: R = 28;
const LEFT: R = 13;
const FA: R = 9;
const FB: R = 10;
const FR: R = 11;
const FC: R = 12;
const T0: R = 14;
const T1: R = 15;
const AD: R = 16;
const T3: R = 17;
/// Saved branch target / helper temporaries.
const W5: R = 5;

#[inline]
fn g(r: u8) -> R {
    19 + (r & 7) as R
}

/// Compile-time location of the status flags.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Debug)]
enum Fl {
    /// In the `Cpu` (lazy or materialised), as the interpreter left them.
    Cpu,
    /// Lazy kind + operand size; operands in FA/FB/FR (+ FC for inc/dec), not yet stored.
    Lazy(u8, u32),
    /// Materialised status bits (CF PF AF ZF SF OF) in FA (`lk = NONE` once stored).
    Eager,
}

/// A condition after its compare was emitted.
enum Cc {
    Always,
    Never,
    If(Cond),
}

/// Memory operand (EA form, base, index, shift, displacement), as `fast::mem_op` returns it.
type M = (u8, u8, u8, u8, u32);

struct C<'a> {
    a: Asm,
    jit: &'a mut Jit,
    blk: &'a Block,
    fl: Fl,
    /// Index of the instruction being compiled.
    i: u32,
    /// Side-exit label of the current instruction (created on first check).
    cur_side: Option<Label>,
    side: Vec<(Label, u32, Fl)>,
    fails: Vec<(Label, u32)>,
    lits: Vec<(Label, u64)>,
    miss: Option<Label>,
    ended: bool,
}

/// Compile `blk` for execution at address `base`. Returns the code and the offset (in instructions) of the
/// block body; for a native-fast-path block the code starts with a stub that calls the native function first
/// (what the run loop does at a block entry) and continues in the body when it declines.
pub(super) fn compile(jit: &mut Jit, blk: &Block, base: usize) -> (Vec<u32>, usize) {
    let mut c = C {
        a: Asm::new_at(base),
        jit,
        blk,
        fl: Fl::Cpu,
        i: 0,
        cur_side: None,
        side: Vec::new(),
        fails: Vec::new(),
        lits: Vec::new(),
        miss: None,
        ended: false,
    };
    let n = blk.n;
    let budget = c.a.label();
    if blk.native.is_some() {
        c.native_stub(budget);
    }
    let body = c.a.pos();
    // Budget: the whole block must fit, else the run loop runs it partially through the interpreter.
    c.a.cmp_xi(LEFT, n);
    c.a.b_cond(Cond::Lo, budget);
    for i in 0..n as usize {
        c.i = i as u32;
        c.cur_side = None;
        let ins = &blk.insns[i];
        let op = &blk.ops[i];
        let last = i + 1 == n as usize;
        if !c.native(ins, op) {
            c.fallback(ins, last);
        }
        if c.ended {
            break;
        }
    }
    if !c.ended {
        c.end_block();
        c.link(blk.end);
    }
    // Out-of-line stubs.
    c.a.bind(budget);
    c.a.mov_wi(0, blk.start);
    c.a.b_abs(c.jit.exit_eip);
    if let Some(l) = c.miss {
        c.a.bind(l);
        c.a.b_abs(c.jit.exit_eip);
    }
    let blk_lit = c.lit(blk as *const Block as u64);
    for (l, i, f) in std::mem::take(&mut c.side) {
        c.a.bind(l);
        c.flush(f);
        c.exit_at(blk_lit, i, EXIT_SIDE);
    }
    for (l, i) in std::mem::take(&mut c.fails) {
        c.a.bind(l);
        c.exit_at(blk_lit, i, EXIT_FAIL);
    }
    for (l, v) in std::mem::take(&mut c.lits) {
        c.a.literal64(l, v);
    }
    c.a.finish();
    (c.a.code, body)
}

impl C<'_> {
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- infrastructure

    fn lit(&mut self, v: u64) -> Label {
        if let Some(&(l, _)) = self.lits.iter().find(|e| e.1 == v) {
            return l;
        }
        let l = self.a.label();
        self.lits.push((l, v));
        l
    }

    /// Exit to the run loop at instruction `i` of this block (`code` = EXIT_SIDE / EXIT_FAIL).
    fn exit_at(&mut self, blk_lit: Label, i: u32, code: u32) {
        self.a.ldr_x_lit(T3, blk_lit);
        self.a.str_x(T3, CPU, OFF_BLK);
        self.a.mov_wi(T3, i);
        self.a.str_w(T3, CPU, OFF_IDX);
        self.a.mov_wi(0, code);
        self.a.b_abs(self.jit.exit_common);
    }

    /// Side-exit label of the current instruction (flags as at its start).
    fn side(&mut self) -> Label {
        if let Some(l) = self.cur_side {
            return l;
        }
        let l = self.a.label();
        self.side.push((l, self.i, self.fl));
        self.cur_side = Some(l);
        l
    }

    /// Fault check: guest address in `r` below the NULL guard -> side exit.
    fn check(&mut self, r: R) {
        let l = self.side();
        self.a.cmp_wi(r, layout::NULL_GUARD_END);
        self.a.b_cond(Cond::Lo, l);
    }

    /// `dst = src + v` (32-bit, any v).
    fn add_imm(&mut self, dst: R, src: R, v: u32) {
        if v == 0 {
            self.a.mov_w(dst, src);
        } else if v < 4096 {
            self.a.add_wi(dst, src, v);
        } else if v.wrapping_neg() < 4096 {
            self.a.sub_wi(dst, src, v.wrapping_neg());
        } else if v & 0xFFF == 0 && v < (1 << 24) {
            self.a.add_wi(dst, src, v);
        } else {
            self.a.mov_wi(T3, v);
            self.a.add_w(dst, src, T3);
        }
    }

    /// Effective address into `dst` (or the base register itself for `[reg]`). `None` = a constant address in
    /// the NULL guard: an unconditional side exit was emitted and the block ends here.
    fn ea(&mut self, m: M, dst: R) -> Option<R> {
        let (e, b, x, s, d) = m;
        match e {
            E_DISP => {
                if d < layout::NULL_GUARD_END {
                    let l = self.side();
                    self.a.b(l);
                    self.ended = true;
                    return None;
                }
                self.a.mov_wi(dst, d);
                return Some(dst);
            }
            E_BASE => {
                if d == 0 && dst == AD {
                    return Some(g(b));
                }
                self.add_imm(dst, g(b), d);
            }
            E_BI => {
                if d != 0 && !(d < 4096 || d.wrapping_neg() < 4096) {
                    self.a.mov_wi(T3, d);
                    self.a.add_w_lsl(dst, g(b), g(x), s as u32);
                    self.a.add_w(dst, dst, T3);
                } else {
                    self.a.add_w_lsl(dst, g(b), g(x), s as u32);
                    self.add_imm(dst, dst, d);
                }
            }
            _ => {
                self.a.mov_wi(T3, d);
                self.a.add_w_lsl(dst, T3, g(x), s as u32);
            }
        }
        Some(dst)
    }

    /// Effective address of a memory access, with its fault check (E_DISP constants need none).
    fn addr(&mut self, m: M) -> Option<R> {
        let r = self.ea(m, AD)?;
        if m.0 != E_DISP {
            self.check(r);
        }
        Some(r)
    }

    /// Zero-extended value of an 8/16/32-bit guest register (32-bit: the register itself, else into `tmp`).
    fn read(&mut self, sz: u32, r: u8, tmp: R) -> R {
        match sz {
            4 => g(r),
            2 => {
                self.a.uxth_w(tmp, g(r));
                tmp
            }
            _ => {
                if r < 4 {
                    self.a.uxtb_w(tmp, g(r));
                } else {
                    self.a.ubfx_w(tmp, g(r & 3), 8, 8);
                }
                tmp
            }
        }
    }

    /// Write the low `sz` bytes of `src` to a guest register (partial registers merge).
    fn write(&mut self, sz: u32, r: u8, src: R) {
        match sz {
            4 => self.a.mov_w(g(r), src),
            2 => self.a.bfi_w(g(r), src, 0, 16),
            _ => {
                if r < 4 {
                    self.a.bfi_w(g(r), src, 0, 8);
                } else {
                    self.a.bfi_w(g(r & 3), src, 8, 8);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /// Call `f(cpu, x1)` (an `extern "C"` helper). Clobbers x0..x17 except x13 (saved).
    fn call(&mut self, f: usize, x1: Option<u64>) {
        self.a.str_x(LEFT, SP, SAVE_LEFT);
        self.a.mov_x(0, CPU);
        if let Some(v) = x1 {
            let l = self.lit(v);
            self.a.ldr_x_lit(1, l);
        }
        let l = self.lit(f as u64);
        self.a.ldr_x_lit(AD, l);
        self.a.blr(AD);
        self.a.ldr_x(LEFT, SP, SAVE_LEFT);
    }

    fn store_regs(&mut self) {
        for k in 0..4 {
            self.a.stp_w(19 + 2 * k, 20 + 2 * k, CPU, (OFF_REGS + 8 * k) as i32);
        }
    }

    fn load_regs(&mut self) {
        for k in 0..4 {
            self.a.ldp_w(19 + 2 * k, 20 + 2 * k, CPU, (OFF_REGS + 8 * k) as i32);
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ flags

    /// Store the flag state `f` into the `Cpu` (interpreter format). Does not change NZCV.
    fn flush(&mut self, f: Fl) {
        match f {
            Fl::Cpu => {}
            Fl::Lazy(k, sz) => {
                self.a.mov_wi(T0, k as u32 | (sz << 8));
                self.a.strh(T0, CPU, OFF_LK);
                self.a.stp_w(FA, FB, CPU, OFF_LA as i32);
                self.a.str_w(FR, CPU, OFF_LR);
                if k == lk::INC || k == lk::DEC {
                    self.a.str_w(FC, CPU, OFF_LCF);
                }
            }
            Fl::Eager => {
                self.a.ldr_w(T0, CPU, OFF_EF);
                self.a.mov_wi(T1, fl::STATUS);
                self.a.bic_w(T0, T0, T1);
                self.a.orr_w(T0, T0, FA);
                self.a.str_w(T0, CPU, OFF_EF);
                self.a.strb(ZR, CPU, OFF_LK);
            }
        }
    }

    /// FC = CF of the current flag state (before an inc/dec). Clobbers T0, T1, T3.
    fn cf_into_fc(&mut self) {
        match self.fl {
            Fl::Lazy(lk::ADD, _) => {
                self.a.cmp_w(FR, FA);
                self.a.cset_w(FC, Cond::Lo);
            }
            Fl::Lazy(lk::SUB, _) => {
                self.a.cmp_w(FA, FB);
                self.a.cset_w(FC, Cond::Lo);
            }
            Fl::Lazy(lk::LOGIC, _) => self.a.movz_w(FC, 0, 0),
            Fl::Lazy(..) => {}
            Fl::Eager => {
                self.a.try_and_wi(FC, FA, 1);
            }
            Fl::Cpu => {
                let (l_ef, l_zero, l_lcf, done) = (self.a.label(), self.a.label(), self.a.label(), self.a.label());
                self.a.ldrb(T0, CPU, OFF_LK);
                self.a.cbz_w(T0, l_ef);
                self.a.cmp_wi(T0, lk::LOGIC as u32);
                self.a.b_cond(Cond::Hi, l_lcf);
                self.a.b_cond(Cond::Eq, l_zero);
                self.a.ldr_w(T1, CPU, OFF_LA);
                self.a.ldr_w(T3, CPU, OFF_LB);
                self.a.ldr_w(FC, CPU, OFF_LR);
                self.a.cmp_wi(T0, lk::ADD as u32);
                self.a.csel_w(T0, FC, T1, Cond::Eq); // ADD: lr < la, SUB: la < lb
                self.a.csel_w(T1, T1, T3, Cond::Eq);
                self.a.cmp_w(T0, T1);
                self.a.cset_w(FC, Cond::Lo);
                self.a.b(done);
                self.a.bind(l_ef);
                self.a.ldr_w(FC, CPU, OFF_EF);
                self.a.try_and_wi(FC, FC, fl::CF);
                self.a.b(done);
                self.a.bind(l_zero);
                self.a.movz_w(FC, 0, 0);
                self.a.b(done);
                self.a.bind(l_lcf);
                self.a.ldr_w(FC, CPU, OFF_LCF);
                self.a.bind(done);
            }
        }
    }

    /// `dst` = AF (0 or 0x10) of the current flag state. Clobbers T3 (dst must not be T3).
    fn af_into(&mut self, dst: R) {
        match self.fl {
            Fl::Lazy(lk::LOGIC, _) => self.a.movz_w(dst, 0, 0),
            Fl::Lazy(..) => {
                self.a.eor_w(dst, FA, FB);
                self.a.eor_w(dst, dst, FR);
                self.a.try_and_wi(dst, dst, fl::AF);
            }
            Fl::Eager => {
                self.a.try_and_wi(dst, FA, fl::AF);
            }
            Fl::Cpu => {
                let (l_none, l_zero, done) = (self.a.label(), self.a.label(), self.a.label());
                self.a.ldrb(T3, CPU, OFF_LK);
                self.a.cbz_w(T3, l_none);
                self.a.cmp_wi(T3, lk::LOGIC as u32);
                self.a.b_cond(Cond::Eq, l_zero);
                self.a.ldr_w(dst, CPU, OFF_LA);
                self.a.ldr_w(T3, CPU, OFF_LB);
                self.a.eor_w(dst, dst, T3);
                self.a.ldr_w(T3, CPU, OFF_LR);
                self.a.eor_w(dst, dst, T3);
                self.a.try_and_wi(dst, dst, fl::AF);
                self.a.b(done);
                self.a.bind(l_none);
                self.a.ldr_w(dst, CPU, OFF_EF);
                self.a.try_and_wi(dst, dst, fl::AF);
                self.a.b(done);
                self.a.bind(l_zero);
                self.a.movz_w(dst, 0, 0);
                self.a.bind(done);
            }
        }
    }

    /// `acc |= SF | ZF | PF` of the 32-bit result `r`. Clobbers T0.
    fn szp_or(&mut self, acc: R, r: R) {
        self.szp_or_n(acc, r, 4);
    }

    /// `acc |= SF | ZF | PF` of the masked `sz`-byte result `r`. Clobbers T0.
    fn szp_or_n(&mut self, acc: R, r: R, sz: u32) {
        self.a.ubfx_w(T0, r, 8 * sz - 1, 1);
        self.a.orr_w_lsl(acc, acc, T0, 7);
        self.a.cmp_wi(r, 0);
        self.a.cset_w(T0, Cond::Eq);
        self.a.orr_w_lsl(acc, acc, T0, 6);
        self.parity_odd(T0, r);
        self.a.mvn_w(T0, T0);
        self.a.try_and_wi(T0, T0, 1);
        self.a.orr_w_lsl(acc, acc, T0, 2);
    }

    /// Bit 0 of `dst` = 1 if the low byte of `r` has an odd number of ones.
    fn parity_odd(&mut self, dst: R, r: R) {
        self.a.eor_w_lsr(dst, r, r, 4);
        self.a.eor_w_lsr(dst, dst, dst, 2);
        self.a.eor_w_lsr(dst, dst, dst, 1);
    }

    /// Emit the compare for condition `cc` on the current flag state.
    fn cond(&mut self, cc: ConditionCode) -> Cc {
        use ConditionCode as K;
        match self.fl {
            Fl::Cpu => {
                self.call(jit_cond as *const () as usize, Some(cc as u8 as u64));
                self.a.cmp_wi(0, 0);
                Cc::If(Cond::Ne)
            }
            Fl::Eager => {
                let bit = |c: K| match c {
                    K::o | K::no => Some(fl::OF),
                    K::b | K::ae => Some(fl::CF),
                    K::e | K::ne => Some(fl::ZF),
                    K::s | K::ns => Some(fl::SF),
                    K::p | K::np => Some(fl::PF),
                    _ => None,
                };
                let set = matches!(cc, K::o | K::b | K::e | K::s | K::p | K::be | K::l | K::le);
                if let Some(b) = bit(cc) {
                    self.a.try_tst_wi(FA, b);
                } else {
                    match cc {
                        K::be | K::a => {
                            self.a.mov_wi(T1, fl::CF | fl::ZF);
                            self.a.tst_w(FA, T1);
                        }
                        K::l | K::ge => {
                            self.a.ubfx_w(T0, FA, 7, 1);
                            self.a.ubfx_w(T1, FA, 11, 1);
                            self.a.cmp_w(T0, T1);
                        }
                        _ => {
                            // le / g: ZF || SF != OF
                            self.a.ubfx_w(T0, FA, 7, 1);
                            self.a.ubfx_w(T1, FA, 11, 1);
                            self.a.eor_w(T0, T0, T1);
                            self.a.ubfx_w(T1, FA, 6, 1);
                            self.a.orr_w(T0, T0, T1);
                            self.a.cmp_wi(T0, 0);
                        }
                    }
                }
                Cc::If(if set { Cond::Ne } else { Cond::Eq })
            }
            Fl::Lazy(k, sz) => self.cond_lazy(k, sz, cc),
        }
    }

    fn cond_lazy(&mut self, k: u8, sz: u32, cc: ConditionCode) -> Cc {
        use ConditionCode as K;
        let sh = 32 - 8 * sz;
        let sb = 1u32 << (8 * sz - 1);
        match cc {
            K::e | K::ne => {
                self.a.cmp_wi(FR, 0);
                return Cc::If(if cc == K::e { Cond::Eq } else { Cond::Ne });
            }
            K::s | K::ns => {
                self.a.try_tst_wi(FR, sb);
                return Cc::If(if cc == K::s { Cond::Ne } else { Cond::Eq });
            }
            K::p | K::np => {
                self.parity_odd(T0, FR);
                self.a.try_tst_wi(T0, 1);
                return Cc::If(if cc == K::p { Cond::Eq } else { Cond::Ne });
            }
            _ => {}
        }
        // Signed / overflow conditions map 1:1 once N, Z, V describe the operation (shifted to bit 31).
        let signed = |c: K| match c {
            K::l => Some(Cond::Lt),
            K::ge => Some(Cond::Ge),
            K::le => Some(Cond::Le),
            K::g => Some(Cond::Gt),
            K::o => Some(Cond::Vs),
            K::no => Some(Cond::Vc),
            _ => None,
        };
        match k {
            lk::SUB => {
                if let Some(c) = signed(cc) {
                    if sh == 0 {
                        self.a.cmp_w(FA, FB);
                    } else {
                        self.a.lsl_wi(T0, FA, sh);
                        self.a.cmp_w_lsl(T0, FB, sh);
                    }
                    return Cc::If(c);
                }
                self.a.cmp_w(FA, FB);
                Cc::If(match cc {
                    K::b => Cond::Lo,
                    K::ae => Cond::Hs,
                    K::be => Cond::Ls,
                    _ => Cond::Hi,
                })
            }
            lk::ADD => {
                if sh == 0 {
                    self.a.cmn_w_lsl(FA, FB, 0);
                } else {
                    self.a.lsl_wi(T0, FA, sh);
                    self.a.cmn_w_lsl(T0, FB, sh);
                }
                if let Some(c) = signed(cc) {
                    return Cc::If(c);
                }
                match cc {
                    K::b => Cc::If(Cond::Hs),
                    K::ae => Cc::If(Cond::Lo),
                    _ => {
                        // be / a: CF || ZF
                        self.a.cset_w(T0, Cond::Hs);
                        self.a.csinc_w(T0, T0, ZR, Cond::Ne);
                        self.a.cmp_wi(T0, 0);
                        Cc::If(if cc == K::be { Cond::Ne } else { Cond::Eq })
                    }
                }
            }
            lk::INC | lk::DEC => {
                if let Some(c) = signed(cc) {
                    let a = if sh == 0 {
                        FA
                    } else {
                        self.a.lsl_wi(T0, FA, sh);
                        T0
                    };
                    self.a.mov_wi(T1, 1 << sh);
                    if k == lk::INC {
                        self.a.cmn_w_lsl(a, T1, 0);
                    } else {
                        self.a.cmp_w_lsl(a, T1, 0);
                    }
                    return Cc::If(c);
                }
                match cc {
                    K::b | K::ae => {
                        self.a.cmp_wi(FC, 0);
                        Cc::If(if cc == K::b { Cond::Ne } else { Cond::Eq })
                    }
                    _ => {
                        self.a.cmp_wi(FR, 0);
                        self.a.csinc_w(T0, FC, ZR, Cond::Ne);
                        self.a.cmp_wi(T0, 0);
                        Cc::If(if cc == K::be { Cond::Ne } else { Cond::Eq })
                    }
                }
            }
            _ => {
                // LOGIC: CF = OF = 0.
                match cc {
                    K::b | K::o => Cc::Never,
                    K::ae | K::no => Cc::Always,
                    K::be | K::a => {
                        self.a.cmp_wi(FR, 0);
                        Cc::If(if cc == K::be { Cond::Eq } else { Cond::Ne })
                    }
                    K::l | K::ge => {
                        self.a.try_tst_wi(FR, sb);
                        Cc::If(if cc == K::l { Cond::Ne } else { Cond::Eq })
                    }
                    _ => {
                        if sh == 0 {
                            self.a.cmp_wi(FR, 0);
                        } else {
                            self.a.lsl_wi(T0, FR, sh);
                            self.a.cmp_wi(T0, 0);
                        }
                        Cc::If(if cc == K::le { Cond::Le } else { Cond::Gt })
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- block ends

    /// Flags to the `Cpu`, count the block.
    fn end_block(&mut self) {
        let f = self.fl;
        self.flush(f);
        self.fl = Fl::Cpu;
        self.a.sub_xi(LEFT, LEFT, self.blk.n);
        self.ended = true;
    }

    /// Native fast path at a block entry (as in the run loop): exit if the budget is used up, else call it;
    /// declined -> fall into the block body, done -> continue at the EIP it left.
    fn native_stub(&mut self, budget: Label) {
        let body = self.a.label();
        self.a.cbz_x(LEFT, budget);
        // The run loop has EIP = block start when it calls a native function.
        self.a.mov_wi(T0, self.blk.start);
        self.a.str_w(T0, CPU, OFF_EIP);
        self.store_regs();
        self.a.str_x(LEFT, SP, SAVE_LEFT);
        self.a.mov_x(0, CPU);
        self.a.mov_x(1, LEFT);
        let lb = self.lit(self.blk as *const Block as u64);
        self.a.ldr_x_lit(2, lb);
        let lf = self.lit(jit_native as *const () as usize as u64);
        self.a.ldr_x_lit(AD, lf);
        self.a.blr(AD);
        self.a.ldr_x(LEFT, SP, SAVE_LEFT);
        self.load_regs();
        self.a.cbz_w(0, body);
        self.a.ldr_x(LEFT, CPU, OFF_LEFT);
        self.a.ldr_w(0, CPU, OFF_EIP);
        self.indirect();
        self.a.bind(body);
    }

    /// Continue at the static guest address `eip`: a direct branch if its block is compiled already, else
    /// through its slot.
    fn link(&mut self, eip: u32) {
        if eip < layout::THUNK_BASE {
            let s = self.jit.slot(eip);
            // SAFETY: slots point into the JIT's chunks.
            let v = unsafe { *s } as usize;
            if v != self.jit.exit_eip {
                self.a.b_abs(v);
                return;
            }
        }
        self.a.mov_wi(0, eip);
        if eip >= layout::THUNK_BASE {
            self.a.b_abs(self.jit.exit_eip);
            return;
        }
        let s = self.jit.slot(eip) as u64;
        let l = self.lit(s);
        self.a.ldr_x_lit(AD, l);
        self.a.ldr_x(AD, AD, 0);
        self.a.br(AD);
    }

    /// Continue at the guest address in w0 (indirect-branch table, else exit).
    fn indirect(&mut self) {
        let t = self.jit.jtab.as_ptr() as u64;
        let l = self.lit(t);
        let miss = match self.miss {
            Some(m) => m,
            None => {
                let m = self.a.label();
                self.miss = Some(m);
                m
            }
        };
        self.a.ldr_x_lit(AD, l);
        self.a.eor_w_lsr(T3, 0, 0, JTAB_BITS);
        self.a.try_and_wi(T3, T3, (JTAB - 1) as u32);
        self.a.add_x_lsl(AD, AD, T3, 4);
        self.a.ldr_w(T3, AD, 0);
        self.a.cmp_w(T3, 0);
        self.a.b_cond(Cond::Ne, miss);
        self.a.ldr_x(AD, AD, 8);
        self.a.br(AD);
    }

    /// Push the 32-bit value in `v` (fault check first; ESP changes only after the store).
    fn push(&mut self, v: R) {
        self.a.sub_wi(T1, g(4), 4);
        self.check(T1);
        self.a.st_guest(v, MEM, T1, 4);
        self.a.mov_w(g(4), T1);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- fallback

    /// Run instruction `ins` through the interpreter (one handler call).
    fn fallback(&mut self, ins: &Instruction, last: bool) {
        let f = self.fl;
        self.flush(f);
        self.fl = Fl::Cpu;
        self.store_regs();
        self.a.mov_wi(T0, self.blk.end);
        self.a.str_w(T0, CPU, OFF_EIP);
        let op = self.jit.fallback_op(ins) as u64;
        self.call(jit_op as *const () as usize, Some(op));
        self.load_regs();
        let l = self.a.label();
        self.fails.push((l, self.i));
        self.a.cbz_w(0, l);
        if last && ins.flow_control() != FlowControl::Next {
            self.end_block();
            self.a.ldr_w(0, CPU, OFF_EIP);
            self.indirect();
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- natives

    /// Native translation of `ins` (mirrors its fast handler). `false` = not translated (nothing emitted).
    fn native(&mut self, ins: &Instruction, op: &Op) -> bool {
        use Mnemonic as Mn;
        if op.h as usize == fast::generic as fast::Handler as usize {
            return self.native_generic(ins);
        }
        let m = ins.mnemonic();
        match m {
            Mn::Mov => self.mov(ins),
            Mn::Movzx | Mn::Movsx => self.movx(ins, m == Mn::Movsx),
            Mn::Lea => {
                let (Some(d), Some(mo)) = (fast::reg_op(ins, 0, 4), fast::mem_op(ins, 1, 0)) else {
                    return false;
                };
                let r = self.ea_lea(mo, g(d));
                self.a.mov_w(g(d), r);
                true
            }
            Mn::Push => match ins.code() {
                Code::Push_r32 | Code::Push_rm32 if fast::reg_op(ins, 0, 4).is_some() => {
                    let r = fast::reg_op(ins, 0, 4).unwrap();
                    self.push(g(r));
                    true
                }
                Code::Pushd_imm8 | Code::Pushd_imm32 => {
                    let Some(v) = fast::imm_op(ins, 0) else {
                        return false;
                    };
                    let src = if v == 0 {
                        ZR
                    } else {
                        self.a.mov_wi(T0, v);
                        T0
                    };
                    self.push(src);
                    true
                }
                Code::Push_rm32 => {
                    let Some(mo) = fast::mem_op(ins, 0, 4) else {
                        return false;
                    };
                    let Some(a) = self.addr(mo) else { return true };
                    self.a.sub_wi(T1, g(4), 4);
                    self.check(T1);
                    self.a.ld_guest(T0, MEM, a, 4, false);
                    self.a.st_guest(T0, MEM, T1, 4);
                    self.a.mov_w(g(4), T1);
                    true
                }
                _ => false,
            },
            Mn::Pop => match ins.code() {
                Code::Pop_r32 | Code::Pop_rm32 => {
                    let Some(r) = fast::reg_op(ins, 0, 4) else {
                        return false;
                    };
                    self.check(g(4));
                    self.a.ld_guest(T0, MEM, g(4), 4, false);
                    self.a.add_wi(g(4), g(4), 4);
                    self.a.mov_w(g(r), T0);
                    true
                }
                _ => false,
            },
            Mn::Add => self.alu(ins, lk::ADD, 0),
            Mn::Sub => self.alu(ins, lk::SUB, 0),
            Mn::Cmp => self.alu(ins, lk::SUB, 1),
            Mn::And => self.alu(ins, lk::LOGIC, 0),
            Mn::Test => self.alu(ins, lk::LOGIC, 1),
            Mn::Or => self.alu(ins, lk::LOGIC, 2),
            Mn::Xor => self.alu(ins, lk::LOGIC, 3),
            Mn::Inc | Mn::Dec => self.incdec(ins, m == Mn::Dec),
            Mn::Neg => {
                let Some(r) = fast::reg_op(ins, 0, 4) else {
                    return false;
                };
                self.a.movz_w(FA, 0, 0);
                self.a.mov_w(FB, g(r));
                self.a.neg_w(FR, g(r));
                self.a.mov_w(g(r), FR);
                self.fl = Fl::Lazy(lk::SUB, 4);
                true
            }
            Mn::Not => {
                let Some(r) = fast::reg_op(ins, 0, 4) else {
                    return false;
                };
                self.a.mvn_w(g(r), g(r));
                true
            }
            Mn::Cdq => {
                self.a.asr_wi(g(2), g(0), 31);
                true
            }
            Mn::Cwde => {
                self.a.sxth_w(g(0), g(0));
                true
            }
            Mn::Nop => true,
            Mn::Shl | Mn::Sal | Mn::Shr | Mn::Sar if ins.op1_kind() == OpKind::Immediate8 => {
                let kind = match m {
                    Mn::Shr => 1,
                    Mn::Sar => 2,
                    _ => 0,
                };
                if let Some(r) = fast::reg_op(ins, 0, 4) {
                    self.shift_ri(r, kind, ins.immediate8() as u32 & 31);
                    return true;
                }
                let sz = size0(ins);
                let Some(r) = fast::reg_op(ins, 0, sz) else {
                    return false;
                };
                if !matches!(sz, 1 | 2) {
                    return false;
                }
                self.shift_ri_n(r, kind, sz, ins.immediate8() as u32 & 31);
                true
            }
            Mn::Shl | Mn::Sal | Mn::Shr | Mn::Sar
                if ins.op1_kind() == OpKind::Register && ins.op1_register() == iced_x86::Register::CL =>
            {
                let kind = match m {
                    Mn::Shr => 1,
                    Mn::Sar => 2,
                    _ => 0,
                };
                let Some(r) = fast::reg_op(ins, 0, 4) else {
                    return false;
                };
                self.shift_rc32(r, kind);
                true
            }
            Mn::Imul | Mn::Mul => self.mul(ins),
            Mn::Call => match ins.code() {
                Code::Call_rel32_32 => {
                    self.a.mov_wi(T0, ins.next_ip32());
                    self.push(T0);
                    self.end_block();
                    self.link(ins.near_branch32());
                    true
                }
                Code::Call_rm32 => {
                    if let Some(r) = fast::reg_op(ins, 0, 4) {
                        self.a.mov_w(W5, g(r));
                    } else {
                        let Some(mo) = fast::mem_op(ins, 0, 4) else {
                            return false;
                        };
                        let Some(a) = self.addr(mo) else { return true };
                        self.a.ld_guest(W5, MEM, a, 4, false);
                    }
                    self.a.mov_wi(T0, ins.next_ip32());
                    self.push(T0);
                    self.end_block();
                    self.a.mov_w(0, W5);
                    self.indirect();
                    true
                }
                _ => false,
            },
            Mn::Ret => {
                let imm = match ins.code() {
                    Code::Retnd => 0,
                    Code::Retnd_imm16 => ins.immediate16() as u32,
                    _ => return false,
                };
                self.check(g(4));
                self.a.ld_guest(W5, MEM, g(4), 4, false);
                self.add_imm(g(4), g(4), 4 + imm);
                self.end_block();
                self.a.mov_w(0, W5);
                self.indirect();
                true
            }
            Mn::Jmp => match ins.code() {
                Code::Jmp_rel8_32 | Code::Jmp_rel32_32 => {
                    self.end_block();
                    self.link(ins.near_branch32());
                    true
                }
                Code::Jmp_rm32 => {
                    if let Some(r) = fast::reg_op(ins, 0, 4) {
                        self.a.mov_w(W5, g(r));
                    } else {
                        let Some(mo) = fast::mem_op(ins, 0, 4) else {
                            return false;
                        };
                        let Some(a) = self.addr(mo) else { return true };
                        self.a.ld_guest(W5, MEM, a, 4, false);
                    }
                    self.end_block();
                    self.a.mov_w(0, W5);
                    self.indirect();
                    true
                }
                _ => false,
            },
            _ if fast::is_fast_jcc(ins) => {
                let c = self.cond(ins.condition_code());
                self.end_block();
                let (taken, next) = (ins.near_branch32(), ins.next_ip32());
                match c {
                    Cc::Always => self.link(taken),
                    Cc::Never => self.link(next),
                    Cc::If(c) => {
                        let l = self.a.label();
                        self.a.b_cond(c, l);
                        self.link(next);
                        self.a.bind(l);
                        self.link(taken);
                    }
                }
                true
            }
            _ if ins.op_count() == 1 && is_setcc(m) => {
                let Some(r) = fast::reg_op(ins, 0, 1) else {
                    return false;
                };
                match self.cond(ins.condition_code()) {
                    Cc::Always => self.a.movz_w(T0, 1, 0),
                    Cc::Never => self.a.movz_w(T0, 0, 0),
                    Cc::If(c) => self.a.cset_w(T0, c),
                }
                self.write(1, r, T0);
                true
            }
            _ => false,
        }
    }

    /// LEA: effective address into `dst` (no memory access, no check).
    fn ea_lea(&mut self, m: M, dst: R) -> R {
        let (e, ..) = m;
        if e == E_DISP {
            self.a.mov_wi(dst, m.4);
            return dst;
        }
        self.ea(m, dst).unwrap_or(dst)
    }

    fn mov(&mut self, ins: &Instruction) -> bool {
        let sz = size0(ins);
        if ins.op_count() != 2 || !matches!(sz, 1 | 2 | 4) {
            return false;
        }
        if let (Some(d), Some(s)) = (fast::reg_op(ins, 0, sz), fast::reg_op(ins, 1, sz)) {
            let v = self.read(sz, s, T0);
            self.write(sz, d, v);
        } else if let (Some(d), Some(mo)) = (fast::reg_op(ins, 0, sz), fast::mem_op(ins, 1, sz)) {
            let Some(a) = self.addr(mo) else { return true };
            if sz == 4 {
                self.a.ld_guest(g(d), MEM, a, 4, false);
            } else {
                self.a.ld_guest(T0, MEM, a, sz, false);
                self.write(sz, d, T0);
            }
        } else if let (Some(mo), Some(s)) = (fast::mem_op(ins, 0, sz), fast::reg_op(ins, 1, sz)) {
            let Some(a) = self.addr(mo) else { return true };
            let v = self.read(sz, s, T0);
            self.a.st_guest(v, MEM, a, sz);
        } else if let (Some(d), Some(v)) = (fast::reg_op(ins, 0, sz), fast::imm_op(ins, 1)) {
            if sz == 4 {
                self.a.mov_wi(g(d), v);
            } else {
                self.a.mov_wi(T0, v);
                self.write(sz, d, T0);
            }
        } else if let (Some(mo), Some(v)) = (fast::mem_op(ins, 0, sz), fast::imm_op(ins, 1)) {
            let Some(a) = self.addr(mo) else { return true };
            let v = v & crate::flags::mask(sz);
            let src = if v == 0 {
                ZR
            } else {
                self.a.mov_wi(T0, v);
                T0
            };
            self.a.st_guest(src, MEM, a, sz);
        } else {
            return false;
        }
        true
    }

    fn movx(&mut self, ins: &Instruction, signed: bool) -> bool {
        let Some(d) = fast::reg_op(ins, 0, 4) else {
            return false;
        };
        if let Some(mo) = fast::mem_op(ins, 1, 0) {
            let sz = ins.memory_size().size() as u32;
            if !matches!(sz, 1 | 2) {
                return false;
            }
            let Some(a) = self.addr(mo) else { return true };
            self.a.ld_guest(g(d), MEM, a, sz, signed);
            return true;
        }
        for sz in [1u32, 2] {
            if let Some(s) = fast::reg_op(ins, 1, sz) {
                match (sz, signed, s < 4) {
                    (2, false, _) => self.a.uxth_w(g(d), g(s)),
                    (2, true, _) => self.a.sxth_w(g(d), g(s)),
                    (_, false, true) => self.a.uxtb_w(g(d), g(s)),
                    (_, true, true) => self.a.sxtb_w(g(d), g(s)),
                    (_, false, false) => self.a.ubfx_w(g(d), g(s & 3), 8, 8),
                    (_, true, false) => self.a.sbfx_w(g(d), g(s & 3), 8, 8),
                }
                return true;
            }
        }
        false
    }

    /// ALU op: `kind` = lazy kind (ADD / SUB / LOGIC); `sub`: for SUB 0 = sub, 1 = cmp; for LOGIC 0 = and,
    /// 1 = test, 2 = or, 3 = xor.
    fn alu(&mut self, ins: &Instruction, kind: u8, sub: u8) -> bool {
        let sz = size0(ins);
        if ins.op_count() != 2 || !matches!(sz, 1 | 2 | 4) {
            return false;
        }
        let msk = crate::flags::mask(sz);
        let writes = !((kind == lk::SUB && sub == 1) || (kind == lk::LOGIC && sub == 1));
        // Sources into FA (destination value) and FB (source value), both masked; memory forms check first.
        enum Dst {
            Reg(u8),
            Mem(R),
        }
        let dst;
        if let (Some(d), Some(s)) = (fast::reg_op(ins, 0, sz), fast::reg_op(ins, 1, sz)) {
            // Read both before writing FA/FB (FA may alias nothing guest-visible, but keep the order simple).
            let a = self.read(sz, d, T0);
            let b = self.read(sz, s, T1);
            self.a.mov_w(FA, a);
            self.a.mov_w(FB, b);
            dst = Dst::Reg(d);
        } else if let (Some(d), Some(v)) = (fast::reg_op(ins, 0, sz), fast::imm_op(ins, 1)) {
            let a = self.read(sz, d, T0);
            self.a.mov_w(FA, a);
            self.a.mov_wi(FB, v & msk);
            dst = Dst::Reg(d);
        } else if let (Some(d), Some(mo)) = (fast::reg_op(ins, 0, sz), fast::mem_op(ins, 1, sz)) {
            let Some(ad) = self.addr(mo) else { return true };
            self.a.ld_guest(FB, MEM, ad, sz, false);
            let a = self.read(sz, d, T0);
            self.a.mov_w(FA, a);
            dst = Dst::Reg(d);
        } else if let (Some(mo), Some(s)) = (fast::mem_op(ins, 0, sz), fast::reg_op(ins, 1, sz)) {
            let Some(ad) = self.addr(mo) else { return true };
            let b = self.read(sz, s, T1);
            self.a.ld_guest(FA, MEM, ad, sz, false);
            self.a.mov_w(FB, b);
            dst = Dst::Mem(ad);
        } else if let (Some(mo), Some(v)) = (fast::mem_op(ins, 0, sz), fast::imm_op(ins, 1)) {
            let Some(ad) = self.addr(mo) else { return true };
            self.a.ld_guest(FA, MEM, ad, sz, false);
            self.a.mov_wi(FB, v & msk);
            dst = Dst::Mem(ad);
        } else {
            return false;
        }
        match kind {
            lk::ADD => self.a.add_w(FR, FA, FB),
            lk::SUB => self.a.sub_w(FR, FA, FB),
            _ => match sub {
                0 | 1 => self.a.and_w(FR, FA, FB),
                2 => self.a.orr_w(FR, FA, FB),
                _ => self.a.eor_w(FR, FA, FB),
            },
        }
        if sz != 4 && kind != lk::LOGIC {
            self.a.try_and_wi(FR, FR, msk);
        }
        self.fl = Fl::Lazy(kind, sz);
        if writes {
            match dst {
                Dst::Reg(d) => self.write(sz, d, FR),
                Dst::Mem(ad) => self.a.st_guest(FR, MEM, ad, sz),
            }
        }
        true
    }

    fn incdec(&mut self, ins: &Instruction, dec: bool) -> bool {
        let k = if dec { lk::DEC } else { lk::INC };
        if let Some(r) = fast::reg_op(ins, 0, 4) {
            self.cf_into_fc();
            self.a.mov_w(FA, g(r));
            self.a.movz_w(FB, 1, 0);
            if dec {
                self.a.sub_wi(FR, FA, 1);
            } else {
                self.a.add_wi(FR, FA, 1);
            }
            self.a.mov_w(g(r), FR);
        } else {
            let Some(mo) = fast::mem_op(ins, 0, 4) else {
                return false;
            };
            let Some(ad) = self.addr(mo) else { return true };
            // `cf_into_fc` clobbers T0/T1/T3 only; the address is in AD or a guest register.
            self.cf_into_fc();
            self.a.ld_guest(FA, MEM, ad, 4, false);
            self.a.movz_w(FB, 1, 0);
            if dec {
                self.a.sub_wi(FR, FA, 1);
            } else {
                self.a.add_wi(FR, FA, 1);
            }
            self.a.st_guest(FR, MEM, ad, 4);
        }
        self.fl = Fl::Lazy(k, 4);
        true
    }

    /// shl/shr/sar r32, imm (KIND 0/1/2), count already masked; flags as `fast::shift_ri`.
    fn shift_ri(&mut self, r: u8, kind: u8, c: u32) {
        if c == 0 {
            return;
        }
        let x = g(r);
        self.af_into(T1);
        // CF = last bit shifted out.
        let cf_bit = if kind == 0 { 32 - c } else { c - 1 };
        self.a.ubfx_w(1, x, cf_bit, 1);
        if kind == 1 {
            self.a.ubfx_w(2, x, 31, 1); // OF (shr) = old sign
        }
        match kind {
            0 => self.a.lsl_wi(x, x, c),
            1 => self.a.lsr_wi(x, x, c),
            _ => self.a.asr_wi(x, x, c),
        }
        if kind == 0 {
            self.a.ubfx_w(2, x, 31, 1);
            self.a.eor_w(2, 2, 1); // OF (shl) = new sign ^ CF
        }
        self.a.orr_w(FA, T1, 1);
        if kind != 2 {
            self.a.orr_w_lsl(FA, FA, 2, 11);
        }
        self.szp_or(FA, x);
        self.fl = Fl::Eager;
    }

    /// imul (2/3 operand, 1 operand) and mul r/m32; flags as `fast::mul_flags` (AF kept).
    fn mul(&mut self, ins: &Instruction) -> bool {
        // Operand fetch first (fault checks before anything changes).
        let src = |c: &mut Self, i: u32| -> Option<Option<R>> {
            if let Some(r) = fast::reg_op(ins, i, 4) {
                return Some(Some(g(r)));
            }
            let mo = fast::mem_op(ins, i, 4)?;
            match c.addr(mo) {
                Some(a) => {
                    c.a.ld_guest(3, MEM, a, 4, false);
                    Some(Some(3))
                }
                None => Some(None),
            }
        };
        match ins.code() {
            Code::Imul_r32_rm32 | Code::Imul_r32_rm32_imm8 | Code::Imul_r32_rm32_imm32 => {
                let Some(d) = fast::reg_op(ins, 0, 4) else {
                    return false;
                };
                let three = ins.code() != Code::Imul_r32_rm32;
                let Some(s) = src(self, 1) else { return false };
                let Some(s) = s else { return true };
                self.af_into(T1);
                if three {
                    self.a.mov_wi(4, ins.immediate(2) as u32);
                    self.a.smull(0, s, 4);
                } else {
                    self.a.smull(0, g(d), s);
                }
                self.a.cmp_x_sxtw(0, 0);
                self.a.cset_w(1, Cond::Ne);
                self.a.mov_w(g(d), 0);
            }
            Code::Imul_rm32 | Code::Mul_rm32 => {
                let signed = ins.code() == Code::Imul_rm32;
                let Some(s) = src(self, 0) else { return false };
                let Some(s) = s else { return true };
                self.af_into(T1);
                if signed {
                    self.a.smull(0, g(0), s);
                    self.a.cmp_x_sxtw(0, 0);
                } else {
                    self.a.umull(0, g(0), s);
                    self.a.lsr_xi(2, 0, 32);
                    self.a.cmp_wi(2, 0);
                }
                self.a.cset_w(1, Cond::Ne);
                self.a.lsr_xi(2, 0, 32);
                self.a.mov_w(g(0), 0);
                self.a.mov_w(g(2), 2);
            }
            _ => return false,
        }
        // FA = AF | szp(lo) | (of ? CF|OF : 0); lo is in w0 (also the guest destination).
        self.a.orr_w(FA, T1, 1);
        self.a.orr_w_lsl(FA, FA, 1, 11);
        self.szp_or(FA, 0);
        self.fl = Fl::Eager;
        true
    }
}

fn is_setcc(m: Mnemonic) -> bool {
    use Mnemonic as M;
    matches!(
        m,
        M::Seto
            | M::Setno
            | M::Setb
            | M::Setae
            | M::Sete
            | M::Setne
            | M::Setbe
            | M::Seta
            | M::Sets
            | M::Setns
            | M::Setp
            | M::Setnp
            | M::Setl
            | M::Setge
            | M::Setle
            | M::Setg
    )
}

/// Operand size in bytes from operand 0 (as `fast::size0`).
fn size0(ins: &Instruction) -> u32 {
    match ins.op0_kind() {
        OpKind::Register => ins.op0_register().size() as u32,
        OpKind::Memory => ins.memory_size().size() as u32,
        _ => 0,
    }
}

// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- more natives

impl C<'_> {
    /// `cur_ip` = this instruction (only the interpreter's generic path maintains it; the x87 code reads it).
    fn cur_ip(&mut self, ins: &Instruction) {
        self.a.mov_wi(T0, ins.ip32());
        self.a.str_w(T0, CPU, OFF_CURIP);
    }

    /// Native translations of forms the interpreter runs through its generic path (`exec::step`); each mirrors
    /// the `exec.rs` semantics, faults go to the interpreter through side exits.
    fn native_generic(&mut self, ins: &Instruction) -> bool {
        if ins.has_lock_prefix() || ins.has_rep_prefix() || ins.has_repne_prefix() {
            return false;
        }
        match ins.code() {
            Code::Loop_rel8_32_ECX => {
                self.cur_ip(ins);
                self.a.sub_wi(g(1), g(1), 1);
                self.end_block();
                let l = self.a.label();
                self.a.cbnz_w(g(1), l);
                self.link(ins.next_ip32());
                self.a.bind(l);
                self.link(ins.near_branch_target() as u32);
                true
            }
            Code::Jecxz_rel8_32 | Code::Jcxz_rel8_32 => {
                self.cur_ip(ins);
                self.end_block();
                let l = self.a.label();
                if ins.code() == Code::Jecxz_rel8_32 {
                    self.a.cbz_w(g(1), l);
                } else {
                    self.a.try_tst_wi(g(1), 0xFFFF);
                    self.a.b_cond(Cond::Eq, l);
                }
                self.link(ins.next_ip32());
                self.a.bind(l);
                self.link(ins.near_branch_target() as u32);
                true
            }
            Code::Div_rm32 | Code::Idiv_rm32 => self.div32(ins, ins.code() == Code::Idiv_rm32),
            Code::Movzx_r16_rm8 => {
                let Some(d) = fast::reg_op(ins, 0, 2) else { return false };
                if let Some(s) = fast::reg_op(ins, 1, 1) {
                    self.cur_ip(ins);
                    let v = self.read(1, s, T1);
                    self.a.bfi_w(g(d), v, 0, 16);
                    return true;
                }
                let Some(mo) = fast::mem_op(ins, 1, 1) else { return false };
                self.cur_ip(ins);
                let Some(a) = self.addr(mo) else { return true };
                self.a.ld_guest(T1, MEM, a, 1, false);
                self.a.bfi_w(g(d), T1, 0, 16);
                true
            }
            Code::Inc_rm8 | Code::Dec_rm8 | Code::Neg_rm8 => {
                let Some(r) = fast::reg_op(ins, 0, 1) else { return false };
                self.cur_ip(ins);
                let k = match ins.code() {
                    Code::Inc_rm8 => lk::INC,
                    Code::Dec_rm8 => lk::DEC,
                    _ => lk::SUB,
                };
                if k != lk::SUB {
                    self.cf_into_fc();
                    let a = self.read(1, r, T1);
                    self.a.mov_w(FA, a);
                    self.a.movz_w(FB, 1, 0);
                    if k == lk::INC {
                        self.a.add_wi(FR, FA, 1);
                    } else {
                        self.a.sub_wi(FR, FA, 1);
                    }
                } else {
                    let a = self.read(1, r, T1);
                    self.a.mov_w(FB, a);
                    self.a.movz_w(FA, 0, 0);
                    self.a.neg_w(FR, FB);
                }
                self.a.try_and_wi(FR, FR, 0xFF);
                self.write(1, r, FR);
                self.fl = Fl::Lazy(k, 1);
                true
            }
            Code::Leaved => {
                self.cur_ip(ins);
                self.check(g(5));
                self.a.ld_guest(T1, MEM, g(5), 4, false);
                self.a.add_wi(g(4), g(5), 4);
                self.a.mov_w(g(5), T1);
                true
            }
            Code::Movsd_m32_m32 | Code::Movsb_m8_m8 | Code::Stosd_m32_EAX | Code::Stosb_m8_AL => {
                let movs = matches!(ins.code(), Code::Movsd_m32_m32 | Code::Movsb_m8_m8);
                let sz = if matches!(ins.code(), Code::Movsd_m32_m32 | Code::Stosd_m32_EAX) { 4 } else { 1 };
                if ins.op0_kind() != OpKind::MemoryESEDI {
                    return false;
                }
                if movs && (ins.op1_kind() != OpKind::MemorySegESI || ins.memory_segment() != iced_x86::Register::DS) {
                    return false;
                }
                self.cur_ip(ins);
                if movs {
                    self.check(g(6));
                }
                self.check(g(7));
                let v = if movs {
                    self.a.ld_guest(T1, MEM, g(6), sz, false);
                    T1
                } else {
                    g(0)
                };
                self.a.st_guest(v, MEM, g(7), sz);
                // step = DF ? -sz : sz
                self.a.ldr_w(T0, CPU, OFF_EF);
                self.a.ubfx_w(T0, T0, 10, 1);
                self.a.mov_wi(T3, sz);
                self.a.sub_w_lsl(T3, T3, T0, if sz == 4 { 3 } else { 1 });
                if movs {
                    self.a.add_w(g(6), g(6), T3);
                }
                self.a.add_w(g(7), g(7), T3);
                true
            }
            Code::Mov_r32_rm32 | Code::Mov_rm32_r32 if ins.memory_segment() == iced_x86::Register::FS => {
                let load = ins.code() == Code::Mov_r32_rm32;
                let (Some(r), true) = (fast::reg_op(ins, if load { 0 } else { 1 }, 4), self.fs_ea_ok(ins)) else {
                    return false;
                };
                self.cur_ip(ins);
                self.fs_ea(ins);
                self.check(AD);
                if load {
                    self.a.ld_guest(g(r), MEM, AD, 4, false);
                } else {
                    self.a.st_guest(g(r), MEM, AD, 4);
                }
                true
            }
            _ => false,
        }
    }

    /// An FS-relative memory operand with 32-bit base/index registers only.
    fn fs_ea_ok(&self, ins: &Instruction) -> bool {
        let ok = |r: iced_x86::Register| r == iced_x86::Register::None || r.is_gpr32();
        (ins.op_kind(0) == OpKind::Memory || ins.op_kind(1) == OpKind::Memory)
            && ok(ins.memory_base())
            && ok(ins.memory_index())
    }

    /// AD = fs_base + base + index * scale + disp.
    fn fs_ea(&mut self, ins: &Instruction) {
        let reg = |r: iced_x86::Register| (r as u32 - iced_x86::Register::EAX as u32) as u8;
        self.a.ldr_w(AD, CPU, OFF_FS);
        let b = ins.memory_base();
        if b != iced_x86::Register::None {
            self.a.add_w(AD, AD, g(reg(b)));
        }
        let x = ins.memory_index();
        if x != iced_x86::Register::None {
            self.a.add_w_lsl(AD, AD, g(reg(x)), ins.memory_index_scale().trailing_zeros());
        }
        let d = ins.memory_displacement32();
        self.add_imm(AD, AD, d);
    }

    /// div / idiv r/m32 (EDX:EAX by the operand); #DE (zero divisor, quotient overflow) -> side exit.
    fn div32(&mut self, ins: &Instruction, signed: bool) -> bool {
        let src = if let Some(r) = fast::reg_op(ins, 0, 4) {
            Some(g(r))
        } else if fast::mem_op(ins, 0, 4).is_some() {
            None
        } else {
            return false;
        };
        self.cur_ip(ins);
        let d = match src {
            Some(r) => r,
            None => {
                let mo = fast::mem_op(ins, 0, 4).unwrap();
                let Some(a) = self.addr(mo) else { return true };
                self.a.ld_guest(3, MEM, a, 4, false);
                3
            }
        };
        let side = self.side();
        self.a.cbz_w(d, side);
        // x0 = EDX:EAX, x1 = divisor (64-bit), x2 = quotient, x4 = remainder.
        self.a.orr_x_lsl(0, g(0), g(2), 32);
        if signed {
            self.a.sxtw_x(1, d);
            // INT64_MIN / -1 overflows (cannot reach here with a 32-bit check alone).
            self.a.sdiv_x(2, 0, 1);
            self.a.cmp_x_sxtw(2, 2);
            self.a.b_cond(Cond::Ne, side);
            // n == i64::MIN && d == -1: sdiv gives i64::MIN, which fails the range check above.
        } else {
            self.a.mov_w(1, d);
            self.a.udiv_x(2, 0, 1);
            self.a.lsr_xi(4, 2, 32);
            self.a.cbnz_w(4, side);
        }
        self.a.msub_x(4, 2, 1, 0);
        self.a.mov_w(g(0), 2);
        self.a.mov_w(g(2), 4);
        true
    }

    /// shl/shr/sar r8/r16, imm (count masked, 1..=31); flags as `fast::shift_val`.
    fn shift_ri_n(&mut self, r: u8, kind: u8, sz: u32, c: u32) {
        if c == 0 {
            return;
        }
        let bits = 8 * sz;
        let msk = crate::flags::mask(sz);
        self.af_into(T1);
        let a = self.read(sz, r, 6); // masked operand in w6
                                     // w1 = CF, w2 = OF, w7 = result
        match kind {
            0 => {
                if c < bits {
                    self.a.ubfx_w(1, a, bits - c, 1);
                    self.a.lsl_wi(7, a, c);
                    self.a.try_and_wi(7, 7, msk);
                } else {
                    if c == bits {
                        self.a.ubfx_w(1, a, 0, 1);
                    } else {
                        self.a.movz_w(1, 0, 0);
                    }
                    self.a.movz_w(7, 0, 0);
                }
                self.a.ubfx_w(2, 7, bits - 1, 1);
                self.a.eor_w(2, 2, 1);
            }
            1 => {
                if c < bits {
                    self.a.ubfx_w(1, a, c - 1, 1);
                    self.a.lsr_wi(7, a, c);
                } else {
                    if c == bits {
                        self.a.ubfx_w(1, a, bits - 1, 1);
                    } else {
                        self.a.movz_w(1, 0, 0);
                    }
                    self.a.movz_w(7, 0, 0);
                }
                self.a.ubfx_w(2, a, bits - 1, 1);
            }
            _ => {
                if sz == 1 {
                    self.a.sxtb_w(8, a);
                } else {
                    self.a.sxth_w(8, a);
                }
                let cbit = (c.min(bits) - 1).min(31);
                self.a.ubfx_w(1, 8, cbit, 1);
                self.a.asr_wi(7, 8, c.min(31));
                self.a.try_and_wi(7, 7, msk);
                self.a.movz_w(2, 0, 0);
            }
        }
        self.a.orr_w(FA, T1, 1);
        self.a.orr_w_lsl(FA, FA, 2, 11);
        self.szp_or_n(FA, 7, sz);
        self.write(sz, r, 7);
        self.fl = Fl::Eager;
    }

    /// shl/shr/sar r32, cl: count 0 leaves the flags alone, so the flags go through the `Cpu` on both paths.
    fn shift_rc32(&mut self, r: u8, kind: u8) {
        let f = self.fl;
        self.flush(f);
        self.fl = Fl::Cpu;
        let x = g(r);
        let skip = self.a.label();
        self.a.try_and_wi(3, g(1), 31);
        self.a.cbz_w(3, skip);
        self.af_into(T1);
        // w1 = CF, w2 = OF
        match kind {
            0 => {
                self.a.neg_w(4, 3); // (32 - c) mod 32
                self.a.lsrv_w(1, x, 4);
                self.a.try_and_wi(1, 1, 1);
                self.a.lslv_w(x, x, 3);
                self.a.ubfx_w(2, x, 31, 1);
                self.a.eor_w(2, 2, 1);
            }
            _ => {
                self.a.sub_wi(4, 3, 1);
                self.a.lsrv_w(1, x, 4);
                self.a.try_and_wi(1, 1, 1);
                if kind == 1 {
                    self.a.ubfx_w(2, x, 31, 1);
                    self.a.lsrv_w(x, x, 3);
                } else {
                    self.a.movz_w(2, 0, 0);
                    self.a.asrv_w(x, x, 3);
                }
            }
        }
        self.a.orr_w(FA, T1, 1);
        self.a.orr_w_lsl(FA, FA, 2, 11);
        self.szp_or(FA, x);
        self.flush(Fl::Eager);
        self.a.bind(skip);
    }
}

```

`port/crates/s3-cpu/src/jit/execmem.rs`:

```rs
//! Executable memory for the JIT: one fixed-size region per code arena, W^X (pages are writable only while code
//! is copied in, read+execute otherwise), instruction-cache maintenance after writes.
//!
```
