#[test]
fn rep_string_ops() {
    let (cpu, mem) = run(|a| {
        a.cld().unwrap();
        a.mov(edi, DATA).unwrap();
        a.mov(eax, 0x4141_4141).unwrap();
        a.mov(ecx, 16).unwrap();
        a.rep().stosd().unwrap();
        a.mov(esi, DATA).unwrap();
        a.mov(edi, DATA + 0x100).unwrap();
        a.mov(ecx, 64).unwrap();
        a.rep().movsb().unwrap();
        // strlen-style scan
        a.mov(byte_ptr(DATA + 0x100 + 10), 0).unwrap();
        a.mov(edi, DATA + 0x100).unwrap();
        a.xor(eax, eax).unwrap();
        a.mov(ecx, 0xFFFF_FFFFu32).unwrap();
        a.repne().scasb().unwrap();
        a.not(ecx).unwrap();
        a.dec(ecx).unwrap(); // length
    });
    assert_eq!(mem.read_u32(DATA + 60), 0x4141_4141);
    assert_eq!(mem.read_u8(DATA + 0x100 + 63), 0x41);
    assert_eq!(cpu.regs[ECX], 10);
}

#[test]
fn overlapping_movsb_replicates() {
    let (_, mem) = run(|a| {
        a.mov(byte_ptr(DATA), 0x5A).unwrap();
        a.mov(esi, DATA).unwrap();
        a.mov(edi, DATA + 1).unwrap();
        a.mov(ecx, 15).unwrap();
        a.rep().movsb().unwrap();
    });
    assert!(mem.slice(DATA, 16).iter().all(|&b| b == 0x5A));
}

#[test]
fn enter_leave_pushad_popad_xchg_bswap() {
    let (cpu, _) = run(|a| {
        a.mov(ebp, 0x1234).unwrap();
        a.enter(16, 0).unwrap();
        a.mov(dword_ptr(ebp - 4), 99).unwrap();
        a.mov(eax, 7).unwrap();
        a.pushad().unwrap();
        a.mov(eax, 0).unwrap();
        a.popad().unwrap();
        a.mov(edx, dword_ptr(ebp - 4)).unwrap();
        a.leave().unwrap();
        a.mov(ecx, 0x1122_3344).unwrap();
        a.bswap(ecx).unwrap();
        a.xchg(eax, ecx).unwrap();
    });
    assert_eq!(cpu.regs[ECX], 7);
    assert_eq!(cpu.regs[EAX], 0x4433_2211);
    assert_eq!(cpu.regs[EDX], 99);
    assert_eq!(cpu.regs[EBP], 0x1234);
}

#[test]
fn thunk_exit_and_fs_segment() {
    let (mut cpu, mut mem) = setup(|a| {
        a.mov(eax, dword_ptr(0x18).fs()).unwrap();
        a.push(5).unwrap();
        a.mov(ecx, layout::THUNK_BASE + 0x10).unwrap();
        a.call(ecx).unwrap();
    });
    cpu.fs_base = 0x7FFD_E000;
    mem.write_u32(0x7FFD_E018, 0x7FFD_E000);
    let exit = cpu.run(&mut mem, 100);
    assert_eq!(exit, CpuExit::Thunk(layout::THUNK_BASE + 0x10));
    assert_eq!(cpu.regs[EAX], 0x7FFD_E000);
    // Return address on top, argument after it.
    assert_eq!(mem.read_u32(cpu.regs[ESP] + 4), 5);
}

#[test]
fn budget_and_cmpxchg_xadd_bt() {
    let (cpu, mem) = run(|a| {
        a.mov(dword_ptr(DATA), 10).unwrap();
        a.mov(eax, 10).unwrap();
        a.mov(ecx, 20).unwrap();
        a.cmpxchg(dword_ptr(DATA), ecx).unwrap(); // equal -> [DATA]=20
        a.mov(edx, 5).unwrap();
        a.xadd(dword_ptr(DATA), edx).unwrap(); // [DATA]=25, edx=20
        a.mov(ebx, 0b1000).unwrap();
        a.bt(ebx, 3).unwrap(); // CF=1
        a.setb(al).unwrap();
        a.bts(ebx, 0).unwrap();
        a.bsr(esi, ebx).unwrap();
    });
    assert_eq!(mem.read_u32(DATA), 25);
    assert_eq!(cpu.regs[EDX], 20);
    assert_eq!(cpu.regs[EAX] & 0xFF, 1);
    assert_eq!(cpu.regs[EBX], 0b1001);
    assert_eq!(cpu.regs[ESI], 3);

    let (mut cpu, mut mem) = setup(|a| {
        let mut l = a.create_label();
        a.set_label(&mut l).unwrap();
        a.jmp(l).unwrap();
    });
    assert_eq!(cpu.run(&mut mem, 1000), CpuExit::Budget);
    assert_eq!(cpu.instructions, 1000);
}

#[test]
fn unimplemented_reports_mnemonic() {
    let (mut cpu, mut mem) = setup(|a| {
        a.addps(xmm0, xmm1).unwrap(); // SSE: out of scope (S3.EXE has none)
    });
    match cpu.run(&mut mem, 10) {
        CpuExit::Fault { kind: FaultKind::Unimplemented, detail, .. } => assert!(detail.contains("Addps"), "{detail}"),
        e => panic!("unexpected {e:?}"),
    }
}

#[test]
fn cache_invalidation_sees_new_code() {
    let (mut cpu, mut mem) = setup(|a| {
        a.mov(eax, 1).unwrap();
    });
    assert_eq!(cpu.run(&mut mem, 100), CpuExit::ReturnMagic);
    assert_eq!(cpu.regs[EAX], 1);
    // Patch the immediate and rerun.
    mem.write_u32(CODE + 1, 2);
    cpu.invalidate_range(CODE, 5);
    cpu.regs[ESP] = STACK_TOP;
    cpu.push32(&mut mem, layout::MAGIC_RETURN);
    cpu.eip = CODE;
    assert_eq!(cpu.run(&mut mem, 100), CpuExit::ReturnMagic);
    assert_eq!(cpu.regs[EAX], 2);
}

/// Micro benchmark: `cargo test --release -p s3-cpu -- --ignored --nocapture bench_mips`.
/// Mix typical of MSVC6 code: memory loads/stores, ALU, compare+branch, call/ret, push/pop.
#[test]
#[ignore]
fn bench_mips() {
    let (mut cpu, mut mem) = setup(|a| {
        let mut top = a.create_label();
        let mut func = a.create_label();
        let mut done = a.create_label();
        let mut skip = a.create_label();
        a.mov(ecx, 20_000_000).unwrap();
        a.mov(esi, DATA).unwrap();
        a.xor(eax, eax).unwrap();
        a.set_label(&mut top).unwrap();
        a.mov(edx, dword_ptr(esi + 8)).unwrap();
        a.add(edx, ecx).unwrap();
        a.mov(dword_ptr(esi + 8), edx).unwrap();
        a.test(ecx, 7).unwrap();
        a.jne(skip).unwrap();
        a.push(ecx).unwrap();
        a.call(func).unwrap();
        a.add(esp, 4).unwrap();
        a.set_label(&mut skip).unwrap();
        a.lea(edi, ptr(esi + ecx * 4)).unwrap();
        a.and(edi, 0xFFF).unwrap();
        a.movzx(ebx, byte_ptr(esi + edi)).unwrap();
        a.add(eax, ebx).unwrap();
        a.dec(ecx).unwrap();
        a.jne(top).unwrap();
        a.jmp(done).unwrap();
        a.set_label(&mut func).unwrap();
        a.push(ebp).unwrap();
        a.mov(ebp, esp).unwrap();
        a.mov(eax, dword_ptr(ebp + 8)).unwrap();
        a.shl(eax, 2).unwrap();
        a.pop(ebp).unwrap();
        a.ret().unwrap();
        a.set_label(&mut done).unwrap();
        a.nop().unwrap();
    });
    let t = std::time::Instant::now();
    let mut total = 0u64;
    loop {
        let before = cpu.instructions;
        let e = cpu.run(&mut mem, 50_000_000);
        total += cpu.instructions - before;
        match e {
            CpuExit::Budget => continue,
            CpuExit::ReturnMagic => break,
            e => panic!("{e:?}"),
        }
    }
    let s = t.elapsed().as_secs_f64();
    println!("bench_mips: {total} instructions in {s:.3}s = {:.1} MIPS", total as f64 / s / 1e6);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// cpu-int additions

/// Run raw bytes at CODE (they must end in `ret`).
fn run_bytes(bytes: &[u8], init: impl FnOnce(&mut Cpu, &mut GuestMemory)) -> (Cpu, GuestMemory, CpuExit) {
    let mut mem = GuestMemory::new().unwrap();
    mem.write_bytes(CODE, bytes);
    let mut cpu = Cpu::new();
    cpu.regs[ESP] = STACK_TOP;
    cpu.push32(&mut mem, layout::MAGIC_RETURN);
    cpu.eip = CODE;
    init(&mut cpu, &mut mem);
    let e = cpu.run(&mut mem, 100_000);
    (cpu, mem, e)
}

/// Run a snippet through both the fast handlers and the generic path; both must agree on registers,
/// flags and the DATA page.
fn run_both(build: impl Fn(&mut CodeAssembler)) -> (Cpu, GuestMemory) {
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    for generic in [false, true] {
        let mut a = CodeAssembler::new(32).unwrap();
        build(&mut a);
        a.ret().unwrap();
        let bytes = a.assemble(CODE as u64).unwrap();
        let mut mem = GuestMemory::new().unwrap();
        mem.write_bytes(CODE, &bytes);
        let mut cpu = Cpu::new();
        cpu.set_generic_only(generic);
        cpu.regs[ESP] = STACK_TOP;
        cpu.push32(&mut mem, layout::MAGIC_RETURN);
        cpu.eip = CODE;
        let e = cpu.run(&mut mem, 1_000_000);
        assert_eq!(e, CpuExit::ReturnMagic, "generic={generic} eip={:#x}", cpu.eip);
        out.push((cpu, mem));
    }
    let (g, gm) = out.pop().unwrap();
    let (f, fm) = out.pop().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(f.regs, g.regs, "fast vs generic registers");
    assert_eq!(f.eflags(), g.eflags(), "fast vs generic eflags");
    assert_eq!(fm.slice(DATA, 0x1000), gm.slice(DATA, 0x1000), "fast vs generic memory");
    (f, fm)
}

#[test]
fn fast_forms_imm8_sign_extension_and_memory_alu() {
    let (cpu, mem) = run_both(|a| {
        a.mov(eax, 10).unwrap();
        a.add(eax, -1).unwrap(); // 83 /0 ib (sign-extended)
        a.mov(ebx, 0x100).unwrap();
        a.sub(ebx, 0x7F).unwrap();
        a.and(ebx, -2i32).unwrap();
        a.mov(dword_ptr(DATA), 5).unwrap();
        a.sub(dword_ptr(DATA), -3).unwrap(); // 8
        a.add(dword_ptr(DATA), 0x1000).unwrap(); // imm32
        a.mov(ecx, 2).unwrap();
        a.xor(dword_ptr(DATA + 4), ecx).unwrap();
        a.or(ecx, dword_ptr(DATA)).unwrap();
        a.cmp(dword_ptr(DATA), 0x1008).unwrap();
        a.sete(dl).unwrap();
        a.push(-5).unwrap(); // push imm8 sign-extended
        a.pop(esi).unwrap();
        a.push(0x12345).unwrap();
        a.pop(edi).unwrap();
        a.mov(dword_ptr(DATA + 8), ecx).unwrap();
        a.inc(dword_ptr(DATA + 8)).unwrap();
        a.test(dword_ptr(DATA + 8), 1).unwrap();
        a.setne(dh).unwrap();
        a.adc(eax, 0).unwrap();
    });
    assert_eq!(cpu.regs[EAX], 9);
    assert_eq!(cpu.regs[EBX], 0x80);
    assert_eq!(mem.read_u32(DATA), 0x1008);
    assert_eq!(mem.read_u32(DATA + 4), 2);
    assert_eq!(cpu.regs[ECX], 0x100A);
    assert_eq!(cpu.regs[EDX] & 0xFFFF, 0x0101);
    assert_eq!(cpu.regs[ESI], (-5i32) as u32);
    assert_eq!(cpu.regs[EDI], 0x12345);
    assert_eq!(mem.read_u32(DATA + 8), 0x100B);
}

#[test]
fn sbb_reg_reg_idiom_and_neg_carry() {
    let (cpu, _) = run_both(|a| {
        a.mov(eax, 5).unwrap();
        a.neg(eax).unwrap(); // CF=1
        a.sbb(ecx, ecx).unwrap(); // -1
        a.xor(edx, edx).unwrap();
        a.neg(edx).unwrap(); // CF=0
        a.sbb(ebx, ebx).unwrap(); // 0
    });
    assert_eq!(cpu.regs[ECX], 0xFFFF_FFFF);
    assert_eq!(cpu.regs[EBX], 0);
}

#[test]
fn string_ops_backward_and_compare() {
    let (cpu, mem) = run_both(|a| {
        // memmove backwards (CRT uses std + rep movsb/movsd for overlapping dst > src)
        a.mov(edi, DATA).unwrap();
        a.mov(ecx, 8).unwrap();
        a.mov(eax, 0x0403_0201).unwrap();
        a.rep().stosd().unwrap(); // 32 bytes of 01 02 03 04
        a.std().unwrap();
        a.mov(esi, DATA + 31).unwrap();
        a.mov(edi, DATA + 35).unwrap();
        a.mov(ecx, 32).unwrap();
        a.rep().movsb().unwrap();
        a.cld().unwrap();
        // repe cmpsb finds the first difference
        a.mov(esi, DATA + 4).unwrap();
        a.mov(edi, DATA + 8).unwrap();
        a.mov(byte_ptr(DATA + 8 + 5), 0xEE).unwrap();
        a.mov(ecx, 20).unwrap();
        a.repe().cmpsb().unwrap();
        a.mov(ebx, ecx).unwrap(); // 20 - 6 = 14
        a.setb(dl).unwrap(); // [esi]=02 < EE ? -> CF=1
        // lodsb / scasd / stosw singles
        a.mov(esi, DATA).unwrap();
        a.lodsb().unwrap();
        a.mov(dword_ptr(DATA + 0x100), 0x1234_5678).unwrap();
        a.mov(edi, DATA + 0x100).unwrap();
        a.push(eax).unwrap();
        a.mov(eax, 0x1234_5678).unwrap();
        a.scasd().unwrap();
        a.sete(dh).unwrap();
        a.pop(eax).unwrap();
        a.mov(edi, DATA + 0x200).unwrap();
        a.stosw().unwrap();
        // rep with ECX=0 does nothing
        a.xor(ecx, ecx).unwrap();
        a.mov(edi, DATA + 0x300).unwrap();
        a.rep().stosb().unwrap();
    });
    // Backward copy moved [DATA..DATA+32) to [DATA+4..DATA+36) without corruption.
    for i in (0..32u32).filter(|&i| i != 9) {
        assert_eq!(mem.read_u8(DATA + 4 + i), (i % 4 + 1) as u8, "byte {i}");
    }
    assert_eq!(cpu.regs[EBX], 14);
    assert_eq!(cpu.regs[EDX] & 0xFF, 1);
    assert_eq!((cpu.regs[EDX] >> 8) & 0xFF, 1);
    assert_eq!(cpu.regs[EAX] & 0xFF, 1);
    assert_eq!(mem.read_u16(DATA + 0x200), 0x0201);
    assert_eq!(cpu.regs[EDI], DATA + 0x300);
    assert!(!cpu.flag(fl::DF));
}

#[test]
fn rep_movsd_overlapping_forward_replicates_dwords() {
    let (_, mem) = run_both(|a| {
        a.mov(dword_ptr(DATA), 0xAABB_CCDDu32).unwrap();
        a.mov(esi, DATA).unwrap();
        a.mov(edi, DATA + 4).unwrap();
        a.mov(ecx, 7).unwrap();
        a.rep().movsd().unwrap();
    });
    for i in 0..8 {
        assert_eq!(mem.read_u32(DATA + 4 * i), 0xAABB_CCDD);
    }
}

#[test]
fn repne_scasb_with_fault_midway_rewinds_and_keeps_ecx() {
    // Scan backwards from 0x10003 into the NULL guard: must fault with ECX/EDI reflecting progress.
    let (mut cpu, mut mem) = setup(|a| {
        a.std().unwrap();
        a.mov(edi, 0x0001_0003).unwrap();
        a.mov(al, 0x77).unwrap();
        a.mov(ecx, 100).unwrap();
        a.repne().scasb().unwrap();
    });
    match cpu.run(&mut mem, 1000) {
        CpuExit::Fault { kind: FaultKind::AccessViolation { addr: 0xFFFF, write: false }, eip, .. } => {
            assert_eq!(cpu.eip, eip);
            assert_eq!(cpu.regs[ECX], 96);
            assert_eq!(cpu.regs[EDI], 0xFFFF);
        }
        e => panic!("{e:?}"),
    }
}

#[test]
fn jcxz_with_address_size_prefix_tests_cx_only() {
    // mov ecx, 0x10000 ; 67 e3 05 (jcxz +5) ; mov eax, 1 ; ret ; mov eax, 2 ; ret
    let code = [
        0xB9, 0x00, 0x00, 0x01, 0x00, // mov ecx, 0x10000
        0x67, 0xE3, 0x06, // jcxz +6
        0xB8, 0x01, 0, 0, 0, // mov eax,1
        0xC3, // ret
        0xB8, 0x02, 0, 0, 0, // mov eax,2
        0xC3,
    ];
    let (cpu, _, e) = run_bytes(&code, |_, _| {});
    assert_eq!(e, CpuExit::ReturnMagic);
    assert_eq!(cpu.regs[EAX], 2, "CX == 0 even though ECX != 0");
    // jecxz (no prefix) must not jump for ECX = 0x10000.
    let mut code2 = code;
    code2[5] = 0x90; // nop instead of 0x67
    let (cpu, _, _) = run_bytes(&code2, |_, _| {});
    assert_eq!(cpu.regs[EAX], 1);
}

#[test]
fn loop_variants() {
    let (cpu, _) = run_both(|a| {
        let mut l1 = a.create_label();
        let mut l2 = a.create_label();
        a.xor(eax, eax).unwrap();
        a.mov(ecx, 5).unwrap();
        a.set_label(&mut l1).unwrap();
        a.add(eax, 2).unwrap();
        a.loop_(l1).unwrap();
        // loope stops when ZF=0
        a.mov(ecx, 10).unwrap();
        a.xor(ebx, ebx).unwrap();
        a.set_label(&mut l2).unwrap();
        a.inc(ebx).unwrap();
        a.cmp(ebx, 3).unwrap(); // ZF=0 once ebx != 3 ... first iteration ebx=1 -> ZF=0 -> exit
        a.loope(l2).unwrap();
    });
    assert_eq!(cpu.regs[EAX], 10);
    assert_eq!(cpu.regs[EBX], 1);
    assert_eq!(cpu.regs[ECX], 9);
}

#[test]
fn bcd_adjust() {
    let (cpu, _) = run_both(|a| {
        a.mov(al, 0x79).unwrap();
        a.add(al, 0x35).unwrap();
        a.daa().unwrap(); // 0x14, CF=1
        a.setb(bl).unwrap();
        a.mov(bh, al).unwrap();
        a.mov(al, 0x35).unwrap();
        a.sub(al, 0x47).unwrap();
        a.das().unwrap(); // 0x88, CF=1
        a.setb(cl).unwrap();
        a.mov(ch, al).unwrap();
        a.mov(eax, 0).unwrap();
        a.mov(al, 8).unwrap();
        a.add(al, 6).unwrap();
        a.aaa().unwrap(); // AX = 0x0104
        a.mov(edx, eax).unwrap();
        a.mov(eax, 0x0103).unwrap();
        a.sub(al, 8).unwrap();
        a.aas().unwrap(); // AX = 0x0005
        a.mov(esi, eax).unwrap();
        a.mov(eax, 0x3F).unwrap();
        a.aam(10).unwrap(); // AX = 0x0603
        a.mov(edi, eax).unwrap();
        a.aad(10).unwrap(); // AX = 0x003F
    });
    assert_eq!(cpu.regs[EBX] & 0xFFFF, 0x1401);
    assert_eq!(cpu.regs[ECX] & 0xFFFF, 0x8801);
    assert_eq!(cpu.regs[EDX] & 0xFFFF, 0x0104);
    assert_eq!(cpu.regs[ESI] & 0xFFFF, 0x0005);
    assert_eq!(cpu.regs[EDI] & 0xFFFF, 0x0603);
    assert_eq!(cpu.regs[EAX] & 0xFFFF, 0x003F);
}

#[test]
fn aam_zero_is_divide_error() {
    let (cpu, _, e) = run_bytes(&[0xD4, 0x00, 0xC3], |_, _| {});
    assert!(matches!(e, CpuExit::Fault { kind: FaultKind::DivideError, .. }), "{e:?}");
    assert_eq!(cpu.eip, CODE);
}

#[test]
fn flags_push_pop_lahf_sahf_and_cpu_probes() {
    let (cpu, mem) = run_both(|a| {
        // 486 / CPUID probe: toggle AC (bit 18) and ID (bit 21) through pushfd/popfd.
        a.pushfd().unwrap();
        a.pop(eax).unwrap();
        a.mov(ecx, eax).unwrap();
        a.xor(eax, 0x0024_0000).unwrap();
        a.push(eax).unwrap();
        a.popfd().unwrap();
        a.pushfd().unwrap();
        a.pop(eax).unwrap();
        a.xor(eax, ecx).unwrap(); // bits that toggled
        a.mov(dword_ptr(DATA), eax).unwrap();
        a.push(ecx).unwrap();
        a.popfd().unwrap();
        // sahf after "fnstsw ax" pattern: AH = C3..C0 -> ZF, PF, CF
        a.mov(eax, 0x4500).unwrap(); // C3 | C2 | C0 -> ZF PF CF
        a.sahf().unwrap();
        a.setp(bl).unwrap();
        a.sete(bh).unwrap();
        a.setb(dl).unwrap();
        a.lahf().unwrap();
        a.mov(dword_ptr(DATA + 4), eax).unwrap();
        a.stc().unwrap();
        a.cmc().unwrap();
        a.setb(dh).unwrap();
        a.mov(dword_ptr(DATA + 16), ebx).unwrap();
        a.mov(dword_ptr(DATA + 20), edx).unwrap();
        // cpuid leaf 1: no MMX
        a.mov(eax, 1).unwrap();
        a.cpuid().unwrap();
        a.mov(dword_ptr(DATA + 8), edx).unwrap();
        a.mov(dword_ptr(DATA + 12), eax).unwrap();
    });
    assert_eq!(mem.read_u32(DATA), 0x0024_0000, "AC and ID toggle");
    let _ = &cpu;
    assert_eq!(mem.read_u32(DATA + 16) & 0xFFFF, 0x0101);
    assert_eq!(mem.read_u32(DATA + 20) & 0xFFFF, 0x0001);
    assert_eq!((mem.read_u32(DATA + 4) >> 8) & 0xD5, 0x45);
    assert_eq!(mem.read_u32(DATA + 8) & (1 << 23), 0, "MMX must not be reported");
    assert_eq!(mem.read_u32(DATA + 8) & 1, 1, "FPU present");
    assert_eq!((mem.read_u32(DATA + 12) >> 8) & 0xF, 5, "family 5");
}

#[test]
fn interrupts_and_invalid_opcodes() {
    let (cpu, _, e) = run_bytes(&[0x90, 0xCC, 0xC3], |_, _| {});
    assert_eq!(e, CpuExit::Interrupt(3));
    assert_eq!(cpu.eip, CODE + 2, "EIP after int3");
    let (_, _, e) = run_bytes(&[0xCD, 0x2E, 0xC3], |_, _| {});
    assert_eq!(e, CpuExit::Interrupt(0x2E));
    let (cpu, _, e) = run_bytes(&[0x90, 0x0F, 0x0B], |_, _| {});
    assert!(matches!(e, CpuExit::Fault { kind: FaultKind::InvalidOpcode, eip, .. } if eip == CODE + 1), "{e:?}");
    assert_eq!(cpu.eip, CODE + 1);
    // Undecodable bytes at the block start.
    let (_, _, e) = run_bytes(&[0x0F, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF], |_, _| {});
    assert!(matches!(e, CpuExit::Fault { kind: FaultKind::InvalidOpcode, .. }), "{e:?}");
    // in al, dx / out: privileged
    let (_, _, e) = run_bytes(&[0xEC, 0xC3], |_, _| {});
    assert!(matches!(e, CpuExit::Fault { kind: FaultKind::GeneralProtection, .. }), "{e:?}");
    let (_, _, e) = run_bytes(&[0xF4], |_, _| {});
    assert_eq!(e, CpuExit::Halt);
}

#[test]
fn misc_xlat_enter_nested_xchg_mem_cmpxchg_fail_bt_mem() {
    let (cpu, mem) = run_both(|a| {
        a.mov(ebx, DATA + 0x100).unwrap();
        a.mov(byte_ptr(DATA + 0x100 + 7), 0x42).unwrap();
        a.mov(eax, 0xFFFF_FF07u32).unwrap();
        a.xlatb().unwrap(); // AL = [EBX + 7]
        a.mov(esi, eax).unwrap();
        // xchg with memory
        a.mov(dword_ptr(DATA), 11).unwrap();
        a.mov(ecx, 22).unwrap();
        a.xchg(dword_ptr(DATA), ecx).unwrap();
        // cmpxchg failing path loads the accumulator
        a.mov(eax, 99).unwrap();
        a.mov(edx, 5).unwrap();
        a.cmpxchg(dword_ptr(DATA), edx).unwrap(); // [DATA]=22 != 99 -> EAX=22, ZF=0
        a.setne(dl).unwrap();
        // bt with memory base and a register offset beyond the dword (bit 37 = byte 4, bit 5)
        a.mov(dword_ptr(DATA + 0x200), 0).unwrap();
        a.mov(dword_ptr(DATA + 0x204), 0x20).unwrap();
        a.mov(edi, 37).unwrap();
        a.bt(dword_ptr(DATA + 0x200), edi).unwrap();
        a.setb(dh).unwrap();
        a.mov(edi, -1i32).unwrap(); // bit -1 = byte -4 .. bit 31 of the previous dword
        a.bts(dword_ptr(DATA + 0x200), edi).unwrap();
        // lock inc on memory
        a.lock().inc(dword_ptr(DATA + 0x300)).unwrap();
        a.lock().dec(dword_ptr(DATA + 0x300)).unwrap();
        a.lock().dec(dword_ptr(DATA + 0x300)).unwrap();
        // movsx/movzx 16-bit forms
        a.mov(word_ptr(DATA + 0x400), 0x8001).unwrap();
        a.movsx(ebp, word_ptr(DATA + 0x400)).unwrap();
        a.mov(dword_ptr(DATA + 0x404), ebp).unwrap();
        a.movzx(ebp, word_ptr(DATA + 0x400)).unwrap();
        a.mov(dword_ptr(DATA + 0x408), ebp).unwrap();
        a.mov(ebp, 0).unwrap();
    });
    assert_eq!(cpu.regs[ESI], 0xFFFF_FF42);
    assert_eq!(cpu.regs[ECX], 11);
    assert_eq!(cpu.regs[EAX], 22);
    assert_eq!(mem.read_u32(DATA), 22);
    assert_eq!(cpu.regs[EDX] & 0xFFFF, 0x0101);
    assert_eq!(mem.read_u32(DATA + 0x1FC), 0x8000_0000);
    assert_eq!(mem.read_u32(DATA + 0x300), 0xFFFF_FFFF);
    assert_eq!(mem.read_u32(DATA + 0x404), 0xFFFF_8001);
    assert_eq!(mem.read_u32(DATA + 0x408), 0x8001);
}

#[test]
fn enter_nested_levels() {
    let (cpu, mem) = run_both(|a| {
        a.mov(ebp, STACK_TOP - 0x100).unwrap();
        a.mov(dword_ptr(STACK_TOP - 0x104), 0xAAAA).unwrap(); // outer frame's saved display entry
        a.enter(8, 2).unwrap();
        a.mov(eax, ebp).unwrap();
        a.mov(ebx, dword_ptr(ebp - 4)).unwrap(); // copied display entry
        a.mov(ecx, dword_ptr(ebp - 8)).unwrap(); // the new frame pointer itself
        a.mov(edx, esp).unwrap();
        a.leave().unwrap();
    });
    let frame = STACK_TOP - 4 - 4; // after `ret addr` push and `push ebp`
    assert_eq!(cpu.regs[EAX], frame);
    assert_eq!(cpu.regs[EBX], 0xAAAA);
    assert_eq!(cpu.regs[ECX], frame);
    assert_eq!(cpu.regs[EDX], frame - 8 - 8);
    assert_eq!(cpu.regs[EBP], STACK_TOP - 0x100);
    let _ = mem;
}

#[test]
fn fs_override_reads_and_writes_teb() {
    let (mut cpu, mut mem) = setup(|a| {
        // Typical SEH prologue: push handler; push fs:[0]; mov fs:[0], esp
        a.push(0x0040_2000).unwrap();
        a.push(dword_ptr(0).fs()).unwrap();
        a.mov(dword_ptr(0).fs(), esp).unwrap();
        a.mov(eax, dword_ptr(4).fs()).unwrap();
        // epilogue
        a.mov(ecx, dword_ptr(esp)).unwrap();
        a.mov(dword_ptr(0).fs(), ecx).unwrap();
        a.add(esp, 8).unwrap();
    });
    cpu.fs_base = 0x7FFD_E000;
    mem.write_u32(0x7FFD_E000, 0xFFFF_FFFF);
    mem.write_u32(0x7FFD_E004, 0x0090_0000);
    assert_eq!(cpu.run(&mut mem, 100), CpuExit::ReturnMagic);
    assert_eq!(cpu.regs[EAX], 0x0090_0000);
    assert_eq!(mem.read_u32(0x7FFD_E000), 0xFFFF_FFFF);
    assert_eq!(cpu.regs[ECX], 0xFFFF_FFFF);
}

#[test]
fn operand_size_prefix_16bit_ops() {
    let (cpu, mem) = run_both(|a| {
        a.mov(eax, 0x1234_FFFF).unwrap();
        a.add(ax, 1).unwrap(); // AX wraps, upper half kept, CF=1
        a.setb(bl).unwrap();
        a.mov(word_ptr(DATA), 0x7FFF).unwrap();
        a.inc(word_ptr(DATA)).unwrap(); // OF
        a.seto(bh).unwrap();
        a.push(ax).unwrap(); // 66 50: 2-byte push
        a.pop(cx).unwrap();
        a.mov(edx, esp).unwrap();
        a.shl(word_ptr(DATA), 1).unwrap(); // 0x8000 << 1 = 0, CF=1
        a.rcl(word_ptr(DATA), 1).unwrap(); // = 1
        a.imul_3(si, word_ptr(DATA), -3).unwrap();
    });
    assert_eq!(cpu.regs[EAX], 0x1234_0000);
    assert_eq!(cpu.regs[EBX] & 0xFFFF, 0x0101);
    assert_eq!(cpu.regs[ECX] & 0xFFFF, 0);
    assert_eq!(cpu.regs[EDX], STACK_TOP - 4);
    assert_eq!(mem.read_u16(DATA), 1);
    assert_eq!(cpu.regs[ESI] & 0xFFFF, 0xFFFD);
}

#[test]
fn indirect_calls_jumps_and_ret_imm() {
    const TARGET: u32 = CODE + 0x800;
    let (cpu, _) = run_both(|a| {
        let mut f = a.create_label();
        // Jump target: `mov esi, 77; ret` written as data first (not yet decoded, so no invalidation needed).
        a.mov(dword_ptr(TARGET), 0x0000_4DBE).unwrap();
        a.mov(word_ptr(TARGET + 4), 0xC300).unwrap();
        a.push(1).unwrap();
        a.push(2).unwrap();
        a.call(f).unwrap(); // stdcall, ret 8
        a.mov(ebx, eax).unwrap();
        a.mov(dword_ptr(DATA + 8), TARGET).unwrap();
        a.mov(edx, 2).unwrap();
        a.jmp(dword_ptr(edx * 4 + DATA)).unwrap(); // switch-table style; target `ret`s to MAGIC
        a.int3().unwrap();
        a.set_label(&mut f).unwrap();
        a.mov(eax, dword_ptr(esp + 4)).unwrap();
        a.add(eax, dword_ptr(esp + 8)).unwrap();
        a.ret_1(8).unwrap();
    });
    assert_eq!(cpu.regs[EBX], 3);
    assert_eq!(cpu.regs[ESI], 77);
}

#[test]
fn sixteen_bit_addressing_wraps_and_string_addr16_is_refused() {
    // 67 8B 00 = mov eax, [bx+si]; bx=0xFFFF si=0x0011 -> address 0x0010 (wraps) -> NULL guard fault at 0x10.
    let (_, _, e) = run_bytes(&[0x67, 0x8B, 0x00, 0xC3], |c, _| {
        c.regs[EBX] = 0x0001_FFFF;
        c.regs[ESI] = 0x0011;
    });
    assert!(matches!(e, CpuExit::Fault { kind: FaultKind::AccessViolation { addr: 0x10, .. }, .. }), "{e:?}");
    // 67 A4 = movsb with SI/DI
    let (_, _, e) = run_bytes(&[0x67, 0xA4, 0xC3], |_, _| {});
    assert!(matches!(e, CpuExit::Fault { kind: FaultKind::Unimplemented, .. }), "{e:?}");
}

#[test]
fn movzx_movsx_all_forms_fast_vs_generic() {
    let (cpu, _) = run_both(|a| {
        a.mov(dword_ptr(DATA), 0x8180_FF7Fu32).unwrap();
        a.movzx(eax, byte_ptr(DATA + 1)).unwrap(); // 0xFF
        a.movsx(ebx, byte_ptr(DATA + 1)).unwrap(); // -1
        a.movzx(ecx, word_ptr(DATA + 2)).unwrap(); // 0x8180
        a.movsx(edx, word_ptr(DATA + 2)).unwrap(); // 0xFFFF8180
        a.mov(esi, 0x1234_80F0).unwrap();
        a.movsx(edi, si).unwrap(); // 0xFFFF80F0
        a.movzx(ebp, si).unwrap();
        a.mov(dword_ptr(DATA + 4), ebp).unwrap();
        a.movsx(ebp, al).unwrap(); // al = 0xFF -> -1
        a.mov(dword_ptr(DATA + 8), ebp).unwrap();
        a.movzx(esi, ch).unwrap(); // 0x81
        a.mov(ebp, 0).unwrap();
    });
    assert_eq!(cpu.regs[EAX], 0xFF);
    assert_eq!(cpu.regs[EBX], 0xFFFF_FFFF);
    assert_eq!(cpu.regs[ECX], 0x8180);
    assert_eq!(cpu.regs[EDX], 0xFFFF_8180);
    assert_eq!(cpu.regs[EDI], 0xFFFF_80F0);
    assert_eq!(cpu.regs[ESI], 0x81);
}

#[test]
fn hook_exits_mid_block_and_skip_once() {
    // mov eax,1 (5 bytes) ; mov ebx,2 (5 bytes, hooked at CODE+5) ; ret
    let (mut cpu, mut mem) = setup(|a| {
        a.mov(eax, 1u32).unwrap();
        a.mov(ebx, 2u32).unwrap();
    });
    // Warm the cache without hooks first: set_hooks must drop the old unsplit block.
    let mut warm = Cpu::new();
    warm.eip = CODE;
    let _ = warm.run(&mut mem, 1);
    let mut set = HookAddrs::new();
    set.insert(CODE + 5);
    cpu.set_hooks(Some(std::sync::Arc::new(set)));
    assert_eq!(cpu.run(&mut mem, 100), CpuExit::Hook(CODE + 5));
    assert_eq!(cpu.regs[EAX], 1);
    assert_eq!(cpu.regs[EBX], 0, "hooked instruction must not have run");
    assert_eq!(cpu.eip, CODE + 5);
    // Running again without skip exits again (no progress).
    assert_eq!(cpu.run(&mut mem, 100), CpuExit::Hook(CODE + 5));
    cpu.skip_hook_once(CODE + 5);
    assert_eq!(cpu.run(&mut mem, 100), CpuExit::ReturnMagic);
    assert_eq!(cpu.regs[EBX], 2);
    // Removing hooks restores plain execution.
    cpu.set_hooks(None);
    cpu.eip = CODE;
    cpu.push32(&mut mem, layout::MAGIC_RETURN);
    assert_eq!(cpu.run(&mut mem, 100), CpuExit::ReturnMagic);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// perf-interp: threaded dispatch must keep exits and retired-instruction counts exact.

/// Loop with loads, stores, ALU, a call and a conditional skip (like `bench_mips`, 200 iterations).
fn budget_program(a: &mut CodeAssembler) {
    let mut top = a.create_label();
    let mut func = a.create_label();
    let mut done = a.create_label();
    let mut skip = a.create_label();
    a.mov(ecx, 200u32).unwrap();
    a.mov(esi, DATA).unwrap();
    a.xor(eax, eax).unwrap();
    a.set_label(&mut top).unwrap();
    a.mov(edx, dword_ptr(esi + 8)).unwrap();
    a.add(edx, ecx).unwrap();
    a.mov(dword_ptr(esi + 8), edx).unwrap();
    a.imul_3(edx, edx, 37).unwrap();
    a.test(ecx, 3).unwrap();
    a.jne(skip).unwrap();
    a.push(ecx).unwrap();
    a.call(func).unwrap();
    a.add(esp, 4).unwrap();
    a.set_label(&mut skip).unwrap();
    a.lea(edi, ptr(esi + ecx * 4)).unwrap();
    a.and(edi, 0xFFF).unwrap();
    a.movzx(ebx, byte_ptr(esi + edi)).unwrap();
    a.add(eax, ebx).unwrap();
    a.adc(eax, edx).unwrap();
    a.dec(ecx).unwrap();
    a.jne(top).unwrap();
    a.jmp(done).unwrap();
    a.set_label(&mut func).unwrap();
    a.push(ebp).unwrap();
    a.mov(ebp, esp).unwrap();
    a.mov(eax, dword_ptr(ebp + 8)).unwrap();
    a.shl(eax, 2).unwrap();
    a.cdq().unwrap();
    a.pop(ebp).unwrap();
    a.ret().unwrap();
    a.set_label(&mut done).unwrap();
    a.nop().unwrap();
}

/// Running with small budgets (stops inside blocks) must retire exactly the budget per run and end in the same
/// state, with the same total count, as one run (fast and generic paths).
#[test]
fn budget_stops_are_exact() {
    let mut results = Vec::new();
    for generic in [false, true] {
        for chunk in [1_000_000u64, 1, 2, 3, 5, 7, 13] {
            let (mut cpu, mut mem) = setup(budget_program);
            cpu.set_generic_only(generic);
            let mut runs = 0u32;
            loop {
                let before = cpu.instructions;
                let e = cpu.run(&mut mem, chunk);
                runs += 1;
                match e {
                    CpuExit::Budget => assert_eq!(cpu.instructions - before, chunk, "chunk {chunk}"),
                    CpuExit::ReturnMagic => break,
                    e => panic!("{e:?}"),
                }
                assert!(runs < 1_000_000);
            }
            results.push((generic, chunk, cpu.regs, cpu.eflags(), cpu.instructions, mem.slice(DATA, 0x1000).to_vec()));
        }
    }
    let r0 = &results[0];
    for r in &results {
        assert_eq!((r.2, r.3, r.4), (r0.2, r0.3, r0.4), "generic {} chunk {}", r.0, r.1);
        assert_eq!(r.5, r0.5, "memory, generic {} chunk {}", r.0, r.1);
    }
}

/// Exits in the middle of a block: retired count and EIP for faults (instruction not retired, EIP at it) and
/// for `int3` / `hlt` (retired, EIP after it), from fast and generic handlers.
#[test]
fn mid_block_exits_count_exactly() {
    // nop; mov eax,[0x10]; ret  -> AV at CODE+1 after 1 instruction.
    let (cpu, _, e) = run_bytes(&[0x90, 0xA1, 0x10, 0, 0, 0, 0xC3], |_, _| {});
    assert!(
        matches!(e, CpuExit::Fault { kind: FaultKind::AccessViolation { addr: 0x10, write: false }, eip, .. } if eip == CODE + 1),
        "{e:?}"
    );
    assert_eq!((cpu.eip, cpu.instructions), (CODE + 1, 1));
    // nop; nop; mov [ecx],eax (ecx = 0); ret
    let (cpu, _, e) = run_bytes(&[0x90, 0x90, 0x89, 0x01, 0xC3], |_, _| {});
    assert!(
        matches!(e, CpuExit::Fault { kind: FaultKind::AccessViolation { addr: 0, write: true }, eip, .. } if eip == CODE + 2),
        "{e:?}"
    );
    assert_eq!((cpu.eip, cpu.instructions), (CODE + 2, 2));
    // nop; push eax with ESP in the guard -> fault, ESP unchanged.
    let (cpu, _, e) = run_bytes(&[0x90, 0x50, 0xC3], |c, _| c.regs[ESP] = 0x100);
    assert!(matches!(e, CpuExit::Fault { eip, .. } if eip == CODE + 1), "{e:?}");
    assert_eq!((cpu.eip, cpu.instructions, cpu.regs[ESP]), (CODE + 1, 1, 0x100));
    // nop; cdq; idiv ecx (ecx = 0) -> #DE after 2 instructions.
    let (cpu, _, e) = run_bytes(&[0x90, 0x99, 0xF7, 0xF9, 0xC3], |_, _| {});
    assert!(matches!(e, CpuExit::Fault { kind: FaultKind::DivideError, eip, .. } if eip == CODE + 2), "{e:?}");
    assert_eq!((cpu.eip, cpu.instructions), (CODE + 2, 2));
    // nop; int3 -> retired, EIP after it.
    let (cpu, _, e) = run_bytes(&[0x90, 0xCC, 0xC3], |_, _| {});
    assert_eq!(e, CpuExit::Interrupt(3));
    assert_eq!((cpu.eip, cpu.instructions), (CODE + 2, 2));
    // nop; nop; hlt; nop -> Halt, EIP after hlt.
    let (cpu, _, e) = run_bytes(&[0x90, 0x90, 0xF4, 0x90, 0xC3], |_, _| {});
    assert_eq!(e, CpuExit::Halt);
    assert_eq!((cpu.eip, cpu.instructions), (CODE + 3, 3));
    // Partial-block path: budget 2, then a run that faults at the 4th instruction of the block.
    let mut mem = GuestMemory::new().unwrap();
    mem.write_bytes(CODE, &[0x90, 0x90, 0x90, 0xA1, 0x10, 0, 0, 0, 0x90, 0xC3]);
    let mut cpu = Cpu::new();
    cpu.regs[ESP] = STACK_TOP;
    cpu.eip = CODE;
    assert_eq!(cpu.run(&mut mem, 2), CpuExit::Budget);
    assert_eq!((cpu.eip, cpu.instructions), (CODE + 2, 2));
    let e = cpu.run(&mut mem, 3);
    assert!(matches!(e, CpuExit::Fault { eip, .. } if eip == CODE + 3), "{e:?}");
    assert_eq!((cpu.eip, cpu.instructions), (CODE + 3, 3));
    // Budget stop exactly before the faulting instruction, then the fault from the full-block path.
    cpu.eip = CODE;
    cpu.instructions = 0;
    assert_eq!(cpu.run(&mut mem, 3), CpuExit::Budget);
    assert_eq!((cpu.eip, cpu.instructions), (CODE + 3, 3));
}

/// Edge-case and pseudo-random operand values for the fast-vs-generic form tests.
fn form_values() -> Vec<u32> {
    let mut v = vec![
        0u32, 1, 2, 3, 7, 8, 9, 15, 16, 17, 31, 32, 33, 0x7F, 0x80, 0x81, 0xFF, 0x100, 0x7FFF, 0x8000, 0xFFFF,
        0x1_0000, 0x7FFF_FFFF, 0x8000_0000, 0x8000_0001, 0xFFFF_FFFE, 0xFFFF_FFFF, 0x1234_5678, 0xDEAD_BEEF,
    ];
    let mut x = 0x9E37_79B9u32;
    for _ in 0..40 {
        x ^= x << 13;
        x ^= x >> 17;
        x ^= x << 5;
        v.push(x);
    }
    v
}

/// Run `emit` for operand pairs `(a, b)` (EAX = a, EBX = b, ECX = b, EDX = !a, [DATA+0xF00] = b, incoming flags
/// alternating 0 / all status flags) and store EAX, EBX, ECX, EDX and EFLAGS of every case into DATA; the
/// fast and the generic path must agree on everything (`run_both`).
fn forms_fast_vs_generic(emit: &dyn Fn(&mut CodeAssembler)) {
    let vals = form_values();
    let pairs: Vec<(u32, u32)> = vals.iter().flat_map(|&a| vals.iter().map(move |&b| (a, b))).collect();
    for chunk in pairs.chunks(150) {
        run_both(|a| {
            for (k, &(x, y)) in chunk.iter().enumerate() {
                let o = DATA + 20 * k as u32;
                a.mov(eax, x).unwrap();
                a.mov(ebx, y).unwrap();
                a.mov(ecx, y).unwrap();
                a.mov(edx, !x).unwrap();
                a.mov(dword_ptr(DATA + 0xF00), y).unwrap();
                a.push(if k % 2 == 0 { 0x202u32 } else { 0x202 | 0x8D5 }).unwrap();
                a.popfd().unwrap();
                emit(a);
                a.pushfd().unwrap();
                a.pop(dword_ptr(o + 16)).unwrap();
                a.mov(dword_ptr(o), eax).unwrap();
                a.mov(dword_ptr(o + 4), ebx).unwrap();
                a.mov(dword_ptr(o + 8), ecx).unwrap();
                a.mov(dword_ptr(o + 12), edx).unwrap();
            }
        });
    }
}

#[test]
fn imul_mul_cdq_forms_fast_vs_generic() {
    forms_fast_vs_generic(&|a| a.imul_2(eax, ebx).unwrap());
    forms_fast_vs_generic(&|a| a.imul_2(eax, dword_ptr(DATA + 0xF00)).unwrap());
    forms_fast_vs_generic(&|a| a.imul_3(edx, ebx, 37).unwrap());
    forms_fast_vs_generic(&|a| a.imul_3(edx, ebx, -3).unwrap());
    forms_fast_vs_generic(&|a| a.imul_3(eax, ebx, 0x1234_5678).unwrap());
    forms_fast_vs_generic(&|a| a.imul_3(ecx, dword_ptr(DATA + 0xF00), -100_000).unwrap());
    forms_fast_vs_generic(&|a| a.imul(ebx).unwrap());
    forms_fast_vs_generic(&|a| a.imul(dword_ptr(DATA + 0xF00)).unwrap());
    forms_fast_vs_generic(&|a| a.mul(ebx).unwrap());
    forms_fast_vs_generic(&|a| a.mul(dword_ptr(DATA + 0xF00)).unwrap());
    forms_fast_vs_generic(&|a| a.cdq().unwrap());
    forms_fast_vs_generic(&|a| a.cwde().unwrap());
    forms_fast_vs_generic(&|a| a.neg(ebx).unwrap());
    forms_fast_vs_generic(&|a| a.not(ebx).unwrap());
    forms_fast_vs_generic(&|a| a.inc(dword_ptr(DATA + 0xF00)).unwrap());
    forms_fast_vs_generic(&|a| a.dec(dword_ptr(DATA + 0xF00)).unwrap());
}

#[test]
fn shift_forms_fast_vs_generic() {
    for c in [0u32, 1, 2, 7, 8, 9, 15, 16, 17, 24, 31] {
        forms_fast_vs_generic(&|a| a.shl(bl, c).unwrap());
        forms_fast_vs_generic(&|a| a.shr(bh, c).unwrap());
        forms_fast_vs_generic(&|a| a.sar(al, c).unwrap());
        forms_fast_vs_generic(&|a| a.shl(bx, c).unwrap());
        forms_fast_vs_generic(&|a| a.shr(ax, c).unwrap());
        forms_fast_vs_generic(&|a| a.sar(dx, c).unwrap());
    }
    // By CL (ECX = b: all counts incl. >= 32, masked to 5 bits).
    forms_fast_vs_generic(&|a| a.shl(eax, cl).unwrap());
    forms_fast_vs_generic(&|a| a.shr(edx, cl).unwrap());
    forms_fast_vs_generic(&|a| a.sar(eax, cl).unwrap());
    forms_fast_vs_generic(&|a| a.shl(ax, cl).unwrap());
    forms_fast_vs_generic(&|a| a.shr(dx, cl).unwrap());
    forms_fast_vs_generic(&|a| a.sar(bx, cl).unwrap());
    forms_fast_vs_generic(&|a| a.shl(al, cl).unwrap());
    forms_fast_vs_generic(&|a| a.shr(ah, cl).unwrap());
    forms_fast_vs_generic(&|a| a.sar(bl, cl).unwrap());
}

#[test]
fn setcc_forms_fast_vs_generic() {
    // After cmp (lazy SUB), test (lazy LOGIC), add (lazy ADD) and the popfd'd flags (eager).
    forms_fast_vs_generic(&|a| {
        a.cmp(eax, ebx).unwrap();
        a.setb(al).unwrap();
        a.setl(ah).unwrap();
        a.setbe(bl).unwrap();
        a.setg(bh).unwrap();
        a.seto(cl).unwrap();
        a.setp(ch).unwrap();
        a.sets(dl).unwrap();
        a.sete(dh).unwrap();
    });
    forms_fast_vs_generic(&|a| {
        a.add(ebx, eax).unwrap();
        a.setae(al).unwrap();
        a.setge(ah).unwrap();
        a.seta(bl).unwrap();
        a.setle(bh).unwrap();
        a.setno(cl).unwrap();
        a.setnp(ch).unwrap();
        a.setns(dl).unwrap();
        a.setne(dh).unwrap();
    });
    forms_fast_vs_generic(&|a| {
        a.test(al, bl).unwrap();
        a.setb(al).unwrap();
        a.setle(ah).unwrap();
        a.seta(bl).unwrap();
        a.setg(bh).unwrap();
    });
    forms_fast_vs_generic(&|a| {
        a.setb(al).unwrap();
        a.setl(ah).unwrap();
        a.setbe(bl).unwrap();
        a.setg(bh).unwrap();
        a.seto(cl).unwrap();
        a.setp(ch).unwrap();
        a.sets(dl).unwrap();
        a.sete(dh).unwrap();
    });
}

/// Superinstructions (`cmp`/`test`/`dec` + block-ending `jcc`, `fast::cmp_jcc`): every fused form and condition
/// against the generic path, both branch outcomes.
#[test]
fn cmp_jcc_fusion_fast_vs_generic() {
    type Cmp = fn(&mut CodeAssembler);
    let cmps: [Cmp; 21] = [
        |a| a.cmp(eax, ebx).unwrap(),
        |a| a.cmp(ax, bx).unwrap(),
        |a| a.cmp(al, bl).unwrap(),
        |a| a.cmp(eax, 0x7F).unwrap(),
        |a| a.cmp(ebx, 0x8000_0000u32).unwrap(),
        |a| a.cmp(ax, 0x8000).unwrap(),
        |a| a.cmp(bl, 0x80).unwrap(),
        |a| a.test(eax, ebx).unwrap(),
        |a| a.test(ax, bx).unwrap(),
        |a| a.test(al, bl).unwrap(),
        |a| a.test(ebx, 0x8000_0001u32).unwrap(),
        |a| a.test(bl, 0x81).unwrap(),
        |a| a.cmp(byte_ptr(DATA + 0xF00), 0x80).unwrap(),
        |a| a.cmp(byte_ptr(esi + 0xF00), 0x7F).unwrap(),
        |a| a.cmp(dword_ptr(DATA + 0xF00), 9).unwrap(),
        |a| a.cmp(dword_ptr(esi + 0xF00), -1).unwrap(),
        |a| a.cmp(word_ptr(esi + 0xF00), 0x7FFF).unwrap(),
        |a| a.test(byte_ptr(DATA + 0xF00), 0x81).unwrap(),
        |a| a.test(byte_ptr(esi + 0xF00), 1).unwrap(),
        |a| a.test(dword_ptr(esi + 0xF00), 0x8000_0000u32).unwrap(),
        |a| a.dec(ebx).unwrap(),
    ];
    type Jcc = fn(&mut CodeAssembler, CodeLabel);
    let jccs: [Jcc; 16] = [
        |a, l| a.je(l).unwrap(),
        |a, l| a.jne(l).unwrap(),
        |a, l| a.jb(l).unwrap(),
        |a, l| a.jae(l).unwrap(),
        |a, l| a.jbe(l).unwrap(),
        |a, l| a.ja(l).unwrap(),
        |a, l| a.js(l).unwrap(),
        |a, l| a.jns(l).unwrap(),
        |a, l| a.jl(l).unwrap(),
        |a, l| a.jge(l).unwrap(),
        |a, l| a.jle(l).unwrap(),
        |a, l| a.jg(l).unwrap(),
        |a, l| a.jo(l).unwrap(),
        |a, l| a.jno(l).unwrap(),
        |a, l| a.jp(l).unwrap(),
        |a, l| a.jnp(l).unwrap(),
    ];
    for c in cmps {
        for j in jccs {
            forms_fast_vs_generic(&|a| {
                let mut l = a.create_label();
                a.mov(esi, DATA).unwrap();
                c(a);
                j(a, l);
                a.lea(edx, ptr(edx + 1)).unwrap();
                a.set_label(&mut l).unwrap();
                a.nop().unwrap();
            });
        }
    }
}

`port/crates/s3-desktop/src/audio.rs`:

```rs
//! Desktop audio sink for `s3run`: everything the game sends to `Host::queue_audio` (DirectSound mixer output,
//! which also carries the MCI CD music) can be
//! - written to a 16-bit PCM WAV file (`--audio-wav <file>`, bounded by `--audio-wav-seconds`, default 300 s),
//! - played on the default output device with cpal (`--audio-play`, only with the cargo feature `audio-cpal`),
//! - checked for timing: every `queue_audio` call is compared with the wall clock (lead = audio produced minus
//!   time elapsed since the first block). A healthy mixer keeps the lead flat (~LATENCY_MS); a growing lead means
//!   two producers or a too-fast mixer (drift), a negative/shrinking lead means underruns (gaps).

use std::fs::File;
use std::io::{BufWriter, Seek, SeekFrom, Write};
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};
use std::time::Instant;

/// Output format the sink expects (the s3-dx mixer's format). Other rates are converted (linear) on the fly.
pub const SINK_RATE: u32 = 44_100;

/// WAV writer that keeps a valid header on disk (patched every second of audio and at the end), so a crashed or
/// killed run still leaves a readable file.
pub struct WavWriter {
    path: PathBuf,
    w: BufWriter<File>,
    rate: u32,
    channels: u16,
    frames: u64,
    max_frames: u64,
    since_patch: u64,
}

fn wav_header(rate: u32, channels: u16, data_bytes: u32) -> [u8; 44] {
    let mut h = [0u8; 44];
    let ba = channels as u32 * 2;
    h[0..4].copy_from_slice(b"RIFF");
    h[4..8].copy_from_slice(&(36u32.saturating_add(data_bytes)).to_le_bytes());
    h[8..12].copy_from_slice(b"WAVE");
    h[12..16].copy_from_slice(b"fmt ");
    h[16..20].copy_from_slice(&16u32.to_le_bytes());
    h[20..22].copy_from_slice(&1u16.to_le_bytes());
    h[22..24].copy_from_slice(&channels.to_le_bytes());
    h[24..28].copy_from_slice(&rate.to_le_bytes());
    h[28..32].copy_from_slice(&(rate * ba).to_le_bytes());
    h[32..34].copy_from_slice(&(ba as u16).to_le_bytes());
    h[34..36].copy_from_slice(&16u16.to_le_bytes());
    h[36..40].copy_from_slice(b"data");
    h[40..44].copy_from_slice(&data_bytes.to_le_bytes());
    h
}

impl WavWriter {
    pub fn create(path: &Path, rate: u32, channels: u16, max_seconds: f64) -> std::io::Result<WavWriter> {
        let mut w = BufWriter::new(File::create(path)?);
        w.write_all(&wav_header(rate, channels, 0))?;
        Ok(WavWriter {
            path: path.to_path_buf(),
            w,
            rate,
            channels,
            frames: 0,
            max_frames: (max_seconds.max(0.0) * rate as f64) as u64,
            since_patch: 0,
        })
    }

    pub fn full(&self) -> bool {
        self.frames >= self.max_frames
    }

    /// Append interleaved samples (must match the writer's channel count); stops at the length bound.
    pub fn write(&mut self, samples: &[i16]) -> std::io::Result<()> {
        let ch = self.channels as usize;
        let room = self.max_frames.saturating_sub(self.frames) as usize;
        let n = (samples.len() / ch).min(room);
        if n == 0 {
            return Ok(());
        }
        let mut bytes = Vec::with_capacity(n * ch * 2);
        for s in &samples[..n * ch] {
            bytes.extend_from_slice(&s.to_le_bytes());
        }
        self.w.write_all(&bytes)?;
        self.frames += n as u64;
        self.since_patch += n as u64;
        if self.since_patch >= self.rate as u64 || self.full() {
            self.since_patch = 0;
            self.patch_header()?;
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    fn patch_header(&mut self) -> std::io::Result<()> {
        let data = (self.frames * self.channels as u64 * 2).min(u32::MAX as u64 - 36) as u32;
        self.w.flush()?;
        let f = self.w.get_mut();
        f.seek(SeekFrom::Start(0))?;
        f.write_all(&wav_header(self.rate, self.channels, data))?;
        f.seek(SeekFrom::End(0))?;
        Ok(())
    }

    pub fn finish(&mut self) -> std::io::Result<()> {
        self.patch_header()?;
        self.w.flush()
    }

    pub fn seconds(&self) -> f64 {
        self.frames as f64 / self.rate as f64
    }

    pub fn path(&self) -> &Path {
        &self.path
    }
}

/// Timing statistics of the `queue_audio` stream against the wall clock.
#[derive(Debug, Default, Clone)]
pub struct Timing {
    pub calls: u64,
    pub frames: u64,
    pub first_ms: Option<u64>,
    pub last_ms: u64,
    /// Lead (ms of audio produced minus ms elapsed since the first call), sampled after each call.
    pub lead_min: f64,
    pub lead_max: f64,
    pub lead_last: f64,
    /// Lead seen ~2 s after the first call (reference for drift).
    pub lead_ref: Option<f64>,
    /// Largest wall-clock gap between two calls (ms).
    pub max_gap_ms: u64,
    /// Calls with a format other than SINK_RATE stereo.
    pub other_format_calls: u64,
}

impl Timing {
    pub fn record(&mut self, now_ms: u64, frames: usize, rate: u32) {
        let first = *self.first_ms.get_or_insert(now_ms);
        if self.calls > 0 {
            self.max_gap_ms = self.max_gap_ms.max(now_ms.saturating_sub(self.last_ms));
        }
        self.calls += 1;
        self.last_ms = now_ms;
        self.frames += frames as u64;
        let lead = self.frames as f64 * 1000.0 / rate.max(1) as f64 - (now_ms - first) as f64;
        if self.calls == 1 {
            self.lead_min = lead;
            self.lead_max = lead;
        }
        self.lead_min = self.lead_min.min(lead);
        self.lead_max = self.lead_max.max(lead);
        self.lead_last = lead;
        if self.lead_ref.is_none() && now_ms - first >= 2000 {
            self.lead_ref = Some(lead);
        }
    }

    pub fn summary(&self) -> String {
        let span = self.last_ms.saturating_sub(self.first_ms.unwrap_or(0));
        format!(
            "audio timing: {} calls, {:.2} s audio over {:.2} s wall, lead min/max/last {:.0}/{:.0}/{:.0} ms, \
             drift since 2 s {:+.0} ms, max gap between calls {} ms, other-format calls {}",
            self.calls,
            self.frames as f64 / SINK_RATE as f64,
            span as f64 / 1000.0,
            self.lead_min,
            self.lead_max,
            self.lead_last,
            self.lead_last - self.lead_ref.unwrap_or(self.lead_last),
            self.max_gap_ms,
            self.other_format_calls,
        )
    }
}

/// Convert any (rate, channels) block to SINK_RATE stereo (linear interpolation, per-call; only used if a
/// producer ever sends another format, which the s3-dx mixer does not).
fn to_sink_format(samples: &[i16], rate: u32, channels: u16) -> Vec<i16> {
    let ch = channels.max(1) as usize;
    let frames = samples.len() / ch;
    if frames == 0 {
        return Vec::new();
    }
    let get = |f: usize, c: usize| samples[f.min(frames - 1) * ch + c.min(ch - 1)] as f32;
    let out_frames = (frames as u64 * SINK_RATE as u64 / rate.max(1) as u64) as usize;
    let step = rate as f64 / SINK_RATE as f64;
    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(out_frames * 2);
    for i in 0..out_frames {
        let p = i as f64 * step;
        let k = p as usize;
        let t = (p - k as f64) as f32;
        for c in 0..2 {
            out.push((get(k, c) * (1.0 - t) + get(k + 1, c) * t) as i16);
        }
    }
    out
}

/// Everything the desktop host does with audio. Shared (Arc<Mutex>) between the host and `main` (summary).
pub struct AudioSink {
    pub wav: Option<WavWriter>,
    pub timing: Timing,
    pub start: Instant,
    #[cfg(feature = "audio-cpal")]
    pub player: Option<player::Player>,
}

impl AudioSink {
    pub fn new(wav: Option<WavWriter>, play: bool) -> AudioSink {
        #[cfg(feature = "audio-cpal")]
        let player = if play {
            match player::Player::start() {
                Ok(p) => Some(p),
                Err(e) => {
                    eprintln!("s3run: audio playback unavailable: {e}");
                    None
                }
            }
        } else {
            None
        };
        #[cfg(not(feature = "audio-cpal"))]
        if play {
            eprintln!("s3run: --audio-play needs a build with `--features audio-cpal`; ignoring");
        }
        AudioSink {
            wav,
            timing: Timing::default(),
            start: Instant::now(),
            #[cfg(feature = "audio-cpal")]
            player,
        }
    }

    pub fn queue(&mut self, samples: &[i16], rate: u32, channels: u16) {
        let now = self.start.elapsed().as_millis() as u64;
        let ch = channels.max(1) as usize;
        self.timing.record(now, samples.len() / ch, rate);
        let conv;
        let samples = if rate == SINK_RATE && channels == 2 {
            samples
        } else {
            self.timing.other_format_calls += 1;
            conv = to_sink_format(samples, rate, channels);
            &conv[..]
        };
        if let Some(w) = &mut self.wav {
            if let Err(e) = w.write(samples) {
                eprintln!("s3run: audio wav write failed: {e}; stopping the recording");
                self.wav = None;
            }
        }
        #[cfg(feature = "audio-cpal")]
        if let Some(p) = &self.player {
            p.push(samples);
        }
    }

    /// Frames waiting in the playback device queue (0 without playback).
    pub fn queued_frames(&self) -> usize {
        #[cfg(feature = "audio-cpal")]
        if let Some(p) = &self.player {
            return p.queued_frames();
        }
        0
    }

    pub fn finish(&mut self) -> Vec<String> {
        let mut lines = Vec::new();
        if let Some(w) = &mut self.wav {
            match w.finish() {
                Ok(()) => lines.push(format!("s3run: audio wav {} ({:.1} s)", w.path().display(), w.seconds())),
                Err(e) => lines.push(format!("s3run: audio wav finish failed: {e}")),
            }
        }
        #[cfg(feature = "audio-cpal")]
        if let Some(p) = &self.player {
            lines.push(format!("s3run: audio playback underrun frames {}", p.underruns()));
        }
        if self.timing.calls > 0 {
            lines.push(format!("s3run: {}", self.timing.summary()));
        }
        lines
    }
}

pub type SharedSink = Arc<Mutex<AudioSink>>;

#[cfg(feature = "audio-cpal")]
mod player {
    //! Real playback through cpal (ALSA on Linux). A lock-protected FIFO between `queue_audio` (engine thread)
    //! and the device callback; the queue is bounded (excess is dropped) so a stalled device cannot grow memory.
    use std::collections::VecDeque;
    use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU64, Ordering};
    use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};

    use cpal::traits::{DeviceTrait, HostTrait, StreamTrait};

    use super::SINK_RATE;

    /// At most 1 s queued.
    const MAX_QUEUED: usize = SINK_RATE as usize * 2;

    pub struct Player {
        queue: Arc<Mutex<VecDeque<i16>>>,
        underruns: Arc<AtomicU64>,
        out_channels: usize,
        _stream: cpal::Stream,
    }

    // cpal::Stream is !Send on some platforms; the sink is only touched from the engine thread, but the host
    // trait object requires Send.
    unsafe impl Send for Player {}

    impl Player {
        pub fn start() -> Result<Player, String> {
            let host = cpal::default_host();
            let dev = host.default_output_device().ok_or("no default output device")?;
            let def = dev.default_output_config().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
            let channels = def.channels().max(1);
            let cfg = cpal::StreamConfig {
                channels,
                sample_rate: cpal::SampleRate(SINK_RATE),
                buffer_size: cpal::BufferSize::Default,
            };
            let queue: Arc<Mutex<VecDeque<i16>>> = Arc::new(Mutex::new(VecDeque::new()));
            let underruns = Arc::new(AtomicU64::new(0));
            let (q, u) = (queue.clone(), underruns.clone());
            let och = channels as usize;
            let stream = dev
                .build_output_stream(
                    &cfg,
                    move |data: &mut [f32], _| {
                        let mut q = q.lock().unwrap();
                        let mut missing = 0u64;
                        for frame in data.chunks_mut(och) {
                            let (l, r) = match (q.pop_front(), q.pop_front()) {
                                (Some(l), Some(r)) => (l, r),
                                _ => {
                                    missing += 1;
                                    (0, 0)
                                }
                            };
                            let (l, r) = (l as f32 / 32768.0, r as f32 / 32768.0);
                            match frame.len() {
                                1 => frame[0] = (l + r) * 0.5,
                                _ => {
                                    frame[0] = l;
                                    frame[1] = r;
                                    for x in frame.iter_mut().skip(2) {
                                        *x = 0.0;
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        if missing > 0 {
                            u.fetch_add(missing, Ordering::Relaxed);
                        }
                    },
                    |e| eprintln!("s3run: audio stream error: {e}"),
                    None,
                )
                .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
            stream.play().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
            Ok(Player { queue, underruns, out_channels: och, _stream: stream })
        }

        pub fn push(&self, samples: &[i16]) {
            let _ = self.out_channels;
            let mut q = self.queue.lock().unwrap();
            q.extend(samples.iter().copied());
            if q.len() > MAX_QUEUED {
                let excess = q.len() - MAX_QUEUED;
                q.drain(..excess & !1);
            }
        }

        pub fn queued_frames(&self) -> usize {
            self.queue.lock().unwrap().len() / 2
        }

        pub fn underruns(&self) -> u64 {
            self.underruns.load(Ordering::Relaxed)
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn wav_is_bounded_and_valid() {
        let dir = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("s3run-wav-test-{}", std::process::id()));
        std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir).unwrap();
        let p = dir.join("t.wav");
        let mut w = WavWriter::create(&p, 1000, 2, 0.5).unwrap();
        w.write(&vec![7i16; 600 * 2]).unwrap();
        assert!(w.full());
        w.write(&[1, 2]).unwrap();
        w.finish().unwrap();
        let b = std::fs::read(&p).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(b.len(), 44 + 500 * 4);
        assert_eq!(&b[0..4], b"RIFF");
        assert_eq!(u32::from_le_bytes(b[40..44].try_into().unwrap()), 2000);
        assert_eq!(u32::from_le_bytes(b[4..8].try_into().unwrap()), 2036);
        std::fs::remove_dir_all(&dir).ok();
    }

    #[test]
    fn timing_tracks_lead_and_drift() {
        let mut t = Timing::default();
        // 60 ms ahead at start, then exactly real time: no drift.
        t.record(0, 2646, SINK_RATE);
        for i in 1..=300 {
            t.record(i * 10, 441, SINK_RATE);
        }
        assert!((t.lead_last - 60.0).abs() < 1.0, "{}", t.lead_last);
        assert!((t.lead_last - t.lead_ref.unwrap()).abs() < 1.0);
        // A second producer doubles the audio: lead grows.
        let mut t2 = t.clone();
        for i in 301..=400 {
            t2.record(i * 10, 882, SINK_RATE);
        }
        assert!(t2.lead_last > t.lead_last + 900.0);
    }

    #[test]
    fn converts_other_formats() {
        let mono22 = vec![1000i16; 2205];
        let out = to_sink_format(&mono22, 22_050, 1);
        assert_eq!(out.len(), 4410 * 2);
        assert!(out.iter().all(|&s| s == 1000));
    }
}

`port/crates/s3-desktop/src/bin/s3det.rs`:

```rs
//! `s3det` — deterministic headless run of S3.EXE with per-interval game-state hashes (W5 determinism test).
//!
//! ```text
//! s3det --game-dir <dir> --data-dir <dir> [--exe <S3.EXE>] --vms <virtual ms to run>
//!       [--ipms N (150000 guest instructions per virtual ms)] [--hash-every MS (1000)] [--hash-out <file>]
//!       [--dump-at VMS --dump <file>]  (raw dump of the hashed memory: repeated [u32 addr][4096 bytes])
//!       [--inject "t_vms:cmd args;..."]   (click x y | rclick x y | move x y | key VK | shot file.png | quit)
//!       [--write-trace FROM-TO --write-trace-out <file>]  (which memory each thread writes, see write_trace.rs)
//! ```
//! Everything the guest can observe about time comes from a **virtual clock** derived from the number of guest
//! instructions executed (plus 1 ms per idle slice), never from the host clock:
//! `GetTickCount`/`timeGetTime`/waits/timers via `Host::now_ms`, and (overridden here) `QueryPerformanceCounter`,
//! `GetSystemTime`/`GetLocalTime`/`GetSystemTimeAsFileTime` (fixed epoch 2001-01-01 00:00 UTC + virtual time, no
//! time zone). Inject times are virtual ms. Two runs with the same game files, an identical fresh `--data-dir`
//! and the same arguments must print identical hash lines; compare them with `diff`.
//! See docs/porting/determinism.md.

use std::collections::VecDeque;
use std::path::PathBuf;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU64, Ordering};
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};

#[path = "../write_trace.rs"]
mod write_trace;

use s3_engine::Engine;
use s3_runtime::{FrameBuffer, Host, HostEvent, LogLevel, Machine, MouseButton, SliceResult, ThunkResult};

/// Virtual time in microseconds, shared by the host and the overridden time thunks.
static VCLOCK_US: AtomicU64 = AtomicU64::new(0);

/// 2001-01-01 00:00:00 UTC as FILETIME (100 ns ticks since 1601).
const EPOCH_FT: u64 = 126_227_808_000_000_000;

struct DetHost {
    game_dir: PathBuf,
    data_dir: PathBuf,
    inject: VecDeque<(u64, HostEvent)>,
    frame: Arc<Mutex<Option<FrameBuffer>>>,
    verbose: bool,
}

impl Host for DetHost {
    fn present(&mut self, fb: &FrameBuffer) {
        *self.frame.lock().unwrap() = Some(fb.clone());
    }
    fn poll_events(&mut self) -> Vec<HostEvent> {
        let now = self.now_ms();
        let mut out = Vec::new();
        while self.inject.front().map(|(t, _)| *t <= now).unwrap_or(false) {
            out.push(self.inject.pop_front().unwrap().1);
        }
        out
    }
    fn now_ms(&self) -> u64 {
        VCLOCK_US.load(Ordering::Relaxed) / 1000
    }
    fn game_dir(&self) -> PathBuf {
        self.game_dir.clone()
    }
    fn data_dir(&self) -> PathBuf {
        self.data_dir.clone()
    }
    fn log(&self, level: LogLevel, msg: &str) {
        if self.verbose || level <= LogLevel::Warn {
            eprintln!("[{level:?}] {msg}");
        }
    }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- time overrides

fn qpc(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    #[derive(Default)]
    struct Last(u64);
    let p = m.arg_u32(0);
    let st = m.state::<Last>();
    let v = {
        let mut l = st.borrow_mut();
        let mut v = VCLOCK_US.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
        if v <= l.0 {
            v = l.0 + 1; // strictly increasing (the blit benchmark at 0x5c4280 waits for it to advance)
        }
        l.0 = v;
        v
    };
    if p == 0 {
        return ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 1);
    }
    m.mem.write_u64(p, v);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(1, 1)
}

fn now_ft() -> u64 {
    EPOCH_FT + VCLOCK_US.load(Ordering::Relaxed) * 10
}

/// FILETIME -> SYSTEMTIME (16 bytes) at `p`.
fn write_systemtime(m: &mut Machine, p: u32, ft: u64) {
    let ms_total = ft / 10_000 - 11_644_473_600_000; // ms since 1970
    let days = (ms_total / 86_400_000) as i64;
    let rem = ms_total % 86_400_000;
    // Civil date from days since 1970-01-01 (H. Hinnant).
    let z = days + 719_468;
    let era = z.div_euclid(146_097);
    let doe = z - era * 146_097;
    let yoe = (doe - doe / 1460 + doe / 36_524 - doe / 146_096) / 365;
    let doy = doe - (365 * yoe + yoe / 4 - yoe / 100);
    let mp = (5 * doy + 2) / 153;
    let d = doy - (153 * mp + 2) / 5 + 1;
    let mo = if mp < 10 { mp + 3 } else { mp - 9 };
    let y = yoe + era * 400 + if mo <= 2 { 1 } else { 0 };
    let dow = (days + 4).rem_euclid(7); // 1970-01-01 was a Thursday
    let f = [
        y as u16,
        mo as u16,
        dow as u16,
        d as u16,
        (rem / 3_600_000) as u16,
        (rem / 60_000 % 60) as u16,
        (rem / 1000 % 60) as u16,
        (rem % 1000) as u16,
    ];
    for (i, v) in f.iter().enumerate() {
        m.mem.write_u16(p + 2 * i as u32, *v);
    }
}

fn get_system_time(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let p = m.arg_u32(0);
    if p != 0 {
        write_systemtime(m, p, now_ft());
    }
    ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 1)
}

fn get_system_time_as_file_time(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let p = m.arg_u32(0);
    if p != 0 {
        m.mem.write_u64(p, now_ft());
    }
    ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 1)
}

fn get_time_zone_information(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let p = m.arg_u32(0);
    if p != 0 {
        m.mem.fill(p, 172, 0); // UTC, no daylight rules
    }
    ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 1) // TIME_ZONE_ID_UNKNOWN
}

/// Deterministic v4 GUIDs (CoCreateGuid / UuidCreate): fixed-seed xorshift64* instead of the host clock.
fn det_guid(m: &mut Machine) -> [u8; 16] {
    #[derive(Default)]
    struct Rng(u64);
    let st = m.state::<Rng>();
    let mut r = st.borrow_mut();
    if r.0 == 0 {
        r.0 = 0x5333_4445_5445_5231;
    }
    let mut g = [0u8; 16];
    for chunk in g.chunks_mut(8) {
        r.0 ^= r.0 >> 12;
        r.0 ^= r.0 << 25;
        r.0 ^= r.0 >> 27;
        chunk.copy_from_slice(&r.0.wrapping_mul(0x2545_F491_4F6C_DD1D).to_le_bytes());
    }
    g[7] = (g[7] & 0x0F) | 0x40;
    g[8] = (g[8] & 0x3F) | 0x80;
    g
}

fn create_guid(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let p = m.arg_u32(0);
    if p == 0 {
        return ThunkResult::stdcall(0x8007_0057, 1); // E_INVALIDARG
    }
    let g = det_guid(m);
    m.mem.write_bytes(p, &g);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 1)
}

fn install_time_overrides(m: &mut Machine) {
    let r = &mut m.registry;
    r.register("kernel32.dll", "QueryPerformanceCounter", qpc);
    r.register("kernel32.dll", "GetSystemTime", get_system_time);
    r.register("kernel32.dll", "GetLocalTime", get_system_time);
    r.register("kernel32.dll", "GetSystemTimeAsFileTime", get_system_time_as_file_time);
    r.register("kernel32.dll", "GetTimeZoneInformation", get_time_zone_information);
    // Host-random GUIDs (rpcrt4::random_guid seeds from the wall clock): the first divergence found by this tool
    // (a 16-byte GUID at 0x7a7ac8 written during the first menu click).
    r.register("ole32.dll", "CoCreateGuid", create_guid);
    r.register("rpcrt4.dll", "UuidCreate", create_guid);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- state hash

/// 64-bit hash over little-endian words (fast; not cryptographic).
struct Hasher(u64);
impl Hasher {
    fn word(&mut self, w: u64) {
        self.0 = (self.0 ^ w).wrapping_mul(0x9E37_79B9_7F4A_7C15).rotate_left(29);
    }
    fn bytes(&mut self, b: &[u8]) {
        let (words, rest) = b.as_chunks::<8>();
        for c in words {
            self.word(u64::from_le_bytes(*c));
        }
        for &x in rest {
            self.word(x as u64);
        }
    }
}

/// Is a page protection writable (PAGE_READWRITE / WRITECOPY / EXECUTE_READWRITE / EXECUTE_WRITECOPY)?
fn writable(protect: u32) -> bool {
    protect & (0x04 | 0x08 | 0x40 | 0x80) != 0
}

/// Visit every page included in the state hash.
fn for_each_page(m: &Machine, mut f: impl FnMut(u32, &[u8])) {
    for a in m.mem.regions.iter() {
        if matches!(a.kind, s3_runtime::mem::RegionKind::Mapped) {
            continue;
        }
        for (i, &prot) in a.pages.iter().enumerate() {
            if prot == 0 || !writable(prot) {
                continue;
            }
            let addr = a.base + (i as u32) * 4096;
            f(addr, m.mem.slice(addr, 4096));
        }
    }
}

fn full_hash() -> bool {
    static ON: std::sync::OnceLock<bool> = std::sync::OnceLock::new();
    *ON.get_or_init(|| std::env::var_os("S3DET_HASH_FULL").is_some())
}

/// Hash of all guest-writable committed memory (not file mappings) plus every thread's CPU + x87 state.
/// Returns (memory hash, cpu hash, bytes hashed).
fn state_hash(m: &Machine) -> (u64, u64, u64) {
    let mut h = Hasher(0x5333_4445_5445_524D);
    let mut n = 0u64;
    for_each_page(m, |addr, page| {
        h.word(addr as u64);
        h.bytes(page);
        n += 4096;
    });
    let mut c = Hasher(0x4350_5553_5441_5445);
    for t in &m.threads {
        c.word(t.tid as u64);
        for r in t.cpu.regs {
            c.word(r as u64);
        }
        c.word(t.cpu.eip as u64);
        for r in t.cpu.fpu.regs {
            c.word(r.to_bits());
        }
        c.word(t.cpu.fpu.status_word() as u64);
        c.word(t.cpu.fpu.control as u64);
        c.word(t.cpu.instructions);
        // S3DET_HASH_FULL=1 (perf-jit): also EFLAGS, FS base, x87 tags / last IP / last data pointer, so
        // CPU-core changes (JIT, interpreter rework) are checked on every observable register.
        if full_hash() {
            c.word(t.cpu.eflags() as u64);
            c.word(t.cpu.fs_base as u64);
            c.word(t.cpu.fpu.tag_word() as u64);
            c.word(t.cpu.fpu.last_ip as u64);
            c.word(t.cpu.fpu.last_dp as u64);
        }
    }
    (h.0, c.0, n)
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- main

fn usage() -> ! {
    eprintln!(
        "usage: s3det --game-dir <dir> --data-dir <dir> [--exe <path>] --vms <virtual ms> [--ipms N] \
         [--hash-every MS] [--hash-out <file>] [--inject \"t:cmd ...;...\"] [-v]"
    );
    std::process::exit(2)
}

fn parse_inject(spec: &str, shots: &mut Vec<(u64, PathBuf)>) -> Vec<(u64, HostEvent)> {
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    for item in spec.split(';').map(str::trim).filter(|s| !s.is_empty()) {
        let (t, cmd) = item.split_once(':').unwrap_or_else(|| usage());
        let t: u64 = t.trim().parse().unwrap_or_else(|_| usage());
        let w: Vec<&str> = cmd.split_whitespace().collect();
        let num = |i: usize| -> i64 {
            let s = w.get(i).copied().unwrap_or_else(|| usage());
            match s.strip_prefix("0x") {
                Some(h) => i64::from_str_radix(h, 16).unwrap_or_else(|_| usage()),
                None => s.parse().unwrap_or_else(|_| usage()),
            }
        };
        match w.first().copied() {
            Some("move") => out.push((t, HostEvent::MouseMove { x: num(1) as i32, y: num(2) as i32 })),
            Some(c @ ("click" | "rclick")) => {
                let button = if c == "rclick" { MouseButton::Right } else { MouseButton::Left };
                out.push((t, HostEvent::MouseMove { x: num(1) as i32, y: num(2) as i32 }));
                out.push((t, HostEvent::MouseButton { button, down: true }));
                out.push((t + 50, HostEvent::MouseButton { button, down: false }));
            }
            Some("key") => {
                let vk = num(1) as u32;
                out.push((t, HostEvent::Key { vk, down: true }));
                out.push((t + 50, HostEvent::Key { vk, down: false }));
            }
            Some("shot") => shots.push((t, PathBuf::from(w.get(1).copied().unwrap_or_else(|| usage())))),
            Some("quit") => out.push((t, HostEvent::Quit)),
            _ => usage(),
        }
    }
    out.sort_by_key(|(t, _)| *t);
    shots.sort_by_key(|(t, _)| *t);
    out
}

fn write_png(path: &std::path::Path, fb: &FrameBuffer) -> Result<(), String> {
    let f = std::fs::File::create(path).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let mut enc = png::Encoder::new(std::io::BufWriter::new(f), fb.width, fb.height);
    enc.set_color(png::ColorType::Rgb);
    enc.set_depth(png::BitDepth::Eight);
    let mut w = enc.write_header().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    w.write_image_data(&fb.to_rgb888()).map_err(|e| e.to_string())
}

fn main() {
    let mut game_dir = None;
    let mut data_dir = None;
    let mut exe: Option<PathBuf> = None;
    let mut vms: u64 = 0;
    let mut ipms: u64 = 150_000;
    let mut every: u64 = 1000;
    let mut hash_out: Option<PathBuf> = None;
    let mut inject = String::new();
    let mut verbose = false;
    let mut dump_at: Option<u64> = None;
    let mut dump: Option<PathBuf> = None;
    let mut write_trace: Option<String> = None;
    let mut write_trace_out: Option<PathBuf> = None;
    let mut it = std::env::args().skip(1);
    while let Some(a) = it.next() {
        let mut val = || it.next().unwrap_or_else(|| usage());
        match a.as_str() {
            "--game-dir" => game_dir = Some(PathBuf::from(val())),
            "--data-dir" => data_dir = Some(PathBuf::from(val())),
            "--exe" => exe = Some(val().into()),
            "--vms" => vms = val().parse().unwrap_or_else(|_| usage()),
            "--ipms" => ipms = val().parse().unwrap_or_else(|_| usage()),
            "--hash-every" => every = val().parse().unwrap_or_else(|_| usage()),
            "--hash-out" => hash_out = Some(val().into()),
            "--inject" => inject = val(),
            "--dump-at" => dump_at = Some(val().parse().unwrap_or_else(|_| usage())),
            "--dump" => dump = Some(val().into()),
            "--write-trace" => write_trace = Some(val()),
            "--write-trace-out" => write_trace_out = Some(val().into()),
            "-v" => verbose = true,
            _ => usage(),
        }
    }
    let (Some(game_dir), Some(data_dir)) = (game_dir, data_dir) else { usage() };
    if vms == 0 || ipms == 0 || every == 0 {
        usage();
    }
    if let Err(e) = s3_runtime::cpu::fpu::math::host_float_env_check() {
        eprintln!("s3det: host floating-point environment is not deterministic: {e}");
        std::process::exit(1);
    }
    std::fs::create_dir_all(&data_dir).ok();
    let mut shots = Vec::new();
    let events = parse_inject(&inject, &mut shots);
    let mut shots: VecDeque<_> = shots.into();
    let frame = Arc::new(Mutex::new(None));
    let host = DetHost { game_dir, data_dir, inject: events.into(), frame: frame.clone(), verbose };
    let mut engine = match Engine::new(Box::new(host), exe.as_deref()) {
        Ok(e) => e,
        Err(e) => {
            eprintln!("s3det: {e}");
            std::process::exit(1);
        }
    };
    install_time_overrides(&mut engine.machine);
    if let Some(w) = &write_trace {
        if let Err(e) = write_trace::install(&mut engine.machine, w) {
            eprintln!("s3det: {e}");
            std::process::exit(2);
        }
    }

    let mut out: Box<dyn std::io::Write> = match &hash_out {
        Some(p) => Box::new(std::fs::File::create(p).unwrap_or_else(|e| {
            eprintln!("s3det: {}: {e}", p.display());
            std::process::exit(1)
        })),
        None => Box::new(std::io::stdout()),
    };
    let wall = std::time::Instant::now();
    let mut idle_us: u64 = 0;
    let mut next_hash = every;
    // Slices of 1/4 virtual ms keep inject/timer latency small; the clock only moves between slices, so every
    // guest-visible time value is a function of the instruction count alone.
    let slice = (ipms / 4).max(1);
    loop {
        let now_us = idle_us + engine.machine.stats.instructions * 1000 / ipms;
        VCLOCK_US.store(now_us, Ordering::Relaxed);
        let now = now_us / 1000;
        if write_trace.is_some() {
            write_trace::set_now(now);
        }
        while shots.front().map(|(t, _)| *t <= now).unwrap_or(false) {
            let (_, p) = shots.pop_front().unwrap();
            match frame.lock().unwrap().as_ref().map(|f| write_png(&p, f)) {
                Some(Ok(())) => eprintln!("s3det: shot {} at {now} vms", p.display()),
                Some(Err(e)) => eprintln!("s3det: shot {} failed: {e}", p.display()),
                None => eprintln!("s3det: shot {}: no frame yet", p.display()),
            }
        }
        if now >= next_hash {
            let (mh, ch, n) = state_hash(&engine.machine);
            let s = &engine.machine.stats;
            writeln!(
                out,
                "vms={next_hash} insns={} presents={} mem={mh:016x} cpu={ch:016x} bytes={n}",
                s.instructions, s.presents
            )
            .ok();
            out.flush().ok();
            next_hash += every;
        }
        if let (Some(t), Some(p)) = (dump_at, &dump) {
            if now >= t {
                let mut buf = Vec::new();
                for_each_page(&engine.machine, |addr, page| {
                    buf.extend_from_slice(&addr.to_le_bytes());
                    buf.extend_from_slice(page);
                });
                match std::fs::write(p, &buf) {
                    Ok(()) => eprintln!("s3det: dumped {} bytes at {now} vms to {}", buf.len(), p.display()),
                    Err(e) => eprintln!("s3det: dump {}: {e}", p.display()),
                }
                dump_at = None;
            }
        }
        if now >= vms {
            break;
        }
        match engine.run_slice(slice) {
            SliceResult::Stopped => break,
            SliceResult::Idle => idle_us += 1000,
            SliceResult::Ran(_) => {}
        }
        if engine.machine.input.quit_requested {
            break;
        }
    }
    let (mh, ch, n) = state_hash(&engine.machine);
    writeln!(
        out,
        "final insns={} presents={} mem={mh:016x} cpu={ch:016x} bytes={n}",
        engine.machine.stats.instructions, engine.machine.stats.presents
    )
    .ok();
    if let Some(p) = &write_trace_out {
        if let Err(e) = write_trace::report(&engine.machine, p) {
            eprintln!("s3det: write trace report: {e}");
        }
    }
    eprintln!(
        "s3det: {} virtual ms in {:.1} s wall, {} instructions, stop: {:?}",
        VCLOCK_US.load(Ordering::Relaxed) / 1000,
        wall.elapsed().as_secs_f64(),
        engine.machine.stats.instructions,
        engine.machine.stop_reason()
    );
    if s3_runtime::cpu::jit_enabled() {
        eprintln!("s3det: {}", s3_runtime::cpu::jit_stats());
    }
    if std::env::var_os("S3_CPU_TIME").is_some() {
        eprintln!("s3det: {:.2} s in Cpu::run", s3_runtime::cpu::cpu_run_seconds());
    }
}
