`port/crates/s3-desktop/src/debug.rs`:

```rs
//! Debug inject commands for runtime reverse engineering (re-ui, 2026-11-05).
//!
//! These are filtered out of the `--inject` spec before the normal parser sees it:
//! - `t:dump ADDR LEN FILE`  write `LEN` bytes of guest memory at `ADDR` to `FILE` (raw).
//! - `t:peek ADDR LEN`       print guest memory as hex dwords to stderr.
//! - `t:poke ADDR HEXBYTES`  write bytes (e.g. `poke 0x7e0000 0a000000`) — debug only, for verifying setters.
//! - `t:regs`                print every thread's EIP/registers to stderr.
//! - `t:watch ADDR LEN SECS` single-step all guest threads (run_slice(1)) for up to SECS wall seconds until the
//!                           bytes at ADDR change; then print old/new value and, for every thread that ran in the
//!                           changing step, the EIP before/after (the writer is in the block starting at "before").
//!                           Repeat the command to catch the next write. Slow (~1-3 M guest instr/s).
//! - `t:dumpall DIR`         write every committed private (heap/VirtualAlloc) region plus the exe `.data`
//!                           section to `DIR/<addr>.bin` (memory-mapped files and code are skipped).
//! - `t:dumpall DIR mapped`  same, plus committed memory-mapped file views (e.g. the game's text tables; local only).
//!
//! Only addresses inside committed guest memory may be used (an unmapped read faults the host).
//! The S3.EXE image `0x400000..0x7ED000` is always mapped.

use s3_engine::Engine;
use std::collections::VecDeque;
use std::path::PathBuf;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub enum DebugCmd {
    Dump { addr: u32, len: usize, file: PathBuf },
    Peek { addr: u32, len: usize },
    Poke { addr: u32, bytes: Vec<u8> },
    Regs,
    DumpAll { dir: PathBuf, with_mapped: bool },
    Watch { addr: u32, len: usize, secs: f64 },
}

fn num(s: &str) -> Option<u64> {
    match s.strip_prefix("0x") {
        Some(h) => u64::from_str_radix(h, 16).ok(),
        None => s.parse().ok(),
    }
}

/// Split debug commands out of an inject spec. Returns (remaining spec, debug commands sorted by time).
pub fn split(spec: &str) -> Result<(String, Vec<(u64, DebugCmd)>), String> {
    let mut rest = Vec::new();
    let mut cmds = Vec::new();
    for item in spec.split(';').map(str::trim).filter(|s| !s.is_empty()) {
        let Some((t, cmd)) = item.split_once(':') else {
            rest.push(item);
            continue;
        };
        let w: Vec<&str> = cmd.split_whitespace().collect();
        let t_ms = || t.trim().parse::<u64>().map_err(|_| format!("bad time in '{item}'"));
        let arg = |i: usize| w.get(i).and_then(|s| num(s)).ok_or(format!("bad argument {i} in '{item}'"));
        let c = match w.first().copied() {
            Some("dump") => DebugCmd::Dump {
                addr: arg(1)? as u32,
                len: arg(2)? as usize,
                file: PathBuf::from(w.get(3).ok_or(format!("missing file in '{item}'"))?),
            },
            Some("peek") => DebugCmd::Peek { addr: arg(1)? as u32, len: arg(2)? as usize },
            Some("poke") => {
                let h = w.get(2).ok_or(format!("missing bytes in '{item}'"))?;
                if h.len() % 2 != 0 {
                    return Err(format!("odd hex length in '{item}'"));
                }
                let bytes = (0..h.len())
                    .step_by(2)
                    .map(|i| u8::from_str_radix(&h[i..i + 2], 16).map_err(|_| format!("bad hex in '{item}'")))
                    .collect::<Result<Vec<u8>, String>>()?;
                DebugCmd::Poke { addr: arg(1)? as u32, bytes }
            }
            Some("regs") => DebugCmd::Regs,
            Some("watch") => DebugCmd::Watch {
                addr: arg(1)? as u32,
                len: arg(2)? as usize,
                secs: w.get(3).and_then(|s| s.parse().ok()).ok_or(format!("bad secs in '{item}'"))?,
            },
            Some("dumpall") => DebugCmd::DumpAll {
                dir: PathBuf::from(w.get(1).ok_or(format!("missing dir in '{item}'"))?),
                with_mapped: w.get(2) == Some(&"mapped"),
            },
            _ => {
                rest.push(item);
                continue;
            }
        };
        cmds.push((t_ms()?, c));
    }
    cmds.sort_by_key(|(t, _)| *t);
    Ok((rest.join(";"), cmds))
}

fn mapped(engine: &Engine, addr: u32, len: usize) -> bool {
    let end = addr as u64 + len as u64;
    let mut a = addr as u64;
    while a < end {
        let info = engine.machine.mem.regions.query(a as u32);
        if info.state != s3_runtime::mem::MEM_COMMIT {
            return false;
        }
        a = info.base_address as u64 + info.region_size as u64;
        if info.region_size == 0 {
            return false;
        }
    }
    true
}

/// Run due debug commands.
pub fn run_due(engine: &mut Engine, cmds: &mut VecDeque<(u64, DebugCmd)>, now_ms: u64) {
    while cmds.front().map(|(t, _)| *t <= now_ms).unwrap_or(false) {
        let (_, c) = cmds.pop_front().unwrap();
        match c {
            DebugCmd::Dump { addr, len, file } => {
                if !mapped(engine, addr, len) {
                    eprintln!("s3run: dump {addr:#x}+{len:#x}: not mapped");
                    continue;
                }
                let b = engine.machine.mem.read_bytes(addr, len);
                match std::fs::write(&file, b) {
                    Ok(()) => eprintln!("s3run: dump {addr:#x}+{len:#x} -> {} at {now_ms} ms", file.display()),
                    Err(e) => eprintln!("s3run: dump {}: {e}", file.display()),
                }
            }
            DebugCmd::Peek { addr, len } => {
                if !mapped(engine, addr, len) {
                    eprintln!("s3run: peek {addr:#x}+{len:#x}: not mapped");
                    continue;
                }
                let b = engine.machine.mem.read_bytes(addr, len);
                for (i, ch) in b.chunks(16).enumerate() {
                    let words: Vec<String> = ch
                        .chunks(4)
                        .map(|w| w.iter().rev().map(|x| format!("{x:02x}")).collect::<String>())
                        .collect();
                    eprintln!("s3run: peek {:#010x}: {}", addr as usize + i * 16, words.join(" "));
                }
            }
            DebugCmd::Poke { addr, bytes } => {
                if !mapped(engine, addr, bytes.len()) {
                    eprintln!("s3run: poke {addr:#x}: not mapped");
                    continue;
                }
                engine.machine.mem.write_bytes(addr, &bytes);
                // Pokes may patch code (RE experiments): drop decoded instructions for the range.
                engine.machine.invalidate_code(addr, bytes.len() as u32);
                eprintln!("s3run: poke {addr:#x} <- {} bytes at {now_ms} ms", bytes.len());
            }
            DebugCmd::DumpAll { dir, with_mapped } => {
                let _ = std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir);
                let mut a: u64 = 0x10000;
                let (mut n, mut total) = (0, 0usize);
                while a < 0x8000_0000 {
                    let info = engine.machine.mem.regions.query(a as u32);
                    if info.region_size == 0 {
                        break;
                    }
                    let keep = info.state == s3_runtime::mem::MEM_COMMIT
                        && (info.type_ == s3_runtime::mem::MEM_PRIVATE
                            || (with_mapped && info.type_ == s3_runtime::mem::MEM_MAPPED)
                            || (info.base_address >= 0x692000 && info.base_address < 0x7eb000));
                    if keep {
                        let b = engine.machine.mem.read_bytes(info.base_address, info.region_size as usize);
                        total += b.len();
                        n += 1;
                        let _ = std::fs::write(dir.join(format!("{:08x}.bin", info.base_address)), b);
                    }
                    a = info.base_address as u64 + info.region_size as u64;
                }
                eprintln!("s3run: dumpall {} regions {} KiB -> {} at {now_ms} ms", n, total / 1024, dir.display());
            }
            DebugCmd::Watch { addr, len, secs } => {
                if !mapped(engine, addr, len) {
                    eprintln!("s3run: watch {addr:#x}: not mapped");
                    continue;
                }
                let t0 = std::time::Instant::now();
                let old = engine.machine.mem.read_bytes(addr, len);
                let mut steps = 0u64;
                loop {
                    let before: Vec<(u32, u64)> =
                        engine.machine.threads.iter().map(|t| (t.cpu.eip, t.cpu.instructions)).collect();
                    let r = engine.machine.run_slice(1);
                    steps += 1;
                    let new = engine.machine.mem.read_bytes(addr, len);
                    if new != old {
                        eprintln!("s3run: watch {addr:#x}: {old:02x?} -> {new:02x?} after {steps} steps");
                        for (i, t) in engine.machine.threads.iter().enumerate() {
                            if let Some(&(eip0, n0)) = before.get(i) {
                                if t.cpu.instructions != n0 {
                                    eprintln!(
                                        "s3run: watch   t{i} eip {eip0:#x} -> {:#x} ({} instr) regs {:x?}",
                                        t.cpu.eip,
                                        t.cpu.instructions - n0,
                                        t.cpu.regs
                                    );
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        break;
                    }
                    if r == s3_runtime::SliceResult::Stopped || t0.elapsed().as_secs_f64() > secs {
                        eprintln!("s3run: watch {addr:#x}: no change after {steps} steps");
                        break;
                    }
                    if r == s3_runtime::SliceResult::Idle {
                        engine.machine.host.idle(1);
                    }
                }
            }
            DebugCmd::Regs => {
                for (i, t) in engine.machine.threads.iter().enumerate() {
                    eprintln!("s3run: regs t{i} eip={:#x} {:x?} {:?}", t.cpu.eip, t.cpu.regs, t.state);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn split_debug_commands() {
        let (rest, c) = split("100:click 1 2;50:dump 0x400000 16 /tmp/a.bin;60:poke 0x10 0aff;70:peek 0x10 4;80:regs").unwrap();
        assert_eq!(rest, "100:click 1 2");
        assert_eq!(c[0], (50, DebugCmd::Dump { addr: 0x400000, len: 16, file: "/tmp/a.bin".into() }));
        assert_eq!(c[1], (60, DebugCmd::Poke { addr: 0x10, bytes: vec![0x0a, 0xff] }));
        assert_eq!(c[2], (70, DebugCmd::Peek { addr: 0x10, len: 4 }));
        assert_eq!(c[3], (80, DebugCmd::Regs));
        assert!(split("1:poke 0x10 abc").is_err());
    }

    #[test]
    fn split_dumpall_mapped_flag() {
        let (_, c) = split("1:dumpall d;2:dumpall e mapped").unwrap();
        assert_eq!(c[0], (1, DebugCmd::DumpAll { dir: "d".into(), with_mapped: false }));
        assert_eq!(c[1], (2, DebugCmd::DumpAll { dir: "e".into(), with_mapped: true }));
    }
}

`port/crates/s3-desktop/src/debug_units.rs`:

```rs
//! Read-only debug inject commands for game-state reverse engineering (re-units, 2026-11-05).
//! See docs/reverse-engineering/game-state-units.md.
//!
//! Filtered out of the `--inject` spec before the other parsers see it:
//! - `t:xdump EXPR LEN FILE` write `LEN` bytes at the address `EXPR` to `FILE` (raw).
//! - `t:xpeek EXPR LEN`      print `LEN` bytes at `EXPR` as hex dwords to stderr.
//! - `t:scan VALUE [MAX]`    print the addresses of up to `MAX` (default 32) aligned dwords equal to `VALUE` in all
//!   committed guest memory (find heap objects by vtable, pointers to an object, ...).
//!
//! `EXPR` is a start address followed by `@OFF` steps; each step reads the dword at the current address and adds
//! `OFF` (pointer chasing): `0x700ffee0@0x3a0@0x67444+0x4800` = `*( *(0x700ffee0) + 0x3a0 ) + 0x67444 + 0x4800`.
//! A part may be a `+` sum (added without deref). All numbers are decimal or `0x` hex. Nothing here writes guest memory.

use s3_engine::Engine;
use std::collections::VecDeque;
use std::path::PathBuf;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub enum UnitsCmd {
    Dump { expr: Vec<u32>, len: usize, file: PathBuf },
    Peek { expr: Vec<u32>, len: usize },
    Scan { value: u32, max: usize },
}

fn num(s: &str) -> Option<u64> {
    match s.strip_prefix("0x") {
        Some(h) => u64::from_str_radix(h, 16).ok(),
        None => s.parse().ok(),
    }
}

/// Parse `ADDR@OFF@OFF...` into `[ADDR, OFF, OFF, ...]`. Each part may be a sum `A+B+...` (no deref inside a part).
fn parse_expr(s: &str) -> Option<Vec<u32>> {
    s.split('@')
        .map(|p| p.split('+').try_fold(0u32, |acc, t| num(t).map(|v| acc.wrapping_add(v as u32))))
        .collect()
}

/// Split our commands out of an inject spec. Returns (remaining spec, commands sorted by time).
pub fn split(spec: &str) -> Result<(String, Vec<(u64, UnitsCmd)>), String> {
    let mut rest = Vec::new();
    let mut cmds = Vec::new();
    for item in spec.split(';').map(str::trim).filter(|s| !s.is_empty()) {
        let Some((t, cmd)) = item.split_once(':') else {
            rest.push(item);
            continue;
        };
        let w: Vec<&str> = cmd.split_whitespace().collect();
        let expr = || w.get(1).and_then(|s| parse_expr(s)).ok_or(format!("bad address in '{item}'"));
        let arg = |i: usize| w.get(i).and_then(|s| num(s)).ok_or(format!("bad argument {i} in '{item}'"));
        let c = match w.first().copied() {
            Some("xdump") => UnitsCmd::Dump {
                expr: expr()?,
                len: arg(2)? as usize,
                file: PathBuf::from(w.get(3).ok_or(format!("missing file in '{item}'"))?),
            },
            Some("xpeek") => UnitsCmd::Peek { expr: expr()?, len: arg(2)? as usize },
            Some("scan") => UnitsCmd::Scan { value: arg(1)? as u32, max: if w.len() > 2 { arg(2)? as usize } else { 32 } },
            _ => {
                rest.push(item);
                continue;
            }
        };
        let t: u64 = t.trim().parse().map_err(|_| format!("bad time in '{item}'"))?;
        cmds.push((t, c));
    }
    cmds.sort_by_key(|(t, _)| *t);
    Ok((rest.join(";"), cmds))
}

fn committed(engine: &Engine, addr: u32, len: usize) -> bool {
    let end = addr as u64 + len.max(1) as u64;
    let mut a = addr as u64;
    while a < end {
        let info = engine.machine.mem.regions.query(a as u32);
        if info.state != s3_runtime::mem::MEM_COMMIT || info.region_size == 0 {
            return false;
        }
        a = info.base_address as u64 + info.region_size as u64;
    }
    true
}

fn eval(engine: &Engine, expr: &[u32]) -> Option<u32> {
    let mut a = *expr.first()?;
    for off in &expr[1..] {
        if !committed(engine, a, 4) {
            return None;
        }
        let b = engine.machine.mem.read_bytes(a, 4);
        a = u32::from_le_bytes([b[0], b[1], b[2], b[3]]).wrapping_add(*off);
    }
    Some(a)
}

/// Run due commands.
pub fn run_due(engine: &mut Engine, cmds: &mut VecDeque<(u64, UnitsCmd)>, now_ms: u64) {
    while cmds.front().map(|(t, _)| *t <= now_ms).unwrap_or(false) {
        let (_, c) = cmds.pop_front().unwrap();
        match c {
            UnitsCmd::Dump { expr, len, file } => {
                let Some(addr) = eval(engine, &expr).filter(|a| committed(engine, *a, len)) else {
                    eprintln!("s3run: xdump {expr:x?}: not mapped");
                    continue;
                };
                let b = engine.machine.mem.read_bytes(addr, len);
                match std::fs::write(&file, b) {
                    Ok(()) => eprintln!("s3run: xdump {addr:#x}+{len:#x} -> {} at {now_ms} ms", file.display()),
                    Err(e) => eprintln!("s3run: xdump {}: {e}", file.display()),
                }
            }
            UnitsCmd::Peek { expr, len } => {
                let Some(addr) = eval(engine, &expr).filter(|a| committed(engine, *a, len)) else {
                    eprintln!("s3run: xpeek {expr:x?}: not mapped");
                    continue;
                };
                let b = engine.machine.mem.read_bytes(addr, len);
                for (i, ch) in b.chunks(16).enumerate() {
                    let words: Vec<String> = ch
                        .chunks(4)
                        .map(|w| w.iter().rev().map(|x| format!("{x:02x}")).collect::<String>())
                        .collect();
                    eprintln!("s3run: xpeek {:#010x}: {}", addr as usize + i * 16, words.join(" "));
                }
            }
            UnitsCmd::Scan { value, max } => {
                let mut found = Vec::new();
                let mut a: u64 = 0x10000;
                while a < 0xFFFF_0000 && found.len() < max {
                    let info = engine.machine.mem.regions.query(a as u32);
                    let size = (info.region_size as u64).max(0x1000);
                    if info.state == s3_runtime::mem::MEM_COMMIT {
                        let b = engine.machine.mem.read_bytes(info.base_address, info.region_size as usize);
                        for (i, w) in b.chunks_exact(4).enumerate() {
                            if u32::from_le_bytes([w[0], w[1], w[2], w[3]]) == value {
                                found.push(info.base_address + 4 * i as u32);
                                if found.len() >= max {
                                    break;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    a = info.base_address as u64 + size;
                }
                eprintln!("s3run: scan {value:#x} at {now_ms} ms: {found:x?}");
            }
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn split_units_commands() {
        let (rest, c) = split("100:click 1 2;50:xdump 0x7e9174@0x90@0x3a0 16 /tmp/a.bin;60:scan 0x658c18;70:xpeek 0x10 4;80:dump 0x1 2 f").unwrap();
        assert_eq!(rest, "100:click 1 2;80:dump 0x1 2 f");
        assert_eq!(c[0], (50, UnitsCmd::Dump { expr: vec![0x7e9174, 0x90, 0x3a0], len: 16, file: "/tmp/a.bin".into() }));
        assert_eq!(c[1], (60, UnitsCmd::Scan { value: 0x658c18, max: 32 }));
        assert_eq!(c[2], (70, UnitsCmd::Peek { expr: vec![0x10], len: 4 }));
        assert!(split("1:xpeek 0x10@zz 4").is_err());
        assert_eq!(parse_expr("0x10+0x20@4+1"), Some(vec![0x30, 5]));
    }
}

`port/crates/s3-desktop/src/layout_tool.rs`:

```rs
//! Dev tools for the full-screen menu layouts (docs/porting/menu-layout.md), no game needed:
//!   s3run --layout-preview <frame.png> <out.png> <WxH> [layout-name]   render a frame through a layout
//!   s3run --layout-probe <frame.png> x,y [x,y ...]                      print 4x4 block means (probe values)
//! Frames are 800x600 screenshots taken with `--inject "t:shot f.png"` (local only, never commit them).
use std::path::Path;

use s3_mods::display::{DisplayMode, ScaleFilter, Viewport};
use s3_mods::menu_layout;

fn read_rgb565(path: &Path) -> Result<(Vec<u16>, u32, u32), String> {
    let dec = png::Decoder::new(std::fs::File::open(path).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?);
    let mut r = dec.read_info().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let mut buf = vec![0; r.output_buffer_size()];
    let info = r.next_frame(&mut buf).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let ch = match info.color_type {
        png::ColorType::Rgb => 3,
        png::ColorType::Rgba => 4,
        c => return Err(format!("unsupported png colour type {c:?}")),
    };
    let px = buf[..info.buffer_size()]
        .chunks(ch)
        .map(|p| ((p[0] as u16 >> 3) << 11) | ((p[1] as u16 >> 2) << 5) | (p[2] as u16 >> 3))
        .collect();
    Ok((px, info.width, info.height))
}

/// Handle the tool arguments; `None` if `args` is not a tool invocation.
pub fn run(args: &[String]) -> Option<Result<(), String>> {
    match args.first().map(|s| s.as_str()) {
        Some("--layout-preview") => Some(preview(&args[1..])),
        Some("--layout-probe") => Some(probe(&args[1..])),
        _ => None,
    }
}

fn preview(a: &[String]) -> Result<(), String> {
    let [frame, out, size, rest @ ..] = a else { return Err("usage: --layout-preview frame.png out.png WxH [name]".into()) };
    let (ww, wh) = size.split_once('x').and_then(|(w, h)| Some((w.parse::<u32>().ok()?, h.parse::<u32>().ok()?))).ok_or("bad WxH")?;
    let (px, w, h) = read_rgb565(Path::new(frame))?;
    let vp = match rest.first() {
        Some(name) => {
            let l = menu_layout::by_name(name).ok_or(format!("no layout '{name}'"))?;
            Viewport::with_layout(DisplayMode::NativeWide, l, ww, wh)
        }
        None => Viewport::for_frame(DisplayMode::NativeWide, &px, w, h, ww, wh),
    };
    eprintln!("layout: {}", vp.layout.map(|l| l.name).unwrap_or("none (Fit)"));
    let mut buf = vec![0u32; (ww * wh) as usize];
    s3_mods::display::scale_to_xrgb(&vp, ScaleFilter::Nearest, &px, &mut buf);
    let f = std::fs::File::create(out).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let mut enc = png::Encoder::new(std::io::BufWriter::new(f), ww, wh);
    enc.set_color(png::ColorType::Rgb);
    enc.set_depth(png::BitDepth::Eight);
    let rgb: Vec<u8> = buf.iter().flat_map(|p| [(p >> 16) as u8, (p >> 8) as u8, *p as u8]).collect();
    enc.write_header().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?.write_image_data(&rgb).map_err(|e| e.to_string())
}

fn probe(a: &[String]) -> Result<(), String> {
    let [frame, pts @ ..] = a else { return Err("usage: --layout-probe frame.png x,y ...".into()) };
    let (px, w, _h) = read_rgb565(Path::new(frame))?;
    for p in pts {
        let (x, y) = p.split_once(',').and_then(|(x, y)| Some((x.parse::<usize>().ok()?, y.parse::<usize>().ok()?))).ok_or("bad x,y")?;
        let m = menu_layout::block_mean(&px, w as usize, x, y);
        println!("        pr({x}, {y}, {}, {}, {}),", m[0], m[1], m[2]);
    }
    Ok(())
}

`port/crates/s3-desktop/src/main.rs`:

```rs
//! `s3run` — run S3.EXE on the desktop (minifb window) or headless.
//!
//! ```text
//! s3run --game-dir <dir> --data-dir <dir> [--exe <S3.EXE>] [--headless] [--max-seconds N]
//!       [--screenshot-every-present <dir>] [--screenshot <file.png>] [--inject "t_ms:cmd args;..."]
//!       [--audio-wav <file.wav> [--audio-wav-seconds N]] [--audio-play]   (audio sink: see audio.rs)
//! ```
//! Inject commands (times in ms since start): `click x y`, `rclick x y`, `move x y`, `down x y`, `up x y`,
//! `key VK` (press+release, VK decimal or 0x..), `text abc` (one key press per character, 120 ms apart; letters,
//! digits, space, `-`, `_` as VK codes so the guest's TranslateMessage makes WM_CHAR), `shot file.png` (write the
//! current frame), `wshot file.png` (the window as the player sees it: frame scaled by the display mode + the mods'
//! window layer; headless: at `--window` size), `quit`.
//! Touch commands (raw pointer events in screen = game pixels, recognized by s3-mods like on Android):
//! `tap`, `dtap`, `tap2`, `tap3`, `drag`, `drag2`, `fling`, `longpress`, `lpdrag`, `pinch`; with a `w` prefix
//! (`wtap`, `wpinch`, ...) in window pixels; see touch_inject.rs.

use std::collections::VecDeque;
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};
use std::time::Instant;

mod audio;
mod debug;
mod debug_units;
mod touch_inject;
mod mp_hash;

use s3_engine::Engine;
use s3_runtime::{FrameBuffer, Host, HostEvent, LogLevel, MouseButton, SliceResult};

/// Max PNG files written by --screenshot-every-present (disk is shared and small).
const MAX_PRESENT_SHOTS: u64 = 300;

struct Args {
    game_dir: PathBuf,
    data_dir: PathBuf,
    exe: Option<PathBuf>,
    headless: bool,
    max_seconds: Option<f64>,
    shots_dir: Option<PathBuf>,
    screenshot: Option<PathBuf>,
    inject: Vec<(u64, HostEvent)>,
    /// `shot` / `wshot` inject commands: (time ms, png path, window-composited).
    inject_shots: Vec<(u64, PathBuf, bool)>,
    verbose: bool,
    audio_wav: Option<PathBuf>,
    audio_wav_seconds: f64,
    audio_play: bool,
    /// Debug inject commands (dump/peek/poke/regs, see debug.rs).
    debug_cmds: Vec<(u64, debug::DebugCmd)>,
    /// re-units read-only commands (xdump/xpeek/scan, see debug_units.rs).
    units_cmds: Vec<(u64, debug_units::UnitsCmd)>,
    /// `--mp-hash FILE`: per-game-step simulation hash (mp_hash.rs), every `mp_hash_every` steps.
    mp_hash: Option<PathBuf>,
    mp_hash_every: u32,
    /// Display overrides (docs/porting/display.md): `--display`, `--filter`, `--fps`, `--window WxH`.
    display_mode: Option<s3_mods::display::DisplayMode>,
    display_filter: Option<s3_mods::display::ScaleFilter>,
    fps_counter: Option<s3_mods::display::FpsCounter>,
    window_size: Option<(u32, u32)>,
}

fn usage() -> ! {
    eprintln!(
        "usage: s3run --game-dir <dir> --data-dir <dir> [--exe <path>] [--headless] [--max-seconds N]\n\
         \x20            [--screenshot-every-present <dir>] [--screenshot <file.png>] [--inject \"t:cmd x y;...\"] [-v]\n\
         \x20            [--audio-wav <file.wav> [--audio-wav-seconds N (300)]] [--audio-play (feature audio-cpal)]\n\
         \x20            [--mp-hash <file> [--mp-hash-every N]]   (multiplayer: env S3_RELAY_URL, S3_NET_NAME)\n\
         \x20            [--display fit|fill|stretch|native] [--filter nearest|linear|sharp] [--fps off|fps|full]\n\
         \x20            [--window WxH]   (window size; headless: the simulated screen for display modes)"
    );
    std::process::exit(2)
}

fn parse_num(s: &str) -> Option<i64> {
    if let Some(h) = s.strip_prefix("0x") {
        i64::from_str_radix(h, 16).ok()
    } else {
        s.parse().ok()
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
fn parse_inject(spec: &str) -> Result<Vec<(u64, HostEvent)>, String> {
    parse_inject_all(spec).map(|(v, _)| v)
}

/// VK code for a `text` character (US layout, unshifted keys only).
fn text_vk(c: char) -> Option<u32> {
    match c {
        'a'..='z' => Some(c.to_ascii_uppercase() as u32),
        'A'..='Z' | '0'..='9' | ' ' => Some(c as u32),
        '-' | '_' => Some(0xBD),
        _ => None,
    }
}

/// Parse inject events plus `shot` / `wshot` commands.
fn parse_inject_all(spec: &str) -> Result<(Vec<(u64, HostEvent)>, Vec<(u64, PathBuf, bool)>), String> {
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    let mut shots = Vec::new();
    for item in spec.split(';').map(str::trim).filter(|s| !s.is_empty()) {
        let (t, cmd) = item.split_once(':').ok_or(format!("bad inject item '{item}'"))?;
        let t: u64 = t.trim().parse().map_err(|_| format!("bad time in '{item}'"))?;
        let w: Vec<&str> = cmd.split_whitespace().collect();
        let xy = |w: &[&str]| -> Result<(i32, i32), String> {
            let x = w.get(1).and_then(|s| parse_num(s)).ok_or(format!("missing x in '{item}'"))?;
            let y = w.get(2).and_then(|s| parse_num(s)).ok_or(format!("missing y in '{item}'"))?;
            Ok((x as i32, y as i32))
        };
        match w.first().copied() {
            Some("move") => {
                let (x, y) = xy(&w)?;
                out.push((t, HostEvent::MouseMove { x, y }));
            }
            Some(c @ ("click" | "rclick" | "down" | "up")) => {
                let (x, y) = xy(&w)?;
                let button = if c == "rclick" { MouseButton::Right } else { MouseButton::Left };
                out.push((t, HostEvent::MouseMove { x, y }));
                if c != "up" {
                    out.push((t, HostEvent::MouseButton { button, down: true }));
                }
                if c != "down" {
                    out.push((t + 50, HostEvent::MouseButton { button, down: false }));
                }
            }
            Some("key") => {
                let vk = w.get(1).and_then(|s| parse_num(s)).ok_or(format!("missing vk in '{item}'"))? as u32;
                out.push((t, HostEvent::Key { vk, down: true }));
                out.push((t + 50, HostEvent::Key { vk, down: false }));
            }
            // Hold / release one key (modifiers: Shift 0x10, Ctrl 0x11, Alt 0x12), e.g. `kdown 0x12;key 0x31;kup 0x12`.
            Some(c @ ("kdown" | "kup")) => {
                let vk = w.get(1).and_then(|s| parse_num(s)).ok_or(format!("missing vk in '{item}'"))? as u32;
                out.push((t, HostEvent::Key { vk, down: c == "kdown" }));
            }
            Some("text") => {
                let txt = cmd.trim_start()["text".len()..].trim();
                for (i, c) in txt.chars().enumerate() {
                    let vk = text_vk(c).ok_or(format!("unsupported text char '{c}' in '{item}'"))?;
                    let at = t + 120 * i as u64;
                    let shift = c.is_ascii_uppercase() || c == '_';
                    if shift {
                        out.push((at, HostEvent::Key { vk: 0x10, down: true }));
                    }
                    out.push((at + 10, HostEvent::Key { vk, down: true }));
                    out.push((at + 60, HostEvent::Key { vk, down: false }));
                    if shift {
                        out.push((at + 70, HostEvent::Key { vk: 0x10, down: false }));
                    }
                }
            }
            Some(c @ ("shot" | "wshot")) => {
                let f = w.get(1).ok_or(format!("missing file in '{item}'"))?;
                shots.push((t, PathBuf::from(f), c == "wshot"));
            }
            Some("quit") => out.push((t, HostEvent::Quit)),
            Some(c) if touch_inject::split_window_prefix(c).is_some() => {
                let num = |i: usize| -> Result<f64, String> {
                    w.get(i).and_then(|s| s.parse::<f64>().ok()).ok_or(format!("missing/bad argument {i} in '{item}'"))
                };
                let opt = |i: usize, d: f64| w.get(i).and_then(|s| s.parse::<f64>().ok()).unwrap_or(d);
                touch_inject::touch_events_any(&mut out, t, c, &num, &opt)?;
            }
            _ => return Err(format!("unknown inject command '{cmd}'")),
        }
    }
    out.sort_by_key(|(t, _)| *t);
    shots.sort_by_key(|(t, _, _)| *t);
    Ok((out, shots))
}

fn parse_args() -> Args {
    let mut a = Args {
        game_dir: PathBuf::new(),
        data_dir: PathBuf::new(),
        exe: None,
        headless: false,
        max_seconds: None,
        shots_dir: None,
        screenshot: None,
        inject: Vec::new(),
        inject_shots: Vec::new(),
        verbose: false,
        audio_wav: None,
        audio_wav_seconds: 300.0,
        audio_play: false,
        debug_cmds: Vec::new(),
        units_cmds: Vec::new(),
        mp_hash: None,
        mp_hash_every: 1,
        display_mode: None,
        display_filter: None,
        fps_counter: None,
        window_size: None,
    };
    let mut it = std::env::args().skip(1);
    while let Some(arg) = it.next() {
        let mut val = || it.next().unwrap_or_else(|| usage());
        match arg.as_str() {
            "--game-dir" => a.game_dir = val().into(),
            "--data-dir" => a.data_dir = val().into(),
            "--exe" => a.exe = Some(val().into()),
            "--headless" => a.headless = true,
            "--max-seconds" => a.max_seconds = Some(val().parse().unwrap_or_else(|_| usage())),
            "--screenshot-every-present" => a.shots_dir = Some(val().into()),
            "--screenshot" => a.screenshot = Some(val().into()),
            "--inject" => {
                let (spec, ucmds) = debug_units::split(&val()).unwrap_or_else(|e| {
                    eprintln!("{e}");
                    usage()
                });
                a.units_cmds = ucmds;
                let (spec, dbg) = debug::split(&spec).unwrap_or_else(|e| {
                    eprintln!("{e}");
                    usage()
                });
                a.debug_cmds = dbg;
                (a.inject, a.inject_shots) = parse_inject_all(&spec).unwrap_or_else(|e| {
                    eprintln!("{e}");
                    usage()
                })
            }
            "-v" | "--verbose" => a.verbose = true,
            "--audio-wav" => a.audio_wav = Some(val().into()),
            "--audio-wav-seconds" => a.audio_wav_seconds = val().parse().unwrap_or_else(|_| usage()),
            "--audio-play" => a.audio_play = true,
            "--mp-hash" => a.mp_hash = Some(val().into()),
            "--mp-hash-every" => a.mp_hash_every = val().parse().unwrap_or_else(|_| usage()),
            "--display" => a.display_mode = Some(s3_mods::display::DisplayMode::parse(&val()).unwrap_or_else(|| usage())),
            "--filter" => a.display_filter = Some(s3_mods::display::ScaleFilter::parse(&val()).unwrap_or_else(|| usage())),
            "--fps" => a.fps_counter = Some(s3_mods::display::FpsCounter::parse(&val()).unwrap_or_else(|| usage())),
            "--window" => {
                let v = val();
                let (w, h) = v.split_once('x').unwrap_or_else(|| usage());
                a.window_size = Some((w.parse().unwrap_or_else(|_| usage()), h.parse().unwrap_or_else(|_| usage())));
            }
            "-h" | "--help" => usage(),
            _ => usage(),
        }
    }
    if a.game_dir.as_os_str().is_empty() || a.data_dir.as_os_str().is_empty() {
        usage();
    }
    a
}

/// State shared between the host (owned by the machine) and the frontend loop.
#[derive(Default)]
struct Shared {
    frame: Option<FrameBuffer>,
    frame_serial: u64,
    events: VecDeque<HostEvent>,
    /// Viewport of the shown (or simulated headless) window, for `w`-prefixed touch injects.
    viewport: Option<s3_mods::display::Viewport>,
}

struct DesktopHost {
    game_dir: PathBuf,
    data_dir: PathBuf,
    start: Instant,
    shared: Arc<Mutex<Shared>>,
    inject: VecDeque<(u64, HostEvent)>,
    shots_dir: Option<PathBuf>,
    shots: u64,
    verbose: bool,
    audio: Option<audio::SharedSink>,
    /// Viewport frozen while injected fingers are down (like s3-android's `pinch_vp`: a pinch switches the render
    /// size, and mapping each move through the newest viewport would make the fingers jump in game pixels).
    touch_vp: Option<s3_mods::display::Viewport>,
    fingers: Vec<u32>,
}

impl Host for DesktopHost {
    fn present(&mut self, fb: &FrameBuffer) {
        if let Some(dir) = &self.shots_dir {
            if self.shots < MAX_PRESENT_SHOTS {
                let p = dir.join(format!("present-{:05}.png", self.shots));
                if let Err(e) = write_png(&p, fb) {
                    eprintln!("screenshot {}: {e}", p.display());
                }
            }
            self.shots += 1;
        }
        let mut s = self.shared.lock().unwrap();
        s.frame = Some(fb.clone());
        s.frame_serial += 1;
    }

    fn poll_events(&mut self) -> Vec<HostEvent> {
        let now = self.now_ms();
        let mut out: Vec<HostEvent> = Vec::new();
        let vp = self.shared.lock().unwrap().viewport;
        while let Some((t, _)) = self.inject.front() {
            if *t > now {
                break;
            }
            let mut e = self.inject.pop_front().unwrap().1;
            // Window-coordinate touch inject: the game position through the viewport of the gesture's start.
            if let HostEvent::Pointer { id, phase, x, y, wx, wy } = &mut e {
                if self.fingers.is_empty() {
                    self.touch_vp = vp;
                }
                if *x < 0 && *wx >= 0 {
                    (*x, *y) = self.touch_vp.map_or((*wx, *wy), |v| v.window_to_game(*wx as f32 + 0.5, *wy as f32 + 0.5));
                }
                match phase {
                    s3_runtime::PointerPhase::Down => self.fingers.push(*id),
                    s3_runtime::PointerPhase::Up | s3_runtime::PointerPhase::Cancel => self.fingers.retain(|f| f != id),
                    _ => {}
                }
            }
            out.push(e);
        }
        out.extend(self.shared.lock().unwrap().events.drain(..));
        out
    }

    fn queue_audio(&mut self, samples: &[i16], rate: u32, channels: u16) {
        if let Some(a) = &self.audio {
            a.lock().unwrap().queue(samples, rate, channels);
        }
    }

    fn audio_queued_frames(&self) -> usize {
        self.audio.as_ref().map_or(0, |a| a.lock().unwrap().queued_frames())
    }

    fn now_ms(&self) -> u64 {
        self.start.elapsed().as_millis() as u64
    }

    fn game_dir(&self) -> PathBuf {
        self.game_dir.clone()
    }

    fn data_dir(&self) -> PathBuf {
        self.data_dir.clone()
    }

    fn log(&self, level: LogLevel, msg: &str) {
        if self.verbose || level <= LogLevel::Info || level == LogLevel::Trace {
            eprintln!("[{level:?}] {msg}");
        }
    }
}

fn write_png(path: &Path, fb: &FrameBuffer) -> Result<(), String> {
    write_png_rgb(path, fb.width, fb.height, &fb.to_rgb888())
}

fn write_png_rgb(path: &Path, w: u32, h: u32, rgb: &[u8]) -> Result<(), String> {
    let f = std::fs::File::create(path).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let mut enc = png::Encoder::new(std::io::BufWriter::new(f), w, h);
    enc.set_color(png::ColorType::Rgb);
    enc.set_depth(png::BitDepth::Eight);
    let mut wr = enc.write_header().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    wr.write_image_data(rgb).map_err(|e| e.to_string())
}

/// The window as the player sees it (XRGB8888): the frame scaled with the display settings (+ the Classic panel
/// split of the scene) and the mods' window layer on top.
fn compose_window(fb: &FrameBuffer, scene: &s3_mods::Scene, raster: &mut s3_mods::LayerRaster, d: s3_mods::display::DisplaySettings, ww: u32, wh: u32) -> (Vec<u32>, s3_mods::display::Viewport) {
    use s3_mods::display::Viewport;
    let panel = s3_mods::display::panel_for_frame(scene.panel, scene.frame, (fb.width, fb.height));
    let vp = Viewport::for_frame_split(d.mode, &fb.pixels, fb.width, fb.height, ww, wh, panel);
    let mut buf = vec![0u32; (ww * wh) as usize];
    s3_mods::display::scale_to_xrgb(&vp, d.filter, &fb.pixels, &mut buf);
    if scene.list.width == ww && scene.list.height == wh {
        let ins = scene.list.insets();
        s3_mods::display::draw_insets_xrgb(&ins, d.filter, &fb.pixels, fb.width as usize, fb.height as usize, &mut buf, ww as usize, wh as usize);
        raster.update(&scene.list);
        raster.blend_onto_xrgb(&mut buf, ww as usize);
    }
    (buf, vp)
}

/// `wshot`: write [`compose_window`] as a PNG.
fn write_window_png(path: &Path, buf: &[u32], w: u32, h: u32) -> Result<(), String> {
    let rgb: Vec<u8> = buf.iter().flat_map(|p| [(p >> 16) as u8, (p >> 8) as u8, *p as u8]).collect();
    write_png_rgb(path, w, h, &rgb)
}

mod layout_tool;

mod window {
    //! minifb window frontend (X11).
    use minifb::{Key, MouseButton as MfButton, MouseMode, ScaleMode, Window, WindowOptions};
    use s3_mods::display::{DisplaySettings, Viewport};
    use s3_mods::{LayerRaster, SceneSlot};
    use s3_runtime::{FrameBuffer, HostEvent, MouseButton};
    use std::sync::Arc;

    pub struct Win {
        win: Option<Window>,
        /// Window (= buffer) size; the game frame is scaled into it by `s3_mods::display` (CPU).
        size: (usize, usize),
        buf: Vec<u32>,
        /// Requested window size (`--window`), else the first frame's size.
        want: Option<(u32, u32)>,
        pub display: DisplaySettings,
        pub viewport: Option<Viewport>,
        last_frame: Option<FrameBuffer>,
        last_mouse: (i32, i32),
        buttons: [bool; 3],
        keys_down: Vec<Key>,
        /// The mods' window layer (s3_mods::layer): mailbox, raster, scene shown.
        pub layer: Option<Arc<SceneSlot>>,
        raster: LayerRaster,
        layer_seq: u64,
    }

    fn vk(k: Key) -> Option<u32> {
        use Key::*;
        let v = match k {
            A => 0x41, B => 0x42, C => 0x43, D => 0x44, E => 0x45, F => 0x46, G => 0x47, H => 0x48, I => 0x49,
            J => 0x4A, K => 0x4B, L => 0x4C, M => 0x4D, N => 0x4E, O => 0x4F, P => 0x50, Q => 0x51, R => 0x52,
            S => 0x53, T => 0x54, U => 0x55, V => 0x56, W => 0x57, X => 0x58, Y => 0x59, Z => 0x5A,
            Key0 => 0x30, Key1 => 0x31, Key2 => 0x32, Key3 => 0x33, Key4 => 0x34, Key5 => 0x35, Key6 => 0x36,
            Key7 => 0x37, Key8 => 0x38, Key9 => 0x39,
            F1 => 0x70, F2 => 0x71, F3 => 0x72, F4 => 0x73, F5 => 0x74, F6 => 0x75, F7 => 0x76, F8 => 0x77,
            F9 => 0x78, F10 => 0x79, F11 => 0x7A, F12 => 0x7B,
            Escape => 0x1B, Enter => 0x0D, Space => 0x20, Backspace => 0x08, Tab => 0x09,
            Left => 0x25, Up => 0x26, Right => 0x27, Down => 0x28,
            LeftShift | RightShift => 0x10, LeftCtrl | RightCtrl => 0x11, LeftAlt | RightAlt => 0x12,
            Delete => 0x2E, Insert => 0x2D, Home => 0x24, End => 0x23, PageUp => 0x21, PageDown => 0x22,
            NumPadPlus => 0x6B, NumPadMinus => 0x6D, Pause => 0x13,
            _ => return None,
        };
        Some(v)
    }

    impl Win {
        pub fn new() -> Self {
            Win {
                win: None,
                size: (0, 0),
                buf: Vec::new(),
                want: None,
                display: DisplaySettings::default(),
                viewport: None,
                last_frame: None,
                last_mouse: (-1, -1),
                buttons: [false; 3],
                keys_down: Vec::new(),
                layer: None,
                raster: LayerRaster::new(),
                layer_seq: u64::MAX,
            }
        }

        pub fn with_size(want: Option<(u32, u32)>) -> Self {
            Win { want, ..Win::new() }
        }

        pub fn is_open(&self) -> bool {
            self.win.as_ref().map(|w| w.is_open()).unwrap_or(true)
        }

        pub fn show(&mut self, fb: &FrameBuffer) {
            if self.win.is_none() {
                let size = self.want.map(|(w, h)| (w as usize, h as usize)).unwrap_or((fb.width as usize, fb.height as usize));
                let opts = WindowOptions { resize: true, scale_mode: ScaleMode::UpperLeft, ..WindowOptions::default() };
                match Window::new("S3 Mobile (s3run)", size.0, size.1, opts) {
                    Ok(mut w) => {
                        w.set_target_fps(0);
                        // The game's cursor is composed into the frame (s3_runtime::cursor).
                        w.set_cursor_visibility(false);
                        self.win = Some(w);
                        self.size = size;
                    }
                    Err(e) => {
                        eprintln!("window: {e}");
                        return;
                    }
                }
            }
            match &mut self.last_frame {
                Some(l) if l.width == fb.width && l.height == fb.height => l.pixels.copy_from_slice(&fb.pixels),
                l => *l = Some(fb.clone()),
            }
            self.redraw();
        }

        /// Scale the last frame into the window buffer with the current display settings.
        fn redraw(&mut self) {
            let Some(fb) = &self.last_frame else { return };
            let Some(w) = &mut self.win else { return };
            let (ww, wh) = w.get_size();
            let (ww, wh) = (ww.max(1), wh.max(1));
            self.size = (ww, wh);
            let scene = self.layer.as_ref().map(|l| l.latest()).unwrap_or_default();
            self.layer_seq = scene.seq;
            let panel = s3_mods::display::panel_for_frame(scene.panel, scene.frame, (fb.width, fb.height));
            let vp = Viewport::for_frame_split(self.display.mode, &fb.pixels, fb.width, fb.height, ww as u32, wh as u32, panel);
            self.buf.resize(ww * wh, 0);
            s3_mods::display::scale_to_xrgb(&vp, self.display.filter, &fb.pixels, &mut self.buf);
            // Window layer on top (only a layer made for this window size).
            if scene.list.width as usize == ww && scene.list.height as usize == wh {
                let ins = scene.list.insets();
                s3_mods::display::draw_insets_xrgb(&ins, self.display.filter, &fb.pixels, fb.width as usize, fb.height as usize, &mut self.buf, ww, wh);
                self.raster.update(&scene.list);
                self.raster.blend_onto_xrgb(&mut self.buf, ww);
            }
            self.viewport = Some(vp);
            let _ = w.update_with_buffer(&self.buf, ww, wh);
        }

        /// New display settings: redraw at once.
        pub fn set_display(&mut self, d: DisplaySettings) {
            if d != self.display {
                self.display = d;
                self.redraw();
            }
        }

        /// Pump window events (call regularly even without new frames).
        pub fn events(&mut self) -> Vec<HostEvent> {
            let mut out = Vec::new();
            let Some(w) = &mut self.win else { return out };
            let (cw, ch) = w.get_size();
            let layer_new = self.layer.as_ref().is_some_and(|l| l.seq() != self.layer_seq);
            if ((cw, ch) != self.size && cw > 0 && ch > 0) || layer_new {
                self.redraw(); // window resized / new window layer
            }
            let Some(w) = &mut self.win else { return out };
            if self.buf.is_empty() {
                w.update();
            } else {
                let _ = w.update_with_buffer(&self.buf, self.size.0, self.size.1);
            }
            if !w.is_open() {
                out.push(HostEvent::Quit);
                return out;
            }
            if let Some((x, y)) = w.get_mouse_pos(MouseMode::Clamp) {
                // Window -> game pixels (shared transform, follows the display mode).
                let p = match &self.viewport {
                    Some(vp) => vp.window_to_game(x, y),
                    None => (x as i32, y as i32),
                };
                if p != self.last_mouse {
                    self.last_mouse = p;
                    out.push(HostEvent::MouseMove { x: p.0, y: p.1 });
                }
            }
            for (i, (mb, b)) in [(MfButton::Left, MouseButton::Left), (MfButton::Right, MouseButton::Right), (MfButton::Middle, MouseButton::Middle)]
                .into_iter()
                .enumerate()
            {
                let d = w.get_mouse_down(mb);
                if d != self.buttons[i] {
                    self.buttons[i] = d;
                    out.push(HostEvent::MouseButton { button: b, down: d });
                }
            }
            let now: Vec<Key> = w.get_keys();
            for k in &now {
                if !self.keys_down.contains(k) {
                    if let Some(v) = vk(*k) {
                        out.push(HostEvent::Key { vk: v, down: true });
                    }
                }
            }
            for k in &self.keys_down {
                if !now.contains(k) {
                    if let Some(v) = vk(*k) {
                        out.push(HostEvent::Key { vk: v, down: false });
                    }
                }
            }
            self.keys_down = now;
            out
        }
    }
}

/// `log` crate output of the network crates (LAN discovery, embedded relay, relay client) on stderr.
struct NetLog;

impl log::Log for NetLog {
    fn enabled(&self, m: &log::Metadata) -> bool {
        m.level() <= log::Level::Info && (m.target().starts_with("s3_net") || m.target().starts_with("s3_relay") || m.target().starts_with("s3_dx"))
    }
    fn log(&self, r: &log::Record) {
        if self.enabled(r.metadata()) {
            eprintln!("[{}] {}: {}", r.level(), r.target(), r.args());
        }
    }
    fn flush(&self) {}
}

fn main() {
    let _ = log::set_logger(&NetLog);
    log::set_max_level(log::LevelFilter::Info);
    let raw: Vec<String> = std::env::args().skip(1).collect();
    if let Some(r) = layout_tool::run(&raw) {
        if let Err(e) = r {
            eprintln!("s3run: {e}");
            std::process::exit(2);
        }
        return;
    }
    let args = parse_args();
    std::fs::create_dir_all(&args.data_dir).ok();
    if let Some(d) = &args.shots_dir {
        std::fs::create_dir_all(d).ok();
    }
    let shared = Arc::new(Mutex::new(Shared::default()));
    let audio_sink: Option<audio::SharedSink> = if args.audio_wav.is_some() || args.audio_play {
        let wav = args.audio_wav.as_ref().and_then(|p| {
            audio::WavWriter::create(p, audio::SINK_RATE, 2, args.audio_wav_seconds)
                .map_err(|e| eprintln!("s3run: --audio-wav {}: {e}", p.display()))
                .ok()
        });
        Some(Arc::new(Mutex::new(audio::AudioSink::new(wav, args.audio_play))))
    } else {
        None
    };
    let host = DesktopHost {
        game_dir: args.game_dir.clone(),
        data_dir: args.data_dir.clone(),
        start: Instant::now(),
        shared: shared.clone(),
        inject: args.inject.iter().copied().collect(),
        shots_dir: args.shots_dir.clone(),
        shots: 0,
        verbose: args.verbose,
        audio: audio_sink.clone(),
        touch_vp: None,
        fingers: Vec::new(),
    };
    let mut engine = match Engine::new(Box::new(host), args.exe.as_deref()) {
        Ok(e) => e,
        Err(e) => {
            eprintln!("s3run: {e}");
            std::process::exit(1);
        }
    };
    // S3_MT=1: multi-core mode (draw thread on its own host thread, docs/porting/multicore.md). Not deterministic.
    if std::env::var("S3_MT").is_ok_and(|v| v == "1") {
        engine.machine.enable_mt();
    }
    if std::env::var_os("S3_GAME_LOG").is_some() {
        mp_hash::install_game_log(&mut engine.machine);
    }
    if std::env::var_os("S3_MP_NETDBG").is_some() {
        mp_hash::install_net_debug(&mut engine.machine);
    }
    if let Some(p) = &args.mp_hash {
        mp_hash::install(&mut engine.machine, p, args.mp_hash_every);
    }
    let start = Instant::now();
    let mut win = if args.headless { None } else { Some(window::Win::with_size(args.window_size)) };
    // The mods' window layer (docs/porting/mods.md "Window layer").
    let layer = s3_mods::SceneSlot::new(None);
    s3_mods::set_layer_sink(&mut engine.machine, layer.clone());
    if let Some(w) = &mut win {
        w.layer = Some(layer.clone());
    }
    let mut shot_raster = s3_mods::LayerRaster::new();
    // Display overrides from the command line (in memory only, not saved to mods-settings.json).
    {
        let mut d = s3_mods::display::display_settings(&mut engine.machine);
        if let Some(v) = args.display_mode {
            d.mode = v;
        }
        if let Some(v) = args.display_filter {
            d.filter = v;
        }
        if let Some(v) = args.fps_counter {
            d.fps_counter = v;
        }
        s3_mods::display::override_display(&mut engine.machine, d);
    }
    let mut published_vp: Option<s3_mods::display::Viewport> = None;
    let mut shown_serial = 0;
    let sample = std::env::var_os("S3_SAMPLE").is_some();
    let mut last_sample = Instant::now();
    let mut sample_prev: Vec<u64> = Vec::new();
    let mut sample_presents = 0u64;
    let mut sample_cpu_ns = 0u64;
    // S3_PROFILE_FROM_MS: zero the profile counters at this time (profile only the in-game part).
    let mut profile_reset: Option<u64> = std::env::var("S3_PROFILE_FROM_MS").ok().and_then(|v| v.parse().ok());
    let mut inject_shots: VecDeque<(u64, PathBuf, bool)> = args.inject_shots.iter().cloned().collect();
    let mut debug_cmds: VecDeque<(u64, debug::DebugCmd)> = args.debug_cmds.iter().cloned().collect();
    let mut units_cmds: VecDeque<(u64, debug_units::UnitsCmd)> = args.units_cmds.iter().cloned().collect();
    loop {
        debug::run_due(&mut engine, &mut debug_cmds, start.elapsed().as_millis() as u64);
        debug_units::run_due(&mut engine, &mut units_cmds, start.elapsed().as_millis() as u64);
        while inject_shots.front().map(|(t, _, _)| *t <= start.elapsed().as_millis() as u64).unwrap_or(false) {
            let (_, p, windowed) = inject_shots.pop_front().unwrap();
            let f = shared.lock().unwrap().frame.clone();
            let d = s3_mods::display::display_settings(&mut engine.machine);
            let r = f.map(|f| {
                if !windowed {
                    return write_png(&p, &f);
                }
                let (ww, wh) = args.window_size.or(s3_mods::display::window_size(&mut engine.machine)).unwrap_or((f.width, f.height));
                let (buf, _) = compose_window(&f, &layer.latest(), &mut shot_raster, d, ww, wh);
                write_window_png(&p, &buf, ww, wh)
            });
            match r {
                Some(Ok(())) => eprintln!("s3run: shot {} at {} ms", p.display(), start.elapsed().as_millis()),
                Some(Err(e)) => eprintln!("s3run: shot {} failed: {e}", p.display()),
                None => eprintln!("s3run: shot {}: no frame yet", p.display()),
            }
        }
        if let Some(max) = args.max_seconds {
            if start.elapsed().as_secs_f64() >= max {
                eprintln!("s3run: --max-seconds reached");
                break;
            }
        }
        let r = engine.run_for_ms(16);
        // Headless + --window: publish the simulated screen so display modes (Native wide, Fill) work headless.
        if let (None, Some((ww, wh))) = (&win, args.window_size) {
            let (fw, fh) = engine.machine.last_frame_size();
            if fw > 0 {
                let mode = s3_mods::display::display_settings(&mut engine.machine).mode;
                let scene = layer.latest();
                let panel = s3_mods::display::panel_for_frame(scene.panel, scene.frame, (fw, fh));
                // Through the last frame, so a menu layout (menu_layout.rs) maps `w` touch injects like `wshot`
                // shows them.
                let vp = Some(match &shared.lock().unwrap().frame {
                    Some(fb) if (fb.width, fb.height) == (fw, fh) => {
                        s3_mods::display::Viewport::for_frame_split(mode, &fb.pixels, fw, fh, ww, wh, panel)
                    }
                    _ => s3_mods::display::Viewport::new_split(mode, fw, fh, ww, wh, panel),
                });
                if vp != published_vp {
                    published_vp = vp;
                    s3_mods::display::set_viewport(&mut engine.machine, vp);
                    shared.lock().unwrap().viewport = vp;
                }
            }
        }
        if profile_reset.is_some_and(|t| start.elapsed().as_millis() as u64 >= t) {
            profile_reset = None;
            for t in engine.machine.threads.iter_mut() {
                t.cpu.cache.reset_profile();
            }
            eprintln!("s3run: profile counters reset");
        }
        // Diagnostics: S3_SAMPLE=1 prints per-thread instruction deltas and EIP once per second.
        if sample && last_sample.elapsed().as_secs_f64() >= 1.0 {
            last_sample = Instant::now();
            let pr = engine.machine.stats.presents;
            let ns = engine.machine.stats.cpu_ns;
            let mut line = format!(
                "[sample {:>5.1}s] fps:{} cpu:{}ms",
                start.elapsed().as_secs_f64(),
                pr - sample_presents,
                (ns - sample_cpu_ns) / 1_000_000
            );
            sample_presents = pr;
            sample_cpu_ns = ns;
            for (i, t) in engine.machine.threads.iter().enumerate() {
                let prev = sample_prev.get(i).copied().unwrap_or(0);
                line.push_str(&format!(" t{i}:{}M@{:#x}/{:?}", (t.cpu.instructions - prev) / 1_000_000, t.cpu.eip, t.state));
            }
            sample_prev = engine.machine.threads.iter().map(|t| t.cpu.instructions).collect();
            eprintln!("{line}");
        }
        if let Some(w) = &mut win {
            let frame = {
                let s = shared.lock().unwrap();
                if s.frame_serial != shown_serial {
                    shown_serial = s.frame_serial;
                    s.frame.clone()
                } else {
                    None
                }
            };
            w.set_display(s3_mods::display::display_settings(&mut engine.machine));
            if let Some(f) = frame {
                w.show(&f);
            }
            if w.viewport != published_vp {
                published_vp = w.viewport;
                s3_mods::display::set_viewport(&mut engine.machine, published_vp);
                shared.lock().unwrap().viewport = published_vp;
            }
            let evs = w.events();
            shared.lock().unwrap().events.extend(evs);
            if !w.is_open() {
                break;
            }
        }
        if engine.machine.input.quit_requested {
            eprintln!("s3run: quit requested");
            break;
        }
        if r == SliceResult::Stopped {
            break;
        }
    }
    // S3_PROFILE=<file>: per-thread decoded-block entry counts (thread start eip len entries), for
    // tools/perf_profile.py (function-level guest profile, see docs/porting/performance.md).
    if let Some(p) = std::env::var_os("S3_PROFILE") {
        let mut out = String::new();
        for (i, t) in engine.machine.threads.iter().enumerate() {
            for (start, len, n) in t.cpu.cache.profile() {
                if n > 0 {
                    out.push_str(&format!("{i} {start:#x} {len} {n}\n"));
                }
            }
        }
        if let Err(e) = std::fs::write(&p, out) {
            eprintln!("s3run: S3_PROFILE write failed: {e}");
        }
        let mut dis = String::new();
        for (i, t) in engine.machine.threads.iter().enumerate() {
            dis.push_str(&format!("=== thread {i}\n{}", t.cpu.cache.profile_disasm(60)));
        }
        let mut dp = p.clone();
        dp.push(".disasm");
        let _ = std::fs::write(dp, dis);
        let mut forms: std::collections::HashMap<String, u64> = Default::default();
        for t in engine.machine.threads.iter() {
            for (k, n) in t.cpu.cache.profile_forms() {
                *forms.entry(k).or_default() += n;
            }
        }
        let mut fv: Vec<_> = forms.into_iter().collect();
        fv.sort_by_key(|e| std::cmp::Reverse(e.1));
        let total: u64 = fv.iter().map(|e| e.1).sum::<u64>().max(1);
        let txt: String = fv.iter().take(150).map(|(k, n)| format!("{:6.2}% {k}\n", 100.0 * *n as f64 / total as f64)).collect();
        let mut fp = p.clone();
        fp.push(".forms");
        let _ = std::fs::write(fp, txt);
    }
    if let Some(p) = &args.screenshot {
        let f = shared.lock().unwrap().frame.clone();
        match f {
            Some(f) => match write_png(p, &f) {
                Ok(()) => eprintln!("s3run: screenshot written to {}", p.display()),
                Err(e) => eprintln!("s3run: screenshot failed: {e}"),
            },
            None => eprintln!("s3run: no frame was presented, no screenshot"),
        }
    }
    if let Some(a) = &audio_sink {
        for line in a.lock().unwrap().finish() {
            eprintln!("{line}");
        }
    }
    println!("{}", engine.summary());
    let code = match engine.machine.stop_reason() {
        Some(s3_runtime::StopReason::Exited(c)) => *c as i32,
        None => 0,
        Some(_) => 3,
    };
    std::process::exit(code);
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use s3_runtime::PointerPhase;

    #[test]
    fn inject_touch_parsing() {
        let v = parse_inject("100:tap 10 20; 200:drag 0 0 100 0 100; 1000:pinch 300 200 2; 2000:longpress 5 5 600").unwrap();
        let pt = |id, phase, x, y| HostEvent::Pointer { id, phase, x, y, wx: -1, wy: -1 };
        assert_eq!(v[0], (100, pt(1, PointerPhase::Down, 10, 20)));
        assert_eq!(v[1], (170, pt(1, PointerPhase::Up, 10, 20)));
        assert!(v.contains(&(301, pt(1, PointerPhase::Up, 100, 0))));
        assert!(v.contains(&(1302, pt(2, PointerPhase::Up, 380, 200))));
        assert_eq!(v.last().unwrap(), &(2600, pt(1, PointerPhase::Up, 5, 5)));
        let v = parse_inject("0:lpdrag 10 10 110 60 700 160; 5000:drag2 300 200 400 200 160; 9000:tap3 50 50; 9500:dtap 5 5").unwrap();
        assert_eq!(v[0], (0, pt(1, PointerPhase::Down, 10, 10)));
        assert_eq!(v[1].0, 716, "lpdrag moves start after the hold");
        assert!(v.contains(&(861, pt(1, PointerPhase::Up, 110, 60))));
        assert!(v.contains(&(5005, pt(2, PointerPhase::Down, 330, 200))));
        assert!(v.contains(&(5172, pt(2, PointerPhase::Up, 430, 200))));
        // Window coordinates (`w` prefix): game position left to the host.
        let wv = parse_inject("0:wtap 1000 400").unwrap();
        assert_eq!(wv[0], (0, HostEvent::Pointer { id: 1, phase: PointerPhase::Down, x: -1, y: -1, wx: 1000, wy: 400 }));
        assert_eq!(v.iter().filter(|e| e.0 >= 9000 && e.0 < 9100 && matches!(e.1, HostEvent::Pointer { phase: PointerPhase::Down, .. })).count(), 3);
        assert_eq!(v.iter().filter(|e| e.0 >= 9500 && matches!(e.1, HostEvent::Pointer { phase: PointerPhase::Up, .. })).count(), 2);
    }

    #[test]
    fn inject_parsing() {
        let v = parse_inject("100:click 10 20; 50:key 0x1B ;300:quit").unwrap();
        assert_eq!(v[0], (50, HostEvent::Key { vk: 0x1B, down: true }));
        assert!(v.contains(&(100, HostEvent::MouseButton { button: MouseButton::Left, down: true })));
        assert!(v.contains(&(150, HostEvent::MouseButton { button: MouseButton::Left, down: false })));
        assert_eq!(v.last(), Some(&(300, HostEvent::Quit)));
        assert!(parse_inject("x:click").is_err());
        let (v, shots) = parse_inject_all("1000:text Ab1;2000:shot /tmp/x.png;3000:wshot /tmp/y.png").unwrap();
        assert_eq!(shots, vec![(2000, PathBuf::from("/tmp/x.png"), false), (3000, PathBuf::from("/tmp/y.png"), true)]);
        assert!(v.contains(&(1010, HostEvent::Key { vk: 0x41, down: true })));
        assert!(v.contains(&(1130, HostEvent::Key { vk: 0x42, down: true })));
        assert!(v.contains(&(1250, HostEvent::Key { vk: 0x31, down: true })));
        assert!(parse_inject("1:text a!").is_err());
    }
}

```

`port/crates/s3-desktop/src/mp_hash.rs`:

```rs
//! `--mp-hash FILE [--mp-hash-every N]`: per-simulation-tick hash of the game state, written from a hook at the
//! start of each simulation tick on the logic thread ([`SIM_HOOK`], GOG exe only), i.e. after the previous tick
//! was fully processed. Two lockstep peers must write identical lines for the same tick number;
//! `tools/mp_hash_compare.py` diffs two files. See docs/porting/multiplayer.md ("Desync check").
//!
//! Hashed (layouts from docs/reverse-engineering/game-state-units.md): settler table, building table, piles,
//! trade, economy sectors, player records, and (every 64 steps) the map tile array.

use std::io::Write;
use std::path::Path;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU64, Ordering};
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};

use s3_runtime::Machine;

/// Logic message executor: `xor eax,eax; mov al,[esi]` before the class switch in `0x535990`.
pub const EXEC_HOOK: u32 = 0x0053_5a59;

/// Start of one simulation tick in the logic loop (`0x53e5a1: mov ecx,[ebp+0x3a0]` before the three game-data
/// tick calls `0x4e7810`, `0x4e05e0`, `0x4e9670` and the AI calls; ebp = logic). Only reached when the lockstep
/// layer lets the simulation run (`word [0x7ace62] == 0`).
pub const SIM_HOOK: u32 = 0x0053_e5a1;

fn fnv(h: &mut u64, bytes: &[u8]) {
    for b in bytes {
        *h ^= *b as u64;
        *h = h.wrapping_mul(0x100_0000_01b3);
    }
}

fn hash_region(m: &Machine, addr: u32, len: usize) -> u64 {
    let mut h = 0xcbf2_9ce4_8422_2325u64;
    // Chunked so huge regions do not allocate much.
    let mut off = 0usize;
    while off < len {
        let n = (len - off).min(1 << 16);
        fnv(&mut h, m.mem.slice(addr + off as u32, n));
        off += n;
    }
    h
}

/// One hash line for game data `gd`.
pub fn state_line(m: &Machine, gd: u32, world: bool) -> String {
    let r = |o: u32| m.mem.read_u32(gd + o);
    let nsettler = r(0x12a5e5c).min(200_000) as usize;
    let nbuild = r(0x1499e60).min(100_000) as usize;
    let npile = r(0x1238858).min(100_000) as usize;
    let ntrade = r(0x110a578).min(10_000) as usize;
    let necon = r(0xe115dc).min(1_000) as usize;
    let parts = [
        ("settlers", hash_region(m, gd + 0x12a5e60, (nsettler + 1) * 0x40)),
        ("buildings", hash_region(m, gd + 0x1499e64, (nbuild + 1) * 0x3a)),
        ("piles", hash_region(m, gd + 0x123885c, (npile + 1) * 0xe)),
        ("trade", hash_region(m, gd + 0x10f45e8, (ntrade + 1) * 0x5a)),
        ("econ", hash_region(m, gd + 0xe145e8, (necon + 1) * 0x2e0)),
        ("players", hash_region(m, gd + 0x11943e0, 8 * 0x148)),
    ];
    let mut s = format!("n={nsettler}/{nbuild}/{npile}");
    for (k, v) in parts {
        s.push_str(&format!(" {k}={:016x}", v));
    }
    if world {
        let size = r(0x2d2d0).min(768) as usize;
        let mut h = 0xcbf2_9ce4_8422_2325u64;
        // Per-peer tile bytes are masked (observed in two-instance runs; meanings HYPOTHESIS): +0x09/+0x0d differ
        // from the first tick in one region (local player's view / fog), +0x0b/+0x0c appear around the local
        // player's land while it is in build mode (placement markers). Simulation data stays identical.
        let mut buf = Vec::with_capacity(size * 0x18);
        for x in 0..size {
            buf.clear();
            buf.extend_from_slice(m.mem.slice(gd + 0x67444 + (x * 768 * 0x18) as u32, size * 0x18));
            for t in buf.chunks_mut(0x18) {
                t[0x09] = 0;
                t[0x0b] = 0;
                t[0x0c] = 0;
                t[0x0d] = 0;
            }
            fnv(&mut h, &buf);
        }
        s.push_str(&format!(" world={h:016x}"));
    }
    s
}

/// Install the hooks writing to `path`: one hash line every `every` simulation ticks, one `exec` line per
/// executed logic message.
pub fn install(m: &mut Machine, path: &Path, every: u32) {
    let f = match std::fs::File::create(path) {
        Ok(f) => Arc::new(Mutex::new(std::io::BufWriter::new(f))),
        Err(e) => {
            eprintln!("s3run: --mp-hash {}: {e}", path.display());
            return;
        }
    };
    let every = every.max(1) as u64;
    // Number of simulation ticks run so far (the game's frame counter gd+0x2d2d8 keeps running while the
    // lockstep layer pauses the simulation, so it differs between peers; this count does not).
    let ticks = Arc::new(AtomicU64::new(0));
    // Every message the logic executor dispatches (0x535a59: esi = message, ebx = logic), with the sim tick:
    // lockstep peers must execute the same messages at the same ticks.
    let (fx, tx) = (f.clone(), ticks.clone());
    s3_mods::add_hook(m, EXEC_HOOK, "mp-exec", move |c| {
        let msg = c.reg(s3_runtime::cpu::ESI);
        let logic = c.reg(s3_runtime::cpu::EBX);
        let gd = c.m.mem.read_u32(logic + 0x3a0);
        let frame = if gd != 0 { c.m.mem.read_u32(gd + 0x2d2d8) } else { 0 };
        let len = (c.m.mem.read_u8(msg + 2) as usize).clamp(4, 64);
        let hex: String = c.m.mem.slice(msg, len).iter().map(|b| format!("{b:02x}")).collect();
        let mut w = fx.lock().unwrap();
        let _ = writeln!(w, "exec at={} frame={frame} msg={hex}", tx.load(Ordering::Relaxed));
        s3_runtime::HookFlow::Continue
    });
    // S3_MP_DUMP_STEP=N[,M...]: also write the raw hashed tables before these sim ticks next to the hash file
    // (`<file>.<tick>.<table>.bin`, for diffing peers with tools/mp_dump_diff.py).
    let dump_steps: Vec<u64> = std::env::var("S3_MP_DUMP_STEP")
        .map(|v| v.split(',').filter_map(|x| x.trim().parse().ok()).collect())
        .unwrap_or_default();
    let dump_base = path.to_path_buf();
    let hdr = std::env::var_os("S3_MP_HDR").is_some();
    s3_mods::add_hook(m, SIM_HOOK, "mp-hash", move |c| {
        let logic = c.reg(s3_runtime::cpu::EBP);
        let gd = c.m.mem.read_u32(logic + 0x3a0);
        if gd == 0 {
            return s3_runtime::HookFlow::Continue;
        }
        let n = ticks.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
        if n % every == 0 {
            let frame = c.m.mem.read_u32(gd + 0x2d2d8);
            let local = c.m.mem.read_u32(gd + 0x2d2d4);
            let rng = c.m.mem.read_u32(gd + 0x2d2dc);
            let mut line = format!("step={n} rng={rng:08x} {}", state_line(c.m, gd, n % 64 == 0));
            if hdr {
                // Debug: game-data header dwords gd+0x2d240.. (to find counters).
                line.push_str(" hdr=");
                for i in 0..56u32 {
                    line.push_str(&format!("{:x},", c.m.mem.read_u32(gd + 0x2d240 + 4 * i)));
                }
            }
            let mut w = f.lock().unwrap();
            let _ = writeln!(w, "{line} frame={frame} local={local}");
            let _ = w.flush();
        }
        if dump_steps.contains(&n) {
            dump(c.m, gd, &dump_base.with_extension(format!("{n}")));
        }
        s3_runtime::HookFlow::Continue
    });
    s3_mods::hooks::commit(m);
}

/// Write each hashed table raw to `<hashfile>.<name>.bin`.
fn dump(m: &Machine, gd: u32, base: &Path) {
    let r = |o: u32| m.mem.read_u32(gd + o);
    let regions = [
        ("settlers", gd + 0x12a5e60, (r(0x12a5e5c).min(200_000) as usize + 1) * 0x40),
        ("buildings", gd + 0x1499e64, (r(0x1499e60).min(100_000) as usize + 1) * 0x3a),
        ("econ", gd + 0xe145e8, (r(0xe115dc).min(1_000) as usize + 1) * 0x2e0),
        ("players", gd + 0x11943e0, 8 * 0x148),
        ("world", gd + 0x67444, 768 * 768 * 0x18),
    ];
    for (name, a, len) in regions {
        let p = format!("{}.{name}.bin", base.display());
        let _ = std::fs::write(&p, m.mem.slice(a, len));
    }
}

/// Game debug log function (cdecl printf-like, `fmt` at [esp+4]); NET:/Desync messages go through it.
pub const GAME_LOG_FN: u32 = 0x0042_8720;

/// Minimal printf for the game's log lines (%d %i %u %x %X %s %c %%, flags/width ignored).
fn format_guest(m: &Machine, fmt: &str, mut arg: impl FnMut() -> u32) -> String {
    let mut out = String::new();
    let mut it = fmt.chars().peekable();
    while let Some(c) = it.next() {
        if c != '%' {
            out.push(c);
            continue;
        }
        let mut spec = None;
        while let Some(&n) = it.peek() {
            it.next();
            if n.is_ascii_alphabetic() || n == '%' {
                if n == 'l' || n == 'h' {
                    continue;
                }
                spec = Some(n);
                break;
            }
        }
        match spec {
            Some('%') => out.push('%'),
            Some('d') | Some('i') => out.push_str(&(arg() as i32).to_string()),
            Some('u') => out.push_str(&arg().to_string()),
            Some('x') => out.push_str(&format!("{:x}", arg())),
            Some('X') => out.push_str(&format!("{:X}", arg())),
            Some('c') => out.push((arg() as u8) as char),
            Some('s') => {
                let p = arg();
                if p != 0 {
                    out.extend(m.mem.read_cstr_bytes(p).into_iter().take(200).map(|b| b as char));
                }
            }
            Some(o) => {
                arg();
                out.push_str(&format!("<%{o}>"));
            }
            None => {}
        }
    }
    out
}

/// `S3_GAME_LOG=1`: print the game's own debug log lines (`[game] ...`) to stderr.
pub fn install_game_log(m: &mut Machine) {
    s3_mods::add_hook(m, GAME_LOG_FN, "game-log", move |c| {
        let esp = c.esp();
        let fmt_p = c.m.mem.read_u32(esp + 4);
        if fmt_p == 0 {
            return s3_runtime::HookFlow::Continue;
        }
        let fmt: String = c.m.mem.read_cstr_bytes(fmt_p).into_iter().take(300).map(|b| b as char).collect();
        let mut i = 2;
        let mem = &c.m.mem;
        let line = format_guest(c.m, &fmt, || {
            let v = mem.read_u32(esp + 4 * i);
            i += 1;
            v
        });
        eprintln!("[game] {}", line.trim_end());
        s3_runtime::HookFlow::Continue
    });
    s3_mods::hooks::commit(m);
}

/// `S3_MP_NETDBG=1`: log the in-game network receive filter (`0x46ae35`: slot active/left flags) and bundle
/// checksum failures (`0x46ae95`), deduplicated. Debug aid for the lockstep start (multiplayer.md).
pub fn install_net_debug(m: &mut Machine) {
    let last = Arc::new(Mutex::new(String::new()));
    let l2 = last.clone();
    s3_mods::add_hook(m, 0x0046_ae35, "mp-netdbg", move |c| {
        let (esi, slot) = (c.reg(s3_runtime::cpu::ESI), c.reg(s3_runtime::cpu::EBP));
        let act = c.m.mem.read_u8(esi + 0x23d + slot);
        let left = c.m.mem.read_u8(esi + 0x251 + slot);
        let s = format!("netdbg: recv slot {slot} active={act} left={left} session={esi:#x}");
        let mut l = l2.lock().unwrap();
        if *l != s {
            eprintln!("{s}");
            *l = s;
        }
        s3_runtime::HookFlow::Continue
    });
    s3_mods::add_hook(m, 0x0046_ae91, "mp-netdbg", move |c| {
        let esp = c.esp();
        let want = c.m.mem.read_u32(esp + 0x18);
        let got = c.reg(s3_runtime::cpu::EAX);
        if want != got {
            eprintln!("netdbg: bundle checksum mismatch {want:#x} != {got:#x}");
        }
        s3_runtime::HookFlow::Continue
    });
    s3_mods::hooks::commit(m);
}

`port/crates/s3-desktop/src/touch_inject.rs`:

```rs
//! Touch inject commands for `s3run --inject` (raw pointer events in screen = game pixels; s3-mods recognizes
//! gestures exactly like on Android). See docs/porting/touch.md. With a `w` prefix (`wtap`, `wpinch`, ...) the
//! coordinates are window pixels (`--window`), mapped to game pixels through the shown viewport when delivered.
//!
//! - `tap x y`, `dtap x y` (double tap), `tap2 x y` (two-finger tap), `tap3 x y` (three-finger tap)
//! - `drag x1 y1 x2 y2 [ms=300]` one finger; `drag2 x1 y1 x2 y2 [ms=300]` two fingers 60 px apart (pan)
//! - `fling x1 y1 x2 y2 [ms=120]` fast one-finger drag released while moving (camera inertia)
//! - `longpress x y [ms=800]`; `lpdrag x1 y1 x2 y2 [hold=700] [ms=400]` long press, then drag (box select)
//! - `pinch cx cy scale [ms=300]` (two fingers 80 px apart -> 80*scale)

use s3_runtime::{HostEvent, PointerPhase};

pub const COMMANDS: [&str; 10] = ["tap", "dtap", "tap2", "tap3", "drag", "drag2", "fling", "longpress", "lpdrag", "pinch"];

thread_local! {
    /// Coordinates of the command being parsed are window pixels (`w` prefix).
    static WINDOW: std::cell::Cell<bool> = const { std::cell::Cell::new(false) };
}

fn p(id: u32, phase: PointerPhase, x: f64, y: f64) -> HostEvent {
    let (x, y) = (x.round().max(0.0) as i32, y.round().max(0.0) as i32);
    if WINDOW.with(|w| w.get()) {
        // Game position filled in by the host when delivered (window -> game through the viewport).
        HostEvent::Pointer { id, phase, x: -1, y: -1, wx: x, wy: y }
    } else {
        HostEvent::Pointer { id, phase, x, y, wx: -1, wy: -1 }
    }
}

/// `cmd` with an optional `w` prefix (window coordinates): the plain command name and the flag.
pub fn split_window_prefix(cmd: &str) -> Option<(&str, bool)> {
    if COMMANDS.contains(&cmd) {
        return Some((cmd, false));
    }
    let c = cmd.strip_prefix('w')?;
    COMMANDS.iter().find(|&&k| k == c).map(|&k| (k, true))
}

/// [`touch_events`] for a command that may carry the `w` prefix.
pub fn touch_events_any(
    out: &mut Vec<(u64, HostEvent)>,
    t: u64,
    cmd: &str,
    num: &dyn Fn(usize) -> Result<f64, String>,
    opt: &dyn Fn(usize, f64) -> f64,
) -> Result<(), String> {
    let (c, win) = split_window_prefix(cmd).ok_or(format!("unknown touch command '{cmd}'"))?;
    WINDOW.with(|w| w.set(win));
    let r = touch_events(out, t, c, num, opt);
    WINDOW.with(|w| w.set(false));
    r
}

/// Moves of finger `id` from a to b over `ms` (every 16 ms), offset by `off`.
fn moves(out: &mut Vec<(u64, HostEvent)>, t: u64, ms: u64, a: (f64, f64), b: (f64, f64), ids: &[(u32, f64)]) {
    let steps = (ms / 16).max(1);
    for i in 1..=steps {
        let k = i as f64 / steps as f64;
        for &(id, off) in ids {
            out.push((t + i * ms / steps, p(id, PointerPhase::Move, a.0 + (b.0 - a.0) * k + off, a.1 + (b.1 - a.1) * k)));
        }
    }
}

/// Raw pointer events for one touch inject command.
pub fn touch_events(
    out: &mut Vec<(u64, HostEvent)>,
    t: u64,
    cmd: &str,
    num: &dyn Fn(usize) -> Result<f64, String>,
    opt: &dyn Fn(usize, f64) -> f64,
) -> Result<(), String> {
    use PointerPhase::{Down, Up};
    match cmd {
        "tap" | "tap2" | "tap3" => {
            let (x, y) = (num(1)?, num(2)?);
            out.push((t, p(1, Down, x, y)));
            let extra = match cmd {
                "tap2" => 1,
                "tap3" => 2,
                _ => 0,
            };
            for k in 0..extra {
                let dx = 40.0 * (k + 1) as f64;
                out.push((t + 10, p(2 + k, Down, x + dx, y)));
                out.push((t + 60, p(2 + k, Up, x + dx, y)));
            }
            out.push((t + 70, p(1, Up, x, y)));
        }
        "dtap" => {
            let (x, y) = (num(1)?, num(2)?);
            out.push((t, p(1, Down, x, y)));
            out.push((t + 60, p(1, Up, x, y)));
            out.push((t + 180, p(1, Down, x, y)));
            out.push((t + 240, p(1, Up, x, y)));
        }
        "longpress" => {
            let (x, y, ms) = (num(1)?, num(2)?, opt(3, 800.0) as u64);
            out.push((t, p(1, Down, x, y)));
            out.push((t + ms, p(1, Up, x, y)));
        }
        "drag" | "fling" => {
            let d = if cmd == "fling" { 120.0 } else { 300.0 };
            let (x1, y1, x2, y2, ms) = (num(1)?, num(2)?, num(3)?, num(4)?, opt(5, d).max(16.0) as u64);
            out.push((t, p(1, Down, x1, y1)));
            moves(out, t, ms, (x1, y1), (x2, y2), &[(1, 0.0)]);
            out.push((t + ms + 1, p(1, Up, x2, y2)));
        }
        "drag2" => {
            let (x1, y1, x2, y2, ms) = (num(1)?, num(2)?, num(3)?, num(4)?, opt(5, 300.0).max(16.0) as u64);
            out.push((t, p(1, Down, x1 - 30.0, y1)));
            out.push((t + 5, p(2, Down, x1 + 30.0, y1)));
            moves(out, t + 5, ms, (x1, y1), (x2, y2), &[(1, -30.0), (2, 30.0)]);
            out.push((t + ms + 10, p(1, Up, x2 - 30.0, y2)));
            out.push((t + ms + 12, p(2, Up, x2 + 30.0, y2)));
        }
        "lpdrag" => {
            let (x1, y1, x2, y2) = (num(1)?, num(2)?, num(3)?, num(4)?);
            let (hold, ms) = (opt(5, 700.0) as u64, opt(6, 400.0).max(16.0) as u64);
            out.push((t, p(1, Down, x1, y1)));
            moves(out, t + hold, ms, (x1, y1), (x2, y2), &[(1, 0.0)]);
            out.push((t + hold + ms + 1, p(1, Up, x2, y2)));
        }
        "pinch" => {
            let (cx, cy, scale, ms) = (num(1)?, num(2)?, num(3)?, opt(4, 300.0).max(16.0) as u64);
            let d0 = 40.0;
            out.push((t, p(1, Down, cx - d0, cy)));
            out.push((t, p(2, Down, cx + d0, cy)));
            let steps = (ms / 16).max(1);
            for i in 1..=steps {
                let d = d0 * (1.0 + (scale - 1.0) * i as f64 / steps as f64);
                let at = t + i * ms / steps;
                out.push((at, p(1, PointerPhase::Move, cx - d, cy)));
                out.push((at, p(2, PointerPhase::Move, cx + d, cy)));
            }
            out.push((t + ms + 1, p(1, Up, cx - d0 * scale, cy)));
            out.push((t + ms + 2, p(2, Up, cx + d0 * scale, cy)));
        }
        _ => return Err(format!("unknown touch command '{cmd}'")),
    }
    Ok(())
}
