`port/crates/s3-dx/src/dsound.rs`:

```rs
//! DirectSound HLE (`dsound.dll`, `DirectSoundCreate` via LoadLibrary/GetProcAddress).
//!
//! Secondary buffers keep their PCM in guest memory (the game Locks, copies and Unlocks). A host-side
//! service ([`mixer_service`], run once per scheduler slice) mixes all playing buffers plus the extra streams
//! from `s3_runtime::audio::AudioStreams` into 44.1 kHz stereo i16 and hands it to `Host::queue_audio`.
//! Pacing is wall-clock based: the mixer keeps ~[`LATENCY_MS`] ahead of real time, so play cursors advance in
//! real time even without an audio device (headless).

use std::collections::HashMap;

use s3_runtime::audio::AudioStreams;
use s3_runtime::com::Guid;
use s3_runtime::{LogLevel, Machine, Registry, ThunkResult};

use crate::hr::*;
use crate::mixer::{self, PcmFormat, OUT_RATE};
use crate::{declare_interface, put_u32, reg_method, ret};

pub const DLL: &str = "dsound.dll";

pub const IID_IDIRECTSOUND: Guid = Guid::parse("279AFA83-4981-11CE-A521-0020AF0BE560");
pub const IID_IDIRECTSOUNDBUFFER: Guid = Guid::parse("279AFA85-4981-11CE-A521-0020AF0BE560");
const IID_IUNKNOWN: Guid = Guid::parse("00000000-0000-0000-C000-000000000046");

pub const EXPORTS: &[&str] = &["DirectSoundCreate", "DirectSoundEnumerateA"];

pub const IDIRECTSOUND: &[&str] = &[
    "QueryInterface", "AddRef", "Release", "CreateSoundBuffer", "GetCaps", "DuplicateSoundBuffer",
    "SetCooperativeLevel", "Compact", "GetSpeakerConfig", "SetSpeakerConfig", "Initialize",
];

pub const IDIRECTSOUNDBUFFER: &[&str] = &[
    "QueryInterface", "AddRef", "Release", "GetCaps", "GetCurrentPosition", "GetFormat", "GetVolume", "GetPan",
    "GetFrequency", "GetStatus", "Initialize", "Lock", "Play", "SetCurrentPosition", "SetFormat", "SetVolume",
    "SetPan", "SetFrequency", "Stop", "Unlock", "Restore",
];

pub const DS_OK: u32 = 0;
pub const DSERR_INVALIDPARAM: u32 = E_INVALIDARG;
pub const DSERR_INVALIDCALL: u32 = 0x8878_0032;
pub const DSERR_PRIOLEVELNEEDED: u32 = 0x8878_0046;
pub const DSERR_BADFORMAT: u32 = 0x8878_0064;
pub const DSERR_ALREADYINITIALIZED: u32 = 0x8878_0082;

pub const DSBCAPS_PRIMARYBUFFER: u32 = 0x1;
pub const DSBLOCK_FROMWRITECURSOR: u32 = 0x1;
pub const DSBLOCK_ENTIREBUFFER: u32 = 0x2;
pub const DSBPLAY_LOOPING: u32 = 0x1;
pub const DSBSTATUS_PLAYING: u32 = 0x1;
pub const DSBSTATUS_LOOPING: u32 = 0x4;

/// How far ahead of real time the mixer produces audio.
pub const LATENCY_MS: u64 = 60;
/// Maximum audio produced in one service call (catch-up after a long slice is dropped).
const MAX_CHUNK_MS: u64 = 250;
/// Upper bound for audio waiting in the host device queue (see the drift guard in [`mixer_service`]).
pub const MAX_HOST_QUEUE_MS: u64 = 250;
/// Distance of the reported write cursor ahead of the play cursor.
const WRITE_AHEAD_MS: u32 = 15;

/// One sound buffer (keyed by its interface pointer).
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default)]
pub struct Buffer {
    pub primary: bool,
    pub flags: u32,
    /// Guest address and size of the PCM data (shared by duplicates).
    pub data: u32,
    pub size: u32,
    pub fmt: PcmFormat,
    /// Read position in source frames.
    pub pos: f64,
    pub playing: bool,
    pub looping: bool,
    /// Hundredths of dB (-10000..=0).
    pub volume: i32,
    pub pan: i32,
    /// 0 = original rate.
    pub freq: u32,
}

impl Buffer {
    fn rate(&self) -> u32 {
        if self.freq == 0 {
            self.fmt.rate
        } else {
            self.freq
        }
    }
}

/// DirectSound module state.
#[derive(Default)]
pub struct DsState {
    pub buffers: HashMap<u32, Buffer>,
    /// Number of buffers sharing each data block.
    data_refs: HashMap<u32, u32>,
    /// Master volume (primary buffer SetVolume).
    pub master_volume: i32,
    pub primary_fmt: PcmFormat,
    start_ms: Option<u64>,
    mixed_frames: u64,
    acc: Vec<i32>,
    out: Vec<i16>,
    /// Fractional positions of the extra streams.
    stream_pos: HashMap<u32, f64>,
    enum_strings: Option<(u32, u32)>,
    /// Total frames handed to the host (stats/tests).
    pub frames_out: u64,
    /// Frames not produced because the host queue was above MAX_HOST_QUEUE_MS (stats).
    pub drift_cut_frames: u64,
    /// Number of secondary-buffer Play calls (stats).
    pub voices_started: u64,
}

fn state(m: &mut Machine) -> s3_runtime::Shared<DsState> {
    m.state::<DsState>()
}

pub fn register(reg: &mut Registry) {
    reg.declare_all(DLL, EXPORTS);
    declare_interface(reg, DLL, "IDirectSound", IDIRECTSOUND);
    declare_interface(reg, DLL, "IDirectSoundBuffer", IDIRECTSOUNDBUFFER);
    reg.register(DLL, "DirectSoundCreate", direct_sound_create);
    reg.register(DLL, "DirectSoundEnumerateA", direct_sound_enumerate_a);

    let ds: &[(&str, s3_runtime::Handler)] = &[
        ("QueryInterface", ds_query_interface),
        ("AddRef", Machine::com_addref),
        ("Release", Machine::com_release),
        ("CreateSoundBuffer", ds_create_sound_buffer),
        ("GetCaps", ds_get_caps),
        ("DuplicateSoundBuffer", ds_duplicate_sound_buffer),
        ("SetCooperativeLevel", ok3),
        ("Compact", ok1),
        ("GetSpeakerConfig", ds_get_speaker_config),
        ("SetSpeakerConfig", ok2),
        ("Initialize", already2),
    ];
    for (n, h) in ds {
        reg_method(reg, DLL, "IDirectSound", n, *h);
    }
    let b: &[(&str, s3_runtime::Handler)] = &[
        ("QueryInterface", buf_query_interface),
        ("AddRef", Machine::com_addref),
        ("Release", buf_release),
        ("GetCaps", buf_get_caps),
        ("GetCurrentPosition", buf_get_current_position),
        ("GetFormat", buf_get_format),
        ("GetVolume", buf_get_volume),
        ("GetPan", buf_get_pan),
        ("GetFrequency", buf_get_frequency),
        ("GetStatus", buf_get_status),
        ("Initialize", already3),
        ("Lock", buf_lock),
        ("Play", buf_play),
        ("SetCurrentPosition", buf_set_current_position),
        ("SetFormat", buf_set_format),
        ("SetVolume", buf_set_volume),
        ("SetPan", buf_set_pan),
        ("SetFrequency", buf_set_frequency),
        ("Stop", buf_stop),
        ("Unlock", ok5),
        ("Restore", ok1),
    ];
    for (n, h) in b {
        reg_method(reg, DLL, "IDirectSoundBuffer", n, *h);
    }
}

crate::stubs! {
    ok1 = (1, DS_OK);
    ok2 = (2, DS_OK);
    ok3 = (3, DS_OK);
    ok5 = (5, DS_OK);
    already2 = (2, DSERR_ALREADYINITIALIZED);
    already3 = (3, DSERR_ALREADYINITIALIZED);
}

/// `DirectSoundCreate(lpGuid, lplpDS, pUnkOuter)`.
fn direct_sound_create(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let out = m.arg_u32(1);
    if out == 0 {
        return ret(DSERR_INVALIDPARAM, 3);
    }
    let vt = m.com_vtable(DLL, "IDirectSound", IDIRECTSOUND);
    let p = m.com_new_object(vt, 0x10);
    m.mem.write_u32(out, p);
    ret(DS_OK, 3)
}

/// `DirectSoundEnumerateA(cb, ctx)`: one device, "Primary Sound Driver" (GUID NULL).
fn direct_sound_enumerate_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (cb, ctx) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1));
    let st = state(m);
    let s = st.borrow_mut().enum_strings;
    let (d, n) = match s {
        Some(x) => x,
        None => {
            let d = m.mem.alloc(32);
            m.mem.write_cstr(d, "Primary Sound Driver");
            let n = m.mem.alloc(4);
            st.borrow_mut().enum_strings = Some((d, n));
            (d, n)
        }
    };
    if cb != 0 {
        m.call_guest(cb, &[0, d, n, ctx]);
    }
    ret(DS_OK, 2)
}

fn ds_query_interface(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (this, riid, out) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1), m.arg_u32(2));
    if out == 0 {
        return ret(E_POINTER, 3);
    }
    let iid = Guid::read(m, riid);
    if iid == IID_IDIRECTSOUND || iid == IID_IUNKNOWN {
        let n = m.mem.read_u32(this + 4) + 1;
        m.mem.write_u32(this + 4, n);
        m.mem.write_u32(out, this);
        ret(S_OK, 3)
    } else {
        m.mem.write_u32(out, 0);
        ret(E_NOINTERFACE, 3)
    }
}

/// DSCAPS (0x60 bytes).
fn ds_get_caps(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let p = m.arg_u32(1);
    if p == 0 {
        return ret(DSERR_INVALIDPARAM, 2);
    }
    m.mem.fill(p + 4, 0x5C, 0);
    // PRIMARYMONO|PRIMARYSTEREO|PRIMARY8BIT|PRIMARY16BIT|CONTINUOUSRATE|SECONDARYMONO|STEREO|8BIT|16BIT
    m.mem.write_u32(p + 4, 0x1 | 0x2 | 0x4 | 0x8 | 0x10 | 0x100 | 0x200 | 0x400 | 0x800);
    m.mem.write_u32(p + 8, 100);
    m.mem.write_u32(p + 0xC, 100_000);
    ret(DS_OK, 2)
}

fn ds_get_speaker_config(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let p = m.arg_u32(1);
    put_u32(m, p, 4); // DSSPEAKER_STEREO
    ret(DS_OK, 2)
}

fn new_buffer_object(m: &mut Machine, b: Buffer) -> u32 {
    let vt = m.com_vtable(DLL, "IDirectSoundBuffer", IDIRECTSOUNDBUFFER);
    let p = m.com_new_object(vt, 0x10);
    let st = state(m);
    let mut s = st.borrow_mut();
    if b.data != 0 {
        *s.data_refs.entry(b.data).or_insert(0) += 1;
    }
    s.buffers.insert(p, b);
    p
}

fn read_wfx(m: &Machine, p: u32) -> Option<PcmFormat> {
    let tag = m.mem.read_u16(p);
    let channels = m.mem.read_u16(p + 2);
    let rate = m.mem.read_u32(p + 4);
    let bits = m.mem.read_u16(p + 14);
    if tag != 1 || !(1..=2).contains(&channels) || !(bits == 8 || bits == 16) || !(100..=200_000).contains(&rate) {
        return None;
    }
    Some(PcmFormat { rate, channels, bits })
}

/// CreateSoundBuffer(this, lpDSBufferDesc, lplpDSBuffer, pUnkOuter).
fn ds_create_sound_buffer(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (d, out) = (m.arg_u32(1), m.arg_u32(2));
    if d == 0 || out == 0 {
        return ret(DSERR_INVALIDPARAM, 4);
    }
    let flags = m.mem.read_u32(d + 4);
    let bytes = m.mem.read_u32(d + 8);
    let pwfx = m.mem.read_u32(d + 0x10);
    let p = if flags & DSBCAPS_PRIMARYBUFFER != 0 {
        let fmt = state(m).borrow_mut().primary_fmt;
        new_buffer_object(m, Buffer { primary: true, flags, fmt, ..Default::default() })
    } else {
        if pwfx == 0 || !(4..=0x0FFF_FFFF).contains(&bytes) {
            return ret(DSERR_INVALIDPARAM, 4);
        }
        let Some(fmt) = read_wfx(m, pwfx) else {
            m.log(LogLevel::Warn, "dsound: CreateSoundBuffer with unsupported format");
            return ret(DSERR_BADFORMAT, 4);
        };
        let data = m.mem.alloc(bytes);
        new_buffer_object(m, Buffer { flags, data, size: bytes, fmt, ..Default::default() })
    };
    m.mem.write_u32(out, p);
    ret(DS_OK, 4)
}

/// DuplicateSoundBuffer(this, lpDsbOriginal, lplpDsbDuplicate): shares the PCM memory.
fn ds_duplicate_sound_buffer(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (orig, out) = (m.arg_u32(1), m.arg_u32(2));
    let b = state(m).borrow_mut().buffers.get(&orig).cloned();
    let Some(b) = b else { return ret(DSERR_INVALIDPARAM, 3) };
    if b.primary || out == 0 {
        return ret(DSERR_INVALIDCALL, 3);
    }
    let dup = Buffer { pos: 0.0, playing: false, looping: false, ..b };
    let p = new_buffer_object(m, dup);
    m.mem.write_u32(out, p);
    ret(DS_OK, 3)
}

fn buf_query_interface(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (this, riid, out) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1), m.arg_u32(2));
    if out == 0 {
        return ret(E_POINTER, 3);
    }
    let iid = Guid::read(m, riid);
    if iid == IID_IDIRECTSOUNDBUFFER || iid == IID_IUNKNOWN {
        let n = m.mem.read_u32(this + 4) + 1;
        m.mem.write_u32(this + 4, n);
        m.mem.write_u32(out, this);
        ret(S_OK, 3)
    } else {
        m.mem.write_u32(out, 0);
        ret(E_NOINTERFACE, 3)
    }
}

fn buf_release(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let this = m.arg_u32(0);
    let n = m.mem.read_u32(this + 4).saturating_sub(1);
    m.mem.write_u32(this + 4, n);
    if n == 0 {
        let st = state(m);
        let free_data = {
            let mut s = st.borrow_mut();
            match s.buffers.remove(&this) {
                Some(b) if b.data != 0 => {
                    let r = s.data_refs.entry(b.data).or_insert(1);
                    *r -= 1;
                    if *r == 0 {
                        s.data_refs.remove(&b.data);
                        Some(b.data)
                    } else {
                        None
                    }
                }
                _ => None,
            }
        };
        if let Some(d) = free_data {
            m.mem.free(d);
        }
        m.mem.free(this);
    }
    ret(n, 1)
}

fn with_buf<R>(m: &mut Machine, p: u32, f: impl FnOnce(&mut Buffer) -> R) -> Option<R> {
    let st = state(m);
    let mut s = st.borrow_mut();
    s.buffers.get_mut(&p).map(f)
}

/// DSBCAPS {dwSize, dwFlags, dwBufferBytes, dwUnlockTransferRate, dwPlayCpuOverhead}.
fn buf_get_caps(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (this, p) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1));
    let Some((flags, size)) = with_buf(m, this, |b| (b.flags, b.size)) else { return ret(DSERR_INVALIDPARAM, 2) };
    if p == 0 {
        return ret(DSERR_INVALIDPARAM, 2);
    }
    m.mem.write_u32(p + 4, flags | 0x8); // DSBCAPS_LOCSOFTWARE
    m.mem.write_u32(p + 8, size);
    m.mem.write_u32(p + 12, 0);
    m.mem.write_u32(p + 16, 0);
    ret(DS_OK, 2)
}

/// Play/write cursors in bytes.
fn cursors(b: &Buffer) -> (u32, u32) {
    if b.size == 0 {
        return (0, 0);
    }
    let ba = b.fmt.block_align().max(1);
    let play = (b.pos as u32 * ba) % b.size;
    let ahead = if b.playing { (b.rate() * WRITE_AHEAD_MS / 1000) * ba } else { 0 };
    (play, (play + ahead) % b.size)
}

fn buf_get_current_position(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (this, pp, pw) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1), m.arg_u32(2));
    let Some((play, write)) = with_buf(m, this, |b| cursors(b)) else { return ret(DSERR_INVALIDPARAM, 3) };
    put_u32(m, pp, play);
    put_u32(m, pw, write);
    ret(DS_OK, 3)
}

/// GetFormat(this, lpwfx, dwSizeAllocated, lpdwSizeWritten).
fn buf_get_format(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (this, p, size, pw) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1), m.arg_u32(2), m.arg_u32(3));
    let Some(f) = with_buf(m, this, |b| b.fmt) else { return ret(DSERR_INVALIDPARAM, 4) };
    if p == 0 {
        put_u32(m, pw, 18);
        return ret(DS_OK, 4);
    }
    let ba = f.block_align();
    let mut wfx = Vec::with_capacity(18);
    wfx.extend_from_slice(&1u16.to_le_bytes());
    wfx.extend_from_slice(&f.channels.to_le_bytes());
    wfx.extend_from_slice(&f.rate.to_le_bytes());
    wfx.extend_from_slice(&(f.rate * ba).to_le_bytes());
    wfx.extend_from_slice(&(ba as u16).to_le_bytes());
    wfx.extend_from_slice(&f.bits.to_le_bytes());
    wfx.extend_from_slice(&0u16.to_le_bytes());
    let n = (size as usize).min(18);
    m.mem.write_bytes(p, &wfx[..n]);
    put_u32(m, pw, n as u32);
    ret(DS_OK, 4)
}

fn buf_get_volume(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (this, p) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1));
    let st = state(m);
    let v = {
        let s = st.borrow_mut();
        s.buffers.get(&this).map(|b| if b.primary { s.master_volume } else { b.volume })
    };
    let Some(v) = v else { return ret(DSERR_INVALIDPARAM, 2) };
    put_u32(m, p, v as u32);
    ret(DS_OK, 2)
}

fn buf_get_pan(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (this, p) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1));
    let Some(v) = with_buf(m, this, |b| b.pan) else { return ret(DSERR_INVALIDPARAM, 2) };
    put_u32(m, p, v as u32);
    ret(DS_OK, 2)
}

fn buf_get_frequency(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (this, p) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1));
    let Some(v) = with_buf(m, this, |b| b.rate()) else { return ret(DSERR_INVALIDPARAM, 2) };
    put_u32(m, p, v);
    ret(DS_OK, 2)
}

fn buf_get_status(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (this, p) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1));
    let Some(v) = with_buf(m, this, |b| {
        (if b.playing { DSBSTATUS_PLAYING } else { 0 }) | (if b.playing && b.looping { DSBSTATUS_LOOPING } else { 0 })
    }) else {
        return ret(DSERR_INVALIDPARAM, 2);
    };
    put_u32(m, p, v);
    ret(DS_OK, 2)
}

/// Lock(this, dwOffset, dwBytes, ppvAudioPtr1, pdwAudioBytes1, ppvAudioPtr2, pdwAudioBytes2, dwFlags).
fn buf_lock(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let this = m.arg_u32(0);
    let (mut off, mut bytes) = (m.arg_u32(1), m.arg_u32(2));
    let (pp1, pl1, pp2, pl2, flags) = (m.arg_u32(3), m.arg_u32(4), m.arg_u32(5), m.arg_u32(6), m.arg_u32(7));
    let Some(b) = with_buf(m, this, |b| b.clone()) else { return ret(DSERR_INVALIDPARAM, 8) };
    if b.primary || b.size == 0 {
        return ret(DSERR_PRIOLEVELNEEDED, 8);
    }
    if flags & DSBLOCK_FROMWRITECURSOR != 0 {
        off = cursors(&b).1;
    }
    if flags & DSBLOCK_ENTIREBUFFER != 0 {
        bytes = b.size;
    }
    if off >= b.size || bytes == 0 || bytes > b.size {
        return ret(DSERR_INVALIDPARAM, 8);
    }
    let l1 = bytes.min(b.size - off);
    let l2 = bytes - l1;
    put_u32(m, pp1, b.data + off);
    put_u32(m, pl1, l1);
    put_u32(m, pp2, if l2 > 0 { b.data } else { 0 });
    put_u32(m, pl2, l2);
    ret(DS_OK, 8)
}

/// Play(this, dwReserved1, dwPriority, dwFlags).
fn buf_play(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (this, flags) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(3));
    let r = with_buf(m, this, |b| {
        if !b.primary {
            b.playing = true;
            b.looping = flags & DSBPLAY_LOOPING != 0;
        }
        (b.primary, b.volume, b.pan, b.rate(), b.size, b.fmt)
    });
    if let Some((false, vol, pan, rate, size, fmt)) = r {
        state(m).borrow_mut().voices_started += 1;
        m.log(LogLevel::Debug, &format!(
            "dsound: Play {this:#x} vol {vol} pan {pan} rate {rate} {}ch/{}bit {size} bytes flags {flags:#x}",
            fmt.channels, fmt.bits
        ));
    }
    ret(if r.is_some() { DS_OK } else { DSERR_INVALIDPARAM }, 4)
}

fn buf_stop(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let this = m.arg_u32(0);
    with_buf(m, this, |b| b.playing = false);
    ret(DS_OK, 1)
}

fn buf_set_current_position(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (this, pos) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1));
    with_buf(m, this, |b| {
        if b.size > 0 {
            b.pos = ((pos % b.size) / b.fmt.block_align().max(1)) as f64;
        }
    });
    ret(DS_OK, 2)
}

fn buf_set_format(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (this, p) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1));
    let Some(primary) = with_buf(m, this, |b| b.primary) else { return ret(DSERR_INVALIDPARAM, 2) };
    if !primary {
        return ret(DSERR_INVALIDCALL, 2);
    }
    let Some(f) = (p != 0).then(|| read_wfx(m, p)).flatten() else { return ret(DSERR_BADFORMAT, 2) };
    with_buf(m, this, |b| b.fmt = f);
    state(m).borrow_mut().primary_fmt = f;
    ret(DS_OK, 2)
}

fn buf_set_volume(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (this, v) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_i32(1));
    if !(-10000..=0).contains(&v) {
        return ret(DSERR_INVALIDPARAM, 2);
    }
    let st = state(m);
    let mut s = st.borrow_mut();
    let Some(b) = s.buffers.get_mut(&this) else { return ret(DSERR_INVALIDPARAM, 2) };
    if b.primary {
        s.master_volume = v;
    } else {
        b.volume = v;
    }
    ret(DS_OK, 2)
}

fn buf_set_pan(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (this, v) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_i32(1));
    if !(-10000..=10000).contains(&v) {
        return ret(DSERR_INVALIDPARAM, 2);
    }
    with_buf(m, this, |b| b.pan = v);
    ret(DS_OK, 2)
}

fn buf_set_frequency(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (this, v) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1));
    if v != 0 && !(100..=200_000).contains(&v) {
        return ret(DSERR_INVALIDPARAM, 2);
    }
    with_buf(m, this, |b| b.freq = v);
    ret(DS_OK, 2)
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- mixer

/// Scheduler service: mix everything that should have been played by now (+ latency) and queue it.
pub fn mixer_service(m: &mut Machine) {
    // Wall clock: audio plays in real time whatever the game speed.
    let now = m.real_ms();
    if m.input.paused {
        // Do not run ahead while the app is in the background; restart pacing on resume.
        state(m).borrow_mut().start_ms = None;
        return;
    }
    let st = state(m);
    let streams = m.state::<AudioStreams>();
    let mut s = st.borrow_mut();
    let start = *s.start_ms.get_or_insert(now);
    let target = (now.saturating_sub(start) + LATENCY_MS) * OUT_RATE as u64 / 1000;
    let max = MAX_CHUNK_MS * OUT_RATE as u64 / 1000;
    if target <= s.mixed_frames {
        return;
    }
    let mut n = target - s.mixed_frames;
    if n > max {
        n = max;
    }
    s.mixed_frames = target;
    // Device-clock drift guard: a host with a real device reports its queue. If the device consumes slower than
    // the wall clock (or stalled), the queue grows; produce less so it never exceeds MAX_HOST_QUEUE_MS (voices
    // are delayed, not skipped). Hosts without a device report 0 and are paced by the wall clock alone.
    let queued = m.host.audio_queued_frames() as u64;
    let max_q = MAX_HOST_QUEUE_MS * OUT_RATE as u64 / 1000;
    if queued + n > max_q {
        let cut = (queued + n - max_q).min(n);
        n -= cut;
        s.drift_cut_frames += cut;
        if n == 0 {
            return;
        }
    }
    let frames = n as usize;
    let mut acc = std::mem::take(&mut s.acc);
    acc.clear();
    acc.resize(frames * 2, 0);

    for b in s.buffers.values_mut() {
        if !b.playing || b.primary || b.size == 0 {
            continue;
        }
        let data = m.mem.slice(b.data, b.size as usize);
        let step = b.rate() as f64 / OUT_RATE as f64;
        let vol = mixer::db100_to_gain(b.volume);
        let (l, r) = mixer::pan_gains(b.pan);
        let fmt = b.fmt;
        if !mixer::mix_voice(data, &fmt, &mut b.pos, step, (l * vol, r * vol), b.looping, &mut acc) {
            b.playing = false;
        }
    }
    {
        let mut ex = streams.borrow_mut();
        let ids: Vec<u32> = ex.streams.keys().copied().collect();
        for id in ids {
            let stm = ex.streams.get_mut(&id).unwrap();
            if stm.samples.is_empty() {
                continue;
            }
            let gain = if stm.gain_set { stm.gain } else { 1.0 };
            let pos = s.stream_pos.entry(id).or_insert(0.0);
            mixer::mix_stream(&mut stm.samples, stm.rate.max(1), stm.channels, pos, gain, &mut acc);
        }
    }
    let master = mixer::db100_to_gain(s.master_volume);
    let mut out = std::mem::take(&mut s.out);
    mixer::finish(&acc, master, &mut out);
    s.acc = acc;
    s.frames_out += frames as u64;
    m.host.queue_audio(&out, OUT_RATE, 2);
    s.out = out;
}

//! DirectX HLE: DirectDraw (`ddraw.rs`), DirectSound (`dsound.rs`), DirectInput 3 (`dinput.rs`),
//! DirectPlay 6 + lobby stubs (`dplay.rs`). Pixel-level blit code is in `blit.rs`, the audio mixer in
//! `mixer.rs`. Documentation: docs/porting/directx-hle.md.
//!
//! COM objects use the runtime helpers (`Machine::com_vtable`, `Machine::com_new_object`): vtables are arrays
//! of thunks named `Interface::Method` in the implementing DLL, `this` is `m.arg_u32(0)`. Method lists are in
//! vtable order from the DirectX SDK headers (ddraw.h, dsound.h, dinput.h, dplay.h, dplobby.h). Host-side
//! object state lives in per-module `Machine::state` tables keyed by the guest object pointer.

pub mod blit;
pub mod ddraw;
pub mod dinput;
pub mod dplay;
pub mod dplay_net;
pub mod dsound;
pub mod mixer;

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests;

use s3_runtime::{Machine, Registry, ThunkResult};

/// Declare all DirectX exports and interface methods and register their handlers.
pub fn register_all(reg: &mut Registry) {
    ddraw::register(reg);
    dsound::register(reg);
    dinput::register(reg);
    dplay::register(reg);
}

/// Register COM class factories (CoCreateInstance) and the host-side services (audio mixer, DirectInput
/// event pump) in the machine.
pub fn register_factories(m: &mut Machine) {
    ddraw::register_factories(m);
    dplay::register_factories(m);
    m.add_service("dsound-mixer", dsound::mixer_service);
    m.add_service("dinput-pump", dinput::pump_service);
}

/// Declare every `Iface::Method` of an interface (so they show up in the registry before first use).
pub(crate) fn declare_interface(reg: &mut Registry, dll: &str, iface: &str, methods: &[&str]) {
    for m in methods {
        reg.declare(dll, &format!("{iface}::{m}"));
    }
}

/// Register `iface::name` in `dll`.
pub(crate) fn reg_method(reg: &mut Registry, dll: &str, iface: &str, name: &str, h: s3_runtime::Handler) {
    reg.register(dll, &format!("{iface}::{name}"), h);
}

/// IUnknown methods (first three slots of every interface).
pub const IUNKNOWN: [&str; 3] = ["QueryInterface", "AddRef", "Release"];

/// stdcall return helper.
#[inline]
pub(crate) fn ret(eax: u32, nargs: u32) -> ThunkResult {
    ThunkResult::stdcall(eax, nargs)
}

/// Write `v` to `*ptr` if ptr is not NULL.
#[inline]
pub(crate) fn put_u32(m: &mut Machine, ptr: u32, v: u32) {
    if ptr != 0 {
        m.mem.write_u32(ptr, v);
    }
}

/// Generate trivial stdcall handlers returning a constant: `stub!(name, nargs, result);`.
#[macro_export]
#[doc(hidden)]
macro_rules! stubs {
    ($($name:ident = ($nargs:expr, $res:expr);)*) => {
        $(
            fn $name(_m: &mut s3_runtime::Machine) -> s3_runtime::ThunkResult {
                s3_runtime::ThunkResult::stdcall($res, $nargs)
            }
        )*
    };
}

pub mod hr {

    pub const S_FALSE: u32 = 1;

}

`port/crates/s3-dx/src/mixer.rs`:

```rs
//! Software audio mixer core (pure functions, unit-tested): PCM voice resampling with volume/pan, DirectSound
//! dB conversions, i32 -> i16 clamping.

/// Output format of the mixer: 44100 Hz, stereo, i16.
pub const OUT_RATE: u32 = 44_100;

/// PCM format of a voice (WAVEFORMATEX subset).
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct PcmFormat {
    pub rate: u32,
    /// 1 or 2.
    pub channels: u16,
    /// 8 (unsigned) or 16 (signed LE).
    pub bits: u16,
}

impl Default for PcmFormat {
    fn default() -> Self {
        PcmFormat { rate: 22_050, channels: 2, bits: 16 }
    }
}

impl PcmFormat {
    /// Bytes per frame.
    pub fn block_align(&self) -> u32 {
        self.channels as u32 * self.bits as u32 / 8
    }
}

/// DirectSound volume (hundredths of dB, -10000..=0) to linear gain.
pub fn db100_to_gain(v: i32) -> f32 {
    if v <= -10000 {
        0.0
    } else {
        10f32.powf(v.min(0) as f32 / 2000.0)
    }
}

/// DirectSound pan (-10000 = left only .. 10000 = right only) to (left, right) gains.
pub fn pan_gains(pan: i32) -> (f32, f32) {
    let pan = pan.clamp(-10000, 10000);
    if pan > 0 {
        (db100_to_gain(-pan), 1.0)
    } else {
        (1.0, db100_to_gain(pan))
    }
}

#[inline]
fn sample(data: &[u8], fmt: &PcmFormat, frame: usize, ch: usize) -> f32 {
    let ch = ch.min(fmt.channels as usize - 1);
    if fmt.bits == 8 {
        let i = frame * fmt.channels as usize + ch;
        data.get(i).map_or(0.0, |&b| ((b as i32 - 128) << 8) as f32)
    } else {
        let i = (frame * fmt.channels as usize + ch) * 2;
        match data.get(i..i + 2) {
            Some(b) => i16::from_le_bytes([b[0], b[1]]) as f32,
            None => 0.0,
        }
    }
}

/// Mix one voice into `out` (interleaved stereo i32 accumulators, `out.len() / 2` frames).
/// `pos` is the read position in source frames (fractional), `step` = source frames per output frame.
/// Linear interpolation. Returns false when a non-looping voice reached its end (`pos` is then 0).
pub fn mix_voice(
    data: &[u8],
    fmt: &PcmFormat,
    pos: &mut f64,
    step: f64,
    gains: (f32, f32),
    looping: bool,
    out: &mut [i32],
) -> bool {
    let frames = data.len() / fmt.block_align().max(1) as usize;
    if frames == 0 {
        *pos = 0.0;
        return false;
    }
    let total = frames as f64;
    for o in out.chunks_exact_mut(2) {
        if *pos >= total {
            if looping {
                *pos %= total;
            } else {
                *pos = 0.0;
                return false;
            }
        }
        let i = *pos as usize;
        let frac = (*pos - i as f64) as f32;
        let j = if i + 1 < frames { i + 1 } else if looping { 0 } else { i };
        let l = sample(data, fmt, i, 0) * (1.0 - frac) + sample(data, fmt, j, 0) * frac;
        let r = if fmt.channels > 1 {
            sample(data, fmt, i, 1) * (1.0 - frac) + sample(data, fmt, j, 1) * frac
        } else {
            l
        };
        o[0] += (l * gains.0) as i32;
        o[1] += (r * gains.1) as i32;
        *pos += step;
    }
    if *pos >= total && !looping {
        *pos = 0.0;
        return false;
    }
    true
}

/// Mix interleaved i16 PCM from a queue (consumed from the front) into `out`, resampling linearly.
/// `pos` carries the fractional position between calls. Stops early when the queue runs dry.
pub fn mix_stream(
    q: &mut std::collections::VecDeque<i16>,
    rate: u32,
    channels: u16,
    pos: &mut f64,
    gain: f32,
    out: &mut [i32],
) {
    let ch = channels.max(1) as usize;
    let step = rate as f64 / OUT_RATE as f64;
    for o in out.chunks_exact_mut(2) {
        let avail = q.len() / ch;
        if avail < 2 {
            break;
        }
        let i = *pos as usize;
        if i + 1 >= avail {
            break;
        }
        let frac = (*pos - i as f64) as f32;
        let get = |f: usize, c: usize| q[f * ch + c.min(ch - 1)] as f32;
        let l = get(i, 0) * (1.0 - frac) + get(i + 1, 0) * frac;
        let r = get(i, 1) * (1.0 - frac) + get(i + 1, 1) * frac;
        o[0] += (l * gain) as i32;
        o[1] += (r * gain) as i32;
        *pos += step;
        let consumed = *pos as usize;
        if consumed > 0 {
            q.drain(..consumed * ch);
            *pos -= consumed as f64;
        }
    }
}

/// Clamp accumulators to i16 with a master gain.
pub fn finish(acc: &[i32], master: f32, out: &mut Vec<i16>) {
    out.clear();
    out.extend(acc.iter().map(|&v| ((v as f32 * master) as i32).clamp(-32768, 32767) as i16));
}

fn slot(list: &[&str], name: &str) -> usize {

#[test]
fn register_implements_every_method() {
    let mut reg = Registry::new();
    register_all(&mut reg);
    let ifaces: &[(&str, &str, &[&str])] = &[
        (ddraw::DLL, "IDirectDraw", ddraw::IDIRECTDRAW),
        (ddraw::DLL, "IDirectDraw2", ddraw::IDIRECTDRAW2),
        (ddraw::DLL, "IDirectDrawSurface", ddraw::IDIRECTDRAWSURFACE3),
        (ddraw::DLL, "IDirectDrawPalette", ddraw::IDIRECTDRAWPALETTE),
        (ddraw::DLL, "IDirectDrawClipper", ddraw::IDIRECTDRAWCLIPPER),
        (dsound::DLL, "IDirectSound", dsound::IDIRECTSOUND),
        (dsound::DLL, "IDirectSoundBuffer", dsound::IDIRECTSOUNDBUFFER),
        (dinput::DLL, "IDirectInputA", dinput::IDIRECTINPUTA),
        (dinput::DLL, "IDirectInputDeviceA", dinput::IDIRECTINPUTDEVICEA),
        (dplay::DLL, "IDirectPlay4A", dplay::IDIRECTPLAY4A),
        (dplay::DLL, "IDirectPlayLobby3A", dplay::IDIRECTPLAYLOBBY3A),
    ];
    for (dll, iface, methods) in ifaces {
        for m in *methods {
            let a = reg.lookup(dll, &format!("{iface}::{m}")).unwrap();
            assert!(reg.entry(a).unwrap().handler.is_some(), "{dll}!{iface}::{m} has no handler");
        }
    }
    for (dll, ex) in [(ddraw::DLL, ddraw::EXPORTS), (dsound::DLL, dsound::EXPORTS), (dinput::DLL, dinput::EXPORTS), (dplay::DLL, dplay::EXPORTS)] {
        for e in ex {
            let a = reg.lookup(dll, e).unwrap();
            assert!(reg.entry(a).unwrap().handler.is_some(), "{dll}!{e}");
        }
    }
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ blit

fn mem() -> s3_mem::GuestMemory {
    s3_mem::GuestMemory::new().unwrap()
}

const A: u32 = 0x1000_0000;
const B: u32 = 0x1010_0000;

fn s16(bits: u32, w: u32, h: u32) -> Surf {
    Surf { bits, width: w, height: h, pitch: w * 2, bpp: 16 }
}

fn px(m: &s3_mem::GuestMemory, s: &Surf, x: u32, y: u32) -> u16 {
    m.read_u16(s.bits + y * s.pitch + x * 2)
}

#[test]
fn fill_clips() {
    let mut m = mem();
    let s = s16(A, 8, 4);
    blit::fill(&mut m, &s, Rect::new(-2, 1, 3, 10), 0xF800);
    assert_eq!(px(&m, &s, 0, 0), 0);
    assert_eq!(px(&m, &s, 0, 1), 0xF800);
    assert_eq!(px(&m, &s, 2, 3), 0xF800);
    assert_eq!(px(&m, &s, 3, 1), 0);
}

#[test]
fn blt_copy_clip_and_key() {
    let mut m = mem();
    let src = s16(A, 4, 4);
    let dst = s16(B, 4, 4);
    for y in 0..4 {
        for x in 0..4 {
            m.write_u16(A + y * 8 + x * 2, (y * 4 + x) as u16);
        }
    }
    // Copy the full 4x4 to (2,2): only the top-left 2x2 of the source lands.
    blit::blt(&mut m, &dst, Rect::new(2, 2, 6, 6), &src, src.full(), &BltOpts::default());
    assert_eq!(px(&m, &dst, 2, 2), 0);
    assert_eq!(px(&m, &dst, 3, 3), 5);
    assert_eq!(px(&m, &dst, 1, 1), 0);
    // Source colour key: pixel value 5 is transparent.
    blit::fill(&mut m, &dst, dst.full(), 0xAAAA);
    let o = BltOpts { src_key: Some(ColorKey { low: 5, high: 5 }), ..Default::default() };
    blit::blt(&mut m, &dst, dst.full(), &src, src.full(), &o);
    assert_eq!(px(&m, &dst, 1, 1), 0xAAAA);
    assert_eq!(px(&m, &dst, 2, 1), 6);
}

#[test]
fn blt_stretch_mirror_overlap() {
    let mut m = mem();
    let src = s16(A, 2, 2);
    m.write_u16(A, 1);
    m.write_u16(A + 2, 2);
    m.write_u16(A + 4, 3);
    m.write_u16(A + 6, 4);
    let dst = s16(B, 4, 4);
    blit::blt(&mut m, &dst, dst.full(), &src, src.full(), &BltOpts::default());
    assert_eq!([px(&m, &dst, 0, 0), px(&m, &dst, 1, 1), px(&m, &dst, 2, 1), px(&m, &dst, 3, 3)], [1, 1, 2, 4]);
    let o = BltOpts { mirror_lr: true, ..Default::default() };
    blit::blt(&mut m, &dst, Rect::new(0, 0, 2, 2), &src, src.full(), &o);
    assert_eq!([px(&m, &dst, 0, 0), px(&m, &dst, 1, 0), px(&m, &dst, 0, 1)], [2, 1, 4]);
    // Overlapping scroll inside one surface (down by one row).
    let s = s16(A, 4, 4);
    for y in 0..4 {
        blit::fill(&mut m, &s, Rect::new(0, y, 4, y + 1), y as u32 + 10);
    }
    blit::blt(&mut m, &s, Rect::new(0, 1, 4, 4), &s, Rect::new(0, 0, 4, 3), &BltOpts::default());
    assert_eq!([px(&m, &s, 0, 0), px(&m, &s, 0, 1), px(&m, &s, 0, 2), px(&m, &s, 0, 3)], [10, 10, 11, 12]);
}

#[test]
fn framebuffer_conversion() {
    let mut m = mem();
    let s = Surf { bits: A, width: 2, height: 1, pitch: 4, bpp: 8 };
    m.write_u8(A, 1);
    m.write_u8(A + 1, 0);
    let pal = vec![0u32; 256].into_iter().enumerate().map(|(i, _)| if i == 1 { 0x0000_00FF } else { 0 }).collect::<Vec<_>>();
    let fb = blit::to_framebuffer(&m, &s, false, Some(&pal));
    assert_eq!(fb.pixels, vec![0xF800, 0]);
    let s = s16(A, 1, 1);
    m.write_u16(A, 0x7C00); // 555 red
    assert_eq!(blit::to_framebuffer(&m, &s, true, None).pixels, vec![0xF800]);
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ mixer

#[test]
fn mixer_gain_and_voice() {
    use crate::mixer::*;
    assert_eq!(db100_to_gain(0), 1.0);
    assert!((db100_to_gain(-2000) - 0.1).abs() < 1e-6);
    assert_eq!(db100_to_gain(-10000), 0.0);
    assert_eq!(pan_gains(0), (1.0, 1.0));
    let (l, r) = pan_gains(10000);
    assert_eq!((l, r), (0.0, 1.0));
    // Mono 16-bit, 4 frames of 1000, played at the output rate.
    let data: Vec<u8> = [1000i16; 4].iter().flat_map(|v| v.to_le_bytes()).collect();
    let fmt = PcmFormat { rate: OUT_RATE, channels: 1, bits: 16 };
    let mut pos = 0.0;
    let mut out = vec![0i32; 12];
    let more = mix_voice(&data, &fmt, &mut pos, 1.0, (1.0, 0.5), false, &mut out);
    assert!(!more, "non-looping voice ends");
    assert_eq!(&out[..8], &[1000, 500, 1000, 500, 1000, 500, 1000, 500]);
    assert_eq!(&out[8..], &[0, 0, 0, 0]);
    // Looping 8-bit voice keeps going.
    let fmt8 = PcmFormat { rate: OUT_RATE, channels: 1, bits: 8 };
    let mut pos = 0.0;
    let mut out = vec![0i32; 20];
    assert!(mix_voice(&[128 + 64, 128 - 64], &fmt8, &mut pos, 1.0, (1.0, 1.0), true, &mut out));
    assert_eq!(out[0], 64 << 8);
    assert_eq!(out[2], -(64 << 8));
    assert_eq!(out[4], 64 << 8);
    let mut v = Vec::new();
    finish(&[40000, -40000, 100], 1.0, &mut v);
    assert_eq!(v, vec![32767, -32768, 100]);
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ COM objects through the machine

const CODE: u32 = 0x0040_1000;

fn machine() -> Machine {
    let d = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("s3dx-test-{}-{:?}", std::process::id(), std::thread::current().id()));
    let _ = std::fs::create_dir_all(&d);
    let mut host = NullHost::new(d.join("game"), d.join("data"));
    host.quiet = true;
    let mut m = Machine::new(Box::new(host)).unwrap();
    m.mem.alloc_region(Some(layout::IMAGE_BASE), 0x10_0000, s3_mem::RegionKind::Image, (0, 0)).unwrap();
    m.setup_process(layout::IMAGE_BASE, 0x10_0000, CODE, 0x10_0000, "TEST.EXE");
    register_all(&mut m.registry);
    register_factories(&mut m);
    let slot = m.create_thread(CODE, 0, 0x10_0000, false).unwrap();
    m.cur = slot;
    m
}

/// Call method `name` of the COM object `this` through its vtable.
fn call(m: &mut Machine, this: u32, list: &[&str], name: &str, args: &[u32]) -> u32 {
    let vt = m.mem.read_u32(this);
    let f = m.mem.read_u32(vt + 4 * slot(list, name) as u32);
    let mut a = vec![this];
    a.extend_from_slice(args);
    let r = m.call_guest(f, &a);
    assert!(!m.is_stopped(), "machine stopped: {:?}", m.stop_reason());
    r
}

fn export(m: &mut Machine, dll: &str, name: &str, args: &[u32]) -> u32 {
    let f = m.registry.lookup(dll, name).unwrap();
    let r = m.call_guest(f, args);
    assert!(!m.is_stopped(), "machine stopped: {:?}", m.stop_reason());
    r
}

#[test]
fn ddraw_menu_flow_presents() {
    use ddraw::*;
    let mut m = machine();
    let (_, f) = m.com.factories[&CLSID_DIRECTDRAW];
    let dd = f(&mut m, IID_IDIRECTDRAW2).unwrap();
    let scratch = m.mem.alloc(0x200);
    assert_eq!(call(&mut m, dd, IDIRECTDRAW2, "Initialize", &[0]), 0);
    assert_eq!(call(&mut m, dd, IDIRECTDRAW2, "SetCooperativeLevel", &[0x1234, 0x13]), 0);
    assert_eq!(call(&mut m, dd, IDIRECTDRAW2, "SetDisplayMode", &[640, 480, 16, 0, 0]), 0);
    // GetDisplayMode
    m.mem.write_u32(scratch, DDSD_SIZE);
    assert_eq!(call(&mut m, dd, IDIRECTDRAW2, "GetDisplayMode", &[scratch]), 0);
    assert_eq!((m.mem.read_u32(scratch + 0xC), m.mem.read_u32(scratch + 8)), (640, 480));
    assert_eq!(m.mem.read_u32(scratch + 0x48 + 0x10), 0xF800);
    // Primary surface (caps only).
    let ddsd = m.mem.alloc(DDSD_SIZE);
    let out = m.mem.alloc(4);
    m.mem.write_u32(ddsd, DDSD_SIZE);
    m.mem.write_u32(ddsd + 4, DDSD_CAPS);
    m.mem.write_u32(ddsd + 0x68, DDSCAPS_PRIMARYSURFACE);
    assert_eq!(call(&mut m, dd, IDIRECTDRAW2, "CreateSurface", &[ddsd, out, 0]), 0);
    let prim = m.mem.read_u32(out);
    // QueryInterface to IDirectDrawSurface3 returns the same object.
    let iid = m.mem.alloc(16);
    IID_IDIRECTDRAWSURFACE3.write(&mut m, iid);
    assert_eq!(call(&mut m, prim, IDIRECTDRAWSURFACE3, "QueryInterface", &[iid, out]), 0);
    assert_eq!(m.mem.read_u32(out), prim);
    // Offscreen system-memory back buffer.
    m.mem.fill(ddsd, DDSD_SIZE as usize, 0);
    m.mem.write_u32(ddsd, DDSD_SIZE);
    m.mem.write_u32(ddsd + 4, DDSD_CAPS | DDSD_WIDTH | DDSD_HEIGHT);
    m.mem.write_u32(ddsd + 8, 480);
    m.mem.write_u32(ddsd + 0xC, 640);
    m.mem.write_u32(ddsd + 0x68, DDSCAPS_OFFSCREENPLAIN | DDSCAPS_SYSTEMMEMORY);
    assert_eq!(call(&mut m, dd, IDIRECTDRAW2, "CreateSurface", &[ddsd, out, 0]), 0);
    let back = m.mem.read_u32(out);
    // Lock, draw a pixel, unlock.
    m.mem.write_u32(ddsd, DDSD_SIZE);
    assert_eq!(call(&mut m, back, IDIRECTDRAWSURFACE3, "Lock", &[0, ddsd, 1, 0]), 0);
    let bits = m.mem.read_u32(ddsd + 0x24);
    let pitch = m.mem.read_u32(ddsd + 0x10);
    assert_eq!(pitch, 1280);
    assert_eq!(m.mem.read_u32(ddsd + 0x68) & DDSCAPS_SYSTEMMEMORY, DDSCAPS_SYSTEMMEMORY);
    m.mem.write_u16(bits + 10 * pitch + 20, 0x07E0);
    assert_eq!(call(&mut m, back, IDIRECTDRAWSURFACE3, "Unlock", &[0]), 0);
    let presents0 = m.stats.presents;
    // Blt back -> primary with the game's flags (WAIT|ROP|ASYNC, SRCCOPY).
    let rect = m.mem.alloc(16);
    m.mem.write_bytes(rect, &[0u32, 0, 640, 480].iter().flat_map(|v| v.to_le_bytes()).collect::<Vec<_>>());
    let fx = m.mem.alloc(0x64);
    m.mem.write_u32(fx, 0x64);
    m.mem.write_u32(fx + 8, 0xCC0020);
    assert_eq!(call(&mut m, prim, IDIRECTDRAWSURFACE3, "Blt", &[rect, back, rect, 0x1020200, fx]), 0);
    assert_eq!(m.stats.presents, presents0 + 1, "Blt to primary presents");
    let st = m.state::<DdState>();
    let s = st.borrow_mut();
    assert_eq!((s.fb.width, s.fb.height), (640, 480));
    assert_eq!(s.fb.pixels[10 * 640 + 10], 0x07E0);
    drop(s);
    // Colour fill on the primary.
    m.mem.write_u32(fx + 0x50, 0x001F);
    assert_eq!(call(&mut m, prim, IDIRECTDRAWSURFACE3, "Blt", &[0, 0, 0, DDBLT_COLORFILL | DDBLT_WAIT, fx]), 0);
    assert_eq!(st.borrow_mut().fb.pixels[0], 0x001F);
    // BltFast back -> primary.
    assert_eq!(call(&mut m, prim, IDIRECTDRAWSURFACE3, "BltFast", &[0, 0, back, rect, 0x10]), 0);
    assert_eq!(st.borrow_mut().fb.pixels[0], 0);
    // WaitForVerticalBlank is a frame limiter (60 fps default): three waits take >= ~2 periods, not more
    // than a few.
    let t0 = std::time::Instant::now();
    for _ in 0..3 {
        assert_eq!(call(&mut m, dd, IDIRECTDRAW2, "WaitForVerticalBlank", &[1, 0]), 0);
    }
    let ms = t0.elapsed().as_millis();
    assert!((30..=120).contains(&ms), "3 waits took {ms} ms");
    // Release frees the offscreen surface.
    assert_eq!(call(&mut m, back, IDIRECTDRAWSURFACE3, "Release", &[]), 0);
    assert!(!st.borrow_mut().surfaces.contains_key(&back));
}

#[test]
fn ddraw_flip_chain_and_enum() {
    use ddraw::*;
    let mut m = machine();
    let out = m.mem.alloc(4);
    assert_eq!(export(&mut m, DLL, "DirectDrawCreate", &[0, out, 0]), 0);
    let dd = m.mem.read_u32(out);
    // IDirectDraw v1 SetDisplayMode has 3 args.
    assert_eq!(call(&mut m, dd, IDIRECTDRAW, "SetDisplayMode", &[800, 600, 16]), 0);
    let ddsd = m.mem.alloc(DDSD_SIZE);
    m.mem.write_u32(ddsd, DDSD_SIZE);
    m.mem.write_u32(ddsd + 4, DDSD_CAPS | DDSD_BACKBUFFERCOUNT);
    m.mem.write_u32(ddsd + 0x14, 1);
    m.mem.write_u32(ddsd + 0x68, DDSCAPS_PRIMARYSURFACE | DDSCAPS_FLIP | DDSCAPS_COMPLEX);
    assert_eq!(call(&mut m, dd, IDIRECTDRAW, "CreateSurface", &[ddsd, out, 0]), 0);
    let front = m.mem.read_u32(out);
    let caps = m.mem.alloc(4);
    m.mem.write_u32(caps, DDSCAPS_BACKBUFFER);
    assert_eq!(call(&mut m, front, IDIRECTDRAWSURFACE3, "GetAttachedSurface", &[caps, out]), 0);
    let back = m.mem.read_u32(out);
    assert_ne!(back, front);
    m.mem.write_u32(ddsd, DDSD_SIZE);
    call(&mut m, back, IDIRECTDRAWSURFACE3, "Lock", &[0, ddsd, 1, 0]);
    let bits = m.mem.read_u32(ddsd + 0x24);
    m.mem.write_u16(bits, 0x1234);
    call(&mut m, back, IDIRECTDRAWSURFACE3, "Unlock", &[0]);
    let p0 = m.stats.presents;
    assert_eq!(call(&mut m, front, IDIRECTDRAWSURFACE3, "Flip", &[0, 1]), 0);
    assert_eq!(m.stats.presents, p0 + 1);
    let st = m.state::<DdState>();
    assert_eq!(st.borrow_mut().fb.pixels[0], 0x1234);
    // EnumDisplayModes: a guest callback that counts calls into a global and returns 1.
    let counter = m.mem.alloc(4);
    let cb = CODE + 0x100;
    // inc dword [counter]; mov eax,1; ret 8
    let mut code = vec![0xFF, 0x05];
    code.extend_from_slice(&counter.to_le_bytes());
    code.extend_from_slice(&[0xB8, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0xC2, 8, 0]);
    m.mem.write_bytes(cb, &code);
    assert_eq!(call(&mut m, dd, IDIRECTDRAW, "EnumDisplayModes", &[0, 0, 0, cb]), 0);
    assert_eq!(m.mem.read_u32(counter), (MODES.len() * MODE_BPPS.len()) as u32);
}

#[test]
fn dsound_buffer_plays_in_real_time() {
    use dsound::*;
    let mut m = machine();
    let out = m.mem.alloc(4);
    assert_eq!(export(&mut m, DLL, "DirectSoundCreate", &[0, out, 0]), 0);
    let ds = m.mem.read_u32(out);
    assert_eq!(call(&mut m, ds, IDIRECTSOUND, "SetCooperativeLevel", &[0x1234, 2]), 0);
    // Primary buffer (flags 0x81, no format).
    let desc = m.mem.alloc(0x14);
    m.mem.write_u32(desc, 0x14);
    m.mem.write_u32(desc + 4, 0x81);
    assert_eq!(call(&mut m, ds, IDIRECTSOUND, "CreateSoundBuffer", &[desc, out, 0]), 0);
    let primary = m.mem.read_u32(out);
    assert_eq!(call(&mut m, primary, IDIRECTSOUNDBUFFER, "SetVolume", &[0]), 0);
    // Secondary: mono 22050 16-bit, 1 s.
    let wfx = m.mem.alloc(18);
    m.mem.write_u16(wfx, 1);
    m.mem.write_u16(wfx + 2, 1);
    m.mem.write_u32(wfx + 4, 22050);
    m.mem.write_u32(wfx + 8, 44100);
    m.mem.write_u16(wfx + 12, 2);
    m.mem.write_u16(wfx + 14, 16);
    m.mem.write_u32(desc + 4, 0xE0);
    m.mem.write_u32(desc + 8, 44100);
    m.mem.write_u32(desc + 0x10, wfx);
    assert_eq!(call(&mut m, ds, IDIRECTSOUND, "CreateSoundBuffer", &[desc, out, 0]), 0);
    let buf = m.mem.read_u32(out);
    let ptrs = m.mem.alloc(16);
    assert_eq!(call(&mut m, buf, IDIRECTSOUNDBUFFER, "Lock", &[44000, 200, ptrs, ptrs + 4, ptrs + 8, ptrs + 12, 0]), 0);
    assert_eq!(m.mem.read_u32(ptrs + 4), 100);
    assert_eq!(m.mem.read_u32(ptrs + 12), 100, "lock wraps around");
    assert_eq!(call(&mut m, buf, IDIRECTSOUNDBUFFER, "Unlock", &[0, 0, 0, 0]), 0);
    assert_eq!(call(&mut m, ds, IDIRECTSOUND, "DuplicateSoundBuffer", &[buf, out]), 0);
    let dup = m.mem.read_u32(out);
    assert_ne!(dup, buf);
    assert_eq!(call(&mut m, buf, IDIRECTSOUNDBUFFER, "SetPan", &[(-500i32) as u32]), 0);
    assert_eq!(call(&mut m, buf, IDIRECTSOUNDBUFFER, "Play", &[0, 0, 0]), 0);
    call(&mut m, buf, IDIRECTSOUNDBUFFER, "GetStatus", &[out]);
    assert_eq!(m.mem.read_u32(out), DSBSTATUS_PLAYING);
    mixer_service(&mut m);
    std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(50));
    mixer_service(&mut m);
    call(&mut m, buf, IDIRECTSOUNDBUFFER, "GetCurrentPosition", &[out, 0]);
    let play = m.mem.read_u32(out);
    // >= 50 ms + latency at 22050 Hz * 2 bytes.
    assert!(play >= 2 * 22050 * 50 / 1000, "play cursor advanced: {play}");
    assert!(play < 44100);
    assert_eq!(call(&mut m, dup, IDIRECTSOUNDBUFFER, "Release", &[]), 0);
    assert_eq!(call(&mut m, buf, IDIRECTSOUNDBUFFER, "Stop", &[]), 0);
    call(&mut m, buf, IDIRECTSOUNDBUFFER, "GetStatus", &[out]);
    assert_eq!(m.mem.read_u32(out), 0);
}

#[test]
fn dinput_mouse_buffered_with_notification() {
    use dinput::*;
    let mut m = machine();
    let out = m.mem.alloc(4);
    assert_eq!(export(&mut m, DLL, "DirectInputCreateA", &[0x400000, 0x300, out, 0]), 0);
    let di = m.mem.read_u32(out);
    let g = m.mem.alloc(16);
    GUID_SYSMOUSE.write(&mut m, g);
    assert_eq!(call(&mut m, di, IDIRECTINPUTA, "CreateDevice", &[g, out, 0]), 0);
    let dev = m.mem.read_u32(out);
    let prop = m.mem.alloc(0x14);
    m.mem.write_bytes(prop, &[0x14u32, 0x10, 0, 0, 128].iter().flat_map(|v| v.to_le_bytes()).collect::<Vec<_>>());
    assert_eq!(call(&mut m, dev, IDIRECTINPUTDEVICEA, "SetProperty", &[DIPROP_BUFFERSIZE, prop]), 0);
    let ev = m.handles.insert(KernelObject::Event { manual_reset: false, signaled: false });
    assert_eq!(call(&mut m, dev, IDIRECTINPUTDEVICEA, "SetEventNotification", &[ev]), 0);
    let data = m.mem.alloc(16 * 8);
    m.mem.write_u32(out, 8);
    assert_eq!(call(&mut m, dev, IDIRECTINPUTDEVICEA, "GetDeviceData", &[16, data, out, 0]), DIERR_NOTACQUIRED);
    assert_eq!(call(&mut m, dev, IDIRECTINPUTDEVICEA, "Acquire", &[]), 0);
    m.input.push(HostEvent::MouseMove { x: 10, y: 5 });
    m.input.push(HostEvent::MouseButton { button: MouseButton::Left, down: true });
    pump_service(&mut m);
    assert_eq!(m.is_signaled(ev), Some(true));
    // Peek first (the game does), then read.
    m.mem.write_u32(out, 8);
    assert_eq!(call(&mut m, dev, IDIRECTINPUTDEVICEA, "GetDeviceData", &[16, data, out, DIGDD_PEEK]), 0);
    assert_eq!(m.mem.read_u32(out), 3);
    m.mem.write_u32(out, 2);
    assert_eq!(call(&mut m, dev, IDIRECTINPUTDEVICEA, "GetDeviceData", &[16, data, out, 0]), 0);
    assert_eq!(m.mem.read_u32(out), 2);
    assert_eq!((m.mem.read_u32(data), m.mem.read_u32(data + 4)), (DIMOFS_X, 10));
    assert_eq!((m.mem.read_u32(data + 16), m.mem.read_u32(data + 20)), (DIMOFS_Y, 5));
    m.mem.write_u32(out, 8);
    assert_eq!(call(&mut m, dev, IDIRECTINPUTDEVICEA, "GetDeviceData", &[16, data, out, 0]), 0);
    assert_eq!(m.mem.read_u32(out), 1);
    assert_eq!((m.mem.read_u32(data), m.mem.read_u32(data + 4)), (DIMOFS_BUTTON0, 0x80));
    // Immediate state.
    let stt = m.mem.alloc(16);
    assert_eq!(call(&mut m, dev, IDIRECTINPUTDEVICEA, "GetDeviceState", &[16, stt]), 0);
    assert_eq!(m.mem.read_u8(stt + 12), 0x80);
    assert_eq!(vk_to_dik(0x41), 0x1E);
    assert_eq!(vk_to_dik(0x1B), 0x01);
}

#[test]
fn dplay_factories_and_stubs() {
    use dplay::*;
    let mut m = machine();
    let (_, f) = m.com.factories[&CLSID_DIRECTPLAY];
    let dp = f(&mut m, IID_IDIRECTPLAY4A).unwrap();
    let (_, f) = m.com.factories[&CLSID_DIRECTPLAYLOBBY];
    let lobby = f(&mut m, IID_IDIRECTPLAYLOBBY2A).unwrap();
    let out = m.mem.alloc(4);
    // No callback / no connection blob: invalid parameters (the relay-backed calls are tested below).
    assert_eq!(call(&mut m, dp, IDIRECTPLAY4A, "EnumConnections", &[0, 0, 0, 0]), 0x8007_0057);
    assert_eq!(call(&mut m, dp, IDIRECTPLAY4A, "InitializeConnection", &[0, 0]), 0x8007_0057);
    // Not connected yet.
    assert_eq!(call(&mut m, dp, IDIRECTPLAY4A, "Receive", &[out, out, 1, 0, out]), s3_net::dplay::dperr::NOMESSAGES);
    assert_eq!(call(&mut m, lobby, IDIRECTPLAYLOBBY3A, "GetConnectionSettings", &[0, 0, out]), DPERR_NOTLOBBIED);
    assert_eq!(call(&mut m, dp, IDIRECTPLAY4A, "Release", &[]), 0);
    assert_eq!(call(&mut m, lobby, IDIRECTPLAYLOBBY3A, "Release", &[]), 0);
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ audio sink (audio-verify)

/// Host that records `queue_audio` and reports a settable device queue.
struct RecHost {
    inner: NullHost,
    audio: std::sync::Arc<std::sync::Mutex<Vec<i16>>>,
    queued: std::sync::Arc<std::sync::atomic::AtomicUsize>,
}

impl s3_runtime::Host for RecHost {
    fn present(&mut self, fb: &s3_runtime::FrameBuffer) {
        self.inner.present(fb)
    }
    fn poll_events(&mut self) -> Vec<HostEvent> {
        self.inner.poll_events()
    }
    fn queue_audio(&mut self, samples: &[i16], rate: u32, channels: u16) {
        assert_eq!((rate, channels), (mixer::OUT_RATE, 2));
        self.audio.lock().unwrap().extend_from_slice(samples);
    }
    fn audio_queued_frames(&self) -> usize {
        self.queued.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed)
    }
    fn now_ms(&self) -> u64 {
        self.inner.now_ms()
    }
    fn game_dir(&self) -> std::path::PathBuf {
        self.inner.game_dir()
    }
    fn data_dir(&self) -> std::path::PathBuf {
        self.inner.data_dir()
    }
}

type RecHandles = (std::sync::Arc<std::sync::Mutex<Vec<i16>>>, std::sync::Arc<std::sync::atomic::AtomicUsize>);

fn rec_machine() -> (Machine, RecHandles) {
    let d = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("s3dx-rec-{}-{:?}", std::process::id(), std::thread::current().id()));
    let _ = std::fs::create_dir_all(&d);
    let mut inner = NullHost::new(d.join("game"), d.join("data"));
    inner.quiet = true;
    let audio = std::sync::Arc::new(std::sync::Mutex::new(Vec::new()));
    let queued = std::sync::Arc::new(std::sync::atomic::AtomicUsize::new(0));
    let host = RecHost { inner, audio: audio.clone(), queued: queued.clone() };
    let m = Machine::new(Box::new(host)).unwrap();
    (m, (audio, queued))
}

#[test]
fn mixer_passes_stream_music_through_unchanged_and_gapless() {
    use s3_runtime::audio::{AudioStream, AudioStreams};
    let (mut m, (audio, _)) = rec_machine();
    // 1 s of a 44100 Hz stereo ramp (L = i, R = -i): exact passthrough at step 1.0 keeps every sample.
    let mut st = AudioStream { rate: 44_100, channels: 2, gain: 1.0, gain_set: true, ..Default::default() };
    for i in 0..44_100i32 {
        st.samples.push_back((i % 30000) as i16);
        st.samples.push_back(-((i % 30000) as i16));
    }
    m.state::<AudioStreams>().borrow_mut().streams.insert(7, st);
    for _ in 0..4 {
        dsound::mixer_service(&mut m);
        std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(20));
    }
    let a = audio.lock().unwrap().clone();
    assert!(a.len() / 2 >= 44_100 * 80 / 1000, "mixed {} frames", a.len() / 2);
    for (i, f) in a.chunks_exact(2).enumerate() {
        assert_eq!(f[0], (i % 30000) as i16, "frame {i}");
        assert_eq!(f[1], -f[0]);
    }
}

#[test]
fn mixer_resamples_22k_voice_smoothly_with_pan() {
    use crate::mixer::*;
    // 22050 Hz mono sine at 441 Hz upsampled x2: no sample may deviate from the ideal sine by more than the
    // linear-interpolation error bound (~0.06 % of full scale at this frequency ratio).
    let n = 2205;
    let data: Vec<u8> = (0..n)
        .flat_map(|i| ((10000.0 * (2.0 * std::f64::consts::PI * 441.0 * i as f64 / 22050.0).sin()) as i16).to_le_bytes())
        .collect();
    let fmt = PcmFormat { rate: 22_050, channels: 1, bits: 16 };
    let mut pos = 0.0;
    let mut out = vec![0i32; 2 * 4000];
    let (l, r) = pan_gains(-600); // right attenuated by 6 dB
    assert!(mix_voice(&data, &fmt, &mut pos, 22_050.0 / OUT_RATE as f64, (l, r), false, &mut out));
    for (k, f) in out.chunks_exact(2).enumerate() {
        let ideal = 10000.0 * (2.0 * std::f64::consts::PI * 441.0 * k as f64 / 44100.0).sin();
        assert!((f[0] as f64 - ideal).abs() < 25.0, "frame {k}: {} vs {ideal}", f[0]);
        assert!((f[1] as f64 - ideal * 0.501).abs() < 25.0, "frame {k}: R {}", f[1]);
    }
}

#[test]
fn mixer_drift_guard_caps_host_queue() {
    let (mut m, (audio, queued)) = rec_machine();
    dsound::mixer_service(&mut m);
    let first = audio.lock().unwrap().len() / 2;
    assert!(first >= (dsound::LATENCY_MS as usize - 1) * 441 / 10, "initial latency block: {first}");
    // Device reports a full queue: nothing more is produced.
    queued.store(dsound::MAX_HOST_QUEUE_MS as usize * 441 / 10, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed);
    std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(30));
    dsound::mixer_service(&mut m);
    assert_eq!(audio.lock().unwrap().len() / 2, first);
    // Queue drains: production resumes at wall-clock pace.
    queued.store(0, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed);
    std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(30));
    dsound::mixer_service(&mut m);
    assert!(audio.lock().unwrap().len() / 2 > first);
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ DirectPlay over a relay

struct TestRelay {
    rt: tokio::runtime::Runtime,
    handle: Option<s3_relay::RelayHandle>,
}

impl TestRelay {
    fn start() -> TestRelay {
        let rt = tokio::runtime::Builder::new_multi_thread().worker_threads(1).enable_all().build().unwrap();
        let handle = rt.block_on(s3_relay::start(s3_relay::RelayConfig::default())).unwrap();
        TestRelay { rt, handle: Some(handle) }
    }
}

impl Drop for TestRelay {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        if let Some(h) = self.handle.take() {
            h.shutdown();
        }
        let _ = &self.rt;
    }
}

/// A machine with one IDirectPlay4A object connected to `url` through EnumConnections + InitializeConnection.
fn dp_machine(url: &str) -> (Machine, u32) {
    use dplay::*;
    let mut m = machine();
    dplay_net::set_config(&mut m, dplay_net::NetConfig { relay_url: url.into(), lan: false, client_name: "test".into() });
    let (_, f) = m.com.factories[&CLSID_DIRECTPLAY];
    let dp = f(&mut m, IID_IDIRECTPLAY4A).unwrap();
    // EnumConnectionsCallback (stdcall, 6 args): store lpConnection (arg 2) at CODE+0x800, count at CODE+0x804.
    let cb = CODE + 0x100;
    let mut code = vec![0x8B, 0x44, 0x24, 0x08, 0xA3];
    code.extend_from_slice(&(CODE + 0x800).to_le_bytes());
    code.extend_from_slice(&[0xFF, 0x05]);
    code.extend_from_slice(&(CODE + 0x804).to_le_bytes());
    code.extend_from_slice(&[0xB8, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0xC2, 0x18, 0x00]);
    m.mem.write_bytes(cb, &code);
    assert_eq!(call(&mut m, dp, IDIRECTPLAY4A, "EnumConnections", &[0, cb, 0, 1]), 0);
    assert_eq!(m.mem.read_u32(CODE + 0x804), 1, "one connection");
    let conn = m.mem.read_u32(CODE + 0x800);
    assert_eq!(call(&mut m, dp, IDIRECTPLAY4A, "InitializeConnection", &[conn, 0]), 0);
    (m, dp)
}

/// Pump until `GetMessageCount` reports a message (relay events arrive on a background thread).
fn wait_msg(m: &mut Machine, dp: u32, cnt: u32) -> bool {
    for _ in 0..200 {
        call(m, dp, dplay::IDIRECTPLAY4A, "GetMessageCount", &[0, cnt]);
        if m.mem.read_u32(cnt) > 0 {
            return true;
        }
        std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(10));
    }
    false
}

#[test]
fn dplay_two_machines_through_relay() {
    use dplay::*;
    use s3_net::dplay::{dpsys, DPOPEN_CREATE, DPOPEN_JOIN};
    let relay = TestRelay::start();
    let url = relay.handle.as_ref().unwrap().url();
    let (mut a, dpa) = dp_machine(&url);
    let (mut b, dpb) = dp_machine(&url);

    // Host: DPSESSIONDESC2 like S3 builds it (0x46ff80), then Open(CREATE).
    let sd = a.mem.alloc(0x50);
    a.mem.write_u32(sd, 0x50);
    a.mem.write_u32(sd + 4, 0x44);
    a.mem.write_bytes(sd + 0x18, &s3_net::S3_APP_GUID);
    a.mem.write_u32(sd + 0x28, 2);
    let name = a.mem.alloc(16);
    a.mem.write_cstr(name, "Test game");
    a.mem.write_u32(sd + 0x30, name);
    a.mem.write_u32(sd + 0x48, 0xa0);
    assert_eq!(call(&mut a, dpa, IDIRECTPLAY4A, "Open", &[sd, DPOPEN_CREATE]), 0);
    // CreatePlayer with a Win32 event that must be signalled when messages arrive.
    let ev_a = a.handles.insert(KernelObject::Event { manual_reset: false, signaled: false });
    let (pid, pname) = (a.mem.alloc(4), a.mem.alloc(16));
    let short = a.mem.alloc(8);
    a.mem.write_cstr(short, "Host");
    a.mem.write_u32(pname, 16);
    a.mem.write_u32(pname + 8, short);
    assert_eq!(call(&mut a, dpa, IDIRECTPLAY4A, "CreatePlayer", &[pid, pname, ev_a, 0, 0, 0]), 0);
    let host_id = a.mem.read_u32(pid);
    assert!(host_id > 1);

    // Joiner: EnumSessions (sync, guest callback stores the desc's instance GUID), Open(JOIN), CreatePlayer.
    let cb = CODE + 0x200;
    // EnumSessionsCallback2(lpThisSD, lpdwTimeOut, dwFlags, lpContext): if lpThisSD: copy 16 bytes from +8 to
    // CODE+0x900; return 0 (stop).
    let mut code = vec![0x8B, 0x74, 0x24, 0x04, 0x85, 0xF6, 0x74, 0x0F, 0x83, 0xC6, 0x08, 0xBF];
    code.extend_from_slice(&(CODE + 0x900).to_le_bytes());
    code.extend_from_slice(&[0xB9, 4, 0, 0, 0, 0xF3, 0xA5, 0x31, 0xC0, 0xC2, 0x10, 0x00]);
    b.mem.write_bytes(cb, &code);
    let sdb = b.mem.alloc(0x50);
    b.mem.write_u32(sdb, 0x50);
    b.mem.write_bytes(sdb + 0x18, &s3_net::S3_APP_GUID);
    assert_eq!(call(&mut b, dpb, IDIRECTPLAY4A, "EnumSessions", &[sdb, 0, cb, 0, 0]), 0);
    let inst = b.mem.read_bytes(CODE + 0x900, 16);
    assert_ne!(inst, vec![0u8; 16], "session found");
    b.mem.write_bytes(sdb + 8, &inst);
    assert_eq!(call(&mut b, dpb, IDIRECTPLAY4A, "Open", &[sdb, DPOPEN_JOIN]), 0);
    let (pidb, pnameb) = (b.mem.alloc(4), b.mem.alloc(16));
    b.mem.write_u32(pnameb, 16);
    assert_eq!(call(&mut b, dpb, IDIRECTPLAY4A, "CreatePlayer", &[pidb, pnameb, 0, 0, 0, 0]), 0);
    let join_id = b.mem.read_u32(pidb);

    // Host sees DPSYS_CREATEPLAYERORGROUP from DPID_SYSMSG, and its event is signalled by the pump service.
    let cnt = a.mem.alloc(4);
    assert!(wait_msg(&mut a, dpa, cnt), "host got no system message");
    dplay_net::pump_service(&mut a);
    let (from, to, buf, size) = (a.mem.alloc(4), a.mem.alloc(4), a.mem.alloc(0x400), a.mem.alloc(4));
    a.mem.write_u32(size, 4);
    assert_eq!(call(&mut a, dpa, IDIRECTPLAY4A, "Receive", &[from, to, 1, buf, size]), s3_net::dplay::dperr::BUFFERTOOSMALL);
    assert!(a.mem.read_u32(size) >= 48);
    a.mem.write_u32(size, 0x400);
    assert_eq!(call(&mut a, dpa, IDIRECTPLAY4A, "Receive", &[from, to, 1, buf, size]), 0);
    assert_eq!(a.mem.read_u32(from), 0);
    assert_eq!(a.mem.read_u32(buf), dpsys::CREATEPLAYERORGROUP);
    assert_eq!(a.mem.read_u32(buf + 8), join_id);

    // Data both ways, in order.
    let data = b.mem.alloc(16);
    for i in 0..3u32 {
        b.mem.write_u32(data, 0x1000 + i);
        assert_eq!(call(&mut b, dpb, IDIRECTPLAY4A, "Send", &[join_id, host_id, 0, data, 4]), 0);
    }
    for i in 0..3u32 {
        assert!(wait_msg(&mut a, dpa, cnt));
        a.mem.write_u32(size, 0x400);
        assert_eq!(call(&mut a, dpa, IDIRECTPLAY4A, "Receive", &[from, to, 1, buf, size]), 0);
        assert_eq!((a.mem.read_u32(from), a.mem.read_u32(to), a.mem.read_u32(size)), (join_id, host_id, 4));
        assert_eq!(a.mem.read_u32(buf), 0x1000 + i);
    }
    let dataa = a.mem.alloc(8);
    a.mem.write_bytes(dataa, b"bundle!!");
    assert_eq!(call(&mut a, dpa, IDIRECTPLAY4A, "Send", &[host_id, 0, 0, dataa, 8]), 0);
    let (fb, tb, bufb, sizeb, cntb) = (b.mem.alloc(4), b.mem.alloc(4), b.mem.alloc(64), b.mem.alloc(4), b.mem.alloc(4));
    // The joiner first sees the host's player in EnumPlayers (already there on join) and then the data.
    assert!(wait_msg(&mut b, dpb, cntb));
    b.mem.write_u32(sizeb, 64);
    assert_eq!(call(&mut b, dpb, IDIRECTPLAY4A, "Receive", &[fb, tb, 1, bufb, sizeb]), 0);
    assert_eq!(b.mem.read_bytes(bufb, 8), b"bundle!!");
    assert_eq!(b.mem.read_u32(fb), host_id);
    // Event of the host was set when the joiner's player arrived.
    assert!(matches!(a.handles.get_mut(ev_a), Some(KernelObject::Event { signaled: true, .. })));
    // GetSessionDesc on the joiner returns the host's name and dwUser3.
    let sz = b.mem.alloc(4);
    b.mem.write_u32(sz, 0x100);
    let d = b.mem.alloc(0x100);
    assert_eq!(call(&mut b, dpb, IDIRECTPLAY4A, "GetSessionDesc", &[d, sz]), 0);
    assert_eq!(b.mem.read_cstr(b.mem.read_u32(d + 0x30)), "Test game");
    assert_eq!(b.mem.read_u32(d + 0x48), 0xa0);
    assert_eq!(call(&mut b, dpb, IDIRECTPLAY4A, "Close", &[]), 0);
    // Host gets DESTROYPLAYER.
    assert!(wait_msg(&mut a, dpa, cnt));
    a.mem.write_u32(size, 0x400);
    assert_eq!(call(&mut a, dpa, IDIRECTPLAY4A, "Receive", &[from, to, 1, buf, size]), 0);
    assert_eq!(a.mem.read_u32(buf), dpsys::DESTROYPLAYERORGROUP);
}

/// res-zoom port extension: `SetDisplayMode(.., DDSDM_PORT_LOGICAL)` crops the presented primary surface without
/// re-creating surfaces; a real mode change clears it (docs/porting/resolution-zoom.md).
#[test]
fn ddraw_logical_size_crops_present() {
    use ddraw::*;
    let mut m = machine();
    let (_, f) = m.com.factories[&CLSID_DIRECTDRAW];
    let dd = f(&mut m, IID_IDIRECTDRAW2).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(call(&mut m, dd, IDIRECTDRAW2, "SetCooperativeLevel", &[0x1234, 0x13]), 0);
    // Custom sizes are accepted.
    assert_eq!(call(&mut m, dd, IDIRECTDRAW2, "SetDisplayMode", &[1920, 780, 16, 0, 0]), 0);
    let ddsd = m.mem.alloc(DDSD_SIZE);
    let out = m.mem.alloc(4);
    m.mem.write_u32(ddsd, DDSD_SIZE);
    m.mem.write_u32(ddsd + 4, DDSD_CAPS);
    m.mem.write_u32(ddsd + 0x68, DDSCAPS_PRIMARYSURFACE);
    assert_eq!(call(&mut m, dd, IDIRECTDRAW2, "CreateSurface", &[ddsd, out, 0]), 0);
    let prim = m.mem.read_u32(out);
    let fx = m.mem.alloc(0x64);
    m.mem.write_u32(fx, 0x64);
    m.mem.write_u32(fx + 0x50, 0x001F);
    assert_eq!(call(&mut m, prim, IDIRECTDRAWSURFACE3, "Blt", &[0, 0, 0, DDBLT_COLORFILL | DDBLT_WAIT, fx]), 0);
    let st = m.state::<DdState>();
    let size = |st: &s3_runtime::Shared<DdState>| {
        let s = st.borrow_mut();
        (s.fb.width, s.fb.height)
    };
    assert_eq!(size(&st), (1920, 780));
    // Logical 1480x600: presents are cropped, the mode stays.
    assert_eq!(call(&mut m, dd, IDIRECTDRAW2, "SetDisplayMode", &[1480, 600, 16, 0, DDSDM_PORT_LOGICAL]), 0);
    assert_eq!(call(&mut m, prim, IDIRECTDRAWSURFACE3, "Blt", &[0, 0, 0, DDBLT_COLORFILL | DDBLT_WAIT, fx]), 0);
    assert_eq!(size(&st), (1480, 600));
    assert_eq!(st.borrow_mut().mode, Some((1920, 780, 16)));
    // Bigger than the mode: rejected.
    assert_ne!(call(&mut m, dd, IDIRECTDRAW2, "SetDisplayMode", &[2000, 600, 16, 0, DDSDM_PORT_LOGICAL]), 0);
    // A real mode change clears the logical size.
    assert_eq!(call(&mut m, dd, IDIRECTDRAW2, "SetDisplayMode", &[800, 600, 16, 0, 0]), 0);
    assert_eq!(st.borrow_mut().logical, None);
}

`port/crates/s3-engine/src/lib.rs`:

```rs
//! Engine: one call to get a running S3.EXE.
//!
//! ```no_run
//! # use s3_engine::Engine;
//! # use s3_runtime::NullHost;
//! let host = NullHost::new("/path/to/game".into(), "/path/to/data".into());
//! let mut e = Engine::new(Box::new(host), None).unwrap();
//! while e.run_for_ms(16) != s3_runtime::SliceResult::Stopped {}
//! println!("{}", e.summary());
//! ```

use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use std::time::Instant;

use s3_pe::LoadedImage;
use s3_runtime::{Host, LogLevel, Machine, SliceResult, Vfs};

/// Instructions per `run_slice` call made by [`Engine::run_for_ms`].
pub const SLICE_INSTRUCTIONS: u64 = 1_000_000;

pub struct Engine {
    pub machine: Machine,
    pub image: LoadedImage,
    pub exe_path: PathBuf,
}

/// Find `S3.EXE` in the game dir (case-insensitive).
pub fn find_exe(game_dir: &Path) -> Option<PathBuf> {
    Vfs::lookup_ci(game_dir, &["S3.EXE".to_string()])
}

impl Engine {
    /// Build the machine, register all HLE modules, load the exe (default: `<game_dir>/S3.EXE`) and create
    /// the main thread at the entry point.
    pub fn new(host: Box<dyn Host>, exe_path: Option<&Path>) -> Result<Engine, String> {
        let exe_path = match exe_path {
            Some(p) => p.to_path_buf(),
            None => find_exe(&host.game_dir())
                .ok_or_else(|| format!("S3.EXE not found in {}", host.game_dir().display()))?,
        };
        let bytes = std::fs::read(&exe_path).map_err(|e| format!("read {}: {e}", exe_path.display()))?;
        let mut m = Machine::new(host)?;
        s3_win32::register_all(&mut m.registry);
        s3_dx::register_all(&mut m.registry);
        s3_dx::register_factories(&mut m);
        let image = s3_pe::load(&mut m, &bytes, "S3.EXE").map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        let auto: Vec<String> = image.auto_stubbed(&m).map(|i| format!("{}!{}", i.dll, i.name)).collect();
        if !auto.is_empty() {
            m.log(LogLevel::Warn, &format!("{} imports not declared by any HLE module: {}", auto.len(), auto.join(", ")));
        }
        let stack = m.process.stack_reserve;
        m.create_thread(image.entry, 0, stack, false)?;
        // Mod framework (hooks/patches keyed by the exe sha256, touch gestures, overlay); see docs/porting/mods.md.
        let mods = s3_mods::install(&mut m, &bytes);
        m.log(
            LogLevel::Info,
            &format!("mods: sha256 {} patch set {:?}, {} hook addresses", mods.exe_sha256, mods.patch_set, mods.hooks),
        );
        m.log(
            LogLevel::Info,
            &format!("loaded {} entry={:#x} imports={}", exe_path.display(), image.entry, image.imports.len()),
        );
        Ok(Engine { machine: m, image, exe_path })
    }

    /// Run up to `max_instructions` guest instructions.
    pub fn run_slice(&mut self, max_instructions: u64) -> SliceResult {
        self.machine.run_slice(max_instructions)
    }

    /// Run for about `ms` wall-clock milliseconds (sleeping when all threads are idle). Returns the last slice
    /// result (`Stopped` as soon as the machine stops).
    pub fn run_for_ms(&mut self, ms: u64) -> SliceResult {
        let start = Instant::now();
        let mut last = SliceResult::Idle;
        while start.elapsed().as_millis() < ms as u128 {
            last = self.machine.run_slice(SLICE_INSTRUCTIONS);
            match last {
                SliceResult::Stopped => return last,
                SliceResult::Idle => self.machine.idle(1),
                SliceResult::Ran(_) => {}
            }
        }
        last
    }

    /// Human-readable run summary: instructions, top thunk calls, presents, stop reason.
    pub fn summary(&self) -> String {
        let m = &self.machine;
        let mut s = String::new();
        s.push_str(&format!("instructions executed: {}\n", m.stats.instructions));
        s.push_str(&format!("thunk calls: {}\n", m.stats.thunk_calls));
        s.push_str(&format!("presents: {}\n", m.stats.presents));
        s.push_str(&format!("guest exceptions: {}\n", m.stats.exceptions));
        s.push_str(&format!("mod hooks dispatched: {}\n", m.stats.hooks));
        s.push_str(&format!("threads: {}\n", m.threads.len()));
        for (i, t) in m.threads.iter().enumerate() {
            if t.cpu_ns > 0 {
                s.push_str(&format!(
                    "  t{i}: {} M instr in {} ms Cpu::run ({} M/s)\n",
                    t.cpu.instructions / 1_000_000,
                    t.cpu_ns / 1_000_000,
                    t.cpu.instructions * 1000 / t.cpu_ns.max(1)
                ));
            }
        }
        let mut calls: Vec<_> = m.registry.entries().iter().filter(|e| e.calls > 0).collect();
        calls.sort_by(|a, b| b.calls.cmp(&a.calls));
        s.push_str(&format!("distinct HLE functions called: {}\n", calls.len()));
        for e in calls.iter().take(40) {
            s.push_str(&format!("  {:>10}  {}!{}\n", e.calls, e.dll, e.name));
        }
        s.push_str(&m.host_prof_report(30));
        s.push_str(&m.mt_report());
        if let Some(t) = m.threads.get(m.cur) {
            s.push_str(&format!("current thread {} eip={:#x} esp={:#x}\n", m.cur, t.cpu.eip, t.cpu.regs[4]));
        }
        match m.stop_reason() {
            Some(r) => s.push_str(&format!("stop: {r}\n")),
            None => s.push_str("stop: (still running)\n"),
        }
        s
    }
}

```rs
//! Anime4K CNN x2 upscaler shaders (generated by tools/anime4k_to_gles.py from
//! Anime4K_Upscale_CNN_x2_S.glsl, https://github.com/bloc97/Anime4K v3.2). Do not edit by hand.

/// Depth-to-space: 2x output = bilinear game frame + the last pass's residual.
pub const DEPTH_TO_SPACE: &str = r#"#version 300 es
precision highp float;
uniform sampler2D u_last;
uniform sampler2D u_main;
uniform vec2 u_last_size;
in vec2 v_uv;
out vec4 o;
void main() {
    vec2 f0 = fract(v_uv * u_last_size);
    ivec2 i0 = ivec2(f0 * vec2(2.0));
    vec4 t = texture(u_last, (vec2(0.5) - f0) / u_last_size + v_uv);
    float c0 = t[i0.y * 2 + i0.x];
    o = vec4(texture(u_main, v_uv).rgb + vec3(c0), 1.0);
}
"#;

`port/crates/s3-frontend/src/audio.rs`:

```rs
//! Audio path: the engine thread pushes PCM through [`Resampler`] into a lock-free single-producer /
//! single-consumer [`AudioRing`] of interleaved stereo i16 at [`OUT_RATE`]; the AAudio data callback (real-time
//! thread, no locks/allocations) pops from it and plays silence on underrun.

use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, AtomicI16, AtomicU64, AtomicUsize, Ordering};

pub const OUT_RATE: u32 = 44100;
pub const OUT_CHANNELS: usize = 2;

/// SPSC ring of stereo frames.
pub struct AudioRing {
    buf: Vec<AtomicI16>,
    /// Total samples written / read (monotonic; index = value % len).
    write: AtomicUsize,
    read: AtomicUsize,
    /// Samples dropped because the ring was full / underrun frames played as silence (diagnostics).
    pub dropped: AtomicU64,
    pub underruns: AtomicU64,
    /// Set while the stream is running (diagnostics; the producer keeps writing anyway).
    pub running: AtomicBool,
}

impl AudioRing {
    pub fn new(frames: usize) -> Self {
        let n = frames * OUT_CHANNELS;
        AudioRing {
            buf: (0..n).map(|_| AtomicI16::new(0)).collect(),
            write: AtomicUsize::new(0),
            read: AtomicUsize::new(0),
            dropped: AtomicU64::new(0),
            underruns: AtomicU64::new(0),
            running: AtomicBool::new(false),
        }
    }

    /// Queued stereo frames.
    pub fn queued_frames(&self) -> usize {
        (self.write.load(Ordering::Acquire) - self.read.load(Ordering::Acquire)) / OUT_CHANNELS
    }

    /// Producer: append interleaved stereo samples (drops what does not fit).
    pub fn push(&self, samples: &[i16]) {
        let w = self.write.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
        let r = self.read.load(Ordering::Acquire);
        let free = self.buf.len() - (w - r);
        let n = samples.len().min(free) & !1;
        let len = self.buf.len();
        for (i, &s) in samples[..n].iter().enumerate() {
            self.buf[(w + i) % len].store(s, Ordering::Relaxed);
        }
        self.write.store(w + n, Ordering::Release);
        if n < samples.len() {
            self.dropped.fetch_add((samples.len() - n) as u64, Ordering::Relaxed);
        }
    }

    /// Consumer: fill `out` (interleaved stereo), zero-filling on underrun. Returns samples copied from the ring.
    pub fn pop_into(&self, out: &mut [i16]) -> usize {
        let r = self.read.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
        let w = self.write.load(Ordering::Acquire);
        let n = out.len().min(w - r);
        let len = self.buf.len();
        for (i, o) in out[..n].iter_mut().enumerate() {
            *o = self.buf[(r + i) % len].load(Ordering::Relaxed);
        }
        out[n..].fill(0);
        self.read.store(r + n, Ordering::Release);
        if n < out.len() && n > 0 {
            self.underruns.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
        }
        n
    }

    /// Drop everything queued (consumer side; call only when the stream is stopped).
    pub fn clear(&self) {
        self.read.store(self.write.load(Ordering::Acquire), Ordering::Release);
    }
}

/// Linear-interpolating converter from any rate/channel count (1 or 2) to stereo [`OUT_RATE`].
#[derive(Debug, Default)]
pub struct Resampler {
    /// Position in input frames relative to `prev` (index 0 = prev).
    phase: f64,
    prev: (i16, i16),
    out: Vec<i16>,
    pub last_rate: u32,
}

impl Resampler {
    pub fn convert(&mut self, samples: &[i16], rate: u32, channels: u16) -> &[i16] {
        self.out.clear();
        let ch = channels.max(1) as usize;
        let n = samples.len() / ch;
        if n == 0 || rate == 0 {
            return &self.out;
        }
        self.last_rate = rate;
        let frame = |i: usize| -> (i16, i16) {
            let s = &samples[i * ch..];
            if ch == 1 {
                (s[0], s[0])
            } else {
                (s[0], s[1])
            }
        };
        if rate == OUT_RATE && self.phase == 0.0 {
            for i in 0..n {
                let (l, r) = frame(i);
                self.out.extend_from_slice(&[l, r]);
            }
            self.prev = frame(n - 1);
            return &self.out;
        }
        let step = rate as f64 / OUT_RATE as f64;
        let mut t = self.phase;
        // f(0) = prev, f(k) = frame(k-1); interpolate between f(i) and f(i+1) for i < n.
        while t < n as f64 {
            let i = t as usize;
            let fr = t - i as f64;
            let a = if i == 0 { self.prev } else { frame(i - 1) };
            let b = frame(i);
            let l = a.0 as f64 + (b.0 as f64 - a.0 as f64) * fr;
            let r = a.1 as f64 + (b.1 as f64 - a.1 as f64) * fr;
            self.out.push(l.round() as i16);
            self.out.push(r.round() as i16);
            t += step;
        }
        self.phase = t - n as f64;
        self.prev = frame(n - 1);
        &self.out
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn ring_roundtrip_and_underrun() {
        let r = AudioRing::new(4);
        r.push(&[1, 2, 3, 4]);
        assert_eq!(r.queued_frames(), 2);
        let mut out = [9i16; 6];
        assert_eq!(r.pop_into(&mut out), 4);
        assert_eq!(out, [1, 2, 3, 4, 0, 0]);
        // Overflow drops.
        r.push(&[5; 10]);
        assert_eq!(r.queued_frames(), 4);
        assert_eq!(r.dropped.load(Ordering::Relaxed), 2);
    }

    #[test]
    fn mono_22050_doubles_frames() {
        let mut rs = Resampler::default();
        let input: Vec<i16> = (0..100).map(|i| i * 10).collect();
        let n1 = rs.convert(&input, 22050, 1).len();
        let n2 = rs.convert(&input, 22050, 1).len();
        // 100 input frames -> ~200 output frames (stereo -> x2 samples).
        assert!((n1 as i32 / 2 - 200).abs() <= 1, "{n1}");
        assert!((n2 as i32 / 2 - 200).abs() <= 1, "{n2}");
        // Interpolated values are monotonic within a ramp (after the first frames, which blend with the
        // previous call's last frame).
        let out = rs.convert(&input, 22050, 1).to_vec();
        assert!(out[4..].windows(4).step_by(2).all(|w| w[2] >= w[0]));
    }

    #[test]
    fn passthrough_at_out_rate() {
        let mut rs = Resampler::default();
        assert_eq!(rs.convert(&[1, 2, 3, 4], OUT_RATE, 2), &[1, 2, 3, 4]);
    }
}
