`port/crates/s3-mods/src/fast_obj.rs`:

```rs
//! Native fast path: the per-tile object drawer `0x4d3050` (draw thread, `thiscall`, 6 stack arguments, `ret 0x18`)
//! for the common case "nothing to draw" (see `fast.rs` for the contract, docs/porting/performance.md).
//!
//! The frame renderer `0x4b26c0` calls it once per snapshot tile and frame (~10 000 times per frame at 1536x600);
//! it was 17-22 % of all guest instructions in game. Arguments: `a1` = snapshot, `a2`/`a3` = cell column/row
//! (cell `a1 + (a3 + a2*130)*0x30`), `a6` = object type of the tile. The native path handles only `a6 == 0` with
//! cell byte `+0x502` (landscape type) != 0x50 (for types 2..7 only when word `+0x50a` != 0 or
//! `(byte +0x505 & 0x3f)*4 <= 0x48`), and `[a1+0x60]` not 1 or 4: then the original runs its prologue (four
//! `0x5fc540` setter calls on locals), a chain of type compares and returns without drawing (110-116 guest
//! instructions). Everything else (and a budget too small for the whole call) declines,
//! so the original code runs.

use s3_cpu::{code_hash, layout, Cpu, GuestMemory, EAX, ECX, EDX, ESP};

pub const START: u32 = 0x004d_3050;
/// End of the function's code (`ret 0x18` at 0x4d5a4c is its last instruction).
pub const END: u32 = 0x004d_5a4f;
pub const HASH: u64 = 0x9d97_378a_b979_69ee; // patched code (res::code_patches)
/// The 4-instruction setter `mov eax,ecx; mov ecx,[esp+4]; mov [eax],ecx; ret 4` it calls four times.
const SETTER: u32 = 0x005f_c540;
const SETTER_LEN: u32 = 11;
const SETTER_HASH: u64 = 0xbd7e_00ef_0d5a_a4ab;

#[inline]
fn ok(a: u32, len: u32) -> bool {
    a >= layout::NULL_GUARD_END && a as u64 + len as u64 <= u32::MAX as u64
}

#[inline]
fn disjoint(a: u32, alen: u32, b: u32, blen: u32) -> bool {
    let (a, b) = (a as u64, b as u64);
    a + alen as u64 <= b || b + blen as u64 <= a
}

/// What the empty-tile call does, decided by [`plan`] before anything is written.
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub struct Plan {
    /// Guest instructions of the whole call (`call` excluded, `ret 0x18` included).
    pub n: u64,
    land: u32,
    b505: u32,
}

/// The checks of the native path, without the budget and the setter hash: `e` = ESP at the entry of `0x4d3050`
/// (return address at `[e]`), arguments `a1`, `a2`, `a3`, `a6` (as the caller pushes them). Reads only the cell
/// bytes `+0x502..+0x50c` and `[a1+0x60]`; `None` = the original code must run.
#[inline]
pub fn plan(mem: &GuestMemory, e: u32, a1: u32, a2: u32, a3: u32, a6: u32) -> Option<Plan> {
    // stack: writes [e-0x34c, e), reads [e, e+0x1c)
    if e < 0x1000 || !ok(e - 0x34c, 0x34c + 0x1c) {
        return None;
    }
    if a6 != 0 {
        return None; // object type
    }
    let cell = a1.wrapping_add(a3.wrapping_add(a2.wrapping_mul(crate::res::SNAP_ROWS)).wrapping_mul(48));
    if !ok(cell.wrapping_add(0x502), 0xa) || !ok(a1.wrapping_add(0x60), 4) {
        return None;
    }
    let lo = e - 0x34c;
    if !disjoint(lo, 0x34c, cell.wrapping_add(0x502), 0xa) || !disjoint(lo, 0x34c, a1.wrapping_add(0x60), 4) {
        return None;
    }
    let land = mem.read_u8(cell.wrapping_add(0x502));
    if land == 0x50 {
        return None;
    }
    let b505 = mem.read_u8(cell.wrapping_add(0x505)) as u32;
    let n: u64 = match land {
        0 | 1 => 110,
        // 0x4d4af8: land 2..7 -> 0x4d4b00 `cmp word [cell+0x50a],0; jne` -> 0x4d4b0d `cmp [esp+0x20],0x48; jle`
        2..=7 if mem.read_u16(cell.wrapping_add(0x50a)) != 0 => 114,
        2..=7 if ((b505 & 0x3f) << 2) <= 0x48 => 116,
        2..=7 => return None, // draws decorations (0x4d4b18..)
        _ => 112,
    };
    let mode = mem.read_u32(a1.wrapping_add(0x60));
    if mode == 4 || mode == 1 {
        return None;
    }
    Some(Plan { n, land: land as u32, b505 })
}

/// The setter `0x5fc540` the call uses is the original code.
#[inline]
pub fn setter_ok(mem: &GuestMemory) -> bool {
    code_hash(mem.slice(SETTER, SETTER_LEN as usize)) == SETTER_HASH
}

/// Do the call planned by [`plan`] (same `e` and `a1`): its stack writes, registers, EFLAGS, ESP and EIP after
/// the `ret 0x18`. EBX, EBP, ESI and EDI must hold the caller's values (the prologue saves them on the stack).
#[inline]
pub fn apply(cpu: &mut Cpu, mem: &mut GuestMemory, e: u32, a1: u32, p: &Plan) {
    let x = e - 0x344; // esp after the prologue pushes
    let [_, _, _, ebx, _, ebp, esi, edi] = cpu.regs;
    // prologue
    mem.write_u32(e - 0x338, ebx);
    mem.write_u32(e - 0x33c, ebp);
    mem.write_u32(e - 0x340, esi);
    mem.write_u32(e - 0x344, edi);
    // four setter calls: push 0; call (return address); [local] = 0
    for (ret, local) in [(0x004d_306cu32, 0x2cu32), (0x004d_3076, 0x38), (0x004d_3080, 0x18), (0x004d_308a, 0x24)] {
        mem.write_u32(x - 4, 0);
        mem.write_u32(x - 8, ret);
        if ret == 0x004d_306c {
            mem.write_u32(x + 0x1c, 0); // mov [esp+0x20],ebx (before the first call)
        }
        mem.write_u32(x + local, 0);
    }
    mem.write_u32(x + 0x20, (p.b505 & 0x3f) << 2);
    let ret_addr = mem.read_u32(e);
    cpu.regs[EAX] = p.land;
    cpu.regs[ECX] = a1;
    cpu.regs[EDX] = a1;
    // ebx, ebp, esi, edi are restored by the epilogue (unchanged)
    cpu.alu_add(e - 0x334, 0x334, 0, 4); // add esp,0x334 (after the last cmp)
    cpu.regs[ESP] = e.wrapping_add(4 + 0x18);
    cpu.eip = ret_addr;
}

pub fn obj_empty(cpu: &mut Cpu, mem: &mut GuestMemory, budget: u64) -> Option<u64> {
    let e = cpu.regs[ESP];
    if e < 0x1000 || !ok(e, 0x1c) {
        return None;
    }
    let a1 = mem.read_u32(e.wrapping_add(4));
    let a2 = mem.read_u32(e.wrapping_add(8));
    let a3 = mem.read_u32(e.wrapping_add(0xc));
    let a6 = mem.read_u32(e.wrapping_add(0x18));
    let p = plan(mem, e, a1, a2, a3, a6)?;
    if p.n > budget || !setter_ok(mem) {
        return None;
    }
    apply(cpu, mem, e, a1, &p);
    Some(p.n)
}

```

`port/crates/s3-mods/src/fast_shadow.rs`:

```rs
//! Native fast paths: the run/row loops of the two shadow sprite functions of the GOG S3.EXE (perf-shadow, see
//! `fast.rs` for the contract, docs/porting/performance.md).
//!
//! Both functions walk an RLE stream of `(count, skip|last)` byte pairs per row and call a per-run function
//! through a pointer global for every run; the loops (caller part + call + callee) are replaced as a whole.
//!
//! **`shadow_zero`** (`0x5fc2cd..0x5fc346`, second row loop of `0x5fc160`): per run `b0 = count`, `b1 = skip|last`;
//! `dst = cur + 2*(b1 & 0x7f)`, then `call [0x7e8c74]` (= `0x5f48e0`, hash-checked): zero `b0 >> 1` dwords and,
//! when `b0 & 1`, one word; the source cursor `[esp+0x90]` advances by 2 + the pixel bytes (the pixels are
//! skipped, not read). Row end: row start `[esp+0x10]` += pitch `[esp+0x34]` (`shr 1`, `*2`), EDI = row counter
//! vs `[esp+0x14]` (signed). Guest instructions: 38 + 5/dword + 3 (odd word) per run, 9 per row end, 1 row head.
//!
//! **`shadow_rows`** (`0x5fd24f..0x5fd301`, row loop of `0x5fd120`): per run `dst = cur + 2*skip`, phase
//! `[esp+0x90] = (phase + skip) & 31`, `call [0x7e8e20]` with `ecx = &cur`, `edx = dst + 2*count`, args
//! `(&phase, row phase ESI)`. The callee is `0x5fd080` (checkerboard: zero pixels where `phase + row phase` is
//! odd) or `0x5fd0c0` (darken: `(px >> 1) & mask`, word head/tail with `[0x7e8dd8]`, dwords with `[0x7e8dec]`),
//! both hash-checked. Row end (`0x5fd2ba`): row start `[esp+0x8c]` += pitch `[esp+0x30]`, ESI = (ESI + 1) mod 32
//! (C remainder), `[esp+0x90] = EDI` (start phase), counter `[esp+0xa4]` vs `[esp+0x18]` (signed).
//!
//! Every guest write is reproduced in the original order (stack slots of the call/pushes included, so the memory
//! below ESP is identical too); the natives stop at a run head, a row head or the loop exit, run whole runs
//! within the budget and stop (or decline) before a run that could fault, would not terminate (odd distance,
//! wrap), writes into the stack frame / the darken mask, or calls an unknown function.

use s3_cpu::{code_hash, layout, Cpu, GuestMemory, EAX, EBP, EBX, ECX, EDI, EDX, ESI, ESP};

/// `[a, a+len)` inside the guest window above the NULL guard, no wrap.
#[inline]
fn range_ok(a: u32, len: u64) -> bool {
    a >= layout::NULL_GUARD_END && a as u64 + len <= u32::MAX as u64
}

#[inline]
fn disjoint(a: u32, alen: u64, b: u32, blen: u64) -> bool {
    let (a, b) = (a as u64, b as u64);
    a + alen <= b || b + blen <= a
}

/// Largest run length handled (bytes); a longer one is garbage: stop.
const MAX_RUN: u64 = 1 << 20;

// ================================================================== 0x5fc160 second loop (zero runs)

/// Row head `mov [esp+0x98],eax` (jl target and first entry).
pub const ZERO_ROW: u32 = 0x005f_c2cd;
/// Run head `mov ecx,[esp+0x90]` (je target).
pub const ZERO_RUN: u32 = 0x005f_c2d4;
/// Loop exit `pop edi`.
pub const ZERO_EXIT: u32 = 0x005f_c346;
pub const ZERO_ROW_HASH: u64 = 0x4c3d_6969_605d_5f17;
pub const ZERO_RUN_HASH: u64 = 0x8911_9add_0620_64f6;
/// Hash of the row head instruction alone (`ZERO_ROW..ZERO_RUN`), checked when entered at the run head.
const ZERO_HEAD_HASH: u64 = 0x29fa_16c2_5452_31b4;
/// Return address of the run call.
const ZERO_RET: u32 = 0x005f_c327;
/// Function pointer global and the only callee handled: zero `[ecx]..edx` dwords + optional word.
const ZERO_PTR: u32 = 0x007e_8c74;
const ZERO_FN: u32 = 0x005f_48e0;
const ZERO_FN_LEN: usize = 0x3a;
const ZERO_FN_HASH: u64 = 0xb0f4_8b04_d105_8220;

pub fn shadow_zero(cpu: &mut Cpu, mem: &mut GuestMemory, budget: u64) -> Option<u64> {
    let s = cpu.regs[ESP];
    // frame: callee pushes down to s-0x14, locals up to s+0x9c
    let (flo, fhi) = (s.wrapping_sub(0x14), 0x14u64 + 0xa0);
    if s < 0x1000 || !range_ok(flo, fhi) || !disjoint(flo, fhi, ZERO_PTR, 4) {
        return None;
    }
    let mut pc = cpu.eip;
    let mut head_ok = pc == ZERO_ROW;
    let mut fn_ok = false;
    let mut done = 0u64;
    loop {
        match pc {
            ZERO_ROW => {
                if done + 1 > budget {
                    break;
                }
                if !head_ok {
                    if code_hash(mem.slice(ZERO_ROW, 7)) != ZERO_HEAD_HASH {
                        break;
                    }
                    head_ok = true;
                }
                mem.write_u32(s.wrapping_add(0x98), cpu.regs[EAX]);
                done += 1;
                pc = ZERO_RUN;
            }
            ZERO_RUN => {
                let src = mem.read_u32(s.wrapping_add(0x90));
                if !range_ok(src, 2) || !disjoint(src, 2, flo, fhi) {
                    break;
                }
                let b0 = mem.read_u8(src) as u32;
                let b1 = mem.read_u8(src.wrapping_add(1)) as u32;
                let cur = mem.read_u32(s.wrapping_add(0x98));
                let dst = cur.wrapping_add(2 * (b1 & 0x7f));
                let n = b0 >> 1;
                let odd = b0 & 1;
                let len = 4 * n as u64 + 2 * odd as u64;
                if !range_ok(dst, len) || !disjoint(dst, len, flo, fhi) || !disjoint(dst, len, ZERO_PTR, 4) {
                    break;
                }
                if mem.read_u32(ZERO_PTR) != ZERO_FN {
                    break;
                }
                if !fn_ok {
                    if code_hash(mem.slice(ZERO_FN, ZERO_FN_LEN)) != ZERO_FN_HASH {
                        break;
                    }
                    fn_ok = true;
                }
                let cost = 38 + 5 * n as u64 + 3 * odd as u64;
                if done + cost > budget {
                    break;
                }
                // caller 0x5fc2d4..0x5fc321
                mem.write_u32(s.wrapping_add(0x90), src.wrapping_add(2));
                mem.write_u32(s.wrapping_sub(4), odd); // push ecx (= b0 & 1)
                mem.write_u32(s.wrapping_sub(8), s.wrapping_add(0x90)); // push edx
                mem.write_u32(s.wrapping_add(0x98), dst);
                mem.write_u32(s.wrapping_sub(0xc), ZERO_RET);
                // callee 0x5f48e0
                let edi = cpu.regs[EDI];
                mem.write_u32(s.wrapping_sub(0x10), dst); // push esi (= dst)
                mem.write_u32(s.wrapping_sub(0x14), edi); // push edi
                let dend = dst.wrapping_add(4 * n);
                if n > 0 {
                    mem.fill(dst, 4 * n as usize, 0);
                }
                let mut eax = dend;
                if odd != 0 {
                    mem.write_u16(eax, 0);
                    eax = eax.wrapping_add(2);
                }
                mem.write_u32(s.wrapping_add(0x98), eax); // [ecx] = eax
                mem.write_u32(s.wrapping_add(0x90), src.wrapping_add(2).wrapping_add(len as u32)); // [edi] = esi
                cpu.regs[EAX] = eax;
                cpu.regs[EBX] = b1;
                cpu.regs[ECX] = s.wrapping_add(0x98);
                cpu.regs[EDX] = (dend & !0xff) | odd;
                cpu.regs[ESI] = dst;
                // test bl,0x80
                cpu.alu_logic(b1 & 0x80, 1);
                done += cost;
                pc = if b1 & 0x80 == 0 { ZERO_RUN } else { 0x005f_c32c };
            }
            0x005f_c32c => {
                if done + 9 > budget {
                    break;
                }
                let pitch = mem.read_u32(s.wrapping_add(0x34)) >> 1;
                let row = mem.read_u32(s.wrapping_add(0x10));
                let edi = cpu.regs[EDI].wrapping_add(1);
                let eax = row.wrapping_add(pitch.wrapping_mul(2));
                let rows = mem.read_u32(s.wrapping_add(0x14));
                cpu.alu_sub(edi, rows, 0, 4);
                mem.write_u32(s.wrapping_add(0x10), eax);
                cpu.regs[EAX] = eax;
                cpu.regs[ECX] = rows;
                cpu.regs[EDI] = edi;
                done += 9;
                pc = if (edi as i32) < (rows as i32) { ZERO_ROW } else { ZERO_EXIT };
            }
            _ => break,
        }
    }
    if done == 0 {
        return None;
    }
    cpu.eip = pc;
    Some(done)
}

// ================================================================== 0x5fd120 row loop (dither / darken runs)

/// First entry (`mov eax,[esp+0x8c]`, fall-through after the `jle` that skips the loop).
pub const ROWS_FIRST: u32 = 0x005f_d24f;
/// Row head `mov [esp+0x94],eax` (jl target).
pub const ROWS_ROW: u32 = 0x005f_d256;
/// Run head `mov ecx,[esp+0x10]` (je target).
pub const ROWS_RUN: u32 = 0x005f_d25d;
/// Row end (fall-through after the `je`).
const ROWS_END: u32 = 0x005f_d2ba;
/// Loop exit `pop edi`.
pub const ROWS_EXIT: u32 = 0x005f_d301;
pub const ROWS_FIRST_HASH: u64 = 0x98cc_f1dd_5cea_9327;
pub const ROWS_ROW_HASH: u64 = 0x999a_6335_cb88_679e;
pub const ROWS_RUN_HASH: u64 = 0xecbd_f380_9897_f81b;
/// Hash of the row head instruction alone (`ROWS_ROW..ROWS_RUN`), checked when entered at the run head.
const ROWS_HEAD_HASH: u64 = 0xa9e4_c6e3_ad29_23f8;
const ROWS_RET: u32 = 0x005f_d2b6;
const ROWS_PTR: u32 = 0x007e_8e20;
const DITHER_FN: u32 = 0x005f_d080;
const DITHER_FN_LEN: usize = 0x39;
const DITHER_FN_HASH: u64 = 0xe8fc_6c04_049b_befb;
const DARKEN_FN: u32 = 0x005f_d0c0;
const DARKEN_FN_LEN: usize = 0x5f;
const DARKEN_FN_HASH: u64 = 0x871d_d4d2_7f59_cc9a;
/// Darken masks: word head/tail, dwords.
const MASK16: u32 = 0x007e_8dd8;
const MASK32: u32 = 0x007e_8dec;

/// Guest instructions of `0x5fd080` from entry to `ret` for a run `[dst, end)`, phase `ph`, row phase `rp`, or
/// `None` if it would not terminate normally / could fault.
fn dither_cost(dst: u32, end: u32, ph: u32, rp: u32) -> Option<u64> {
    if dst >= end {
        return Some(11);
    }
    let dist = (end - dst) as u64;
    if dist & 1 != 0 || dist > MAX_RUN || !range_ok(dst, dist) {
        return None;
    }
    let c = dist / 2;
    let odd = if ph.wrapping_add(rp) & 1 != 0 { c.div_ceil(2) } else { c / 2 };
    Some(18 + 8 * c + odd)
}

/// Guest instructions of `0x5fd0c0` for a run `[dst, end)`, or `None` (fault / no termination / the dword
/// loop would write its own mask).
fn darken_cost(dst: u32, end: u32) -> Option<u64> {
    if dst >= end {
        return Some(4);
    }
    let dist = (end - dst) as u64;
    if (dst | end) & 1 != 0 || dist > MAX_RUN || !range_ok(dst, dist) {
        return None;
    }
    let h = (dst & 2 != 0) as u64;
    let a = dst.wrapping_add(2 * h as u32);
    let al = end & !3;
    let t = (al != end) as u64;
    let n = ((al - a) / 4) as u64;
    if n > 0 && !disjoint(a, 4 * n, MASK32, 4) {
        return None;
    }
    Some(17 + 6 * h + 6 * t + if n > 0 { 2 + 8 * n } else { 0 })
}

/// Run `0x5fd080` from its entry (EIP at the function, ESP at the return address) to after its `ret 8`, in the
/// original order of reads and writes. The caller has checked `dither_cost` for the same state.
fn dither_exec(cpu: &mut Cpu, mem: &mut GuestMemory) {
    let e = cpu.regs[ESP];
    let [_, ecx0, edx, ebx, _, ebp, esi, edi] = cpu.regs;
    mem.write_u32(e.wrapping_sub(4), esi);
    mem.write_u32(e.wrapping_sub(8), edi);
    let dptr = ecx0;
    let pptr = mem.read_u32(e.wrapping_add(4));
    let mut eax = mem.read_u32(dptr);
    let mut ph = mem.read_u32(pptr);
    if eax >= edx {
        cpu.alu_sub(eax, edx, 0, 4);
    } else {
        mem.write_u32(e.wrapping_sub(0xc), ebx);
        mem.write_u32(e.wrapping_sub(0x10), ebp);
        let rp = mem.read_u32(e.wrapping_add(8));
        // pixel i is cleared when (ph + i + rp) is odd; ph's parity alternates (the & 31 keeps it)
        let mut p = eax;
        let mut odd = ph.wrapping_add(rp) & 1;
        while p != edx {
            if odd != 0 {
                mem.write_u16(p, 0);
            }
            odd ^= 1;
            p = p.wrapping_add(2);
        }
        let c = (edx - eax) / 2;
        ph = ph.wrapping_add(c) & 0x1f;
        eax = edx;
        mem.write_u32(dptr, eax);
        mem.write_u32(pptr, ph);
        cpu.alu_sub(eax, edx, 0, 4);
    }
    cpu.regs[EAX] = eax;
    cpu.regs[ECX] = pptr;
    cpu.eip = mem.read_u32(e);
    cpu.regs[ESP] = e.wrapping_add(0xc);
}

/// Run `0x5fd0c0` from its entry to after its `ret 8` (original order). The caller has checked `darken_cost`.
fn darken_exec(cpu: &mut Cpu, mem: &mut GuestMemory) {
    let e = cpu.regs[ESP];
    let [_, ecx, mut edx, _, _, _, esi0, edi0] = cpu.regs;
    let mut eax = mem.read_u32(ecx);
    if eax >= edx {
        cpu.alu_sub(eax, edx, 0, 4);
    } else {
        mem.write_u32(e.wrapping_sub(4), esi0);
        mem.write_u32(e.wrapping_sub(8), edi0);
        if eax & 2 != 0 {
            let m = mem.read_u32(MASK16);
            let v = ((mem.read_u16(eax) >> 1) as u32 | (esi0 & 0xffff_0000)) & m;
            mem.write_u16(eax, v as u16);
            eax = eax.wrapping_add(2);
        }
        let al = edx & !3;
        if eax != al {
            mem.write_u32(e.wrapping_sub(0xc), cpu.regs[EBX]);
            let m = mem.read_u32(MASK32);
            while eax != al {
                let v = (mem.read_u32(eax) >> 1) & m;
                mem.write_u32(eax, v);
                eax = eax.wrapping_add(4);
            }
        }
        if al != edx {
            let m = mem.read_u32(MASK16);
            edx = ((mem.read_u16(eax) >> 1) as u32 | (edx & 0xffff_0000)) & m;
            mem.write_u16(eax, edx as u16);
            cpu.alu_add(eax, 2, 0, 4);
            eax = eax.wrapping_add(2);
        } else {
            cpu.alu_sub(al, edx, 0, 4);
        }
        mem.write_u32(ecx, eax);
    }
    cpu.regs[EAX] = eax;
    cpu.regs[EDX] = edx;
    cpu.eip = mem.read_u32(e);
    cpu.regs[ESP] = e.wrapping_add(0xc);
}

pub fn shadow_rows(cpu: &mut Cpu, mem: &mut GuestMemory, budget: u64) -> Option<u64> {
    let s = cpu.regs[ESP];
    // frame: call + callee pushes down to s-0x1c, locals/arguments up to s+0xb8
    let (flo, fhi) = (s.wrapping_sub(0x1c), 0x1cu64 + 0xb8);
    if s < 0x1000 || !range_ok(flo, fhi) || !disjoint(flo, fhi, ROWS_PTR, 4) {
        return None;
    }
    if !disjoint(flo, fhi, MASK16, 4) || !disjoint(flo, fhi, MASK32, 4) {
        return None;
    }
    let mut pc = cpu.eip;
    let mut head_ok = pc != ROWS_RUN;
    let (mut dither_ok, mut darken_ok) = (false, false);
    let mut done = 0u64;
    loop {
        match pc {
            ROWS_FIRST => {
                if done + 1 > budget {
                    break;
                }
                cpu.regs[EAX] = mem.read_u32(s.wrapping_add(0x8c));
                done += 1;
                pc = ROWS_ROW;
            }
            ROWS_ROW => {
                if done + 1 > budget {
                    break;
                }
                if !head_ok {
                    if code_hash(mem.slice(ROWS_ROW, 7)) != ROWS_HEAD_HASH {
                        break;
                    }
                    head_ok = true;
                }
                mem.write_u32(s.wrapping_add(0x94), cpu.regs[EAX]);
                done += 1;
                pc = ROWS_RUN;
            }
            ROWS_RUN => {
                let src = mem.read_u32(s.wrapping_add(0x10));
                if !range_ok(src, 2) {
                    break;
                }
                let cnt = mem.read_u8(src) as u32;
                let b1 = mem.read_u8(src.wrapping_add(1)) as u32;
                let ph0 = mem.read_u32(s.wrapping_add(0x90));
                let cur = mem.read_u32(s.wrapping_add(0x94));
                let skip = b1 & 0x7f;
                let dst = cur.wrapping_add(2 * skip);
                let ph = skip.wrapping_add(ph0) & 0x1f;
                let end = dst.wrapping_add(2 * cnt);
                let rp = cpu.regs[ESI];
                let target = mem.read_u32(ROWS_PTR);
                let cost = match target {
                    DITHER_FN => {
                        if !dither_ok {
                            if code_hash(mem.slice(DITHER_FN, DITHER_FN_LEN)) != DITHER_FN_HASH {
                                break;
                            }
                            dither_ok = true;
                        }
                        dither_cost(dst, end, ph, rp)
                    }
                    DARKEN_FN => {
                        if !darken_ok {
                            if code_hash(mem.slice(DARKEN_FN, DARKEN_FN_LEN)) != DARKEN_FN_HASH {
                                break;
                            }
                            darken_ok = true;
                        }
                        darken_cost(dst, end)
                    }
                    _ => None,
                };
                let Some(cost) = cost else { break };
                if dst < end {
                    let len = (end - dst) as u64;
                    if !disjoint(dst, len, flo, fhi) || !disjoint(dst, len, ROWS_PTR, 4) {
                        break;
                    }
                }
                let cost = 25 + cost;
                if done + cost > budget {
                    break;
                }
                // caller 0x5fd25d..0x5fd2b0
                let esi = cpu.regs[ESI];
                let ebx = (cpu.regs[EBX] & !0xff) | (b1 & 0x80);
                mem.write_u32(s.wrapping_add(0x10), src.wrapping_add(2));
                mem.write_u32(s.wrapping_sub(4), esi); // push esi
                mem.write_u32(s.wrapping_add(0x94), dst);
                mem.write_u32(s.wrapping_add(0x90), ph);
                mem.write_u32(s.wrapping_sub(8), s.wrapping_add(0x90)); // push eax
                mem.write_u32(s.wrapping_sub(0xc), ROWS_RET); // call
                cpu.regs[EAX] = s.wrapping_add(0x90);
                cpu.regs[ECX] = s.wrapping_add(0x94);
                cpu.regs[EDX] = end;
                cpu.regs[EBX] = ebx;
                cpu.regs[EBP] = ph0;
                cpu.regs[ESP] = s.wrapping_sub(0xc);
                if target == DITHER_FN {
                    dither_exec(cpu, mem);
                } else {
                    darken_exec(cpu, mem);
                }
                debug_assert_eq!(cpu.regs[ESP], s);
                // test bl,bl; je
                cpu.alu_logic(b1 & 0x80, 1);
                done += cost;
                pc = if b1 & 0x80 == 0 { ROWS_RUN } else { ROWS_END };
            }
            ROWS_END => {
                let mut esi = cpu.regs[ESI].wrapping_add(1) & 0x8000_001f;
                let neg = esi & 0x8000_0000 != 0;
                let cost = if neg { 18 } else { 15 };
                if done + cost > budget {
                    break;
                }
                let pitch = mem.read_u32(s.wrapping_add(0x30)) >> 1;
                let row = mem.read_u32(s.wrapping_add(0x8c));
                if neg {
                    esi = (esi.wrapping_sub(1) | 0xffff_ffe0).wrapping_add(1);
                }
                let eax = row.wrapping_add(pitch.wrapping_mul(2));
                mem.write_u32(s.wrapping_add(0x8c), eax);
                let ecx = mem.read_u32(s.wrapping_add(0xa4)).wrapping_add(1);
                let edx = mem.read_u32(s.wrapping_add(0x18));
                mem.write_u32(s.wrapping_add(0x90), cpu.regs[EDI]);
                cpu.alu_sub(ecx, edx, 0, 4);
                mem.write_u32(s.wrapping_add(0xa4), ecx);
                cpu.regs[EAX] = eax;
                cpu.regs[ECX] = ecx;
                cpu.regs[EDX] = edx;
                cpu.regs[ESI] = esi;
                done += cost;
                pc = if (ecx as i32) < (edx as i32) { ROWS_ROW } else { ROWS_EXIT };
            }
            _ => break,
        }
    }
    if done == 0 {
        return None;
    }
    cpu.eip = pc;
    Some(done)
}
```

`port/crates/s3-mods/src/fast_snap.rs`:

```rs
//! Native fast path: the per-tile copy loop of the render snapshot fill (logic thread, `0x51f110`; see `fast.rs` for
//! the contract and docs/porting/performance.md).
//!
//! The loop at `0x522219..0x52303e` walks one diagonal of the visible map: per iteration one map tile
//! (`gd + 0x67444 + (row*768 + col)*24`, `row = [esp+0x28]`, `col = [esp+0x44]`) is copied into one snapshot cell
//! (`snap + 0x500 + ([esp+0x20] + k*130)*0x30`, `k = [esp+0x34]`), then `row` and `k` advance while `k <= [esp+0x3c]`.
//! It was 18-23 % of all guest instructions in game on the phone aspect (2316x904, 1536x600 render size).
//!
//! Only the common path is native (133 guest instructions): tile inside the map, `[gd+0x2d284] != 1`, not the
//! special row `[gd+0x2d2e4]`, tile byte `+0xb` != `[gd+0x2d300]`, light byte `+9` with equal low/high 3-bit
//! fields and bit 7 clear, no object (`+0` word 0), no flag 0x20 in `+0xa`, no `+2` word. Any other tile ends the
//! native run at the loop head *before* that tile, and the original code handles it.

use s3_cpu::{layout, Cpu, GuestMemory, EAX, EBP, EBX, ECX, EDI, EDX, ESI, ESP};

pub const START: u32 = 0x0052_2219;
/// First instruction after the loop (`jle` not taken at `0x523038`).
pub const EXIT: u32 = 0x0052_303e;
pub const HASH: u64 = 0xbcb4_31af_a8d6_444c; // patched code (res::code_patches)
/// Guest instructions per common-path iteration (blocks 0x522219 5, 0x52222b 5, 0x522240 2, 0x522248 2,
/// 0x522250 2, 0x5223b9 3, 0x5223f5 45, 0x5224f2 21, 0x52254e 13, 0x5225d0 10, 0x522b23 6, 0x522ed2 3, 0x522f33 7,
/// 0x523020 9).
pub const PER: u64 = 133;

#[inline]
fn ok(a: u32, len: u32) -> bool {
    a >= layout::NULL_GUARD_END && a as u64 + len as u64 <= u32::MAX as u64
}

#[inline]
fn disjoint(a: u32, alen: u32, b: u32, blen: u32) -> bool {
    let (a, b) = (a as u64, b as u64);
    a + alen as u64 <= b || b + blen as u64 <= a
}

pub fn snap_tiles(cpu: &mut Cpu, mem: &mut GuestMemory, budget: u64) -> Option<u64> {
    let ebp = cpu.regs[EBP];
    let s = cpu.regs[ESP];
    if !ok(s, 0x48) || !ok(ebp, 0x3d4) {
        return None;
    }
    let obj = (ebp.wrapping_add(0x3a0), 0x34u32);
    if !disjoint(s, 0x48, obj.0, obj.1) {
        return None;
    }
    let mut done = 0u64;
    let mut last = None::<(u32, u32, u32, u32)>; // eax, ecx, edx, ebx after the last native iteration
    loop {
        if done + PER > budget {
            break;
        }
        // ---- phase 1: reads and branch conditions (no side effects).
        let row = mem.read_u32(s.wrapping_add(0x28));
        let col = mem.read_u32(s.wrapping_add(0x44));
        if (row as i32) < 0 {
            break;
        }
        let gd = mem.read_u32(ebp.wrapping_add(0x3a0));
        if !ok(gd, 0x2d304) {
            break;
        }
        let max = mem.read_u32(gd.wrapping_add(0x2d2d0)).wrapping_sub(1);
        if (row as i32) > (max as i32) || (col as i32) < 0 || (col as i32) > (max as i32) {
            break;
        }
        if mem.read_u32(gd.wrapping_add(0x2d284)) == 1 {
            break;
        }
        if row == mem.read_u32(gd.wrapping_add(0x2d2e4)) {
            break;
        }
        let ebx = row.wrapping_mul(768).wrapping_add(col).wrapping_mul(24);
        let t = gd.wrapping_add(ebx).wrapping_add(0x67444);
        if !ok(t, 0x12) {
            break;
        }
        let k = mem.read_u32(s.wrapping_add(0x34));
        let base = mem.read_u32(s.wrapping_add(0x20));
        let idx = base.wrapping_add(k.wrapping_mul(crate::res::SNAP_ROWS));
        let esi = idx.wrapping_mul(48);
        let snap = mem.read_u32(ebp.wrapping_add(0x3d0));
        let w = snap.wrapping_add(esi).wrapping_add(0x500);
        if !ok(w, 0x20)
            || !disjoint(w, 0x20, obj.0, obj.1)
            || !disjoint(w, 0x20, t, 0x12)
            || !disjoint(w, 0x20, gd.wrapping_add(0x2d284), 0x80)
            || !disjoint(w, 0x20, s, 0x48)
            || !disjoint(s, 0x48, t, 0x12)
            || !disjoint(s, 0x48, gd.wrapping_add(0x2d284), 0x80)
        {
            break;
        }
        let b = |o: u32| mem.read_u8(t.wrapping_add(o));
        if b(0xb) == mem.read_u8(gd.wrapping_add(0x2d300)) {
            break;
        }
        let light = b(9) as u32;
        let a = light & 7;
        if a != (light >> 3) & 7 {
            break;
        }
        // 0x52254e: cl = a*63/7 (via the magic multiply) + (light & 0xc0)
        let c = a * 63;
        let prod = c as u64 * 0x2492_4925u64;
        let mhi = (prod >> 32) as u32;
        let cl = ((((c.wrapping_sub(mhi)) >> 1).wrapping_add(mhi)) >> 2).wrapping_add(light & 0xc0);
        if cl & 0x80 != 0 {
            break;
        }
        let w0 = mem.read_u16(t);
        if w0 != 0 {
            break;
        }
        if b(0xa) & 0x20 != 0 {
            break;
        }
        if mem.read_u16(t.wrapping_add(2)) != 0 {
            break;
        }
        let kmax = mem.read_u32(s.wrapping_add(0x3c));
        // ---- phase 2: the writes, in the original order (no overlaps, checked above).
        let (b4, b5, b6, b7, b8, ba, b11) = (b(4), b(5), b(6), b(7), mem.read_u16(t.wrapping_add(0xe)), b(0xa), b(0x11));
        let b8c = b(8);
        mem.write_u32(s.wrapping_add(0x18), idx);
        mem.write_u8(w, b4); // +500 <- tile+4
        mem.write_u8(w + 2, b6); // +502 <- tile+6
        mem.write_u8(w + 1, b5); // +501 <- tile+5
        mem.write_u8(w + 3, b7); // +503 <- tile+7
        mem.write_u16(w + 8, b8); // +508 <- tile+0xe (word)
        mem.write_u8(w + 6, ba); // +506 <- tile+0xa
        mem.write_u8(w + 7, 0); // +507 <- 0
        mem.write_u8(w + 4, b8c); // +504 <- tile+8
        mem.write_u32(s.wrapping_add(0x14), t.wrapping_add(9));
        mem.write_u8(s.wrapping_add(0x38), light as u8);
        mem.write_u32(s.wrapping_add(0x10), a);
        mem.write_u8(w + 5, cl as u8); // +505
        mem.write_u32(s.wrapping_add(0x1c), 0);
        mem.write_u16(w + 0x1e, 0); // +51e <- tile+0 word (0)
        mem.write_u16(w + 0xa, 0); // +50a <- di = 0
        mem.write_u8(w + 0xc, b11); // +50c <- tile+0x11
        let esi2 = row.wrapping_add(1);
        let eax2 = k.wrapping_add(1);
        mem.write_u32(s.wrapping_add(0x28), esi2);
        mem.write_u32(s.wrapping_add(0x34), eax2);
        done += PER;
        last = Some((eax2, kmax, snap, ebx));
        cpu.regs[ESI] = esi2;
        if (eax2 as i32) > (kmax as i32) {
            break;
        }
    }
    let (eax, ecx, edx, ebx) = last?;
    cpu.regs[EAX] = eax;
    cpu.regs[ECX] = ecx;
    cpu.regs[EDX] = edx;
    cpu.regs[EBX] = ebx;
    cpu.regs[EDI] = 0;
    cpu.alu_sub(eax, ecx, 0, 4);
    cpu.eip = if (eax as i32) <= (ecx as i32) { START } else { EXIT };
    Some(done)
}

```

`port/crates/s3-mods/src/fast_sprite.rs`:

```rs
//! Native fast path: opaque RLE sprite rows (GOG S3.EXE, inside the sprite blitter `0x5fc350`).
//!
//! Region `0x5fc4c0..0x5fc536` is the second row loop of the 16-bit sprite blitter: per row a list of runs
//! `(len_bytes, skip|last)`: byte 0 = pixel count (bit 0 = one extra 16-bit pixel, the rest copied as dwords),
//! byte 1 = `skip` pixels (bits 0-6) and "last run of the row" (bit 7); the pixels follow the 2-byte header. At
//! the row end the destination row start `[esp+0x10]` advances by the pitch `[esp+0x30]` (bytes, `shr 1` then
//! `*2`), the row counter EDI increments and the loop repeats while `EDI < [esp+0x98]` (signed).
//!
//! The native version reproduces the guest state exactly at row boundaries (EIP `0x5fc4c0`) or at the loop exit
//! (`0x5fc536`): all registers, EFLAGS (from the final `cmp edi, ecx`), the stack slots it writes
//! (`[esp+0x8c]` = source cursor, `[esp+0x10]` = row start) and every pixel, plus the exact number of guest
//! instructions. It runs whole rows only, within the instruction budget, and declines a row (falls back to the
//! interpreter) if any address could fault or source, destination and the stack slots overlap.
//! Verified by `tests::differential_sprite_rows` (needs the local game files) and by `s3det` hash runs
//! (docs/porting/performance.md).

use s3_cpu::{layout, Cpu, GuestMemory, ESP};

/// Start of the replaced region (row loop head).
pub const START: u32 = 0x005f_c4c0;
/// First address after the loop (`pop edi`).
pub const EXIT: u32 = 0x005f_c536;
/// `s3_cpu::code_hash` of the GOG bytes `START..EXIT` (tools/perf/code_hash.py).
pub const HASH: u64 = 0x2b90_3216_3848_d568;

/// Guest instructions per run header (`0x5fc4c0..0x5fc4eb`), per copied dword, for the odd-pixel test, for an odd
/// pixel, for the run tail (`0x5fc50c..0x5fc517`) and for the row end (`0x5fc519..0x5fc534`).
const N_HEAD: u64 = 15;
const N_DWORD: u64 = 6;
const N_ODD_TEST: u64 = 2;
const N_ODD: u64 = 4;
const N_TAIL: u64 = 4;
const N_ROW_END: u64 = 9;

/// `[lo, hi)` (u64, no wrap) contains `[a, a+len)`?
#[inline]
fn overlaps(lo: u64, hi: u64, a: u32, len: u64) -> bool {
    let a = a as u64;
    a < hi && a + len > lo
}

/// Scan one row from `src` / `dst` without writing: (instructions, src end, dst end) or `None` if the row
/// is unsafe to run natively (fault possible or wrap).
fn scan_row(mem: &GuestMemory, src: u32, dst: u32) -> Option<(u64, u64, u64)> {
    let g = layout::NULL_GUARD_END as u64;
    let (mut p, mut d) = (src as u64, dst as u64);
    if p < g || d < g {
        return None;
    }
    let mut n = 0u64;
    loop {
        if p + 2 > u32::MAX as u64 {
            return None;
        }
        let b0 = mem.read_u8(p as u32) as u64;
        let b1 = mem.read_u8(p as u32 + 1) as u64;
        p += 2;
        d += (b1 & 0x7f) * 2;
        let dwords = (b0 & 0xfe) / 2;
        let odd = b0 & 1;
        n += N_HEAD + N_DWORD * dwords + N_ODD_TEST + N_ODD * odd + N_TAIL;
        p += dwords * 4 + odd * 2;
        d += dwords * 4 + odd * 2;
        if p > u32::MAX as u64 || d > u32::MAX as u64 {
            return None;
        }
        if b1 & 0x80 != 0 {
            break;
        }
    }
    Some((n + N_ROW_END, p, d))
}

/// The fast path (see the module docs and `s3_cpu::NativeFn`).
pub fn sprite_rows(cpu: &mut Cpu, mem: &mut GuestMemory, budget: u64) -> Option<u64> {
    let esp = cpu.regs[ESP];
    let g = layout::NULL_GUARD_END;
    if esp < g || esp > 0xFFFF_FF00 {
        return None;
    }
    let (s10, s30, s8c, s98) = (esp + 0x10, esp + 0x30, esp + 0x8c, esp + 0x98);
    let [mut eax, _, _, mut ebx, _, mut ebp, mut esi, mut edi] = cpu.regs;
    let (mut ecx, mut edx);
    let mut done = 0u64;
    loop {
        // One row from the loop head (EIP 0x5fc4c0): check it, then run it.
        let Some((n, src_end, dst_end)) = scan_row(mem, eax, esi) else { break };
        if done + n > budget {
            break;
        }
        let (src_lo, dst_lo) = (eax as u64, esi as u64);
        if overlaps(src_lo, src_end, esi, dst_end - dst_lo)
            || [s10, s30, s8c, s98].iter().any(|&s| overlaps(dst_lo, dst_end, s, 4))
            || [s10, s8c].iter().any(|&s| overlaps(src_lo, src_end, s, 4))
        {
            break;
        }
        loop {
            let b0 = mem.read_u8(eax) as u32;
            let b1 = mem.read_u8(eax.wrapping_add(1)) as u32;
            // xor ecx,ecx / xor edx,edx / mov cl,[eax+1] / mov dl,[eax] / mov bl,cl / and ecx,7f / and bl,80
            ebx = (ebx & !0xFF) | (b1 & 0x80);
            edx = b0;
            eax = eax.wrapping_add(2);
            ecx = esi.wrapping_add((b1 & 0x7f) * 2);
            esi = ecx.wrapping_add((edx & 0xfe) * 2);
            mem.write_u32(s8c, eax);
            while ecx != esi {
                ebp = mem.read_u32(eax);
                eax = eax.wrapping_add(4);
                mem.write_u32(ecx, ebp);
                ecx = ecx.wrapping_add(4);
            }
            if edx & 1 != 0 {
                edx = mem.read_u16(eax) as u32;
                eax = eax.wrapping_add(2);
                mem.write_u16(ecx, edx as u16);
                ecx = ecx.wrapping_add(2);
            }
            esi = ecx;
            mem.write_u32(s8c, eax);
            if ebx & 0xFF != 0 {
                break;
            }
        }
        // Row end: next row start = [esp+0x10] + ([esp+0x30] >> 1) * 2; edi++; loop while edi < [esp+0x98].
        let pitch = mem.read_u32(s30) >> 1;
        edx = mem.read_u32(s10);
        edi = edi.wrapping_add(1);
        esi = edx.wrapping_add(pitch.wrapping_mul(2));
        ecx = mem.read_u32(s98);
        mem.write_u32(s10, esi);
        done += n;
        // Flags of `cmp edi, ecx` (the shr before it is overwritten).
        cpu.alu_sub(edi, ecx, 0, 4);
        cpu.regs = [eax, ecx, edx, ebx, esp, ebp, esi, edi];
        if (edi as i32) < (ecx as i32) {
            cpu.eip = START;
        } else {
            cpu.eip = EXIT;
            return Some(done);
        }
    }
    (done > 0).then_some(done)
}

```

`port/crates/s3-mods/src/fast_tests.rs`:

```rs
//! Differential tests of the native fast paths (`fast_*.rs`) against the original guest code.
//!
//! The original code comes from the user's local S3.EXE (never from our sources): the test maps its sections
//! into guest memory, prepares random inputs, then
//! 1. calls the native fast path with a random budget: it returns `k` guest instructions (or declines), and
//! 2. runs the interpreter (no fast paths) for exactly `k` instructions from the same state,
//! and requires identical registers, EFLAGS, EIP and memory (all buffers the code touches, byte for byte).
//! Skipped (passes with a note) when the exe is missing. Exe path: env `S3_EXE`, else
//! `game-files/gog-s3-ultimate/S3.EXE` in the repository.

use s3_cpu::{Cpu, GuestMemory, NativeFn, EAX, EBP, EBX, ECX, EDI, EDX, ESI, ESP};

use crate::{fast_blit, fast_land, fast_land_rows, fast_obj, fast_snap, fast_sprite, fast_tile, res};

fn exe_bytes() -> Option<Vec<u8>> {
    let p = std::env::var_os("S3_EXE").map(std::path::PathBuf::from).unwrap_or_else(|| {
        std::path::Path::new(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")).join("../../../game-files/gog-s3-ultimate/S3.EXE")
    });
    std::fs::read(p).ok()
}

/// Map the PE sections at their virtual addresses.
fn load_image(mem: &mut GuestMemory, b: &[u8]) {
    let u16_at = |o: usize| u16::from_le_bytes([b[o], b[o + 1]]) as usize;
    let u32_at = |o: usize| u32::from_le_bytes([b[o], b[o + 1], b[o + 2], b[o + 3]]);
    let pe = u32_at(0x3c) as usize;
    let n = u16_at(pe + 6);
    let opt = u16_at(pe + 20);
    let base = u32_at(pe + 24 + 28);
    for i in 0..n {
        let s = pe + 24 + opt + 40 * i;
        let (va, rsize, raw) = (u32_at(s + 12), u32_at(s + 16) as usize, u32_at(s + 20) as usize);
        if rsize > 0 && raw + rsize <= b.len() {
            mem.write_bytes(base + va, &b[raw..raw + rsize]);
        }
    }
    // The game always runs with the resolution patch (snapshot row stride, sprite buckets), and the fast paths
    // stand for the patched code.
    crate::res::apply_code_patches(mem).expect("res code patch");
}

/// Every fast path's hash matches the patched code (`res::code_patches`), so none is silently disabled.
#[test]
fn fast_path_hashes_match_patched_code() {
    let Some(exe) = exe_bytes() else {
        eprintln!("fast_path_hashes_match_patched_code: S3.EXE not found, skipped");
        return;
    };
    let mut mem = GuestMemory::new().unwrap();
    load_image(&mut mem, &exe);
    let mut bad = Vec::new();
    for (start, _end, b) in crate::fast::gog_blocks() {
        let h = s3_cpu::code_hash(mem.slice(start, b.len as usize));
        if h != b.hash {
            bad.push(format!("{} {start:#x}: {h:#x}", b.name));
        }
    }
    let mut h: u64 = 0xcbf2_9ce4_8422_2325;
    for &(a, e) in &fast_tile::OBJ_RANGES {
        for &x in mem.slice(a, (e - a) as usize) {
            h ^= x as u64;
            h = h.wrapping_mul(0x0000_0100_0000_01B3);
        }
    }
    if h != fast_tile::OBJ_HASH {
        bad.push(format!("OBJ_HASH: {h:#x}"));
    }
    assert!(bad.is_empty(), "hash mismatch (patched code): {bad:?}");
}

struct Rng(u64);
impl Rng {
    fn next(&mut self) -> u32 {
        self.0 ^= self.0 << 13;
        self.0 ^= self.0 >> 7;
        self.0 ^= self.0 << 17;
        (self.0 >> 16) as u32
    }
    fn below(&mut self, n: u32) -> u32 {
        self.next() % n.max(1)
    }
}

/// Guest buffers used by the cases.
const STACK: u32 = 0x3000_0000;
const SRC: u32 = 0x3100_0000;
const DST: u32 = 0x3200_0000;
const PAL: u32 = 0x3300_0000;
const BUF_LEN: u32 = 0x10_0000;

/// One case: initial registers, memory writes, native function, start EIP. Compares both executions.
/// Returns false if the native path declined.
fn check(
    exe: &[u8],
    f: NativeFn,
    start: u32,
    regs: [u32; 8],
    eflags: u32,
    writes: &[(u32, Vec<u8>)],
    budget: u64,
    what: &str,
) -> bool {
    let regions = [STACK, SRC, DST, PAL, 0x007e_8dec & !0xFFF].map(|a| (a, BUF_LEN));
    check_in(exe, f, start, regs, eflags, writes, budget, what, &regions)
}

#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
fn check_in(
    exe: &[u8],
    f: NativeFn,
    start: u32,
    regs: [u32; 8],
    eflags: u32,
    writes: &[(u32, Vec<u8>)],
    budget: u64,
    what: &str,
    regions: &[(u32, u32)],
) -> bool {
    let mk = || {
        let mut mem = GuestMemory::new().unwrap();
        load_image(&mut mem, exe);
        for (a, d) in writes {
            mem.write_bytes(*a, d);
        }
        let mut cpu = Cpu::new();
        cpu.regs = regs;
        cpu.set_eflags(eflags);
        cpu.eip = start;
        (cpu, mem)
    };
    let (mut nc, mut nm) = mk();
    let Some(k) = f(&mut nc, &mut nm, budget) else { return false };
    assert!(k <= budget, "{what}: k {k} > budget {budget}");
    let (mut ic, mut im) = mk();
    let mut left = k;
    while left > 0 {
        let before = ic.instructions;
        let e = ic.run(&mut im, left);
        assert!(matches!(e, s3_cpu::CpuExit::Budget), "{what}: interpreter exit {e:?} at {:#x}", ic.eip);
        left -= ic.instructions - before;
    }
    assert_eq!(nc.eip, ic.eip, "{what}: eip");
    assert_eq!(nc.regs, ic.regs, "{what}: regs (native vs interpreter)");
    assert_eq!(nc.eflags(), ic.eflags(), "{what}: eflags");
    for &(a, len) in regions {
        assert!(nm.slice(a, len as usize) == im.slice(a, len as usize), "{what}: memory at {a:#x} differs");
    }
    true
}

fn random_bytes(r: &mut Rng, n: usize) -> Vec<u8> {
    (0..n).map(|_| r.next() as u8).collect()
}

#[test]
fn differential_fast_paths() {
    let Some(exe) = exe_bytes() else {
        eprintln!("differential_fast_paths: S3.EXE not found, skipped");
        return;
    };
    let mut r = Rng(0x1234_5678_9abc_def1);
    let mut ran = [0u32; 4];
    for case in 0..120 {
        let budget = if case % 4 == 0 { 1 + r.below(400) as u64 } else { 1 << 30 };
        let eflags = 0x202 | (r.next() & 0x8D5);
        let base_regs = |r: &mut Rng| -> [u32; 8] { std::array::from_fn(|_| r.next()) };

        // --- sprite rows: random RLE rows, pitch, row counter.
        {
            let mut regs = base_regs(&mut r);
            let esp = STACK + 0x1000;
            let rows = 1 + r.below(12);
            let pitch = 2 * (100 + r.below(600)) + r.below(2); // odd pitch too (shr 1 drops bit 0)
            let mut src = Vec::new();
            for _ in 0..rows {
                let runs = 1 + r.below(5);
                for k in 0..runs {
                    let cnt = r.below(60) as u8;
                    let skip = r.below(40) as u8 | if k + 1 == runs { 0x80 } else { 0 };
                    src.push(cnt);
                    src.push(skip);
                    src.extend(random_bytes(&mut r, cnt as usize * 2));
                }
            }
            let mut stack = random_bytes(&mut r, 0x200);
            let put = |s: &mut Vec<u8>, off: usize, v: u32| s[off..off + 4].copy_from_slice(&v.to_le_bytes());
            let dst0 = DST + 2 * r.below(64);
            put(&mut stack, 0x10, dst0);
            put(&mut stack, 0x30, pitch);
            put(&mut stack, 0x98, rows + r.below(3));
            regs[EAX] = SRC;
            regs[ESI] = dst0;
            regs[EDI] = r.below(2);
            regs[ESP] = esp;
            let writes = vec![(SRC, src), (esp, stack), (DST, random_bytes(&mut r, 0x4000))];
            if check(&exe, fast_sprite::sprite_rows, fast_sprite::START, regs, eflags, &writes, budget, "sprite_rows") {
                ran[0] += 1;
            }
        }
        // --- palette row.
        {
            let mut regs = base_regs(&mut r);
            let n = 1 + r.below(300);
            regs[EAX] = DST + 2 * r.below(32);
            regs[ESI] = regs[EAX] + 2 * n;
            regs[ECX] = SRC + r.below(16);
            regs[EBP] = PAL + 2 * r.below(8);
            let writes = vec![(SRC, random_bytes(&mut r, 400)), (PAL, random_bytes(&mut r, 600))];
            if check(&exe, fast_blit::palette_row, fast_blit::PAL_START, regs, eflags, &writes, budget, "palette_row") {
                ran[1] += 1;
            }
        }
        // --- darken.
        {
            let mut regs = base_regs(&mut r);
            let n = 1 + r.below(300);
            regs[EAX] = DST + 4 * r.below(32);
            regs[ESI] = regs[EAX] + 4 * n;
            let writes = vec![(DST, random_bytes(&mut r, 2000)), (0x007e_8dec, random_bytes(&mut r, 4))];
            if check(&exe, fast_blit::darken, fast_blit::DARK_START, regs, eflags, &writes, budget, "darken") {
                ran[2] += 1;
            }
        }
        // --- dither.
        {
            let mut regs = base_regs(&mut r);
            let n = 1 + r.below(300);
            regs[EAX] = DST + 2 * r.below(32);
            regs[EDX] = regs[EAX] + 2 * n;
            regs[ESI] = r.below(32);
            let writes = vec![(DST, random_bytes(&mut r, 1000))];
            if check(&exe, fast_blit::dither, fast_blit::DITHER_START, regs, eflags, &writes, budget, "dither") {
                ran[3] += 1;
            }
        }
    }
    eprintln!("differential_fast_paths: native ran (not declined) sprite/palette/darken/dither = {ran:?} of 120 each");
    assert!(ran.iter().all(|&n| n > 60), "too many declines: {ran:?}");
}

/// Snapshot fill tile loop (`fast_snap`): random map tiles, mostly on the common path, random exits.
#[test]
fn differential_snap_tiles() {
    let Some(exe) = exe_bytes() else {
        eprintln!("differential_snap_tiles: S3.EXE not found, skipped");
        return;
    };
    const OBJ: u32 = 0x3500_0000;
    const GD: u32 = 0x3400_0000;
    const SNAP: u32 = 0x3600_0000;
    let mut r = Rng(0x0bad_cafe_1234_5679);
    let mut ran = 0;
    for case in 0..200 {
        let budget = if case % 4 == 0 { 1 + r.below(2000) as u64 } else { 1 << 30 };
        let eflags = 0x202 | (r.next() & 0x8D5);
        let mut regs: [u32; 8] = std::array::from_fn(|_| r.next());
        let esp = STACK + 0x1000;
        regs[ESP] = esp;
        regs[EBP] = OBJ;
        let n = 8 + r.below(24); // map size
        let row0 = r.below(n);
        let col = if r.below(20) == 0 { n + r.below(3) } else { r.below(n) };
        let k0 = r.below(40);
        let kmax = k0 + r.below(30);
        let base = r.below(100);
        let mut stack = random_bytes(&mut r, 0x100);
        let put = |s: &mut Vec<u8>, off: usize, v: u32| s[off..off + 4].copy_from_slice(&v.to_le_bytes());
        put(&mut stack, 0x28, row0);
        put(&mut stack, 0x44, col);
        put(&mut stack, 0x34, k0);
        put(&mut stack, 0x3c, kmax);
        put(&mut stack, 0x20, base);
        let mut obj = vec![0u8; 0x400];
        obj[0x3a0..0x3a4].copy_from_slice(&GD.to_le_bytes());
        obj[0x3d0..0x3d4].copy_from_slice(&SNAP.to_le_bytes());
        let put_h = |s: &mut Vec<u8>, off: usize, v: u32| s[off..off + 4].copy_from_slice(&v.to_le_bytes());
        let mut gdh = vec![0u8; 0x80];
        put_h(&mut gdh, 0x2d2d0 - 0x2d284, n);
        put_h(&mut gdh, 0, if r.below(30) == 0 { 1 } else { r.next() & !1 });
        put_h(&mut gdh, 0x2d2e4 - 0x2d284, if r.below(10) == 0 { row0 + r.below(8) } else { 0xffff });
        gdh[0x2d300 - 0x2d284] = 0x55;
        // tiles: rows row0.. (at most n rows) of column col
        let tiles_len = (n as usize + 2) * 768 * 24;
        let mut tiles = random_bytes(&mut r, tiles_len.min(0x10_0000));
        for row in 0..n + 1 {
            let o = ((row * 768 + col) * 24) as usize;
            if o + 0x12 > tiles.len() {
                continue;
            }
            let rare = r.below(25) == 0;
            let t = &mut tiles[o..o + 0x12];
            if !rare {
                t[0] = 0;
                t[1] = 0;
                t[2] = 0;
                t[3] = 0;
                t[0xa] &= !0x20;
                if t[0xb] == 0x55 {
                    t[0xb] = 0;
                }
                let a = (r.below(8)) as u8;
                t[9] = a | (a << 3) | (r.below(2) as u8) << 6;
            }
        }
        let writes = vec![
            (esp, stack),
            (OBJ, obj),
            (GD + 0x2d284, gdh),
            (GD + 0x67444, tiles),
            (SNAP, random_bytes(&mut r, 0x10_0000)),
        ];
        let regions = [(STACK, 0x2000), (OBJ, 0x1000), (GD + 0x2d000, 0x1000), (GD + 0x67000, 0x11_0000), (SNAP, 0x11_0000)];
        if check_in(&exe, fast_snap::snap_tiles, fast_snap::START, regs, eflags, &writes, budget, "snap_tiles", &regions) {
            ran += 1;
        }
    }
    eprintln!("differential_snap_tiles: native ran {ran} of 200");
    assert!(ran > 100, "too many declines: {ran}");
}

/// Per-tile object drawer `0x4d3050`, empty-tile case (`fast_obj`): random cells/args, the native path runs the
/// whole call up to the return address; the interpreter must arrive at the same state.
#[test]
fn differential_obj_empty() {
    let Some(exe) = exe_bytes() else {
        eprintln!("differential_obj_empty: S3.EXE not found, skipped");
        return;
    };
    const SNAP: u32 = 0x3600_0000;
    let mut r = Rng(0x5eed_0000_4d30_50aa);
    let mut ran = 0;
    for case in 0..300 {
        let budget = if case % 5 == 0 { 100 + r.below(20) as u64 } else { 1 << 30 };
        let eflags = 0x202 | (r.next() & 0x8D5);
        let mut regs: [u32; 8] = std::array::from_fn(|_| r.next());
        let e = STACK + 0x1000;
        regs[ESP] = e;
        regs[ECX] = r.next();
        let (a2, a3) = (r.below(200), r.below(130));
        let mut stack = random_bytes(&mut r, 0x1400);
        let base = 0xc00; // the stack buffer starts at STACK = e - 0x1000; base + 0x400 = offset of e
        let put = |s: &mut Vec<u8>, off: usize, v: u32| s[off..off + 4].copy_from_slice(&v.to_le_bytes());
        put(&mut stack, base + 0x400, 0x0040_1000 + r.below(0x1000)); // return address
        put(&mut stack, base + 0x404, SNAP);
        put(&mut stack, base + 0x408, a2);
        put(&mut stack, base + 0x40c, a3);
        put(&mut stack, base + 0x418, if r.below(15) == 0 { 1 + r.below(300) } else { 0 });
        let mut snap = random_bytes(&mut r, 0x10_0000.min(0x60 + 8));
        put(&mut snap, 0x60, [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 0x10][r.below(7) as usize]);
        let cell = ((a3 + a2 * res::SNAP_ROWS) * 48) as usize;
        let mut cellb = random_bytes(&mut r, 0x10);
        cellb[2] = [0, 1, 2, 5, 7, 8, 0x50, 0x51, 0xff, 3, 4, 6][r.below(12) as usize];
        if r.below(2) == 0 {
            cellb[0xa] = 0;
            cellb[0xb] = 0;
        }
        if r.below(2) == 0 {
            cellb[5] &= 0x13;
        }
        let writes = vec![(STACK, stack), (SNAP, snap), (SNAP + cell as u32 + 0x500, cellb)];
        let regions = [(STACK, 0x3000), (SNAP, 0x20_0000)];
        if check_in(&exe, fast_obj::obj_empty, fast_obj::START, regs, eflags, &writes, budget, "obj_empty", &regions) {
            ran += 1;
        }
    }
    eprintln!("differential_obj_empty: native ran {ran} of 300");
    assert!(ran > 60, "too many declines: {ran}");
}

/// Landscape triangle loop (`fast_land`): random heights and dirty bits, random frame variables.
#[test]
fn differential_land_clean() {
    let Some(exe) = exe_bytes() else {
        eprintln!("differential_land_clean: S3.EXE not found, skipped");
        return;
    };
    const SNAP: u32 = 0x3600_0000;
    let mut r = Rng(0x1a2d_c1ea_0054_ce53);
    let mut ran = 0;
    for case in 0..300 {
        let budget = if case % 4 == 0 { 1 + r.below(800) as u64 } else { 1 << 30 };
        let eflags = 0x202 | (r.next() & 0x8D5);
        let mut regs: [u32; 8] = std::array::from_fn(|_| r.next());
        let ebp = STACK + 0x1000;
        regs[EBP] = ebp;
        regs[ESP] = ebp - 0x200;
        let mut frame = random_bytes(&mut r, 0x200);
        let o = |d: i32| (0x100 + d) as usize; // frame buffer starts at ebp - 0x100
        let put = |f: &mut Vec<u8>, d: i32, v: u32| f[o(d)..o(d) + 4].copy_from_slice(&v.to_le_bytes());
        let v74 = r.below(50);
        put(&mut frame, -0x74, v74);
        put(&mut frame, -0xc4, v74 + r.below(60));
        put(&mut frame, -0x5c, r.below(2));
        put(&mut frame, -0x44, r.below(20));
        put(&mut frame, -0x48, r.below(40));
        put(&mut frame, -0x98, r.below(1000));
        put(&mut frame, 8, SNAP);
        for d in [-0x68, -0xe4, -0xe8] {
            put(&mut frame, d, if r.below(40) == 0 { 1 } else { r.below(3) * 2 });
        }
        let mut cells = random_bytes(&mut r, 0x8_0000);
        for (i, c) in cells.iter_mut().enumerate() {
            if i % 48 == 0x505 % 48 && r.below(30) != 0 {
                *c &= 0x7f;
            }
        }
        let writes = vec![(ebp - 0x100, frame), (SNAP, cells)];
        let regions = [(STACK, 0x2000), (SNAP, 0x8_0000)];
        if check_in(&exe, fast_land::land_clean, fast_land::START, regs, eflags, &writes, budget, "land_clean", &regions) {
            ran += 1;
        }
    }
    eprintln!("differential_land_clean: native ran {ran} of 300");
    assert!(ran > 60, "too many declines: {ran}");
}

/// RLE rows `(count, skip|last)` (+ `count*2` pixel bytes per run when `pixels`: `shadow_zero` skips them).
fn shadow_rle(r: &mut Rng, rows: u32, pixels: bool) -> Vec<u8> {
    let mut src = Vec::new();
    for _ in 0..rows {
        let runs = 1 + r.below(5);
        for k in 0..runs {
            let cnt = if r.below(6) == 0 { 0 } else { r.below(60) } as u8;
            let skip = r.below(40) as u8 | if k + 1 == runs { 0x80 } else { 0 };
            src.push(cnt);
            src.push(skip);
            if pixels {
                src.extend(random_bytes(r, cnt as usize * 2));
            }
        }
    }
    src
}

/// Second row loop of `0x5fc160` (`fast_shadow::shadow_zero`): zero runs through `[0x7e8c74]`.
#[test]
fn differential_shadow_zero() {
    use crate::fast_shadow as fs;
    let Some(exe) = exe_bytes() else {
        eprintln!("differential_shadow_zero: S3.EXE not found, skipped");
        return;
    };
    let mut r = Rng(0x5fc1_6000_2cd0_beef);
    let mut ran = 0;
    for case in 0..300 {
        let budget = if case % 3 == 0 { 1 + r.below(600) as u64 } else { 1 << 30 };
        let eflags = 0x202 | (r.next() & 0x8D5);
        let mut regs: [u32; 8] = std::array::from_fn(|_| r.next());
        let s = STACK + 0x1000;
        regs[ESP] = s;
        let rows = 1 + r.below(10);
        let pitch = 2 * (100 + r.below(600)) + r.below(2);
        let src = shadow_rle(&mut r, rows, true);
        let row0 = DST + 2 * r.below(64);
        let mut stack = random_bytes(&mut r, 0x200);
        let o = 0x100; // the stack buffer starts at s - 0x100
        let put = |b: &mut Vec<u8>, off: usize, v: u32| b[o + off..o + off + 4].copy_from_slice(&v.to_le_bytes());
        put(&mut stack, 0x90, SRC);
        put(&mut stack, 0x98, row0 + 2 * r.below(8));
        put(&mut stack, 0x10, row0);
        put(&mut stack, 0x34, pitch);
        let counter = r.below(3);
        put(&mut stack, 0x14, counter + 1 + r.below(rows));
        regs[EDI] = counter;
        regs[EAX] = row0;
        let entry = if r.below(2) == 0 { fs::ZERO_ROW } else { fs::ZERO_RUN };
        let fptr: u32 = if r.below(25) == 0 { 0x005f_4920 } else { 0x005f_48e0 };
        let writes = vec![
            (SRC, src),
            (s - 0x100, stack),
            (DST, random_bytes(&mut r, 0x8000)),
            (0x007e_8c74, fptr.to_le_bytes().to_vec()),
        ];
        if check(&exe, fs::shadow_zero, entry, regs, eflags, &writes, budget, "shadow_zero") {
            ran += 1;
        }
    }
    eprintln!("differential_shadow_zero: native ran {ran} of 300");
    assert!(ran > 150, "too many declines: {ran}");
}

/// Row loop of `0x5fd120` (`fast_shadow::shadow_rows`): runs through `[0x7e8e20]` = dither `0x5fd080` or darken
/// `0x5fd0c0`, random phases (negative row phases too), masks, odd destinations.
#[test]
fn differential_shadow_rows() {
    use crate::fast_shadow as fs;
    let Some(exe) = exe_bytes() else {
        eprintln!("differential_shadow_rows: S3.EXE not found, skipped");
        return;
    };
    let mut r = Rng(0x5fd1_2000_d24f_0042);
    let mut ran = [0u32; 2];
    for case in 0..400 {
        let budget = if case % 3 == 0 { 1 + r.below(800) as u64 } else { 1 << 30 };
        let eflags = 0x202 | (r.next() & 0x8D5);
        let mut regs: [u32; 8] = std::array::from_fn(|_| r.next());
        let s = STACK + 0x1000;
        regs[ESP] = s;
        let rows = 1 + r.below(10);
        let pitch = 2 * (100 + r.below(600)) + r.below(2);
        let src = shadow_rle(&mut r, rows, false);
        let row0 = DST + 2 * r.below(64) + if r.below(20) == 0 { 1 } else { 0 };
        let mut stack = random_bytes(&mut r, 0x200);
        let o = 0x100;
        let put = |b: &mut Vec<u8>, off: usize, v: u32| b[o + off..o + off + 4].copy_from_slice(&v.to_le_bytes());
        put(&mut stack, 0x10, SRC);
        put(&mut stack, 0x90, if r.below(4) == 0 { r.next() } else { r.below(32) });
        put(&mut stack, 0x94, row0 + 2 * r.below(8));
        put(&mut stack, 0x8c, row0);
        put(&mut stack, 0x30, pitch);
        let counter = r.below(3);
        put(&mut stack, 0xa4, counter);
        put(&mut stack, 0x18, counter + 1 + r.below(rows));
        regs[ESI] = if r.below(3) == 0 { (r.below(40) as i32 - 35) as u32 } else { r.below(32) };
        regs[EDI] = r.below(32);
        regs[EAX] = row0;
        let entry = [fs::ROWS_FIRST, fs::ROWS_ROW, fs::ROWS_RUN][r.below(3) as usize];
        let dark = r.below(2) == 0;
        let fptr: u32 = if r.below(30) == 0 { 0x005f_d120 } else if dark { 0x005f_d0c0 } else { 0x005f_d080 };
        let mut glob = random_bytes(&mut r, 0x50);
        glob[0x48..0x4c].copy_from_slice(&fptr.to_le_bytes()); // 0x7e8dd8 + 0x48 = 0x7e8e20
        let writes = vec![(SRC, src), (s - 0x100, stack), (DST, random_bytes(&mut r, 0x8000)), (0x007e_8dd8, glob)];
        if check(&exe, fs::shadow_rows, entry, regs, eflags, &writes, budget, "shadow_rows") {
            ran[dark as usize] += 1;
        }
    }
    eprintln!("differential_shadow_rows: native ran dither/darken {ran:?} of ~200 each");
    assert!(ran.iter().all(|&n| n > 80), "too many declines: {ran:?}");
}

/// The instructions `0x4d3050` executes in its empty case all lie in `fast_tile::OBJ_RANGES` (the bytes
/// `frame_tiles` hash-checks before it inlines the call).
#[test]
fn obj_empty_path_hashed() {
    let Some(exe) = exe_bytes() else {
        eprintln!("obj_empty_path_hashed: S3.EXE not found, skipped");
        return;
    };
    const SNAP: u32 = 0x3600_0000;
    let mut traced = 0;
    for land in [0u8, 1, 2, 3, 5, 7, 8, 9, 0x10, 0x1c, 0x4f, 0x51, 0x80, 0xff] {
        for v50a in [0u16, 1, 0x8000] {
            for b505 in [0u8, 0x13, 0x3f, 0xff] {
                for mode in [0u32, 2, 3, 5, 0x10] {
                    let mut mem = GuestMemory::new().unwrap();
                    load_image(&mut mem, &exe);
                    let e = STACK + 0x1000;
                    mem.write_u32(e, 0x0040_1000);
                    mem.write_u32(e + 4, SNAP);
                    mem.write_u32(e + 8, 3);
                    mem.write_u32(e + 0xc, 5);
                    mem.write_u32(e + 0x18, 0);
                    mem.write_u32(SNAP + 0x60, mode);
                    let cell = SNAP + (5 + 3 * res::SNAP_ROWS) * 48;
                    mem.write_u8(cell + 0x502, land);
                    mem.write_u8(cell + 0x505, b505);
                    mem.write_u16(cell + 0x50a, v50a);
                    let mut cpu = Cpu::new();
                    cpu.regs[ESP] = e;
                    cpu.eip = fast_obj::START;
                    let (mut nc, mut nm) = (Cpu::new(), GuestMemory::new().unwrap());
                    nc.regs = cpu.regs;
                    load_image(&mut nm, &exe);
                    nm.write_bytes(STACK, mem.slice(STACK, 0x2000));
                    nm.write_bytes(SNAP, mem.slice(SNAP, 0x2_0000));
                    let Some(k) = fast_obj::obj_empty(&mut nc, &mut nm, 1 << 20) else { continue };
                    for _ in 0..k {
                        let ip = cpu.eip;
                        if (fast_obj::START..fast_obj::END).contains(&ip) {
                            assert!(
                                fast_tile::OBJ_RANGES.iter().any(|&(a, b)| ip >= a && ip < b),
                                "obj_empty executes {ip:#x} outside OBJ_RANGES"
                            );
                        }
                        cpu.step(&mut mem);
                    }
                    assert_eq!(cpu.eip, 0x0040_1000);
                    traced += 1;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    eprintln!("obj_empty_path_hashed: {traced} empty calls traced");
    assert!(traced > 100);
}

/// Frame renderer cell loop (`fast_tile::frame_tiles`): random rows/columns, cells mostly on the native path,
/// random sound-statistics sectors, decoration grid, object kinds, budgets; native vs interpreter.
#[test]
fn differential_frame_tiles() {
    let Some(exe) = exe_bytes() else {
        eprintln!("differential_frame_tiles: S3.EXE not found, skipped");
        return;
    };
    const SNAP: u32 = 0x3600_0000;
    const REND: u32 = 0x3700_0000;
    const SNAP_LEN: u32 = 0x10_0000;
    let mut r = Rng(0xf4a3_e000_004b_2e44);
    let mut ran = 0;
    let mut longest = 0u64;
    for case in 0..400 {
        let budget = if case % 4 == 0 { 1 + r.below(3000) as u64 } else { 1 << 30 };
        let eflags = 0x202 | (r.next() & 0x8D5);
        let mut regs: [u32; 8] = std::array::from_fn(|_| r.next());
        let ebp = STACK + 0x1000;
        regs[EBP] = ebp;
        regs[ESP] = ebp - 0xf8;
        regs[EBX] = REND;
        regs[EDI] = SNAP;
        let rows = 2 + r.below(8);
        let w = r.below(30);
        let row = r.below(rows + 1);
        let start = r.below(12);
        let col = start + r.below(w + 3);
        regs[EAX] = start;
        regs[ECX] = row;
        regs[ESI] = col;
        let mut frame = random_bytes(&mut r, 0x200);
        let o = |d: i32| (0x100 + d) as usize; // frame buffer starts at ebp - 0x100
        let put = |f: &mut Vec<u8>, d: i32, v: u32| f[o(d)..o(d) + 4].copy_from_slice(&v.to_le_bytes());
        put(&mut frame, 8, SNAP);
        put(&mut frame, 0xc, row);
        put(&mut frame, -0x7c, w);
        put(&mut frame, -0x44, rows);
        put(&mut frame, -0x24, start);
        put(&mut frame, -0x14, (r.below(800) as i32 - 60) as u32);
        put(&mut frame, -0x18, (r.below(1000) as i32 - 100) as u32);
        put(&mut frame, -0x1c, (r.below(1000) as i32 - 100) as u32);
        put(&mut frame, -0x4c, col);
        let mut snap = random_bytes(&mut r, SNAP_LEN as usize);
        let put_s = |b: &mut Vec<u8>, off: usize, v: u32| b[off..off + 4].copy_from_slice(&v.to_le_bytes());
        put_s(&mut snap, 0x24, r.below(8));
        put_s(&mut snap, 0x28, r.below(8));
        put_s(&mut snap, 0x60, [0, 0, 0, 2, 3, 1, 4][r.below(7) as usize]);
        let lands = [0u8, 0, 1, 2, 5, 7, 8, 0x0f, 0x10, 0x1c, 0x20, 0x50, 0x51, 0xff];
        for i in 0..60u32 {
            for rr in 0..rows + 6 {
                let c = (0x500 + (rr + i * res::SNAP_ROWS) * 48) as usize;
                if c + 0x30 > snap.len() {
                    continue;
                }
                let cb = &mut snap[c..c + 0x30];
                cb[2] = lands[r.below(lands.len() as u32) as usize];
                cb[3] = if r.below(10) != 0 { 0 } else { [0xf7, 0xf8, 0xfb, 0xfd, 0xfe, 0xff, 3][r.below(7) as usize] };
                if r.below(10) != 0 {
                    cb[0xa] = 0;
                    cb[0xb] = 0;
                }
                if r.below(10) != 0 {
                    cb[0x1e] = 0;
                    cb[0x1f] = 0;
                }
                if r.below(5) != 0 {
                    cb[9] &= 0x07; // +0x508 word: kind bits 0xf800 clear
                }
                if r.below(3) == 0 {
                    cb[5] &= 0x92; // small L
                }
            }
        }
        let rend = random_bytes(&mut r, 0x1000);
        let writes = vec![(ebp - 0x100, frame), (SNAP, snap), (REND + 0x5f000, rend)];
        let regions = [(STACK, 0x2000), (SNAP, SNAP_LEN), (REND + 0x5f000, 0x1000)];
        let mut probe = (Cpu::new(), GuestMemory::new().unwrap());
        load_image(&mut probe.1, &exe);
        for (a, d) in &writes {
            probe.1.write_bytes(*a, d);
        }
        probe.0.regs = regs;
        if let Some(k) = fast_tile::frame_tiles(&mut probe.0, &mut probe.1, budget) {
            longest = longest.max(k);
        }
        if check_in(&exe, fast_tile::frame_tiles, fast_tile::START, regs, eflags, &writes, budget, "frame_tiles", &regions)
        {
            ran += 1;
        }
    }
    let cov: Vec<u64> = fast_tile::COVER.iter().map(|c| c.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed)).collect();
    eprintln!("differential_frame_tiles: native ran {ran} of 400, longest {longest} instructions, rows/exits/stats/G/H {cov:?}");
    assert!(cov.iter().all(|&c| c > 20), "path not covered: {cov:?}");
    assert!(ran > 150, "too many declines: {ran}");
    assert!(longest > 2000, "runs too short: {longest}");
}

/// Pre-pass column loop (`fast_tile::land_mark`).
#[test]
fn differential_land_mark() {
    let Some(exe) = exe_bytes() else {
        eprintln!("differential_land_mark: S3.EXE not found, skipped");
        return;
    };
    const SNAP: u32 = 0x3600_0000;
    let mut r = Rng(0x0d1a_4b27_7e00_1c10);
    let mut ran = 0;
    for case in 0..300 {
        let budget = if case % 4 == 0 { 1 + r.below(300) as u64 } else { 1 << 30 };
        let eflags = 0x202 | (r.next() & 0x8D5);
        let mut regs: [u32; 8] = std::array::from_fn(|_| r.next());
        regs[EAX] = SNAP + 0x502 + 48 * r.below(130);
```
