`port/crates/s3-mods/src/tests.rs`:

```rs
//! Machine-level tests: hooks on hand-assembled guest code, post-call trampolines, guest calls, deferred
//! work, touch pipeline, overlay compose. No game bytes.

use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};

use iced_x86::code_asm::*;
use s3_cpu::{EBX, ECX, EDI, ESI};
use s3_mem::layout;
use s3_runtime::*;

use crate::*;

const CODE: u32 = 0x0040_1000;
const ADD2: u32 = 0x0040_2000; // stdcall add2(a, b)
const DBL: u32 = 0x0040_2100; // cdecl dbl(a)
const METHOD: u32 = 0x0040_2200; // thiscall: [ecx] + arg, ret 4
const OBJ: u32 = 0x0050_0000;

#[derive(Default)]
struct Frames(Vec<FrameBuffer>);

struct TestHost {
    data: std::path::PathBuf,
    frames: Arc<Mutex<Frames>>,
    start: std::time::Instant,
}

impl Host for TestHost {
    fn present(&mut self, fb: &FrameBuffer) {
        self.frames.lock().unwrap().0.push(fb.clone());
    }
    fn poll_events(&mut self) -> Vec<HostEvent> {
        Vec::new()
    }
    fn now_ms(&self) -> u64 {
        self.start.elapsed().as_millis() as u64
    }
    fn game_dir(&self) -> std::path::PathBuf {
        self.data.clone()
    }
    fn data_dir(&self) -> std::path::PathBuf {
        self.data.clone()
    }
    fn log(&self, _l: LogLevel, _m: &str) {}
}

fn asm(m: &mut Machine, at: u32, build: impl FnOnce(&mut CodeAssembler)) {
    let mut a = CodeAssembler::new(32).unwrap();
    build(&mut a);
    let bytes = a.assemble(at as u64).unwrap();
    m.mem.write_bytes(at, &bytes);
}

fn h_exit(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    ThunkResult::Exit(m.arg_u32(0))
}

/// Machine with test functions and a main program; returns (machine, frames, address of `mov edi, eax`).
fn machine(tag: &str) -> (Machine, Arc<Mutex<Frames>>) {
    let d = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("s3mods-test-{tag}-{}", std::process::id()));
    let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&d);
    std::fs::create_dir_all(&d).unwrap();
    let frames = Arc::new(Mutex::new(Frames::default()));
    let host = TestHost { data: d, frames: frames.clone(), start: std::time::Instant::now() };
    let mut m = Machine::new(Box::new(host)).unwrap();
    m.mem.alloc_region(Some(layout::IMAGE_BASE), 0x20_0000, s3_mem::RegionKind::Image, (0, 0)).unwrap();
    m.setup_process(layout::IMAGE_BASE, 0x20_0000, CODE, 0x10_0000, "TEST.EXE");
    let exit = m.registry.register("test.dll", "exit", h_exit);
    asm(&mut m, ADD2, |a| {
        a.mov(eax, dword_ptr(esp + 4)).unwrap();
        a.add(eax, dword_ptr(esp + 8)).unwrap();
        a.ret_1(8).unwrap();
    });
    asm(&mut m, DBL, |a| {
        a.mov(eax, dword_ptr(esp + 4)).unwrap();
        a.add(eax, eax).unwrap();
        a.ret().unwrap();
    });
    asm(&mut m, METHOD, |a| {
        a.mov(eax, dword_ptr(ecx)).unwrap();
        a.add(eax, dword_ptr(esp + 4)).unwrap();
        a.ret_1(4).unwrap();
    });
    m.mem.write_u32(OBJ, 1000);
    asm(&mut m, CODE, |a| {
        a.push(7).unwrap();
        a.push(5).unwrap();
        a.mov(eax, ADD2).unwrap();
        a.call(eax).unwrap();
        a.mov(ebx, eax).unwrap();
        a.push(3).unwrap();
        a.mov(eax, DBL).unwrap();
        a.call(eax).unwrap();
        a.add(esp, 4).unwrap();
        a.mov(esi, eax).unwrap(); // CODE + 0x1c (checked below)
        a.mov(ecx, OBJ).unwrap();
        a.push(10).unwrap();
        a.mov(eax, METHOD).unwrap();
        a.call(eax).unwrap();
        a.mov(edi, eax).unwrap();
        a.push(0x42).unwrap();
        a.mov(eax, exit).unwrap();
        a.call(eax).unwrap();
    });
    m.create_thread(CODE, 0, 0x10_000, false).unwrap();
    install(&mut m, b"not the real exe");
    (m, frames)
}

fn run(m: &mut Machine) {
    for _ in 0..100 {
        if m.run_slice(1_000_000) == SliceResult::Stopped {
            assert_eq!(m.stop_reason(), Some(&StopReason::Exited(0x42)), "{:?}", m.stop_reason());
            return;
        }
    }
    panic!("did not stop");
}

/// Address of the `mov esi, eax` instruction in the main program.
fn mov_esi_addr(m: &Machine) -> u32 {
    let bytes = m.mem.read_bytes(CODE, 0x40);
    let mut dec = iced_x86::Decoder::with_ip(32, &bytes, CODE as u64, 0);
    for ins in &mut dec {
        if ins.code() == iced_x86::Code::Mov_rm32_r32 || ins.code() == iced_x86::Code::Mov_r32_rm32 {
            if ins.op0_register() == iced_x86::Register::ESI {
                return ins.ip32();
            }
        }
    }
    panic!("mov esi not found");
}

#[test]
fn unhooked_baseline() {
    let (mut m, _) = machine("base");
    assert!(m.hook_addrs().is_none(), "unknown exe: no hooks");
    run(&mut m);
    let r = m.threads[0].cpu.regs;
    assert_eq!((r[EBX], r[ESI], r[EDI]), (12, 6, 1010));
}

#[test]
fn skip_function_post_call_and_mid_block_hook() {
    let (mut m, _) = machine("hooks");
    add_hook(&mut m, ADD2, "skip", |c| {
        assert_eq!((c.arg(0), c.arg(1)), (5, 7));
        c.return_from_function(100, 2)
    });
    add_hook(&mut m, DBL, "post", |c| {
        c.on_return(|p| {
            assert_eq!(p.eax, 6);
            let v = p.eax + 1000;
            p.set_eax(v);
        });
        HookFlow::Continue
    });
    let seen = Arc::new(Mutex::new(0u32));
    let s2 = seen.clone();
    let at = mov_esi_addr(&m);
    add_hook(&mut m, at, "mid", move |c| {
        *s2.lock().unwrap() = c.reg(s3_cpu::EAX);
        HookFlow::Continue
    });
    hooks::commit(&mut m);
    run(&mut m);
    let r = m.threads[0].cpu.regs;
    assert_eq!(r[EBX], 100, "skipped add2");
    assert_eq!(r[ESI], 1006, "post-call changed eax");
    assert_eq!(r[EDI], 1010);
    assert_eq!(*seen.lock().unwrap(), 1006, "mid-block hook ran before mov esi");
    let stats = hooks::hook_stats(&mut m);
    assert!(stats.iter().all(|(_, _, hits)| *hits == 1), "{stats:?}");
    assert!(m.stats.hooks >= 3);
}

#[test]
fn guest_calls_from_hook_and_deferred_safe_point() {
    let (mut m, _) = machine("calls");
    let got = Arc::new(Mutex::new(Vec::new()));
    let g2 = got.clone();
    let inside = Arc::new(std::sync::atomic::AtomicBool::new(false));
    add_hook(&mut m, DBL, "call", move |c| {
        // Hooks fire again for guest calls made from the hook itself: guard against recursion.
        if inside.swap(true, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::SeqCst) {
            g2.lock().unwrap().push((0, 0, 0, 0));
            return HookFlow::Continue;
        }
        let ecx_before = c.reg(ECX);
        let a = call::call_stdcall(c.m, ADD2, &[2, 3]);
        let b = call::call_cdecl(c.m, DBL, &[21]); // nested: the hook itself fires again (inner call)
        let t = call::call_thiscall(c.m, METHOD, OBJ, &[5]);
        let v = call::call_virtual(c.m, OBJ + 0x10, 0, &[1]);
        assert_eq!(c.reg(ECX), ecx_before, "thiscall must not leak ECX");
        g2.lock().unwrap().push((a, b, t, v));
        inside.store(false, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::SeqCst);
        HookFlow::Continue
    });
    // Virtual table for call_virtual: object at OBJ+0x10 -> vtbl at OBJ+0x20 -> METHOD; [obj] is the vtbl
    // pointer, so METHOD reads [ecx] = vtbl address.
    m.mem.write_u32(OBJ + 0x10, OBJ + 0x20);
    m.mem.write_u32(OBJ + 0x20, METHOD);
    let ran = Arc::new(Mutex::new(0u32));
    let r2 = ran.clone();
    let at = mov_esi_addr(&m);
    add_hook(&mut m, at, "safe", |_| HookFlow::Continue);
    add_safe_point(&mut m, at);
    defer(&mut m, move |m| {
        *r2.lock().unwrap() = call::call_stdcall(m, ADD2, &[40, 2]);
    });
    hooks::commit(&mut m);
    run(&mut m);
    let v = got.lock().unwrap().clone();
    // Outer hook call: (5, 42, 1005, OBJ+0x20+1); the inner DBL call re-entered the hook once (guarded).
    assert_eq!(v, vec![(0, 0, 0, 0), (5, 42, 1005, OBJ + 0x20 + 1)]);
    assert!(v.contains(&(5, 42, 1005, OBJ + 0x20 + 1)), "{v:?}");
    assert_eq!(*ran.lock().unwrap(), 42);
    let r = m.threads[0].cpu.regs;
    assert_eq!((r[EBX], r[ESI], r[EDI]), (12, 6, 1010), "guest results unchanged");
}

fn pointer(m: &mut Machine, id: u32, phase: PointerPhase, x: i32, y: i32) -> Vec<HostEvent> {
    let f = m.ext.event_filter.unwrap();
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    f(m, HostEvent::Pointer { id, phase, x, y, wx: -1, wy: -1 }, &mut out);
    out
}

struct Button {
    hits: Arc<Mutex<Vec<String>>>,
}

impl Mod for Button {
    fn name(&self) -> &str {
        "button"
    }
    fn on_touch(&mut self, _m: &mut Machine, ev: &TouchEvent) -> ModEvent {
        match *ev {
            TouchEvent::Down { x, .. } if x < 50.0 => {
                self.hits.lock().unwrap().push("down".into());
                ModEvent::Consumed
            }
            TouchEvent::Up { .. } | TouchEvent::Move { .. } => {
                self.hits.lock().unwrap().push(format!("{ev:?}"));
                ModEvent::Pass
            }
            _ => ModEvent::Pass,
        }
    }
    fn wants_draw_frame(&self) -> bool {
        true
    }
    fn draw(&mut self, _m: &mut Machine, c: &mut Canvas) {
        c.fill_rect(0, 0, 4, 4, Rgba::rgb(255, 0, 0));
    }
}

#[test]
fn touch_pipeline_fallback_and_capture() {
    let (mut m, frames) = machine("touch");
    // Tap on the "map" -> fallback left click.
    let out1 = pointer(&mut m, 1, PointerPhase::Down, 300, 200);
    assert!(out1.is_empty(), "{out1:?}");
    let out = pointer(&mut m, 1, PointerPhase::Up, 301, 200);
    assert_eq!(out, vec![HostEvent::MouseMove { x: 300, y: 200 }, HostEvent::MouseButton { button: MouseButton::Left, down: true }]);
    std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(70));
    m.run_slice(10); // service drains the delayed button-up into m.input
    assert!(!m.input.buttons[0]);
    // A mod button captures pointers that start on it.
    let hits = Arc::new(Mutex::new(Vec::new()));
    add_mod(&mut m, Box::new(Button { hits: hits.clone() }));
    assert!(pointer(&mut m, 2, PointerPhase::Down, 10, 10).is_empty());
    assert!(pointer(&mut m, 2, PointerPhase::Move, 200, 10).is_empty(), "captured: no drag");
    assert!(pointer(&mut m, 2, PointerPhase::Up, 200, 10).is_empty(), "captured: no tap");
    let h = hits.lock().unwrap().clone();
    assert_eq!(h.len(), 3, "{h:?}");
    // Overlay: the mod draws on presented frames.
    let fb = FrameBuffer::new(8, 8);
    m.present(&fb);
    let f = frames.lock().unwrap().0.last().cloned().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(f.pixels[0], 0xF800);
    assert_eq!(f.pixels[7 * 8 + 7], 0);
    assert_eq!(m.last_frame_size(), (8, 8));
    // Keys pass through untouched.
    let f = m.ext.event_filter.unwrap();
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    f(&mut m, HostEvent::Key { vk: 0x1B, down: true }, &mut out);
    assert_eq!(out, vec![HostEvent::Key { vk: 0x1B, down: true }]);
}
```

`port/crates/s3-mods/src/touch.rs`:

```rs
//! Context-aware touch for the GOG S3.EXE (W3, docs/porting/touch.md), shared by both UI modes.
//!
//! A [`Mod`] that sits just above the touch->mouse fallback. In game it turns gestures into what a player means:
//!
//! | Gesture | In game |
//! | --- | --- |
//! | tap own unit / building | select (left click, enlarged hit box) |
//! | tap ground / enemy with units selected | move / attack (quick right click = the game's own command 9 path) |
//! | tap in build placement | place; tap ✕ / two-finger tap = cancel |
//! | tap panel / minimap | left click |
//! | double tap own soldier | select the same type nearby (Ctrl + click) |
//! | two-finger tap | cancel placement, deselect building / units |
//! | one- or two-finger drag on the map | scroll the camera with the finger, with inertia |
//! | long press, then drag | box selection (left drag) |
//! | long press | hover (tooltip); never a right click |
//! | pinch | zoom = the game's resolution (640x480 / 800x600 / 1024x768, F1..F3) |
//!
//! Outside a game (menus) only long press changes (hover instead of a right click) and long-press drags become
//! left drags; everything else goes to the fallback mapping. The in-game test is a hook on
//! `CLogicThread::HandleInput` (runs every logic tick) plus the layout globals matching the presented frame.

use s3_runtime::{FrameBuffer, HookFlow, HostEvent, Machine, MouseButton};

use crate::gesture::{Phase, TouchEvent};
use crate::layer::Layer;
use crate::overlay::Rgba;
use crate::touch_fx::{self as fx, Fx};
use crate::touch_game as game;
use crate::touch_logic::{self as logic, CameraPan, DragKind, Layout, Mode, TapAction, View};
use crate::{Mod, ModEvent, ModsState};

/// Updated by the `HandleInput` hook.
#[derive(Default)]
pub struct TouchGame {
    pub last_logic_tick_ms: u64,
    pub ticks: u64,
}

/// A logic tick within this many ms means a game is running.
const IN_GAME_MS: u64 = 1500;
/// Long-press progress ring starts after this many ms.
const PRESS_SHOW_MS: u64 = 150;

/// Install the context-aware touch mod (GOG exe only; called by [`crate::install`]).
pub fn install(m: &mut Machine) -> Result<(), String> {
    if m.mem.read_bytes(game::HANDLE_INPUT, 4).iter().all(|&b| b == 0) {
        return Err(format!("touch-context: no code at {:#x}", game::HANDLE_INPUT));
    }
    crate::hooks::add_hook(m, game::HANDLE_INPUT, "touch-context:logic-tick", |c| {
        let logic = c.reg(s3_cpu::ECX);
        game::note_logic(c.m, logic);
        let now = c.m.real_ms();
        let st = c.m.state::<TouchGame>();
        let mut g = st.borrow_mut();
        g.last_logic_tick_ms = now;
        g.ticks += 1;
        HookFlow::Continue
    });
    crate::add_mod(m, Box::new(ContextTouch::default()));
    Ok(())
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
enum Drag {
    Camera,
    Left,
    /// Finger dragged over the minimap: the game reacts to a button press there (jump), not to moves with the
    /// button held, so the drag re-presses at the finger every [`MINIMAP_REPRESS_MS`] (last press time).
    Minimap(u64),
    /// Box selection from `a` to `b` (screen).
    Box { a: (f32, f32), b: (f32, f32) },
}

#[derive(Default)]
pub struct ContextTouch {
    now: u64,
    in_game: bool,
    /// Light view (layout, mode, selection; no hit list) refreshed every tick.
    view: View,
    fx: Vec<Fx>,
    cam: CameraPan,
    /// Camera value we last wrote (to notice the game moving the camera itself).
    cam_written: Option<(i32, i32)>,
    drag: Option<Drag>,
    /// Finger down on the map, waiting for a long press: (x, y, t0).
    press: Option<(f32, f32, u64)>,
    long_press_ms: u64,
    pinch_done: bool,
    /// Zoom = render resolution levels (res-zoom); used instead of F1-F3 when the custom resolution is on.
    zoom: crate::zoom::Pinch,
    draw_wanted: bool,
}

fn with_fallback<R>(m: &mut Machine, f: impl FnOnce(&mut crate::fallback::TouchMouse) -> R) -> R {
    let st = m.state::<ModsState>();
    let mut s = st.borrow_mut();
    f(&mut s.fallback)
}

fn click(m: &mut Machine, t: u64, x: i32, y: i32, b: MouseButton) {
    with_fallback(m, |f| f.click(t, (x, y), b));
}

fn key(m: &mut Machine, t: u64, vk: u32) {
    with_fallback(m, |f| {
        f.push(t, HostEvent::Key { vk, down: true });
        let c = f.click_ms();
        f.push(t + c, HostEvent::Key { vk, down: false });
    });
}

fn mouse(m: &mut Machine, t: u64, e: HostEvent) {
    with_fallback(m, |f| f.push(t, e));
}

/// Minimap drag: re-press interval (the game jumps on a press there, see [`Drag::Minimap`]).
const MINIMAP_REPRESS_MS: u64 = 50;

fn pt(x: f32, y: f32) -> (i32, i32) {
    (x.round() as i32, y.round() as i32)
}

impl ContextTouch {
    fn refresh(&mut self, m: &mut Machine) {
        let recent = {
            let st = m.state::<TouchGame>();
            let g = st.borrow_mut();
            g.ticks > 0 && self.now.saturating_sub(g.last_logic_tick_ms) < IN_GAME_MS
        };
        let frame = m.state::<ModsState>().borrow_mut().frame_size;
        self.view = if recent { game::view(m, frame, false) } else { View::default() };
        self.in_game = self.view.layout.is_some();
    }

    fn layout(&self) -> Layout {
        self.view.layout.unwrap_or(Layout::GOG_640)
    }

    fn camera_now(&self, m: &Machine) -> (f32, f32) {
        match game::gd(m) {
            Some(gd) => {
                let (x, y) = game::camera(m, gd);
                (x as f32, y as f32)
            }
            None => (0.0, 0.0),
        }
    }

    fn write_camera(&mut self, m: &mut Machine) {
        let Some(gd) = game::gd(m) else { return };
        let l = self.layout();
        let (x, y) = logic::clamp_camera(self.cam.pos.0, self.cam.pos.1, game::world_size(m, gd), l.map_w, l.map_h);
        if (x, y) != self.cam.pos {
            self.cam.set_pos((x, y));
        }
        let v = (x.round() as i32, y.round() as i32);
        if std::env::var_os("S3_TOUCH_TRACE").is_some() {
            eprintln!("touch: t={} cam mem={:?} last={:?} -> {:?}", self.now, game::camera(m, gd), self.cam_written, v);
        }
        game::set_camera(m, gd, v.0, v.1);
        self.cam_written = Some(v);
    }

    fn exec(&mut self, m: &mut Machine, a: TapAction, tap: (f32, f32)) {
        let now = self.now;
        let ripple = |c: Rgba| Fx::Ripple { x: tap.0, y: tap.1, t0: now, color: c };
        match a {
            TapAction::Click { x, y } => {
                click(m, now, x, y, MouseButton::Left);
                self.fx.push(ripple(fx::TAP));
            }
            TapAction::Command { x, y, attack } => {
                // Quick down+up: the game ignores right-ups held >= 15 game steps (0x53437d).
                click(m, now, x, y, MouseButton::Right);
                let cam = self.camera_now(m);
                self.fx.push(ripple(if attack { fx::ATTACK } else { fx::MOVE }));
                self.fx.push(Fx::Flag { wx: x as f32 + cam.0, wy: y as f32 + cam.1, t0: now, attack });
            }
            TapAction::RightClick { x, y } => {
                click(m, now, x, y, MouseButton::Right);
                self.fx.push(ripple(fx::CANCEL));
            }
            TapAction::CancelBuild => {
                if let Some(gd) = game::gd(m) {
                    game::cancel_build(m, gd);
                }
                self.fx.push(ripple(fx::CANCEL));
            }
            TapAction::Deselect => {
                if let Some(gd) = game::gd(m) {
                    game::deselect(m, gd);
                }
                self.fx.push(ripple(fx::CANCEL));
            }
            TapAction::SelectSameType { x, y } => {
                // After the second tap's click (its button-up is CLICK_MS later).
                let c = with_fallback(m, |f| f.click_ms());
                let t = now + c + 20;
                mouse(m, t, HostEvent::Key { vk: 0x11, down: true });
                click(m, t + 10, x, y, MouseButton::Left);
                mouse(m, t + 10 + c + 10, HostEvent::Key { vk: 0x11, down: false });
                self.fx.push(ripple(fx::SELECT));
            }
            TapAction::Nothing => {}
        }
    }

    fn left_drag(&mut self, m: &mut Machine, phase: Phase, start: (f32, f32), cur: (f32, f32)) {
        let now = self.now;
        let (s, c) = (pt(start.0, start.1), pt(cur.0, cur.1));
        match phase {
            Phase::Begin => {
                mouse(m, now, HostEvent::MouseMove { x: s.0, y: s.1 });
                mouse(m, now, HostEvent::MouseButton { button: MouseButton::Left, down: true });
                mouse(m, now, HostEvent::MouseMove { x: c.0, y: c.1 });
            }
            Phase::Update => mouse(m, now, HostEvent::MouseMove { x: c.0, y: c.1 }),
            Phase::End => {
                mouse(m, now, HostEvent::MouseMove { x: c.0, y: c.1 });
                mouse(m, now, HostEvent::MouseButton { button: MouseButton::Left, down: false });
            }
        }
    }

    fn end_drag(&mut self, m: &mut Machine) {
        match self.drag.take() {
            Some(Drag::Left) | Some(Drag::Box { .. }) | Some(Drag::Minimap(_)) => {
                mouse(m, self.now, HostEvent::MouseButton { button: MouseButton::Left, down: false })
            }
            Some(Drag::Camera) => self.cam.release(self.now),
            None => {}
        }
    }

    fn pan(&mut self, m: &mut Machine, ev: &TouchEvent) -> ModEvent {
        let TouchEvent::Pan { phase, fingers, x, y, dx, dy, start_x, start_y, after_long_press } = *ev else {
            return ModEvent::Pass;
        };
        // A drag that starts on the minimap is always a left-button drag there (scroll the map), also after a long
        // press (holding the finger first used to start a box selection instead; user report 2026-11-08).
        let on_minimap = self.in_game && {
            let (sx, sy) = pt(start_x, start_y);
            self.layout().region(sx, sy) == logic::Region::Minimap
        };
        if fingers == 1 && (on_minimap || matches!(self.drag, Some(Drag::Minimap(_)))) {
            self.press = None;
            let now = self.now;
            let c = pt(x, y);
            match phase {
                Phase::Begin => {
                    self.left_drag(m, Phase::Begin, (start_x, start_y), (x, y));
                    self.drag = Some(Drag::Minimap(now));
                }
                Phase::Update => {
                    if let Some(Drag::Minimap(t)) = self.drag {
                        if now.saturating_sub(t) >= MINIMAP_REPRESS_MS {
                            mouse(m, now, HostEvent::MouseButton { button: MouseButton::Left, down: false });
                            mouse(m, now, HostEvent::MouseMove { x: c.0, y: c.1 });
                            mouse(m, now, HostEvent::MouseButton { button: MouseButton::Left, down: true });
                            self.drag = Some(Drag::Minimap(now));
                        } else {
                            mouse(m, now, HostEvent::MouseMove { x: c.0, y: c.1 });
                        }
                    }
                }
                Phase::End => {
                    mouse(m, now, HostEvent::MouseButton { button: MouseButton::Left, down: false });
                    mouse(m, now, HostEvent::MouseMove { x: c.0, y: c.1 });
                    mouse(m, now, HostEvent::MouseButton { button: MouseButton::Left, down: true });
                    mouse(m, now, HostEvent::MouseButton { button: MouseButton::Left, down: false });
                    self.drag = None;
                }
            }
            return ModEvent::Consumed;
        }
        if fingers == 1 && after_long_press {
            // Box selection in game, a plain left drag in menus.
            self.press = None;
            self.left_drag(m, phase, (start_x, start_y), (x, y));
            self.drag = match phase {
                Phase::End => None,
                _ if self.in_game => Some(Drag::Box { a: (start_x, start_y), b: (x, y) }),
                _ => Some(Drag::Left),
            };
            return ModEvent::Consumed;
        }
        if !self.in_game {
            return ModEvent::Pass;
        }
        match phase {
            Phase::Begin => {
                self.press = None;
                let (sx, sy) = pt(start_x, start_y);
                let kind = if fingers >= 2 { DragKind::Camera } else { logic::drag_kind(&self.layout(), sx, sy) };
                match kind {
                    DragKind::Camera => {
                        let p = self.camera_now(m);
                        self.cam.begin(p, self.now);
                        self.cam.drag(dx, dy, self.now);
                        self.write_camera(m);
                        self.drag = Some(Drag::Camera);
                    }
                    DragKind::LeftDrag => {
                        self.left_drag(m, phase, (start_x, start_y), (x, y));
                        self.drag = Some(Drag::Left);
                    }
                }
            }
            Phase::Update => match self.drag {
                Some(Drag::Camera) => {
                    self.cam.drag(dx, dy, self.now);
                    self.write_camera(m);
                }
                Some(Drag::Left) => self.left_drag(m, phase, (start_x, start_y), (x, y)),
                _ => {}
            },
            Phase::End => match self.drag {
                Some(Drag::Left) => {
                    self.left_drag(m, phase, (start_x, start_y), (x, y));
                    self.drag = None;
                }
                _ => self.end_drag(m),
            },
        }
        ModEvent::Consumed
    }
}

impl Mod for ContextTouch {
    fn name(&self) -> &str {
        "touch-context"
    }

    fn on_touch(&mut self, m: &mut Machine, ev: &TouchEvent) -> ModEvent {
        self.now = m.real_ms();
        let right_armed = m.state::<ModsState>().borrow_mut().fallback.right_next;
        match *ev {
            TouchEvent::Down { x, y, .. } => {
                self.cam.stop();
                self.refresh(m);
                let l = self.layout();
                let first = self.press.is_none() && self.drag.is_none();
                self.press = (first && self.in_game && l.region(x as i32, y as i32) == logic::Region::Map)
                    .then_some((x, y, self.now));
                ModEvent::Pass
            }
            TouchEvent::Move { x, y, .. } => {
                if let Some((px, py, _)) = self.press {
                    if ((x - px).powi(2) + (y - py).powi(2)).sqrt() > 8.0 {
                        self.press = None;
                    }
                }
                ModEvent::Pass
            }
            TouchEvent::Up { .. } => {
                self.press = None;
                ModEvent::Pass
            }
            TouchEvent::Cancel { .. } => {
                self.press = None;
                self.end_drag(m);
                ModEvent::Pass
            }
            // The legacy RMB button armed "next tap = right click": let the fallback do it.
            TouchEvent::Tap { .. } if right_armed => ModEvent::Pass,
            TouchEvent::Tap { x, y } => {
                self.press = None;
                let trace = std::env::var_os("S3_TOUCH_TRACE").is_some();
                if !self.in_game {
                    if trace {
                        let (ticks, last) = {
                            let st = m.state::<TouchGame>();
                            let g = st.borrow_mut();
                            (g.ticks, g.last_logic_tick_ms)
                        };
                        let frame = m.state::<ModsState>().borrow_mut().frame_size;
                        eprintln!(
                            "touch: tap ({x:.0},{y:.0}) not in game -> fallback (ticks {ticks} last {last} now {} frame {frame:?} gd {:?} layout {:?})",
                            self.now,
                            game::gd(m),
                            game::layout(m)
                        );
                    }
                    return ModEvent::Pass;
                }
                let frame = m.state::<ModsState>().borrow_mut().frame_size;
                let v = with_vis(m, game::view(m, frame, true));
                let (ix, iy) = pt(x, y);
                let a = logic::decide_tap(&v, ix, iy);
                if trace {
                    eprintln!("touch: tap ({ix},{iy}) mode {:?} -> {a:?}", v.mode);
                }
                self.exec(m, a, (x, y));
                ModEvent::Consumed
            }
            TouchEvent::DoubleTap { x, y } => {
                if !self.in_game {
                    return ModEvent::Pass;
                }
                let frame = m.state::<ModsState>().borrow_mut().frame_size;
                let v = with_vis(m, game::view(m, frame, true));
                let (ix, iy) = pt(x, y);
                let a = logic::decide_double_tap(&v, ix, iy);
                self.exec(m, a, (x, y));
                ModEvent::Consumed
            }
            TouchEvent::LongPress { x, y } => {
                if self.in_game {
                    crate::haptics::touch(m);
                }
                // Hover only (tooltips); a long press is never a right click (the game ignores long right clicks).
                // The press ring stays (full) while the finger rests: dragging now draws a selection box.
                let p = pt(x, y);
                mouse(m, self.now, HostEvent::MouseMove { x: p.0, y: p.1 });
                ModEvent::Consumed
            }
            TouchEvent::TwoFingerTap { x, y } => {
                if !self.in_game {
                    return ModEvent::Pass;
                }
                let (ix, iy) = pt(x, y);
                let a = logic::decide_two_finger_tap(&self.view, ix, iy);
                self.exec(m, a, (x, y));
                ModEvent::Consumed
            }
            TouchEvent::ThreeFingerTap { .. } => ModEvent::Pass,
            TouchEvent::Pan { .. } => self.pan(m, ev),
            TouchEvent::Pinch { phase, scale, cx, cy } => {
                // Continuous zoom through the render resolution levels (docs/porting/resolution-zoom.md). Checked
                // before `in_game`: while a zoom step settles the frame size differs from the layout for a moment.
                if crate::res::in_game(m) && crate::zoom::pinch(m, &mut self.zoom, phase, cx, cy, scale) {
                    self.cam.stop();
                    self.drag = None;
                    return ModEvent::Consumed;
                }
                if !self.in_game {
                    return ModEvent::Pass;
                }
                if phase == Phase::Begin {
                    self.pinch_done = false;
                }
                if std::env::var_os("S3_TOUCH_TRACE").is_some() {
                    eprintln!("touch: pinch {phase:?} scale {scale:.2} res {} done {}", self.layout().res_index, self.pinch_done);
                }
                if !self.pinch_done && phase != Phase::End {
                    if let Some(vk) = logic::pinch_zoom_key(scale, self.layout().res_index) {
                        self.pinch_done = true;
                        key(m, self.now, vk);
                        // The view size changes; do not glide afterwards.
                        self.cam.stop();
                        self.drag = None;
                    }
                }
                ModEvent::Consumed
            }
        }
    }

    fn tick(&mut self, m: &mut Machine, now: u64) {
        self.now = now;
        if self.long_press_ms == 0 {
            self.long_press_ms = m.state::<ModsState>().borrow_mut().settings.touch.long_press_ms.max(1);
        }
        self.refresh(m);
        if !self.in_game {
            self.cam.stop();
            self.drag = None;
            self.press = None;
        } else if self.cam.gliding() {
            let cur = game::gd(m).map(|gd| game::camera(m, gd));
            if cur.is_some() && cur != self.cam_written {
                // The game moved the camera (minimap, keys, resolution switch): stop gliding.
                self.cam.stop();
            } else if self.cam.step(now).is_some() {
                self.write_camera(m);
            }
        }
        self.fx.retain(|f| f.alive(now));
        self.draw_wanted = self.in_game
            && (!self.fx.is_empty()
                || self.drag.is_some()
                || self.press.is_some()
                || matches!(self.view.mode, Some(Mode::BuildPlacement))
                || !self.view.selected.is_empty());
    }

    fn wants_draw(&self) -> bool {
        self.draw_wanted
    }

    fn draw_window(&mut self, m: &mut Machine, c: &mut Layer, _frame: &FrameBuffer) {
        let frame = m.state::<ModsState>().borrow_mut().frame_size;
        let v = with_vis(m, game::view(m, frame, true));
        let Some(l) = v.layout else { return };
        let now = self.now;
        let vp = crate::draw_viewport(m);
        let u = c.ui();
        let to_win = |x: f32, y: f32| vp.game_to_window(x, y);
        // Map-only effects are clipped to the map view.
        let mx = to_win(l.panel_w as f32, 0.0).0.round() as i32;
        let (_, wy0, _, wh) = vp.dst_rect_clipped();
        c.set_clip(mx, wy0, c.width() as i32 - mx, wh);
        if !v.selected.is_empty() {
            let s = vp.scale().1;
            for h in v.hits.iter().filter(|h| h.own && !h.is_building() && v.selected.contains(&h.id)) {
                let (x, y) = to_win(h.x as f32, h.y as f32);
                fx::selection_marker(c, x, y, s);
            }
        }
        let cam = self.camera_now(m);
        for f in &self.fx {
            if matches!(f, Fx::Flag { .. }) {
                fx::draw(c, f, now, cam, &to_win, u);
            }
        }
        c.reset_clip();
        for f in &self.fx {
            if matches!(f, Fx::Ripple { .. }) {
                fx::draw(c, f, now, cam, &to_win, u);
            }
        }
        if let Some((x, y, t0)) = self.press {
            let age = now.saturating_sub(t0);
            if age >= PRESS_SHOW_MS {
                let k = (age - PRESS_SHOW_MS) as f32 / (self.long_press_ms.saturating_sub(PRESS_SHOW_MS).max(1)) as f32;
                let (x, y) = to_win(x, y);
                fx::press_progress(c, x, y, k.min(1.0), u);
            }
        }
        if let Some(Drag::Box { a, b }) = self.drag {
            fx::selection_box(c, to_win(a.0, a.1), to_win(b.0, b.1), u);
        }
        // Mode B (Mobile HUD) shows its own placement banner with Cancel; our ✕ would sit on its resource strip.
        let hud = m.state::<crate::ModsState>().borrow_mut().settings.ui_mode == crate::settings::UiMode::MobileHud;
        if v.mode == Some(Mode::BuildPlacement) && !hud {
            fx::cancel_button(c, cancel_window_rect(m), u, "Cancel");
        } else if matches!(v.mode, Some(Mode::UnitsSelected | Mode::BuildingSelected)) && !hud {
            fx::cancel_button(c, cancel_window_rect(m), u, "Deselect");
        }
    }
}

/// Window rectangle of the ✕ button (top right of the shown game area, below the FPS counter).
fn cancel_window_rect(m: &mut Machine) -> (i32, i32, i32, i32) {
    let vp = crate::draw_viewport(m);
    let top = match crate::display::display_settings(m).fps_counter {
        crate::display::FpsCounter::Off => 0.0,
        crate::display::FpsCounter::Fps => 22.0,
        crate::display::FpsCounter::Detailed => 62.0,
    };
    fx::cancel_rect(vp.dst_rect_clipped(), top, vp.win_h as f32 / 600.0)
}

/// Add the visible frame rect (display mode) and the ✕ button (drawn in the window layer, mapped back to game
/// pixels for the tap test) to a view.
fn with_vis(m: &mut Machine, mut v: View) -> View {
    let r = crate::display::visible_game_rect(m);
    v.vis = Some((r, 0));
    let vp = crate::draw_viewport(m);
    let (x, y, w, h) = cancel_window_rect(m);
    let (gx0, gy0) = vp.window_to_game_f(x as f32, y as f32);
    let (gx1, gy1) = vp.window_to_game_f((x + w) as f32, (y + h) as f32);
    v.cancel = Some((gx0.floor() as i32, gy0.floor() as i32, (gx1 - gx0).ceil() as i32, (gy1 - gy0).ceil() as i32));
    v.deselect_button = m.state::<crate::ModsState>().borrow_mut().settings.ui_mode == crate::settings::UiMode::ClassicTouch;
    v
}
```

`port/crates/s3-mods/src/touch_fx.rs`:

```rs
//! Visual touch feedback drawn into the window layer ([`crate::layer`]): tap ripples, move/attack target flags
//! (anchored to the map), selection rings under selected units, long-press progress, the box-selection rectangle
//! and the build placement cancel button.
//!
//! Effects are kept in game pixels (where the touch landed); drawing maps them to window pixels and sizes them with
//! `u` (window px per reference px = window height / 600), so they keep their on-screen size at every zoom level.
//! Selection rings hug the unit sprites and use the map scale instead.

use crate::layer::Layer;
use crate::overlay::{Rgba, Weight};

pub const RIPPLE_MS: u64 = 380;
pub const FLAG_MS: u64 = 1400;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
pub enum Fx {
    /// Expanding ring at a game-screen point.
    Ripple { x: f32, y: f32, t0: u64, color: Rgba },
    /// Flag at a world point (screen + camera at creation time).
    Flag { wx: f32, wy: f32, t0: u64, attack: bool },
}

impl Fx {
    fn t0(&self) -> u64 {
        match *self {
            Fx::Ripple { t0, .. } | Fx::Flag { t0, .. } => t0,
        }
    }
    fn life(&self) -> u64 {
        match self {
            Fx::Ripple { .. } => RIPPLE_MS,
            Fx::Flag { .. } => FLAG_MS,
        }
    }
    pub fn alive(&self, now: u64) -> bool {
        now.saturating_sub(self.t0()) < self.life()
    }
}

pub const TAP: Rgba = Rgba::rgba(255, 255, 255, 220);
pub const MOVE: Rgba = Rgba::rgba(90, 230, 90, 230);
pub const ATTACK: Rgba = Rgba::rgba(255, 70, 50, 235);
pub const CANCEL: Rgba = Rgba::rgba(255, 190, 60, 230);
pub const SELECT: Rgba = Rgba::rgba(120, 255, 120, 210);

/// Draw one effect. `cam` = current camera (world px) for map-anchored effects, `to_win` maps game pixels to
/// window pixels, `u` = UI scale.
pub fn draw(c: &mut Layer, fx: &Fx, now: u64, cam: (f32, f32), to_win: &dyn Fn(f32, f32) -> (f32, f32), u: f32) {
    let age = now.saturating_sub(fx.t0()) as f32 / fx.life() as f32;
    if age >= 1.0 {
        return;
    }
    match *fx {
        Fx::Ripple { x, y, color, .. } => {
            let (x, y) = to_win(x, y);
            let r = (6.0 + 22.0 * age.sqrt()) * u;
            c.ring(x, y, r, 3.0 * u, color.fade(1.0 - age));
            c.fill_circle(x, y, 4.0 * (1.0 - age) * u, color.fade(1.0 - age));
        }
        Fx::Flag { wx, wy, attack, .. } => {
            let (x, y) = to_win(wx - cam.0, wy - cam.1);
            let k = if age < 0.7 { 1.0 } else { 1.0 - (age - 0.7) / 0.3 };
            let col = if attack { ATTACK } else { MOVE };
            // Ground ring pulsing.
            let p = (age * 3.0).fract();
            c.ellipse_ring(x, y, (6.0 + 10.0 * p) * u, (3.0 + 5.0 * p) * u, 2.0 * u, col.fade(k * (1.0 - p)));
            c.ellipse_ring(x, y, 7.0 * u, 3.5 * u, 2.0 * u, col.fade(k));
            // Pole and pennant (drops in during the first 150 ms).
            let q = |v: f32| (v * u).round() as i32;
            let drop = (1.0 - age / 0.1).max(0.0) * 12.0;
            let (px, py) = (x as i32, (y - drop * u) as i32);
            c.fill_rect(px - q(2.0), py - q(34.0), q(3.0).max(1), q(34.0), Rgba::rgba(30, 22, 14, (235.0 * k) as u8));
            // Pennant pointing right (one column per reference pixel, scaled).
            let cols = q(16.0).max(1);
            for i in 0..cols {
                let f = i as f32 / u;
                let h = ((16.0 - f) * u).round() as i32;
                c.fill_rect(px + q(1.0) + i, py - q(34.0) + (f / 2.0 * u) as i32, 1, h, col.fade(k));
            }
            c.fill_rect(px + q(1.0), py - q(35.0), q(16.0), q(1.0).max(1), Rgba::rgba(0, 0, 0, (120.0 * k) as u8));
            if attack {
                c.text(px + q(4.0), py - q(33.0), 12.0 * u, Weight::Bold, Rgba::WHITE.fade(k), "!");
            }
        }
    }
}

/// Small ring under a selected unit (feet at window `x, y`); `s` = map scale (window px per game px).
pub fn selection_marker(c: &mut Layer, x: f32, y: f32, s: f32) {
    c.ellipse_ring(x, y + s, 10.0 * s, 4.5 * s, 2.0 * s.max(0.75), SELECT);
}

/// Long-press progress around the finger (window `x, y`, `k` 0..1); at 1 a box selection drag starts.
pub fn press_progress(c: &mut Layer, x: f32, y: f32, k: f32, u: f32) {
    let r = (34.0 - 16.0 * k) * u;
    c.ring(x, y, r, 3.0 * u, Rgba::rgba(255, 255, 255, (60.0 + 160.0 * k) as u8));
}

/// Box selection rectangle (window corners).
pub fn selection_box(c: &mut Layer, a: (f32, f32), b: (f32, f32), u: f32) {
    let (x0, y0) = (a.0.min(b.0) as i32, a.1.min(b.1) as i32);
    let (x1, y1) = (a.0.max(b.0) as i32, a.1.max(b.1) as i32);
    c.fill_rect(x0, y0, x1 - x0, y1 - y0, Rgba::rgba(120, 255, 120, 40));
    c.stroke_rect(x0, y0, x1 - x0, y1 - y0, (2.0 * u).round().max(1.0) as i32, SELECT);
}

/// Build placement cancel button (✕) at window rect `r`.
pub fn cancel_button(c: &mut Layer, r: (i32, i32, i32, i32), u: f32, label: &str) {
    let (x, y, w, h) = r;
    c.fill_rounded_rect(x, y, w, h, 10.0 * u, Rgba::rgba(30, 20, 10, 190));
    c.stroke_rounded_rect(x, y, w, h, 10.0 * u, 2.0 * u, CANCEL);
    // Diagonal cross from small discs (anti-aliased).
    let (cx, cy, s) = (x as f32 + w as f32 / 2.0, y as f32 + h as f32 / 2.0, w as f32 * 0.26);
    let n = 14;
    for i in 0..=n {
        let k = -1.0 + 2.0 * i as f32 / n as f32;
        c.fill_circle(cx + k * s, cy + k * s, 2.2 * u, Rgba::WHITE);
        c.fill_circle(cx + k * s, cy - k * s, 2.2 * u, Rgba::WHITE);
    }
    let px = 11.0 * u;
    let (tw, th) = crate::overlay::measure_text(px, Weight::Bold, label);
    let q = |v: f32| (v * u).round() as i32;
    let lx = (x + w / 2 - tw / 2).min(c.width() as i32 - tw - q(2.0));
    c.fill_rounded_rect(lx - q(4.0), y + h + q(3.0), tw + q(8.0), th + q(3.0), 4.0 * u, Rgba::rgba(0, 0, 0, 150));
    c.text(lx, y + h + q(4.0), px, Weight::Bold, CANCEL, label);
}

/// Window rectangle of the ✕ button: top right of the shown game area, below the FPS counter (`fps_top` reference
/// px), 40 reference px.
pub fn cancel_rect(vis: (i32, i32, i32, i32), fps_top: f32, u: f32) -> (i32, i32, i32, i32) {
    let s = (40.0 * u).round() as i32;
    let (vx, vy, vw, _) = vis;
    (vx + vw - s - (8.0 * u).round() as i32, vy + ((8.0 + fps_top) * u).round() as i32, s, s)
}

```

`port/crates/s3-mods/src/touch_game.rs`:

```rs
//! GOG S3.EXE memory access for context-aware touch (addresses: docs/reverse-engineering/game-state-units.md and
//! game-state-ui.md; GOG sha256 `00a925cf…` only). Reads build a [`View`]; writes are limited to UI state
//! (camera, build slot, selection) that the game itself keeps per client.

use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU32, Ordering};

use s3_runtime::Machine;

use crate::touch_logic::{Hit, Layout, Mode, View};

/// `CGameData*` global (= `[logic+0x3a0]`); 0 before the first game. VERIFIED (s3run: `0x18790000`).
pub const GD_PTR: u32 = 0x007e_3408;
/// `CGameData` vtable.
pub const GD_VTABLE: u32 = 0x0065_8c18;
/// `CLogicThread::HandleInput` (thiscall logic), runs every logic tick while a game is running.
pub const HANDLE_INPUT: u32 = 0x0052_4fa0;

// gd offsets
const CAM_X: u32 = 0x2d25c;
const CAM_Y: u32 = 0x2d260;
const PANEL_DIRTY: u32 = 0x2d27c;
const PAGE: u32 = 0x2d284;
const BUILD_SLOT: u32 = 0x2d28c;
const WORLD: u32 = 0x2d2d0;
const LOCAL_PLAYER: u32 = 0x2d2d4;
const SETTLERS: u32 = 0x12a5e60;
const SETTLERS_MAX: u32 = 0x12a5e5c;
const BUILDINGS: u32 = 0x1499e64;
const BUILDINGS_MAX: u32 = 0x1499e60;

// globals
const LAYOUT: u32 = 0x0073_0f08;
const HITS: u32 = 0x007a_de08;
const HITS_COUNT: u32 = 0x007d_fd5c;
const HITS_BUF: u32 = 0x007d_fd64;
const SEL_SLOT: u32 = 0x007d_fd68;
const SEL_BUILDING: u32 = 0x007d_fd6c;
const SEL_COUNT: u32 = 0x007a_d620;
const SEL_IDS: u32 = 0x007a_d634;
const SEL_DIRTY: u32 = 0x007a_d5f8;
/// Hit list capacity (space up to the next global).
const HITS_MAX: u32 = 4096;

/// `CLogicThread` -> `CGameData*` offset.
pub const LOGIC_GD: u32 = 0x3a0;
/// `[logic+0x3a0]` seen by the last `HandleInput` call (see [`note_logic`]).
static LOGIC_GD_SEEN: AtomicU32 = AtomicU32::new(0);

/// Record the logic object's game data (call from a `HandleInput` hook, ECX = logic).
/// In a multiplayer game the global `GD_PTR` stays 0 (VERIFIED 2026-11-05, ux-verify1, joiner and host), but
/// `[logic+0x3a0]` holds the CGameData (ui-classic reads it there), so this is the fallback.
pub fn note_logic(m: &Machine, logic: u32) {
    if logic >= 0x1_0000 {
        LOGIC_GD_SEEN.store(m.mem.read_u32(logic.wrapping_add(LOGIC_GD)), Ordering::Relaxed);
    }
}

fn valid_gd(m: &Machine, gd: u32) -> bool {
    gd >= 0x1_0000 && m.mem.virtual_query(gd).state == s3_mem::MEM_COMMIT && m.mem.read_u32(gd) == GD_VTABLE
}

/// Game data pointer, if a game has been created: the global, else the one of the logic thread (multiplayer).
pub fn gd(m: &Machine) -> Option<u32> {
    let gd = m.mem.read_u32(GD_PTR);
    if valid_gd(m, gd) {
        return Some(gd);
    }
    let gd = LOGIC_GD_SEEN.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
    valid_gd(m, gd).then_some(gd)
}

/// Screen layout globals (`0x4c6d70`).
pub fn layout(m: &Machine) -> Option<Layout> {
    let r = |o: u32| m.mem.read_u32(LAYOUT + o) as i32;
    let l = Layout {
        res_index: r(0),
        screen_w: r(4),
        screen_h: r(8),
        map_w: r(0x10),
        map_h: r(0x14),
        panel_w: r(0x1c),
        mm_x: r(0x24),
        mm_bottom: r(0x2c),
    };
    // panel_w == 0 is valid: UI mode B (Mobile HUD) patches the layout to a full-screen map (ui-hud.md).
    ((1..=3).contains(&l.res_index) && l.screen_w > 0 && l.panel_w >= 0 && l.panel_w < l.screen_w).then_some(l)
}

pub fn local_player(m: &Machine, gd: u32) -> u8 {
    m.mem.read_u32(gd + LOCAL_PLAYER) as u8
}

/// UI selection (settler ids).
pub fn selection(m: &Machine) -> Vec<u16> {
    let slot = m.mem.read_u32(SEL_SLOT) as i32;
    if !(0..10).contains(&slot) {
        return Vec::new();
    }
    let n = (m.mem.read_u16(SEL_COUNT + slot as u32 * 2) as u32).min(100);
    (0..n).map(|i| m.mem.read_u16(SEL_IDS + slot as u32 * 200 + i * 2)).collect()
}

fn owner(m: &Machine, gd: u32, kind: u16, id: u16) -> Option<u8> {
    if kind == 100 {
        (id as u32 <= m.mem.read_u32(gd + BUILDINGS_MAX)).then(|| m.mem.read_u8(gd + BUILDINGS + id as u32 * 0x3a))
    } else {
        (id as u32 <= m.mem.read_u32(gd + SETTLERS_MAX)).then(|| m.mem.read_u8(gd + SETTLERS + id as u32 * 0x40))
    }
}

/// Selectable things drawn on screen (hit list, current buffer as read by the click handler).
pub fn hits(m: &Machine, gd: u32) -> Vec<Hit> {
    let n = m.mem.read_u32(HITS_COUNT).min(HITS_MAX);
    let buf = m.mem.read_u32(HITS_BUF) & 1;
    let me = local_player(m, gd);
    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(n as usize);
    for i in 0..n {
        let a = HITS + (buf + 2 * i) * 10;
        let kind = m.mem.read_u16(a);
        let id = m.mem.read_u16(a + 6);
        if kind == 0 || id == 0 {
            continue;
        }
        let own = owner(m, gd, kind, id) == Some(me);
        out.push(Hit { kind, x: m.mem.read_u16(a + 2) as i16 as i32, y: m.mem.read_u16(a + 4) as i16 as i32, id, own });
    }
    out
}

/// Interaction mode (game-state-ui.md §3).
pub fn mode(m: &Machine, gd: u32) -> Mode {
    let page = m.mem.read_u32(gd + PAGE);
    if page == 9 {
        Mode::Paused
    } else if page == 1 && m.mem.read_u32(gd + BUILD_SLOT) != 0 {
        Mode::BuildPlacement
    } else if page == 4 && m.mem.read_u32(SEL_BUILDING) != 0 {
        Mode::BuildingSelected
    } else if selection_count(m) > 0 {
        Mode::UnitsSelected
    } else {
        Mode::Normal
    }
}

pub fn selection_count(m: &Machine) -> u32 {
    let slot = m.mem.read_u32(SEL_SLOT) as i32;
    if !(0..10).contains(&slot) {
        return 0;
    }
    m.mem.read_u16(SEL_COUNT + slot as u32 * 2) as u32
}

/// Full snapshot (`frame` = size of the presented frame; the layout must match it, else we are not in game).
pub fn view(m: &Machine, frame: (u32, u32), with_hits: bool) -> View {
    let Some(gd) = gd(m) else { return View::default() };
    let Some(l) = layout(m) else { return View::default() };
    if (l.screen_w as u32, l.screen_h as u32) != frame {
        return View::default();
    }
    View {
        layout: Some(l),
        mode: Some(mode(m, gd)),
        hits: if with_hits { hits(m, gd) } else { Vec::new() },
        selected: selection(m),
        vis: None,
        cancel: None,
        deselect_button: false,
    }
}

pub fn camera(m: &Machine, gd: u32) -> (i32, i32) {
    (m.mem.read_u32(gd + CAM_X) as i32, m.mem.read_u32(gd + CAM_Y) as i32)
}

pub fn set_camera(m: &mut Machine, gd: u32, x: i32, y: i32) {
    m.mem.write_u32(gd + CAM_X, x as u32);
    m.mem.write_u32(gd + CAM_Y, y as u32);
}

pub fn world_size(m: &Machine, gd: u32) -> i32 {
    m.mem.read_u32(gd + WORLD) as i32
}

/// Leave build placement: slot 0 + panel dirty (what the right-click handler does). VERIFIED by re-ui pokes.
pub fn cancel_build(m: &mut Machine, gd: u32) {
    m.mem.write_u32(gd + BUILD_SLOT, 0);
    m.mem.write_u32(gd + PANEL_DIRTY, 1);
}

/// Clear the UI unit selection (count 0, dirty so the logic copy is re-synced by the next command, panel page 0).
pub fn deselect(m: &mut Machine, gd: u32) {
    let slot = m.mem.read_u32(SEL_SLOT) as i32;
    if slot == 0 {
        m.mem.write_u16(SEL_COUNT, 0);
        m.mem.write_u32(SEL_DIRTY, 1);
    } else if (1..10).contains(&slot) {
        // A control group (unit_orders): keep its members, only leave it, like the game's own deselect click
        // (`0x534178`: slot = -1).
        m.mem.write_u32(SEL_SLOT, u32::MAX);
    }
    if m.mem.read_u32(gd + PAGE) == 5 {
        m.mem.write_u32(gd + PAGE, 0);
    }
    m.mem.write_u32(gd + PANEL_DIRTY, 1);
}

```

`port/crates/s3-mods/src/touch_logic.rs`:

```rs
//! Pure decision logic for context-aware touch (W3, docs/porting/touch.md). No machine access, unit tested.
//!
//! [`View`] is a snapshot of the game state that matters for touch (built by `touch_game` from GOG S3.EXE
//! memory); [`decide_tap`] / [`decide_two_finger_tap`] turn a gesture into a [`TapAction`]. Camera panning with
//! inertia is [`CameraPan`]; pinch -> resolution switch is [`pinch_zoom_key`].

/// Screen layout of the running game (globals `0x730f0c..0x730f34`, docs/reverse-engineering/game-state-ui.md §1).
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Layout {
    pub screen_w: i32,
    pub screen_h: i32,
    /// x < panel_w is the left panel (or the minimap).
    pub panel_w: i32,
    /// Minimap origin x (sheared parallelogram), bottom y.
    pub mm_x: i32,
    pub mm_bottom: i32,
    /// Map view width/height (`screen - panel`).
    pub map_w: i32,
    pub map_h: i32,
    /// Resolution index + 1 (1 = 640x480, 2 = 800x600, 3 = 1024x768).
    pub res_index: i32,
}

impl Layout {
    pub const GOG_640: Layout =
        Layout { screen_w: 640, screen_h: 480, panel_w: 136, mm_x: 5, mm_bottom: 142, map_w: 504, map_h: 480, res_index: 1 };
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Region {
    Panel,
    Minimap,
    Map,
}

impl Layout {
    /// Where a screen point is. The minimap is a parallelogram whose right edge leans right by
    /// `(mm_bottom - y)/2` (the game's own hit test, `0x52537b`).
    pub fn region(&self, x: i32, y: i32) -> Region {
        if y < self.mm_bottom {
            let d = (self.mm_bottom - y) / 2;
            if x < self.panel_w + d && x > self.mm_x + d {
                return Region::Minimap;
            }
        }
        if x < self.panel_w {
            Region::Panel
        } else {
            Region::Map
        }
    }
}

/// Interaction mode derived from the panel page and selections (game-state-ui.md §3).
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Mode {
    Normal,
    /// Page 1 with a building chosen: the next map click places a site.
    BuildPlacement,
    /// Page 4: a building is selected.
    BuildingSelected,
    /// Units in the UI selection.
    UnitsSelected,
    /// Page 9.
    Paused,
}

/// Something selectable drawn on screen (entry of the hit list `0x7ade08`).
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Hit {
    /// 100 = building, 1..9 / 40 / 50.. = soldiers and other selectable settlers.
    pub kind: u16,
    /// Screen position (the unit's feet).
    pub x: i32,
    pub y: i32,
    pub id: u16,
    /// Owned by the local player.
    pub own: bool,
}

impl Hit {
    pub fn is_building(&self) -> bool {
        self.kind == 100
    }
}

/// Touch-relevant game state.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, PartialEq)]
pub struct View {
    pub layout: Option<Layout>,
    pub mode: Option<Mode>,
    pub hits: Vec<Hit>,
    /// UI selection (settler ids).
    pub selected: Vec<u16>,
    /// Visible part of the frame and extra top margin (FPS counter) for the ✕ button (docs/porting/display.md:
    /// Fill mode crops the frame). `None` = whole frame.
    pub vis: Option<((i32, i32, i32, i32), i32)>,
    /// The ✕ button as drawn (window layer, mapped back to game pixels); overrides the `vis` placement.
    pub cancel: Option<(i32, i32, i32, i32)>,
    /// The ✕ is also shown while units or a building are selected (UI mode A: "Deselect"; the original panel
    /// had no other way than a right click, user report 2026-11-08).
    pub deselect_button: bool,
}

/// What a touch does in game.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum TapAction {
    /// Left click at a point (select, place, panel button, minimap).
    Click { x: i32, y: i32 },
    /// Quick right click at a point with units selected: the game's move / attack command.
    Command { x: i32, y: i32, attack: bool },
    /// Quick right click (deselects a building).
    RightClick { x: i32, y: i32 },
    /// Leave build placement (slot := 0).
    CancelBuild,
    /// Clear the unit selection.
    Deselect,
    /// Ctrl + left click: select units of the same type around a unit.
    SelectSameType { x: i32, y: i32 },
    /// Do nothing (but the gesture is handled).
    Nothing,
}

/// Game hit box around a click (left-button-up handler `0x5339a1`): x ±10, feet `y-5 ..= y+32`.
pub const GAME_HIT: (i32, i32, i32) = (10, 5, 32);
/// Touch hit box (bigger fingers): x ±18, feet `y-12 ..= y+44`.
pub const TOUCH_HIT: (i32, i32, i32) = (18, 12, 44);
/// A click this far above a unit's feet is inside the game's own hit box.
pub const CLICK_ABOVE_FEET: i32 = 12;

/// Best hit-list entry under a finger at (x, y): own entries first, then nearest to the body centre.
pub fn find_hit(hits: &[Hit], x: i32, y: i32) -> Option<Hit> {
    let (hx, up, down) = TOUCH_HIT;
    hits.iter()
        .filter(|h| (h.x - x).abs() <= hx && h.y >= y - up && h.y <= y + down)
        .min_by_key(|h| {
            let (dx, dy) = (h.x - x, h.y - CLICK_ABOVE_FEET - 4 - y);
            (!h.own, dx * dx + dy * dy)
        })
        .copied()
}

/// Cancel button (✕) shown in build placement mode: top-right corner of the map view.
pub fn cancel_button(l: &Layout) -> (i32, i32, i32, i32) {
    cancel_button_in(l, None)
}

/// [`cancel_button`] inside the visible part of the frame (`View::vis`).
pub fn cancel_button_in(l: &Layout, vis: Option<((i32, i32, i32, i32), i32)>) -> (i32, i32, i32, i32) {
    let s = 40;
    match vis {
        Some(((vx, vy, vw, _), top)) => ((vx + vw).min(l.screen_w) - s - 8, vy + 8 + top, s, s),
        None => (l.screen_w - s - 8, 8, s, s),
    }
}

fn inside(r: (i32, i32, i32, i32), x: i32, y: i32) -> bool {
    x >= r.0 && y >= r.1 && x < r.0 + r.2 && y < r.1 + r.3
}

/// One-finger tap.
pub fn decide_tap(v: &View, x: i32, y: i32) -> TapAction {
    let (Some(l), Some(mode)) = (v.layout, v.mode) else { return TapAction::Click { x, y } };
    if mode == Mode::BuildPlacement && inside(v.cancel.unwrap_or_else(|| cancel_button_in(&l, v.vis)), x, y) {
        return TapAction::CancelBuild;
    }
    if v.deselect_button
        && matches!(mode, Mode::UnitsSelected | Mode::BuildingSelected)
        && inside(v.cancel.unwrap_or_else(|| cancel_button_in(&l, v.vis)), x, y)
    {
        // Same as a two-finger tap there (deselect units / right click deselects the building).
        return decide_two_finger_tap(v, x, y);
    }
    if l.region(x, y) != Region::Map {
        // Panel buttons / minimap: the game handles them (choosing another slot or tab also ends placement).
        return TapAction::Click { x, y };
    }
    match mode {
        Mode::Paused | Mode::BuildPlacement => TapAction::Click { x, y },
        _ => {
            let hit = find_hit(&v.hits, x, y);
            let at = |h: Hit| (h.x, h.y - CLICK_ABOVE_FEET);
            match hit {
                Some(h) if h.own => {
                    let (cx, cy) = at(h);
                    TapAction::Click { x: cx, y: cy }
                }
                Some(h) if mode == Mode::UnitsSelected => {
                    let (cx, cy) = at(h);
                    TapAction::Command { x: cx, y: cy, attack: true }
                }
                None if mode == Mode::UnitsSelected => TapAction::Command { x, y, attack: false },
                _ => TapAction::Click { x, y },
            }
        }
    }
}

/// Second tap of a double tap (the first two taps were already handled by [`decide_tap`]).
pub fn decide_double_tap(v: &View, x: i32, y: i32) -> TapAction {
    let (Some(l), Some(mode)) = (v.layout, v.mode) else { return TapAction::Nothing };
    if l.region(x, y) != Region::Map || matches!(mode, Mode::Paused | Mode::BuildPlacement) {
        return TapAction::Nothing;
    }
    match find_hit(&v.hits, x, y) {
        Some(h) if h.own && !h.is_building() => TapAction::SelectSameType { x: h.x, y: h.y - CLICK_ABOVE_FEET },
        _ => TapAction::Nothing,
    }
}

/// Two-finger tap = "cancel / back".
pub fn decide_two_finger_tap(v: &View, x: i32, y: i32) -> TapAction {
    match v.mode {
        Some(Mode::BuildPlacement) => TapAction::CancelBuild,
        Some(Mode::BuildingSelected) => {
            let l = v.layout.unwrap_or(Layout::GOG_640);
            // A right click on the map deselects the building (right-up handler, page 4).
            let (x, y) = if l.region(x, y) == Region::Map { (x, y) } else { (l.panel_w + l.map_w / 2, l.screen_h / 2) };
            TapAction::RightClick { x, y }
        }
        Some(Mode::UnitsSelected) => TapAction::Deselect,
        _ => TapAction::Nothing,
    }
}

/// What a one-finger drag starting at (x, y) does in game.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum DragKind {
    /// Scroll the map with the finger.
    Camera,
    /// Left-button drag (panel controls, minimap).
    LeftDrag,
}

pub fn drag_kind(l: &Layout, x: i32, y: i32) -> DragKind {
    if l.region(x, y) == Region::Map {
        DragKind::Camera
    } else {
        DragKind::LeftDrag
    }
}

/// Pinch thresholds: closing the fingers to this scale zooms out one step (more map), opening zooms in.
pub const PINCH_OUT_SCALE: f32 = 0.75;
pub const PINCH_IN_SCALE: f32 = 1.33;

/// Key (F1/F2/F3 = VK 0x70..0x72) that switches the game resolution for a pinch of `scale`, if any.
/// Zoom levels are the game's resolutions: 640x480 (closest) .. 1024x768 (most map; the frontend scales the
/// frame to the screen).
pub fn pinch_zoom_key(scale: f32, res_index: i32) -> Option<u32> {
    let target = if scale <= PINCH_OUT_SCALE {
        res_index + 1
    } else if scale >= PINCH_IN_SCALE {
        res_index - 1
    } else {
        return None;
    };
    (1..=3).contains(&target).then(|| 0x70 + (target - 1) as u32)
}

/// Camera bounds (clamp `0x51b4d0`): `x <= 24*W + 0x167 - mapW`, `y <= 9*W + 0x176 - mapW` (sic: the game
/// uses the view width for both).
pub fn clamp_camera(x: f32, y: f32, world: i32, map_w: i32, map_h: i32) -> (f32, f32) {
    let mx = (24 * world + 0x167 - map_w).max(0) as f32;
    // The game uses map_w here too (bug); gog-base patches 0x51b528 to use the view height, so do we.
    let my = (9 * world + 0x176 - map_h).max(0) as f32;
    (x.clamp(0.0, mx), y.clamp(0.0, my))
}

/// Finger-driven camera with inertia (world pixels; pure, the caller writes the result to the game).
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default)]
pub struct CameraPan {
    pub pos: (f32, f32),
    /// px/ms, camera direction.
    pub vel: (f32, f32),
    pub dragging: bool,
    last_t: u64,
    /// Recent (time, position) samples for the release velocity (several events can share a timestamp, e.g.
    /// both fingers of a two-finger pan, so the velocity is measured over a window, not per event).
    samples: Vec<(u64, (f32, f32))>,
}

/// Inertia decays with this time constant (ms).
pub const INERTIA_TAU_MS: f32 = 300.0;
/// Below this speed (px/ms) inertia stops.
pub const INERTIA_MIN: f32 = 0.02;
/// A release slower than this (px/ms) does not glide (a controlled drag stops where the finger lifts).
pub const FLING_MIN: f32 = 0.25;
/// Max fling speed (px/ms).
pub const INERTIA_MAX: f32 = 4.0;
/// Velocity window (ms).
pub const VELOCITY_WINDOW_MS: u64 = 80;

impl CameraPan {
    pub fn begin(&mut self, pos: (f32, f32), t: u64) {
        self.pos = pos;
        self.vel = (0.0, 0.0);
        self.dragging = true;
        self.last_t = t;
        self.samples.clear();
        self.samples.push((t, pos));
    }

    /// The finger moved by (dx, dy) screen pixels: the camera moves the other way (content follows the finger).
    pub fn drag(&mut self, dx: f32, dy: f32, t: u64) {
        self.pos.0 -= dx;
        self.pos.1 -= dy;
        self.last_t = t;
        self.samples.push((t, self.pos));
        let keep = t.saturating_sub(VELOCITY_WINDOW_MS * 2);
        if self.samples.len() > 2 && self.samples[0].0 < keep {
            self.samples.retain(|s| s.0 >= keep);
        }
    }

    /// The camera position was clamped (or changed) by the caller.
    pub fn set_pos(&mut self, p: (f32, f32)) {
        if let Some(s) = self.samples.last_mut() {
            s.1 = p;
        }
        self.pos = p;
    }

    /// Finger lifted: keep gliding if it was flung.
    pub fn release(&mut self, t: u64) {
        self.dragging = false;
        self.vel = (0.0, 0.0);
        self.last_t = t;
        let Some(&(t1, p1)) = self.samples.last() else { return };
        if t.saturating_sub(t1) > VELOCITY_WINDOW_MS {
            return; // the finger rested before lifting
        }
        // Position at the start of the window (last sample at or before it, else the oldest one).
        let from = t1.saturating_sub(VELOCITY_WINDOW_MS);
        let Some(&(t0, p0)) = self.samples.iter().rev().find(|s| s.0 <= from).or(self.samples.first()) else { return };
        if t0 >= t1 {
            return;
        }
        let dt = (t1 - t0).max(8) as f32;
        let (mut vx, mut vy) = ((p1.0 - p0.0) / dt, (p1.1 - p0.1) / dt);
        let s = (vx * vx + vy * vy).sqrt();
        if s < FLING_MIN {
            return;
        }
        if s > INERTIA_MAX {
            vx *= INERTIA_MAX / s;
            vy *= INERTIA_MAX / s;
        }
        self.vel = (vx, vy);
    }

    pub fn gliding(&self) -> bool {
        !self.dragging && (self.vel.0 != 0.0 || self.vel.1 != 0.0)
    }

    /// Stop gliding (the game moved the camera itself, a new touch...).
    pub fn stop(&mut self) {
        self.vel = (0.0, 0.0);
        self.dragging = false;
    }

    /// Advance inertia to `t`; returns the new position while gliding.
    pub fn step(&mut self, t: u64) -> Option<(f32, f32)> {
        if !self.gliding() {
            return None;
        }
        let dt = t.saturating_sub(self.last_t) as f32;
        if dt <= 0.0 {
            return None;
        }
        self.last_t = t;
        // Exact integral of v*e^(-t/tau) over dt.
        let decay = (-dt / INERTIA_TAU_MS).exp();
        let f = INERTIA_TAU_MS * (1.0 - decay);
        self.pos.0 += self.vel.0 * f;
        self.pos.1 += self.vel.1 * f;
        self.vel = (self.vel.0 * decay, self.vel.1 * decay);
        if (self.vel.0.powi(2) + self.vel.1.powi(2)).sqrt() < INERTIA_MIN {
            self.vel = (0.0, 0.0);
        }
        Some(self.pos)
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn view(mode: Mode, hits: Vec<Hit>) -> View {
        View { layout: Some(Layout::GOG_640), mode: Some(mode), hits, selected: vec![], vis: None, cancel: None, deselect_button: false }
    }
    const OWN_SOLDIER: Hit = Hit { kind: 1, x: 300, y: 300, id: 41, own: true };
    const ENEMY: Hit = Hit { kind: 2, x: 500, y: 200, id: 90, own: false };
    const OWN_TOWER: Hit = Hit { kind: 100, x: 400, y: 150, id: 1, own: true };

    #[test]
    fn regions_640() {
        let l = Layout::GOG_640;
        assert_eq!(l.region(50, 300), Region::Panel);
        assert_eq!(l.region(60, 60), Region::Minimap);
        // Sheared right edge of the minimap: at y=10 it reaches x = 136 + 66.
        assert_eq!(l.region(190, 10), Region::Minimap);
        assert_eq!(l.region(190, 140), Region::Map);
        assert_eq!(l.region(400, 300), Region::Map);
    }

    #[test]
    fn tap_without_game_state_is_a_click() {
        assert_eq!(decide_tap(&View::default(), 10, 20), TapAction::Click { x: 10, y: 20 });
    }

    #[test]
    fn tap_on_own_unit_selects_inside_game_hit_box() {
        let v = view(Mode::Normal, vec![OWN_SOLDIER, ENEMY]);
        // Finger 15 px left of and 30 px above the feet: outside the game's own box, inside ours.
        let a = decide_tap(&v, 285, 270);
        assert_eq!(a, TapAction::Click { x: 300, y: 288 });
        let TapAction::Click { x, y } = a else { unreachable!() };
        let (hx, up, down) = GAME_HIT;
        assert!((OWN_SOLDIER.x - x).abs() <= hx && OWN_SOLDIER.y >= y - up && OWN_SOLDIER.y <= y + down);
    }

        assert_eq!(decide_tap(&v, 505, 180), TapAction::Command { x: 500, y: 188, attack: true });
        assert_eq!(decide_tap(&v, 300, 290), TapAction::Click { x: 300, y: 288 });

        assert_eq!(decide_tap(&v, 60, 60), TapAction::Click { x: 60, y: 60 });
```
