```rs
        assert_eq!(pinch_zoom_key(0.6, 2), Some(0x72)); // 800 -> 1024
        assert_eq!(pinch_zoom_key(0.6, 3), None);
        assert_eq!(pinch_zoom_key(1.5, 3), Some(0x71));
        assert_eq!(pinch_zoom_key(1.5, 1), None);
        assert_eq!(pinch_zoom_key(1.0, 2), None);
    }

    #[test]
    fn camera_clamp() {
        assert_eq!(clamp_camera(-5.0, -1.0, 384, 504, 480), (0.0, 0.0));
        assert_eq!(clamp_camera(1e6, 1e6, 384, 504, 480), ((24 * 384 + 0x167 - 504) as f32, (9 * 384 + 0x176 - 480) as f32));
        assert_eq!(clamp_camera(100.0, 200.0, 384, 504, 480), (100.0, 200.0));
        // Wide view on a small map: the y range must not collapse (tutorial bug, 2026-11-07).
        assert!(clamp_camera(0.0, 1e6, 128, 2000, 780).1 > 300.0);
    }

    #[test]
    fn camera_follows_finger_and_glides() {
        let mut c = CameraPan::default();
        c.begin((1000.0, 500.0), 0);
        for i in 1..=10 {
            c.drag(5.0, -2.0, i * 16);
        }
        assert_eq!(c.pos, (950.0, 520.0));
        c.release(165);
        assert!(c.gliding());
        let mut last = c.pos;
        let mut t = 165;
        while c.gliding() && t < 10_000 {
            t += 16;
            let p = c.step(t).unwrap();
            assert!(p.0 < last.0 && p.1 > last.1, "keeps moving the same way");
            last = p;
        }
        assert!(!c.gliding(), "inertia stops");
        // Total glide ~ v*tau = (5/16)*300 ~ 94 px.
        assert!((950.0 - last.0) > 60.0 && (950.0 - last.0) < 100.0, "{last:?}");
    }

    #[test]
    fn two_finger_samples_with_equal_timestamps_give_the_real_speed() {
        // Each finger's move arrives as its own half-step Pan update at the same time.
        let mut c = CameraPan::default();
        c.begin((0.0, 0.0), 0);
        for i in 1..=10u64 {
            c.drag(2.5, 0.0, i * 16);
            c.drag(2.5, 0.0, i * 16);
        }
        c.release(161);
        let v = c.vel.0;
        assert!((v + 5.0 / 16.0).abs() < 0.02, "{v}");
        // A slow drag does not glide.
        let mut c = CameraPan::default();
        c.begin((0.0, 0.0), 0);
        for i in 1..=10u64 {
            c.drag(1.0, 0.0, i * 16);
        }
        c.release(161);
        assert!(!c.gliding());
    }

    #[test]
    fn camera_no_glide_after_resting_finger() {
        let mut c = CameraPan::default();
        c.begin((0.0, 0.0), 0);
        c.drag(10.0, 0.0, 16);
        c.release(300);
        assert!(!c.gliding());
        assert_eq!(c.step(400), None);
    }
}

```

`port/crates/s3-mods/src/ui_classic.rs`:

```rs
//! UI mode A "Classic Touch" (docs/porting/ui-classic.md): the original panel and screens, made
//! finger-friendly without replacing them.
//!
//! - **Panel taps with a magnifier**: a finger on the left panel (below the minimap) is captured. While it is
//!   down, a bubble right of the panel shows the area under the finger enlarged 3x plus the button's name in
//!   large text; the button that will be pressed is outlined. The finger may slide to correct the choice.
//!   On lift, a left click is sent to the **centre** of that button (taps in the gaps between buttons snap
//!   to the nearest button on pages whose layout we know). Sliding far out of the panel cancels.
//! - **Floating Menu button** (top right of the map): opens/closes the in-game Save/Quit menu (panel page 7)
//!   by writing the panel state at the logic thread's `HandleInput` entry (ESC is not a hotkey in S3).
//! - **Context chip**: top left of the map, the current context ("Place: Woodcutter's Hut", "14 selected",
//!   the selected building's name). The build-placement ✕ Cancel button is drawn by the context-aware touch
//!   mod (`touch.rs`, top right), shared by both UI modes, so the Menu button sits bottom right.
//!
//! Active when `settings.ui_mode == ClassicTouch` (override with `S3_UI_MODE=A|classic|B|hud|off`), in game,
//! and only for the GOG exe (all addresses are for GOG S3.EXE `00a925cf…`). Map touches are not touched
//! here: they go on to the context-aware input / fallback mapping.
//!
//! Everything is drawn into the window layer ([`crate::layer`], window pixels, sizes in units of a 600 px high
//! window), so the floating buttons, chip and bubble keep their on-screen size at every zoom level; the panel
//! itself is shown at a constant scale by the frontend ([`crate::display::PanelSplit`]).

#[path = "ui_classic_panel.rs"]
pub mod panel;

use s3_cpu::ECX;
use s3_runtime::{FrameBuffer, HostEvent, LogLevel, Machine, MouseButton};

use crate::gesture::TouchEvent;
use crate::layer::Layer;
use crate::overlay::{measure_text, Rgba, Weight};
use crate::{settings::UiMode, Mod, ModEvent, ModsState};
use panel::{Button, Label, Layout, PanelState};

/// GOG addresses (game-state-ui.md / game-state-units.md).
pub mod gog {
    /// `CLogicThread::HandleInput`, thiscall logic; runs on the logic thread every tick in game.
    pub const HANDLE_INPUT: u32 = 0x0052_4fa0;
    /// Render screen object ctor (thiscall gfx); `[gfx+0x5f6b8]` = string table.
    pub const GFX_CTOR: u32 = 0x0042_c820;
    pub const GFX_STRTAB: u32 = 0x5f6b8;
    /// `[logic+0x3a0]` = game data `gd`.
    pub const LOGIC_GD: u32 = 0x3a0;
    /// `[logic+0x3d0]` = render snapshot; `snap+0x270` = tooltip text id (-1 none).
    pub const LOGIC_SNAP: u32 = 0x3d0;
    pub const SNAP_TOOLTIP: u32 = 0x270;
    /// CGameData vtable (sanity check).
    pub const GD_VTABLE: u32 = 0x0065_8c18;
    pub const GD_PANEL_DIRTY: u32 = 0x2d27c;
    pub const GD_PAGE: u32 = 0x2d284;
    pub const GD_CATEGORY: u32 = 0x2d288;
    pub const GD_SLOT: u32 = 0x2d28c;
    pub const GD_SUBPAGE: u32 = 0x2d298;
    pub const GD_BUILD_TYPE: u32 = 0x2d2f0;
    pub const GD_LOCAL_PLAYER: u32 = 0x2d2d4;
    pub const GD_PLAYERS: u32 = 0x11943e0;
    pub const PLAYER_SIZE: u32 = 0x148;
    pub const GD_BUILDINGS: u32 = 0x1499e64;
    pub const BUILDING_SIZE: u32 = 0x3a;
    /// UI selection: slot `[SEL_SLOT]` (-1 none), count `u16 [SEL_COUNT + slot*2]`.
    pub const SEL_SLOT: u32 = 0x7dfd68;
    pub const SEL_COUNT: u32 = 0x7ad620;
    /// Selected building id (0 none).
    pub const SEL_BUILDING: u32 = 0x7dfd6c;
    /// `CLogicThread` click sound `0x53f560(id)` thiscall logic; 0x3d = panel click (STATIC).
    pub const PLAY_SOUND: u32 = 0x0053_f560;
}

/// Hook / state name.
pub const NAME: &str = "ui-classic";

/// UI changes queued by the mod and applied on the logic thread at `HandleInput` entry.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Action {
    /// Open the Save/Quit menu (page 7, sub-page 0).
    OpenMenu,
    /// Close it again (back to the previous page, or none).
    CloseMenu,
}

/// State shared between the hooks (logic thread) and the mod (input/overlay).
#[derive(Default)]
pub struct ClassicShared {
    pub logic: u32,
    pub gd: u32,
    pub gfx: u32,
    /// Host ms of the last `HandleInput` call (in-game detection).
    pub last_input_ms: u64,
    pub handle_input_hits: u64,
    pub pending: Vec<Action>,
    /// Page before the menu was opened.
    prev_page: u32,
    /// Hooks installed (GOG exe).
    pub hooked: bool,
}

/// Install mode A: hooks (GOG exe only) and the mod. Called by [`crate::install`] before the hook commit.
pub fn install(m: &mut Machine, gog: bool) {
    if gog {
        crate::add_hook(m, gog::GFX_CTOR, NAME, |c| {
            let gfx = c.reg(ECX);
            c.m.state::<ClassicShared>().borrow_mut().gfx = gfx;
            s3_runtime::HookFlow::Continue
        });
        crate::add_hook(m, gog::HANDLE_INPUT, NAME, |c| {
            let logic = c.reg(ECX);
            on_handle_input(c.m, logic);
            s3_runtime::HookFlow::Continue
        });
        m.state::<ClassicShared>().borrow_mut().hooked = true;
    }
    crate::add_mod(m, Box::new(ClassicTouch::new()));
}

fn valid_gd(m: &Machine, gd: u32) -> bool {
    gd >= 0x1_0000 && m.mem.read_u32(gd) == gog::GD_VTABLE
}

fn on_handle_input(m: &mut Machine, logic: u32) {
    let now = m.real_ms();
    let st = m.state::<ClassicShared>();
    let gd = m.mem.read_u32(logic.wrapping_add(gog::LOGIC_GD));
    let pending = {
        let mut s = st.borrow_mut();
        s.logic = logic;
        s.gd = gd;
        s.last_input_ms = now;
        s.handle_input_hits += 1;
        if s.pending.is_empty() {
            return;
        }
        std::mem::take(&mut s.pending)
    };
    if !valid_gd(m, gd) {
        return;
    }
    for a in pending {
        let page = m.mem.read_u32(gd + gog::GD_PAGE);
        match a {
            Action::OpenMenu => {
                if page != 7 {
                    st.borrow_mut().prev_page = page;
                }
                m.mem.write_u32(gd + gog::GD_PAGE, 7);
                m.mem.write_u32(gd + gog::GD_SUBPAGE, 0);
            }
            Action::CloseMenu => {
                let prev = std::mem::take(&mut st.borrow_mut().prev_page);
                let back = if matches!(prev, 1..=3) { prev } else { 0 };
                m.mem.write_u32(gd + gog::GD_PAGE, back);
                m.mem.write_u32(gd + gog::GD_SUBPAGE, 0);
            }
        }
        m.mem.write_u32(gd + gog::GD_PANEL_DIRTY, 1);
        // Click feedback like the original panel buttons (thiscall logic, (sound id)).
        crate::call::call_thiscall(m, gog::PLAY_SOUND, logic, &[0x3d]);
        m.log(LogLevel::Debug, &format!("ui-classic: {a:?} (page {page})"));
    }
}

/// Snapshot of the game UI read per event/frame.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, Default)]
struct GameView {
    layout: Option<Layout>,
    panel: PanelState,
    slot: u32,
    build_type: u8,
    sel_units: u32,
    sel_building_type: Option<u8>,
    tooltip: Option<u32>,
}

/// One finger on the panel.
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
struct PanelTouch {
    id: u32,
    x: f32,
    y: f32,
    /// Chosen button (index into `buttons`).
    target: Option<usize>,
    buttons: Vec<Button>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
enum FloatBtn {
    Menu,
    /// Shown while the menu is open: the game's own Save / Quit page (panel page 7).
    GameMenu,
    /// Shown while the menu is open: switch to UI mode B (the HUD's menu has the way back).
    HudMode,
    /// Shown while the menu is open: cycle the FPS counter (docs/porting/display.md).
    Fps,
    /// Shown while the menu is open: cycle the game frame limit (30 / 60 / 120 / 144 / display rate).
    FpsLimit,
    /// Shown while the menu is open: move the FPS counter to the next corner / edge.
    FpsPos,
    /// Shown while the menu is open: cycle the display filter (Pixel / Smooth / Sharp / xBR / AI).
    Filter,
    /// Always (single-player game): normal <-> chosen fast speed, left of Menu.
    Speed,
    /// Shown while the menu is open: choose the fast speed (2x..8x).
    SpeedChoice,
    /// Shown while the menu is open: game time display on / off.
    GameTime,
    /// Shown while the menu is open: cycle the display mode (Fit / Fill / Stretch / Native wide).
    Screen,
    /// Shown while the menu is open: zoom in / out one level (render resolution, docs/porting/resolution-zoom.md).
    ZoomIn,
    ZoomOut,
    /// Shown while the menu is open: paths of all ordered units / only the selected ones (`crate::unit_orders`).
    UnitPaths,
    /// Shown while the menu is open: group buttons 1..6 on / off.
    Groups,
    /// Shown while the menu is open: vibration all / touch / messages / off.
    Vibration,
}

/// The mode A mod.
pub struct ClassicTouch {
    env_mode: Option<bool>,
    active: bool,
    in_game: bool,
    view: GameView,
    touch: Option<PanelTouch>,
    pressed: Option<(u32, FloatBtn, bool)>,
    /// Our floating Menu is open: the column of extra buttons (Save / Quit, UI mode, FPS, filter, zoom...).
    /// Independent of the game's Save / Quit page: Menu no longer opens that page by itself, "Save / Quit" in the
    /// column does; the panel's own computer icon opens just the game's page (user reports 2026-11-08).
    float_open: bool,
    /// Speed button state (chosen fast speed label, running fast) while it can be changed, refreshed each tick.
    speed: Option<(String, bool)>,
    /// Delayed host events (click button-up).
    queue: Vec<(u64, HostEvent)>,
    texts: std::collections::HashMap<u32, Option<String>>,
    dirty: bool,
    logged_active: bool,
    /// Window rectangle that shows the game (`Viewport::dst_rect_clipped`), the UI scale (window height / 600) and
    /// the display settings, for the floating buttons (window layer).
    vis: Option<(i32, i32, i32, i32)>,
    ui: f32,
    disp: crate::display::DisplaySettings,
}

/// Snap radius in panel grid cells (3 px per cell at 640x480 -> 12 px).
const SNAP_CELLS: f32 = 4.0;
/// Sliding this far right of the panel cancels the panel tap.
const CANCEL_MARGIN: f32 = 48.0;
const CLICK_MS: u64 = 60;
/// In game = `HandleInput` ran within this time.
const IN_GAME_MS: u64 = 1500;

const BG: Rgba = Rgba::rgba(20, 16, 10, 200);
const GOLD: Rgba = Rgba::rgb(236, 196, 92);

impl ClassicTouch {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        let env_mode = std::env::var("S3_UI_MODE").ok().map(|v| {
            let v = v.to_ascii_lowercase();
            matches!(v.as_str(), "a" | "classic" | "classictouch" | "classic-touch")
        });
        ClassicTouch {
            env_mode,
            active: false,
            in_game: false,
            view: GameView::default(),
            touch: None,
            pressed: None,
            float_open: false,
            speed: None,
            queue: Vec::new(),
            texts: Default::default(),
            dirty: false,
            logged_active: false,
            vis: None,
            ui: 1.0,
            disp: crate::display::DisplaySettings::default(),
        }
    }

    fn read_view(&mut self, m: &mut Machine) {
        let (gd, logic, last, hooked) = {
            let st = m.state::<ClassicShared>();
            let s = st.borrow_mut();
            (s.gd, s.logic, s.last_input_ms, s.hooked)
        };
        let frame = m.last_frame_size();
        let vp = crate::draw_viewport(m);
        // Window rect: the shown frame's rect changes with the zoom (crop) and must not move the buttons.
        self.vis = Some((0, 0, vp.win_w as i32, vp.win_h as i32));
        self.ui = vp.win_h as f32 / 600.0;
        self.disp = crate::display::display_settings(m);
        let any_layout = Layout::read(&m.mem);
        // During a zoom step the layout globals already have the next size while the old frame is shown: stay in
        // game with the last matching layout (the panel is the same 640x480 variant at every size), so the floating
        // Menu / speed buttons do not blink (user report 2026-11-08).
        let layout = any_layout
            .filter(|l| (l.screen_w as u32, l.screen_h as u32) == frame)
            .or_else(|| self.view.layout.filter(|_| any_layout.is_some() && crate::res::in_game_frame(m)));
        self.in_game = hooked
            && layout.is_some()
            && valid_gd(m, gd)
            && m.real_ms().saturating_sub(last) < IN_GAME_MS;
        if !self.in_game {
            self.view = GameView::default();
            return;
        }
        let mem = &m.mem;
        let rd = |o: u32| mem.read_u32(gd + o);
        let player = rd(gog::GD_LOCAL_PLAYER).min(7);
        let race = mem.read_u8(gd + gog::GD_PLAYERS + player * gog::PLAYER_SIZE).min(3);
        let page = rd(gog::GD_PAGE);
        let slot_sel = mem.read_i32(gog::SEL_SLOT);
        let sel_units = if page == 5 && (0..10).contains(&slot_sel) {
            mem.read_u16(gog::SEL_COUNT + slot_sel as u32 * 2) as u32
        } else {
            0
        };
        let bid = mem.read_u32(gog::SEL_BUILDING);
        let sel_building_type = (page == 4 && (1..20000).contains(&bid))
            .then(|| mem.read_u8(gd + gog::GD_BUILDINGS + bid * gog::BUILDING_SIZE + 6));
        let snap = mem.read_u32(logic.wrapping_add(gog::LOGIC_SNAP));
        let tip = if snap >= 0x1_0000 { mem.read_u32(snap + gog::SNAP_TOOLTIP) } else { u32::MAX };
        self.view = GameView {
            layout,
            panel: PanelState { page, sub: rd(gog::GD_SUBPAGE), category: rd(gog::GD_CATEGORY), race },
            slot: rd(gog::GD_SLOT),
            build_type: rd(gog::GD_BUILD_TYPE) as u8,
            sel_units,
            sel_building_type,
            tooltip: (tip >> 16 == 8).then_some(tip),
        };
    }

    fn text(&mut self, m: &mut Machine, id: u32) -> Option<String> {
        if id == 0 {
            return None;
        }
        if let Some(t) = self.texts.get(&id) {
            return t.clone();
        }
        let gfx = m.state::<ClassicShared>().borrow_mut().gfx;
        if gfx < 0x1_0000 {
            return None;
        }
        let strtab = m.mem.read_u32(gfx + gog::GFX_STRTAB);
        let t = panel::read_text(&m.mem, strtab, id);
        if t.is_some() {
            self.texts.insert(id, t.clone());
        }
        t
    }

    fn label(&mut self, m: &mut Machine, l: Label) -> String {
        match l {
            Label::Text(id, en) => self.text(m, id).unwrap_or_else(|| en.to_string()),
            Label::Building(t) => self.building_name(m, t),
        }
    }

    fn building_name(&mut self, m: &mut Machine, t: u8) -> String {
        self.text(m, panel::building_text_id(t)).unwrap_or_else(|| format!("Building {t}"))
    }

    /// Window pixels for `v` units (1 unit = 1 px of a 600 px high window).
    fn q(&self, v: f32) -> i32 {
        (v * self.ui).round() as i32
    }

    /// Floating buttons: (kind, window rect).
    fn float_buttons(&self) -> Vec<(FloatBtn, (i32, i32, i32, i32))> {
        if self.view.layout.is_none() {
            return Vec::new();
        }
        // Bottom right of the map: the top right corner holds touch.rs' build-placement ✕ button.
        let (w, h) = (self.q(76.0), self.q(38.0));
        // Right / bottom edge of the part of the window showing the game (Fill mode crops the frame).
        let Some((vx, vy, vw, vh)) = self.vis.filter(|r| r.2 > 0 && r.3 > 0) else { return Vec::new() };
        let (right, bottom) = (vx + vw, vy + vh);
        let menu = (right - w - self.q(8.0), bottom - h - self.q(14.0), w, h);
        let mut v = vec![(FloatBtn::Menu, menu)];
        if self.speed.is_some() {
            let sw = self.q(60.0);
            v.push((FloatBtn::Speed, (menu.0 - sw - self.q(10.0), menu.1, sw, h)));
        }
        if self.float_open {
            let hw = self.q(150.0);
            let mut y = menu.1;
            let mut x = right - hw - self.q(8.0);
            let mut ks = vec![FloatBtn::GameMenu, FloatBtn::GameTime, FloatBtn::HudMode, FloatBtn::Fps, FloatBtn::FpsPos, FloatBtn::FpsLimit, FloatBtn::Filter, FloatBtn::Screen, FloatBtn::ZoomIn, FloatBtn::ZoomOut, FloatBtn::UnitPaths, FloatBtn::Groups, FloatBtn::Vibration];
            if self.speed.is_some() {
                ks.insert(1, FloatBtn::SpeedChoice);
            }
            for k in ks {
                y -= h + self.q(12.0);
                if y < vy + self.q(4.0) {
                    // Next column to the left (short windows).
                    y = menu.1 - h - self.q(12.0);
                    x -= hw + self.q(10.0);
                    if x < vx + self.q(4.0) {
                        break;
                    }
                }
                v.push((k, (x, y, hw, h)));
            }
        }
        v
    }

    fn placing(&self) -> bool {
        self.view.panel.page == 1 && self.view.slot != 0
    }

    /// Floating button under a window point.
    fn float_at(&self, x: f32, y: f32) -> Option<FloatBtn> {
        // A few pixels of extra margin around each button.
        let e = self.q(6.0);
        self.float_buttons().into_iter().find_map(|(k, (bx, by, bw, bh))| {
            let inside = x >= (bx - e) as f32 && x < (bx + bw + e) as f32 && y >= (by - e) as f32 && y < (by + bh + e) as f32;
            inside.then_some(k)
        })
    }

    fn queue_click(&mut self, m: &mut Machine, p: (i32, i32)) {
        let now = m.real_ms();
        m.log(LogLevel::Debug, &format!("ui-classic: panel click at {},{} (page {})", p.0, p.1, self.view.panel.page));
        m.input.push(HostEvent::MouseMove { x: p.0, y: p.1 });
        m.input.push(HostEvent::MouseButton { button: MouseButton::Left, down: true });
        // CLICK_MS of game time (the guest clock runs faster at game speed 2x..8x, see `fallback::TouchMouse::click_ms`).
        let hold = if m.time_scale() > 1.0 { ((CLICK_MS as f64 / m.time_scale()).round() as u64).max(12) } else { CLICK_MS };
        self.queue.push((now + hold, HostEvent::MouseButton { button: MouseButton::Left, down: false }));
    }

    fn update_target(&mut self) {
        let (Some(l), Some(t)) = (self.view.layout, self.touch.as_mut()) else { return };
        let snap = self.view.panel.fully_known();
        t.target = panel::pick(&l, &t.buttons, t.x, t.y, snap, SNAP_CELLS * l.cell as f32);
    }

    /// Where the click for the current panel touch goes.
    fn touch_point(&self) -> Option<(i32, i32)> {
        let t = self.touch.as_ref()?;
        let l = self.view.layout?;
        Some(match t.target {
            Some(i) => panel::center(&l, &t.buttons[i]),
            None => (t.x.round() as i32, t.y.round() as i32),
        })
    }

    fn context_chip(&mut self, m: &mut Machine) -> Option<String> {
        let v = self.view;
        if self.placing() {
            let name = self.building_name(m, v.build_type);
            return Some(format!("Place: {name}"));
        }
        if v.sel_units > 0 {
            return Some(format!("{} selected", v.sel_units));
        }
        if let Some(t) = v.sel_building_type {
            return Some(self.building_name(m, t));
        }
        None
    }

    fn draw_panel_touch(&mut self, m: &mut Machine, c: &mut Layer, frame: &FrameBuffer) {
        let (Some(l), Some(t)) = (self.view.layout, self.touch.clone()) else { return };
        let vp = crate::draw_viewport(m);
        let ps = vp.panel_scale().unwrap_or(vp.scale().1);
        let to_win = |x: i32, y: i32| {
            let (wx, wy) = vp.game_to_window(x as f32, y as f32);
            (wx.round() as i32, wy.round() as i32)
        };
        // Magnified source region, centred on the chosen button (or the finger).
        let (cx, cy) = self.touch_point().unwrap_or((t.x as i32, t.y as i32));
        let (sw, sh) = (64, 40);
        // 3x the panel's on-screen size.
        let k = 3.0 * ps;
        let sx = (cx - sw / 2).clamp(0, l.panel_w - sw).max(0);
        let sy = (cy - sh / 2).clamp(0, l.screen_h - sh).max(0);
        let _ = frame;
        let label = match t.target {
            Some(i) => self.label(m, t.buttons[i].label),
            None => match self.view.tooltip {
                Some(id) => self.text(m, id).unwrap_or_default(),
                None => String::new(),
            },
        };
        let ui = self.ui;
        let q = move |v: f32| (v * ui).round() as i32;
        // Outline the chosen button in place.
        if let Some(i) = t.target {
            let (bx, by, bw, bh) = l.rect(&t.buttons[i]);
            let (x0, y0) = to_win(bx, by);
            let (x1, y1) = to_win(bx + bw, by + bh);
            c.stroke_rounded_rect(x0 - q(2.0), y0 - q(2.0), x1 - x0 + q(4.0), y1 - y0 + q(4.0), 3.0 * self.ui, 2.0 * self.ui, GOLD);
        }
        // Bubble right of the panel, vertically next to the finger (never under it).
        let (mw, mh) = ((sw as f32 * k).round() as i32, (sh as f32 * k).round() as i32);
        let px = 18.0 * self.ui;
        let (tw, th) = measure_text(px, Weight::Bold, &label);
        let bw = mw.max(tw + q(20.0)) + q(12.0);
        let bh = mh + q(12.0) + if label.is_empty() { 0 } else { th + q(10.0) };
        let (panel_right, fy) = to_win(l.panel_w, cy);
        let bx = panel_right + q(10.0);
        let (wtop, wbottom) = self.vis.map(|v| (v.1, v.1 + v.3)).unwrap_or((0, c.height() as i32));
        let by = (fy - bh / 2 - q(20.0)).clamp(wtop + q(4.0), (wbottom - bh - q(4.0)).max(wtop + q(4.0)));
        c.fill_rounded_rect(bx, by, bw, bh, 10.0 * self.ui, BG);
        c.stroke_rounded_rect(bx, by, bw, bh, 10.0 * self.ui, 2.0 * self.ui, GOLD);
        // Pointer triangle towards the finger.
        let ty = fy.clamp(by + q(12.0), by + bh - q(12.0));
        for i in 0..q(10.0) {
            c.fill_rect(bx - i, ty - (q(10.0) - i), 1, 2 * (q(10.0) - i), BG);
        }
        let ix = bx + (bw - mw) / 2;
        let iy = by + q(6.0);
        // The frontend draws the frame region there with the display filter (xBR / AI like the panel itself).
        c.frame_inset([sx as f32, sy as f32, sw as f32, sh as f32], ix, iy, mw, mh);
        // The panel texts are not in the frame while the window layer is shown (`panel_text`): draw them too.
        crate::panel_text::draw_inset(m, c, [sx as f32, sy as f32, sw as f32, sh as f32], (ix, iy, mw, mh));
        // Outline of the chosen button inside the magnified view.
        if let Some(i) = t.target {
            let (rx, ry, rw, rh) = l.rect(&t.buttons[i]);
            let kk = |v: i32| (v as f32 * k).round() as i32;
            c.set_clip(ix, iy, mw, mh);
            c.stroke_rect(ix + kk(rx - sx) - q(2.0), iy + kk(ry - sy) - q(2.0), kk(rw) + q(4.0), kk(rh) + q(4.0), q(2.0).max(1), GOLD);
            c.reset_clip();
        }
        if !label.is_empty() {
            c.text(bx + (bw - tw) / 2, iy + mh + q(6.0), px, Weight::Bold, Rgba::WHITE, &label);
        }
    }

    fn draw_float(&mut self, m: &mut Machine, c: &mut Layer) {
        let Some(l) = self.view.layout else { return };
        let ui = self.ui;
        let q = move |v: f32| (v * ui).round() as i32;
        let u = self.ui;
        let menu_open = self.float_open;
        for (k, (x, y, w, h)) in self.float_buttons() {
            let pressed = self.pressed.is_some_and(|(_, pk, inside)| pk == k && inside);
            let (bg, text) = match k {
                FloatBtn::Menu => (BG, if menu_open { "Close" } else { "Menu" }),
                FloatBtn::GameMenu => (BG, "Save / Quit"),
                FloatBtn::GameTime => (BG, if crate::game_time::enabled(m) { "Game time: on" } else { "Game time: off" }),
                FloatBtn::HudMode => (BG, "UI: Mobile HUD"),
                FloatBtn::Fps => (BG, match self.disp.fps_counter {
                    crate::display::FpsCounter::Off => "FPS: off",
                    crate::display::FpsCounter::Fps => "FPS: on",
                    crate::display::FpsCounter::Detailed => "FPS: details",
                }),
                FloatBtn::Screen => (BG, match self.disp.mode {
                    crate::display::DisplayMode::Fit => "Screen: Fit",
                    crate::display::DisplayMode::Fill => "Screen: Fill",
                    crate::display::DisplayMode::Stretch => "Screen: Stretch",
                    crate::display::DisplayMode::NativeWide => "Screen: Wide",
                }),
                FloatBtn::Speed if self.speed.as_ref().is_some_and(|s| s.1) => (GOLD.fade(0.55), ""),
                FloatBtn::UnitPaths => (BG, match crate::settings(m).unit_paths {
                    crate::settings::PathMode::Selected => "Paths: selected",
                    crate::settings::PathMode::Units => "Paths: units",
                    crate::settings::PathMode::All => "Paths: all units",
                }),
                FloatBtn::Vibration => (BG, crate::settings::vibration_label(&crate::settings(m))),
                FloatBtn::Groups => (BG, if crate::settings(m).group_shortcuts { "Groups: on" } else { "Groups: off" }),
                FloatBtn::ZoomIn | FloatBtn::ZoomOut | FloatBtn::FpsLimit | FloatBtn::FpsPos | FloatBtn::Filter | FloatBtn::Speed | FloatBtn::SpeedChoice => (BG, ""),
            };
            let zoom_label;
            let text = match k {
                FloatBtn::ZoomIn | FloatBtn::ZoomOut => {
                    let (lv, n) = (crate::zoom::level(m) + 1, crate::zoom::level_count());
                    let sign = if k == FloatBtn::ZoomIn { "+" } else { "-" };
                    let word = if k == FloatBtn::ZoomIn { "in" } else { "out" };
                    let _ = sign;
                    zoom_label = if crate::zoom::enabled(m) { format!("Zoom {word} ({lv}/{n})") } else { format!("Zoom {word} (off)") };
                    zoom_label.as_str()
                }
                FloatBtn::FpsLimit => {
                    zoom_label = crate::display::fps_limit_label(m);
                    zoom_label.as_str()
                }
                FloatBtn::FpsPos => {
                    zoom_label = format!("FPS pos: {}", self.disp.fps_pos.label());
                    zoom_label.as_str()
                }
                FloatBtn::Filter => {
                    zoom_label = format!("Filter: {}", self.disp.filter.label());
                    zoom_label.as_str()
                }
                FloatBtn::Speed => {
                    zoom_label = format!(">> {}", self.speed.as_ref().map(|s| s.0.clone()).unwrap_or_default());
                    zoom_label.as_str()
                }
                FloatBtn::SpeedChoice => {
                    zoom_label = format!("Fast speed: {}", crate::speed::choice_label(m));
                    zoom_label.as_str()
                }
                _ => text,
            };
            let bg = if pressed { GOLD.fade(0.85) } else { bg };
            c.fill_rounded_rect(x, y, w, h, 9.0 * u, bg);
            c.stroke_rounded_rect(x, y, w, h, 9.0 * u, 2.0 * u, GOLD);
            let fg = if pressed { Rgba::BLACK } else { Rgba::WHITE };
            c.text_centered(x, y, w, h, 17.0 * u, Weight::Bold, fg, text);
        }
        if let Some(chip) = self.context_chip(m) {
            let px = 15.0 * u;
            let (tw, th) = measure_text(px, Weight::Bold, &chip);
            let vp = crate::draw_viewport(m);
            // Right of the panel art incl. the minimap frame's diagonal edge at the top (`PanelSplit::overhang`).
            let right = vp.panel.map_or(l.panel_w as f32, |p| p.art_right(0.0).max(l.panel_w as f32));
            // (`right - 1` is the last art pixel, mapped at the panel's scale; `right` itself is map.)
            let x = vp.game_to_window(right - 1.0, 0.0).0.round() as i32 + q(10.0);
            let top = self.vis.map(|v| v.1).unwrap_or(0) + q(8.0);
            let w = tw + q(20.0);
            if x + w < c.width() as i32 - q(60.0) {
                c.fill_rounded_rect(x, top, w, th + q(12.0), 8.0 * u, BG);
                c.text(x + q(10.0), top + q(6.0), px, Weight::Bold, GOLD, &chip);
            }
        }
    }
}

impl Default for ClassicTouch {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new()
    }
}

impl Mod for ClassicTouch {
    fn name(&self) -> &str {
        NAME
    }

    fn on_touch(&mut self, m: &mut Machine, ev: &TouchEvent) -> ModEvent {
        if !self.active {
            return ModEvent::Pass;
        }
        match *ev {
            TouchEvent::Down { id, x, y } => {
                self.read_view(m);
                if !self.in_game {
                    return ModEvent::Pass;
                }
                let (wx, wy) = crate::touch_window_pos(m, ev);
                if let Some(k) = self.float_at(wx, wy) {
                    self.pressed = Some((id, k, true));
                    self.dirty = true;
                    return ModEvent::Consumed;
                }
                let Some(l) = self.view.layout else { return ModEvent::Pass };
                if self.touch.is_none() && l.in_panel(x, y) && self.view.panel.page != 9 {
                    self.touch = Some(PanelTouch { id, x, y, target: None, buttons: panel::buttons(&self.view.panel) });
                    self.update_target();
                    // Hover there so the game computes its own tooltip for buttons we do not know.
                    m.input.push(HostEvent::MouseMove { x: x as i32, y: y as i32 });
                    self.dirty = true;
                    return ModEvent::Consumed;
                }
                ModEvent::Pass
            }
            TouchEvent::Move { id, x, y } => {
                if let Some((pid, k, _)) = self.pressed {
                    if pid == id {
                        let (wx, wy) = crate::touch_window_pos(m, ev);
                        let inside = self.float_at(wx, wy) == Some(k);
                        self.pressed = Some((pid, k, inside));
                        self.dirty = true;
                        return ModEvent::Consumed;
                    }
                }
                if self.touch.as_ref().is_some_and(|t| t.id == id) {
                    if let Some(t) = self.touch.as_mut() {
                        t.x = x;
                        t.y = y;
                    }
                    self.update_target();
                    m.input.push(HostEvent::MouseMove { x: x as i32, y: y as i32 });
                    self.dirty = true;
                    return ModEvent::Consumed;
                }
                ModEvent::Pass
            }
            TouchEvent::Up { id, x, y } => {
                if let Some((pid, k, _)) = self.pressed {
                    if pid == id {
                        self.pressed = None;
                        self.dirty = true;
                        let (wx, wy) = crate::touch_window_pos(m, ev);
                        if self.float_at(wx, wy) == Some(k) {
                            let action = match k {
                                FloatBtn::Menu => {
                                    // Only our button column; the game's page is opened by "Save / Quit".
                                    self.float_open = !self.float_open;
                                    return ModEvent::Consumed;
                                }
                                FloatBtn::GameMenu => {
                                    // The Mobile HUD's game menu dialog (Resume / Save / Pause / Quit with its
                                    // own confirm), not the original panel's page 7 (user request 2026-11-08).
                                    self.float_open = false;
                                    m.state::<crate::ui_hud_game::HudShared>().borrow_mut().classic_menu = true;
                                    self.dirty = true;
                                    return ModEvent::Consumed;
                                }
                                FloatBtn::HudMode => {
                                    // Close the menu page, then hand over to mode B (settings are saved).
                                    let mut s = crate::settings(m);
                                    s.ui_mode = UiMode::MobileHud;
                                    m.log(LogLevel::Info, "ui-classic: switching to UI mode B (Mobile HUD)");
                                    let _ = crate::set_settings(m, s);
                                    self.float_open = false;
                                    if self.view.panel.page != 7 {
                                        return ModEvent::Consumed;
                                    }
                                    Action::CloseMenu
                                }
                                FloatBtn::ZoomIn | FloatBtn::ZoomOut => {
                                    // Render resolution only (res.rs switches at the next frame).
                                    if k == FloatBtn::ZoomIn {
                                        crate::zoom::zoom_in(m);
                                    } else {
                                        crate::zoom::zoom_out(m);
                                    }
                                    self.dirty = true;
                                    return ModEvent::Consumed;
                                }
                                FloatBtn::GameTime => {
                                    crate::game_time::toggle(m);
                                    self.dirty = true;
                                    return ModEvent::Consumed;
                                }
                                FloatBtn::UnitPaths | FloatBtn::Groups | FloatBtn::Vibration => {
                                    let mut s = crate::settings(m);
                                    if k == FloatBtn::UnitPaths {
                                        s.unit_paths = s.unit_paths.next();
                                    } else if k == FloatBtn::Vibration {
                                        crate::settings::cycle_vibration(&mut s);
                                    } else {
                                        s.group_shortcuts = !s.group_shortcuts;
                                    }
                                    let _ = crate::set_settings(m, s);
                                    self.dirty = true;
                                    return ModEvent::Consumed;
                                }
                                FloatBtn::Speed | FloatBtn::SpeedChoice => {
                                    if k == FloatBtn::Speed {
                                        crate::speed::toggle(m);
                                    } else {
                                        crate::speed::cycle_choice(m);
                                    }
                                    self.speed = crate::speed::button_state(m);
                                    self.dirty = true;
                                    return ModEvent::Consumed;
                                }
                                FloatBtn::Fps | FloatBtn::Screen | FloatBtn::FpsLimit | FloatBtn::FpsPos | FloatBtn::Filter => {
                                    // Presentation settings only: no game action.
                                    if k == FloatBtn::Fps {
                                        crate::display::cycle_fps(m);
                                    } else if k == FloatBtn::FpsLimit {
                                        crate::display::cycle_fps_limit(m);
                                    } else if k == FloatBtn::FpsPos {
                                        crate::display::cycle_fps_pos(m);
                                    } else if k == FloatBtn::Filter {
                                        crate::display::cycle_filter(m);
                                    } else {
                                        crate::display::cycle_mode(m);
                                    }
                                    self.disp = crate::display::display_settings(m);
                                    return ModEvent::Consumed;
                                }
                            };
                            m.state::<ClassicShared>().borrow_mut().pending.push(action);
                        }
                        return ModEvent::Consumed;
                    }
                }
                if self.touch.as_ref().is_some_and(|t| t.id == id) {
                    if let Some(t) = self.touch.as_mut() {
                        t.x = x;
                        t.y = y;
                    }
                    self.read_view(m);
                    self.update_target();
                    let cancel = self.view.layout.is_none_or(|l| x > l.panel_w as f32 + CANCEL_MARGIN);
                    if !cancel {
                        if let Some(p) = self.touch_point() {
                            self.queue_click(m, p);
                        }
                    }
                    self.touch = None;
                    self.dirty = true;
                    return ModEvent::Consumed;
                }
                ModEvent::Pass
            }
            TouchEvent::Cancel { id } => {
                if self.pressed.is_some_and(|p| p.0 == id) {
                    self.pressed = None;
                }
                if self.touch.as_ref().is_some_and(|t| t.id == id) {
                    self.touch = None;
                }
                self.dirty = true;
                ModEvent::Pass
            }
            _ => ModEvent::Pass,
        }
    }

    fn wants_draw(&self) -> bool {
        self.active && self.in_game
    }

    fn needs_redraw(&self) -> bool {
        self.dirty
    }

    fn tick(&mut self, m: &mut Machine, now: u64) {
        let speed = crate::speed::button_state(m);
        if speed != self.speed {
            self.speed = speed;
            self.dirty = true;
        }
        let mode = m.state::<ModsState>().borrow_mut().settings.ui_mode;
        self.active = self.env_mode.unwrap_or(mode == UiMode::ClassicTouch);
        if !self.queue.is_empty() {
            let mut due = Vec::new();
            self.queue.retain(|&(t, e)| {
                if t <= now {
                    due.push(e);
                    false
                } else {
                    true
                }
            });
            for e in due {
                m.input.push(e);
            }
        }
        if self.active {
            let was = self.in_game;
            self.read_view(m);
            if was != self.in_game {
                self.dirty = true;
                if self.in_game && !self.logged_active {
                    self.logged_active = true;
                    m.log(LogLevel::Info, "ui-classic: in game, Classic Touch overlay active");
                }
            }
        } else {
            self.in_game = false;
            self.touch = None;
            self.pressed = None;
        }
    }

    fn draw_window(&mut self, m: &mut Machine, c: &mut Layer, frame: &FrameBuffer) {
        self.dirty = false;
        if !self.in_game {
            return;
        }
        let vp = crate::draw_viewport(m);
        // Window rect: the shown frame's rect changes with the zoom (crop) and must not move the buttons.
        self.vis = Some((0, 0, vp.win_w as i32, vp.win_h as i32));
        self.ui = vp.win_h as f32 / 600.0;
        if self.touch.is_some() {
            self.draw_panel_touch(m, c, frame);
        }
        self.draw_float(m, c);
    }
}

```

`port/crates/s3-mods/src/ui_classic_panel.rs`:

```rs
//! Pure model of the original left panel for UI mode A ("Classic Touch"): screen layout globals, the
//! button grid per page, the build list per race, and "which button does this finger mean" (snapping).
//! All addresses/grid values are for the GOG S3.EXE (docs/reverse-engineering/game-state-ui.md §1-2).
//! No guest code runs here; everything is plain data so it can be unit tested.

use s3_mem::GuestMemory;

/// Screen layout globals (set by `0x4c6d70(resIndex)`).
pub mod addr {
    pub const RES_INDEX1: u32 = 0x730f08;
    pub const SCREEN_W: u32 = 0x730f0c;
    pub const SCREEN_H: u32 = 0x730f10;
    pub const PANEL_W: u32 = 0x730f24;
    pub const MINIMAP_BOTTOM: u32 = 0x730f34;
    pub const CELL: u32 = 0x730f38;
    pub const GRID_X: u32 = 0x730f3c;
    pub const GRID_Y: u32 = 0x730f40;
}

/// Panel geometry for the current resolution.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Layout {
    pub screen_w: i32,
    pub screen_h: i32,
    pub panel_w: i32,
    pub minimap_bottom: i32,
    pub cell: i32,
    pub grid_x: i32,
    pub grid_y: i32,
}

impl Layout {
    /// The three layouts the game knows (640x480, 800x600, 1024x768), VERIFIED values.
    pub const fn builtin(res: u32) -> Layout {
        match res {
            0 => Layout { screen_w: 640, screen_h: 480, panel_w: 136, minimap_bottom: 142, cell: 3, grid_x: 8, grid_y: 152 },
            1 => Layout { screen_w: 800, screen_h: 600, panel_w: 176, minimap_bottom: 170, cell: 4, grid_x: 8, grid_y: 171 },
            _ => Layout { screen_w: 1024, screen_h: 768, panel_w: 216, minimap_bottom: 224, cell: 5, grid_x: 8, grid_y: 228 },
        }
    }

    /// Read the layout globals; `None` until the game has set them (index 1..3) or when they look wrong.
    pub fn read(mem: &GuestMemory) -> Option<Layout> {
        let idx = mem.read_u32(addr::RES_INDEX1);
        if !(1..=3).contains(&idx) {
            return None;
        }
        let l = Layout {
            screen_w: mem.read_u32(addr::SCREEN_W) as i32,
            screen_h: mem.read_u32(addr::SCREEN_H) as i32,
            panel_w: mem.read_u32(addr::PANEL_W) as i32,
            minimap_bottom: mem.read_u32(addr::MINIMAP_BOTTOM) as i32,
            cell: mem.read_u32(addr::CELL) as i32,
            grid_x: mem.read_u32(addr::GRID_X) as i32,
            grid_y: mem.read_u32(addr::GRID_Y) as i32,
        };
        let sane = (1..=8).contains(&l.cell)
            && (crate::res::MIN_W as i32..=crate::res::MAX_W as i32).contains(&l.screen_w)
            && (crate::res::MIN_H as i32..=crate::res::MAX_H as i32).contains(&l.screen_h)
            && (40..l.screen_w / 2).contains(&l.panel_w);
        sane.then_some(l)
    }

    /// Pixel rectangle (x, y, w, h) of a grid button (inclusive column/row ranges).
    pub fn rect(&self, b: &Button) -> (i32, i32, i32, i32) {
        let (c0, c1) = b.cols;
        let (r0, r1) = b.rows;
        (
            self.grid_x + c0 as i32 * self.cell,
            self.grid_y + r0 as i32 * self.cell,
            (c1 as i32 - c0 as i32 + 1) * self.cell,
            (r1 as i32 - r0 as i32 + 1) * self.cell,
        )
    }

    /// Is (x, y) in the panel button area (left panel below the minimap)?
    pub fn in_panel(&self, x: f32, y: f32) -> bool {
        x >= 0.0 && x < self.panel_w as f32 && y >= self.minimap_bottom as f32 && y < self.screen_h as f32
    }
}

/// What a button is called (for the magnifier bubble).
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Label {
    /// A text id of the game's string tables (`table << 16 | index`), with an English fallback.
    Text(u32, &'static str),
    /// A building type (name = text `building_text_id(type)`).
    Building(u8),
}

/// A panel button in grid units (inclusive ranges, as in the game's hit tests).
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Button {
    pub cols: (u8, u8),
    pub rows: (u8, u8),
    pub label: Label,
}

const fn b(c0: u8, c1: u8, r0: u8, r1: u8, label: Label) -> Button {
    Button { cols: (c0, c1), rows: (r0, r1), label }
}

/// Panel state needed to know which buttons exist.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Default)]
pub struct PanelState {
    /// `[gd+0x2d284]`: 1 build, 2 goods, 3 settlers, 4 building, 5 units, 7 Save/Quit, 8 messages, 9 paused.
    pub page: u32,
    /// `[gd+0x2d298]`: menu sub-page on page 7.
    pub sub: u32,
    /// `[gd+0x2d288]`: build category 1..4.
    pub category: u32,
    /// Race of the local player (0..3).
    pub race: u8,
}

impl PanelState {
    /// Pages whose whole button set we know: snapping (moving a tap to the nearest button) is safe there.
    /// On other pages a tap is only snapped when it already lies inside a known button.
    pub fn fully_known(&self) -> bool {
        matches!(self.page, 0..=3) || (self.page == 7 && self.sub == 0)
    }
}

/// Building type in build list `slot` (1..12) of category `cat` (1..4) for `race` (0..3), `None` = empty
/// (STATIC table from `0x526f8a..0x528a37`, game-state-ui.md §2).
pub fn build_slot_type(cat: u32, slot: u32, race: u8) -> Option<u8> {
    const N: u8 = 0;
    let per_race = |t: [u8; 4]| t.get(race as usize).copied().filter(|&v| v != N);
    let one = |t: u8| Some(t);
    match (cat, slot) {
        (1, 1) => one(0x02),
        (1, 2) => one(0x04),
        (1, 3) => one(0x03),
        (1, 4) => one(0x05),
        (1, 5) => one(0x09),
        (1, 6) => one(0x0b),
        (1, 7) => one(0x08),
        (1, 8) => one(0x0a),
        (1, 9) => one(0x07),
        (1, 10) => one(0x0c),
        (1, 11) => per_race([0x27, 0x25, 0x1d, 0x38]),
        (1, 12) => per_race([N, N, 0x28, 0x25]),
        (2, 1) => one(0x19),
        (2, 2) => one(0x18),
        (2, 3) => one(0x17),
        (2, 4) => one(0x11),
        (2, 5) => one(0x15),
        (2, 6) => one(0x14),
        (2, 7) => one(0x1e),
        (2, 8) => one(0x31),
        (2, 9) => per_race([0x0e, 0x26, 0x16, 0x33]),
        (2, 10) => per_race([N, N, 0x24, 0x34]),
        (3, 1) => one(0x0f),
        (3, 2) => one(0x10),
        (3, 3) => one(0x12),
        (3, 4) => one(0x06),
        (3, 5) => one(0x0d),
        (3, 6) => per_race([0x1f, 0x2f, 0x30, 0x32]),
        (3, 7) => one(0x13),
        (3, 8) => one(0x20),
        (3, 9) => one(0x23),
        (4, 1) => one(0x1a),
        (4, 2) => one(0x1b),
        (4, 3) => one(0x1c),
        (4, 4) => one(0x01),
        (4, 5) => one(0x22),
        (4, 6) => one(0x21),
        (4, 7) => per_race([0x2c, 0x2a, 0x2e, 0x36]),
        (4, 8) => per_race([0x2b, 0x29, 0x2d, 0x37]),
        (4, 9) => per_race([N, N, N, 0x35]),
        _ => None,
    }
}

/// Text id of a building type's name (table 8). Types 0x32.. (Amazon variants) use other ids.
pub fn building_text_id(t: u8) -> u32 {
    match t {
        0x32 => 0x8015e,
        0x33 => 0x8015f,
        0x34 => 0x80160,
        0x35 => 0x80161,
        // Amazon variants of buildings other races have: reuse those names (HYPOTHESIS: same names in game).
        0x36 => 0x8002c,
        0x37 => 0x8002b,
        0x38 => 0x8001d,
        t => 0x80000 + t as u32,
    }
}

/// Buttons present on the panel for `st` (only the ones we know; see game-state-ui.md grid map).
pub fn buttons(st: &PanelState) -> Vec<Button> {
    let mut v = Vec::with_capacity(24);
    // Bottom row (menu + four message categories): every page.
    v.push(b(0, 7, 97, 103, Label::Text(0x8008f, "Save/Quit")));
    v.push(b(8, 15, 97, 103, Label::Text(0x800ad, "Battle Messages")));
    v.push(b(16, 23, 97, 103, Label::Text(0x800ae, "General Messages")));
    v.push(b(24, 31, 97, 103, Label::Text(0x800af, "Resource Messages")));
    v.push(b(32, 39, 97, 103, Label::Text(0x800b0, "Trade Messages")));
    if st.page == 7 {
        if st.sub == 0 {
            v.push(b(3, 37, 22, 29, Label::Text(0, "Save Game")));
            v.push(b(3, 37, 87, 91, Label::Text(0, "Quit Game")));
        }
        return v;
    }
    // Top tabs.
    v.push(b(2, 13, 1, 8, Label::Text(0x8004a, "Buildings")));
    v.push(b(15, 26, 1, 8, Label::Text(0x8004b, "Goods")));
    v.push(b(28, 39, 1, 8, Label::Text(0x8004c, "Settlers")));
    let quarters = |v: &mut Vec<Button>, ids: [(u32, &'static str); 4]| {
        for (i, (id, en)) in ids.into_iter().enumerate() {
            let c0 = (i * 10) as u8;
            v.push(b(c0, c0 + 9, 11, 18, Label::Text(id, en)));
        }
    };
    match st.page {
        1 => {
            quarters(&mut v, [
                (0x8004d, "Resource Buildings"),
                (0x8004e, "Food Buildings"),
                (0x8004f, "Military Buildings"),
                (0x80050, "Misc. Buildings"),
            ]);
            for slot in 1..=12u32 {
                let Some(t) = build_slot_type(st.category, slot, st.race) else { continue };
                let k = ((slot - 1) / 2) as u8;
                let (c0, c1) = if slot % 2 == 1 { (1, 19) } else { (21, 39) };
                v.push(b(c0, c1, 22 + 12 * k, 31 + 12 * k, Label::Building(t)));
            }
        }
        2 => quarters(&mut v, [
            (0x80051, "Inventory"),
            (0x80052, "Tools and Weapons"),
            (0x80081, "Priority of Buildings"),
            (0x80082, "Priority of Goods"),
        ]),
        3 => quarters(&mut v, [
            (0x8005a, "Population"),
            (0x8005b, "Occupations"),
            (0x8005c, "Recruitment"),
            (0x80155, "Production statistics"),
        ]),
        _ => {}
    }
    v
}

/// Squared distance from a point to a rectangle (0 inside).
fn dist2(r: (i32, i32, i32, i32), x: f32, y: f32) -> f32 {
    let dx = (r.0 as f32 - x).max(0.0).max(x - (r.0 + r.2) as f32);
    let dy = (r.1 as f32 - y).max(0.0).max(y - (r.1 + r.3) as f32);
    dx * dx + dy * dy
}

/// The button a finger at (x, y) means: the button under it, or (when `snap` and the page is fully
/// known) the nearest button within `snap_px`. Returns its index in `buttons`.
pub fn pick(l: &Layout, buttons: &[Button], x: f32, y: f32, snap: bool, snap_px: f32) -> Option<usize> {
    let mut best: Option<(usize, f32)> = None;
    for (i, btn) in buttons.iter().enumerate() {
        let d = dist2(l.rect(btn), x, y);
        if best.is_none_or(|(_, bd)| d < bd) {
            best = Some((i, d));
        }
    }
    let (i, d) = best?;
    let limit = if snap { snap_px * snap_px } else { 0.0 };
    (d <= limit).then_some(i)
}

/// Centre of a button in screen pixels (where the click is sent).
pub fn center(l: &Layout, btn: &Button) -> (i32, i32) {
    let (x, y, w, h) = l.rect(btn);
    (x + w / 2, y + h / 2)
}

/// Decode game text bytes (Windows-1252 for the Western versions; HYPOTHESIS for other languages).
pub fn decode_cp1252(bytes: &[u8]) -> String {
    const HI: [char; 32] = [
        '€', '\u{81}', '‚', 'ƒ', '„', '…', '†', '‡', 'ˆ', '‰', 'Š', '‹', 'Œ', '\u{8d}', 'Ž', '\u{8f}', '\u{90}', '‘', '’', '“',
        '”', '•', '–', '—', '˜', '™', 'š', '›', 'œ', '\u{9d}', 'ž', 'Ÿ',
    ];
    bytes
        .iter()
        .map(|&c| match c {
            0x80..=0x9f => HI[(c - 0x80) as usize],
            c => c as char,
        })
        .collect()
}

/// Resolve a text id like `0x5faaa0` does, by reading the string table at `strtab` (`[gfx+0x5f6b8]`).
pub fn read_text(mem: &GuestMemory, strtab: u32, id: u32) -> Option<String> {
    if strtab < 0x1_0000 {
        return None;
    }
    let lang = mem.read_u32(strtab + 0xc40);
    let (t, ix) = (id >> 16, id & 0xffff);
    if lang > 16 || t >= 64 {
        return None;
    }
    let hdr = mem.read_u32(strtab + 0x37c + t * 4);
    let base = mem.read_u32(strtab + 0x264 + t * 4);
    if hdr < 0x1_0000 || base < 0x1_0000 {
        return None;
    }
    let n = mem.read_u16(hdr + 8) as u32;
    if ix >= n {
        return None;
    }
    let off = mem.read_u32(hdr + 0xc + (n * lang + ix) * 4);
    let a = base.wrapping_add(off);
    if a < 0x1_0000 {
        return None;
    }
    let len = mem.strlen(a, 160);
    let s = decode_cp1252(&mem.read_bytes(a, len));
    let s = s.trim().to_string();
    (!s.is_empty() && s.chars().all(|c| !c.is_control())).then_some(s)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    const L640: Layout = Layout::builtin(0);

    #[test]
    fn grid_rects_match_recipes() {
        // integration-log recipe (640x480): menu icon at 21,452.
        let bs = buttons(&PanelState { page: 0, ..Default::default() });
        let menu = &bs[0];
        let (x, y, w, h) = L640.rect(menu);
        assert_eq!((x, y, w, h), (8, 443, 24, 21));
        assert!(x <= 21 && 21 < x + w && y <= 452 && 452 < y + h);
        assert_eq!(pick(&L640, &bs, 21.0, 452.0, false, 0.0), Some(0));
    }

    #[test]
    fn build_list_per_race() {
        let st = PanelState { page: 1, category: 1, race: 0, ..Default::default() };
        let bs = buttons(&st);
        let slots: Vec<_> = bs.iter().filter_map(|b| if let Label::Building(t) = b.label { Some(t) } else { None }).collect();
        // Romans: 11 entries in category 1 (slot 12 empty).
        assert_eq!(slots.len(), 11);
        assert_eq!(slots[0], 0x02);
        let asians = buttons(&PanelState { race: 2, ..st });
        assert_eq!(asians.iter().filter(|b| matches!(b.label, Label::Building(_))).count(), 12);
        assert_eq!(build_slot_type(4, 9, 3), Some(0x35));
        assert_eq!(build_slot_type(4, 9, 0), None);
        assert_eq!(building_text_id(0x0f), 0x8000f);
        assert_eq!(building_text_id(0x33), 0x8015f);
    }

    #[test]
    fn snapping_only_near_and_on_known_pages() {
        let st = PanelState { page: 1, category: 1, race: 0, ..Default::default() };
        let bs = buttons(&st);
        // Slot 1 is cols 1..19 rows 22..31 -> x 11..71, y 218..248; slot 3 starts at row 34 (y 254).
        let i = pick(&L640, &bs, 30.0, 250.0, true, 9.0).unwrap();
        assert!(matches!(bs[i].label, Label::Building(0x02)));
        let i = pick(&L640, &bs, 30.0, 253.0, true, 9.0).unwrap();
        assert!(matches!(bs[i].label, Label::Building(0x03)));
        // Column gap between the two slots (col 20 = x 68..70) snaps to a neighbour.
        assert!(pick(&L640, &bs, 69.5, 230.0, true, 9.0).is_some());
        // Far away (minimap area / map): nothing.
        assert_eq!(pick(&L640, &bs, 300.0, 230.0, true, 9.0), None);
        // Without snapping a gap is not a hit.
        assert_eq!(pick(&L640, &bs, 30.0, 252.5, false, 9.0), None);
        // Page 5 is not fully known.
        assert!(!PanelState { page: 5, ..Default::default() }.fully_known());
        assert!(st.fully_known());
    }

    #[test]
    fn layout_and_panel_area() {
        let l = Layout::builtin(1);
        assert!(l.in_panel(20.0, 300.0));
        assert!(!l.in_panel(20.0, 100.0)); // minimap
        assert!(!l.in_panel(200.0, 300.0)); // map
        let bs = buttons(&PanelState::default());
        // Same grid at 800x600: menu icon centre.
        assert_eq!(center(&l, &bs[0]), (8 + 16, 171 + 97 * 4 + 14));
    }

    #[test]
    fn cp1252() {
        assert_eq!(decode_cp1252(b"Caf\xe9 \x80"), "Café €");
    }
}
```

```rs
//! UI mode B "Mobile HUD" (workstream W4, docs/porting/ui-hud.md): a native large-button overlay UI.
//!
//! - The original left panel is hidden and the map uses the full screen (layout patch, see
//!   [`ui_hud_game`](crate::ui_hud_game)); the game's own minimap, its frame and camera rectangle are not drawn.
//! - Own minimap widget (bottom left, [`ui_hud_minimap`](crate::ui_hud_minimap)) from the game's minimap image:
//!   drag on it pans the camera, a tap opens the full-screen map (tap a point = jump there and close).
//! - Settings sheet: display mode / filter / FPS counter (`crate::display`), zoom, HUD size, UI mode.
//! - Bottom bar: Basic / Food / Military / Special (build categories), Settlers, Stats, Menu.
//! - Bottom sheet: the buildings of a category as large cards (icon + the game's own name). Icons are sampled
//!   at runtime from the game's own panel (the HUD lets the game draw each build page once and copies the slot
//!   pixels from the presented frame); nothing is shipped. Choosing a card enters the game's build placement
//!   mode (panel state, game-state-ui.md); the next map tap places the site.
//! - Selection card (units / building), building sheet (stop / resume, site priority, work area, garrison),
//!   resource summary strip, settlers sheet (with recruitment) and goods sheet, in-game menu (save sheet with the
//!   game's slot list, quit, pause, settings incl. the UI mode switch). The original panel is never shown
//!   (docs/porting/ui-hud.md "No original panel").
//!
//! Active only while `settings.ui_mode == MobileHud`; switching modes at runtime restores the original layout.
//!
//! Drawn into the window layer ([`crate::layer`]) in window pixels, sized from the window height (not the game's
//! render size), so the HUD keeps its size and sharpness at every zoom level; touches are hit-tested with their
//! window position ([`crate::touch_window_pos`]).

/// Height of the bottom bar in HUD units (1 unit = 1 px of a 480 px high window, times `hud_scale`).
const BAR_H: f32 = 54.0;

/// Window px of the HUD's bottom bar and top resource strip for a view of `vw` x `vh` (same scale as `HudMod::k`),
/// for other window-layer UI that must not cover them (FPS counter).
pub(crate) fn bar_and_strip_h(m: &mut Machine, vw: i32, vh: i32) -> (i32, i32) {
    let pref = crate::settings(m).hud_scale;
    let k = (vh.max(1) as f32 / 480.0).min(vw.max(1) as f32 / 640.0).max(0.5) * pref.clamp(0.6, 1.6);
    ((BAR_H * k).round() as i32, (34.0 * k).round() as i32)
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- geometry

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Default)]
pub(crate) struct Rect {
    pub x: i32,
    pub y: i32,
    pub w: i32,
    pub h: i32,
}

impl Rect {
    fn new(x: i32, y: i32, w: i32, h: i32) -> Rect {
        Rect { x, y, w, h }
    }
    fn contains(&self, x: f32, y: f32) -> bool {
        x >= self.x as f32 && y >= self.y as f32 && x < (self.x + self.w) as f32 && y < (self.y + self.h) as f32
    }
    fn inset(&self, d: i32) -> Rect {
        Rect::new(self.x + d, self.y + d, self.w - 2 * d, self.h - 2 * d)
    }
}

    MenuQuit,
    /// Confirmation: really end the game.
    MenuQuitYes,
    MenuPause,
    MenuToggleMode,
    MenuToggleFullMap,
    MenuScale(i32),
    /// The minimap widget (drag = pan, tap = full-screen map).
    Minimap,
    /// Game speed: normal <-> chosen fast speed (single player).
    Speed,
    /// Settings: choose the fast speed (2x..8x).
    CycleFastSpeed,
    /// Settings: game time display on / off.
    ToggleGameTime,
    /// The full-screen map image (tap = jump there).
    MapPoint,
    MenuSettings,
    CycleDisplayMode,
    CycleFilter,
    CycleFps,
    /// Next game frame limit (30 / 60 / 120 / 144 / display rate).
    CycleFpsLimit,
    /// Next FPS counter position.
    CycleFpsPos,
    Zoom(i32),
    /// Swallow the tap (sheet background).
    Nothing,
}

/// Which sheet is open.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) enum Sheet {
    None,
    Build(u32),
    Settlers,
    Stats,
    Menu,
    Settings,
    /// "Quit this game?" confirmation (replaces the original panel's page 7 sub-page 1).
    QuitConfirm,
    /// Full-screen map overlay.
    Map,
    /// Selected building: state and the original page 4's actions (stop/resume, priority, work area, garrison).
    Building,
    /// Save game: the 8 slots (or one multiplayer save).
    Save,
}

/// Icon harvesting state (see module docs).
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
enum Harvest {
    /// Not started (waiting for a game).
    Idle,
    /// Showing build category `cat`; capture once `panel_frames >= wait_until`.
    Cat { cat: u32, wait_until: u64, started_ms: u64 },
    Done,
}

/// The Mobile HUD mod.
pub struct MobileHud {
    active: bool,
    scale_pref: f32,
    fullscreen_map: bool,
    sheet: Sheet,
    /// UI mode A: only the game menu dialogs (menu, save slots, quit confirm) are shown, over the Classic UI
    /// (`HudShared::classic_menu`).
    classic_dialog: bool,
    /// A save is running (slot) since this time: the save sheet shows "Saving..." until the result arrives.
    saving: Option<(u32, u64)>,
    /// Occupied save slot tapped once: (slot, until ms); a second tap overwrites it.
    overwrite: Option<(u32, u64)>,
    /// The last drawn save sheet showed the slot list (redraw once the logic thread has read it).
    save_slots_drawn: bool,
    /// Speed button state (chosen fast speed label, running fast) while it can be changed.
    speed: Option<(String, bool)>,
    snap: Option<GameSnapshot>,
    in_game: bool,
    frame: (u32, u32),
    /// Hit targets of the last draw (top-most last).
    targets: Vec<(Rect, Action)>,
    /// Pointer captured by a HUD element: (id, action at Down).
    pressed: Option<(u32, Action)>,
    /// Icons per (cat, slot) for the current race.
    icons: Vec<((u32, u32), ImageRef)>,
    icon_race: Option<u32>,
    /// Goods icons from the Inventory page, by good id.
    good_icons: Vec<(u8, ImageRef)>,
    /// Settler icons from the settlers page tab Population, by icon index (`ui_hud_data::POP_ICONS`).
    pop_icons: Vec<(u8, ImageRef)>,
    harvest: Harvest,
    /// Saved panel state before harvesting (page, cat).
    saved_page: Option<(u32, u32)>,
    names: Vec<(u32, String)>,
    destroy_armed_ms: u64,
    toast: Option<(String, u64)>,
    now: u64,
    dirty: bool,
    last_snap_ms: u64,
    text_dumped: bool,
    /// Part of the window that shows the game (window pixels; display `Fit` leaves bars, HUD elements stay inside).
    view: Rect,
    /// Minimap image + camera rectangle (refreshed every `MINI_REFRESH_MS`) and the image as RGBA for the layer.
    mini: Option<MiniData>,
    mini_img: Option<ImageRef>,
    last_mini_ms: u64,
    /// Geometry of the minimap widget / of the full-screen map from the last draw (hit tests).
    mini_geom: Option<MapGeom>,
    map_geom: Option<MapGeom>,
    /// Finger on the minimap widget: start point and whether it became a drag.
    mini_drag: Option<(f32, f32, bool)>,
    /// Last tile the camera was centred on by a minimap drag (avoid queueing the same jump again).
    mini_last_tile: Option<(u32, u32)>,
}

/// Minimap image refresh period (the game updates its minimap incrementally, a few times a second).
const MINI_REFRESH_MS: u64 = 250;

impl Default for MobileHud {
    fn default() -> Self {
        MobileHud {
            active: false,
            scale_pref: 1.0,
            fullscreen_map: true,
            sheet: Sheet::None,
            classic_dialog: false,
            saving: None,
            save_slots_drawn: false,
            overwrite: None,
            speed: None,
            snap: None,
            in_game: false,
            frame: (640, 480),
            targets: Vec::new(),
            pressed: None,
            icons: Vec::new(),
            icon_race: None,
            good_icons: Vec::new(),
            pop_icons: Vec::new(),
            harvest: Harvest::Idle,
            saved_page: None,
            names: Vec::new(),
            destroy_armed_ms: 0,
            toast: None,
            now: 0,
            dirty: true,
            last_snap_ms: 0,
            text_dumped: false,
            view: Rect::new(0, 0, 640, 480),
            mini: None,
            mini_img: None,
            last_mini_ms: 0,
            mini_geom: None,
            map_geom: None,
            mini_drag: None,
            mini_last_tile: None,
        }
    }
}

/// Add the HUD mod (always; it is inactive unless `ui_mode == MobileHud`) and its game hooks for the GOG exe.
/// Call before `hooks::commit`.
pub fn install(m: &mut Machine, gog_patches: bool) {
    if gog_patches {
        game::install_hooks(m);
    }
    crate::add_mod(m, Box::new(MobileHud::default()));
}

impl MobileHud {
    /// HUD scale factor (window px per HUD unit): window height relative to 480, times the user's `hud_scale`.
    fn k(&self) -> f32 {
        let (w, h) = (self.view.w.max(1) as f32, self.view.h.max(1) as f32);
        (h / 480.0).min(w / 640.0).max(0.5) * self.scale_pref.clamp(0.6, 1.6)
    }
    fn u(&self, v: f32) -> i32 {
        (v * self.k()).round() as i32
    }

    fn name(&mut self, m: &mut Machine, id: u32) -> String {
        if let Some((_, s)) = self.names.iter().find(|(i, _)| *i == id) {
            return s.clone();
        }
        match game::text(m, id) {
            Some(s) if !s.is_empty() => {
                self.names.push((id, s.clone()));
                s
            }
            _ => format!("#{:x}", id & 0xffff),
        }
    }

    fn building_name(&mut self, m: &mut Machine, t: u8) -> String {
        self.name(m, building_text_id(t))
    }

    fn icon(&self, cat: u32, slot: u32) -> Option<&ImageRef> {
        self.icons.iter().find(|(k, _)| *k == (cat, slot)).map(|(_, i)| i)
    }

    fn set_toast(&mut self, s: &str) {
        self.toast = Some((s.to_string(), self.now + 2500));
        self.dirty = true;
    }

    fn sync_layout(&mut self, m: &mut Machine) {
        // The original panel is never shown in this mode (except behind the "Preparing" cover while the icons are
        // read): every former panel page has a native sheet.
        let want = self.active && self.fullscreen_map && self.harvest_done_or_idle();
        let st = m.state::<HudShared>();
        let mut s = st.borrow_mut();
        if s.fullscreen_map != want {
            s.fullscreen_map = want;
            drop(s);
            if !want {
                // Restore immediately (the panel hook also restores on the next frame).
                game::apply_layout(m, false);
            }
        }
    }

    fn harvest_done_or_idle(&self) -> bool {
        matches!(self.harvest, Harvest::Done | Harvest::Idle)
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ icon harvesting

    fn harvest_tick(&mut self, m: &mut Machine) {
        let harvesting = matches!(self.harvest, Harvest::Cat { .. });
        m.state::<HudShared>().borrow_mut().harvesting = harvesting;
        let Some(snap) = self.snap.clone() else { return };
        if self.icon_race != Some(snap.race) && self.harvest == Harvest::Done {
            self.harvest = Harvest::Idle;
            self.icons.clear();
            self.pop_icons.clear();
        }
        let hooked = m.state::<HudShared>().borrow_mut().hooked;
        if !hooked || !self.in_game {
            return;
        }
        match self.harvest {
            Harvest::Idle => {
                // Only from a calm state (no placement / menu in progress).
                if snap.page == 9 || snap.page == 7 || (snap.page == 1 && snap.slot != 0) {
                    return;
                }
                self.saved_page = Some((snap.page, snap.cat));
                self.icon_race = Some(snap.race);
                self.start_harvest_cat(m, 1);
            }
            Harvest::Cat { started_ms, cat, .. } => {
                if self.now.saturating_sub(started_ms) > 8000 {
                    // Give up on this category (game not rendering?); continue with the next.
                    self.next_harvest_cat(m, cat);
                }
            }
            Harvest::Done => {}
        }
    }

    fn start_harvest_cat(&mut self, m: &mut Machine, cat: u32) {
        self.sync_layout_force_panel(m);
        if cat == GOODS_PAGE {
            game::queue(m, LogicAction::GoodsTab(1));
        } else if cat == SETTLERS_PAGE {
            game::queue(m, LogicAction::SettlersTab(1));
        } else {
            game::queue(m, LogicAction::Page { page: 1, sub: None });
            game::queue(m, LogicAction::StartBuild { cat, slot: 0, btype: 0 });
        }
        let frames = m.state::<HudShared>().borrow_mut().panel_frames;
        self.harvest = Harvest::Cat { cat, wait_until: frames + 3, started_ms: self.now };
        self.dirty = true;
    }

    fn sync_layout_force_panel(&mut self, m: &mut Machine) {
        m.state::<HudShared>().borrow_mut().fullscreen_map = false;
        game::apply_layout(m, false);
    }

    fn next_harvest_cat(&mut self, m: &mut Machine, cat: u32) {
        if cat < SETTLERS_PAGE {
            self.start_harvest_cat(m, cat + 1);
        } else {
            let (page, c) = self.saved_page.take().unwrap_or((0, 1));
            game::queue(m, LogicAction::StartBuild { cat: c.max(1), slot: 0, btype: 0 });
            game::queue(m, LogicAction::Page { page: if page == 1 { 0 } else { page }, sub: None });
            self.harvest = Harvest::Done;
            m.state::<HudShared>().borrow_mut().harvesting = false;
            self.sync_layout(m);
            self.dirty = true;
        }
    }

    /// Called in `draw` with the guest frame (before the HUD draws): copy the build slots of the shown page.
    fn harvest_capture(&mut self, m: &mut Machine, c: &FrameBuffer) {
        let Harvest::Cat { cat, wait_until, .. } = self.harvest else { return };
        let frames = m.state::<HudShared>().borrow_mut().panel_frames;
        if frames < wait_until {
            return;
        }
        let Some(g) = game::gd(m) else { return };
        let shown = if cat == GOODS_PAGE {
            m.mem.read_u32(g + game::GD_PAGE) == 2 && m.mem.read_u32(g + game::GD_GOODS_TAB) == 1
        } else if cat == SETTLERS_PAGE {
            m.mem.read_u32(g + game::GD_PAGE) == 3 && m.mem.read_u32(g + game::GD_SETTLERS_TAB) == 1
        } else {
            m.mem.read_u32(g + game::GD_PAGE) == 1 && m.mem.read_u32(g + game::GD_BUILD_CAT) == cat
        };
        // The panel art needs a frame at least as high as the 640x480 layout (the zoom switches up for the harvest).
        if !shown || c.height < game::HARVEST_MIN_H {
            return;
        }
        if m.mem.read_u32(game::L_PANEL_W) == 0 {
            return;
        }
        let cell = m.mem.read_u32(game::L_CELL) as i32;
        let (gx, gy) = (m.mem.read_u32(game::L_GRID_X) as i32, m.mem.read_u32(game::L_GRID_Y) as i32);
        if !(1..=8).contains(&cell) {
            return;
        }
        if cat == GOODS_PAGE {
            for &(good, row, col, _) in GOODS.iter() {
                let (x, y, w, h) = inventory_icon_rect(row, col, cell, gx, gy);
                let img = Arc::new(copy_rect(c, Rect::new(x, y, w, h)));
                self.good_icons.retain(|(k, _)| *k != good);
                self.good_icons.push((good, img));
            }
            self.next_harvest_cat(m, cat);
            return;
        }
        if cat == SETTLERS_PAGE {
            for i in 0..POP_ICONS {
                let (x, y, w, h) = pop_icon_rect(i, cell, gx, gy);
                let img = Arc::new(copy_rect(c, Rect::new(x, y, w, h)));
                self.pop_icons.retain(|(k, _)| *k != i);
                self.pop_icons.push((i, img));
            }
            if std::env::var("S3_HUD_DEBUG").is_ok() {
                log_population_check(m, self.snap.as_ref());
            }
            self.next_harvest_cat(m, cat);
            return;
        }
        let race = self.icon_race.unwrap_or(0);
        for slot in 1..=12u32 {
            if build_type(race, cat, slot).is_none() {
                continue;
            }
            let r = slot_rect(slot, cell, gx, gy);
            let img = Arc::new(copy_rect(c, r));
            self.icons.retain(|(k, _)| *k != (cat, slot));
            self.icons.push(((cat, slot), img));
        }
        self.next_harvest_cat(m, cat);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ actions

    fn run(&mut self, m: &mut Machine, a: Action) {
        self.dirty = true;
        match a {
            Action::Category(c) => {
                self.sheet = if self.sheet == Sheet::Build(c) { Sheet::None } else { Sheet::Build(c) };
            }
            Action::Settlers => self.sheet = if self.sheet == Sheet::Settlers { Sheet::None } else { Sheet::Settlers },
            Action::Stats => self.sheet = if self.sheet == Sheet::Stats { Sheet::None } else { Sheet::Stats },
            Action::Menu => self.sheet = if self.sheet == Sheet::Menu { Sheet::None } else { Sheet::Menu },
            Action::CloseSheet | Action::MenuResume => self.sheet = Sheet::None,
            Action::Build { cat, slot, btype } => {
                game::queue(m, LogicAction::StartBuild { cat, slot, btype: btype as u32 });
                self.sheet = Sheet::None;
                let n = self.building_name(m, btype);
                self.set_toast(&format!("Tap the map to place: {n}"));
            }
            Action::CancelBuild => game::queue(m, LogicAction::CancelBuild),
            Action::Deselect => game::queue(m, LogicAction::ClearSelection),
            Action::MoveUnits => {
                crate::set_right_next(m, true);
                self.set_toast("Tap the target on the map");
            }
            Action::Order(o) => {
                if crate::unit_orders::arm(m, o) {
                    self.set_toast(o.hint());
                } else {
                    self.toast = None;
                }
            }
            Action::ToggleUnitPaths => {
                let mut s = crate::settings(m);
                s.unit_paths = s.unit_paths.next();
                let _ = crate::set_settings(m, s);
            }
            Action::CycleVibration => {
                let mut s = crate::settings(m);
                crate::settings::cycle_vibration(&mut s);
                let _ = crate::set_settings(m, s);
            }
            Action::ToggleGroups => {
                let mut s = crate::settings(m);
                s.group_shortcuts = !s.group_shortcuts;
                let _ = crate::set_settings(m, s);
            }
            Action::Destroy => {
                if self.now < self.destroy_armed_ms {
                    if let Some(b) = self.snap.as_ref().map(|s| s.building).filter(|&b| b != 0) {
                        game::queue(m, LogicAction::Destroy { building: b });
                        self.set_toast("Building destroyed");
                    }
                    self.destroy_armed_ms = 0;
                } else {
                    self.destroy_armed_ms = self.now + 3000;
                }
            }
            Action::BuildingDetails => self.sheet = Sheet::Building,
            Action::ToggleWork | Action::SitePriority | Action::Garrison(_) => {
                if std::env::var("S3_HUD_DEBUG").is_ok() {
                    if let Some(s) = self.snap.as_ref().filter(|s| s.building != 0) {
                        let e = s.gd + game::GD_BUILDINGS + s.building as u32 * 0x3a;
                        let b: Vec<String> = (0..0x3a).map(|i| format!("{:02x}", m.mem.read_u8(e + i))).collect();
                        eprintln!("ui-hud: {a:?} building {} entry {}", s.building, b.join(" "));
                    }
                }
                if let Some(req) = self.snap.as_ref().and_then(|s| building_request(s, &a)) {
                    game::queue(m, req);
                }
            }
            Action::WorkArea => {
                if let Some(b) = self.snap.as_ref().map(|s| s.building).filter(|&b| b != 0) {
                    game::queue(m, LogicAction::WorkArea { building: b });
                    self.sheet = Sheet::None;
                    self.set_toast("Tap the map to set the work area");
                }
            }
            Action::Recruit { kind, count } => {
                game::queue(m, LogicAction::Recruit { kind, count });
                self.set_toast(&format!("Ordered {count}"));
            }
            Action::MenuSave => {
                m.state::<HudShared>().borrow_mut().save_slots = None;
                game::queue(m, LogicAction::ReadSaveSlots);
                self.sheet = Sheet::Save;
            }
            Action::SaveSlot(slot) => {
                // An occupied slot needs a second tap within 3 s (the original list overwrites at once).
                let used = m.state::<HudShared>().borrow_mut().save_slots.as_ref().is_some_and(|s| {
                    !s.multiplayer && s.slots.get(slot.wrapping_sub(1) as usize).is_some_and(|x| x.is_some())
                });
                if used && !self.overwrite_armed(slot) {
                    self.overwrite = Some((slot, self.now + 3000));
                } else if self.saving.is_none() {
                    self.overwrite = None;
                    game::queue(m, LogicAction::SaveGame { slot });
                    self.saving = Some((slot, self.now));
                }
            }
            Action::MenuQuit => self.sheet = Sheet::QuitConfirm,
            Action::MenuQuitYes => {
                game::queue(m, LogicAction::QuitGame);
                self.sheet = Sheet::None;
            }
            Action::MenuPause => {
                // P toggles the pause page (game-state-ui.md: hotkey table).
                m.input.push(HostEvent::Key { vk: 0x50, down: true });
                m.input.push(HostEvent::Key { vk: 0x50, down: false });
                self.sheet = Sheet::None;
            }
            Action::MenuToggleMode => {
                let mut s = crate::settings(m);
                s.ui_mode = if s.ui_mode == UiMode::MobileHud { UiMode::ClassicTouch } else { UiMode::MobileHud };
                let _ = crate::set_settings(m, s);
                self.sheet = Sheet::None;
            }
            Action::MenuToggleFullMap => {
                self.fullscreen_map = !self.fullscreen_map;
                m.state::<HudShared>().borrow_mut().no_full = !self.fullscreen_map;
                let ok = m.state::<HudShared>().borrow_mut().buffer_ok;
                if self.fullscreen_map && !ok {
                    self.set_toast("Full-screen map after the next resolution change (F1-F3) or game start");
                }
            }
```
