`port/crates/s3-net/src/client.rs`:

```rs
//! Synchronous relay client for the DirectPlay HLE.
//!
//! The emulator thread calls blocking methods ([`NetClient::create_session`], ...) and polls events
//! ([`NetClient::poll_event`]) from `Receive`/`GetMessageCount`. A background thread runs a single-threaded tokio
//! runtime that owns the WebSocket, answers keepalives, acks frames and transparently resumes the link after a
//! network drop (mobile networks switch Wi-Fi <-> LTE). Nothing here blocks the game except explicit requests.

use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU32, Ordering};
use std::sync::mpsc as std_mpsc;
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

use futures_util::{SinkExt, StreamExt};
use tokio::sync::mpsc;
use tokio_tungstenite::tungstenite::Message as WsMessage;

use crate::link::{Accept, Link};
use crate::protocol::*;

type Ws = tokio_tungstenite::WebSocketStream<tokio_tungstenite::MaybeTlsStream<tokio::net::TcpStream>>;

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct ClientConfig {
    /// `ws://host:port/` of the relay.
    pub url: String,
    pub exe_sha256: Sha256,
    /// Shown in session lists / logs (not the in-game player name).
    pub name: String,
    pub build: String,
    /// How long blocking requests wait for the relay.
    pub request_timeout: Duration,
    /// Try to resume a dropped link for this long before reporting the session as lost (zero = never resume).
    pub resume_window: Duration,
    /// Declare the link dead if nothing is received for this long (relay pings us back every keepalive).
    pub idle_timeout: Duration,
}

impl ClientConfig {
    pub fn new(url: impl Into<String>, name: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
        Self {
            url: url.into(),
            exe_sha256: crate::GOG_EXE_SHA256,
            name: name.into(),
            build: concat!("s3-net ", env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION")).into(),
            request_timeout: Duration::from_secs(10),
            resume_window: Duration::from_secs(20),
            idle_timeout: Duration::from_secs(15),
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum NetError {
    Connect(String),
    Rejected(ErrorCode, String),
    Relay(ErrorCode, String),
    Timeout,
    Closed,
    Protocol(String),
}

impl NetError {
    pub fn code(&self) -> ErrorCode {
        match self {
            NetError::Rejected(c, _) | NetError::Relay(c, _) => *c,
            NetError::Timeout => ErrorCode::Timeout,
            _ => ErrorCode::Disconnected,
        }
    }
}

impl std::fmt::Display for NetError {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
        write!(f, "{self:?}")
    }
}

impl std::error::Error for NetError {}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum LinkState {
    Connected,
    Reconnecting,
    /// Link resumed after a drop, nothing lost.
    Resumed,
    /// Gave up (or relay forgot us); the session is gone.
    Lost,
}

/// What the HLE turns into DirectPlay messages (data messages or `DPSYS_*`).
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Event {
    Message { from: u32, to: u32, flags: u32, payload: Vec<u8> },
    PlayerAdded(PlayerInfo),
    PlayerRemoved(PlayerInfo),
    PlayerData { dpid: u32, data: Vec<u8> },
    PlayerName { dpid: u32, short_name: String, long_name: String },
    SessionDesc(SessionDesc),
    BecameHost,
    SessionLost(ErrorCode),
    Desync { client_id: u32, step: u32, checksum: u32, detail: String },
    Link(LinkState),
}

/// Session state mirrored from relay events (for EnumPlayers / GetPlayerData / GetSessionDesc).
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default)]
pub struct Snapshot {
    pub client_id: u32,
    pub session: Option<SessionDesc>,
    pub host: u32,
    pub players: HashMap<u32, PlayerInfo>,
    pub rtt_ms: Option<u32>,
}

impl Snapshot {
    pub fn is_host(&self) -> bool {
        self.session.is_some() && self.host == self.client_id
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Joined {
    pub desc: SessionDesc,
    pub host: u32,
    pub players: Vec<PlayerInfo>,
}

enum Cmd {
    Request(ClientMsg, std_mpsc::Sender<Result<ServerMsg, NetError>>),
    Fire(ClientMsg),
    Close,
}

pub struct NetClient {
    cmd: mpsc::UnboundedSender<Cmd>,
    events: Mutex<std_mpsc::Receiver<Event>>,
    snapshot: Arc<Mutex<Snapshot>>,
    next_req: AtomicU32,
    timeout: Duration,
    thread: Option<std::thread::JoinHandle<()>>,
}

impl NetClient {
    /// Connect and handshake (blocking). Fails with [`NetError::Rejected`] on version/exe mismatch.
    pub fn connect(cfg: ClientConfig) -> Result<NetClient, NetError> {
        let (cmd_tx, cmd_rx) = mpsc::unbounded_channel();
        let (ev_tx, ev_rx) = std_mpsc::channel();
        let (ready_tx, ready_rx) = std_mpsc::channel();
        let snapshot = Arc::new(Mutex::new(Snapshot::default()));
        let snap2 = snapshot.clone();
        let timeout = cfg.request_timeout;
        let thread = std::thread::Builder::new()
            .name("s3-net".into())
            .spawn(move || {
                let rt = match tokio::runtime::Builder::new_current_thread().enable_all().build() {
                    Ok(rt) => rt,
                    Err(e) => {
                        let _ = ready_tx.send(Err(NetError::Connect(e.to_string())));
                        return;
                    }
                };
                rt.block_on(async move {
                    let mut link = Link::<ClientMsg>::new();
                    match handshake(&cfg, None, &mut link).await {
                        Err(e) => {
                            let _ = ready_tx.send(Err(e));
                        }
                        Ok((ws, w)) => {
                            {
                                let mut s = snap2.lock().unwrap();
                                s.client_id = w.client_id;
                            }
                            let _ = ready_tx.send(Ok(()));
                            Task { cfg, link, token: w.token, keepalive: w.keepalive, cmd_rx, ev_tx, snapshot: snap2, pending: HashMap::new() }
                                .run(ws)
                                .await;
                        }
                    }
                });
            })
            .map_err(|e| NetError::Connect(e.to_string()))?;
        match ready_rx.recv_timeout(timeout + Duration::from_secs(1)) {
            Ok(Ok(())) => Ok(NetClient {
                cmd: cmd_tx,
                events: Mutex::new(ev_rx),
                snapshot,
                next_req: AtomicU32::new(1),
                timeout,
                thread: Some(thread),
            }),
            Ok(Err(e)) => Err(e),
            Err(_) => Err(NetError::Timeout),
        }
    }

    fn request(&self, make: impl FnOnce(u32) -> ClientMsg) -> Result<ServerMsg, NetError> {
        let req = self.next_req.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
        let (tx, rx) = std_mpsc::channel();
        self.cmd.send(Cmd::Request(make(req), tx)).map_err(|_| NetError::Closed)?;
        match rx.recv_timeout(self.timeout) {
            Ok(Ok(ServerMsg::Error { code, message, .. })) => Err(NetError::Relay(code, message)),
            Ok(r) => r,
            Err(std_mpsc::RecvTimeoutError::Timeout) => Err(NetError::Timeout),
            Err(_) => Err(NetError::Closed),
        }
    }

    fn expect_ok(r: Result<ServerMsg, NetError>) -> Result<(), NetError> {
        match r? {
            ServerMsg::Ok { .. } => Ok(()),
            other => Err(NetError::Protocol(format!("unexpected reply {other:?}"))),
        }
    }

    fn expect_joined(r: Result<ServerMsg, NetError>) -> Result<Joined, NetError> {
        match r? {
            ServerMsg::Joined { desc, host, players, .. } => Ok(Joined { desc, host, players }),
            other => Err(NetError::Protocol(format!("unexpected reply {other:?}"))),
        }
    }

    pub fn list_sessions(&self, application: Guid) -> Result<Vec<SessionDesc>, NetError> {
        match self.request(|req| ClientMsg::ListSessions { req, application })? {
            ServerMsg::SessionList { sessions, .. } => Ok(sessions),
            other => Err(NetError::Protocol(format!("unexpected reply {other:?}"))),
        }
    }

    /// DPOPEN_CREATE. The relay assigns the instance GUID (returned in `Joined::desc`).
    pub fn create_session(&self, desc: SessionDesc) -> Result<Joined, NetError> {
        Self::expect_joined(self.request(|req| ClientMsg::CreateSession { req, desc }))
    }

    /// DPOPEN_JOIN.
    pub fn join_session(&self, instance: Guid, password: &str) -> Result<Joined, NetError> {
        Self::expect_joined(self.request(|req| ClientMsg::JoinSession { req, instance, password: password.into() }))
    }

    pub fn leave_session(&self) -> Result<(), NetError> {
        Self::expect_ok(self.request(|req| ClientMsg::LeaveSession { req }))
    }

    pub fn set_session_desc(&self, desc: SessionDesc) -> Result<(), NetError> {
        Self::expect_ok(self.request(|req| ClientMsg::SetSessionDesc { req, desc }))
    }

    pub fn create_player(&self, short_name: &str, long_name: &str, data: &[u8], flags: u32) -> Result<u32, NetError> {
        let r = self.request(|req| ClientMsg::CreatePlayer {
            req,
            flags,
            short_name: short_name.into(),
            long_name: long_name.into(),
            data: data.to_vec(),
        })?;
        match r {
            ServerMsg::PlayerCreated { dpid, .. } => Ok(dpid),
            other => Err(NetError::Protocol(format!("unexpected reply {other:?}"))),
        }
    }

    pub fn destroy_player(&self, dpid: u32) -> Result<(), NetError> {
        Self::expect_ok(self.request(|req| ClientMsg::DestroyPlayer { req, dpid }))
    }

    pub fn set_player_data(&self, dpid: u32, data: &[u8]) -> Result<(), NetError> {
        Self::expect_ok(self.request(|req| ClientMsg::SetPlayerData { req, dpid, data: data.to_vec() }))
    }

    pub fn set_player_name(&self, dpid: u32, short_name: &str, long_name: &str) -> Result<(), NetError> {
        Self::expect_ok(self.request(|req| ClientMsg::SetPlayerName {
            req,
            dpid,
            short_name: short_name.into(),
            long_name: long_name.into(),
        }))
    }

    /// IDirectPlay4::Send. Non-blocking; ordering per sender is preserved. `to = 0` = all other players.
    pub fn send(&self, from: u32, to: u32, flags: u32, payload: &[u8]) -> Result<(), NetError> {
        if payload.len() > crate::wire::MAX_BYTES {
            return Err(NetError::Protocol("payload too big".into()));
        }
        self.cmd.send(Cmd::Fire(ClientMsg::Send { from, to, flags, payload: payload.to_vec() })).map_err(|_| NetError::Closed)
    }

    pub fn report_desync(&self, step: u32, checksum: u32, detail: &str) -> Result<(), NetError> {
        self.cmd
            .send(Cmd::Fire(ClientMsg::DesyncReport { step, checksum, detail: detail.into() }))
            .map_err(|_| NetError::Closed)
    }

    pub fn poll_event(&self) -> Option<Event> {
        self.events.lock().unwrap().try_recv().ok()
    }

    pub fn wait_event(&self, timeout: Duration) -> Option<Event> {
        self.events.lock().unwrap().recv_timeout(timeout).ok()
    }

    pub fn snapshot(&self) -> Snapshot {
        self.snapshot.lock().unwrap().clone()
    }

    pub fn client_id(&self) -> u32 {
        self.snapshot.lock().unwrap().client_id
    }

    /// Say goodbye and stop the background thread.
    pub fn close(mut self) {
        self.shutdown();
    }

    fn shutdown(&mut self) {
        let _ = self.cmd.send(Cmd::Close);
        if let Some(t) = self.thread.take() {
            let _ = t.join();
        }
    }
}

impl Drop for NetClient {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        self.shutdown();
    }
}

struct WelcomeInfo {
    client_id: u32,
    token: [u8; 16],
    keepalive: Duration,
    resumed: bool,
    last_seq: u64,
}

async fn send_frame(ws: &mut Ws, f: Frame<ClientMsg>) -> Result<(), NetError> {
    ws.send(WsMessage::binary(f.encode())).await.map_err(|e| NetError::Connect(e.to_string()))
}

async fn handshake(cfg: &ClientConfig, token: Option<[u8; 16]>, link: &mut Link<ClientMsg>) -> Result<(Ws, WelcomeInfo), NetError> {
    let connect = tokio_tungstenite::connect_async(cfg.url.as_str());
    let (mut ws, _) = tokio::time::timeout(cfg.request_timeout, connect)
        .await
        .map_err(|_| NetError::Timeout)?
        .map_err(|e| NetError::Connect(e.to_string()))?;
    let hello = ClientMsg::Hello {
        proto: PROTOCOL_VERSION,
        exe_sha256: cfg.exe_sha256,
        name: cfg.name.clone(),
        build: cfg.build.clone(),
        resume: token.map(|token| Resume { token, last_seq: link.last_recv }),
    };
    let f = link.stamp(hello);
    send_frame(&mut ws, f).await?;
    let deadline = Instant::now() + cfg.request_timeout;
    loop {
        let left = deadline.saturating_duration_since(Instant::now());
        let msg = tokio::time::timeout(left, ws.next()).await.map_err(|_| NetError::Timeout)?;
        let data = match msg {
            Some(Ok(WsMessage::Binary(b))) => b,
            Some(Ok(WsMessage::Close(_))) | None => return Err(NetError::Closed),
            Some(Ok(_)) => continue,
            Some(Err(e)) => return Err(NetError::Connect(e.to_string())),
        };
        let frame = Frame::<ServerMsg>::decode(&data).map_err(|e| NetError::Protocol(e.to_string()))?;
        return match frame.msg {
            ServerMsg::Welcome { proto, client_id, token, resumed, last_seq, keepalive_ms, .. } => {
                if proto != PROTOCOL_VERSION {
                    return Err(NetError::Rejected(ErrorCode::VersionMismatch, format!("relay speaks v{proto}")));
                }
                Ok((
                    ws,
                    WelcomeInfo {
                        client_id,
                        token,
                        keepalive: Duration::from_millis(keepalive_ms.clamp(200, 60_000) as u64),
                        resumed,
                        last_seq,
                    },
                ))
            }
            ServerMsg::Reject { code, message } => Err(NetError::Rejected(code, message)),
            other => Err(NetError::Protocol(format!("expected Welcome, got {other:?}"))),
        };
    }
}

struct Task {
    cfg: ClientConfig,
    link: Link<ClientMsg>,
    token: [u8; 16],
    keepalive: Duration,
    cmd_rx: mpsc::UnboundedReceiver<Cmd>,
    ev_tx: std_mpsc::Sender<Event>,
    snapshot: Arc<Mutex<Snapshot>>,
    pending: HashMap<u32, (Pending, std_mpsc::Sender<Result<ServerMsg, NetError>>)>,
}

/// What to update in the [`Snapshot`] when a request succeeds.
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
enum Pending {
    Other,
    Leave,
    Destroy(u32),
}

enum Exit {
    Closed,
    Dropped,
}

impl Task {
    async fn run(mut self, mut ws: Ws) {
        loop {
            match self.connected(&mut ws).await {
                Exit::Closed => {
                    let _ = ws.close(None).await;
                    break;
                }
                Exit::Dropped => {
                    let _ = self.ev_tx.send(Event::Link(LinkState::Reconnecting));
                    match self.reconnect().await {
                        Some(new_ws) => {
                            ws = new_ws;
                            let _ = self.ev_tx.send(Event::Link(LinkState::Resumed));
                        }
                        None => {
                            self.lost();
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for (_, (_, tx)) in self.pending.drain() {
            let _ = tx.send(Err(NetError::Closed));
        }
    }

    fn lost(&mut self) {
        let in_session = self.snapshot.lock().unwrap().session.take().is_some();
        if in_session {
            let _ = self.ev_tx.send(Event::SessionLost(ErrorCode::Disconnected));
        }
        let _ = self.ev_tx.send(Event::Link(LinkState::Lost));
    }

    async fn reconnect(&mut self) -> Option<Ws> {
        if self.cfg.resume_window.is_zero() {
            return None;
        }
        let give_up = Instant::now() + self.cfg.resume_window;
        let mut backoff = Duration::from_millis(100);
        while Instant::now() < give_up {
            match handshake(&self.cfg, Some(self.token), &mut self.link).await {
                Ok((mut ws, w)) => {
                    if !w.resumed {
                        log::warn!("s3-net: relay did not resume our session");
                        let _ = ws.close(None).await;
                        return None;
                    }
                    for f in self.link.retransmit_after(w.last_seq) {
                        if send_frame(&mut ws, f).await.is_err() {
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    return Some(ws);
                }
                Err(NetError::Rejected(code, msg)) => {
                    log::warn!("s3-net: resume rejected {code:?}: {msg}");
                    return None;
                }
                Err(e) => {
                    log::info!("s3-net: reconnect failed: {e}");
                    tokio::time::sleep(backoff).await;
                    backoff = (backoff * 2).min(Duration::from_secs(2));
                }
            }
        }
        None
    }

    async fn connected(&mut self, ws: &mut Ws) -> Exit {
        let mut ping = tokio::time::interval(self.keepalive);
        let mut ack_tick = tokio::time::interval(Duration::from_millis(100));
        let mut last_rx = Instant::now();
        let mut nonce: u64 = 0;
        let mut ping_sent: HashMap<u64, Instant> = HashMap::new();
        loop {
            tokio::select! {
                cmd = self.cmd_rx.recv() => {
                    let msg = match cmd {
                        Some(Cmd::Request(msg, tx)) => {
                            if let Some(req) = request_id(&msg) {
                                let kind = match &msg {
                                    ClientMsg::LeaveSession { .. } => Pending::Leave,
                                    ClientMsg::DestroyPlayer { dpid, .. } => Pending::Destroy(*dpid),
                                    _ => Pending::Other,
                                };
                                self.pending.insert(req, (kind, tx));
                            }
                            msg
                        }
                        Some(Cmd::Fire(msg)) => msg,
                        Some(Cmd::Close) | None => {
                            let f = self.link.stamp(ClientMsg::Bye);
                            let _ = send_frame(ws, f).await;
                            return Exit::Closed;
                        }
                    };
                    let f = self.link.stamp(msg);
                    if send_frame(ws, f).await.is_err() {
                        return Exit::Dropped;
                    }
                }
                msg = ws.next() => {
                    let data = match msg {
                        Some(Ok(WsMessage::Binary(b))) => b,
                        Some(Ok(WsMessage::Close(_))) | None | Some(Err(_)) => return Exit::Dropped,
                        Some(Ok(_)) => continue,
                    };
                    last_rx = Instant::now();
                    let frame = match Frame::<ServerMsg>::decode(&data) {
                        Ok(f) => f,
                        Err(e) => {
                            log::warn!("s3-net: bad frame from relay: {e}");
                            return Exit::Dropped;
                        }
                    };
                    self.link.on_ack(frame.ack);
                    match self.link.accept(frame.seq) {
                        Accept::New => {}
                        Accept::Duplicate => continue,
                        Accept::Gap { expected, got } => {
                            log::warn!("s3-net: frame gap (expected {expected}, got {got})");
                            return Exit::Dropped;
                        }
                    }
                    if let ServerMsg::Pong { nonce } = frame.msg {
                        if let Some(t) = ping_sent.remove(&nonce) {
                            self.snapshot.lock().unwrap().rtt_ms = Some(t.elapsed().as_millis() as u32);
                        }
                        continue;
                    }
                    self.dispatch(frame.msg);
                }
                _ = ack_tick.tick() => {
                    if self.link.ack_due() {
                        let f = self.link.stamp(ClientMsg::Ack);
                        if send_frame(ws, f).await.is_err() {
                            return Exit::Dropped;
                        }
                    }
                }
                _ = ping.tick() => {
                    if last_rx.elapsed() > self.cfg.idle_timeout {
                        log::info!("s3-net: relay silent for {:?}, reconnecting", last_rx.elapsed());
                        return Exit::Dropped;
                    }
                    nonce += 1;
                    ping_sent.retain(|_, t| t.elapsed() < Duration::from_secs(60));
                    ping_sent.insert(nonce, Instant::now());
                    let f = self.link.stamp(ClientMsg::Ping { nonce });
                    if send_frame(ws, f).await.is_err() {
                        return Exit::Dropped;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    fn reply(&mut self, req: u32, msg: ServerMsg) {
        if let Some((kind, tx)) = self.pending.remove(&req) {
            if let ServerMsg::Ok { .. } = msg {
                let mut s = self.snapshot.lock().unwrap();
                match kind {
                    Pending::Leave => {
                        s.session = None;
                        s.players.clear();
                    }
                    Pending::Destroy(dpid) => {
                        s.players.remove(&dpid);
                    }
                    Pending::Other => {}
                }
            }
            let _ = tx.send(Ok(msg));
        }
    }

    fn dispatch(&mut self, msg: ServerMsg) {
        let ev = |s: &Self, e: Event| {
            let _ = s.ev_tx.send(e);
        };
        match msg {
            ServerMsg::Welcome { .. } | ServerMsg::Reject { .. } | ServerMsg::Pong { .. } | ServerMsg::Ack => {}
            ServerMsg::Error { req, .. } | ServerMsg::Ok { req } | ServerMsg::SessionList { req, .. } | ServerMsg::PlayerCreated { req, .. } => {
                if let ServerMsg::PlayerCreated { dpid, .. } = &msg {
                    let mut s = self.snapshot.lock().unwrap();
                    let owner = s.client_id;
                    s.players.entry(*dpid).or_insert(PlayerInfo { dpid: *dpid, owner, ..Default::default() });
                }
                self.reply(req, msg);
            }
            ServerMsg::Joined { req, ref desc, host, ref players } => {
                {
                    let mut s = self.snapshot.lock().unwrap();
                    s.session = Some(desc.clone());
                    s.host = host;
                    s.players = players.iter().map(|p| (p.dpid, p.clone())).collect();
                }
                self.reply(req, msg);
            }
            ServerMsg::PlayerAdded { player } => {
                self.snapshot.lock().unwrap().players.insert(player.dpid, player.clone());
                ev(self, Event::PlayerAdded(player));
            }
            ServerMsg::PlayerRemoved { dpid } => {
                let p = self.snapshot.lock().unwrap().players.remove(&dpid).unwrap_or(PlayerInfo { dpid, ..Default::default() });
                ev(self, Event::PlayerRemoved(p));
            }
            ServerMsg::PlayerData { dpid, data } => {
                if let Some(p) = self.snapshot.lock().unwrap().players.get_mut(&dpid) {
                    p.data = data.clone();
                }
                ev(self, Event::PlayerData { dpid, data });
            }
            ServerMsg::PlayerName { dpid, short_name, long_name } => {
                if let Some(p) = self.snapshot.lock().unwrap().players.get_mut(&dpid) {
                    p.short_name = short_name.clone();
                    p.long_name = long_name.clone();
                }
                ev(self, Event::PlayerName { dpid, short_name, long_name });
            }
            ServerMsg::SessionDescChanged { desc } => {
                self.snapshot.lock().unwrap().session = Some(desc.clone());
                ev(self, Event::SessionDesc(desc));
            }
            ServerMsg::BecameHost => {
                {
                    let mut s = self.snapshot.lock().unwrap();
                    s.host = s.client_id;
                }
                ev(self, Event::BecameHost);
            }
            ServerMsg::SessionLost { code } => {
                {
                    let mut s = self.snapshot.lock().unwrap();
                    s.session = None;
                    s.players.clear();
                }
                ev(self, Event::SessionLost(code));
            }
            ServerMsg::Deliver { from, to, flags, payload } => ev(self, Event::Message { from, to, flags, payload }),
            ServerMsg::Desync { client_id, step, checksum, detail } => ev(self, Event::Desync { client_id, step, checksum, detail }),
        }
    }

}

fn request_id(msg: &ClientMsg) -> Option<u32> {
    use ClientMsg::*;
    match msg {
        ListSessions { req, .. }
        | CreateSession { req, .. }
        | JoinSession { req, .. }
        | SetSessionDesc { req, .. }
        | CreatePlayer { req, .. }
        | DestroyPlayer { req, .. }
        | SetPlayerData { req, .. }
        | SetPlayerName { req, .. } => Some(*req),
        LeaveSession { req } => Some(*req),
        _ => None,
    }
}
```

```rs
//! DirectPlay 6 constants and system-message layouts, for the future s3-dx DirectPlay HLE that sits on top of
//! [`crate::client::NetClient`]. Nothing here touches guest memory directly: [`SystemMessage::layout`] produces
//! the bytes the HLE copies into the game's Receive buffer.
//!
//! Sources: error codes are **OBSERVED** in S3.EXE's own HRESULT->name table at `0x7a03b4`; flag/struct values
//! are from dplay.h (memory) and are cross-checked against S3.EXE where the game uses them (see
//! docs/porting/multiplayer.md). Struct layouts are HYPOTHESIS until a runtime test feeds them to the game.

use crate::protocol::{ErrorCode, PlayerInfo, SessionDesc};

/// connection blob back to InitializeConnection (HYPOTHESIS to confirm in the build phase).

/// Map relay error codes to the HRESULTs the game expects from the matching DirectPlay call.
pub fn hresult_for(code: ErrorCode) -> u32 {
    use ErrorCode::*;
    match code {
        NoSuchSession => dperr::NOSESSIONS,
        SessionFull | JoinDisabled => dperr::NONEWPLAYERS,
        WrongPassword => dperr::INVALIDPASSWORD,
        NotInSession => dperr::UNINITIALIZED,
        AlreadyInSession => dperr::ALREADYINITIALIZED,
        NoSuchPlayer => dperr::INVALIDPLAYER,
        NotOwner => dperr::ACCESSDENIED,
        Timeout => dperr::TIMEOUT,
        Disconnected => dperr::CONNECTIONLOST,
        VersionMismatch | ExeMismatch => dperr::UNKNOWNAPPLICATION,
        ServerFull => dperr::CANNOTCREATESERVER,
        BadRequest => dperr::INVALIDPARAMS,
        ResumeFailed => dperr::SESSIONLOST,
        Unknown => dperr::GENERIC,
    }
}

/// UTF-8 -> Windows-1252-ish ANSI (chars above U+00FF become `?`). S3 is a German/Latin-1 game.
pub fn to_ansi(s: &str) -> Vec<u8> {
    s.chars().map(|c| if (c as u32) < 0x100 { c as u32 as u8 } else { b'?' }).collect()
}

/// A DirectPlay system message (`idFrom == DPID_SYSMSG`) as the HLE must hand it to `Receive`.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum SystemMessage {
    CreatePlayer { player: PlayerInfo, current_players: u32 },
    DestroyPlayer { player: PlayerInfo },
    SetPlayerData { dpid: u32, data: Vec<u8> },
    SetSessionDesc { desc: SessionDesc },
    Host,
    SessionLost,
}

fn put(v: &mut Vec<u8>, x: u32) {
    v.extend_from_slice(&x.to_le_bytes());
}

/// Write a DPSESSIONDESC2 whose string pointers point into `tail` (appended after the struct by the caller).
fn put_session_desc(out: &mut Vec<u8>, tail: &mut Vec<u8>, base: u32, fixed_len: usize, d: &SessionDesc) {
    let tail_ptr = |tail: &Vec<u8>| base + fixed_len as u32 + tail.len() as u32;
    put(out, DPSESSIONDESC2_SIZE as u32);
    put(out, d.flags);
    out.extend_from_slice(&d.instance);
    out.extend_from_slice(&d.application);
    put(out, d.max_players);
    put(out, d.current_players);
    let name_ptr = tail_ptr(tail);
    tail.extend(to_ansi(&d.name));
    tail.push(0);
    put(out, name_ptr);
    put(out, 0); // lpszPassword: never exposed
    put(out, 0); // dwReserved1
    put(out, 0); // dwReserved2
    for u in d.user {
        put(out, u);
    }
}

fn put_name(out: &mut Vec<u8>, tail: &mut Vec<u8>, base: u32, fixed_len: usize, short: &str, long: &str) {
    put(out, DPNAME_SIZE as u32);
    put(out, 0);
    for s in [short, long] {
        if s.is_empty() {
            put(out, 0);
        } else {
            put(out, base + fixed_len as u32 + tail.len() as u32);
            tail.extend(to_ansi(s));
            tail.push(0);
        }
    }
}

impl SystemMessage {
    /// Size of the fixed `DPMSG_*` struct (strings/data follow it in the same buffer).
    pub fn fixed_len(&self) -> usize {
        match self {
            // dwType dwPlayerType dpId dwCurrentPlayers lpData dwDataSize DPNAME dpIdParent dwFlags
            SystemMessage::CreatePlayer { .. } => 6 * 4 + DPNAME_SIZE + 2 * 4,
            // dwType dwPlayerType dpId lpLocalData dwLocalDataSize lpRemoteData dwRemoteDataSize DPNAME dpIdParent dwFlags
            SystemMessage::DestroyPlayer { .. } => 7 * 4 + DPNAME_SIZE + 2 * 4,
            // dwType dwPlayerType dpId lpData dwDataSize
            SystemMessage::SetPlayerData { .. } => 5 * 4,
            SystemMessage::SetSessionDesc { .. } => 4 + DPSESSIONDESC2_SIZE,
            SystemMessage::Host | SystemMessage::SessionLost => 4,
        }
    }

    /// Serialize as it must appear at guest address `base`: fixed struct, then strings/data it points to.
    /// The returned length is what `Receive` reports in `*lpdwDataSize` (DirectPlay also counts the tail).
    pub fn layout(&self, base: u32) -> Vec<u8> {
        let fixed = self.fixed_len();
        let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(fixed + 64);
        let mut tail = Vec::new();
        match self {
            SystemMessage::CreatePlayer { player, current_players } => {
                put(&mut out, dpsys::CREATEPLAYERORGROUP);
                put(&mut out, DPPLAYERTYPE_PLAYER);
                put(&mut out, player.dpid);
                put(&mut out, *current_players);
                let data_ptr = if player.data.is_empty() { 0 } else { base + fixed as u32 };
                tail.extend_from_slice(&player.data);
                put(&mut out, data_ptr);
                put(&mut out, player.data.len() as u32);
                put_name(&mut out, &mut tail, base, fixed, &player.short_name, &player.long_name);
                put(&mut out, 0); // dpIdParent
                put(&mut out, player.flags);
            }
            SystemMessage::DestroyPlayer { player } => {
                put(&mut out, dpsys::DESTROYPLAYERORGROUP);
                put(&mut out, DPPLAYERTYPE_PLAYER);
                put(&mut out, player.dpid);
                put(&mut out, 0); // lpLocalData
                put(&mut out, 0);
                let data_ptr = if player.data.is_empty() { 0 } else { base + fixed as u32 };
                tail.extend_from_slice(&player.data);
                put(&mut out, data_ptr);
                put(&mut out, player.data.len() as u32);
                put_name(&mut out, &mut tail, base, fixed, &player.short_name, &player.long_name);
                put(&mut out, 0);
                put(&mut out, player.flags);
            }
            SystemMessage::SetPlayerData { dpid, data } => {
                put(&mut out, dpsys::SETPLAYERORGROUPDATA);
                put(&mut out, DPPLAYERTYPE_PLAYER);
                put(&mut out, *dpid);
                put(&mut out, if data.is_empty() { 0 } else { base + fixed as u32 });
                put(&mut out, data.len() as u32);
                tail.extend_from_slice(data);
            }
            SystemMessage::SetSessionDesc { desc } => {
                put(&mut out, dpsys::SETSESSIONDESC);
                put_session_desc(&mut out, &mut tail, base, fixed, desc);
            }
            SystemMessage::Host => put(&mut out, dpsys::HOST),
            SystemMessage::SessionLost => put(&mut out, dpsys::SESSIONLOST),
        }
        debug_assert_eq!(out.len(), fixed);
        out.extend_from_slice(&tail);
        out
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn rd(b: &[u8], off: usize) -> u32 {
        u32::from_le_bytes(b[off..off + 4].try_into().unwrap())
    }

    #[test]
    fn hresults_match_dplay_formula() {
        // MAKE_DPHRESULT(code) = 0x88770000 | code
        assert_eq!(dperr::NOTLOBBIED, 0x8877_0000 | 1070);
        assert_eq!(dperr::NOMESSAGES, 0x8877_0000 | 190);
        assert_eq!(dperr::NOMESSAGES as i32, -0x7788_ff42); // the constant S3 compares Receive against
        assert_eq!(hresult_for(ErrorCode::SessionFull), dperr::NONEWPLAYERS);
    }

    #[test]
    fn create_player_layout() {
        let p = PlayerInfo { dpid: 0x55, owner: 1, flags: 0, short_name: "Jörg".into(), long_name: "".into(), data: vec![9, 8] };
        let m = SystemMessage::CreatePlayer { player: p, current_players: 2 };
        let base = 0x0100_0000;
        let b = m.layout(base);
        assert_eq!(m.fixed_len(), 48);
        assert_eq!(rd(&b, 0), dpsys::CREATEPLAYERORGROUP);
        assert_eq!(rd(&b, 4), DPPLAYERTYPE_PLAYER);
        assert_eq!(rd(&b, 8), 0x55);
        assert_eq!(rd(&b, 12), 2);
        assert_eq!(rd(&b, 16), base + 48); // data right after the struct
        assert_eq!(rd(&b, 20), 2);
        assert_eq!(rd(&b, 24), 16); // DPNAME.dwSize
        let short = rd(&b, 32);
        assert_eq!(short, base + 50);
        assert_eq!(&b[50..55], &[b'J', 0xf6, b'r', b'g', 0]);
        assert_eq!(rd(&b, 36), 0); // empty long name -> NULL
    }

    #[test]
    fn set_player_data_type_is_player() {
        // S3 checks dwPlayerType == 1 at 0x5bd013 before dispatching SETPLAYERORGROUPDATA.
        let b = SystemMessage::SetPlayerData { dpid: 7, data: vec![1, 2, 3] }.layout(0x1000);
        assert_eq!(rd(&b, 4), 1);
        assert_eq!(b.len(), 23);
    }

    #[test]
    fn session_desc_layout() {
        let d = SessionDesc { flags: 0x44, max_players: 6, current_players: 3, name: "abc".into(), user: [1, 2, 3, 4], ..Default::default() };
        let b = SystemMessage::SetSessionDesc { desc: d }.layout(0x2000);
        assert_eq!(rd(&b, 4), 0x50);
        assert_eq!(rd(&b, 8), 0x44);
        assert_eq!(rd(&b, 4 + 0x28), 6);
        assert_eq!(rd(&b, 4 + 0x30), 0x2000 + 0x54);
        assert_eq!(rd(&b, 4 + 0x4c), 4);
        assert_eq!(&b[0x54..], b"abc\0");
    }
}
```

`port/crates/s3-net/src/lan.rs`:

```rs
//! LAN discovery of hosts running an embedded relay (docs/porting/multiplayer.md section 8).
//!
//! One background thread per process:
//! * the **listen socket** on [`LAN_PORT`] (SO_REUSEADDR, so several instances on one PC can share it) receives
//!   queries and beacons;
//! * one **interface socket** per local IPv4 address (ephemeral port, bound to that address, so a broadcast leaves
//!   through every interface, not only the default route) broadcasts a query every second to 255.255.255.255 and
//!   the interface's subnet broadcast; hosts answer with a unicast beacon to that socket. Unicast answers to an
//!   outgoing broadcast pass the Windows firewall by default, so a PC finds a phone host without an inbound rule;
//! * while hosting, beacons go out every second from every interface socket (the source address tells the
//!   receiver where the relay is) and to loopback (other instances on this machine).
//!
//! Packet: `"S3PLAN1"` kind:u8 (1 = query, 2 = beacon) nonce:u64le exe_tag:8 relay_port:u16le name_len:u8 name.
//! `nonce` identifies the sending process (own packets are ignored); `exe_tag` = first 8 bytes of the exe sha256
//! (hosts with another exe are ignored: lockstep needs identical code).

use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::net::{IpAddr, Ipv4Addr, SocketAddr, SocketAddrV4, UdpSocket};
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex, OnceLock};
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

/// UDP port of the discovery protocol.
pub const LAN_PORT: u16 = 47777;
const MAGIC: &[u8; 7] = b"S3PLAN1";
const KIND_QUERY: u8 = 1;
const KIND_BEACON: u8 = 2;
/// A host not heard from for this long is dropped from the list.
const EXPIRE: Duration = Duration::from_secs(6);
const PERIOD: Duration = Duration::from_millis(1000);
/// Interfaces are re-read this often (Wi-Fi reconnects, new DHCP address).
const IFACE_REFRESH: Duration = Duration::from_secs(10);

/// A host found on the LAN.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct LanHost {
    /// Candidate addresses of its relay (`ws://addr/`), best first (a host with several interfaces, e.g. Wi-Fi plus
    /// a virtual adapter, is heard on each of them).
    pub relays: Vec<SocketAddr>,
    /// Session name it announced.
    pub name: String,
    pub nonce: u64,
}

impl LanHost {
    pub fn url(addr: &SocketAddr) -> String {
        format!("ws://{addr}/")
    }
}

#[derive(Default)]
struct Inner {
    hosting: Option<(u16, String)>,
    /// nonce -> (name, address -> last heard)
    hosts: HashMap<u64, (String, HashMap<SocketAddr, Instant>)>,
}

/// Discovery service (one per process, see [`Discovery::global`]).
pub struct Discovery {
    nonce: u64,
    exe_tag: [u8; 8],
    inner: Mutex<Inner>,
    /// Local IPv4 addresses (for ranking candidate host addresses).
    local_ips: Mutex<Vec<Ipv4Addr>>,
}

fn encode(kind: u8, nonce: u64, exe_tag: &[u8; 8], port: u16, name: &str) -> Vec<u8> {
    let mut v = MAGIC.to_vec();
    v.push(kind);
    v.extend_from_slice(&nonce.to_le_bytes());
    v.extend_from_slice(exe_tag);
    v.extend_from_slice(&port.to_le_bytes());
    let n = &name.as_bytes()[..name.len().min(64)];
    v.push(n.len() as u8);
    v.extend_from_slice(n);
    v
}

/// (kind, nonce, exe_tag, port, name)
fn decode(b: &[u8]) -> Option<(u8, u64, [u8; 8], u16, String)> {
    if b.len() < 7 + 1 + 8 + 8 + 2 + 1 || &b[..7] != MAGIC {
        return None;
    }
    let kind = b[7];
    let nonce = u64::from_le_bytes(b[8..16].try_into().ok()?);
    let tag: [u8; 8] = b[16..24].try_into().ok()?;
    let port = u16::from_le_bytes([b[24], b[25]]);
    let n = b[26] as usize;
    let name = String::from_utf8_lossy(b.get(27..27 + n)?).into_owned();
    Some((kind, nonce, tag, port, name))
}

fn udp_socket(ip: Ipv4Addr, port: u16, reuse: bool) -> std::io::Result<UdpSocket> {
    use socket2::{Domain, Protocol, Socket, Type};
    let s = Socket::new(Domain::IPV4, Type::DGRAM, Some(Protocol::UDP))?;
    if reuse {
        s.set_reuse_address(true)?;
    }
    s.set_broadcast(true)?;
    s.bind(&SocketAddr::V4(SocketAddrV4::new(ip, port)).into())?;
    let u: UdpSocket = s.into();
    u.set_nonblocking(true)?;
    Ok(u)
}

/// Local IPv4 interface addresses with their broadcast address (if known), loopback excluded.
#[cfg(unix)]
pub fn interfaces() -> Vec<(Ipv4Addr, Option<Ipv4Addr>)> {
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    unsafe {
        let mut ifa: *mut libc::ifaddrs = std::ptr::null_mut();
        if libc::getifaddrs(&mut ifa) != 0 {
            return out;
        }
        let mut p = ifa;
        while !p.is_null() {
            let i = &*p;
            let up = i.ifa_flags & libc::IFF_UP as libc::c_uint != 0;
            if up && !i.ifa_addr.is_null() && (*i.ifa_addr).sa_family as i32 == libc::AF_INET {
                let a = &*(i.ifa_addr as *const libc::sockaddr_in);
                let ip = Ipv4Addr::from(u32::from_be(a.sin_addr.s_addr));
                let mut bc = None;
                if !i.ifa_netmask.is_null() {
                    let nm = &*(i.ifa_netmask as *const libc::sockaddr_in);
                    let mask = u32::from_be(nm.sin_addr.s_addr);
                    bc = Some(Ipv4Addr::from(u32::from(ip) | !mask));
                }
                if !ip.is_loopback() {
                    out.push((ip, bc));
                }
            }
            p = i.ifa_next;
        }
        libc::freeifaddrs(ifa);
    }
    out
}

/// Local IPv4 interface addresses (Windows: the host name's addresses, std only); the broadcast address is guessed
/// as /24 (a wrong guess only sends one useless datagram: 255.255.255.255 from the bound address is the main path).
#[cfg(not(unix))]
pub fn interfaces() -> Vec<(Ipv4Addr, Option<Ipv4Addr>)> {
    use std::net::ToSocketAddrs;
    let mut out: Vec<(Ipv4Addr, Option<Ipv4Addr>)> = Vec::new();
    let host = std::env::var("COMPUTERNAME").unwrap_or_else(|_| "localhost".into());
    let mut add = |ip: Ipv4Addr| {
        if !ip.is_loopback() && !ip.is_unspecified() && !ip.is_link_local() && !out.iter().any(|(a, _)| *a == ip) {
            let o = ip.octets();
            out.push((ip, Some(Ipv4Addr::new(o[0], o[1], o[2], 255))));
        }
    };
    if let Ok(it) = (host.as_str(), 0u16).to_socket_addrs() {
        for a in it {
            if let IpAddr::V4(ip) = a.ip() {
                add(ip);
            }
        }
    }
    if let Some(ip) = primary_ipv4() {
        add(ip);
    }
    out
}

/// Our IPv4 address on the default route (no packet is sent: UDP connect only picks the interface).
pub fn primary_ipv4() -> Option<Ipv4Addr> {
    let s = UdpSocket::bind("0.0.0.0:0").ok()?;
    s.connect("192.0.2.1:9").ok()?;
    match s.local_addr().ok()?.ip() {
        IpAddr::V4(ip) if !ip.is_loopback() && !ip.is_unspecified() => Some(ip),
        _ => None,
    }
}

/// Number of leading bits `a` shares with the closest local address (ranks candidate host addresses).
fn affinity(a: &SocketAddr, local: &[Ipv4Addr]) -> u32 {
    match a.ip() {
        IpAddr::V4(ip) if ip.is_loopback() => 1,
        IpAddr::V4(ip) => 2 + local.iter().map(|l| (u32::from(ip) ^ u32::from(*l)).leading_zeros()).max().unwrap_or(0),
        _ => 0,
    }
}

struct Iface {
    ip: Ipv4Addr,
    bcast: Option<Ipv4Addr>,
    sock: UdpSocket,
}

static START_HOOK: OnceLock<fn()> = OnceLock::new();

/// Called once before discovery opens its sockets (Android: acquire the Wi-Fi multicast lock so broadcasts from
/// other devices are not filtered).
pub fn set_start_hook(f: fn()) {
    let _ = START_HOOK.set(f);
}

impl Discovery {
    /// The process-wide discovery service (started on first use).
    pub fn global(exe_sha256: &[u8; 32]) -> Arc<Discovery> {
        static G: Mutex<Option<Arc<Discovery>>> = Mutex::new(None);
        let mut g = G.lock().unwrap();
        if let Some(d) = g.as_ref() {
            return d.clone();
        }
        let d = Discovery::start(exe_sha256[..8].try_into().unwrap());
        *g = Some(d.clone());
        d
    }

    /// Start a discovery thread (tests may run several in one process).
    pub fn start(exe_tag: [u8; 8]) -> Arc<Discovery> {
        if let Some(h) = START_HOOK.get() {
            h();
        }
        let listen = match udp_socket(Ipv4Addr::UNSPECIFIED, LAN_PORT, true) {
            Ok(s) => Some(s),
            Err(e) => {
                log::warn!("lan: cannot listen on udp {LAN_PORT}: {e} (queries still work)");
                None
            }
        };
        let any = udp_socket(Ipv4Addr::UNSPECIFIED, 0, false).map_err(|e| log::warn!("lan: no query socket: {e}")).ok();
        let d = Arc::new(Discovery {
            nonce: u64::from_le_bytes(crate::random_bytes::<8>()),
            exe_tag,
            inner: Mutex::new(Inner::default()),
            local_ips: Mutex::new(Vec::new()),
        });
        let d2 = d.clone();
        let _ = std::thread::Builder::new().name("s3-lan".into()).spawn(move || d2.run(listen, any));
        log::info!("lan: discovery started (udp {LAN_PORT}, nonce {:016x})", d.nonce);
        d
    }

    /// Announce (`Some((relay_port, session_name))`) or stop announcing (`None`).
    pub fn set_hosting(&self, h: Option<(u16, String)>) {
        log::info!("lan: hosting {h:?}");
        self.inner.lock().unwrap().hosting = h;
    }

    /// Hosts heard from recently (not ourselves), candidate addresses best first.
    pub fn hosts(&self) -> Vec<LanHost> {
        let local = self.local_ips.lock().unwrap().clone();
        let mut g = self.inner.lock().unwrap();
        for (_, addrs) in g.hosts.values_mut() {
            addrs.retain(|_, t| t.elapsed() < EXPIRE);
        }
        g.hosts.retain(|_, (_, a)| !a.is_empty());
        let mut v: Vec<LanHost> = g
            .hosts
            .iter()
            .map(|(n, (name, addrs))| {
                let mut relays: Vec<SocketAddr> = addrs.keys().copied().collect();
                relays.sort_by_key(|a| (std::cmp::Reverse(affinity(a, &local)), *a));
                LanHost { relays, name: name.clone(), nonce: *n }
            })
            .collect();
        v.sort_by_key(|h| h.nonce);
        v
    }

    /// Wait up to `timeout` until at least one host is known; returns the list.
    pub fn wait_hosts(&self, timeout: Duration) -> Vec<LanHost> {
        let end = Instant::now() + timeout;
        loop {
            let h = self.hosts();
            if !h.is_empty() || Instant::now() >= end {
                return h;
            }
            std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(50));
        }
    }

    fn open_ifaces(&self, old: Vec<Iface>) -> Vec<Iface> {
        let now = interfaces();
        if now.len() == old.len() && now.iter().zip(&old).all(|((ip, bc), i)| *ip == i.ip && *bc == i.bcast) {
            return old;
        }
        let v: Vec<Iface> = now
            .into_iter()
            .filter_map(|(ip, bcast)| match udp_socket(ip, 0, false) {
                Ok(sock) => Some(Iface { ip, bcast, sock }),
                Err(e) => {
                    log::warn!("lan: cannot bind {ip}: {e}");
                    None
                }
            })
            .collect();
        log::info!("lan: interfaces {:?}", v.iter().map(|i| (i.ip, i.bcast)).collect::<Vec<_>>());
        *self.local_ips.lock().unwrap() = v.iter().map(|i| i.ip).collect();
        v
    }

    fn run(self: Arc<Self>, listen: Option<UdpSocket>, any: Option<UdpSocket>) {
        let mut last_tx: Option<Instant> = None;
        let mut last_if: Option<Instant> = None;
        let mut ifaces: Vec<Iface> = Vec::new();
        let mut buf = [0u8; 512];
        let loopback = SocketAddr::from((Ipv4Addr::LOCALHOST, LAN_PORT));
        let limited = SocketAddr::from((Ipv4Addr::BROADCAST, LAN_PORT));
        loop {
            if last_if.map_or(true, |t| t.elapsed() >= IFACE_REFRESH) {
                last_if = Some(Instant::now());
                ifaces = self.open_ifaces(std::mem::take(&mut ifaces));
            }
            if last_tx.map_or(true, |t| t.elapsed() >= PERIOD) {
                last_tx = Some(Instant::now());
                let hosting = self.inner.lock().unwrap().hosting.clone();
                let pkt = match &hosting {
                    Some((port, name)) => encode(KIND_BEACON, self.nonce, &self.exe_tag, *port, name),
                    None => encode(KIND_QUERY, self.nonce, &self.exe_tag, 0, ""),
                };
                for i in &ifaces {
                    let _ = i.sock.send_to(&pkt, limited);
                    if let Some(b) = i.bcast {
                        let _ = i.sock.send_to(&pkt, SocketAddr::from((b, LAN_PORT)));
                    }
                }
                if let Some(a) = &any {
                    let _ = a.send_to(&pkt, loopback);
                    if ifaces.is_empty() {
                        let _ = a.send_to(&pkt, limited);
                    }
                }
            }
            let mut got = false;
            let socks = listen.iter().chain(any.iter()).chain(ifaces.iter().map(|i| &i.sock));
            for s in socks {
                while let Ok((n, from)) = s.recv_from(&mut buf) {
                    got = true;
                    self.handle(s, &buf[..n], from);
                }
            }
            if !got {
                std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(30));
            }
        }
    }

    fn handle(&self, sock: &UdpSocket, pkt: &[u8], from: SocketAddr) {
        let Some((kind, nonce, tag, port, name)) = decode(pkt) else { return };
        if nonce == self.nonce || tag != self.exe_tag {
            return;
        }
        match kind {
            KIND_QUERY => {
                let hosting = self.inner.lock().unwrap().hosting.clone();
                if let Some((p, n)) = hosting {
                    let _ = sock.send_to(&encode(KIND_BEACON, self.nonce, &self.exe_tag, p, &n), from);
                }
            }
            KIND_BEACON if port != 0 => {
                let addr = SocketAddr::new(from.ip(), port);
                let mut g = self.inner.lock().unwrap();
                let e = g.hosts.entry(nonce).or_insert_with(|| (name.clone(), HashMap::new()));
                if !e.1.contains_key(&addr) {
                    log::info!("lan: host '{name}' relay {addr}");
                }
                e.0 = name;
                e.1.insert(addr, Instant::now());
            }
            _ => {}
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn packet_roundtrip() {
        let p = encode(KIND_BEACON, 0x1122, b"abcdefgh", 7777, "Player's game");
        assert_eq!(decode(&p), Some((KIND_BEACON, 0x1122, *b"abcdefgh", 7777, "Player's game".into())));
        assert_eq!(decode(&p[..10]), None);
    }

    #[test]
    fn affinity_prefers_same_subnet() {
        let local = [Ipv4Addr::new(192, 168, 1, 51)];
        let wifi: SocketAddr = "192.168.1.50:7777".parse().unwrap();
        let vnet: SocketAddr = "172.16.0.1:7777".parse().unwrap();
        let lo: SocketAddr = "127.0.0.1:7777".parse().unwrap();
        assert!(affinity(&wifi, &local) > affinity(&vnet, &local));
        assert!(affinity(&vnet, &local) > affinity(&lo, &local));
    }

    #[test]
    fn two_instances_find_each_other() {
        let a = Discovery::start(*b"testtag1");
        let b = Discovery::start(*b"testtag1");
        let other = Discovery::start(*b"othertag");
        other.set_hosting(Some((1, "other exe".into())));
        a.set_hosting(Some((12345, "game A".into())));
        let h = b.wait_hosts(Duration::from_secs(5));
        assert_eq!(h.len(), 1, "{h:?}");
        assert!(h[0].relays.iter().all(|r| r.port() == 12345));
        assert_eq!(h[0].name, "game A");
        assert!(a.hosts().is_empty());
        a.set_hosting(None);
    }
}
```

```rs
//! Online multiplayer for the Settlers 3 port (workstream W5).
//!
//! * [`protocol`]: relay wire protocol v1 (frames, client/server messages), see docs/porting/multiplayer.md.
//! * [`link`]: sequence/ack bookkeeping that lets a dropped connection resume without loss.
//! * [`client`]: synchronous client handle for the DirectPlay HLE (a background thread runs the async socket).
//! * [`dplay`]: DirectPlay 6 constants (error table observed in S3.EXE) and system-message layouts.
//!
//! The server lives in the `s3-relay` crate.

pub mod client;
pub mod dplay;
pub mod lan;
pub mod link;
pub mod protocol;
pub mod wire;

/// sha256 of the GOG S3.EXE (the build all our hooks are keyed to). Lockstep play requires every peer to run
/// the same exe; the relay only lets clients with the same hash into one session.
pub const GOG_EXE_SHA256: protocol::Sha256 = hex32("00a925cfdcfc3349b5d0f3b8a4c312f01b813e363b4464f6f3d6de17804d950b");

/// Application GUID S3.EXE puts into its DPSESSIONDESC2 (OBSERVED, `0x6970f8`).
pub const S3_APP_GUID: protocol::Guid = protocol::guid("{0E9F8400-D9A5-11CF-8F4D-00804880B189}");

/// Parse 64 hex digits at compile time.
pub const fn hex32(s: &str) -> [u8; 32] {
    const fn h(c: u8) -> u8 {
        match c {
            b'0'..=b'9' => c - b'0',
            b'a'..=b'f' => c - b'a' + 10,
            b'A'..=b'F' => c - b'A' + 10,
            _ => panic!("bad hex"),
        }
    }
    let b = s.as_bytes();
    assert!(b.len() == 64);
    let mut out = [0u8; 32];
    let mut i = 0;
    while i < 32 {
        out[i] = h(b[2 * i]) << 4 | h(b[2 * i + 1]);
        i += 1;
    }
    out
}

/// Parse a 64-digit hex sha256 at runtime (CLI flags).
pub fn parse_sha256(s: &str) -> Option<protocol::Sha256> {
    let s = s.trim();
    if s.len() != 64 || !s.bytes().all(|c| c.is_ascii_hexdigit()) {
        return None;
    }
    Some(hex32(s))
}

pub fn hex(bytes: &[u8]) -> String {
    bytes.iter().map(|b| format!("{b:02x}")).collect()
}

/// Bytes from the OS-seeded std hasher (no extra dependency). Good enough for session GUIDs and resume
/// tokens on a hobby relay; HYPOTHESIS: switch to `getrandom` before a public deployment.
pub fn random_bytes<const N: usize>() -> [u8; N] {
    use std::collections::hash_map::RandomState;
    use std::hash::{BuildHasher, Hasher};
    use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU64, Ordering};
    static CTR: AtomicU64 = AtomicU64::new(0);
    let mut out = [0u8; N];
    for chunk in out.chunks_mut(8) {
        let mut h = RandomState::new().build_hasher();
        h.write_u64(CTR.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed));
        let t = std::time::SystemTime::now().duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH).map(|d| d.as_nanos()).unwrap_or(0);
        h.write_u128(t);
        let v = h.finish().to_le_bytes();
        chunk.copy_from_slice(&v[..chunk.len()]);
    }
    out
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    #[test]
    fn hashes() {
        assert_eq!(super::GOG_EXE_SHA256[0], 0x00);
        assert_eq!(super::GOG_EXE_SHA256[1], 0xa9);
        assert_eq!(super::hex(&super::GOG_EXE_SHA256[..4]), "00a925cf");
        assert_eq!(super::parse_sha256(&super::hex(&super::GOG_EXE_SHA256)), Some(super::GOG_EXE_SHA256));
        assert_eq!(super::parse_sha256("zz"), None);
        let a: [u8; 16] = super::random_bytes();
        let b: [u8; 16] = super::random_bytes();
        assert_ne!(a, b);
    }
}
```

`port/crates/s3-net/src/link.rs`:

```rs
//! Per-direction sequencing for resumable links (used by both client and relay).
//!
//! Every non-control message gets `seq = 1, 2, ...`; each frame carries `ack` = highest seq received from the
//! peer. The sender keeps messages until acked and retransmits the ones after the peer's `last_seq` when a
//! connection is resumed. The transport (WebSocket over TCP) is ordered, so a gap means a protocol bug.

use std::collections::VecDeque;

use crate::protocol::{Frame, Message};

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Accept {
    /// Control frame or next frame in order: process it.
    New,
    /// Already processed (retransmission after resume): ignore.
    Duplicate,
    /// Missing frames before this one: the link is broken.
    Gap { expected: u64, got: u64 },
}

#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct Link<M> {
    next_seq: u64,
    unacked: VecDeque<(u64, M)>,
    /// Highest in-order seq received from the peer.
    pub last_recv: u64,
    /// Highest seq we told the peer about (to decide when an explicit Ack is due).
    pub last_ack_sent: u64,
}

impl<M: Message + Clone> Default for Link<M> {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new()
    }
}

impl<M: Message + Clone> Link<M> {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self { next_seq: 1, unacked: VecDeque::new(), last_recv: 0, last_ack_sent: 0 }
    }

    /// Assign a sequence number (control messages get 0 and are not kept) and build the frame.
    pub fn stamp(&mut self, msg: M) -> Frame<M> {
        let seq = if msg.is_control() {
            0
        } else {
            let s = self.next_seq;
            self.next_seq += 1;
            self.unacked.push_back((s, msg.clone()));
            s
        };
        self.last_ack_sent = self.last_recv;
        Frame { seq, ack: self.last_recv, msg }
    }

    /// Peer acknowledged everything up to `ack`.
    pub fn on_ack(&mut self, ack: u64) {
        while self.unacked.front().is_some_and(|(s, _)| *s <= ack) {
            self.unacked.pop_front();
        }
    }

    pub fn accept(&mut self, seq: u64) -> Accept {
        if seq == 0 {
            return Accept::New;
        }
        if seq <= self.last_recv {
            return Accept::Duplicate;
        }
        if seq != self.last_recv + 1 {
            return Accept::Gap { expected: self.last_recv + 1, got: seq };
        }
        self.last_recv = seq;
        Accept::New
    }

    /// Frames to resend after a resume where the peer reported `peer_last` as its last received seq.
    pub fn retransmit_after(&mut self, peer_last: u64) -> Vec<Frame<M>> {
        self.on_ack(peer_last);
        self.last_ack_sent = self.last_recv;
        self.unacked.iter().map(|(s, m)| Frame { seq: *s, ack: self.last_recv, msg: m.clone() }).collect()
    }

    pub fn unacked_len(&self) -> usize {
        self.unacked.len()
    }

    pub fn ack_due(&self) -> bool {
        self.last_recv > self.last_ack_sent
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::protocol::ClientMsg;

    fn send(n: u32) -> ClientMsg {
        ClientMsg::Send { from: 1, to: 0, flags: 0, payload: vec![n as u8] }
    }

    #[test]
    fn sequencing_ack_and_resume() {
        let mut a: Link<ClientMsg> = Link::new();
        let mut b: Link<ClientMsg> = Link::new();
        let f1 = a.stamp(send(1));
        let ping = a.stamp(ClientMsg::Ping { nonce: 0 });
        let f2 = a.stamp(send(2));
        let f3 = a.stamp(send(3));
        assert_eq!((f1.seq, ping.seq, f2.seq, f3.seq), (1, 0, 2, 3));
        assert_eq!(a.unacked_len(), 3);
        assert_eq!(b.accept(f1.seq), Accept::New);
        assert_eq!(b.accept(ping.seq), Accept::New);
        assert_eq!(b.accept(f2.seq), Accept::New);
        // connection drops before f3 arrives; b reports last_recv = 2 on resume
        let again = a.retransmit_after(b.last_recv);
        assert_eq!(again.iter().map(|f| f.seq).collect::<Vec<_>>(), vec![3]);
        assert_eq!(b.accept(1), Accept::Duplicate);
        assert_eq!(b.accept(3), Accept::New);
        assert_eq!(b.accept(5), Accept::Gap { expected: 4, got: 5 });
        a.on_ack(3);
        assert_eq!(a.unacked_len(), 0);
        assert!(b.ack_due());
    }
}
```
