`port/crates/s3-net/src/protocol.rs`:

```rs
//! Relay protocol v1: messages between a game client (our DirectPlay HLE via [`crate::client`]) and `s3-relay`.
//!
//! Transport: one WebSocket **binary** message = one [`Frame`]. Frame layout:
//! `seq:varint  ack:varint  tag:u8  body...` (see docs/porting/multiplayer.md, "Wire format").
//!
//! * `seq` = 0 for control frames (Hello/Welcome/Reject/Ping/Pong/Ack/Bye). All other frames are numbered
//!   1, 2, 3, ... per direction and per *client identity* (survives reconnects), so a dropped connection can be
//!   resumed without loss or duplication: the sender keeps unacknowledged frames and retransmits them after a
//!   resume, the receiver drops `seq <= last_received`.
//! * `ack` = highest sequenced frame received from the other side so far (piggybacked on every frame).
//!
//! The model mirrors DirectPlay 6 sessions (what S3.EXE uses): a session has a host, players with 32-bit DPIDs,
//! player data/names, a session description with 4 user dwords, and Send(from, to, flags, payload).

use crate::wire::{DecodeError, Reader, Writer};

/// Bump on any incompatible wire change. The relay rejects other versions with [`ErrorCode::VersionMismatch`].
pub const PROTOCOL_VERSION: u16 = 1;

/// 16-byte GUID in Windows memory order (`GUID` struct bytes as stored by the game).
pub type Guid = [u8; 16];
pub type Sha256 = [u8; 32];

/// `DPID_ALLPLAYERS` (also `DPID_SYSMSG` as a sender): broadcast target.
pub const DPID_ALL: u32 = 0;

/// DirectPlay-compatible session description (subset of `DPSESSIONDESC2` that crosses the wire).
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Default)]
pub struct SessionDesc {
    /// `DPSESSION_*` flags (S3: `MIGRATEHOST|KEEPALIVE` = 0x44, + `PRIVATE` 0x200 / `DIRECTPLAYPROTOCOL` 0x2000).
    pub flags: u32,
    /// Session instance GUID; assigned by the relay on create (value sent by the creator is ignored).
    pub instance: Guid,
    /// Application GUID (S3: `{0E9F8400-D9A5-11CF-8F4D-00804880B189}`).
    pub application: Guid,
    pub max_players: u32,
    /// Filled in by the relay.
    pub current_players: u32,
    pub name: String,
    /// Only sent by the creator / joiner; the relay never sends it back (empty in listings).
    pub password: String,
    /// `dwUser1..4` (S3: build/version dwords, see multiplayer.md).
    pub user: [u32; 4],
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Default)]
pub struct PlayerInfo {
    pub dpid: u32,
    /// Relay client id owning the player.
    pub owner: u32,
    /// `DPPLAYER_*` flags as given to CreatePlayer.
    pub flags: u32,
    pub short_name: String,
    pub long_name: String,
    /// Remote player data (`DPSET_REMOTE`).
    pub data: Vec<u8>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[repr(u16)]
pub enum ErrorCode {
    BadRequest = 1,
    VersionMismatch = 2,
    ExeMismatch = 3,
    ResumeFailed = 4,
    ServerFull = 5,
    NoSuchSession = 10,
    SessionFull = 11,
    WrongPassword = 12,
    JoinDisabled = 13,
    NotInSession = 14,
    AlreadyInSession = 15,
    NoSuchPlayer = 20,
    NotOwner = 21,
    Timeout = 30,
    Disconnected = 31,
    Unknown = 0xffff,
}

impl ErrorCode {
    pub fn from_u16(v: u16) -> ErrorCode {
        use ErrorCode::*;
        match v {
            1 => BadRequest,
            2 => VersionMismatch,
            3 => ExeMismatch,
            4 => ResumeFailed,
            5 => ServerFull,
            10 => NoSuchSession,
            11 => SessionFull,
            12 => WrongPassword,
            13 => JoinDisabled,
            14 => NotInSession,
            15 => AlreadyInSession,
            20 => NoSuchPlayer,
            21 => NotOwner,
            30 => Timeout,
            31 => Disconnected,
            _ => Unknown,
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Resume {
    pub token: [u8; 16],
    /// Highest sequenced server frame this client received.
    pub last_seq: u64,
}

/// Client -> relay.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum ClientMsg {
    // control (seq 0)
    Hello { proto: u16, exe_sha256: Sha256, name: String, build: String, resume: Option<Resume> },
    Ping { nonce: u64 },
    Ack,
    Bye,
    // requests (sequenced; `req` echoes in the reply)
    ListSessions { req: u32, application: Guid },
    CreateSession { req: u32, desc: SessionDesc },
    JoinSession { req: u32, instance: Guid, password: String },
    LeaveSession { req: u32 },
    SetSessionDesc { req: u32, desc: SessionDesc },
    CreatePlayer { req: u32, flags: u32, short_name: String, long_name: String, data: Vec<u8> },
    DestroyPlayer { req: u32, dpid: u32 },
    SetPlayerData { req: u32, dpid: u32, data: Vec<u8> },
    SetPlayerName { req: u32, dpid: u32, short_name: String, long_name: String },
    // fire-and-forget (sequenced)
    Send { from: u32, to: u32, flags: u32, payload: Vec<u8> },
    DesyncReport { step: u32, checksum: u32, detail: String },
}

/// Relay -> client.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum ServerMsg {
    // control (seq 0)
    Welcome { proto: u16, client_id: u32, token: [u8; 16], resumed: bool, last_seq: u64, keepalive_ms: u32, server: String },
    Reject { code: ErrorCode, message: String },
    Pong { nonce: u64 },
    Ack,
    // replies (sequenced)
    Error { req: u32, code: ErrorCode, message: String },
    Ok { req: u32 },
    SessionList { req: u32, sessions: Vec<SessionDesc> },
    Joined { req: u32, desc: SessionDesc, host: u32, players: Vec<PlayerInfo> },
    PlayerCreated { req: u32, dpid: u32 },
    // events (sequenced) -> DPSYS_* system messages / data messages in the HLE
    PlayerAdded { player: PlayerInfo },
    PlayerRemoved { dpid: u32 },
    PlayerData { dpid: u32, data: Vec<u8> },
    PlayerName { dpid: u32, short_name: String, long_name: String },
    SessionDescChanged { desc: SessionDesc },
    /// This client is now the session host (`DPSYS_HOST`).
    BecameHost,
    /// `DPSYS_SESSIONLOST`.
    SessionLost { code: ErrorCode },
    Deliver { from: u32, to: u32, flags: u32, payload: Vec<u8> },
    Desync { client_id: u32, step: u32, checksum: u32, detail: String },
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Frame<M> {
    pub seq: u64,
    pub ack: u64,
    pub msg: M,
}

pub trait Message: Sized {
    fn encode_body(&self, w: &mut Writer);
    fn decode_body(tag: u8, r: &mut Reader) -> Result<Self, DecodeError>;
    /// Control messages travel with seq 0 and are never retransmitted.
    fn is_control(&self) -> bool;
}

impl<M: Message> Frame<M> {
    pub fn encode(&self) -> Vec<u8> {
        let mut w = Writer::new();
        w.u64(self.seq).u64(self.ack);
        self.msg.encode_body(&mut w);
        w.finish()
    }
    pub fn decode(data: &[u8]) -> Result<Self, DecodeError> {
        let mut r = Reader::new(data);
        let seq = r.u64()?;
        let ack = r.u64()?;
        let tag = r.u8()?;
        let msg = M::decode_body(tag, &mut r)?;
        r.end()?;
        Ok(Frame { seq, ack, msg })
    }
}

fn put_desc(w: &mut Writer, d: &SessionDesc) {
    w.u32(d.flags).raw(&d.instance).raw(&d.application).u32(d.max_players).u32(d.current_players);
    w.str(&d.name).str(&d.password);
    for u in d.user {
        w.u32(u);
    }
}

fn get_desc(r: &mut Reader) -> Result<SessionDesc, DecodeError> {
    Ok(SessionDesc {
        flags: r.u32()?,
        instance: r.raw()?,
        application: r.raw()?,
        max_players: r.u32()?,
        current_players: r.u32()?,
        name: r.str()?,
        password: r.str()?,
        user: [r.u32()?, r.u32()?, r.u32()?, r.u32()?],
    })
}

fn put_player(w: &mut Writer, p: &PlayerInfo) {
    w.u32(p.dpid).u32(p.owner).u32(p.flags).str(&p.short_name).str(&p.long_name).bytes(&p.data);
}

fn get_player(r: &mut Reader) -> Result<PlayerInfo, DecodeError> {
    Ok(PlayerInfo {
        dpid: r.u32()?,
        owner: r.u32()?,
        flags: r.u32()?,
        short_name: r.str()?,
        long_name: r.str()?,
        data: r.bytes()?,
    })
}

impl Message for ClientMsg {
    fn is_control(&self) -> bool {
        matches!(self, ClientMsg::Hello { .. } | ClientMsg::Ping { .. } | ClientMsg::Ack | ClientMsg::Bye)
    }

    fn encode_body(&self, w: &mut Writer) {
        use ClientMsg::*;
        match self {
            Hello { proto, exe_sha256, name, build, resume } => {
                w.u8(1).u16(*proto).raw(exe_sha256).str(name).str(build);
                match resume {
                    None => {
                        w.u8(0);
                    }
                    Some(r) => {
                        w.u8(1).raw(&r.token).u64(r.last_seq);
                    }
                }
            }
            Ping { nonce } => {
                w.u8(2).u64(*nonce);
            }
            Ack => {
                w.u8(3);
            }
            Bye => {
                w.u8(4);
            }
            ListSessions { req, application } => {
                w.u8(10).u32(*req).raw(application);
            }
            CreateSession { req, desc } => {
                w.u8(11).u32(*req);
                put_desc(w, desc);
            }
            JoinSession { req, instance, password } => {
                w.u8(12).u32(*req).raw(instance).str(password);
            }
            LeaveSession { req } => {
                w.u8(13).u32(*req);
            }
            SetSessionDesc { req, desc } => {
                w.u8(14).u32(*req);
                put_desc(w, desc);
            }
            CreatePlayer { req, flags, short_name, long_name, data } => {
                w.u8(20).u32(*req).u32(*flags).str(short_name).str(long_name).bytes(data);
            }
            DestroyPlayer { req, dpid } => {
                w.u8(21).u32(*req).u32(*dpid);
            }
            SetPlayerData { req, dpid, data } => {
                w.u8(22).u32(*req).u32(*dpid).bytes(data);
            }
            SetPlayerName { req, dpid, short_name, long_name } => {
                w.u8(23).u32(*req).u32(*dpid).str(short_name).str(long_name);
            }
            Send { from, to, flags, payload } => {
                w.u8(30).u32(*from).u32(*to).u32(*flags).bytes(payload);
            }
            DesyncReport { step, checksum, detail } => {
                w.u8(40).u32(*step).u32(*checksum).str(detail);
            }
        }
    }

    fn decode_body(tag: u8, r: &mut Reader) -> Result<Self, DecodeError> {
        use ClientMsg::*;
        Ok(match tag {
            1 => Hello {
                proto: r.u16()?,
                exe_sha256: r.raw()?,
                name: r.str()?,
                build: r.str()?,
                resume: if r.bool()? { Some(Resume { token: r.raw()?, last_seq: r.u64()? }) } else { None },
            },
            2 => Ping { nonce: r.u64()? },
            3 => Ack,
            4 => Bye,
            10 => ListSessions { req: r.u32()?, application: r.raw()? },
            11 => CreateSession { req: r.u32()?, desc: get_desc(r)? },
            12 => JoinSession { req: r.u32()?, instance: r.raw()?, password: r.str()? },
            13 => LeaveSession { req: r.u32()? },
            14 => SetSessionDesc { req: r.u32()?, desc: get_desc(r)? },
            20 => CreatePlayer {
                req: r.u32()?,
                flags: r.u32()?,
                short_name: r.str()?,
                long_name: r.str()?,
                data: r.bytes()?,
            },
            21 => DestroyPlayer { req: r.u32()?, dpid: r.u32()? },
            22 => SetPlayerData { req: r.u32()?, dpid: r.u32()?, data: r.bytes()? },
            23 => SetPlayerName { req: r.u32()?, dpid: r.u32()?, short_name: r.str()?, long_name: r.str()? },
            30 => Send { from: r.u32()?, to: r.u32()?, flags: r.u32()?, payload: r.bytes()? },
            40 => DesyncReport { step: r.u32()?, checksum: r.u32()?, detail: r.str()? },
            t => return Err(DecodeError::BadTag { what: "client message", tag: t as u64 }),
        })
    }
}

impl Message for ServerMsg {
    fn is_control(&self) -> bool {
        matches!(self, ServerMsg::Welcome { .. } | ServerMsg::Reject { .. } | ServerMsg::Pong { .. } | ServerMsg::Ack)
    }

    fn encode_body(&self, w: &mut Writer) {
        use ServerMsg::*;
        match self {
            Welcome { proto, client_id, token, resumed, last_seq, keepalive_ms, server } => {
                w.u8(1).u16(*proto).u32(*client_id).raw(token).bool(*resumed).u64(*last_seq).u32(*keepalive_ms);
                w.str(server);
            }
            Reject { code, message } => {
                w.u8(2).u16(*code as u16).str(message);
            }
            Pong { nonce } => {
                w.u8(3).u64(*nonce);
            }
            Ack => {
                w.u8(4);
            }
            Error { req, code, message } => {
                w.u8(10).u32(*req).u16(*code as u16).str(message);
            }
            Ok { req } => {
                w.u8(11).u32(*req);
            }
            SessionList { req, sessions } => {
                w.u8(12).u32(*req).u32(sessions.len() as u32);
                for s in sessions {
                    put_desc(w, s);
                }
            }
            Joined { req, desc, host, players } => {
                w.u8(13).u32(*req);
                put_desc(w, desc);
                w.u32(*host).u32(players.len() as u32);
                for p in players {
                    put_player(w, p);
                }
            }
            PlayerCreated { req, dpid } => {
                w.u8(14).u32(*req).u32(*dpid);
            }
            PlayerAdded { player } => {
                w.u8(20);
                put_player(w, player);
            }
            PlayerRemoved { dpid } => {
                w.u8(21).u32(*dpid);
            }
            PlayerData { dpid, data } => {
                w.u8(22).u32(*dpid).bytes(data);
            }
            PlayerName { dpid, short_name, long_name } => {
                w.u8(23).u32(*dpid).str(short_name).str(long_name);
            }
            SessionDescChanged { desc } => {
                w.u8(24);
                put_desc(w, desc);
            }
            BecameHost => {
                w.u8(25);
            }
            SessionLost { code } => {
                w.u8(26).u16(*code as u16);
            }
            Deliver { from, to, flags, payload } => {
                w.u8(30).u32(*from).u32(*to).u32(*flags).bytes(payload);
            }
            Desync { client_id, step, checksum, detail } => {
                w.u8(40).u32(*client_id).u32(*step).u32(*checksum).str(detail);
            }
        }
    }

    fn decode_body(tag: u8, r: &mut Reader) -> Result<Self, DecodeError> {
        use ServerMsg::*;
        Ok(match tag {
            1 => Welcome {
                proto: r.u16()?,
                client_id: r.u32()?,
                token: r.raw()?,
                resumed: r.bool()?,
                last_seq: r.u64()?,
                keepalive_ms: r.u32()?,
                server: r.str()?,
            },
            2 => Reject { code: ErrorCode::from_u16(r.u16()?), message: r.str()? },
            3 => Pong { nonce: r.u64()? },
            4 => Ack,
            10 => Error { req: r.u32()?, code: ErrorCode::from_u16(r.u16()?), message: r.str()? },
            11 => Ok { req: r.u32()? },
            12 => {
                let req = r.u32()?;
                let n = r.count()?;
                let mut sessions = Vec::with_capacity(n);
                for _ in 0..n {
                    sessions.push(get_desc(r)?);
                }
                SessionList { req, sessions }
            }
            13 => {
                let req = r.u32()?;
                let desc = get_desc(r)?;
                let host = r.u32()?;
                let n = r.count()?;
                let mut players = Vec::with_capacity(n);
                for _ in 0..n {
                    players.push(get_player(r)?);
                }
                Joined { req, desc, host, players }
            }
            14 => PlayerCreated { req: r.u32()?, dpid: r.u32()? },
            20 => PlayerAdded { player: get_player(r)? },
            21 => PlayerRemoved { dpid: r.u32()? },
            22 => PlayerData { dpid: r.u32()?, data: r.bytes()? },
            23 => PlayerName { dpid: r.u32()?, short_name: r.str()?, long_name: r.str()? },
            24 => SessionDescChanged { desc: get_desc(r)? },
            25 => BecameHost,
            26 => SessionLost { code: ErrorCode::from_u16(r.u16()?) },
            30 => Deliver { from: r.u32()?, to: r.u32()?, flags: r.u32()?, payload: r.bytes()? },
            40 => Desync { client_id: r.u32()?, step: r.u32()?, checksum: r.u32()?, detail: r.str()? },
            t => return Err(DecodeError::BadTag { what: "server message", tag: t as u64 }),
        })
    }
}

/// Parse a GUID in registry form (`XXXXXXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXXXXXXXXXX`, braces optional) into Windows memory order.
pub const fn guid(s: &str) -> Guid {
    const fn hex(c: u8) -> u8 {
        match c {
            b'0'..=b'9' => c - b'0',
            b'a'..=b'f' => c - b'a' + 10,
            b'A'..=b'F' => c - b'A' + 10,
            _ => panic!("bad hex digit in GUID"),
        }
    }
    let b = s.as_bytes();
    let mut digits = [0u8; 32];
    let mut n = 0;
    let mut i = 0;
    while i < b.len() {
        let c = b[i];
        if c != b'-' && c != b'{' && c != b'}' {
            digits[n] = hex(c);
            n += 1;
        }
        i += 1;
    }
    assert!(n == 32, "GUID needs 32 hex digits");
    let mut v = [0u8; 16];
    let mut k = 0;
    while k < 16 {
        v[k] = digits[2 * k] << 4 | digits[2 * k + 1];
        k += 1;
    }
    // Data1 (4 bytes), Data2 (2), Data3 (2) are little-endian in memory; Data4 is a byte array.
    [v[3], v[2], v[1], v[0], v[5], v[4], v[7], v[6], v[8], v[9], v[10], v[11], v[12], v[13], v[14], v[15]]
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn desc() -> SessionDesc {
        SessionDesc {
            flags: 0x44,
            instance: [7; 16],
            application: crate::S3_APP_GUID,
            max_players: 8,
            current_players: 2,
            name: "Römer gegen Ägypter".into(),
            password: "pw".into(),
            user: [1, 2, 0xa0, 1],
        }
    }

    fn player() -> PlayerInfo {
        PlayerInfo { dpid: 0x1234_5678, owner: 3, flags: 0, short_name: "Ali".into(), long_name: "".into(), data: vec![1, 2, 3] }
    }

    fn rt_client(m: ClientMsg) {
        let seq = if m.is_control() { 0 } else { 42 };
        let f = Frame { seq, ack: 7, msg: m };
        let enc = f.encode();
        assert_eq!(Frame::<ClientMsg>::decode(&enc).unwrap(), f);
        for cut in 0..enc.len() {
            assert!(Frame::<ClientMsg>::decode(&enc[..cut]).is_err(), "prefix {cut} of {:?}", f.msg);
        }
    }

    fn rt_server(m: ServerMsg) {
        let seq = if m.is_control() { 0 } else { 9 };
        let f = Frame { seq, ack: 1 << 40, msg: m };
        let enc = f.encode();
        assert_eq!(Frame::<ServerMsg>::decode(&enc).unwrap(), f);
        for cut in 0..enc.len() {
            assert!(Frame::<ServerMsg>::decode(&enc[..cut]).is_err(), "prefix {cut} of {:?}", f.msg);
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn client_messages_roundtrip() {
        use ClientMsg::*;
        rt_client(Hello { proto: 1, exe_sha256: crate::GOG_EXE_SHA256, name: "x".into(), build: "b".into(), resume: None });
        rt_client(Hello {
            proto: 1,
            exe_sha256: [0; 32],
            name: "".into(),
            build: "".into(),
            resume: Some(Resume { token: [9; 16], last_seq: 77 }),
        });
        rt_client(Ping { nonce: 5 });
        rt_client(Ack);
        rt_client(Bye);
        rt_client(ListSessions { req: 1, application: crate::S3_APP_GUID });
        rt_client(CreateSession { req: 2, desc: desc() });
        rt_client(JoinSession { req: 3, instance: [1; 16], password: "".into() });
        rt_client(LeaveSession { req: 4 });
        rt_client(SetSessionDesc { req: 5, desc: desc() });
        rt_client(CreatePlayer { req: 6, flags: 0, short_name: "a".into(), long_name: "b".into(), data: vec![] });
        rt_client(DestroyPlayer { req: 7, dpid: 3 });
        rt_client(SetPlayerData { req: 8, dpid: 3, data: vec![0; 300] });
        rt_client(SetPlayerName { req: 9, dpid: 3, short_name: "s".into(), long_name: "l".into() });
        rt_client(Send { from: 1, to: 0, flags: 1, payload: vec![0x20, 0, 8, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0] });
        rt_client(DesyncReport { step: 100, checksum: 0xdead_beef, detail: "Desync Settler!".into() });
    }

    #[test]
    fn server_messages_roundtrip() {
        use ServerMsg::*;
        rt_server(Welcome {
            proto: 1,
            client_id: 5,
            token: [3; 16],
            resumed: true,
            last_seq: 12,
            keepalive_ms: 2000,
            server: "s3-relay".into(),
        });
        rt_server(Reject { code: ErrorCode::ExeMismatch, message: "nope".into() });
        rt_server(Pong { nonce: 1 });
        rt_server(Ack);
        rt_server(Error { req: 1, code: ErrorCode::SessionFull, message: "full".into() });
        rt_server(Ok { req: 2 });
        rt_server(SessionList { req: 3, sessions: vec![desc(), SessionDesc::default()] });
        rt_server(Joined { req: 4, desc: desc(), host: 1, players: vec![player(), PlayerInfo::default()] });
        rt_server(PlayerCreated { req: 5, dpid: 99 });
        rt_server(PlayerAdded { player: player() });
        rt_server(PlayerRemoved { dpid: 99 });
        rt_server(PlayerData { dpid: 99, data: vec![5; 10] });
        rt_server(PlayerName { dpid: 99, short_name: "n".into(), long_name: "".into() });
        rt_server(SessionDescChanged { desc: desc() });
        rt_server(BecameHost);
        rt_server(SessionLost { code: ErrorCode::Disconnected });
        rt_server(Deliver { from: 1, to: 2, flags: 0, payload: vec![1; 1000] });
        rt_server(Desync { client_id: 1, step: 2, checksum: 3, detail: "d".into() });
    }

    #[test]
    fn rejects_unknown_tag_and_trailing() {
        assert!(matches!(Frame::<ClientMsg>::decode(&[0, 0, 200]), Err(DecodeError::BadTag { .. })));
        let mut enc = Frame { seq: 0, ack: 0, msg: ClientMsg::Ack }.encode();
        enc.push(0);
        assert_eq!(Frame::<ClientMsg>::decode(&enc), Err(DecodeError::TrailingBytes(1)));
    }

    #[test]
    fn guid_parsing_matches_exe_bytes() {
        // Bytes read from S3.EXE at 0x6970f8 (application GUID in the DPSESSIONDESC2 it opens).
        let exe = [0x00, 0x84, 0x9f, 0x0e, 0xa5, 0xd9, 0xcf, 0x11, 0x8f, 0x4d, 0x00, 0x80, 0x48, 0x80, 0xb1, 0x89];
        assert_eq!(guid("{0E9F8400-D9A5-11CF-8F4D-00804880B189}"), exe);
    }
}
```

`port/crates/s3-net/src/wire.rs`:

```rs
//! Minimal explicit binary encoding used by the protocol (no serde: the wire format is documented in
//! docs/porting/multiplayer.md and must stay stable and easy to re-implement, e.g. for a PC bridge).
//!
//! * integers: unsigned LEB128 varints (`u16`/`u32`/`u64`); fixed-size `[u8; N]` raw.
//! * `bytes`: varint length + raw bytes; `string`: `bytes` holding UTF-8.
//! * `Option<T>`: one byte 0/1 then `T`; `Vec<T>`: varint count then items.

use std::fmt;

/// Hard limits so a malicious peer cannot make us allocate unbounded memory.
pub const MAX_BYTES: usize = 64 * 1024;
pub const MAX_STRING: usize = 256;
pub const MAX_ITEMS: usize = 1024;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum DecodeError {
    Truncated,
    VarintOverflow,
    TooLong { what: &'static str, len: usize },
    BadUtf8,
    BadTag { what: &'static str, tag: u64 },
    TrailingBytes(usize),
}

impl fmt::Display for DecodeError {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
        match self {
            DecodeError::Truncated => write!(f, "truncated message"),
            DecodeError::VarintOverflow => write!(f, "varint overflow"),
            DecodeError::TooLong { what, len } => write!(f, "{what} too long ({len})"),
            DecodeError::BadUtf8 => write!(f, "invalid UTF-8"),
            DecodeError::BadTag { what, tag } => write!(f, "unknown {what} tag {tag}"),
            DecodeError::TrailingBytes(n) => write!(f, "{n} trailing bytes"),
        }
    }
}

impl std::error::Error for DecodeError {}

#[derive(Default, Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Writer {
    pub buf: Vec<u8>,
}

impl Writer {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self { buf: Vec::with_capacity(64) }
    }
    pub fn u8(&mut self, v: u8) -> &mut Self {
        self.buf.push(v);
        self
    }
    pub fn bool(&mut self, v: bool) -> &mut Self {
        self.u8(v as u8)
    }
    pub fn var(&mut self, mut v: u64) -> &mut Self {
        loop {
            let b = (v & 0x7f) as u8;
            v >>= 7;
            if v == 0 {
                self.buf.push(b);
                return self;
            }
            self.buf.push(b | 0x80);
        }
    }
    pub fn u16(&mut self, v: u16) -> &mut Self {
        self.var(v as u64)
    }
    pub fn u32(&mut self, v: u32) -> &mut Self {
        self.var(v as u64)
    }
    pub fn u64(&mut self, v: u64) -> &mut Self {
        self.var(v)
    }
    pub fn raw(&mut self, v: &[u8]) -> &mut Self {
        self.buf.extend_from_slice(v);
        self
    }
    pub fn bytes(&mut self, v: &[u8]) -> &mut Self {
        self.var(v.len() as u64);
        self.raw(v)
    }
    pub fn str(&mut self, v: &str) -> &mut Self {
        self.bytes(v.as_bytes())
    }
    pub fn finish(self) -> Vec<u8> {
        self.buf
    }
}

pub struct Reader<'a> {
    data: &'a [u8],
    pos: usize,
}

impl<'a> Reader<'a> {
    pub fn new(data: &'a [u8]) -> Self {
        Self { data, pos: 0 }
    }
    pub fn remaining(&self) -> usize {
        self.data.len() - self.pos
    }
    pub fn u8(&mut self) -> Result<u8, DecodeError> {
        let b = *self.data.get(self.pos).ok_or(DecodeError::Truncated)?;
        self.pos += 1;
        Ok(b)
    }
    pub fn bool(&mut self) -> Result<bool, DecodeError> {
        Ok(self.u8()? != 0)
    }
    pub fn var(&mut self) -> Result<u64, DecodeError> {
        let mut v: u64 = 0;
        for i in 0..10 {
            let b = self.u8()?;
            let part = (b & 0x7f) as u64;
            if i == 9 && part > 1 {
                return Err(DecodeError::VarintOverflow);
            }
            v |= part << (7 * i);
            if b & 0x80 == 0 {
                return Ok(v);
            }
        }
        Err(DecodeError::VarintOverflow)
    }
    pub fn u16(&mut self) -> Result<u16, DecodeError> {
        u16::try_from(self.var()?).map_err(|_| DecodeError::VarintOverflow)
    }
    pub fn u32(&mut self) -> Result<u32, DecodeError> {
        u32::try_from(self.var()?).map_err(|_| DecodeError::VarintOverflow)
    }
    pub fn u64(&mut self) -> Result<u64, DecodeError> {
        self.var()
    }
    pub fn raw<const N: usize>(&mut self) -> Result<[u8; N], DecodeError> {
        if self.remaining() < N {
            return Err(DecodeError::Truncated);
        }
        let mut out = [0u8; N];
        out.copy_from_slice(&self.data[self.pos..self.pos + N]);
        self.pos += N;
        Ok(out)
    }
    fn len(&mut self, what: &'static str, max: usize) -> Result<usize, DecodeError> {
        let len = self.var()? as usize;
        if len > max {
            return Err(DecodeError::TooLong { what, len });
        }
        Ok(len)
    }
    pub fn bytes(&mut self) -> Result<Vec<u8>, DecodeError> {
        let len = self.len("bytes", MAX_BYTES)?;
        if self.remaining() < len {
            return Err(DecodeError::Truncated);
        }
        let v = self.data[self.pos..self.pos + len].to_vec();
        self.pos += len;
        Ok(v)
    }
    pub fn str(&mut self) -> Result<String, DecodeError> {
        let len = self.len("string", MAX_STRING)?;
        if self.remaining() < len {
            return Err(DecodeError::Truncated);
        }
        let v = std::str::from_utf8(&self.data[self.pos..self.pos + len]).map_err(|_| DecodeError::BadUtf8)?;
        self.pos += len;
        Ok(v.to_owned())
    }
    pub fn count(&mut self) -> Result<usize, DecodeError> {
        self.len("list", MAX_ITEMS)
    }
    pub fn end(&self) -> Result<(), DecodeError> {
        match self.remaining() {
            0 => Ok(()),
            n => Err(DecodeError::TrailingBytes(n)),
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn varint_roundtrip_and_sizes() {
        for v in [0u64, 1, 127, 128, 300, 16383, 16384, u32::MAX as u64, u64::MAX] {
            let mut w = Writer::new();
            w.var(v);
            let b = w.finish();
            assert_eq!(Reader::new(&b).var().unwrap(), v, "{v}");
        }
        let mut w = Writer::new();
        w.var(127);
        assert_eq!(w.buf.len(), 1);
        let mut w = Writer::new();
        w.var(u64::MAX);
        assert_eq!(w.buf.len(), 10);
    }

    #[test]
    fn rejects_overflow_and_limits() {
        assert_eq!(Reader::new(&[0xff; 11]).var(), Err(DecodeError::VarintOverflow));
        let mut w = Writer::new();
        w.var(70_000);
        assert_eq!(Reader::new(&w.buf).u16(), Err(DecodeError::VarintOverflow));
        let mut w = Writer::new();
        w.var((MAX_BYTES + 1) as u64);
        assert!(matches!(Reader::new(&w.buf).bytes(), Err(DecodeError::TooLong { .. })));
        assert_eq!(Reader::new(&[5, 1, 2]).bytes(), Err(DecodeError::Truncated));
        assert_eq!(Reader::new(&[2, 0xff, 0xfe]).str(), Err(DecodeError::BadUtf8));
    }
}
```

`port/crates/s3-pe/src/lib.rs`:

```rs
//! PE32 loader for S3.EXE.
//!
//! [`parse`] reads headers; [`load`] maps the image at its preferred base (S3.EXE has no relocations),
//! resolves every import through the runtime [`Registry`](s3_runtime::Registry) (unknown imports become
//! auto stubs that stop the machine with `UNIMPLEMENTED dll!name` when called) and creates the PEB/process
//! parameters. Resources are looked up in guest memory with [`find_resource`] / [`load_string`].

use std::fmt;

use s3_mem::{RegionKind, PAGE_EXECUTE_READ, PAGE_READONLY, PAGE_READWRITE};
use s3_runtime::Machine;

/// Loader errors.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum PeError {
    Truncated(&'static str),
    BadMagic(&'static str),
    Unsupported(String),
    Map(String),
}

impl fmt::Display for PeError {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
        match self {
            PeError::Truncated(w) => write!(f, "PE truncated ({w})"),
            PeError::BadMagic(w) => write!(f, "not a PE32 image ({w})"),
            PeError::Unsupported(s) => write!(f, "unsupported PE: {s}"),
            PeError::Map(s) => write!(f, "cannot map image: {s}"),
        }
    }
}

impl std::error::Error for PeError {}

/// A section header.
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Section {
    pub name: String,
    pub virtual_address: u32,
    pub virtual_size: u32,
    pub raw_offset: u32,
    pub raw_size: u32,
    pub characteristics: u32,
}

/// Parsed headers.
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct PeHeaders {
    pub image_base: u32,
    pub size_of_image: u32,
    pub size_of_headers: u32,
    pub entry_rva: u32,
    pub stack_reserve: u32,
    pub stack_commit: u32,
    pub heap_reserve: u32,
    pub subsystem: u16,
    pub has_relocs: bool,
    /// Data directories: (rva, size), index as in the PE spec (1 = imports, 2 = resources, 9 = TLS).
    pub dirs: Vec<(u32, u32)>,
    pub sections: Vec<Section>,
}

pub const DIR_IMPORT: usize = 1;
pub const DIR_RESOURCE: usize = 2;
pub const DIR_BASERELOC: usize = 5;
pub const DIR_TLS: usize = 9;

fn u16_at(b: &[u8], o: usize) -> Result<u16, PeError> {
    b.get(o..o + 2).map(|s| u16::from_le_bytes([s[0], s[1]])).ok_or(PeError::Truncated("u16"))
}

fn u32_at(b: &[u8], o: usize) -> Result<u32, PeError> {
    b.get(o..o + 4).map(|s| u32::from_le_bytes([s[0], s[1], s[2], s[3]])).ok_or(PeError::Truncated("u32"))
}

/// Parse PE32 headers.
pub fn parse(b: &[u8]) -> Result<PeHeaders, PeError> {
    if b.get(0..2) != Some(b"MZ") {
        return Err(PeError::BadMagic("MZ"));
    }
    let pe = u32_at(b, 0x3C)? as usize;
    if b.get(pe..pe + 4) != Some(b"PE\0\0") {
        return Err(PeError::BadMagic("PE"));
    }
    let coff = pe + 4;
    let machine = u16_at(b, coff)?;
    if machine != 0x14C {
        return Err(PeError::Unsupported(format!("machine {machine:#x}")));
    }
    let nsec = u16_at(b, coff + 2)? as usize;
    let opt_size = u16_at(b, coff + 16)? as usize;
    let characteristics = u16_at(b, coff + 18)?;
    let opt = coff + 20;
    if u16_at(b, opt)? != 0x10B {
        return Err(PeError::BadMagic("PE32 optional header"));
    }
    let entry_rva = u32_at(b, opt + 16)?;
    let image_base = u32_at(b, opt + 28)?;
    let size_of_image = u32_at(b, opt + 56)?;
    let size_of_headers = u32_at(b, opt + 60)?;
    let subsystem = u16_at(b, opt + 68)?;
    let stack_reserve = u32_at(b, opt + 72)?;
    let stack_commit = u32_at(b, opt + 76)?;
    let heap_reserve = u32_at(b, opt + 80)?;
    let ndirs = (u32_at(b, opt + 92)? as usize).min(16);
    let mut dirs = Vec::new();
    for i in 0..ndirs {
        dirs.push((u32_at(b, opt + 96 + i * 8)?, u32_at(b, opt + 100 + i * 8)?));
    }
    dirs.resize(16, (0, 0));
    let has_relocs = characteristics & 1 == 0 && dirs[DIR_BASERELOC].1 != 0;
    let mut sections = Vec::new();
    let sh = opt + opt_size;
    for i in 0..nsec {
        let o = sh + i * 40;
        let raw_name = b.get(o..o + 8).ok_or(PeError::Truncated("section"))?;
        let name = String::from_utf8_lossy(raw_name).trim_end_matches('\0').to_string();
        sections.push(Section {
            name,
            virtual_size: u32_at(b, o + 8)?,
            virtual_address: u32_at(b, o + 12)?,
            raw_size: u32_at(b, o + 16)?,
            raw_offset: u32_at(b, o + 20)?,
            characteristics: u32_at(b, o + 36)?,
        });
    }
    Ok(PeHeaders {
        image_base,
        size_of_image,
        size_of_headers,
        entry_rva,
        stack_reserve,
        stack_commit,
        heap_reserve,
        subsystem,
        has_relocs,
        dirs,
        sections,
    })
}

/// One resolved import.
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct ImportRef {
    pub dll: String,
    /// Name, or `#ordinal`.
    pub name: String,
    pub ordinal: Option<u16>,
    /// Guest address of the IAT slot.
    pub iat: u32,
    /// Thunk address written into the slot.
    pub thunk: u32,
}

/// Result of [`load`].
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct LoadedImage {
    pub headers: PeHeaders,
    pub base: u32,
    pub entry: u32,
    pub imports: Vec<ImportRef>,
}

impl LoadedImage {
    /// Imports that no HLE module declared (auto stubs).
    pub fn auto_stubbed<'a>(&'a self, m: &'a Machine) -> impl Iterator<Item = &'a ImportRef> + 'a {
        self.imports.iter().filter(move |i| m.registry.entry(i.thunk).map(|e| e.auto).unwrap_or(false))
    }
}

/// Map `bytes` into the machine at its image base, resolve imports, set up the process (PEB, command line
/// `exe_name`). Does not create the main thread.
pub fn load(m: &mut Machine, bytes: &[u8], exe_name: &str) -> Result<LoadedImage, PeError> {
    let h = parse(bytes)?;
    if h.dirs[DIR_TLS].1 != 0 {
        // S3.EXE has no TLS directory; implement TLS callbacks/index when another binary needs it.
        m.log(s3_runtime::LogLevel::Warn, "PE has a TLS directory; static TLS is not supported yet");
    }
    let base = h.image_base;
    m.mem
        .alloc_region(Some(base), h.size_of_image, RegionKind::Image, (0, 0))
        .map_err(|e| PeError::Map(e.to_string()))?;
    let hdr_len = (h.size_of_headers as usize).min(bytes.len());
    m.mem.write_bytes(base, &bytes[..hdr_len]);
    let _ = m.mem.virtual_protect(base, h.size_of_headers.max(1), PAGE_READONLY);
    for s in &h.sections {
        let raw = (s.raw_size.min(if s.virtual_size == 0 { s.raw_size } else { s.virtual_size })) as usize;
        let off = s.raw_offset as usize;
        if raw > 0 {
            let data = bytes.get(off..off + raw).ok_or(PeError::Truncated("section data"))?;
            m.mem.write_bytes(base + s.virtual_address, data);
        }
        let prot = if s.characteristics & 0x8000_0000 != 0 {
            PAGE_READWRITE
        } else if s.characteristics & 0x2000_0000 != 0 {
            PAGE_EXECUTE_READ
        } else {
            PAGE_READONLY
        };
        let vsize = s.virtual_size.max(s.raw_size).max(1);
        let _ = m.mem.virtual_protect(base + s.virtual_address, vsize, prot);
    }

    let mut imports = Vec::new();
    let (irva, _isize) = h.dirs[DIR_IMPORT];
    if irva != 0 {
        let mut d = base + irva;
        loop {
            let oft = m.mem.read_u32(d);
            let name_rva = m.mem.read_u32(d + 12);
            let ft = m.mem.read_u32(d + 16);
            if name_rva == 0 && ft == 0 {
                break;
            }
            let dll = m.mem.read_cstr(base + name_rva);
            let lookup = if oft != 0 { oft } else { ft };
            let mut i = 0u32;
            loop {
                let v = m.mem.read_u32(base + lookup + i * 4);
                if v == 0 {
                    break;
                }
                let iat = base + ft + i * 4;
                let (name, ordinal, thunk) = if v & 0x8000_0000 != 0 {
                    let ord = (v & 0xFFFF) as u16;
                    let t = m.registry.resolve_import_ordinal(&dll, ord);
                    (format!("#{ord}"), Some(ord), t)
                } else {
                    let n = m.mem.read_cstr(base + v + 2);
                    let t = m.registry.resolve_import(&dll, &n);
                    (n, None, t)
                };
                m.mem.write_u32(iat, thunk);
                imports.push(ImportRef { dll: dll.clone(), name, ordinal, iat, thunk });
                i += 1;
            }
            d += 20;
        }
    }
    let entry = base + h.entry_rva;
    m.setup_process(base, h.size_of_image, entry, h.stack_reserve.max(0x10_0000), exe_name);
    Ok(LoadedImage { headers: h, base, entry, imports })
}

// Resources live in s3-runtime so HLE modules (kernel32 FindResourceA, user32 LoadStringA/LoadIconA/...) can
// use them without depending on the loader.
pub use s3_runtime::resources::{find_resource, find_resource_entry, load_string, rt, ResId};
```

`port/crates/s3-pe/src/tests.rs`:

```rs
use super::*;
use s3_runtime::NullHost;

fn machine() -> Machine {
    let d = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("s3pe-test-{}", std::process::id()));
    let mut h = NullHost::new(d.join("game"), d.join("data"));
    h.quiet = true;
    Machine::new(Box::new(h)).unwrap()
}

fn put32(b: &mut [u8], o: usize, v: u32) {
    b[o..o + 4].copy_from_slice(&v.to_le_bytes());
}
fn put16(b: &mut [u8], o: usize, v: u16) {
    b[o..o + 2].copy_from_slice(&v.to_le_bytes());
}

/// A tiny hand-made PE: one section at RVA 0x1000 holding an import table for
/// `KERNEL32.dll!ExitProcess` (by name) and `FOO.dll!#7` (by ordinal).
fn tiny_pe() -> Vec<u8> {
    let mut b = vec![0u8; 0x400];
    b[0..2].copy_from_slice(b"MZ");
    put32(&mut b, 0x3C, 0x80);
    b[0x80..0x84].copy_from_slice(b"PE\0\0");
    let coff = 0x84;
    put16(&mut b, coff, 0x14C);
    put16(&mut b, coff + 2, 1);
    put16(&mut b, coff + 16, 0xE0);
    put16(&mut b, coff + 18, 0x0103); // relocs stripped, exe, 32-bit
    let opt = coff + 20;
    put16(&mut b, opt, 0x10B);
    put32(&mut b, opt + 16, 0x1000); // entry
    put32(&mut b, opt + 28, 0x40_0000);
    put32(&mut b, opt + 32, 0x1000);
    put32(&mut b, opt + 36, 0x200);
    put32(&mut b, opt + 56, 0x2000); // size of image
    put32(&mut b, opt + 60, 0x200); // size of headers
    put16(&mut b, opt + 68, 2);
    put32(&mut b, opt + 72, 0x10_0000);
    put32(&mut b, opt + 92, 16);
    put32(&mut b, opt + 96 + 8, 0x1100); // import dir
    put32(&mut b, opt + 100 + 8, 40);
    let sh = opt + 0xE0;
    b[sh..sh + 5].copy_from_slice(b".text");
    put32(&mut b, sh + 8, 0x200);
    put32(&mut b, sh + 12, 0x1000);
    put32(&mut b, sh + 16, 0x200);
    put32(&mut b, sh + 20, 0x200);
    put32(&mut b, sh + 36, 0xE000_0020);
    // Section data at file 0x200 == RVA 0x1000.
    let s = 0x200usize;
    let rva = |r: u32| s + (r - 0x1000) as usize;
    b[rva(0x1000)] = 0xC3; // ret
    // Descriptors at 0x1100: kernel32, foo, terminator.
    put32(&mut b, rva(0x1100), 0x1140); // OFT
    put32(&mut b, rva(0x1100) + 12, 0x1180); // name
    put32(&mut b, rva(0x1100) + 16, 0x1160); // FT
    put32(&mut b, rva(0x1114), 0);
    put32(&mut b, rva(0x1114) + 12, 0x1190);
    put32(&mut b, rva(0x1114) + 16, 0x1170);
    put32(&mut b, rva(0x1140), 0x11A0); // hint/name
    put32(&mut b, rva(0x1160), 0x11A0);
    put32(&mut b, rva(0x1170), 0x8000_0007);
    b[rva(0x1180)..rva(0x1180) + 12].copy_from_slice(b"KERNEL32.dll");
    b[rva(0x1190)..rva(0x1190) + 7].copy_from_slice(b"FOO.dll");
    b[rva(0x11A2)..rva(0x11A2) + 11].copy_from_slice(b"ExitProcess");
    b
}

#[test]
fn parse_and_load_tiny() {
    let pe = tiny_pe();
    let h = parse(&pe).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(h.image_base, 0x40_0000);
    assert_eq!(h.sections.len(), 1);
    assert!(!h.has_relocs);
    let mut m = machine();
    let known = m.registry.declare("kernel32.dll", "ExitProcess");
    let img = load(&mut m, &pe, "TINY.EXE").unwrap();
    assert_eq!(img.entry, 0x40_1000);
    assert_eq!(img.imports.len(), 2);
    assert_eq!(m.mem.read_u32(0x40_1160), known);
    let foo = m.mem.read_u32(0x40_1170);
    assert_eq!(m.registry.describe(foo), "foo.dll!#7");
    assert_eq!(img.auto_stubbed(&m).count(), 1);
    assert_eq!(m.mem.read_u8(0x40_1000), 0xC3);
    assert_eq!(m.process.image_base, 0x40_0000);
    assert!(parse(b"MZ").is_err());
}

/// The local copy in the repo's (gitignored) `game-files/` folder; env `S3_EXE` overrides it.
const S3_EXE: &str = concat!(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"), "/../../../game-files/gog-s3-ultimate/S3.EXE");

/// Loads the user's local S3.EXE if present (never committed). Skips otherwise.
#[test]
fn load_real_s3_exe_if_present() {
    let path = std::env::var("S3_EXE").unwrap_or_else(|_| S3_EXE.to_string());
    let Ok(bytes) = std::fs::read(&path) else {
        eprintln!("skipping: {path} not found");
        return;
    };
    let mut m = machine();
    let img = load(&mut m, &bytes, "S3.EXE").unwrap();
    assert_eq!(img.entry, 0x0062_1BC6);
    assert_eq!(img.imports.len(), 219);
    assert!(!img.headers.has_relocs);
    // .rsrc is readable through find_resource (S3.EXE has at least one icon group).
    assert!(find_resource(&m, img.base, &ResId::Id(rt::GROUP_ICON), &ResId::Id(1), None).is_some()
        || img.headers.dirs[DIR_RESOURCE].1 > 0);
    let mut dlls: Vec<&str> = img.imports.iter().map(|i| i.dll.as_str()).collect();
    dlls.dedup();
    eprintln!("dlls: {dlls:?}");
}
```

`port/crates/s3-relay/src/lib.rs`:

```rs
//! s3-relay: lobby/relay server for Settlers 3 port online play.
//!
//! One async "hub" task owns all state (clients, sessions, players) and processes events from per-connection
//! tasks in arrival order, so ordering per sender is preserved without locks. Each connection task only
//! decodes/encodes WebSocket frames. See docs/porting/multiplayer.md for protocol and semantics.
//!
//! Semantics mirror DirectPlay 6 as S3.EXE uses it: sessions with a host (migrates when the host leaves, because
//! S3 sets `DPSESSION_MIGRATEHOST`), players with DPIDs, system events (player added/removed, data, host,
//! session lost) and `Send(from, to, flags, payload)`. Delivery is reliable and ordered (TCP); messages *without*
//! `DPSEND_GUARANTEED` may be dropped when a receiver falls far behind, which DirectPlay also allows and S3's
//! lockstep layer tolerates (it retransmits on its own).

use std::collections::{BTreeMap, HashMap};
use std::net::SocketAddr;
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

use futures_util::{SinkExt, StreamExt};
use s3_net::dplay::{DPSESSION_JOINDISABLED, DPSESSION_MIGRATEHOST, DPSESSION_NEWPLAYERSDISABLED, DPSESSION_PASSWORDREQUIRED, DPSEND_GUARANTEED};
use s3_net::link::{Accept, Link};
use s3_net::protocol::*;
use tokio::net::{TcpListener, TcpStream};
use tokio::sync::{mpsc, oneshot};
use tokio_tungstenite::tungstenite::Message as WsMessage;

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct RelayConfig {
    pub listen: SocketAddr,
    /// Empty = accept any exe (sessions still only match identical exes).
    pub allowed_exes: Vec<Sha256>,
    pub max_clients: usize,
    /// Interval the client should ping at (sent in Welcome).
    pub keepalive: Duration,
    /// Drop a connection that sent nothing for this long.
    pub idle_timeout: Duration,
    /// Keep a dropped client's slot (players, host role, queued messages) this long for a resume.
    pub resume_grace: Duration,
    /// Non-guaranteed messages to a client are dropped while it has more unacked frames than this.
    pub soft_queue_limit: usize,
    /// A client with more unacked frames than this is disconnected (and its slot freed).
    pub hard_queue_limit: usize,
    pub server_name: String,
}

impl Default for RelayConfig {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            listen: "127.0.0.1:0".parse().unwrap(),
            allowed_exes: Vec::new(),
            max_clients: 1024,
            keepalive: Duration::from_secs(2),
            idle_timeout: Duration::from_secs(10),
            resume_grace: Duration::from_secs(20),
            soft_queue_limit: 2048,
            hard_queue_limit: 50_000,
            server_name: concat!("s3-relay ", env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION")).into(),
        }
    }
}

/// Counters for tests and the log.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Stats {
    pub clients: usize,
    pub sessions: usize,
    pub delivered: u64,
    pub dropped_unguaranteed: u64,
    pub desync_reports: u64,
    pub resumes: u64,
    pub host_migrations: u64,
}

pub struct RelayHandle {
    pub local_addr: SocketAddr,
    hub: mpsc::UnboundedSender<HubEvent>,
    task: tokio::task::JoinHandle<()>,
}

impl RelayHandle {
    pub fn url(&self) -> String {
        format!("ws://{}/", self.local_addr)
    }

    pub async fn stats(&self) -> Stats {
        let (tx, rx) = oneshot::channel();
        if self.hub.send(HubEvent::Stats(tx)).is_err() {
            return Stats::default();
        }
        rx.await.unwrap_or_default()
    }

    /// Test helper: cut a client's TCP connection without a Bye (simulates a network drop).
    pub fn kick_connection(&self, client_id: u32) {
        let _ = self.hub.send(HubEvent::Kick(client_id));
    }

    pub fn shutdown(self) {
        self.task.abort();
    }
}

/// Embedded relay for LAN play (docs/porting/multiplayer.md section 8): start the relay on its own thread with its
/// own tokio runtime, trying each address in `listen` in turn. Blocks until bound; the relay then runs for the rest
/// of the process. Returns the bound address.
pub fn spawn_background(listen: &[SocketAddr], cfg: RelayConfig) -> std::io::Result<SocketAddr> {
    let addrs = listen.to_vec();
    let (tx, rx) = std::sync::mpsc::channel();
    std::thread::Builder::new().name("s3-relay".into()).spawn(move || {
        let rt = match tokio::runtime::Builder::new_current_thread().enable_all().build() {
            Ok(rt) => rt,
            Err(e) => {
                let _ = tx.send(Err(e));
                return;
            }
        };
        rt.block_on(async move {
            let mut last = std::io::Error::other("no listen address");
            for a in addrs {
                match start(RelayConfig { listen: a, ..cfg.clone() }).await {
                    Ok(h) => {
                        let _ = tx.send(Ok(h.local_addr));
                        // Keep the handle (dropping it does not stop the tasks, but keep it anyway) and park.
                        let _keep = h;
                        std::future::pending::<()>().await;
                    }
                    Err(e) => {
                        log::warn!("embedded relay: cannot listen on {a}: {e}");
                        last = e;
                    }
                }
            }
            let _ = tx.send(Err(last));
        });
    })?;
    rx.recv().map_err(|_| std::io::Error::other("relay thread died"))?
}

/// Bind and start the relay on the current tokio runtime.
pub async fn start(cfg: RelayConfig) -> std::io::Result<RelayHandle> {
    let listener = TcpListener::bind(cfg.listen).await?;
    let local_addr = listener.local_addr()?;
    let (hub_tx, hub_rx) = mpsc::unbounded_channel();
    let hub_tx2 = hub_tx.clone();
    let idle = cfg.idle_timeout;
    tokio::spawn(Hub::new(cfg).run(hub_rx));
    let task = tokio::spawn(async move {
        let mut next_conn: u64 = 1;
        loop {
            let (stream, peer) = match listener.accept().await {
                Ok(x) => x,
                Err(e) => {
                    log::warn!("accept: {e}");
                    tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(50)).await;
                    continue;
                }
            };
            let _ = stream.set_nodelay(true);
            let conn = next_conn;
            next_conn += 1;
            tokio::spawn(connection(stream, peer, conn, hub_tx2.clone(), idle));
        }
    });
    log::info!("s3-relay listening on {local_addr}");
    Ok(RelayHandle { local_addr, hub: hub_tx, task })
}

enum Out {
    Frame(Vec<u8>),
    Close,
}

enum HubEvent {
    Open { conn: u64, peer: SocketAddr, out: mpsc::UnboundedSender<Out> },
    Frame { conn: u64, data: Vec<u8> },
    Closed { conn: u64 },
    Stats(oneshot::Sender<Stats>),
    Kick(u32),
    Tick,
}

async fn connection(stream: TcpStream, peer: SocketAddr, conn: u64, hub: mpsc::UnboundedSender<HubEvent>, idle: Duration) {
    let ws = match tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(10), tokio_tungstenite::accept_async(stream)).await {
        Ok(Ok(ws)) => ws,
        _ => return,
    };
    let (mut sink, mut stream) = ws.split();
    let (out_tx, mut out_rx) = mpsc::unbounded_channel();
    if hub.send(HubEvent::Open { conn, peer, out: out_tx }).is_err() {
        return;
    }
    let writer = tokio::spawn(async move {
        while let Some(o) = out_rx.recv().await {
            match o {
                Out::Frame(b) => {
                    if sink.send(WsMessage::binary(b)).await.is_err() {
                        break;
                    }
                }
                Out::Close => break,
            }
        }
        let _ = sink.close().await;
    });
    loop {
        match tokio::time::timeout(idle, stream.next()).await {
            Ok(Some(Ok(WsMessage::Binary(b)))) => {
                if hub.send(HubEvent::Frame { conn, data: b.to_vec() }).is_err() {
                    break;
                }
            }
            Ok(Some(Ok(WsMessage::Close(_)))) | Ok(None) | Ok(Some(Err(_))) => break,
            Ok(Some(Ok(_))) => {}
            Err(_) => {
                log::info!("conn {conn} ({peer}): idle timeout");
                break;
            }
        }
        if writer.is_finished() {
            break;
        }
    }
    let _ = hub.send(HubEvent::Closed { conn });
    writer.abort();
}

struct Client {
    id: u32,
    token: [u8; 16],
    name: String,
    exe: Sha256,
    link: Link<ServerMsg>,
    conn: Option<(u64, mpsc::UnboundedSender<Out>)>,
    disconnected_at: Option<Instant>,
    session: Option<Guid>,
}

struct Session {
    desc: SessionDesc,
    exe: Sha256,
    host: u32,
    /// Client ids in join order (host migration picks the oldest member).
    members: Vec<u32>,
    players: BTreeMap<u32, PlayerInfo>,
}

impl Session {
    fn public_desc(&self) -> SessionDesc {
        let mut d = self.desc.clone();
        if !d.password.is_empty() {
            d.flags |= DPSESSION_PASSWORDREQUIRED;
        }
        d.password.clear();
        d.current_players = self.players.len() as u32;
        d
    }
}

struct Hub {
    cfg: RelayConfig,
    clients: HashMap<u32, Client>,
    by_token: HashMap<[u8; 16], u32>,
    /// conn -> client id (None until Hello)
    conns: HashMap<u64, (Option<u32>, mpsc::UnboundedSender<Out>, SocketAddr)>,
    sessions: HashMap<Guid, Session>,
    next_client: u32,
    dpid_counter: u32,
    dpid_salt: u32,
    stats: Stats,
}

impl Hub {
    fn new(cfg: RelayConfig) -> Self {
        let salt: [u8; 4] = s3_net::random_bytes();
        Self {
            cfg,
            clients: HashMap::new(),
            by_token: HashMap::new(),
            conns: HashMap::new(),
            sessions: HashMap::new(),
            next_client: 1,
            dpid_counter: 0,
            dpid_salt: u32::from_le_bytes(salt),
            stats: Stats::default(),
        }
    }

    async fn run(mut self, mut rx: mpsc::UnboundedReceiver<HubEvent>) {
        let mut tick = tokio::time::interval(Duration::from_millis(250));
        loop {
            let ev = tokio::select! {
                ev = rx.recv() => match ev { Some(ev) => ev, None => break },
                _ = tick.tick() => HubEvent::Tick,
            };
            match ev {
                HubEvent::Open { conn, peer, out } => {
                    self.conns.insert(conn, (None, out, peer));
                }
                HubEvent::Frame { conn, data } => self.on_frame(conn, &data),
                HubEvent::Closed { conn } => self.on_closed(conn),
                HubEvent::Stats(tx) => {
                    let mut s = self.stats.clone();
                    s.clients = self.clients.len();
                    s.sessions = self.sessions.len();
                    let _ = tx.send(s);
                }
                HubEvent::Kick(cid) => {
                    if let Some(conn) = self.clients.get(&cid).and_then(|c| c.conn.as_ref().map(|x| x.0)) {
                        if let Some((_, out, _)) = self.conns.get(&conn) {
                            let _ = out.send(Out::Close);
                        }
                        self.on_closed(conn);
                    }
                }
                HubEvent::Tick => self.sweep(),
            }
        }
    }

    fn raw_send(out: &mpsc::UnboundedSender<Out>, f: Frame<ServerMsg>) {
        let _ = out.send(Out::Frame(f.encode()));
    }

    /// Sequence and send (or queue while disconnected) a message to a client.
    fn send(&mut self, cid: u32, msg: ServerMsg) {
        let Some(c) = self.clients.get_mut(&cid) else { return };
        let f = c.link.stamp(msg);
        if let Some((_, out)) = &c.conn {
            Self::raw_send(out, f);
        }
        if c.link.unacked_len() > self.cfg.hard_queue_limit {
            log::warn!("client {cid}: {} unacked frames, dropping", c.link.unacked_len());
            self.remove_client(cid);
        }
    }

    fn reply_err(&mut self, cid: u32, req: u32, code: ErrorCode, message: &str) {
        self.send(cid, ServerMsg::Error { req, code, message: message.into() });
    }

    fn on_frame(&mut self, conn: u64, data: &[u8]) {
        let Some((cid, out, peer)) = self.conns.get(&conn).map(|(c, o, p)| (*c, o.clone(), *p)) else { return };
        let frame = match Frame::<ClientMsg>::decode(data) {
            Ok(f) => f,
            Err(e) => {
                log::warn!("conn {conn} ({peer}): bad frame: {e}");
                let _ = out.send(Out::Close);
                return;
            }
        };
        let Some(cid) = cid else {
            match frame.msg {
                ClientMsg::Hello { proto, exe_sha256, name, build, resume } => {
                    self.on_hello(conn, out, peer, proto, exe_sha256, name, build, resume)
                }
                _ => {
                    let _ = out.send(Out::Close);
                }
            }
            return;
        };
        let Some(c) = self.clients.get_mut(&cid) else { return };
        c.link.on_ack(frame.ack);
        match c.link.accept(frame.seq) {
            Accept::New => {}
            Accept::Duplicate => return,
            Accept::Gap { expected, got } => {
                log::warn!("client {cid}: gap expected {expected} got {got}");
                let _ = out.send(Out::Close);
                return;
            }
        }
        self.on_msg(cid, frame.msg);
    }

    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    fn on_hello(
        &mut self,
        conn: u64,
        out: mpsc::UnboundedSender<Out>,
        peer: SocketAddr,
        proto: u16,
        exe: Sha256,
        name: String,
        build: String,
        resume: Option<Resume>,
    ) {
        let reject = |code: ErrorCode, message: String| {
            Self::raw_send(&out, Frame { seq: 0, ack: 0, msg: ServerMsg::Reject { code, message } });
            let _ = out.send(Out::Close);
        };
        if proto != PROTOCOL_VERSION {
            return reject(ErrorCode::VersionMismatch, format!("relay speaks protocol v{PROTOCOL_VERSION}, client v{proto}"));
        }
        if !self.cfg.allowed_exes.is_empty() && !self.cfg.allowed_exes.contains(&exe) {
            return reject(ErrorCode::ExeMismatch, format!("S3.EXE {} is not allowed on this relay", s3_net::hex(&exe[..8])));
        }
        // Resume an existing identity?
        if let Some(r) = resume {
            if let Some(&cid) = self.by_token.get(&r.token) {
                let c = self.clients.get_mut(&cid).unwrap();
                if c.exe == exe {
                    if let Some((old, old_out)) = c.conn.take() {
                        let _ = old_out.send(Out::Close);
                        self.conns.remove(&old);
                    }
                    c.conn = Some((conn, out.clone()));
                    c.disconnected_at = None;
                    let welcome = ServerMsg::Welcome {
                        proto: PROTOCOL_VERSION,
                        client_id: cid,
                        token: c.token,
                        resumed: true,
                        last_seq: c.link.last_recv,
                        keepalive_ms: self.cfg.keepalive.as_millis() as u32,
                        server: self.cfg.server_name.clone(),
                    };
                    Self::raw_send(&out, Frame { seq: 0, ack: c.link.last_recv, msg: welcome });
                    for f in c.link.retransmit_after(r.last_seq) {
                        Self::raw_send(&out, f);
                    }
                    if let Some(e) = self.conns.get_mut(&conn) {
                        e.0 = Some(cid);
                    }
                    self.stats.resumes += 1;
                    log::info!("client {cid} resumed from {peer}");
                    return;
                }
            }
            // Unknown/expired token: continue as a fresh client; `resumed: false` tells it the old state is gone.
        }
        if self.clients.len() >= self.cfg.max_clients {
            return reject(ErrorCode::ServerFull, "relay full".into());
        }
        let cid = self.next_client;
        self.next_client = self.next_client.wrapping_add(1).max(1);
        let token: [u8; 16] = s3_net::random_bytes();
        let link = Link::new();
        let welcome = ServerMsg::Welcome {
            proto: PROTOCOL_VERSION,
            client_id: cid,
            token,
            resumed: false,
            last_seq: 0,
            keepalive_ms: self.cfg.keepalive.as_millis() as u32,
            server: self.cfg.server_name.clone(),
        };
        Self::raw_send(&out, Frame { seq: 0, ack: 0, msg: welcome });
        log::info!("client {cid} '{name}' ({build}) from {peer}, exe {}", s3_net::hex(&exe[..8]));
        self.clients.insert(cid, Client { id: cid, token, name, exe, link, conn: Some((conn, out)), disconnected_at: None, session: None });
        self.by_token.insert(token, cid);
        if let Some(e) = self.conns.get_mut(&conn) {
            e.0 = Some(cid);
        }
    }

    fn on_closed(&mut self, conn: u64) {
        let Some((cid, _, _)) = self.conns.remove(&conn) else { return };
        let Some(cid) = cid else { return };
        if let Some(c) = self.clients.get_mut(&cid) {
            if c.conn.as_ref().map(|x| x.0) == Some(conn) {
                c.conn = None;
                c.disconnected_at = Some(Instant::now());
                log::info!("client {cid}: connection lost, keeping slot for {:?}", self.cfg.resume_grace);
            }
        }
    }

    fn sweep(&mut self) {
        let expired: Vec<u32> = self
            .clients
            .values()
            .filter(|c| c.disconnected_at.is_some_and(|t| t.elapsed() > self.cfg.resume_grace))
            .map(|c| c.id)
            .collect();
        for cid in expired {
            log::info!("client {cid}: resume grace expired");
            self.remove_client(cid);
        }
    }

    fn remove_client(&mut self, cid: u32) {
        self.leave(cid);
        if let Some(c) = self.clients.remove(&cid) {
            self.by_token.remove(&c.token);
            if let Some((conn, out)) = c.conn {
                let _ = out.send(Out::Close);
                self.conns.remove(&conn);
            }
        }
    }

    fn alloc_dpid(&mut self, g: &Guid) -> u32 {
        loop {
            self.dpid_counter = self.dpid_counter.wrapping_add(1);
            let id = self.dpid_counter.wrapping_mul(0x9e37_79b1) ^ self.dpid_salt;
            if id > 1 && id != u32::MAX && !self.sessions[g].players.contains_key(&id) {
                return id;
            }
        }
    }

    fn members_except(&self, g: &Guid, cid: u32) -> Vec<u32> {
        self.sessions.get(g).map(|s| s.members.iter().copied().filter(|&m| m != cid).collect()).unwrap_or_default()
    }

    /// Remove a client from its session: destroy its players, migrate host, delete empty sessions.
    fn leave(&mut self, cid: u32) {
        let Some(g) = self.clients.get_mut(&cid).and_then(|c| c.session.take()) else { return };
        let Some(s) = self.sessions.get_mut(&g) else { return };
        s.members.retain(|&m| m != cid);
        let gone: Vec<u32> = s.players.values().filter(|p| p.owner == cid).map(|p| p.dpid).collect();
        for d in &gone {
            s.players.remove(d);
        }
        let was_host = s.host == cid;
        let members = s.members.clone();
        let migrate = s.desc.flags & DPSESSION_MIGRATEHOST != 0;
        if members.is_empty() {
            self.sessions.remove(&g);
            log::info!("session {} closed", s3_net::hex(&g[..4]));
            return;
        }
        for &m in &members {
            for &d in &gone {
                self.send(m, ServerMsg::PlayerRemoved { dpid: d });
            }
        }
        if was_host {
            if migrate {
                let new_host = members[0];
                self.sessions.get_mut(&g).unwrap().host = new_host;
                self.stats.host_migrations += 1;
                log::info!("session {}: host {cid} left, new host {new_host}", s3_net::hex(&g[..4]));
                self.send(new_host, ServerMsg::BecameHost);
            } else {
                for &m in &members {
                    if let Some(c) = self.clients.get_mut(&m) {
                        c.session = None;
                    }
                    self.send(m, ServerMsg::SessionLost { code: ErrorCode::Disconnected });
                }
                self.sessions.remove(&g);
            }
        }
    }

    fn on_msg(&mut self, cid: u32, msg: ClientMsg) {
        match msg {
            ClientMsg::Hello { .. } => {}
            ClientMsg::Ping { nonce } => {
                if let Some(c) = self.clients.get_mut(&cid) {
                    let f = c.link.stamp(ServerMsg::Pong { nonce });
                    if let Some((_, out)) = &c.conn {
                        Self::raw_send(out, f);
                    }
                }
            }
            ClientMsg::Ack => {}
            ClientMsg::Bye => {
                log::info!("client {cid}: bye");
                self.remove_client(cid);
            }
            ClientMsg::ListSessions { req, application } => {
                let exe = self.clients[&cid].exe;
                let mut sessions: Vec<SessionDesc> = self
                    .sessions
                    .values()
                    .filter(|s| s.exe == exe && s.desc.application == application)
                    .map(|s| s.public_desc())
                    .collect();
                sessions.sort_by(|a, b| a.name.cmp(&b.name));
                self.send(cid, ServerMsg::SessionList { req, sessions });
            }
            ClientMsg::CreateSession { req, mut desc } => {
                if self.clients[&cid].session.is_some() {
                    return self.reply_err(cid, req, ErrorCode::AlreadyInSession, "already in a session");
                }
                desc.instance = s3_net::random_bytes();
                desc.current_players = 0;
                let g = desc.instance;
                let s = Session { desc, exe: self.clients[&cid].exe, host: cid, members: vec![cid], players: BTreeMap::new() };
                let public = s.public_desc();
                log::info!("client {cid} created session {} '{}'", s3_net::hex(&g[..4]), public.name);
                self.sessions.insert(g, s);
                self.clients.get_mut(&cid).unwrap().session = Some(g);
                self.send(cid, ServerMsg::Joined { req, desc: public, host: cid, players: Vec::new() });
            }
            ClientMsg::JoinSession { req, instance, password } => {
                if self.clients[&cid].session.is_some() {
                    return self.reply_err(cid, req, ErrorCode::AlreadyInSession, "already in a session");
                }
                let exe = self.clients[&cid].exe;
                let Some(s) = self.sessions.get_mut(&instance) else {
                    return self.reply_err(cid, req, ErrorCode::NoSuchSession, "no such session");
                };
                let err = if s.exe != exe {
                    Some((ErrorCode::ExeMismatch, "different S3.EXE than the host"))
                } else if s.desc.flags & (DPSESSION_JOINDISABLED | DPSESSION_NEWPLAYERSDISABLED) != 0 {
                    Some((ErrorCode::JoinDisabled, "session closed for joining"))
                } else if !s.desc.password.is_empty() && s.desc.password != password {
                    Some((ErrorCode::WrongPassword, "wrong password"))
                } else if s.desc.max_players != 0 && s.members.len() as u32 >= s.desc.max_players {
                    Some((ErrorCode::SessionFull, "session full"))
                } else {
                    None
                };
                if let Some((code, m)) = err {
                    return self.reply_err(cid, req, code, m);
                }
                s.members.push(cid);
                let (desc, host, players) = (s.public_desc(), s.host, s.players.values().cloned().collect());
                self.clients.get_mut(&cid).unwrap().session = Some(instance);
                self.send(cid, ServerMsg::Joined { req, desc, host, players });
            }
            ClientMsg::LeaveSession { req } => {
                if self.clients[&cid].session.is_none() {
                    return self.reply_err(cid, req, ErrorCode::NotInSession, "not in a session");
                }
                self.leave(cid);
                self.send(cid, ServerMsg::Ok { req });
            }
            ClientMsg::SetSessionDesc { req, desc } => {
                let Some(g) = self.clients[&cid].session else {
                    return self.reply_err(cid, req, ErrorCode::NotInSession, "not in a session");
                };
                let s = self.sessions.get_mut(&g).unwrap();
                if s.host != cid {
                    return self.reply_err(cid, req, ErrorCode::NotOwner, "only the host may change the session");
                }
                s.desc.flags = desc.flags;
                s.desc.max_players = desc.max_players;
                s.desc.name = desc.name;
                s.desc.password = desc.password;
                s.desc.user = desc.user;
                let public = s.public_desc();
                for m in self.members_except(&g, cid) {
                    self.send(m, ServerMsg::SessionDescChanged { desc: public.clone() });
                }
                self.send(cid, ServerMsg::Ok { req });
            }
            ClientMsg::CreatePlayer { req, flags, short_name, long_name, data } => {
                let Some(g) = self.clients[&cid].session else {
                    return self.reply_err(cid, req, ErrorCode::NotInSession, "not in a session");
                };
                let s = &self.sessions[&g];
                if s.desc.max_players != 0 && s.players.len() as u32 >= s.desc.max_players {
                    return self.reply_err(cid, req, ErrorCode::SessionFull, "session full");
                }
                let dpid = self.alloc_dpid(&g);
                let p = PlayerInfo { dpid, owner: cid, flags, short_name, long_name, data };
                self.sessions.get_mut(&g).unwrap().players.insert(dpid, p.clone());
                // Reply first so the creator knows its DPID before any message from others can mention it.
                self.send(cid, ServerMsg::PlayerCreated { req, dpid });
                for m in self.members_except(&g, cid) {
                    self.send(m, ServerMsg::PlayerAdded { player: p.clone() });
                }
            }
            ClientMsg::DestroyPlayer { req, dpid } => match self.owned_player(cid, dpid) {
                Err(code) => self.reply_err(cid, req, code, "cannot destroy player"),
                Ok(g) => {
                    self.sessions.get_mut(&g).unwrap().players.remove(&dpid);
                    for m in self.members_except(&g, cid) {
                        self.send(m, ServerMsg::PlayerRemoved { dpid });
                    }
                    self.send(cid, ServerMsg::Ok { req });
                }
            },
            ClientMsg::SetPlayerData { req, dpid, data } => match self.owned_player(cid, dpid) {
                Err(code) => self.reply_err(cid, req, code, "cannot set player data"),
                Ok(g) => {
                    self.sessions.get_mut(&g).unwrap().players.get_mut(&dpid).unwrap().data = data.clone();
                    for m in self.members_except(&g, cid) {
                        self.send(m, ServerMsg::PlayerData { dpid, data: data.clone() });
                    }
                    self.send(cid, ServerMsg::Ok { req });
                }
            },
            ClientMsg::SetPlayerName { req, dpid, short_name, long_name } => match self.owned_player(cid, dpid) {
                Err(code) => self.reply_err(cid, req, code, "cannot set player name"),
                Ok(g) => {
                    let p = self.sessions.get_mut(&g).unwrap().players.get_mut(&dpid).unwrap();
                    p.short_name = short_name.clone();
                    p.long_name = long_name.clone();
                    for m in self.members_except(&g, cid) {
                        self.send(m, ServerMsg::PlayerName { dpid, short_name: short_name.clone(), long_name: long_name.clone() });
                    }
                    self.send(cid, ServerMsg::Ok { req });
                }
            },
            ClientMsg::Send { from, to, flags, payload } => self.on_send(cid, from, to, flags, payload),
            ClientMsg::DesyncReport { step, checksum, detail } => {
                self.stats.desync_reports += 1;
                let name = self.clients[&cid].name.clone();
                log::warn!("DESYNC reported by client {cid} '{name}': step {step} checksum {checksum:#x}: {detail}");
                if let Some(g) = self.clients[&cid].session {
                    for m in self.members_except(&g, cid) {
                        self.send(m, ServerMsg::Desync { client_id: cid, step, checksum, detail: detail.clone() });
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    fn owned_player(&self, cid: u32, dpid: u32) -> Result<Guid, ErrorCode> {
        let g = self.clients[&cid].session.ok_or(ErrorCode::NotInSession)?;
        let p = self.sessions[&g].players.get(&dpid).ok_or(ErrorCode::NoSuchPlayer)?;
        if p.owner != cid {
            return Err(ErrorCode::NotOwner);
        }
        Ok(g)
    }

    fn on_send(&mut self, cid: u32, from: u32, to: u32, flags: u32, payload: Vec<u8>) {
        let Some(g) = self.clients[&cid].session else { return };
        let s = &self.sessions[&g];
        if s.players.get(&from).map(|p| p.owner) != Some(cid) {
            log::debug!("client {cid}: Send from foreign/unknown player {from:#x} ignored");
            return;
        }
        let targets: Vec<(u32, u32)> = if to == DPID_ALL {
            s.players.values().filter(|p| p.dpid != from).map(|p| (p.dpid, p.owner)).collect()
        } else {
            match s.players.get(&to) {
                Some(p) => vec![(p.dpid, p.owner)],
                None => return,
            }
        };
        for (dpid, owner) in targets {
            if flags & DPSEND_GUARANTEED == 0
                && self.clients.get(&owner).is_some_and(|c| c.link.unacked_len() > self.cfg.soft_queue_limit)
            {
                self.stats.dropped_unguaranteed += 1;
                continue;
            }
            self.stats.delivered += 1;
            self.send(owner, ServerMsg::Deliver { from, to: dpid, flags, payload: payload.clone() });
        }
    }
}
```
