`port/crates/s3-runtime/src/registry.rs`:

```rs
//! Thunk registry: every HLE function (Win32 export, COM method, internal helper) gets one address in the
//! thunk page `[THUNK_BASE, THUNK_END)`. Guest code calls/jumps there; the CPU exits with
//! `CpuExit::Thunk(addr)` and the machine runs the handler.

use std::collections::HashMap;

use s3_mem::layout::{FAKE_MODULE_BASE, THUNK_BASE, THUNK_END};

use crate::Machine;

/// An HLE function. Read arguments with `m.arg_u32(i)` (`i` = 0 for the first argument) and return a
/// [`ThunkResult`]. A handler that may return [`ThunkResult::Block`] must not have side effects before deciding
/// to block: it is simply called again later.
pub type Handler = fn(&mut Machine) -> ThunkResult;

/// What a handler wants to happen next.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum ThunkResult {
    /// Return to the guest caller: EAX = `eax`, pop the return address and then `pop_bytes` of arguments
    /// (stdcall: 4 * nargs; cdecl: 0).
    Return { eax: u32, pop_bytes: u32 },
    /// Like `Return` but also sets EDX (64-bit results).
    Return64 { eax: u32, edx: u32, pop_bytes: u32 },
    /// The handler already set EIP/ESP/registers itself (e.g. it redirected into guest code); do nothing.
    Done,
    /// The calling thread waits; the handler is called again when the scheduler retries this thread.
    Block,
    /// Terminate the process with this exit code.
    Exit(u32),
    /// Terminate the calling thread with this exit code.
    ExitThread(u32),
    /// Stop the machine with an error (bug or unsupported situation).
    Error(String),
}

impl ThunkResult {
    /// stdcall return: callee pops `nargs` dword arguments.
    pub fn stdcall(eax: u32, nargs: u32) -> Self {
        ThunkResult::Return { eax, pop_bytes: nargs * 4 }
    }
    /// cdecl return: caller pops the arguments.
    pub fn cdecl(eax: u32) -> Self {
        ThunkResult::Return { eax, pop_bytes: 0 }
    }
}

/// One thunk.
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct ThunkEntry {
    /// Guest address of the thunk.
    pub addr: u32,
    /// Lower-case DLL name with extension, e.g. `kernel32.dll`. COM methods use the DLL that implements them.
    pub dll: String,
    /// Export name, or `Interface::Method` for COM methods, or `#123` for ordinal-only imports.
    pub name: String,
    pub ordinal: Option<u16>,
    /// `None` = not implemented: calling it stops the machine with `UNIMPLEMENTED dll!name`.
    pub handler: Option<Handler>,
    /// Created automatically while resolving an import nobody declared.
    pub auto: bool,
    /// Number of calls so far.
    pub calls: u64,
}

/// Normalize a DLL name: lower case, `.dll` appended when there is no extension, path stripped.
pub fn normalize_dll(dll: &str) -> String {
    let base = dll.rsplit(['\\', '/']).next().unwrap_or(dll);
    let mut s = base.to_ascii_lowercase();
    if !s.contains('.') {
        s.push_str(".dll");
    }
    s
}

/// All thunks plus the list of HLE modules.
#[derive(Debug, Default)]
pub struct Registry {
    entries: Vec<ThunkEntry>,
    by_name: HashMap<(String, String), usize>,
    by_ordinal: HashMap<(String, u16), usize>,
    aliases: HashMap<String, String>,
    modules: Vec<String>,
}

impl Registry {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self::default()
    }

    /// Make `alias` (e.g. `_inmm.dll`) resolve to `target` (e.g. `winmm.dll`).
    pub fn alias(&mut self, alias: &str, target: &str) {
        self.aliases.insert(normalize_dll(alias), normalize_dll(target));
    }

    fn canon(&self, dll: &str) -> String {
        let d = normalize_dll(dll);
        self.aliases.get(&d).cloned().unwrap_or(d)
    }

    fn ensure_module(&mut self, dll: &str) {
        if !self.modules.iter().any(|m| m == dll) {
            self.modules.push(dll.to_string());
        }
    }

    fn add(&mut self, dll: String, name: String, handler: Option<Handler>, auto: bool) -> u32 {
        let idx = self.entries.len();
        let addr = THUNK_BASE + idx as u32;
        assert!(addr < THUNK_END, "thunk page full");
        self.ensure_module(&dll);
        self.by_name.insert((dll.clone(), name.clone()), idx);
        self.entries.push(ThunkEntry { addr, dll, name, ordinal: None, handler, auto, calls: 0 });
        addr
    }

    /// Register (or replace) the handler of `dll!name`. Returns the thunk address.
    pub fn register(&mut self, dll: &str, name: &str, handler: Handler) -> u32 {
        let dll = self.canon(dll);
        if let Some(&i) = self.by_name.get(&(dll.clone(), name.to_string())) {
            self.entries[i].handler = Some(handler);
            self.entries[i].auto = false;
            return self.entries[i].addr;
        }
        self.add(dll, name.to_string(), Some(handler), false)
    }

    /// Declare `dll!name` without an implementation (keeps an existing handler). Returns the thunk address.
    pub fn declare(&mut self, dll: &str, name: &str) -> u32 {
        let dll = self.canon(dll);
        if let Some(&i) = self.by_name.get(&(dll.clone(), name.to_string())) {
            return self.entries[i].addr;
        }
        self.add(dll, name.to_string(), None, false)
    }

    /// Declare several names at once.
    pub fn declare_all(&mut self, dll: &str, names: &[&str]) {
        for n in names {
            self.declare(dll, n);
        }
    }

    /// Attach an export ordinal to `dll!name` (declaring it if needed).
    pub fn set_ordinal(&mut self, dll: &str, name: &str, ordinal: u16) {
        let addr = self.declare(dll, name);
        let i = (addr - THUNK_BASE) as usize;
        let dll = self.canon(dll);
        self.entries[i].ordinal = Some(ordinal);
        self.by_ordinal.insert((dll, ordinal), i);
    }

    /// Address of `dll!name` if known.
    pub fn lookup(&self, dll: &str, name: &str) -> Option<u32> {
        let dll = self.canon(dll);
        self.by_name.get(&(dll, name.to_string())).map(|&i| self.entries[i].addr)
    }

    /// Address of `dll!#ordinal` if known.
    pub fn lookup_ordinal(&self, dll: &str, ordinal: u16) -> Option<u32> {
        let dll = self.canon(dll);
        self.by_ordinal.get(&(dll, ordinal)).map(|&i| self.entries[i].addr)
    }

    /// Resolve an import by name, creating an auto stub when nobody declared it.
    pub fn resolve_import(&mut self, dll: &str, name: &str) -> u32 {
        if let Some(a) = self.lookup(dll, name) {
            return a;
        }
        let dll = self.canon(dll);
        self.add(dll, name.to_string(), None, true)
    }

    /// Resolve an import by ordinal, creating an auto stub `#ordinal` when unknown.
    pub fn resolve_import_ordinal(&mut self, dll: &str, ordinal: u16) -> u32 {
        if let Some(a) = self.lookup_ordinal(dll, ordinal) {
            return a;
        }
        let name = format!("#{ordinal}");
        let addr = self.resolve_import(dll, &name);
        let i = (addr - THUNK_BASE) as usize;
        self.entries[i].ordinal = Some(ordinal);
        let dll = self.canon(dll);
        self.by_ordinal.insert((dll, ordinal), i);
        addr
    }

    /// Entry for a thunk address.
    pub fn entry(&self, addr: u32) -> Option<&ThunkEntry> {
        self.entries.get(addr.checked_sub(THUNK_BASE)? as usize)
    }

    pub(crate) fn entry_mut(&mut self, addr: u32) -> Option<&mut ThunkEntry> {
        self.entries.get_mut(addr.checked_sub(THUNK_BASE)? as usize)
    }

    /// All entries.
    pub fn entries(&self) -> &[ThunkEntry] {
        &self.entries
    }

    /// `dll!name` for display.
    pub fn describe(&self, addr: u32) -> String {
        match self.entry(addr) {
            Some(e) => format!("{}!{}", e.dll, e.name),
            None => format!("<thunk {addr:#x}>"),
        }
    }

    /// Fake HMODULE for an HLE DLL (`LoadLibraryA`/`GetModuleHandleA`), or None if no function of that DLL
    /// was ever declared.
    pub fn module_handle(&self, dll: &str) -> Option<u32> {
        let dll = self.canon(dll);
        self.modules.iter().position(|m| *m == dll).map(|i| FAKE_MODULE_BASE + i as u32 * 0x1_0000)
    }

    /// Module name of a fake HMODULE.
    pub fn module_name(&self, hmodule: u32) -> Option<&str> {
        let off = hmodule.checked_sub(FAKE_MODULE_BASE)?;
        if off % 0x1_0000 != 0 {
            return None;
        }
        self.modules.get((off / 0x1_0000) as usize).map(|s| s.as_str())
    }
}
```

`port/crates/s3-runtime/src/resources.rs`:

```rs
//! PE resources (`.rsrc`) of images mapped in guest memory: `FindResourceA` / `LoadResource` /
//! `SizeofResource` (kernel32) and `LoadStringA` / `LoadIconA` / `LoadCursorA` (user32).
//!
//! A resource handle (HRSRC) is the guest address of its `IMAGE_RESOURCE_DATA_ENTRY`
//! (`find_resource_entry`); `LoadResource(HRSRC)` = `module_base + entry.OffsetToData`, size = `entry.Size`.

use crate::Machine;

/// Resource identifier: integer id (`MAKEINTRESOURCE`) or name.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum ResId {
    Id(u16),
    Name(String),
}

impl ResId {
    /// From a guest `LPCSTR` argument: values < 0x10000 are integer ids, otherwise an ANSI string (`#123`
    /// strings are converted to ids).
    pub fn from_guest_a(m: &Machine, p: u32) -> ResId {
        if p < 0x1_0000 {
            return ResId::Id(p as u16);
        }
        let s = m.mem.read_cstr(p);
        if let Some(n) = s.strip_prefix('#').and_then(|n| n.parse().ok()) {
            return ResId::Id(n);
        }
        ResId::Name(s.to_ascii_uppercase())
    }
}

/// Standard resource types.
pub mod rt {
    pub const CURSOR: u16 = 1;
    pub const BITMAP: u16 = 2;
    pub const ICON: u16 = 3;
    pub const MENU: u16 = 4;
    pub const DIALOG: u16 = 5;
    pub const STRING: u16 = 6;
    pub const RCDATA: u16 = 10;
    pub const GROUP_CURSOR: u16 = 12;
    pub const GROUP_ICON: u16 = 14;
    pub const VERSION: u16 = 16;
}

fn res_dir_find(m: &Machine, rsrc: u32, dir: u32, id: Option<&ResId>) -> Option<u32> {
    let named = m.mem.read_u16(dir + 12) as u32;
    let ids = m.mem.read_u16(dir + 14) as u32;
    for i in 0..named + ids {
        let e = dir + 16 + i * 8;
        let name = m.mem.read_u32(e);
        let off = m.mem.read_u32(e + 4);
        let matches = match id {
            None => true,
            Some(ResId::Id(want)) => name & 0x8000_0000 == 0 && name as u16 == *want,
            Some(ResId::Name(want)) => {
                if name & 0x8000_0000 == 0 {
                    false
                } else {
                    let s = rsrc + (name & 0x7FFF_FFFF);
                    let len = m.mem.read_u16(s) as usize;
                    let units: Vec<u16> = (0..len).map(|k| m.mem.read_u16(s + 2 + 2 * k as u32)).collect();
                    String::from_utf16_lossy(&units).eq_ignore_ascii_case(want)
                }
            }
        };
        if matches {
            return Some(off);
        }
    }
    None
}

/// Find a resource in the module mapped at `module_base`. Returns (guest address, size) of the data.
/// `lang = None` takes the first language.
pub fn find_resource(m: &Machine, module_base: u32, rtype: &ResId, name: &ResId, lang: Option<u16>) -> Option<(u32, u32)> {
    let data = find_resource_entry(m, module_base, rtype, name, lang)?;
    Some((module_base + m.mem.read_u32(data), m.mem.read_u32(data + 4)))
}

/// Like [`find_resource`] but returns the guest address of the `IMAGE_RESOURCE_DATA_ENTRY` (used as HRSRC).
pub fn find_resource_entry(m: &Machine, module_base: u32, rtype: &ResId, name: &ResId, lang: Option<u16>) -> Option<u32> {
    let pe = module_base + m.mem.read_u32(module_base + 0x3C);
    let opt = pe + 24;
    let rva = m.mem.read_u32(opt + 96 + 2 * 8);
    if rva == 0 {
        return None;
    }
    let rsrc = module_base + rva;
    let l1 = res_dir_find(m, rsrc, rsrc, Some(rtype))?;
    if l1 & 0x8000_0000 == 0 {
        return None;
    }
    let l2 = res_dir_find(m, rsrc, rsrc + (l1 & 0x7FFF_FFFF), Some(name))?;
    if l2 & 0x8000_0000 == 0 {
        return None;
    }
    let lang_id = lang.map(ResId::Id);
    let l3_dir = rsrc + (l2 & 0x7FFF_FFFF);
    let l3 = res_dir_find(m, rsrc, l3_dir, lang_id.as_ref()).or_else(|| res_dir_find(m, rsrc, l3_dir, None))?;
    if l3 & 0x8000_0000 != 0 {
        return None;
    }
    Some(rsrc + l3)
}

/// `LoadString` helper: string `id` from the RT_STRING table of `module_base`.
pub fn load_string(m: &Machine, module_base: u32, id: u32) -> Option<String> {
    let block = (id >> 4) + 1;
    let (addr, _) = find_resource(m, module_base, &ResId::Id(rt::STRING), &ResId::Id(block as u16), None)?;
    let mut p = addr;
    for i in 0..16 {
        let len = m.mem.read_u16(p) as u32;
        if i == id & 15 {
            let units: Vec<u16> = (0..len).map(|k| m.mem.read_u16(p + 2 + 2 * k)).collect();
            return Some(String::from_utf16_lossy(&units));
        }
        p += 2 + 2 * len;
    }
    None
}
```

`port/crates/s3-runtime/src/seh.rs`:

```rs
//! Structured exception handling (x86 Win32 SEH), enough for MSVC6 `__try/__except/__finally` and C++ `throw`
//! (which goes through `RaiseException`).
//!
//! Dispatch runs *in the guest*, without nesting host frames: for each registration record on the FS:[0]
//! chain the handler is called as `handler(EXCEPTION_RECORD*, frame, CONTEXT*, dispatcher_ctx)` with return
//! address `s3port.dll!seh_handler_return`. That thunk reads the disposition and either resumes from the
//! (possibly modified) CONTEXT, or calls the next handler. MSVC handlers that decide to execute an `__except`
//! block never return (they `RtlUnwind` and jump into the function); stale dispatch records are dropped the
//! next time an exception is raised.

use s3_cpu::{Context, CpuExit, FaultKind, EAX, EBP, EBX, ECX, EDI, EDX, ESI, ESP};

use crate::machine::{teb, StopReason};
use crate::{Machine, ThunkResult};

pub const EXCEPTION_ACCESS_VIOLATION: u32 = 0xC000_0005;
pub const EXCEPTION_BREAKPOINT: u32 = 0x8000_0003;
pub const EXCEPTION_ILLEGAL_INSTRUCTION: u32 = 0xC000_001D;
pub const EXCEPTION_INT_DIVIDE_BY_ZERO: u32 = 0xC000_0094;
pub const EXCEPTION_INT_OVERFLOW: u32 = 0xC000_0095;
pub const EXCEPTION_PRIV_INSTRUCTION: u32 = 0xC000_0096;
pub const STATUS_UNWIND: u32 = 0xC000_0027;
/// MSVC C++ exception code ('msc' | 0xE0000000).
pub const CXX_EXCEPTION: u32 = 0xE06D_7363;

pub const EXCEPTION_NONCONTINUABLE: u32 = 1;
pub const EXCEPTION_UNWINDING: u32 = 2;
pub const EXCEPTION_EXIT_UNWIND: u32 = 4;

/// Size of the x86 `CONTEXT` structure.
pub const CONTEXT_SIZE: u32 = 0x2CC;
/// `CONTEXT_FULL | CONTEXT_FLOATING_POINT | CONTEXT_DEBUG_REGISTERS | CONTEXT_EXTENDED_REGISTERS` (i386).
pub const CONTEXT_ALL: u32 = 0x0001_003F;

/// CONTEXT field offsets.
pub mod ctx {
    pub const FLAGS: u32 = 0x00;
    pub const SEG_GS: u32 = 0x8C;
    pub const SEG_FS: u32 = 0x90;
    pub const SEG_ES: u32 = 0x94;
    pub const SEG_DS: u32 = 0x98;
    pub const EDI: u32 = 0x9C;
    pub const ESI: u32 = 0xA0;
    pub const EBX: u32 = 0xA4;
    pub const EDX: u32 = 0xA8;
    pub const ECX: u32 = 0xAC;
    pub const EAX: u32 = 0xB0;
    pub const EBP: u32 = 0xB4;
    pub const EIP: u32 = 0xB8;
    pub const SEG_CS: u32 = 0xBC;
    pub const EFLAGS: u32 = 0xC0;
    pub const ESP: u32 = 0xC4;
    pub const SEG_SS: u32 = 0xC8;
}

/// One exception dispatch in progress on a thread.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy)]
pub(crate) struct Dispatch {
    rec: u32,
    ctx: u32,
    frame: u32,
    call_esp: u32,
}

/// Write a CONTEXT structure.
pub fn write_context(m: &mut Machine, addr: u32, c: &Context) {
    m.mem.fill(addr, CONTEXT_SIZE as usize, 0);
    let w = |m: &mut Machine, off: u32, v: u32| m.mem.write_u32(addr + off, v);
    w(m, ctx::FLAGS, CONTEXT_ALL);
    w(m, ctx::SEG_GS, 0);
    w(m, ctx::SEG_FS, 0x3B);
    w(m, ctx::SEG_ES, 0x23);
    w(m, ctx::SEG_DS, 0x23);
    w(m, ctx::EDI, c.regs[EDI]);
    w(m, ctx::ESI, c.regs[ESI]);
    w(m, ctx::EBX, c.regs[EBX]);
    w(m, ctx::EDX, c.regs[EDX]);
    w(m, ctx::ECX, c.regs[ECX]);
    w(m, ctx::EAX, c.regs[EAX]);
    w(m, ctx::EBP, c.regs[EBP]);
    w(m, ctx::EIP, c.eip);
    w(m, ctx::SEG_CS, 0x1B);
    w(m, ctx::EFLAGS, c.eflags);
    w(m, ctx::ESP, c.regs[ESP]);
    w(m, ctx::SEG_SS, 0x23);
}

/// Read a CONTEXT structure.
pub fn read_context(m: &Machine, addr: u32) -> Context {
    let r = |off: u32| m.mem.read_u32(addr + off);
    let mut c = Context::default();
    c.regs[EDI] = r(ctx::EDI);
    c.regs[ESI] = r(ctx::ESI);
    c.regs[EBX] = r(ctx::EBX);
    c.regs[EDX] = r(ctx::EDX);
    c.regs[ECX] = r(ctx::ECX);
    c.regs[EAX] = r(ctx::EAX);
    c.regs[EBP] = r(ctx::EBP);
    c.regs[ESP] = r(ctx::ESP);
    c.eip = r(ctx::EIP);
    c.eflags = r(ctx::EFLAGS);
    c
}

/// Turn a CPU exit (fault / int / hlt) into a guest exception. Returns true if guest execution can continue
/// (an exception handler is being called), false if the machine stopped.
pub(crate) fn handle_cpu_exit(m: &mut Machine, exit: CpuExit) -> bool {
    let c = m.cpu().context();
    match exit {
        CpuExit::Fault { eip, kind, detail } => {
            let (code, params): (u32, Vec<u32>) = match kind {
                FaultKind::Unimplemented => {
                    m.stop(StopReason::Fault(format!("unimplemented instruction at {eip:#x}: {detail}")));
                    return false;
                }
                FaultKind::AccessViolation { addr, write } => (EXCEPTION_ACCESS_VIOLATION, vec![write as u32, addr]),
                FaultKind::DivideError => (EXCEPTION_INT_DIVIDE_BY_ZERO, vec![]),
                FaultKind::InvalidOpcode => (EXCEPTION_ILLEGAL_INSTRUCTION, vec![]),
                FaultKind::GeneralProtection => (EXCEPTION_PRIV_INSTRUCTION, vec![]),
            };
            m.log(crate::LogLevel::Warn, &format!("guest exception {code:#x} at {eip:#x} ({detail})"));
            raise_exception(m, code, 0, &params, c, eip)
        }
        CpuExit::Interrupt(3) => {
            let mut c = c;
            c.eip = c.eip.wrapping_sub(1);
            raise_exception(m, EXCEPTION_BREAKPOINT, 0, &[0], c, c.eip)
        }
        CpuExit::Interrupt(n) => {
            m.stop(StopReason::Fault(format!("int {n:#x} at {:#x}", c.eip)));
            false
        }
        CpuExit::Halt => {
            m.stop(StopReason::Fault(format!("hlt at {:#x}", c.eip)));
            false
        }
        other => {
            m.stop(StopReason::Error(format!("unexpected cpu exit {other:?}")));
            false
        }
    }
}

/// Raise a guest exception on the current thread: builds EXCEPTION_RECORD + CONTEXT (from `c`) on the
/// guest stack and starts calling handlers. `address` = ExceptionAddress. Returns false if nobody handles it
/// (the machine is stopped). After a `true` return the CPU is set up to run the first handler; a thunk that
/// calls this must return [`ThunkResult::Done`].
pub fn raise_exception(m: &mut Machine, code: u32, flags: u32, params: &[u32], c: Context, address: u32) -> bool {
    m.stats.exceptions += 1;
    let esp = c.regs[ESP];
    let slot = m.cur;
    // Drop dispatches whose frames were unwound (handler jumped away instead of returning).
    m.threads[slot].seh.retain(|d| d.call_esp > esp);
    if m.threads[slot].seh.len() > 16 {
        m.stop(StopReason::Fault(format!("exception {code:#x} at {address:#x}: nested too deep")));
        return false;
    }
    let ctx_addr = (esp.wrapping_sub(0x100 + CONTEXT_SIZE)) & !0xF;
    let rec_addr = ctx_addr - 0x50;
    let disp_addr = rec_addr - 0x10;
    let call_esp = disp_addr - 0x10;
    write_context(m, ctx_addr, &c);
    m.mem.fill(rec_addr, 0x50, 0);
    m.mem.write_u32(rec_addr, code);
    m.mem.write_u32(rec_addr + 4, flags);
    m.mem.write_u32(rec_addr + 12, address);
    let n = params.len().min(15);
    m.mem.write_u32(rec_addr + 16, n as u32);
    for (i, p) in params.iter().take(n).enumerate() {
        m.mem.write_u32(rec_addr + 20 + 4 * i as u32, *p);
    }
    m.mem.fill(disp_addr, 0x10, 0);
    let teb_addr = m.threads[slot].teb;
    let frame = m.mem.read_u32(teb_addr + teb::EXCEPTION_LIST);
    m.threads[slot].seh.push(Dispatch { rec: rec_addr, ctx: ctx_addr, frame, call_esp });
    call_next_handler(m)
}

fn frame_valid(m: &Machine, frame: u32) -> bool {
    let t = &m.threads[m.cur];
    frame != 0xFFFF_FFFF && frame >= t.stack_bottom && frame < t.stack_top && frame & 3 == 0
}

fn call_next_handler(m: &mut Machine) -> bool {
    let slot = m.cur;
    let Some(d) = m.threads[slot].seh.last().copied() else { return false };
    if !frame_valid(m, d.frame) {
        let code = m.mem.read_u32(d.rec);
        let addr = m.mem.read_u32(d.rec + 12);
        m.threads[slot].seh.pop();
        m.stop(StopReason::Fault(format!("unhandled exception {code:#x} at {addr:#x} (thread {slot})")));
        return false;
    }
    let handler = m.mem.read_u32(d.frame + 4);
    let ret = m.seh_return_thunk;
    let cpu = &mut m.threads[slot].cpu;
    cpu.regs[ESP] = d.call_esp;
    for v in [d.rec - 0x10 /* dispatcher ctx */, d.ctx, d.frame, d.rec] {
        cpu.push32(&mut m.mem, v);
    }
    cpu.push32(&mut m.mem, ret);
    cpu.eip = handler;
    true
}

/// `s3port.dll!seh_handler_return`: an exception handler returned its disposition in EAX.
pub(crate) fn handler_return(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let slot = m.cur;
    let disposition = m.cpu().regs[EAX];
    let Some(d) = m.threads[slot].seh.last().copied() else {
        return ThunkResult::Error("seh_handler_return without dispatch".into());
    };
    match disposition {
        0 => {
            // ExceptionContinueExecution
            let c = read_context(m, d.ctx);
            m.threads[slot].seh.pop();
            m.cpu().set_context(&c);
        }
        _ => {
            // ExceptionContinueSearch (1) / nested (2) / collided unwind (3): next frame.
            let next = m.mem.read_u32(d.frame);
            if let Some(top) = m.threads[slot].seh.last_mut() {
                top.frame = next;
            }
            call_next_handler(m);
        }
    }
    ThunkResult::Done
}

/// `RtlUnwind(target_frame, target_ip, exception_record, return_value)` core: call every handler between
/// FS:[0] and `target_frame` with the UNWINDING flag, unlinking them. `target_frame == 0` unwinds everything.
pub fn rtl_unwind(m: &mut Machine, target_frame: u32, exc_rec: u32) {
    let slot = m.cur;
    let teb_addr = m.threads[slot].teb;
    let scratch = m.mem.alloc(0x50 + CONTEXT_SIZE + 0x10);
    let rec = if exc_rec != 0 {
        exc_rec
    } else {
        m.mem.write_u32(scratch, STATUS_UNWIND);
        scratch
    };
    let mut flags = m.mem.read_u32(rec + 4) | EXCEPTION_UNWINDING;
    if target_frame == 0 {
        flags |= EXCEPTION_EXIT_UNWIND;
    }
    m.mem.write_u32(rec + 4, flags);
    let c = m.cpu().context();
    let ctx_addr = scratch + 0x50;
    write_context(m, ctx_addr, &c);
    let disp = ctx_addr + CONTEXT_SIZE;
    let mut frame = m.mem.read_u32(teb_addr + teb::EXCEPTION_LIST);
    let mut guard = 0;
    while frame != target_frame && frame_valid(m, frame) && guard < 1000 {
        guard += 1;
        let handler = m.mem.read_u32(frame + 4);
        m.call_guest(handler, &[rec, frame, ctx_addr, disp]);
        if m.is_stopped() {
            break;
        }
        frame = m.mem.read_u32(frame);
        m.mem.write_u32(teb_addr + teb::EXCEPTION_LIST, frame);
    }
    if target_frame != 0 {
        m.mem.write_u32(teb_addr + teb::EXCEPTION_LIST, target_frame);
    }
    m.mem.free(scratch);
}
```

`port/crates/s3-runtime/src/tests.rs`:

```rs
use iced_x86::code_asm::*;

use s3_cpu::{EAX, EBX, ESP};
use s3_mem::layout;

use crate::*;

const CODE: u32 = 0x0040_1000;

fn tmpdir(tag: &str) -> std::path::PathBuf {
    let d = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("s3rt-test-{}-{}", tag, std::process::id()));
    let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&d);
    std::fs::create_dir_all(&d).unwrap();
    d
}

fn machine() -> Machine {
    let d = tmpdir("m");
    let mut host = NullHost::new(d.join("game"), d.join("data"));
    host.quiet = true;
    let mut m = Machine::new(Box::new(host)).unwrap();
    m.mem.alloc_region(Some(layout::IMAGE_BASE), 0x10_0000, s3_mem::RegionKind::Image, (0, 0)).unwrap();
    m.setup_process(layout::IMAGE_BASE, 0x10_0000, CODE, 0x10_0000, "TEST.EXE");
    m
}

fn load(m: &mut Machine, at: u32, build: impl FnOnce(&mut CodeAssembler)) {
    let mut a = CodeAssembler::new(32).unwrap();
    build(&mut a);
    let bytes = a.assemble(at as u64).unwrap();
    m.mem.write_bytes(at, &bytes);
}

fn run_to_stop(m: &mut Machine) -> StopReason {
    for _ in 0..1000 {
        if m.run_slice(1_000_000) == SliceResult::Stopped {
            return m.stop_reason().unwrap().clone();
        }
    }
    panic!("did not stop");
}

fn h_add2(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let s = m.arg_u32(0) + m.arg_u32(1);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(s, 2)
}

fn h_exit(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    ThunkResult::Exit(m.arg_u32(0))
}

#[test]
fn registry_basics() {
    let mut r = Registry::new();
    r.alias("_inmm.dll", "winmm.dll");
    let a = r.declare("KERNEL32", "Sleep");
    assert_eq!(r.lookup("kernel32.dll", "Sleep"), Some(a));
    let b = r.register("kernel32.dll", "Sleep", h_add2);
    assert_eq!(a, b, "register keeps the declared address");
    assert!(r.entry(a).unwrap().handler.is_some());
    let t = r.declare("winmm.dll", "timeGetTime");
    assert_eq!(r.resolve_import("_INMM.dll", "timeGetTime"), t);
    let auto = r.resolve_import("foo.dll", "Bar");
    assert!(r.entry(auto).unwrap().auto);
    assert_eq!(r.describe(auto), "foo.dll!Bar");
    let o = r.resolve_import_ordinal("wsock32.dll", 23);
    assert_eq!(r.lookup_ordinal("WSOCK32", 23), Some(o));
    let hm = r.module_handle("KERNEL32.DLL").unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.module_name(hm), Some("kernel32.dll"));
    assert_eq!(r.module_handle("_inmm.dll"), r.module_handle("winmm.dll"));
    assert!(r.module_handle("nothere.dll").is_none());
}

#[test]
fn vfs_case_insensitive_and_overlay() {
    let d = tmpdir("vfs");
    let game = d.join("game");
    std::fs::create_dir_all(game.join("Gfx")).unwrap();
    std::fs::write(game.join("Gfx").join("Siedler3_00.f8007e01f.DAT"), b"x").unwrap();
    std::fs::write(game.join("S3.EXE"), b"mz").unwrap();
    let mut v = Vfs::new(game.clone(), d.join("data"));
    assert_eq!(v.components("C:\\S3\\GFX\\a.dat"), vec!["GFX", "a.dat"]);
    assert_eq!(v.components("d:\\gfx\\..\\snd\\x"), vec!["snd", "x"]);
    assert_eq!(v.components("gfx/x.dat"), vec!["gfx", "x.dat"]);
    let p = v.resolve_read("C:\\S3\\gfx\\siedler3_00.F8007E01F.dat").unwrap();
    assert!(p.ends_with("Gfx/Siedler3_00.f8007e01f.DAT"));
    assert!(v.resolve_read("gfx\\missing.dat").is_none());
    // Writes go to the overlay and shadow the game dir.
    let w = v.resolve_write("Save\\game1.sav").unwrap();
    std::fs::write(&w, b"save").unwrap();
    assert!(w.starts_with(d.join("data").join("overlay")));
    assert_eq!(v.resolve_read("SAVE\\GAME1.SAV").unwrap(), w);
    let up = v.copy_up("s3.exe").unwrap();
    assert_eq!(std::fs::read(&up).unwrap(), b"mz");
    assert_eq!(v.resolve_read("S3.exe").unwrap(), up);
    let names: Vec<String> = v.list_dir("C:\\S3").into_iter().map(|e| e.name).collect();
    assert_eq!(names.iter().filter(|n| n.eq_ignore_ascii_case("s3.exe")).count(), 1);
    assert!(names.iter().any(|n| n == "Gfx"));
    assert!(v.set_cwd("gfx"));
    assert_eq!(v.cwd, "C:\\S3\\gfx");
    assert!(!v.set_cwd("nope"));
    assert!(vfs::wildcard_match("*.dat", "A.DAT"));
    assert!(vfs::wildcard_match("s?.exe", "S3.EXE"));
    assert!(!vfs::wildcard_match("*.dat", "a.dax"));
    let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&d);
}

#[test]
fn thunk_call_stdcall_and_exit() {
    let mut m = machine();
    let add = m.registry.register("test.dll", "Add2", h_add2);
    let exit = m.registry.register("test.dll", "Exit", h_exit);
    load(&mut m, CODE, |a| {
        a.push(30).unwrap();
        a.push(12).unwrap();
        a.mov(ecx, add).unwrap();
        a.call(ecx).unwrap();
        a.push(eax).unwrap();
        a.mov(ecx, exit).unwrap();
        a.call(ecx).unwrap();
    });
    m.create_thread(CODE, 0, 0x1_0000, false).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(run_to_stop(&mut m), StopReason::Exited(42));
    assert_eq!(m.registry.entry(add).unwrap().calls, 1);
}

#[test]
fn unimplemented_stops_with_name() {
    let mut m = machine();
    let f = m.registry.resolve_import("KERNEL32.dll", "GetVersion");
    load(&mut m, CODE, |a| {
        a.mov(ecx, f).unwrap();
        a.call(ecx).unwrap();
    });
    m.create_thread(CODE, 0, 0x1_0000, false).unwrap();
    match run_to_stop(&mut m) {
        StopReason::Unimplemented(s) => assert!(s.contains("UNIMPLEMENTED kernel32.dll!GetVersion"), "{s}"),
        r => panic!("{r:?}"),

fn h_callback(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    // Calls the guest function passed as arg 0 with (arg1) and returns its result + 1.
    let f = m.arg_u32(0);
    let x = m.arg_u32(1);
    let r = m.call_guest(f, &[x]);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(r + 1, 2)
}

#[test]
fn call_guest_nested() {
    let mut m = machine();
    let cb = m.registry.register("test.dll", "Callback", h_callback);
    let exit = m.registry.register("test.dll", "Exit", h_exit);
    let func = CODE + 0x100;
    // func(x) (stdcall): returns x*2, clobbers ebx (must be restored by call_guest).
    load(&mut m, func, |a| {
        a.mov(eax, dword_ptr(esp + 4)).unwrap();
        a.add(eax, eax).unwrap();
        a.mov(ebx, 0xBAD).unwrap();
        a.ret_1(4).unwrap();
    });
    load(&mut m, CODE, |a| {
        a.mov(ebx, 7).unwrap();
        a.push(20).unwrap();
        a.push(func).unwrap();
        a.mov(ecx, cb).unwrap();
        a.call(ecx).unwrap(); // 41
        a.add(eax, ebx).unwrap(); // + 7 = 48
        a.push(eax).unwrap();
        a.mov(ecx, exit).unwrap();
        a.call(ecx).unwrap();
    });
    m.create_thread(CODE, 0, 0x1_0000, false).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(run_to_stop(&mut m), StopReason::Exited(48));
}

// Blocking wait on an event that another thread sets.
fn h_wait(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let h = m.arg_u32(0);
    if m.try_acquire(h) {
        ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 1)
    } else {
        ThunkResult::Block
    }
}

fn h_set(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let h = m.arg_u32(0);
    if let Some(KernelObject::Event { signaled, .. }) = m.handles.get_mut(h) {
        *signaled = true;
    }
    ThunkResult::stdcall(1, 1)
}

#[test]
fn threads_block_and_wake() {
    let mut m = machine();
    let wait = m.registry.register("test.dll", "Wait", h_wait);
    let set = m.registry.register("test.dll", "Set", h_set);
    let exit = m.registry.register("test.dll", "Exit", h_exit);
    let ev = m.handles.insert(KernelObject::Event { manual_reset: false, signaled: false });
    let data = 0x0048_0000;
    // Thread A: wait(ev); exit([data])
    load(&mut m, CODE, |a| {
        a.push(ev).unwrap();
        a.mov(ecx, wait).unwrap();
        a.call(ecx).unwrap();
        a.push(dword_ptr(data)).unwrap();
        a.mov(ecx, exit).unwrap();
        a.call(ecx).unwrap();
    });
    // Thread B (param = value): spin a while, store value, set(ev), return 0 (thread exit)
    let b = CODE + 0x200;
    load(&mut m, b, |a| {
        let mut l = a.create_label();
        a.mov(ecx, 300_000).unwrap();
        a.set_label(&mut l).unwrap();
        a.dec(ecx).unwrap();
        a.jnz(l).unwrap();
        a.mov(eax, dword_ptr(esp + 4)).unwrap();
        a.mov(dword_ptr(data), eax).unwrap();
        a.push(ev).unwrap();
        a.mov(ecx, set).unwrap();
        a.call(ecx).unwrap();
        a.xor(eax, eax).unwrap();
        a.ret_1(4).unwrap();
    });
    m.create_thread(CODE, 0, 0x1_0000, false).unwrap();
    m.create_thread(b, 77, 0x1_0000, false).unwrap();
    m.quantum = 10_000;
    assert_eq!(run_to_stop(&mut m), StopReason::Exited(77));
    assert!(matches!(m.threads[1].state, ThreadState::Exited(0)));
    assert_eq!(m.is_signaled(m.threads[1].handle), Some(true));
}

#[test]
fn seh_handler_resumes_after_divide_error() {
    let mut m = machine();
    let exit = m.registry.register("test.dll", "Exit", h_exit);
    let handler = CODE + 0x300;
    // handler(rec, frame, ctx, disp): ctx->Eip += 2; ctx->Ecx = 5; return ExceptionContinueExecution
    load(&mut m, handler, |a| {
        a.mov(eax, dword_ptr(esp + 12)).unwrap();
        a.add(dword_ptr(eax + 0xB8), 2).unwrap();
        a.mov(dword_ptr(eax + 0xAC), 5).unwrap();
        a.xor(eax, eax).unwrap();
        a.ret().unwrap();
    });
    load(&mut m, CODE, |a| {
        a.push(handler).unwrap();
        a.push(dword_ptr(0).fs()).unwrap();
        a.mov(dword_ptr(0).fs(), esp).unwrap();
        a.xor(ecx, ecx).unwrap();
        a.div(ecx).unwrap(); // 2 bytes: f7 f1
        a.pop(dword_ptr(0).fs()).unwrap();
        a.add(esp, 4).unwrap();
        a.push(ecx).unwrap();
        a.mov(ecx, exit).unwrap();
        a.call(ecx).unwrap();
    });
    m.create_thread(CODE, 0, 0x1_0000, false).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(run_to_stop(&mut m), StopReason::Exited(5));
    assert_eq!(m.stats.exceptions, 1);
}

#[test]
fn teb_and_args_and_state() {
    let mut m = machine();
    load(&mut m, CODE, |a| {
        a.nop().unwrap();
    });
    let slot = m.create_thread(CODE, 0x55, 0x1_0000, false).unwrap();
    m.cur = slot;
    let t = &m.threads[slot];
    assert_eq!(m.mem.read_u32(t.teb + 0x18), t.teb);
    assert_eq!(m.mem.read_u32(t.teb + 0x30), layout::PEB_ADDR);
    assert_eq!(m.mem.read_u32(t.teb), 0xFFFF_FFFF);
    assert_eq!(t.cpu.fs_base, t.teb);
    // At entry: [esp] = thread_exit thunk, [esp+4] = param.
    assert_eq!(m.arg_u32(0), 0x55);
    m.set_last_error(123);
    assert_eq!(m.last_error(), 123);
    assert_eq!(m.mem.read_cstr(m.process.cmdline_a), "TEST.EXE");
    assert_eq!(m.process.module_path, "C:\\S3\\TEST.EXE");
    #[derive(Default)]
    struct Counter(u32);
    m.state::<Counter>().borrow_mut().0 += 2;
    assert_eq!(m.state::<Counter>().borrow_mut().0, 2);
    let _ = (EAX, EBX, ESP);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- multi-core mode

/// Set when a present ran on the draw worker (multi-core test).
static MT_PRESENT_OFFLOADED: std::sync::atomic::AtomicBool = std::sync::atomic::AtomicBool::new(false);

fn h_wait1(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let h = m.arg_u32(0);
    match m.poll_wait(&[h], false, 0xFFFF_FFFF) {
        WaitPoll::Ready(_) => ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 1),
        WaitPoll::Pending => ThunkResult::Block,
        _ => ThunkResult::Error("wait failed".into()),
    }
}

fn h_set1(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let h = m.arg_u32(0);
    if let Some(KernelObject::Event { signaled, .. }) = m.handles.get_mut(h) {
        *signaled = true;
    }
    ThunkResult::stdcall(1, 1)
}

fn h_present(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    if m.threads[m.cur].offloaded {
        MT_PRESENT_OFFLOADED.store(true, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::SeqCst);
    }
    let fb = FrameBuffer { width: 4, height: 2, pixels: vec![m.mem.read_u32(0x48_0004) as u16; 8] };
    let _back = m.present_owned(fb);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 0)
}

/// The game's draw/logic pipeline in miniature: thread 1 ("draw") waits for event A, does some work, presents,
/// counts, sets B; thread 0 ("logic") waits for B, counts, sets A. Returns (draw count, logic count, presents,
/// draw work sum).
fn pipeline(mt: bool, frames: u32) -> (u32, u32, u64, u32) {
    let mut m = machine();
    let wait = m.registry.register("test.dll", "Wait", h_wait1);
    let set = m.registry.register("test.dll", "Set", h_set1);
    let present = m.registry.register("test.dll", "Present", h_present);
    let exit = m.registry.register("test.dll", "Exit", h_exit);
    let ev_a = m.handles.insert(KernelObject::Event { manual_reset: false, signaled: true });
    let ev_b = m.handles.insert(KernelObject::Event { manual_reset: false, signaled: false });
    // logic (slot 0)
    load(&mut m, CODE, |a| {
        let mut top = a.create_label();
        a.set_label(&mut top).unwrap();
        a.push(ev_b).unwrap();
        a.mov(ecx, wait).unwrap();
        a.call(ecx).unwrap();
        a.inc(dword_ptr(0x48_0000)).unwrap();
        a.push(ev_a).unwrap();
        a.mov(ecx, set).unwrap();
        a.call(ecx).unwrap();
        a.jmp(top).unwrap();
    });
    // draw (slot 1): some guest work per frame (more than one quantum), then present
    load(&mut m, CODE + 0x200, |a| {
        let mut top = a.create_label();
        let mut work = a.create_label();
        a.mov(esi, frames).unwrap();
        a.set_label(&mut top).unwrap();
        a.push(ev_a).unwrap();
        a.mov(ecx, wait).unwrap();
        a.call(ecx).unwrap();
        a.mov(edx, 150_000u32).unwrap();
        a.set_label(&mut work).unwrap();
        a.add(dword_ptr(0x48_0008), edx).unwrap();
        a.dec(edx).unwrap();
        a.jnz(work).unwrap();
        a.mov(ecx, present).unwrap();
        a.call(ecx).unwrap();
        a.inc(dword_ptr(0x48_0004)).unwrap();
        a.push(ev_b).unwrap();
        a.mov(ecx, set).unwrap();
        a.call(ecx).unwrap();
        a.dec(esi).unwrap();
        a.jnz(top).unwrap();
        a.push(7).unwrap();
        a.mov(ecx, exit).unwrap();
        a.call(ecx).unwrap();
    });
    m.create_thread(CODE, 0, 0x1_0000, false).unwrap();
    m.create_thread(CODE + 0x200, 0, 0x1_0000, false).unwrap();
    if mt {
        m.enable_mt();
    }
    let start = std::time::Instant::now();
    loop {
        match m.run_slice(1_000_000) {
            SliceResult::Stopped => break,
            SliceResult::Idle => m.idle(1),
            SliceResult::Ran(_) => {}
        }
        assert!(start.elapsed().as_secs() < 120, "pipeline did not finish");
    }
    assert_eq!(m.stop_reason(), Some(&StopReason::Exited(7)));
    let r = (m.mem.read_u32(0x48_0004), m.mem.read_u32(0x48_0000), m.stats.presents, m.mem.read_u32(0x48_0008));
    drop(m); // joins the worker
    r
}

#[test]
fn mt_pipeline_matches_single_thread() {
    let st = pipeline(false, 120);
    assert_eq!(st.0, 120);
    assert!(st.1 >= 119, "{st:?}");
    MT_PRESENT_OFFLOADED.store(false, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::SeqCst);
    let mt = pipeline(true, 120);
    assert!(MT_PRESENT_OFFLOADED.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::SeqCst), "draw thread was never offloaded");
    assert_eq!(mt.0, 120, "{mt:?}");
    assert!(mt.1 >= 119, "{mt:?}");
    assert_eq!(mt.2, 120);
    assert_eq!(mt.3, st.3, "guest work of the offloaded thread differs");
}

```

`port/crates/s3-runtime/src/vfs.rs`:

```rs
//! Guest path -> host path mapping.
//!
//! - Guest paths are case-insensitive, use `\` or `/`, may carry a drive letter and may be relative to the guest
//!   current directory.
//! - The guest sees the game installed at [`GUEST_GAME_DIR`] (`C:\S3`). Any absolute path under it, and any other
//!   drive root (CD paths like `D:\GFX\...`), maps onto the host `game_dir`.
//! - Writes go to an overlay in `data_dir/overlay/` mirroring the guest-relative path; reads check the overlay
//!   first, then the game dir. The game dir is never modified.
//! - Deleting / renaming a file that exists only in the game dir records a *whiteout* (persisted in
//!   `data_dir/overlay-whiteouts.txt`): the game-dir copy is hidden from then on.

use std::collections::BTreeSet;
use std::fs;
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};

/// Where the guest believes the game is installed (no trailing backslash).
pub const GUEST_GAME_DIR: &str = "C:\\S3";

/// The mapping.
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Vfs {
    pub game_dir: PathBuf,
    pub data_dir: PathBuf,
    /// Guest current directory, absolute, e.g. `C:\S3`.
    pub cwd: String,
    /// Lower-case game-relative paths (`gfx\x.dat`) hidden from the game dir (deleted/renamed by the guest).
    pub whiteouts: BTreeSet<String>,
}

/// Win32 error codes returned by the VFS file operations.
pub mod err {
    pub const FILE_NOT_FOUND: u32 = 2;
    pub const PATH_NOT_FOUND: u32 = 3;
    pub const ACCESS_DENIED: u32 = 5;
    pub const FILE_EXISTS: u32 = 80;
    pub const DIR_NOT_EMPTY: u32 = 145;
    pub const ALREADY_EXISTS: u32 = 183;
}

/// A directory entry from [`Vfs::list_dir`].
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct DirEntry {
    /// Name as found on disk.
    pub name: String,
    pub is_dir: bool,
    pub size: u64,
    pub host_path: PathBuf,
}

impl Vfs {
    pub fn new(game_dir: PathBuf, data_dir: PathBuf) -> Self {
        let mut whiteouts = BTreeSet::new();
        if let Ok(t) = fs::read_to_string(data_dir.join("overlay-whiteouts.txt")) {
            whiteouts.extend(t.lines().filter(|l| !l.is_empty()).map(|l| l.to_string()));
        }
        Vfs { game_dir, data_dir, cwd: GUEST_GAME_DIR.to_string(), whiteouts }
    }

    fn key(parts: &[String]) -> String {
        parts.join("\\").to_ascii_lowercase()
    }

    /// Is the game-dir copy of `parts` (or one of its parent directories) hidden?
    pub fn is_whited_out(&self, parts: &[String]) -> bool {
        (1..=parts.len()).any(|n| self.whiteouts.contains(&Self::key(&parts[..n])))
    }

    fn save_whiteouts(&self) {
        let _ = fs::create_dir_all(&self.data_dir);
        let t: String = self.whiteouts.iter().map(|w| format!("{w}\n")).collect();
        let _ = fs::write(self.data_dir.join("overlay-whiteouts.txt"), t);
    }

    fn set_whiteout(&mut self, parts: &[String], on: bool) {
        let k = Self::key(parts);
        let changed = if on { self.whiteouts.insert(k) } else { self.whiteouts.remove(&k) };
        if changed {
            self.save_whiteouts();
        }
    }

    /// Game-dir path of `parts` unless whited out.
    fn game_lookup(&self, parts: &[String]) -> Option<PathBuf> {
        if self.is_whited_out(parts) {
            return None;
        }
        Self::lookup_ci(&self.game_dir, parts)
    }

    /// Overlay root for written files.
    pub fn overlay_dir(&self) -> PathBuf {
        self.data_dir.join("overlay")
    }

    /// Normalize a guest path to components relative to the game root (`..` and `.` resolved).
    /// `"C:\\S3\\Gfx\\x.dat"` -> `["Gfx", "x.dat"]`; relative paths are resolved against `cwd`.
    pub fn components(&self, guest: &str) -> Vec<String> {
        let p = guest.replace('/', "\\");
        let abs = if p.len() >= 2 && p.as_bytes()[1] == b':' {
            p
        } else if p.starts_with('\\') {
            format!("{}{}", &self.cwd[..2.min(self.cwd.len())], p)
        } else {
            format!("{}\\{}", self.cwd, p)
        };
        // Strip the drive letter.
        let rest = &abs[2..];
        let mut parts: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
        for c in rest.split('\\') {
            match c {
                "" | "." => {}
                ".." => {
                    parts.pop();
                }
                c => parts.push(c.to_string()),
            }
        }
        // Strip the guest install dir prefix (C:\S3\...) when present.
        let prefix: Vec<&str> = GUEST_GAME_DIR[3..].split('\\').collect();
        let drive_c = abs[..1].eq_ignore_ascii_case("c");
        if drive_c
            && parts.len() >= prefix.len()
            && parts.iter().zip(prefix.iter()).all(|(a, b)| a.eq_ignore_ascii_case(b))
        {
            parts.drain(..prefix.len());
        }
        parts
    }

    /// Absolute guest path for components (inverse of [`Vfs::components`]).
    pub fn guest_path(parts: &[String]) -> String {
        let mut s = GUEST_GAME_DIR.to_string();
        for p in parts {
            s.push('\\');
            s.push_str(p);
        }
        s
    }

    /// Case-insensitive lookup of `parts` under `root`. Returns the existing host path.
    pub fn lookup_ci(root: &Path, parts: &[String]) -> Option<PathBuf> {
        let mut cur = root.to_path_buf();
        for part in parts {
            let exact = cur.join(part);
            if exact.exists() {
                cur = exact;
                continue;
            }
            let rd = fs::read_dir(&cur).ok()?;
            let mut found = None;
            for e in rd.flatten() {
                if e.file_name().to_string_lossy().eq_ignore_ascii_case(part) {
                    found = Some(e.path());
                    break;
                }
            }
            cur = found?;
        }
        Some(cur)
    }

    /// Host path to read `guest` from (overlay first, then game dir). None if it does not exist.
    pub fn resolve_read(&self, guest: &str) -> Option<PathBuf> {
        let parts = self.components(guest);
        Self::lookup_ci(&self.overlay_dir(), &parts).or_else(|| self.game_lookup(&parts))
    }

    /// Does `guest` exist in the overlay (as opposed to only in the game dir)?
    pub fn in_overlay(&self, guest: &str) -> bool {
        Self::lookup_ci(&self.overlay_dir(), &self.components(guest)).is_some()
    }

    /// `DeleteFileA`. Overlay copies are removed; a game-dir file is hidden with a whiteout.
    pub fn remove_file(&mut self, guest: &str) -> Result<(), u32> {
        let parts = self.components(guest);
        let ov = Self::lookup_ci(&self.overlay_dir(), &parts);
        let game = self.game_lookup(&parts);
        if ov.is_none() && game.is_none() {
            return Err(err::FILE_NOT_FOUND);
        }
        if ov.as_ref().or(game.as_ref()).map(|p| p.is_dir()).unwrap_or(false) {
            return Err(err::ACCESS_DENIED);
        }
        if let Some(p) = ov {
            fs::remove_file(p).map_err(|_| err::ACCESS_DENIED)?;
        }
        if game.is_some() {
            self.set_whiteout(&parts, true);
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    /// `MoveFileA` (files; directories only when they live in the overlay alone).
    pub fn rename(&mut self, src: &str, dst: &str) -> Result<(), u32> {
        if self.resolve_read(dst).is_some() {
            return Err(err::ALREADY_EXISTS);
        }
        let sparts = self.components(src);
        let ov = Self::lookup_ci(&self.overlay_dir(), &sparts);
        let game = self.game_lookup(&sparts);
        let Some(from) = ov.clone().or(game.clone()) else { return Err(err::FILE_NOT_FOUND) };
        if from.is_dir() && game.is_some() {
            return Err(err::ACCESS_DENIED);
        }
        let to = self.resolve_write(dst).map_err(|_| err::PATH_NOT_FOUND)?;
        if ov.is_some() {
            fs::rename(&from, &to).map_err(|_| err::ACCESS_DENIED)?;
        } else {
            fs::copy(&from, &to).map_err(|_| err::ACCESS_DENIED)?;
        }
        if game.is_some() {
            self.set_whiteout(&sparts, true);
        }
        let dparts = self.components(dst);
        self.set_whiteout(&dparts, false);
        Ok(())
    }

    /// `CopyFileA`.
    pub fn copy(&mut self, src: &str, dst: &str, fail_if_exists: bool) -> Result<(), u32> {
        let from = self.resolve_read(src).ok_or(err::FILE_NOT_FOUND)?;
        if from.is_dir() {
            return Err(err::ACCESS_DENIED);
        }
        if fail_if_exists && self.resolve_read(dst).is_some() {
            return Err(err::FILE_EXISTS);
        }
        let to = self.resolve_write(dst).map_err(|_| err::PATH_NOT_FOUND)?;
        fs::copy(&from, &to).map_err(|_| err::ACCESS_DENIED)?;
        let dparts = self.components(dst);
        self.set_whiteout(&dparts, false);
        Ok(())
    }

    /// `CreateDirectoryA` (in the overlay).
    pub fn create_dir(&mut self, guest: &str) -> Result<(), u32> {
        if self.resolve_read(guest).is_some() {
            return Err(err::ALREADY_EXISTS);
        }
        let parts = self.components(guest);
        if parts.is_empty() {
            return Err(err::ALREADY_EXISTS);
        }
        let parent = Self::guest_path(&parts[..parts.len() - 1]);
        if !parts[..parts.len() - 1].is_empty() && !self.is_dir(&parent) {
            return Err(err::PATH_NOT_FOUND);
        }
        let p = self.resolve_write(guest).map_err(|_| err::PATH_NOT_FOUND)?;
        fs::create_dir_all(p).map_err(|_| err::ACCESS_DENIED)?;
        self.set_whiteout(&parts, false);
        Ok(())
    }

    /// `RemoveDirectoryA` (must be empty as seen by the guest).
    pub fn remove_dir(&mut self, guest: &str) -> Result<(), u32> {
        if !self.is_dir(guest) {
            return Err(err::PATH_NOT_FOUND);
        }
        if !self.list_dir(guest).is_empty() {
            return Err(err::DIR_NOT_EMPTY);
        }
        let parts = self.components(guest);
        if let Some(p) = Self::lookup_ci(&self.overlay_dir(), &parts) {
            let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(p);
        }
        if Self::lookup_ci(&self.game_dir, &parts).is_some() {
            self.set_whiteout(&parts, true);
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    /// Host path to write `guest` to (in the overlay). Parent directories are created. Existing overlay
    /// entries are matched case-insensitively so the same file is not duplicated with different case.
    pub fn resolve_write(&self, guest: &str) -> std::io::Result<PathBuf> {
        let parts = self.components(guest);
        let mut cur = self.overlay_dir();
        fs::create_dir_all(&cur)?;
        for (i, part) in parts.iter().enumerate() {
            let last = i + 1 == parts.len();
            let next = Self::lookup_ci(&cur, std::slice::from_ref(part)).unwrap_or_else(|| cur.join(part));
            if !last && !next.exists() {
                fs::create_dir_all(&next)?;
            }
            cur = next;
        }
        Ok(cur)
    }

    /// Like [`Vfs::resolve_write`] for a file being created/truncated: also drops a whiteout on that path.
    pub fn create_path(&mut self, guest: &str) -> std::io::Result<PathBuf> {
        let p = self.resolve_write(guest)?;
        let parts = self.components(guest);
        self.set_whiteout(&parts, false);
        Ok(p)
    }

    /// Copy a game-dir file into the overlay (for read/write opens of existing files). Returns the overlay path.
    pub fn copy_up(&self, guest: &str) -> std::io::Result<PathBuf> {
        let dst = self.resolve_write(guest)?;
        if !dst.exists() {
            if let Some(src) = self.game_lookup(&self.components(guest)) {
                if src.is_file() {
                    fs::copy(&src, &dst)?;
                }
            }
        }
        Ok(dst)
    }

    /// Is `guest` a directory (in overlay or game dir)?
    pub fn is_dir(&self, guest: &str) -> bool {
        self.resolve_read(guest).map(|p| p.is_dir()).unwrap_or(false)
    }

    /// Merged listing of a guest directory (overlay wins on name clashes, compared case-insensitively).
    pub fn list_dir(&self, guest_dir: &str) -> Vec<DirEntry> {
        let parts = self.components(guest_dir);
        let mut out: Vec<DirEntry> = Vec::new();
        for (gi, root) in [self.overlay_dir(), self.game_dir.clone()].into_iter().enumerate() {
            if gi == 1 && self.is_whited_out(&parts) {
                continue;
            }
            let Some(dir) = Self::lookup_ci(&root, &parts) else { continue };
            let Ok(rd) = fs::read_dir(&dir) else { continue };
            for e in rd.flatten() {
                let name = e.file_name().to_string_lossy().to_string();
                if out.iter().any(|d| d.name.eq_ignore_ascii_case(&name)) {
                    continue;
                }
                if gi == 1 {
                    let mut p = parts.clone();
                    p.push(name.clone());
                    if self.whiteouts.contains(&Self::key(&p)) {
                        continue;
                    }
                }
                let md = e.metadata().ok();
                out.push(DirEntry {
                    name,
                    is_dir: md.as_ref().map(|m| m.is_dir()).unwrap_or(false),
                    size: md.map(|m| m.len()).unwrap_or(0),
                    host_path: e.path(),
                });
            }
        }
        out.sort_by(|a, b| a.name.to_ascii_lowercase().cmp(&b.name.to_ascii_lowercase()));
        out
    }

    /// Set the guest current directory (`SetCurrentDirectoryA`). Returns false if it does not exist.
    pub fn set_cwd(&mut self, guest: &str) -> bool {
        let parts = self.components(guest);
        let exists = parts.is_empty()
            || Self::lookup_ci(&self.overlay_dir(), &parts).map(|p| p.is_dir()).unwrap_or(false)
            || self.game_lookup(&parts).map(|p| p.is_dir()).unwrap_or(false);
        if exists {
            self.cwd = Self::guest_path(&parts);
        }
        exists
    }
}

/// Simple DOS wildcard match (`*`, `?`), case-insensitive. `*.*` matches names without a dot too.
pub fn wildcard_match(pattern: &str, name: &str) -> bool {
    if pattern == "*.*" || pattern == "*" {
        return true;
    }
    let p: Vec<char> = pattern.to_ascii_lowercase().chars().collect();
    let n: Vec<char> = name.to_ascii_lowercase().chars().collect();
    fn rec(p: &[char], n: &[char]) -> bool {
        match (p.first(), n.first()) {
            (None, None) => true,
            (Some('*'), _) => rec(&p[1..], n) || (!n.is_empty() && rec(p, &n[1..])),
            (Some('?'), Some(_)) => rec(&p[1..], &n[1..]),
            (Some(a), Some(b)) if a == b => rec(&p[1..], &n[1..]),
            _ => false,
        }
    }
    rec(&p, &n)
}
```

`port/crates/s3-win32/src/advapi32.rs`:

```rs
//! `advapi32.dll` HLE. Registry backed by JSON in data_dir (see `registry_store.rs` for the load order and the
//! `SingleNumber` rule), plus `GetUserNameA`.
//!
//! `NAMES` lists every function we know the game can reach; all are declared (calling one without a handler
//! stops the machine with `UNIMPLEMENTED advapi32.dll!Name`).

use s3_runtime::{KernelObject, LogLevel, Machine, Registry, ThunkResult};

use crate::registry_store::{root_name, split_path, RegStore, RegValue, GENERAL_KEY, REG_SZ};

/// DLL name as registered.
pub const DLL: &str = "advapi32.dll";

/// Known exports (static imports of S3.EXE first).
pub const NAMES: &[&str] = &[
    "RegQueryInfoKeyA", "RegSetValueExA", "RegCloseKey", "GetUserNameA", "RegCreateKeyExA",
    "RegDeleteKeyA", "RegOpenKeyExA", "RegEnumKeyExA", "RegEnumValueA", "RegQueryValueExA",
    "RegOpenKeyA", "RegCreateKeyA", "RegSetValueA", "RegQueryValueA", "RegDeleteValueA",
    "RegFlushKey",
];

const ERROR_SUCCESS: u32 = 0;
const ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND: u32 = 2;
const ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE: u32 = 6;
const ERROR_MORE_DATA: u32 = 234;
const ERROR_NO_MORE_ITEMS: u32 = 259;

/// Declare all names and register implemented handlers.
pub fn register(reg: &mut Registry) {
    reg.declare_all(DLL, NAMES);
    reg.register(DLL, "RegOpenKeyExA", reg_open_key_ex_a);
    reg.register(DLL, "RegOpenKeyA", reg_open_key_a);
    reg.register(DLL, "RegCreateKeyExA", reg_create_key_ex_a);
    reg.register(DLL, "RegCreateKeyA", reg_create_key_a);
    reg.register(DLL, "RegCloseKey", reg_close_key);
    reg.register(DLL, "RegQueryValueExA", reg_query_value_ex_a);
    reg.register(DLL, "RegSetValueExA", reg_set_value_ex_a);
    reg.register(DLL, "RegQueryValueA", reg_query_value_a);
    reg.register(DLL, "RegSetValueA", reg_set_value_a);
    reg.register(DLL, "RegDeleteKeyA", reg_delete_key_a);
    reg.register(DLL, "RegDeleteValueA", reg_delete_value_a);
    reg.register(DLL, "RegQueryInfoKeyA", reg_query_info_key_a);
    reg.register(DLL, "RegEnumKeyExA", reg_enum_key_ex_a);
    reg.register(DLL, "RegEnumValueA", reg_enum_value_a);
    reg.register(DLL, "RegFlushKey", reg_flush_key);
    reg.register(DLL, "GetUserNameA", get_user_name_a);
}

#[derive(Default)]
struct AdvState {
    store: Option<RegStore>,
}

/// An open key handle (in the kernel handle table).
struct KeyHandle(Vec<String>);

/// Run `f` on the (lazily loaded) registry store.
pub fn with_store<R>(m: &mut Machine, f: impl FnOnce(&mut RegStore) -> R) -> R {
    let st = m.state::<AdvState>();
    let mut g = st.borrow_mut();
    if g.store.is_none() {
        let (s, notes) = RegStore::load(&m.host.game_dir(), &m.host.data_dir(), s3_runtime::GUEST_GAME_DIR);
        for n in notes {
            m.log(LogLevel::Info, &n);
        }
        g.store = Some(s);
    }
    f(g.store.as_mut().unwrap())
}

fn save(m: &mut Machine) {
    let dd = m.host.data_dir();
    if let Err(e) = with_store(m, |s| s.save(&dd)) {
        m.log(LogLevel::Warn, &format!("registry: save failed: {e}"));
    }
}

/// Path of an HKEY (predefined root or open handle).
fn key_path(m: &Machine, hkey: u32) -> Option<Vec<String>> {
    if let Some(r) = root_name(hkey) {
        return Some(vec![r.to_string()]);
    }
    m.handles.get_other::<KeyHandle>(hkey).map(|k| k.0.clone())
}

fn sub_path(m: &Machine, hkey: u32, sub: Option<String>) -> Option<Vec<String>> {
    let mut p = key_path(m, hkey)?;
    if let Some(s) = sub {
        let extra = split_path(&format!("X\\{s}"));
        p.extend(extra.into_iter().skip(1));
        // Re-run the Wow6432Node folding on the full path.
        p = split_path(&p.join("\\"));
    }
    Some(p)
}

fn open_handle(m: &mut Machine, path: Vec<String>) -> u32 {
    m.handles.insert(KernelObject::Other("regkey", Box::new(KeyHandle(path))))
}

fn open_common(m: &mut Machine, hkey: u32, sub: Option<String>, out: u32, create: bool) -> (u32, u32) {
    let Some(path) = sub_path(m, hkey, sub) else { return (ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE, 0) };
    let disp;
    if create {
        let created = with_store(m, |s| s.create_key(&path));
        disp = if created { 1 } else { 2 };
        if created {
            save(m);
        }
    } else {
        if !with_store(m, |s| s.key(&path).is_some()) {
            m.log(LogLevel::Debug, &format!("RegOpenKey {} -> not found", path.join("\\")));
            if out != 0 {
                m.mem.write_u32(out, 0);
            }
            return (ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND, 0);
        }
        disp = 2;
    }
    let h = open_handle(m, path);
    if out != 0 {
        m.mem.write_u32(out, h);
    }
    (ERROR_SUCCESS, disp)
}

/// RegOpenKeyExA(hKey, lpSubKey, ulOptions, samDesired, phkResult)
fn reg_open_key_ex_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (hkey, sub, out) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_str(1), m.arg_u32(4));
    ThunkResult::stdcall(open_common(m, hkey, sub, out, false).0, 5)
}

/// RegOpenKeyA(hKey, lpSubKey, phkResult)
fn reg_open_key_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (hkey, sub, out) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_str(1), m.arg_u32(2));
    ThunkResult::stdcall(open_common(m, hkey, sub, out, false).0, 3)
}

/// RegCreateKeyExA(hKey, lpSubKey, Reserved, lpClass, dwOptions, samDesired, lpSA, phkResult, lpdwDisposition)
fn reg_create_key_ex_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (hkey, sub, out, disp) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_str(1), m.arg_u32(7), m.arg_u32(8));
    let (r, d) = open_common(m, hkey, sub, out, true);
    if r == 0 && disp != 0 {
        m.mem.write_u32(disp, d);
    }
    ThunkResult::stdcall(r, 9)
}

/// RegCreateKeyA(hKey, lpSubKey, phkResult)
fn reg_create_key_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (hkey, sub, out) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_str(1), m.arg_u32(2));
    ThunkResult::stdcall(open_common(m, hkey, sub, out, true).0, 3)
}

fn reg_close_key(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let h = m.arg_u32(0);
    if root_name(h).is_some() {
        return ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 1);
    }
    let r = if m.handles.get_other::<KeyHandle>(h).is_some() {
        let _ = m.handles.close(h);
        0
    } else {
        ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE
    };
    ThunkResult::stdcall(r, 1)
}

/// Copy a value out with the usual size protocol. Returns the error code.
fn write_value_out(m: &mut Machine, v: &RegValue, lp_type: u32, lp_data: u32, lpcb: u32) -> u32 {
    if lp_type != 0 {
        m.mem.write_u32(lp_type, v.kind);
    }
    let need = v.data.len() as u32;
    if lpcb == 0 {
        return if lp_data == 0 { 0 } else { 87 }; // ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER
    }
    let have = m.mem.read_u32(lpcb);
    m.mem.write_u32(lpcb, need);
    if lp_data == 0 {
        return 0;
    }
    if have < need {
        return ERROR_MORE_DATA;
    }
    m.mem.write_bytes(lp_data, &v.data);
    0
}

/// RegQueryValueExA(hKey, lpValueName, lpReserved, lpType, lpData, lpcbData)
fn reg_query_value_ex_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (hkey, name) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_str(1).unwrap_or_default());
    let (lp_type, lp_data, lpcb) = (m.arg_u32(3), m.arg_u32(4), m.arg_u32(5));
    let Some(path) = key_path(m, hkey) else { return ThunkResult::stdcall(ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE, 6) };
    let v = with_store(m, |s| s.get_value(&path, &name).cloned());
    let r = match v {
        Some(v) => write_value_out(m, &v, lp_type, lp_data, lpcb),
        None => {
            m.log(LogLevel::Debug, &format!("RegQueryValueEx {}\\{name} -> not found", path.join("\\")));
            ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND
        }
    };
    ThunkResult::stdcall(r, 6)
}

fn is_general(path: &[String]) -> bool {
    let g = split_path(GENERAL_KEY);
    path.len() == g.len() && path.iter().zip(g.iter()).all(|(a, b)| a.eq_ignore_ascii_case(b))
}

fn set_value(m: &mut Machine, path: Vec<String>, v: RegValue) {
    if v.name.eq_ignore_ascii_case("SingleNumber") && is_general(&path) {
        let exists = with_store(m, |s| s.get_value(&path, "SingleNumber").is_some());
        if exists {
            m.log(LogLevel::Info, "registry: ignoring (encrypted) rewrite of SingleNumber, keeping the plain value");
            return;
        }
    }
    m.log(LogLevel::Debug, &format!("RegSetValue {}\\{} type {} len {}", path.join("\\"), v.name, v.kind, v.data.len()));
    with_store(m, |s| s.set_value(&path, v));
    save(m);
}

/// RegSetValueExA(hKey, lpValueName, Reserved, dwType, lpData, cbData)
fn reg_set_value_ex_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (hkey, name) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_str(1).unwrap_or_default());
    let (kind, data, cb) = (m.arg_u32(3), m.arg_u32(4), m.arg_u32(5));
    let Some(path) = key_path(m, hkey) else { return ThunkResult::stdcall(ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE, 6) };
    let bytes = if data == 0 { Vec::new() } else { m.mem.read_bytes(data, cb.min(1 << 20) as usize) };
    set_value(m, path, RegValue { name, kind, data: bytes });
    ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 6)
}

/// RegQueryValueA(hKey, lpSubKey, lpValue, lpcbValue): default value of a subkey (string).
fn reg_query_value_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (hkey, sub, data, lpcb) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_str(1), m.arg_u32(2), m.arg_u32(3));
    let Some(path) = sub_path(m, hkey, sub) else { return ThunkResult::stdcall(ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE, 4) };
    let r = match with_store(m, |s| s.key(&path).map(|k| k.values.get("").cloned())) {
        None => ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND,
        Some(v) => {
            let v = v.unwrap_or_else(|| RegValue::sz("", ""));
            write_value_out(m, &v, 0, data, lpcb)
        }
    };
    ThunkResult::stdcall(r, 4)
}

/// RegSetValueA(hKey, lpSubKey, dwType, lpData, cbData)
fn reg_set_value_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (hkey, sub, data) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_str(1), m.arg_u32(3));
    let Some(path) = sub_path(m, hkey, sub) else { return ThunkResult::stdcall(ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE, 5) };
    let s = if data == 0 { String::new() } else { m.mem.read_cstr(data) };
    set_value(m, path, RegValue::sz("", &s));
    ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 5)
}

fn reg_delete_key_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (hkey, sub) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_str(1));
    let Some(path) = sub_path(m, hkey, sub) else { return ThunkResult::stdcall(ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE, 2) };
    let ok = with_store(m, |s| s.delete_key(&path));
    save(m);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(if ok { 0 } else { ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND }, 2)
}

fn reg_delete_value_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (hkey, name) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_str(1).unwrap_or_default());
    let Some(path) = key_path(m, hkey) else { return ThunkResult::stdcall(ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE, 2) };
    let ok = with_store(m, |s| s.delete_value(&path, &name));
    save(m);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(if ok { 0 } else { ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND }, 2)
}

/// RegQueryInfoKeyA(hKey, lpClass, lpcClass, lpReserved, lpcSubKeys, lpcMaxSubKeyLen, lpcMaxClassLen,
/// lpcValues, lpcMaxValueNameLen, lpcMaxValueLen, lpcbSecurityDescriptor, lpftLastWriteTime)
fn reg_query_info_key_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let hkey = m.arg_u32(0);
    let Some(path) = key_path(m, hkey) else { return ThunkResult::stdcall(ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE, 12) };
    let info = with_store(m, |s| {
        s.key(&path).map(|k| {
            (
                k.subkeys.len() as u32,
                k.subkeys.values().map(|s| s.name.len()).max().unwrap_or(0) as u32,
                k.values.len() as u32,
                k.values.values().map(|v| v.name.len()).max().unwrap_or(0) as u32,
                k.values.values().map(|v| v.data.len()).max().unwrap_or(0) as u32,
            )
        })
    });
    let Some((nsub, maxsub, nval, maxname, maxval)) = info else { return ThunkResult::stdcall(ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND, 12) };
    let (cls, lpc_cls) = (m.arg_u32(1), m.arg_u32(2));
    if cls != 0 {
        m.mem.write_u8(cls, 0);
    }
    if lpc_cls != 0 {
        m.mem.write_u32(lpc_cls, 0);
    }
    for (i, v) in [(4, nsub), (5, maxsub), (6, 0), (7, nval), (8, maxname), (9, maxval), (10, 0)] {
        let p = m.arg_u32(i);
        if p != 0 {
            m.mem.write_u32(p, v);
        }
    }
    let ft = m.arg_u32(11);
    if ft != 0 {
        m.mem.write_u64(ft, 0x01D0_0000_0000_0000);
    }
    ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 12)
}

/// RegEnumKeyExA(hKey, dwIndex, lpName, lpcName, lpReserved, lpClass, lpcClass, lpftLastWriteTime)
fn reg_enum_key_ex_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (hkey, idx, name, lpc) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1), m.arg_u32(2), m.arg_u32(3));
    let Some(path) = key_path(m, hkey) else { return ThunkResult::stdcall(ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE, 8) };
    let n = with_store(m, |s| s.key(&path).and_then(|k| k.subkeys.values().nth(idx as usize).map(|s| s.name.clone())));
    let Some(n) = n else { return ThunkResult::stdcall(ERROR_NO_MORE_ITEMS, 8) };
    let have = if lpc != 0 { m.mem.read_u32(lpc) } else { 0 };
    if (n.len() as u32) + 1 > have {
        return ThunkResult::stdcall(ERROR_MORE_DATA, 8);
    }
    m.mem.write_cstr(name, &n);
    m.mem.write_u32(lpc, n.len() as u32);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 8)
}

/// RegEnumValueA(hKey, dwIndex, lpValueName, lpcValueName, lpReserved, lpType, lpData, lpcbData)
fn reg_enum_value_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (hkey, idx, name, lpc) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1), m.arg_u32(2), m.arg_u32(3));
    let (lp_type, lp_data, lpcb) = (m.arg_u32(5), m.arg_u32(6), m.arg_u32(7));
    let Some(path) = key_path(m, hkey) else { return ThunkResult::stdcall(ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE, 8) };
    let v = with_store(m, |s| s.key(&path).and_then(|k| k.values.values().nth(idx as usize).cloned()));
    let Some(v) = v else { return ThunkResult::stdcall(ERROR_NO_MORE_ITEMS, 8) };
    let have = if lpc != 0 { m.mem.read_u32(lpc) } else { 0 };
    if (v.name.len() as u32) + 1 > have {
        return ThunkResult::stdcall(ERROR_MORE_DATA, 8);
    }
    m.mem.write_cstr(name, &v.name);
    m.mem.write_u32(lpc, v.name.len() as u32);
    let r = write_value_out(m, &v, lp_type, lp_data, lpcb);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(r, 8)
}

fn reg_flush_key(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    save(m);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 1)
}

/// GetUserNameA(lpBuffer, pcbBuffer): the registry `Playername` (default "Player").
fn get_user_name_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (buf, pcb) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1));
    let g = split_path(GENERAL_KEY);
    let name = with_store(m, |s| s.get_value(&g, "Playername").filter(|v| v.kind == REG_SZ).map(|v| v.as_str()))
        .filter(|s| !s.is_empty())
        .unwrap_or_else(|| "Player".into());
    let have = if pcb != 0 { m.mem.read_u32(pcb) } else { 0 };
    let need = name.len() as u32 + 1;
    if pcb != 0 {
        m.mem.write_u32(pcb, need);
    }
    if buf == 0 || have < need {
        m.set_last_error(122); // ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_BUFFER
        return ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 2);
    }
    m.mem.write_cstr(buf, &name);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(1, 2)
}
```

`port/crates/s3-win32/src/audio_music.rs`:

```rs
//! CD-audio emulation for MCI `cdaudio`: track N plays `MUSIC\TrackNN.ogg` (the GOG `_inmm.dll` convention,
//! track 1 is the data track and has no file). Decoded with lewton (pure Rust Ogg Vorbis).
//!
//! Output: [`MusicPlayer::mix`] *adds* music into an interleaved i16 buffer at any rate/channel count (linear
//! resampling). By default winmm runs a scheduler service that queues music itself to `Host::queue_audio` at
//! 44100 Hz stereo, paced by the wall clock. If another mixer (DirectSound in s3-dx) owns the host audio stream,
//! it should call `winmm::set_external_music_mixer(m, true)` once and `winmm::mix_music(m, buf, rate, channels)`
//! for every block it produces, so there is only one producer for `queue_audio`.

use std::fs::File;
use std::io::{BufReader, Read, Seek, SeekFrom};
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};

use lewton::inside_ogg::OggStreamReader;

/// Default music volume (0..1). HYPOTHESIS: the real CD volume is set by the user in the Windows mixer.
pub const DEFAULT_MUSIC_VOLUME: f32 = 0.6;

/// A playing Ogg track.
pub struct Track {
    reader: OggStreamReader<BufReader<File>>,
    pub rate: u32,
    pub channels: u16,
    /// Decoded, not yet consumed interleaved samples.
    pending: Vec<i16>,
    pos: usize,
    /// Fractional source position for resampling.
    frac: f64,
    eof: bool,
}

impl Track {
    pub fn open(path: &Path) -> Result<Track, String> {
        let f = File::open(path).map_err(|e| format!("{}: {e}", path.display()))?;
        let reader = OggStreamReader::new(BufReader::new(f)).map_err(|e| format!("{}: {e}", path.display()))?;
        let rate = reader.ident_hdr.audio_sample_rate;
        let channels = reader.ident_hdr.audio_channels as u16;
        Ok(Track { reader, rate, channels, pending: Vec::new(), pos: 0, frac: 0.0, eof: false })
    }

    /// Next source frame as (left, right); None at the end.
    fn frame(&mut self, idx: usize) -> Option<(i16, i16)> {
        let ch = self.channels.max(1) as usize;
        while self.pos + (idx + 1) * ch > self.pending.len() {
            if self.eof {
                return None;
            }
            // Drop consumed samples, then decode another packet.
            if self.pos > 0 {
                self.pending.drain(..self.pos);
                self.pos = 0;
            }
            match self.reader.read_dec_packet_itl() {
                Ok(Some(p)) => self.pending.extend_from_slice(&p),
                Ok(None) | Err(_) => self.eof = true,
            }
        }
        let i = self.pos + idx * ch;
        let l = self.pending[i];
        let r = if ch > 1 { self.pending[i + 1] } else { l };
        Some((l, r))
    }

    /// Add up to `frames` frames into `out` (interleaved, `channels`) at `rate` and `volume`. Returns frames
    /// written (fewer at the end of the track).
    pub fn mix_into(&mut self, out: &mut [i16], channels: u16, rate: u32, volume: f32) -> usize {
        let och = channels.max(1) as usize;
        let frames = out.len() / och;
        let step = self.rate as f64 / rate.max(1) as f64;
        let ch = self.channels.max(1) as usize;
        for f in 0..frames {
            let i0 = self.frac.floor() as usize;
            let t = (self.frac - i0 as f64) as f32;
            let Some(a) = self.frame(i0) else { return f };
            let b = self.frame(i0 + 1).unwrap_or(a);
            let l = (a.0 as f32 * (1.0 - t) + b.0 as f32 * t) * volume;
            let r = (a.1 as f32 * (1.0 - t) + b.1 as f32 * t) * volume;
            let base = f * och;
            if och == 1 {
                out[base] = out[base].saturating_add(((l + r) * 0.5) as i16);
            } else {
                out[base] = out[base].saturating_add(l as i16);
                out[base + 1] = out[base + 1].saturating_add(r as i16);
            }
            self.frac += step;
            let adv = self.frac.floor() as usize;
            if adv > 0 {
                self.pos += adv * ch;
                self.frac -= adv as f64;
            }
        }
        frames
    }
}

/// Duration of an Ogg Vorbis file in ms from the last page's granule position (no decoding).
pub fn ogg_duration_ms(path: &Path) -> Option<u32> {
    let mut f = File::open(path).ok()?;
    let len = f.metadata().ok()?.len();
    // Sample rate from the identification header (first page).
    let mut head = [0u8; 64];
    f.read_exact(&mut head).ok()?;
    let vi = head.windows(7).position(|w| w == b"\x01vorbis")?;
    let rate = u32::from_le_bytes(head.get(vi + 12..vi + 16)?.try_into().ok()?);
    let tail = len.min(65536);
    f.seek(SeekFrom::Start(len - tail)).ok()?;
    let mut buf = vec![0u8; tail as usize];
    f.read_exact(&mut buf).ok()?;
    let p = buf.windows(4).rposition(|w| w == b"OggS")?;
    let gran = u64::from_le_bytes(buf.get(p + 6..p + 14)?.try_into().ok()?);
    if rate == 0 {
        return None;
    }
    Some((gran * 1000 / rate as u64) as u32)
}

/// What the player reports after mixing.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum MusicEvent {
    /// The requested range finished (MCI notify successful).
    Finished,
}

/// CD player state: plays tracks `cur..end` (end exclusive).
pub struct MusicPlayer {
    pub track: Option<Track>,
    pub cur_track: u32,
    pub end_track: u32,
    pub paused: bool,
    pub volume: f32,
    pub track_started_ms: u64,
    resolve: Option<Box<dyn Fn(u32) -> Option<PathBuf> + Send>>,
}

impl Default for MusicPlayer {
    fn default() -> Self {
        MusicPlayer { track: None, cur_track: 0, end_track: 0, paused: false, volume: DEFAULT_MUSIC_VOLUME, track_started_ms: 0, resolve: None }
    }
}

impl MusicPlayer {
    /// Set the track -> file resolver.
    pub fn set_resolver(&mut self, f: Box<dyn Fn(u32) -> Option<PathBuf> + Send>) {
        self.resolve = Some(f);
    }

    pub fn is_playing(&self) -> bool {
        self.track.is_some() && !self.paused
    }

    /// Start playing tracks `from..to` (to exclusive). Returns an error text if no track could be opened.
    pub fn play(&mut self, from: u32, to: u32, now_ms: u64) -> Result<(), String> {
        self.stop();
        self.cur_track = from;
        self.end_track = to.max(from + 1);
        self.open_current(now_ms)
    }

    fn open_current(&mut self, now_ms: u64) -> Result<(), String> {
        while self.cur_track < self.end_track {
            let path = self.resolve.as_ref().and_then(|r| r(self.cur_track));
            if let Some(p) = path {
                match Track::open(&p) {
                    Ok(t) => {
                        self.track = Some(t);
                        self.paused = false;
                        self.track_started_ms = now_ms;
                        return Ok(());
                    }
                    Err(e) => return Err(e),
                }
            }
            self.cur_track += 1;
        }
        Err("no playable track in range".into())
    }

    pub fn stop(&mut self) {
        self.track = None;
        self.paused = false;
    }

    /// Mix music into `out`; returns Finished when the range ended during this block.
    pub fn mix(&mut self, out: &mut [i16], channels: u16, rate: u32, now_ms: u64) -> Option<MusicEvent> {
        if self.paused {
            return None;
        }
        let och = channels.max(1) as usize;
        let mut done = 0usize;
        let total = out.len() / och;
        while done < total {
            let Some(t) = self.track.as_mut() else { return None };
            let n = t.mix_into(&mut out[done * och..], channels, rate, self.volume);
            done += n;
            if done < total {
                // Track ended: next one in range, or finished.
                self.track = None;
                self.cur_track += 1;
                if self.cur_track >= self.end_track || self.open_current(now_ms).is_err() {
                    return Some(MusicEvent::Finished);
                }
            }
        }
        None
    }
}
```
