```rs
const ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER: u32 = 87;
const ERROR_MOD_NOT_FOUND: u32 = 126;
const ERROR_PROC_NOT_FOUND: u32 = 127;
const ERROR_NOT_ENOUGH_MEMORY: u32 = 8;

/// Windows 98 (4.10.1998): the game was built for Win9x; `GetVersion` high bit set = not NT.
fn get_version(_m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    ThunkResult::stdcall(0xC0000A04, 0)
}

fn get_current_process(_m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    ThunkResult::stdcall(s3_runtime::handles::CURRENT_PROCESS, 0)
}




fn get_last_error(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    ThunkResult::stdcall(m.last_error(), 0)
}

fn set_last_error(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let v = m.arg_u32(0);
    m.set_last_error(v);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 1)
}

fn exit_process(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    ThunkResult::Exit(m.arg_u32(0))
}

fn get_command_line_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    ThunkResult::stdcall(m.process.cmdline_a, 0)
}

fn get_module_handle_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let r = match m.arg_str(0) {
        None => m.process.image_base,
        Some(name) => {
            let exe = m.process.module_path.rsplit('\\').next().unwrap_or("").to_ascii_lowercase();
            let n = s3_runtime::normalize_dll(&name);
            if n == exe || n.trim_end_matches(".dll") == exe.trim_end_matches(".exe") {
                m.process.image_base
            } else {
                m.registry.module_handle(&n).unwrap_or(0)
            }
        }
    };
    if r == 0 {
        m.set_last_error(ERROR_MOD_NOT_FOUND);
    }
    ThunkResult::stdcall(r, 1)
}

/// Only HLE modules can be "loaded": returns their fake HMODULE.
fn load_library_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let name = m.arg_str(0).unwrap_or_default();
    let h = m.registry.module_handle(&name).unwrap_or(0);
    if h == 0 {
        m.log(s3_runtime::LogLevel::Warn, &format!("LoadLibraryA({name}): no HLE module"));
        m.set_last_error(ERROR_MOD_NOT_FOUND);
    }
    ThunkResult::stdcall(h, 1)
}

/// Returns 0 for functions nobody declared (logged), so optional-feature probes take their fallback path.
fn get_proc_address(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let hmod = m.arg_u32(0);
    let p = m.arg_u32(1);
    let Some(dll) = m.registry.module_name(hmod).map(|s| s.to_string()) else {
        m.set_last_error(ERROR_MOD_NOT_FOUND);
        return ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 2);
    };
    let r = if p < 0x1_0000 {
        m.registry.lookup_ordinal(&dll, p as u16)
    } else {
        let name = m.mem.read_cstr(p);
        let r = m.registry.lookup(&dll, &name);
        if r.is_none() {
            m.log(s3_runtime::LogLevel::Warn, &format!("GetProcAddress({dll}, {name}): not declared"));
        }
        r
    };
    if r.is_none() {
        m.set_last_error(ERROR_PROC_NOT_FOUND);
    }
    ThunkResult::stdcall(r.unwrap_or(0), 2)
}

/// `IsProcessorFeaturePresent(feature)` (looked up by the CRT via GetProcAddress). Matches what our CPUID reports
/// (Pentium P54C: FPU, TSC, CMPXCHG8B; no MMX/SSE/3DNow, no FDIV errata, FPU not emulated).
pub fn processor_feature_present(feature: u32) -> bool {
    const PF_COMPARE_EXCHANGE_DOUBLE: u32 = 2;
    const PF_RDTSC_INSTRUCTION_AVAILABLE: u32 = 8;
    matches!(feature, PF_COMPARE_EXCHANGE_DOUBLE | PF_RDTSC_INSTRUCTION_AVAILABLE)
}

fn is_processor_feature_present(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    ThunkResult::stdcall(processor_feature_present(m.arg_u32(0)) as u32, 1)
}

fn free_library(_m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    ThunkResult::stdcall(1, 1)
}

fn heap_create(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (initial, max) = (m.arg_u32(1), m.arg_u32(2));
    let h = m.mem.heap_create(initial, max).unwrap_or(0);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(h, 3)
}

fn heap_destroy(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let h = m.arg_u32(0);
    let ok = m.mem.heap_destroy(h).is_ok();
    ThunkResult::stdcall(ok as u32, 1)
}

fn heap_alloc(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (h, flags, size) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1), m.arg_u32(2));
    let p = m.mem.heap_alloc(h, size, flags).unwrap_or(0);
    if p == 0 {
        m.set_last_error(ERROR_NOT_ENOUGH_MEMORY);
    }
    ThunkResult::stdcall(p, 3)
}

fn heap_free(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (h, p) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(2));
    let ok = p == 0 || m.mem.heap_free(h, p);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(ok as u32, 3)
}

fn heap_realloc(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (h, flags, p, size) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1), m.arg_u32(2), m.arg_u32(3));
    let r = m.mem.heap_realloc(h, p, size, flags).unwrap_or(0);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(r, 4)
}

fn heap_size(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (h, p) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(2));
    ThunkResult::stdcall(m.mem.heap_size(h, p).unwrap_or(u32::MAX), 3)
}

fn virtual_alloc(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (a, size, ty, prot) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1), m.arg_u32(2), m.arg_u32(3));
    let r = m.mem.virtual_alloc(a, size, ty, prot).unwrap_or(0);
    if r == 0 {
        m.set_last_error(ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER);
    }
    ThunkResult::stdcall(r, 4)
}

fn virtual_free(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (a, size, ty) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1), m.arg_u32(2));
    let ok = m.mem.virtual_free(a, size, ty).is_ok();
    ThunkResult::stdcall(ok as u32, 3)
}

fn virtual_query(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (a, buf, len) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1), m.arg_u32(2));
    if len < 28 {
        return ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 3);
    }
    let info = m.mem.virtual_query(a).to_bytes();
    m.mem.write_bytes(buf, &info);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(28, 3)
}

fn virtual_protect(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (a, size, prot, old) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1), m.arg_u32(2), m.arg_u32(3));
    match m.mem.virtual_protect(a, size, prot) {
        Ok(o) => {
            if old != 0 {
                m.mem.write_u32(old, o);
            }
            ThunkResult::stdcall(1, 4)
        }
        Err(_) => {
            m.set_last_error(ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER);
            ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 4)
        }
    }
}




/// `RaiseException(code, flags, nargs, args)`: dispatch through the guest SEH chain. If a handler returns
/// ExceptionContinueExecution the call returns normally (CONTEXT.Eip = return address).
fn raise_exception(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    use s3_cpu::ESP;
    let (code, flags, n, args) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1), m.arg_u32(2), m.arg_u32(3));
    let params: Vec<u32> = (0..n.min(15)).map(|i| m.mem.read_u32(args + 4 * i)).collect();
    let ret = m.return_address();
    let mut c = m.cpu().context();
    c.eip = ret;
    c.regs[ESP] = c.regs[ESP].wrapping_add(4 + 16);
    s3_runtime::seh::raise_exception(m, code, flags, &params, c, ret);
    ThunkResult::Done
}

/// `RtlUnwind(target_frame, target_ip, exception_record, return_value)`.
fn rtl_unwind(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (frame, _ip, rec, rv) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1), m.arg_u32(2), m.arg_u32(3));
    s3_runtime::seh::rtl_unwind(m, frame, rec);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(rv, 4)
}

// ================================================================================================ process

/// `GetVersionExA(OSVERSIONINFOA*)`: Windows 98 (4.10.1998, platform VER_PLATFORM_WIN32_WINDOWS), matching
/// `GetVersion`.
fn get_version_ex_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let p = m.arg_u32(0);
    let size = m.mem.read_u32(p);
    if size < 148 {
        m.set_last_error(122); // ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_BUFFER
        return ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 1);
    }
    m.mem.fill(p + 4, (size - 4) as usize, 0);
    m.mem.write_u32(p + 4, 4);
    m.mem.write_u32(p + 8, 10);
    m.mem.write_u32(p + 12, 0x040A_07CE);
    m.mem.write_u32(p + 16, 1);
    m.mem.write_cstr(p + 20, " A");
    ThunkResult::stdcall(1, 1)
}

fn terminate_process(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (h, code) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1));
    if h == s3_runtime::handles::CURRENT_PROCESS || matches!(m.handles.get(h), Some(s3_runtime::KernelObject::Process)) {
        m.log(LogLevel::Info, &format!("TerminateProcess({code})"));
        return ThunkResult::Exit(code);
    }
    m.set_last_error(6);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 2)
}

/// `CreateProcessA`: child processes are not supported (the game only uses it for the 565->555 patch
/// converter and external tools); fails with ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND.
fn create_process_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let app = m.arg_str(0).unwrap_or_default();
    let cmd = m.arg_str(1).unwrap_or_default();
    m.log(LogLevel::Warn, &format!("CreateProcessA({app:?}, {cmd:?}): not supported"));
    m.set_last_error(2);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 10)
}

fn get_exit_code_process(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let p = m.arg_u32(1);
    if p != 0 {
        m.mem.write_u32(p, 259); // STILL_ACTIVE
    }
    ThunkResult::stdcall(1, 2)
}

/// `GetStartupInfoA(STARTUPINFOA*)` (68 bytes, nothing inherited).
fn get_startup_info_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let p = m.arg_u32(0);
    m.mem.fill(p, 68, 0);
    m.mem.write_u32(p, 68);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 1)
}

#[derive(Default)]
struct EnvState {
    vars: Option<Vec<(String, String)>>,
}

fn env_vars(m: &mut Machine) -> s3_runtime::Shared<EnvState> {
    let st = m.state::<EnvState>();
    {
        let mut s = st.borrow_mut();
        if s.vars.is_none() {
            s.vars = Some(
                s3_runtime::process::DEFAULT_ENV
                    .iter()
                    .filter_map(|v| v.split_once('='))
                    .map(|(a, b)| (a.to_string(), b.to_string()))
                    .collect(),
            );
        }
    }
    st
}

fn get_environment_variable_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (name, buf, size) = (m.arg_str(0).unwrap_or_default(), m.arg_u32(1), m.arg_u32(2));
    let st = env_vars(m);
    let v = st.borrow_mut().vars.as_ref().unwrap().iter().find(|(k, _)| k.eq_ignore_ascii_case(&name)).map(|(_, v)| v.clone());
    match v {
        Some(v) => {
            let len = v.len() as u32;
            if buf != 0 && size > len {
                m.mem.write_cstr(buf, &v);
                ThunkResult::stdcall(len, 3)
            } else {
                ThunkResult::stdcall(len + 1, 3)
            }
        }
        None => {
            m.set_last_error(203); // ERROR_ENVVAR_NOT_FOUND
            ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 3)
        }
    }
}

/// Stored host-side only (the environment block returned by GetEnvironmentStrings is not rebuilt).
fn set_environment_variable_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (name, value) = (m.arg_str(0).unwrap_or_default(), m.arg_str(1));
    let st = env_vars(m);
    let mut s = st.borrow_mut();
    let vars = s.vars.as_mut().unwrap();
    vars.retain(|(k, _)| !k.eq_ignore_ascii_case(&name));
    if let Some(v) = value {
        vars.push((name, v));
    }
    ThunkResult::stdcall(1, 2)
}

/// Guest path of a module handle: the exe, or `C:\WINDOWS\SYSTEM\<DLL>` for HLE modules.
fn module_path(m: &Machine, hmod: u32) -> Option<String> {
    if hmod == 0 || hmod == m.process.image_base {
        return Some(m.process.module_path.clone());
    }
    m.registry.module_name(hmod).map(|n| format!("C:\\WINDOWS\\SYSTEM\\{}", n.to_ascii_uppercase()))
}

/// `GetModuleFileNameA(hmod, buf, size)`: returns the number of chars copied (truncated, NUL-terminated).
fn get_module_file_name_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (hmod, buf, size) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1), m.arg_u32(2));
    let Some(path) = module_path(m, hmod) else {
        m.set_last_error(ERROR_MOD_NOT_FOUND);
        return ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 3);
    };
    if size == 0 {
        return ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 3);
    }
    let n = path.len().min(size as usize - 1);
    m.mem.write_cstr(buf, &path[..n]);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(n as u32, 3)
}

/// `GetSystemInfo(SYSTEM_INFO*)`: one Pentium (586), 4 KiB pages, 64 KiB granularity.
fn get_system_info(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let p = m.arg_u32(0);
    m.mem.fill(p, 36, 0);
    m.mem.write_u32(p + 4, 0x1000);
    m.mem.write_u32(p + 8, 0x1_0000);
    m.mem.write_u32(p + 12, 0x7FFE_FFFF);
    m.mem.write_u32(p + 16, 1);
    m.mem.write_u32(p + 20, 1);
    m.mem.write_u32(p + 24, 586);
    m.mem.write_u32(p + 28, 0x1_0000);
    m.mem.write_u16(p + 32, 5);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 1)
}

fn sys_dir(m: &mut Machine, dir: &str) -> ThunkResult {
    let (buf, size) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1));
    let len = dir.len() as u32;
    if buf != 0 && size > len {
        m.mem.write_cstr(buf, dir);
        ThunkResult::stdcall(len, 2)
    } else {
        ThunkResult::stdcall(len + 1, 2)
    }
}

fn get_computer_name_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (buf, psize) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1));
    let name = "S3PORT";
    let size = m.mem.read_u32(psize);
    if size <= name.len() as u32 {
        m.mem.write_u32(psize, name.len() as u32 + 1);
        m.set_last_error(111); // ERROR_BUFFER_OVERFLOW
        return ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 2);
    }
    m.mem.write_cstr(buf, name);
    m.mem.write_u32(psize, name.len() as u32);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(1, 2)
}

// ================================================================================================ memory

/// `GlobalMemoryStatus(MEMORYSTATUS*)`: 256 MiB RAM machine (values chosen to fit 32-bit math).
fn global_memory_status(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let p = m.arg_u32(0);
    let v = [32u32, 10, 256 << 20, 192 << 20, 512 << 20, 448 << 20, 0x7FFE_0000, 0x7000_0000];
    for (i, x) in v.iter().enumerate() {
        m.mem.write_u32(p + 4 * i as u32, *x);
    }
    ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 1)
}

const LMEM_ZEROINIT: u32 = 0x40;

/// `LocalAlloc/GlobalAlloc(flags, size)`: fixed blocks from the process heap (handle == pointer, also for
/// MOVEABLE; Lock returns the same value).
fn local_alloc(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (flags, size) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1));
    let h = m.mem.process_heap();
    let zero = if flags & LMEM_ZEROINIT != 0 { s3_mem::HEAP_ZERO_MEMORY } else { 0 };
    let p = m.mem.heap_alloc(h, size.max(1), zero).unwrap_or(0);
    if p == 0 {
        m.set_last_error(ERROR_NOT_ENOUGH_MEMORY);
    }
    ThunkResult::stdcall(p, 2)
}

fn local_free(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let p = m.arg_u32(0);
    if p == 0 {
        return ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 1);
    }
    let h = m.mem.process_heap();
    if m.mem.heap_free(h, p) {
        ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 1)
    } else {
        m.set_last_error(6);
        ThunkResult::stdcall(p, 1)
    }
}

fn local_realloc(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (p, size, flags) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1), m.arg_u32(2));
    let h = m.mem.process_heap();
    let zero = if flags & LMEM_ZEROINIT != 0 { s3_mem::HEAP_ZERO_MEMORY } else { 0 };
    let r = m.mem.heap_realloc(h, p, size.max(1), zero).unwrap_or(0);
    if r == 0 {
        m.set_last_error(ERROR_NOT_ENOUGH_MEMORY);
    }
    ThunkResult::stdcall(r, 3)
}

fn local_size(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let p = m.arg_u32(0);
    let h = m.mem.process_heap();
    ThunkResult::stdcall(m.mem.heap_size(h, p).unwrap_or(0), 1)
}

/// True if every page of `[p, p+n)` is committed.
fn range_ok(m: &Machine, p: u32, n: u32) -> bool {
    if n == 0 {
        return true;
    }
    if p < layout_null_end() {
        return false;
    }
    let Some(end) = p.checked_add(n - 1) else { return false };
    let mut a = p & !0xFFF;
    loop {
        if m.mem.virtual_query(a).state != s3_mem::MEM_COMMIT {
            return false;
        }
        match a.checked_add(0x1000) {
            Some(next) if next <= end => a = next,
            _ => return true,
        }
    }
}

fn layout_null_end() -> u32 {
    s3_mem::layout::NULL_GUARD_END
}

fn is_bad_read_ptr(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (p, n) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1));
    ThunkResult::stdcall(!range_ok(m, p, n) as u32, 2)
}

fn is_bad_code_ptr(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let p = m.arg_u32(0);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(!range_ok(m, p, 1) as u32, 1)
}

fn is_bad_string_ptr_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (p, max) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1));
    if max == 0 {
        return ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 2);
    }
    if !range_ok(m, p, 1) {
        return ThunkResult::stdcall(1, 2);
    }
    let n = m.mem.strlen(p, max.min(0x100_0000) as usize) as u32;
    ThunkResult::stdcall(!range_ok(m, p, (n + 1).min(max)) as u32, 2)
}

// ================================================================================================ errors / debug

#[derive(Default)]
struct ErrState {
    filter: u32,
    error_mode: u32,
    debug_lines: u32,
}

fn set_unhandled_exception_filter(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let f = m.arg_u32(0);
    let st = m.state::<ErrState>();
    let prev = std::mem::replace(&mut st.borrow_mut().filter, f);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(prev, 1)
}

/// `UnhandledExceptionFilter(EXCEPTION_POINTERS*)`: called by the CRT's top-level `__except` filter. Logs the
/// exception, runs the filter set with SetUnhandledExceptionFilter (if any) and otherwise returns
/// EXCEPTION_EXECUTE_HANDLER (1), after which the CRT terminates the process.
fn unhandled_exception_filter(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let ptrs = m.arg_u32(0);
    let rec = m.mem.read_u32(ptrs);
    let (code, addr) = (m.mem.read_u32(rec), m.mem.read_u32(rec + 12));
    m.log(LogLevel::Error, &format!("UnhandledExceptionFilter: exception {code:#x} at {addr:#x} (thread {})", m.cur));
    let filter = m.state::<ErrState>().borrow_mut().filter;
    if filter != 0 {
        let r = m.call_guest(filter, &[ptrs]);
        if r != 0 {
            return ThunkResult::stdcall(r, 1);
        }
    }
    ThunkResult::stdcall(1, 1)
}

fn set_error_mode(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let mode = m.arg_u32(0);
    let st = m.state::<ErrState>();
    let prev = std::mem::replace(&mut st.borrow_mut().error_mode, mode);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(prev, 1)
}

/// Guest debug output -> host log (first 2000 lines at Info, then Debug).
fn output_debug_string_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let s = m.arg_str(0).unwrap_or_default();
    let st = m.state::<ErrState>();
    let n = {
        let mut g = st.borrow_mut();
        g.debug_lines += 1;
        g.debug_lines
    };
    let level = if n <= 2000 { LogLevel::Info } else { LogLevel::Debug };
    m.log(level, &format!("[guest t{}] {}", m.cur, s.trim_end()));
    ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 1)
}

/// `FormatMessageA(flags, src, id, lang, buf, size, args)`. System messages are a generic
/// "Error N." text; `FORMAT_MESSAGE_FROM_STRING` copies the string without processing inserts (HYPOTHESIS:
/// the game only formats system error codes for its error dialogs/logs).
fn format_message_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (flags, src, id, buf, size) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1), m.arg_u32(2), m.arg_u32(4), m.arg_u32(5));
    let text = if flags & 0x400 != 0 && src != 0 {
        m.mem.read_cstr(src)
    } else {
        let t = match id {
            0 => "The operation completed successfully.",
            2 => "The system cannot find the file specified.",
            3 => "The system cannot find the path specified.",
            5 => "Access is denied.",
            6 => "The handle is invalid.",
            8 => "Not enough storage is available to process this command.",
            87 => "The parameter is incorrect.",
            _ => "",
        };
        if t.is_empty() {
            format!("Error {id} ({id:#x}).\r\n")
        } else {
            format!("{t}\r\n")
        }
    };
    let len = text.len() as u32;
    if flags & 0x100 != 0 {
        // FORMAT_MESSAGE_ALLOCATE_BUFFER: *buf = LocalAlloc'ed string
        let h = m.mem.process_heap();
        let p = m.mem.heap_alloc(h, (len + 1).max(size), 0).unwrap_or(0);
        if p == 0 {
            return ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 7);
        }
        m.mem.write_cstr(p, &text);
        m.mem.write_u32(buf, p);
        return ThunkResult::stdcall(len, 7);
    }
    if size <= len {
        m.set_last_error(122);
        return ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 7);
    }
    m.mem.write_cstr(buf, &text);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(len, 7)
}

// ================================================================================================ resources

fn res_module(m: &Machine, hmod: u32) -> u32 {
    if hmod == 0 {
        m.process.image_base
    } else {
        hmod
    }
}

/// `FindResourceA(hmod, name, type)` -> HRSRC (address of the IMAGE_RESOURCE_DATA_ENTRY).
fn find_resource_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let base = res_module(m, m.arg_u32(0));
    let name = ResId::from_guest_a(m, m.arg_u32(1));
    let ty = ResId::from_guest_a(m, m.arg_u32(2));
    if base != m.process.image_base {
        m.set_last_error(1813); // ERROR_RESOURCE_TYPE_NOT_FOUND (HLE modules have no resources)
        return ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 3);
    }
    match find_resource_entry(m, base, &ty, &name, None) {
        Some(e) => ThunkResult::stdcall(e, 3),
        None => {
            m.set_last_error(1814); // ERROR_RESOURCE_NAME_NOT_FOUND
            ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 3)
        }
    }
}

fn load_resource(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (hmod, hres) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1));
    if hres == 0 {
        return ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 2);
    }
    let base = res_module(m, hmod);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(base + m.mem.read_u32(hres), 2)
}

fn sizeof_resource(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let hres = m.arg_u32(1);
    if hres == 0 {
        return ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 2);
    }
    ThunkResult::stdcall(m.mem.read_u32(hres + 4), 2)
}

```

`port/crates/s3-win32/src/kernel32_file.rs`:

```rs
//! kernel32: files, directories, find, file mappings, drives, std handles — all through the VFS
//! (`s3_runtime::Vfs`): the game lives at `C:\S3` (any other drive root maps there too), reads check the
//! overlay (`data_dir/overlay`) first, writes always go to the overlay, the user's game dir is never modified.
//!
//! - Read-only opens use the game file directly; opens with write access copy the file into the overlay first.
//! - `CreateFileMappingA` + `MapViewOfFile` mmap the host file into guest memory (`s3_runtime::mapfile`).
//! - Std handles are the fake values 0x10/0x14/0x18 (FILE_TYPE_CHAR); writes to them go to the log.

use std::fs::{File, OpenOptions};
use std::io::{Read, Seek, SeekFrom, Write};
use std::path::PathBuf;

use s3_mem::{align_up, layout, RegionKind};
use s3_runtime::handles::INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE;
use s3_runtime::hosttime::systemtime_to_filetime;
use s3_runtime::vfs::wildcard_match;
use s3_runtime::{KernelObject, LogLevel, Machine, Registry, ThunkResult, Vfs};

use super::DLL;

const ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND: u32 = 2;
const ERROR_PATH_NOT_FOUND: u32 = 3;
const ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED: u32 = 5;
const ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE: u32 = 6;
const ERROR_NOT_ENOUGH_MEMORY: u32 = 8;
const ERROR_NO_MORE_FILES: u32 = 18;
const ERROR_FILE_EXISTS: u32 = 80;
const ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER: u32 = 87;
const ERROR_NEGATIVE_SEEK: u32 = 131;
const ERROR_ALREADY_EXISTS: u32 = 183;

const GENERIC_WRITE: u32 = 0x4000_0000;
const GENERIC_ALL: u32 = 0x1000_0000;
const FILE_WRITE_DATA: u32 = 0x2;
const FILE_APPEND_DATA: u32 = 0x4;
const FILE_FLAG_BACKUP_SEMANTICS: u32 = 0x0200_0000;

const FILE_ATTRIBUTE_READONLY: u32 = 0x1;
const FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY: u32 = 0x10;
const FILE_ATTRIBUTE_ARCHIVE: u32 = 0x20;

/// Fake std handles (STD_INPUT/OUTPUT/ERROR).
pub const STD_HANDLES: [u32; 3] = [0x10, 0x14, 0x18];

pub fn is_std_handle(h: u32) -> bool {
    STD_HANDLES.contains(&h)
}

/// An open file (`KernelObject::Other("file", ..)`).
pub struct FileObj {
    pub file: File,
    pub guest: String,
    pub host: PathBuf,
    pub writable: bool,
    pub is_dir: bool,
}

struct FindObj {
    entries: Vec<(String, bool, u64, u64)>,
    pos: usize,
}

/// A file mapping object (`KernelObject::Other("mapping", ..)`).
pub struct MappingObj {
    file: Option<File>,
    size: u64,
    /// Pagefile-backed mapping: guest memory shared by all views.
    anon_base: Option<u32>,
}

#[derive(Default)]
struct Views {
    /// view base -> (length, file-backed region we own)
    views: std::collections::BTreeMap<u32, (u32, bool)>,
}

pub(crate) fn register(reg: &mut Registry) {
    reg.register(DLL, "CreateFileA", create_file_a);
    reg.register(DLL, "ReadFile", read_file);
    reg.register(DLL, "WriteFile", write_file);
    reg.register(DLL, "SetFilePointer", set_file_pointer);
    reg.register(DLL, "GetFileSize", get_file_size);
    reg.register(DLL, "SetEndOfFile", set_end_of_file);
    reg.register(DLL, "FlushFileBuffers", flush_file_buffers);
    reg.register(DLL, "GetFileType", get_file_type);
    reg.register(DLL, "GetFileTime", get_file_time);
    reg.register(DLL, "SetFileTime", |_m| ThunkResult::stdcall(1, 4));
    reg.register(DLL, "GetStdHandle", get_std_handle);
    reg.register(DLL, "SetStdHandle", |_m| ThunkResult::stdcall(1, 2));
    reg.register(DLL, "SetHandleCount", |m| ThunkResult::stdcall(m.arg_u32(0), 1));
    reg.register(DLL, "FindFirstFileA", find_first_file_a);
    reg.register(DLL, "FindNextFileA", find_next_file_a);
    reg.register(DLL, "FindClose", find_close);
    reg.register(DLL, "DeleteFileA", delete_file_a);
    reg.register(DLL, "MoveFileA", move_file_a);
    reg.register(DLL, "CopyFileA", copy_file_a);
    reg.register(DLL, "CreateDirectoryA", create_directory_a);
    reg.register(DLL, "RemoveDirectoryA", remove_directory_a);
    reg.register(DLL, "GetFileAttributesA", get_file_attributes_a);
    reg.register(DLL, "SetFileAttributesA", set_file_attributes_a);
    reg.register(DLL, "GetFullPathNameA", get_full_path_name_a);
    reg.register(DLL, "GetCurrentDirectoryA", get_current_directory_a);
    reg.register(DLL, "SetCurrentDirectoryA", set_current_directory_a);
    reg.register(DLL, "GetDriveTypeA", |_m| ThunkResult::stdcall(3, 1)); // DRIVE_FIXED (see wine-trace.md)
    reg.register(DLL, "GetLogicalDrives", |_m| ThunkResult::stdcall(1 << 2, 0)); // C: only
    reg.register(DLL, "GetVolumeInformationA", get_volume_information_a);
    reg.register(DLL, "GetDiskFreeSpaceA", get_disk_free_space_a);
    reg.register(DLL, "GetTempPathA", get_temp_path_a);
    reg.register(DLL, "GetTempFileNameA", get_temp_file_name_a);
    reg.register(DLL, "CreateFileMappingA", create_file_mapping_a);
    reg.register(DLL, "OpenFileMappingA", open_file_mapping_a);
    reg.register(DLL, "MapViewOfFile", map_view_of_file);
    reg.register(DLL, "UnmapViewOfFile", unmap_view_of_file);
    reg.register(DLL, "FlushViewOfFile", |_m| ThunkResult::stdcall(1, 2));
}

/// `S3_FILES=1`: log every file-system call with its guest path and result at Info (save/load debugging).
fn files_log_on() -> bool {
    static ON: std::sync::OnceLock<bool> = std::sync::OnceLock::new();
    *ON.get_or_init(|| std::env::var_os("S3_FILES").is_some())
}

fn flog(m: &Machine, msg: impl FnOnce() -> String) {
    if files_log_on() {
        m.log(LogLevel::Info, &format!("[files] {}", msg()));
    }
}

fn fail(m: &mut Machine, err: u32, value: u32, nargs: u32) -> ThunkResult {
    m.set_last_error(err);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(value, nargs)
}

/// Does the parent directory of `guest` exist?
fn parent_exists(vfs: &Vfs, guest: &str) -> bool {
    let parts = vfs.components(guest);
    if parts.len() <= 1 {
        return true;
    }
    vfs.is_dir(&Vfs::guest_path(&parts[..parts.len() - 1]))
}

fn not_found_err(vfs: &Vfs, guest: &str) -> u32 {
    if parent_exists(vfs, guest) {
        ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND
    } else {
        ERROR_PATH_NOT_FOUND
    }
}

/// `CreateFileA(name, access, share, sa, disposition, flags, template)`.
fn create_file_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let r = create_file_a_inner(m);
    if files_log_on() {
        let name = m.arg_str(0).unwrap_or_default();
        let (access, disp) = (m.arg_u32(1), m.arg_u32(4));
        let ret = match &r {
            ThunkResult::Return { eax, .. } => *eax,
            _ => 0,
        };
        let err = m.last_error();
        flog(m, || format!("CreateFileA({name:?}, access {access:#x}, disp {disp}) -> {ret:#x} err {err}"));
    }
    r
}

fn create_file_a_inner(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let Some(name) = m.arg_str(0) else { return fail(m, ERROR_PATH_NOT_FOUND, INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE, 7) };
    let (access, disp, flags) = (m.arg_u32(1), m.arg_u32(4), m.arg_u32(5));
    if name.is_empty() {
        return fail(m, ERROR_PATH_NOT_FOUND, INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE, 7);
    }
    if name.starts_with("\\\\.\\") || name.eq_ignore_ascii_case("CON") || name.eq_ignore_ascii_case("NUL") {
        m.log(LogLevel::Warn, &format!("CreateFileA({name}): device names not supported"));
        return fail(m, ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND, INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE, 7);
    }
    let write = access & (GENERIC_WRITE | GENERIC_ALL | FILE_WRITE_DATA | FILE_APPEND_DATA) != 0;
    let existing = m.vfs.resolve_read(&name);
    let exists = existing.is_some();

    if let Some(p) = &existing {
        if p.is_dir() {
            if flags & FILE_FLAG_BACKUP_SEMANTICS != 0 && matches!(disp, 3 | 4) {
                if let Ok(f) = File::open(p) {
                    let obj = FileObj { file: f, guest: name.clone(), host: p.clone(), writable: false, is_dir: true };
                    let h = m.handles.insert(KernelObject::Other("file", Box::new(obj)));
                    return ThunkResult::stdcall(h, 7);
                }
            }
            return fail(m, ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED, INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE, 7);
        }
    }

    // (create/truncate?, must exist?, fail if exists?)
    let (truncate, must_exist, fail_exists) = match disp {
        1 => (true, false, true),  // CREATE_NEW
        2 => (true, false, false), // CREATE_ALWAYS
        3 => (false, true, false), // OPEN_EXISTING
        4 => (false, false, false), // OPEN_ALWAYS
        5 => (true, true, false),  // TRUNCATE_EXISTING
        _ => return fail(m, ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER, INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE, 7),
    };
    if fail_exists && exists {
        return fail(m, ERROR_FILE_EXISTS, INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE, 7);
    }
    if must_exist && !exists {
        let e = not_found_err(&m.vfs, &name);
        return fail(m, e, INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE, 7);
    }
    if !exists && !parent_exists(&m.vfs, &name) {
        return fail(m, ERROR_PATH_NOT_FOUND, INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE, 7);
    }

    let result: std::io::Result<(File, PathBuf, bool)> = (|| {
        if truncate || !exists {
            let p = m.vfs.create_path(&name)?;
            let f = OpenOptions::new().read(true).write(true).create(true).truncate(truncate).open(&p)?;
            Ok((f, p, true))
        } else if write {
            let p = m.vfs.copy_up(&name)?;
            let f = OpenOptions::new().read(true).write(true).open(&p)?;
            Ok((f, p, true))
        } else {
            let p = existing.clone().unwrap();
            Ok((File::open(&p)?, p, false))
        }
    })();
    match result {
        Ok((file, host, writable)) => {
            if m.trace.thunks {
                m.log(LogLevel::Debug, &format!("CreateFileA({name}) -> {}", host.display()));
            }
            let obj = FileObj { file, guest: name, host, writable, is_dir: false };
            let h = m.handles.insert(KernelObject::Other("file", Box::new(obj)));
            m.set_last_error(if exists && matches!(disp, 2 | 4) { ERROR_ALREADY_EXISTS } else { 0 });
            ThunkResult::stdcall(h, 7)
        }
        Err(e) => {
            m.log(LogLevel::Warn, &format!("CreateFileA: host error {e}"));
            fail(m, ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED, INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE, 7)
        }
    }
}

/// `ReadFile(h, buf, n, *read, overlapped)`.
fn read_file(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (h, buf, n, pread) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1), m.arg_u32(2), m.arg_u32(3));
    if pread != 0 {
        m.mem.write_u32(pread, 0);
    }
    if is_std_handle(h) {
        return ThunkResult::stdcall(1, 5);
    }
    let Some(f) = m.handles.get_other_mut::<FileObj>(h) else { return fail(m, ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE, 0, 5) };
    if f.is_dir {
        return fail(m, ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED, 0, 5);
    }
    let dst = m.mem.slice_mut(buf, n as usize);
    let mut total = 0usize;
    while total < dst.len() {
        match f.file.read(&mut dst[total..]) {
            Ok(0) => break,
            Ok(k) => total += k,
            Err(e) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::Interrupted => {}
            Err(_) => return fail(m, ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED, 0, 5),
        }
    }
    if pread != 0 {
        m.mem.write_u32(pread, total as u32);
    }
    ThunkResult::stdcall(1, 5)
}

/// `WriteFile(h, buf, n, *written, overlapped)`.
fn write_file(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (h, buf, n, pw) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1), m.arg_u32(2), m.arg_u32(3));
    if is_std_handle(h) {
        let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(m.mem.slice(buf, n.min(4096) as usize)).to_string();
        m.log(LogLevel::Info, &format!("[guest stdio] {}", text.trim_end()));
        if pw != 0 {
            m.mem.write_u32(pw, n);
        }
        return ThunkResult::stdcall(1, 5);
    }
    let Some(f) = m.handles.get_other_mut::<FileObj>(h) else { return fail(m, ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE, 0, 5) };
    if !f.writable {
        return fail(m, ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED, 0, 5);
    }
    let src = m.mem.slice(buf, n as usize);
    if f.file.write_all(src).is_err() {
        return fail(m, ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED, 0, 5);
    }
    if pw != 0 {
        m.mem.write_u32(pw, n);
    }
    ThunkResult::stdcall(1, 5)
}

/// `SetFilePointer(h, lo, *hi, method)`.
fn set_file_pointer(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (h, lo, phi, method) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1), m.arg_u32(2), m.arg_u32(3));
    let dist: i64 = if phi != 0 { ((m.mem.read_u32(phi) as u64) << 32 | lo as u64) as i64 } else { lo as i32 as i64 };
    let Some(f) = m.handles.get_other_mut::<FileObj>(h) else { return fail(m, ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE, u32::MAX, 4) };
    let base: i64 = match method {
        0 => 0,
        1 => f.file.stream_position().unwrap_or(0) as i64,
        2 => f.file.metadata().map(|md| md.len()).unwrap_or(0) as i64,
        _ => return fail(m, ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER, u32::MAX, 4),
    };
    let pos = base + dist;
    if pos < 0 {
        return fail(m, ERROR_NEGATIVE_SEEK, u32::MAX, 4);
    }
    if f.file.seek(SeekFrom::Start(pos as u64)).is_err() {
        return fail(m, ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER, u32::MAX, 4);
    }
    if phi != 0 {
        m.mem.write_u32(phi, (pos as u64 >> 32) as u32);
    }
    m.set_last_error(0);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(pos as u32, 4)
}

fn get_file_size(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (h, phi) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1));
    let Some(f) = m.handles.get_other::<FileObj>(h) else { return fail(m, ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE, u32::MAX, 2) };
    let len = f.file.metadata().map(|md| md.len()).unwrap_or(0);
    if phi != 0 {
        m.mem.write_u32(phi, (len >> 32) as u32);
    }
    m.set_last_error(0);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(len as u32, 2)
}

fn set_end_of_file(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let h = m.arg_u32(0);
    let Some(f) = m.handles.get_other_mut::<FileObj>(h) else { return fail(m, ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE, 0, 1) };
    if !f.writable {
        return fail(m, ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED, 0, 1);
    }
    let pos = f.file.stream_position().unwrap_or(0);
    let ok = f.file.set_len(pos).is_ok();
    ThunkResult::stdcall(ok as u32, 1)
}

fn flush_file_buffers(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let h = m.arg_u32(0);
    if let Some(f) = m.handles.get_other_mut::<FileObj>(h) {
        let _ = f.file.flush();
    }
    ThunkResult::stdcall(1, 1)
}

fn get_file_type(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let h = m.arg_u32(0);
    if is_std_handle(h) {
        return ThunkResult::stdcall(2, 1); // FILE_TYPE_CHAR
    }
    if m.handles.get_other::<FileObj>(h).is_some() {
        return ThunkResult::stdcall(1, 1); // FILE_TYPE_DISK
    }
    fail(m, ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE, 0, 1)
}

fn get_file_time(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (h, pc, pa, pw) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1), m.arg_u32(2), m.arg_u32(3));
    let Some(f) = m.handles.get_other::<FileObj>(h) else { return fail(m, ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE, 0, 4) };
    let md = f.file.metadata().ok();
    let ft = |t: Option<std::time::SystemTime>| t.map(systemtime_to_filetime).unwrap_or(0);
    let mt = ft(md.as_ref().and_then(|d| d.modified().ok()));
    let at = ft(md.as_ref().and_then(|d| d.accessed().ok()));
    for (p, v) in [(pc, mt), (pa, at), (pw, mt)] {
        if p != 0 {
            m.mem.write_u64(p, v);
        }
    }
    ThunkResult::stdcall(1, 4)
}

fn get_std_handle(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let n = m.arg_u32(0) as i32;
    let h = match n {
        -10 => STD_HANDLES[0],
        -11 => STD_HANDLES[1],
        -12 => STD_HANDLES[2],
        _ => return fail(m, ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE, INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE, 1),
    };
    ThunkResult::stdcall(h, 1)
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- find

/// Split a guest path into (directory, last component).
fn split_dir(path: &str) -> (String, String) {
    let p = path.replace('/', "\\");
    match p.rfind('\\') {
        Some(i) => {
            let dir = if i == 0 || (i == 2 && p.as_bytes()[1] == b':') { p[..=i].to_string() } else { p[..i].to_string() };
            (dir, p[i + 1..].to_string())
        }
        None if p.len() >= 2 && p.as_bytes()[1] == b':' => (p[..2].to_string(), p[2..].to_string()),
        None => (".".to_string(), p),
    }
}

/// WIN32_FIND_DATAA (320 bytes).
fn write_find_data(m: &mut Machine, p: u32, name: &str, is_dir: bool, size: u64, mtime: u64) {
    m.mem.fill(p, 320, 0);
    m.mem.write_u32(p, if is_dir { FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY } else { FILE_ATTRIBUTE_ARCHIVE });
    for off in [4, 12, 20] {
        m.mem.write_u64(p + off, mtime);
    }
    m.mem.write_u32(p + 28, (size >> 32) as u32);
    m.mem.write_u32(p + 32, size as u32);
    let n: String = name.chars().take(259).collect();
    m.mem.write_cstr(p + 44, &n);
}

/// `FindFirstFileA(pattern, WIN32_FIND_DATAA*)`. Like Windows, "." and ".." are listed first for
/// subdirectories when the pattern matches them.
fn find_first_file_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (pp, data) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1));
    let pattern_full = m.mem.read_cstr(pp);
    let r = find_first_inner(m, &pattern_full, data);
    flog(m, || format!("FindFirstFileA({pattern_full:?}) -> {:?}", match &r { ThunkResult::Return { eax, .. } => *eax, _ => 0 }));
    r
}

fn find_first_inner(m: &mut Machine, pattern_full: &str, data: u32) -> ThunkResult {
    let (dir, pat) = split_dir(pattern_full);
    if pat.is_empty() || !m.vfs.is_dir(&dir) && !m.vfs.components(&dir).is_empty() {
        return fail(m, if pat.is_empty() { ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND } else { ERROR_PATH_NOT_FOUND }, INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE, 2);
    }
    let mut entries = Vec::new();
    for dot in [".", ".."] {
        if wildcard_match(&pat, dot) && pat.contains(['*', '?']) {
            entries.push((dot.to_string(), true, 0, 0));
        }
    }
    for e in m.vfs.list_dir(&dir) {
        if wildcard_match(&pat, &e.name) {
            let mt = std::fs::metadata(&e.host_path).and_then(|md| md.modified()).map(systemtime_to_filetime).unwrap_or(0);
            entries.push((e.name, e.is_dir, e.size, mt));
        }
    }
    if entries.is_empty() {
        return fail(m, ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND, INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE, 2);
    }
    let (n, d, s, t) = entries[0].clone();
    write_find_data(m, data, &n, d, s, t);
    let h = m.handles.insert(KernelObject::Other("find", Box::new(FindObj { entries, pos: 1 })));
    ThunkResult::stdcall(h, 2)
}

fn find_next_file_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (h, data) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1));
    let Some(f) = m.handles.get_other_mut::<FindObj>(h) else { return fail(m, ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE, 0, 2) };
    let Some(e) = f.entries.get(f.pos).cloned() else { return fail(m, ERROR_NO_MORE_FILES, 0, 2) };
    f.pos += 1;
    write_find_data(m, data, &e.0, e.1, e.2, e.3);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(1, 2)
}

fn find_close(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let h = m.arg_u32(0);
    if m.handles.get_other::<FindObj>(h).is_none() {
        return fail(m, ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE, 0, 1);
    }
    let _ = m.handles.close(h);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(1, 1)
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- file system ops

fn vfs_result(m: &mut Machine, api: &str, r: Result<(), u32>, nargs: u32) -> ThunkResult {
    flog(m, || {
        let args: Vec<String> = (0..nargs.min(2)).map(|i| m.arg_str(i).unwrap_or_default()).collect();
        format!("{} {:?} -> {:?}", api, args, r)
    });
    match r {
        Ok(()) => ThunkResult::stdcall(1, nargs),
        Err(e) => fail(m, e, 0, nargs),
    }
}

fn delete_file_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let name = m.arg_str(0).unwrap_or_default();
    let r = m.vfs.remove_file(&name);
    vfs_result(m, "DeleteFileA", r, 1)
}

fn move_file_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (a, b) = (m.arg_str(0).unwrap_or_default(), m.arg_str(1).unwrap_or_default());
    let r = m.vfs.rename(&a, &b);
    vfs_result(m, "MoveFileA", r, 2)
}

fn copy_file_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (a, b, fx) = (m.arg_str(0).unwrap_or_default(), m.arg_str(1).unwrap_or_default(), m.arg_u32(2) != 0);
    let r = m.vfs.copy(&a, &b, fx);
    vfs_result(m, "CopyFileA", r, 3)
}

fn create_directory_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let a = m.arg_str(0).unwrap_or_default();
    let r = m.vfs.create_dir(&a);
    vfs_result(m, "CreateDirectoryA", r, 2)
}

fn remove_directory_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let a = m.arg_str(0).unwrap_or_default();
    let r = m.vfs.remove_dir(&a);
    vfs_result(m, "RemoveDirectoryA", r, 1)
}

fn get_file_attributes_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let name = m.arg_str(0).unwrap_or_default();
    if m.vfs.components(&name).is_empty() {
        return ThunkResult::stdcall(FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY, 1);
    }
    match m.vfs.resolve_read(&name) {
        Some(p) => {
            let a = if p.is_dir() { FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY } else { FILE_ATTRIBUTE_ARCHIVE };
            ThunkResult::stdcall(a, 1)
        }
        None => {
            let e = not_found_err(&m.vfs, &name);
            fail(m, e, u32::MAX, 1)
        }
    }
}

/// Attributes are not stored (READONLY etc. are accepted and ignored).
fn set_file_attributes_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let name = m.arg_str(0).unwrap_or_default();
    let attrs = m.arg_u32(1);
    if m.vfs.resolve_read(&name).is_none() {
        let e = not_found_err(&m.vfs, &name);
        return fail(m, e, 0, 2);
    }
    if attrs & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_READONLY != 0 {
        m.log(LogLevel::Debug, &format!("SetFileAttributesA({name}, {attrs:#x}): attributes not stored"));
    }
    ThunkResult::stdcall(1, 2)
}

/// Write `s` + NUL into a buffer of `size` chars; returns the Win32 "length or required size" value.
fn put_path(m: &mut Machine, buf: u32, size: u32, s: &str) -> u32 {
    let len = s.len() as u32;
    if buf != 0 && size > len {
        m.mem.write_cstr(buf, s);
        len
    } else {
        len + 1
    }
}

/// `GetFullPathNameA(name, size, buf, *filepart)`: normalized absolute guest path (always under `C:\S3`).
fn get_full_path_name_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (size, buf, pfile) = (m.arg_u32(1), m.arg_u32(2), m.arg_u32(3));
    let name = m.arg_str(0).unwrap_or_default();
    let parts = m.vfs.components(&name);
    let mut full = Vfs::guest_path(&parts);
    if (name.ends_with('\\') || name.ends_with('/')) && !full.ends_with('\\') {
        full.push('\\');
    }
    let r = put_path(m, buf, size, &full);
    if pfile != 0 && buf != 0 && r < size {
        let file_off = full.rfind('\\').map(|i| i as u32 + 1).unwrap_or(0);
        m.mem.write_u32(pfile, if file_off as usize >= full.len() { 0 } else { buf + file_off });
    }
    ThunkResult::stdcall(r, 4)
}

fn get_current_directory_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (size, buf) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1));
    let cwd = m.vfs.cwd.clone();
    let r = put_path(m, buf, size, &cwd);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(r, 2)
}

fn set_current_directory_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let name = m.arg_str(0).unwrap_or_default();
    if m.vfs.set_cwd(&name) {
        ThunkResult::stdcall(1, 1)
    } else {
        let e = not_found_err(&m.vfs, &name);
        fail(m, e, 0, 1)
    }
}

/// `GetVolumeInformationA(root, name, nsize, *serial, *maxcomp, *flags, fsname, fssize)`.
fn get_volume_information_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (name, nsize, ser, maxc, fl, fs, fssize) =
        (m.arg_u32(1), m.arg_u32(2), m.arg_u32(3), m.arg_u32(4), m.arg_u32(5), m.arg_u32(6), m.arg_u32(7));
    if name != 0 && nsize > 2 {
        m.mem.write_cstr(name, "S3");
    }
    if ser != 0 {
        m.mem.write_u32(ser, 0x5333_0001);
    }
    if maxc != 0 {
        m.mem.write_u32(maxc, 255);
    }
    if fl != 0 {
        m.mem.write_u32(fl, 0x3); // case-preserved, case-sensitive search
    }
    if fs != 0 && fssize > 4 {
        m.mem.write_cstr(fs, "FAT32");
    }
    ThunkResult::stdcall(1, 8)
}

/// `GetDiskFreeSpaceA(root, *spc, *bps, *free, *total)`: 1 GiB free of 2 GiB (fits 32-bit math).
fn get_disk_free_space_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let vals = [8u32, 512, 262_144, 524_288];
    for (i, v) in vals.iter().enumerate() {
        let p = m.arg_u32(1 + i as u32);
        if p != 0 {
            m.mem.write_u32(p, *v);
        }
    }
    ThunkResult::stdcall(1, 5)
}

const TEMP_DIR: &str = "C:\\S3\\TEMP\\";

fn get_temp_path_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (size, buf) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1));
    let _ = m.vfs.resolve_write(&format!("{TEMP_DIR}x"));
    let r = put_path(m, buf, size, TEMP_DIR);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(r, 2)
}

/// `GetTempFileNameA(dir, prefix, unique, buf)`.
fn get_temp_file_name_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (unique, buf) = (m.arg_u32(2), m.arg_u32(3));
    let dir = m.arg_str(0).unwrap_or_else(|| ".".into());
    let prefix: String = m.arg_str(1).unwrap_or_default().chars().take(3).collect();
    let dir = dir.trim_end_matches(['\\', '/']).to_string();
    let mut n = if unique != 0 { unique & 0xFFFF } else { (m.now_ms() as u32 & 0xFFFF).max(1) };
    let path = loop {
        let p = format!("{dir}\\{prefix}{n:04X}.TMP");
        if unique != 0 || m.vfs.resolve_read(&p).is_none() {
            break p;
        }
        n = (n + 1) & 0xFFFF;
    };
    if unique == 0 {
        if let Ok(hp) = m.vfs.create_path(&path) {
            let _ = File::create(hp);
        }
    }
    m.mem.write_cstr(buf, &path);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(n, 4)
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- mappings

/// `CreateFileMappingA(hFile, sa, protect, max_hi, max_lo, name)`.
fn create_file_mapping_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (hf, hi, lo, name) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(3), m.arg_u32(4), m.arg_str(5));
    if let Some(n) = &name {
        if let Some(h) = m.handles.open_named(n) {
            m.set_last_error(ERROR_ALREADY_EXISTS);
            return ThunkResult::stdcall(h, 6);
        }
    }
    let max = (hi as u64) << 32 | lo as u64;
    let obj = if hf == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE {
        if max == 0 {
            return fail(m, ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER, 0, 6);
        }
        MappingObj { file: None, size: max, anon_base: None }
    } else {
        let Some(f) = m.handles.get_other::<FileObj>(hf) else { return fail(m, ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE, 0, 6) };
        let len = f.file.metadata().map(|md| md.len()).unwrap_or(0);
        let Ok(file) = f.file.try_clone() else { return fail(m, ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED, 0, 6) };
        if max > len {
            // Windows would grow the file; we do not (HYPOTHESIS: the game only maps existing data files).
            m.log(LogLevel::Warn, &format!("CreateFileMappingA: size {max} > file size {len}; not growing"));
        }
        let size = if max == 0 { len } else { max };
        if size == 0 {
            return fail(m, 1006, 0, 6); // ERROR_FILE_INVALID (empty file)
        }
        MappingObj { file: Some(file), size, anon_base: None }
    };
    m.set_last_error(0);
    let h = m.handles.insert_named(KernelObject::Other("mapping", Box::new(obj)), name);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(h, 6)
}

fn open_file_mapping_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let h = m.arg_str(2).and_then(|n| m.handles.open_named(&n)).unwrap_or(0);
    if h == 0 {
        m.set_last_error(ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND);
    }
    ThunkResult::stdcall(h, 3)
}

/// `MapViewOfFile(hMap, access, off_hi, off_lo, size)`.
fn map_view_of_file(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (hm, ohi, olo, n) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(2), m.arg_u32(3), m.arg_u32(4));
    let off = (ohi as u64) << 32 | olo as u64;
    if off % layout::ALLOC_GRANULARITY as u64 != 0 {
        return fail(m, ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER /* MAPPED_ALIGNMENT */, 0, 5);
    }
    let Some(mo) = m.handles.get_other::<MappingObj>(hm) else { return fail(m, ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE, 0, 5) };
    if off >= mo.size {
        return fail(m, ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED, 0, 5);
    }
    let len = if n == 0 { (mo.size - off).min(u32::MAX as u64) as u32 } else { n };
    if off + len as u64 > mo.size {
        return fail(m, ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED, 0, 5);
    }
    let anon = mo.file.is_none();
    if anon {
        // Pagefile-backed: one shared block; views alias it.
        let size = mo.size;
        let base = match mo.anon_base {
            Some(b) => b,
            None => {
                let Ok(b) = m.mem.alloc_region(
                    None,
                    align_up(size as u32, layout::ALLOC_GRANULARITY),
                    RegionKind::Mapped,
                    (layout::ALLOC_ARENA_START, layout::ALLOC_ARENA_END),
                ) else {
                    return fail(m, ERROR_NOT_ENOUGH_MEMORY, 0, 5);
                };
                if let Some(mo) = m.handles.get_other_mut::<MappingObj>(hm) {
                    mo.anon_base = Some(b);
                }
                b
            }
        };
        let v = base + off as u32;
        let st = m.state::<Views>();
        st.borrow_mut().views.insert(v, (len, false));
        return ThunkResult::stdcall(v, 5);
    }
    let Ok(file) = mo.file.as_ref().unwrap().try_clone() else { return fail(m, ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED, 0, 5) };
    let Ok(base) = m.mem.alloc_region(
        None,
        align_up(len, layout::ALLOC_GRANULARITY),
        RegionKind::Mapped,
        (layout::ALLOC_ARENA_START, layout::ALLOC_ARENA_END),
    ) else {
        return fail(m, ERROR_NOT_ENOUGH_MEMORY, 0, 5);
    };
    if let Err(e) = s3_runtime::mapfile::map_file_into(&mut m.mem, base, &file, off, len) {
        m.log(LogLevel::Warn, &format!("MapViewOfFile: {e}"));
        let _ = m.mem.virtual_free(base, 0, s3_mem::MEM_RELEASE);
        return fail(m, ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED, 0, 5);
    }
    let st = m.state::<Views>();
    st.borrow_mut().views.insert(base, (len, true));
    ThunkResult::stdcall(base, 5)
}

fn unmap_view_of_file(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let p = m.arg_u32(0);
    let st = m.state::<Views>();
    let v = st.borrow_mut().views.remove(&p);
    match v {
        Some((len, true)) => {
            s3_runtime::mapfile::unmap_file(&mut m.mem, p, len);
            let _ = m.mem.virtual_free(p, 0, s3_mem::MEM_RELEASE);
            ThunkResult::stdcall(1, 1)
        }
        Some((_, false)) => ThunkResult::stdcall(1, 1),
        None => fail(m, 487 /* ERROR_INVALID_ADDRESS */, 0, 1),
    }
}
```

```rs
//! kernel32: code pages, locale and string functions (MultiByteToWideChar, GetLocaleInfo, LCMapString,
//! GetStringType, CompareString, lstr*).
//!
//! The guest runs in locale 0x0409 (English, US) with ANSI code page 1252 and OEM code page 437
//! (HYPOTHESIS: the game picks its text language from the registry value `Language`, not from the locale).
//! All ANSI<->UTF-16 conversions use Windows-1252 regardless of the code page argument (UTF-8 = 65001 is
//! honoured); every byte is a single character (no DBCS lead bytes).

use s3_runtime::{Machine, Registry, ThunkResult};

use super::DLL;

pub const LCID_DEFAULT: u32 = 0x0409;
pub const ACP: u32 = 1252;
pub const OEMCP: u32 = 437;
const CP_UTF8: u32 = 65001;
const ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_BUFFER: u32 = 122;
const ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER: u32 = 87;
const ERROR_INVALID_FLAGS: u32 = 1004;

pub(crate) fn register(reg: &mut Registry) {
    reg.register(DLL, "GetACP", |_m| ThunkResult::stdcall(ACP, 0));
    reg.register(DLL, "GetOEMCP", |_m| ThunkResult::stdcall(OEMCP, 0));
    reg.register(DLL, "GetCPInfo", get_cp_info);
    reg.register(DLL, "IsValidCodePage", is_valid_code_page);
    reg.register(DLL, "GetUserDefaultLCID", |_m| ThunkResult::stdcall(LCID_DEFAULT, 0));
    reg.register(DLL, "GetSystemDefaultLCID", |_m| ThunkResult::stdcall(LCID_DEFAULT, 0));
    reg.register(DLL, "GetUserDefaultLangID", |_m| ThunkResult::stdcall(LCID_DEFAULT, 0));
    reg.register(DLL, "GetSystemDefaultLangID", |_m| ThunkResult::stdcall(LCID_DEFAULT, 0));
    reg.register(DLL, "GetThreadLocale", |_m| ThunkResult::stdcall(LCID_DEFAULT, 0));
    reg.register(DLL, "IsValidLocale", |_m| ThunkResult::stdcall(1, 2));
    reg.register(DLL, "EnumSystemLocalesA", enum_system_locales_a);
    reg.register(DLL, "GetLocaleInfoA", get_locale_info_a);
    reg.register(DLL, "GetLocaleInfoW", get_locale_info_w);
    reg.register(DLL, "MultiByteToWideChar", multi_byte_to_wide_char);
    reg.register(DLL, "WideCharToMultiByte", wide_char_to_multi_byte);
    reg.register(DLL, "GetStringTypeA", get_string_type_a);
    reg.register(DLL, "GetStringTypeW", get_string_type_w);
    reg.register(DLL, "LCMapStringA", lc_map_string_a);
    reg.register(DLL, "LCMapStringW", lc_map_string_w);
    reg.register(DLL, "CompareStringA", compare_string_a);
    reg.register(DLL, "CompareStringW", compare_string_w);
    reg.register(DLL, "lstrlenA", lstrlen_a);
    reg.register(DLL, "lstrlenW", lstrlen_w);
    reg.register(DLL, "lstrcpyA", lstrcpy_a);
    reg.register(DLL, "lstrcpynA", lstrcpyn_a);
    reg.register(DLL, "lstrcatA", lstrcat_a);
    reg.register(DLL, "lstrcmpA", lstrcmp_a);
    reg.register(DLL, "lstrcmpiA", lstrcmpi_a);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- cp1252

/// Windows-1252 bytes 0x80..0x9F (0 = undefined, mapped to the C1 control of the same value like Windows).
const CP1252_80: [u16; 32] = [
    0x20AC, 0x0081, 0x201A, 0x0192, 0x201E, 0x2026, 0x2020, 0x2021, 0x02C6, 0x2030, 0x0160, 0x2039, 0x0152, 0x008D,
    0x017D, 0x008F, 0x0090, 0x2018, 0x2019, 0x201C, 0x201D, 0x2022, 0x2013, 0x2014, 0x02DC, 0x2122, 0x0161, 0x203A,
    0x0153, 0x009D, 0x017E, 0x0178,
];

/// One cp1252 byte -> UTF-16 unit.
pub fn cp1252_to_u16(b: u8) -> u16 {
    if (0x80..0xA0).contains(&b) {
        CP1252_80[(b - 0x80) as usize]
    } else {
        b as u16
    }
}

/// One UTF-16 unit -> cp1252 byte (`None` if not representable).
pub fn u16_to_cp1252(u: u16) -> Option<u8> {
    if u < 0x80 || (0xA0..=0xFF).contains(&u) {
        return Some(u as u8);
    }
    CP1252_80.iter().position(|&c| c == u).map(|i| 0x80 + i as u8)
}

fn decode(cp: u32, bytes: &[u8]) -> Vec<u16> {
    if cp == CP_UTF8 {
        String::from_utf8_lossy(bytes).encode_utf16().collect()
    } else {
        bytes.iter().map(|&b| cp1252_to_u16(b)).collect()
    }
}

/// Encode; returns (bytes, used_default_char).
fn encode(cp: u32, units: &[u16], default: u8) -> (Vec<u8>, bool) {
    if cp == CP_UTF8 {
        return (String::from_utf16_lossy(units).into_bytes(), false);
    }
    let mut used = false;
    let v = units
        .iter()
        .map(|&u| {
            u16_to_cp1252(u).unwrap_or_else(|| {
                used = true;
                default
            })
        })
        .collect();
    (v, used)
}

/// Read an ANSI string argument with explicit length (`-1` = NUL-terminated, NUL included).
fn read_a(m: &Machine, p: u32, n: i32) -> Vec<u8> {
    if p == 0 {
        return Vec::new();
    }
    if n < 0 {
        let mut v = m.mem.read_cstr_bytes(p);
        v.push(0);
        v
    } else {
        m.mem.read_bytes(p, n as usize)
    }
}

/// Read a UTF-16 string argument with explicit length (`-1` = NUL-terminated, NUL included).
fn read_w(m: &Machine, p: u32, n: i32) -> Vec<u16> {
    if p == 0 {
        return Vec::new();
    }
    if n < 0 {
        let mut v = Vec::new();
        let mut a = p;
        loop {
            let u = m.mem.read_u16(a);
            v.push(u);
            if u == 0 || v.len() > 0x10_0000 {
                break;
            }
            a += 2;
        }
        v
    } else {
        (0..n as u32).map(|i| m.mem.read_u16(p + 2 * i)).collect()
    }
}

fn write_w(m: &mut Machine, p: u32, units: &[u16]) {
    for (i, &u) in units.iter().enumerate() {
        m.mem.write_u16(p + 2 * i as u32, u);
    }
}

fn get_cp_info(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (cp, info) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1));
    if !valid_cp(cp) || info == 0 {
        m.set_last_error(ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER);
        return ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 2);
    }
    // CPINFO { UINT MaxCharSize; BYTE DefaultChar[2]; BYTE LeadByte[12]; }
    m.mem.fill(info, 20, 0);
    m.mem.write_u32(info, if cp == CP_UTF8 { 4 } else { 1 });
    m.mem.write_u8(info + 4, b'?');
    ThunkResult::stdcall(1, 2)
}

fn valid_cp(cp: u32) -> bool {
    matches!(cp, 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 437 | 850 | 1252 | 28591 | 20127 | CP_UTF8)
}

fn is_valid_code_page(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let cp = m.arg_u32(0);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(valid_cp(cp) as u32, 1)
}

fn enum_system_locales_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let cb = m.arg_u32(0);
    if cb != 0 {
        let s = m.mem.alloc(16);
        m.mem.write_cstr(s, "00000409");
        m.call_guest(cb, &[s]);
        m.mem.free(s);
    }
    ThunkResult::stdcall(1, 2)
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- locale info

const DAYS: [&str; 7] = ["Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday", "Sunday"];
const MONTHS: [&str; 12] = [
    "January", "February", "March", "April", "May", "June", "July", "August", "September", "October", "November",
    "December",
];

/// `GetLocaleInfo` data for en-US (LCTYPE without flags).
pub fn locale_info(lctype: u32) -> Option<String> {
    let s = match lctype {
        0x01 => "0409",                        // LOCALE_ILANGUAGE
        0x02 => "English (United States)",     // LOCALE_SLANGUAGE
        0x03 => "ENU",                         // LOCALE_SABBREVLANGNAME
        0x04 => "English",                     // LOCALE_SNATIVELANGNAME
        0x05 => "1",                           // LOCALE_ICOUNTRY
        0x06 => "United States",               // LOCALE_SCOUNTRY
        0x07 => "USA",                         // LOCALE_SABBREVCTRYNAME
        0x08 => "United States",               // LOCALE_SNATIVECTRYNAME
        0x09 => "0409",                        // LOCALE_IDEFAULTLANGUAGE
        0x0A => "1",                           // LOCALE_IDEFAULTCOUNTRY
        0x0B => "437",                         // LOCALE_IDEFAULTCODEPAGE (OEM)
        0x0C => ",",                           // LOCALE_SLIST
        0x0D => "1",                           // LOCALE_IMEASURE (US)
        0x0E => ".",                           // LOCALE_SDECIMAL
        0x0F => ",",                           // LOCALE_STHOUSAND
        0x10 => "3;0",                         // LOCALE_SGROUPING
        0x11 => "2",                           // LOCALE_IDIGITS
        0x12 => "1",                           // LOCALE_ILZERO
        0x13 => "0123456789",                  // LOCALE_SNATIVEDIGITS
        0x14 => "$",                           // LOCALE_SCURRENCY
        0x15 => "USD",                         // LOCALE_SINTLSYMBOL
        0x16 => ".",                           // LOCALE_SMONDECIMALSEP
        0x17 => ",",                           // LOCALE_SMONTHOUSANDSEP
        0x18 => "3;0",                         // LOCALE_SMONGROUPING
        0x19 => "2",                           // LOCALE_ICURRDIGITS
        0x1A => "2",                           // LOCALE_IINTLCURRDIGITS
        0x1B => "0",                           // LOCALE_ICURRENCY
        0x1C => "0",                           // LOCALE_INEGCURR
        0x1D => "/",                           // LOCALE_SDATE
        0x1E => ":",                           // LOCALE_STIME
        0x1F => "M/d/yyyy",                    // LOCALE_SSHORTDATE
        0x20 => "dddd, MMMM dd, yyyy",         // LOCALE_SLONGDATE
        0x21 => "0",                           // LOCALE_IDATE
        0x22 => "0",                           // LOCALE_ILDATE
        0x23 => "0",                           // LOCALE_ITIME
        0x24 => "1",                           // LOCALE_ICENTURY
        0x25 => "0",                           // LOCALE_ITLZERO
        0x26 => "0",                           // LOCALE_IDAYLZERO
        0x27 => "0",                           // LOCALE_IMONLZERO
        0x28 => "AM",                          // LOCALE_S1159
        0x29 => "PM",                          // LOCALE_S2359
        0x2A..=0x30 => DAYS[(lctype - 0x2A) as usize],
        0x31..=0x37 => &DAYS[(lctype - 0x31) as usize][..3],
        0x38..=0x43 => MONTHS[(lctype - 0x38) as usize],
        0x44..=0x4F => &MONTHS[(lctype - 0x44) as usize][..3],
        0x50 => "",                            // LOCALE_SPOSITIVESIGN
        0x51 => "-",                           // LOCALE_SNEGATIVESIGN
        0x52..=0x57 => "0",                    // sign positions etc.
        0x1001 => "English",                   // LOCALE_SENGLANGUAGE
        0x1002 => "United States",             // LOCALE_SENGCOUNTRY
        0x1003 => "h:mm:ss tt",                // LOCALE_STIMEFORMAT
        0x1004 => "1252",                      // LOCALE_IDEFAULTANSICODEPAGE
        0x1005 => "0",                         // LOCALE_ITIMEMARKPOSN
        0x1007 => "Dollar",                    // LOCALE_SENGCURRNAME
        0x1008 => "US Dollar",                 // LOCALE_SNATIVECURRNAME
        0x1009 => "1",                         // LOCALE_ICALENDARTYPE
        0x100A => "0",                         // LOCALE_IOPTIONALCALENDAR
        0x100B => "0",                         // LOCALE_IFIRSTDAYOFWEEK (Monday=0... en-US: 6) — keep 6 below
        0x100C => "0",                         // LOCALE_IFIRSTWEEKOFYEAR
        0x1014 => "-",                         // LOCALE_SNEGATIVESIGN (alt)
        0x1016 => "MMMM, yyyy",                // LOCALE_SYEARMONTH
        0x1018 => "1",                         // LOCALE_IDEFAULTEBCDICCODEPAGE (unused)
        0x1059 | 0x105A => "",                 // abbreviated names (Vista+)
        _ => return None,
    };
    if lctype == 0x100B {
        return Some("6".into());
    }
    Some(s.to_string())
}

const LOCALE_RETURN_NUMBER: u32 = 0x2000_0000;

fn get_locale_info(m: &mut Machine, wide: bool) -> ThunkResult {
    let (_lcid, lctype, buf, n) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1), m.arg_u32(2), m.arg_i32(3));
    let ty = lctype & 0x0FFF_FFFF & !0x8000_0000;
    let Some(s) = locale_info(ty & 0xFFFF) else {
        m.log(s3_runtime::LogLevel::Debug, &format!("GetLocaleInfo: unknown LCTYPE {lctype:#x}"));
        m.set_last_error(ERROR_INVALID_FLAGS);
        return ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 4);
    };
    if lctype & LOCALE_RETURN_NUMBER != 0 {
        let v: u32 = s.parse().unwrap_or(0);
        let need = if wide { 2 } else { 4 };
        if n == 0 {
            return ThunkResult::stdcall(need, 4);
        }
        if (n as u32) < need {
            m.set_last_error(ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_BUFFER);
            return ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 4);
        }
        m.mem.write_u32(buf, v);
        return ThunkResult::stdcall(need, 4);
    }
    let need = s.chars().count() as u32 + 1;
    if n == 0 {
        return ThunkResult::stdcall(need, 4);
    }
    if (n as u32) < need {
        m.set_last_error(ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_BUFFER);
        return ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 4);
    }
    if wide {
        m.mem.write_wstr(buf, &s);
    } else {
        m.mem.write_cstr(buf, &s);
    }
    ThunkResult::stdcall(need, 4)
}

fn get_locale_info_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    get_locale_info(m, false)
}

fn get_locale_info_w(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    get_locale_info(m, true)
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- conversions

/// `MultiByteToWideChar(cp, flags, src, cb, dst, cch)`.
fn multi_byte_to_wide_char(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (cp, _flags, src, cb, dst, cch) =
        (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1), m.arg_u32(2), m.arg_i32(3), m.arg_u32(4), m.arg_i32(5));
    if src == 0 || cb == 0 || cch < 0 {
        m.set_last_error(ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER);
        return ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 6);
    }
    let units = decode(cp, &read_a(m, src, cb));
    if cch == 0 {
        return ThunkResult::stdcall(units.len() as u32, 6);
    }
    if units.len() > cch as usize {
        write_w(m, dst, &units[..cch as usize]);
        m.set_last_error(ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_BUFFER);
        return ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 6);
    }
    write_w(m, dst, &units);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(units.len() as u32, 6)
}

/// `WideCharToMultiByte(cp, flags, src, cch, dst, cb, default_char, used_default)`.
fn wide_char_to_multi_byte(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (cp, _flags, src, cch, dst, cb, defp, usedp) = (
        m.arg_u32(0),
        m.arg_u32(1),
        m.arg_u32(2),
        m.arg_i32(3),
        m.arg_u32(4),
        m.arg_i32(5),
        m.arg_u32(6),
        m.arg_u32(7),
    );
    if src == 0 || cch == 0 || cb < 0 {
        m.set_last_error(ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER);
        return ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 8);
    }
    let default = if defp != 0 { m.mem.read_u8(defp) } else { b'?' };
    let (bytes, used) = encode(cp, &read_w(m, src, cch), default);
    if usedp != 0 {
        m.mem.write_u32(usedp, used as u32);
    }
    if cb == 0 {
        return ThunkResult::stdcall(bytes.len() as u32, 8);
    }
    if bytes.len() > cb as usize {
        m.mem.write_bytes(dst, &bytes[..cb as usize]);
        m.set_last_error(ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_BUFFER);
        return ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 8);
    }
    m.mem.write_bytes(dst, &bytes);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(bytes.len() as u32, 8)
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- char types

const C1_UPPER: u16 = 0x1;
const C1_LOWER: u16 = 0x2;
const C1_DIGIT: u16 = 0x4;
const C1_SPACE: u16 = 0x8;
const C1_PUNCT: u16 = 0x10;
const C1_CNTRL: u16 = 0x20;
const C1_BLANK: u16 = 0x40;
const C1_XDIGIT: u16 = 0x80;
const C1_ALPHA: u16 = 0x100;

/// CT_CTYPE1 flags of a UTF-16 unit.
pub fn ctype1(u: u16) -> u16 {
    let Some(c) = char::from_u32(u as u32) else { return 0 };
    let mut f = 0;
    if c.is_uppercase() {
        f |= C1_UPPER | C1_ALPHA;
    }
    if c.is_lowercase() {
        f |= C1_LOWER | C1_ALPHA;
    }
    if c.is_alphabetic() {
        f |= C1_ALPHA;
    }
    if c.is_ascii_digit() {
        f |= C1_DIGIT;
    }
    if c.is_ascii_hexdigit() {
        f |= C1_XDIGIT;
    }
    if matches!(c, ' ' | '\t' | '\n' | '\r' | '\x0b' | '\x0c') || u == 0xA0 {
        f |= C1_SPACE;
    }
    if c == ' ' || c == '\t' || u == 0xA0 {
        f |= C1_BLANK;
    }
    if c.is_control() {
        f |= C1_CNTRL;
    }
    if !c.is_control() && !c.is_alphanumeric() && !c.is_whitespace() && u != 0xA0 && u != 0 {
        f |= C1_PUNCT;
    }
    f
}

fn ctype(info: u32, u: u16) -> u16 {
    match info {
        1 => ctype1(u),
        2 => {
            // CT_CTYPE2: C2_LEFTTORIGHT for letters/digits, C2_WHITESPACE, C2_OTHERNEUTRAL
            let c1 = ctype1(u);
            if c1 & (C1_ALPHA | C1_DIGIT) != 0 {
                1
            } else if c1 & C1_SPACE != 0 {
                0xA
            } else {
                0xB
            }
        }
        _ => 0,
    }
}

/// `GetStringTypeA(lcid, info, src, cch, out)`.
fn get_string_type_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (_lcid, info, src, cch, out) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1), m.arg_u32(2), m.arg_i32(3), m.arg_u32(4));
    let mut bytes = read_a(m, src, cch);
    if cch < 0 {
        bytes.pop();
        bytes.push(0);
    }
    for (i, b) in bytes.iter().enumerate() {
        let v = ctype(info, cp1252_to_u16(*b));
        m.mem.write_u16(out + 2 * i as u32, v);
    }
    ThunkResult::stdcall(1, 5)
}

/// `GetStringTypeW(info, src, cch, out)`.
fn get_string_type_w(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (info, src, cch, out) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1), m.arg_i32(2), m.arg_u32(3));
    let units = read_w(m, src, cch);
    for (i, u) in units.iter().enumerate() {
        let v = ctype(info, *u);
        m.mem.write_u16(out + 2 * i as u32, v);
    }
    ThunkResult::stdcall(1, 4)
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- LCMapString

const LCMAP_LOWERCASE: u32 = 0x100;
const LCMAP_UPPERCASE: u32 = 0x200;
const LCMAP_SORTKEY: u32 = 0x400;
const NORM_IGNORECASE: u32 = 0x1;

fn upper(u: u16) -> u16 {
    match char::from_u32(u as u32) {
        Some(c) => {
            let mut it = c.to_uppercase();
            match (it.next(), it.next()) {
                (Some(x), None) if (x as u32) < 0x10000 => x as u16,
                _ => u,
            }
        }
        None => u,
    }
}

fn lower(u: u16) -> u16 {
    match char::from_u32(u as u32) {
        Some(c) => {
            let mut it = c.to_lowercase();
            match (it.next(), it.next()) {
                (Some(x), None) if (x as u32) < 0x10000 => x as u16,
                _ => u,
            }
        }
        None => u,
    }
}

/// Map units; for LCMAP_SORTKEY returns a byte key (case-insensitive when NORM_IGNORECASE).
fn lcmap(flags: u32, units: &[u16]) -> Result<Vec<u16>, Vec<u8>> {
    if flags & LCMAP_SORTKEY != 0 {
        let mut key = Vec::new();
        for &u in units {
            if u == 0 {
                break;
            }
            let k = if flags & NORM_IGNORECASE != 0 { upper(u) } else { u };
            key.push((k >> 8) as u8 + 1);
            key.push(k as u8);
        }
        key.push(0);
        return Err(key);
    }
    Ok(units
        .iter()
        .map(|&u| {
            if flags & LCMAP_UPPERCASE != 0 {
                upper(u)
            } else if flags & LCMAP_LOWERCASE != 0 {
                lower(u)
            } else {
                u
            }
        })
        .collect())
}

/// `LCMapStringA(lcid, flags, src, cch, dst, cchDest)`.
fn lc_map_string_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (_lcid, flags, src, cch, dst, cdst) =
        (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1), m.arg_u32(2), m.arg_i32(3), m.arg_u32(4), m.arg_i32(5));
    let units = decode(ACP, &read_a(m, src, cch));
    let out: Vec<u8> = match lcmap(flags, &units) {
        Ok(u) => encode(ACP, &u, b'?').0,
        Err(key) => key,
    };
    finish_bytes(m, dst, cdst, &out, 6)
}

fn finish_bytes(m: &mut Machine, dst: u32, cdst: i32, out: &[u8], nargs: u32) -> ThunkResult {
    if cdst == 0 {
        return ThunkResult::stdcall(out.len() as u32, nargs);
    }
    if out.len() > cdst as usize {
        m.set_last_error(ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_BUFFER);
        return ThunkResult::stdcall(0, nargs);
    }
    m.mem.write_bytes(dst, out);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(out.len() as u32, nargs)
}

/// `LCMapStringW(lcid, flags, src, cch, dst, cchDest)` (sort keys are bytes, `cchDest` counts bytes then).
fn lc_map_string_w(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (_lcid, flags, src, cch, dst, cdst) =
        (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1), m.arg_u32(2), m.arg_i32(3), m.arg_u32(4), m.arg_i32(5));
    let units = read_w(m, src, cch);
    match lcmap(flags, &units) {
        Err(key) => finish_bytes(m, dst, cdst, &key, 6),
        Ok(u) => {
            if cdst == 0 {
                return ThunkResult::stdcall(u.len() as u32, 6);
            }
            if u.len() > cdst as usize {
                m.set_last_error(ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_BUFFER);
                return ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 6);
            }
            write_w(m, dst, &u);
            ThunkResult::stdcall(u.len() as u32, 6)
        }
    }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- compare

fn compare(flags: u32, a: &[u16], b: &[u16]) -> u32 {
    let strip = |v: &[u16]| -> Vec<u16> {
        let end = v.iter().position(|&u| u == 0).unwrap_or(v.len());
        v[..end].iter().map(|&u| if flags & NORM_IGNORECASE != 0 { upper(u) } else { u }).collect()
    };
    match strip(a).cmp(&strip(b)) {
        std::cmp::Ordering::Less => 1,
        std::cmp::Ordering::Equal => 2,
        std::cmp::Ordering::Greater => 3,
    }
}

/// `CompareStringA(lcid, flags, s1, c1, s2, c2)` -> CSTR_LESS_THAN 1 / CSTR_EQUAL 2 / CSTR_GREATER_THAN 3.
fn compare_string_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (_l, flags, s1, c1, s2, c2) =
        (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1), m.arg_u32(2), m.arg_i32(3), m.arg_u32(4), m.arg_i32(5));
    let a = decode(ACP, &read_a(m, s1, c1));
    let b = decode(ACP, &read_a(m, s2, c2));
    ThunkResult::stdcall(compare(flags, &a, &b), 6)
}

fn compare_string_w(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (_l, flags, s1, c1, s2, c2) =
        (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1), m.arg_u32(2), m.arg_i32(3), m.arg_u32(4), m.arg_i32(5));
    let a = read_w(m, s1, c1);
    let b = read_w(m, s2, c2);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(compare(flags, &a, &b), 6)
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- lstr*

fn lstrlen_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let p = m.arg_u32(0);
    let n = if p < 0x1_0000 { 0 } else { m.mem.strlen(p, 0x100_0000) as u32 };
    ThunkResult::stdcall(n, 1)
}

fn lstrlen_w(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let p = m.arg_u32(0);
    let n = if p < 0x1_0000 { 0 } else { read_w(m, p, -1).len() as u32 - 1 };
    ThunkResult::stdcall(n, 1)
}

fn lstrcpy_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (d, s) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1));
    if d < 0x1_0000 || s < 0x1_0000 {
        return ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 2);
    }
    let n = m.mem.strlen(s, 0x100_0000);
    m.mem.copy_within(s, d, n + 1);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(d, 2)
}

fn lstrcpyn_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (d, s, n) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1), m.arg_i32(2));
    if d < 0x1_0000 || s < 0x1_0000 || n <= 0 {
        return ThunkResult::stdcall(if n == 0 { d } else { 0 }, 3);
    }
    let len = m.mem.strlen(s, (n - 1) as usize);
    m.mem.copy_within(s, d, len);
    m.mem.write_u8(d + len as u32, 0);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(d, 3)
}

fn lstrcat_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (d, s) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1));
    if d < 0x1_0000 || s < 0x1_0000 {
        return ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 2);
    }
    let dl = m.mem.strlen(d, 0x100_0000) as u32;
    let n = m.mem.strlen(s, 0x100_0000);
    m.mem.copy_within(s, d + dl, n + 1);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(d, 2)
}

fn lstrcmp_impl(m: &mut Machine, flags: u32) -> ThunkResult {
    let (s1, s2) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1));
    let a = if s1 == 0 { vec![] } else { decode(ACP, &m.mem.read_cstr_bytes(s1)) };
    let b = if s2 == 0 { vec![] } else { decode(ACP, &m.mem.read_cstr_bytes(s2)) };
    let r = compare(flags, &a, &b) as i32 - 2;
    ThunkResult::stdcall(r as u32, 2)
}

fn lstrcmp_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    lstrcmp_impl(m, 0)
}

fn lstrcmpi_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    lstrcmp_impl(m, NORM_IGNORECASE)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn cp1252_roundtrip() {
        for b in 0u8..=255 {
            assert_eq!(u16_to_cp1252(cp1252_to_u16(b)), Some(b), "byte {b:#x}");
        }
        assert_eq!(cp1252_to_u16(0x80), 0x20AC);
        assert_eq!(u16_to_cp1252(0x4E00), None);

    fn ctype_flags() {
        assert_eq!(ctype1(b'A' as u16) & (C1_UPPER | C1_ALPHA | C1_XDIGIT), C1_UPPER | C1_ALPHA | C1_XDIGIT);
        assert_eq!(ctype1(b'7' as u16), C1_DIGIT | C1_XDIGIT);
        assert_eq!(ctype1(b' ' as u16), C1_SPACE | C1_BLANK);
        assert_eq!(ctype1(b',' as u16), C1_PUNCT);
        assert_eq!(ctype1(0xE4) & C1_LOWER, C1_LOWER); // ä
        assert_eq!(compare(NORM_IGNORECASE, &[b'a' as u16], &[b'A' as u16]), 2);
        assert_eq!(locale_info(0x1004).as_deref(), Some("1252"));
    }
}
```

`port/crates/s3-win32/src/kernel32_sync.rs`:

```rs
//! kernel32: threads, synchronisation objects, waits, critical sections, TLS, waitable timers, Sleep.
//!
//! Everything runs on the cooperative scheduler of `s3_runtime::Machine`: a wait that cannot be satisfied
//! returns `ThunkResult::Block` and the handler is called again on the next scheduling round (see
//! `Machine::poll_wait`). Critical sections live in the guest struct
//! (`{DebugInfo, LockCount, RecursionCount, OwningThread, LockSemaphore, SpinCount}`); a contended `Enter`
//! blocks, and `Leave` hands ownership directly to one blocked waiter (FIFO by thread slot order) so a thread
//! that re-enters in a loop cannot starve the others.

use s3_mem::align_up;
use s3_runtime::handles::{CURRENT_PROCESS, CURRENT_THREAD};
use s3_runtime::machine::teb;
use s3_runtime::{KernelObject, Machine, Registry, ThreadState, ThunkResult, WaitPoll};

use super::DLL;

pub const WAIT_OBJECT_0: u32 = 0;
pub const WAIT_TIMEOUT: u32 = 0x102;
pub const WAIT_FAILED: u32 = 0xFFFF_FFFF;
pub const INFINITE: u32 = 0xFFFF_FFFF;
const STILL_ACTIVE: u32 = 259;
const ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE: u32 = 6;
const ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER: u32 = 87;
const ERROR_ALREADY_EXISTS: u32 = 183;
const ERROR_TOO_MANY_POSTS: u32 = 298;
const ERROR_NOT_OWNER: u32 = 288;
const ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND: u32 = 2;
const MAXIMUM_WAIT_OBJECTS: u32 = 64;

pub(crate) fn register(reg: &mut Registry) {
    reg.register(DLL, "CreateThread", create_thread);
    reg.register(DLL, "ExitThread", exit_thread);
    reg.register(DLL, "ResumeThread", resume_thread);
    reg.register(DLL, "SuspendThread", suspend_thread);
    reg.register(DLL, "GetExitCodeThread", get_exit_code_thread);
    reg.register(DLL, "TerminateThread", terminate_thread);
    reg.register(DLL, "GetCurrentThread", |_m| ThunkResult::stdcall(CURRENT_THREAD, 0));
    reg.register(DLL, "GetCurrentThreadId", |m| ThunkResult::stdcall(m.current_tid(), 0));
    reg.register(DLL, "SetThreadPriority", set_thread_priority);
    reg.register(DLL, "GetThreadPriority", get_thread_priority);
    reg.register(DLL, "Sleep", sleep);
    reg.register(DLL, "SleepEx", sleep_ex);
    reg.register(DLL, "CreateEventA", create_event_a);
    reg.register(DLL, "OpenEventA", open_event_a);
    reg.register(DLL, "SetEvent", set_event);

    reg.register(DLL, "CreateSemaphoreA", create_semaphore_a);
    reg.register(DLL, "OpenSemaphoreA", open_semaphore_a);
    reg.register(DLL, "ReleaseSemaphore", release_semaphore);

    reg.register(DLL, "SetWaitableTimer", set_waitable_timer);
    reg.register(DLL, "CancelWaitableTimer", cancel_waitable_timer);
    reg.register(DLL, "WaitForSingleObject", wait_for_single_object);
    reg.register(DLL, "WaitForSingleObjectEx", wait_for_single_object_ex);
    reg.register(DLL, "WaitForMultipleObjects", wait_for_multiple_objects);
    reg.register(DLL, "WaitForMultipleObjectsEx", wait_for_multiple_objects_ex);
    reg.register(DLL, "InitializeCriticalSection", initialize_critical_section);
    reg.register(DLL, "InitializeCriticalSectionAndSpinCount", initialize_critical_section_spin);

    reg.register(DLL, "InterlockedDecrement", interlocked_decrement);
```
