```rs
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- threads

/// Thread slot for a thread handle (or the current-thread pseudo handle).
pub fn thread_slot(m: &Machine, h: u32) -> Option<usize> {
    if h == CURRENT_THREAD {
        return Some(m.cur);
    }
    match m.handles.get(h)? {
        KernelObject::Thread { tid } => m.thread_by_tid(*tid),
        _ => None,
    }
}

/// `CreateThread(sa, stack, start, param, flags, *tid)`.
fn create_thread(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (stack, start, param, flags, ptid) = (m.arg_u32(1), m.arg_u32(2), m.arg_u32(3), m.arg_u32(4), m.arg_u32(5));
    // Windows: `stack` is the initial *commit* (unless STACK_SIZE_PARAM_IS_A_RESERVATION 0x10000); the reserve
    // stays the PE default and is only raised (to a 1 MiB multiple) when the commit is larger. S3.EXE starts
    // threads with small values and then uses 256 KiB locals (save/load, FUN_004a5c80), so using `stack` as the
    // whole size made those frames run below the stack (SEH frames rejected -> "unhandled exception").
    let reserve = m.process.stack_reserve.max(0x1_0000);
    let size = if stack == 0 {
        reserve
    } else if flags & 0x1_0000 != 0 {
        stack.max(0x1_0000)
    } else if stack >= reserve {
        align_up(stack, 0x10_0000)
    } else {
        reserve
    };
    let suspended = flags & 4 != 0; // CREATE_SUSPENDED
    match m.create_thread(start, param, size, suspended) {
        Ok(slot) => {
            let (tid, h) = (m.threads[slot].tid, m.threads[slot].handle);
            if ptid != 0 {
                m.mem.write_u32(ptid, tid);
            }
            m.log(s3_runtime::LogLevel::Info, &format!("CreateThread entry={start:#x} param={param:#x} stack {stack:#x} -> {size:#x} -> tid {tid:#x} slot {slot}{}", if suspended { " (suspended)" } else { "" }));
            ThunkResult::stdcall(h, 6)
        }
        Err(e) => {
            m.log(s3_runtime::LogLevel::Warn, &format!("CreateThread failed: {e}"));
            m.set_last_error(8);
            ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 6)
        }
    }
}

fn exit_thread(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    ThunkResult::ExitThread(m.arg_u32(0))
}

fn resume_thread(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let h = m.arg_u32(0);
    let Some(slot) = thread_slot(m, h) else {
        m.set_last_error(ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE);
        return ThunkResult::stdcall(u32::MAX, 1);
    };
    let t = &mut m.threads[slot];
    let prev = match t.state {
        ThreadState::Suspended(n) => {
            t.state = if n <= 1 { ThreadState::Runnable } else { ThreadState::Suspended(n - 1) };
            n
        }
        _ => 0,
    };
    ThunkResult::stdcall(prev, 1)
}

fn suspend_thread(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let h = m.arg_u32(0);
    let Some(slot) = thread_slot(m, h) else {
        m.set_last_error(ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE);
        return ThunkResult::stdcall(u32::MAX, 1);
    };
    if slot == m.cur {
        // Suspending yourself would need to stop mid-thunk; not used by the game.
        m.log(s3_runtime::LogLevel::Warn, "SuspendThread(self) ignored");
        return ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 1);
    }
    let t = &mut m.threads[slot];
    let prev = match t.state {
        ThreadState::Suspended(n) => {
            t.state = ThreadState::Suspended(n + 1);
            n
        }
        ThreadState::Runnable => {
            t.state = ThreadState::Suspended(1);
            0
        }
        // A blocked thread stays blocked (HYPOTHESIS: good enough; the game never suspends threads).
        _ => 0,
    };
    ThunkResult::stdcall(prev, 1)
}

fn get_exit_code_thread(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (h, p) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1));
    let Some(slot) = thread_slot(m, h) else {
        m.set_last_error(ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE);
        return ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 2);
    };
    let code = match m.threads[slot].state {
        ThreadState::Exited(c) => c,
        _ => STILL_ACTIVE,
    };
    m.mem.write_u32(p, code);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(1, 2)
}

fn terminate_thread(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (h, code) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1));
    let Some(slot) = thread_slot(m, h) else {
        m.set_last_error(ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE);
        return ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 2);
    };
    if slot == m.cur {
        return ThunkResult::ExitThread(code);
    }
    m.exit_thread(slot, code);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(1, 2)
}

fn set_thread_priority(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (h, p) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_i32(1));
    match thread_slot(m, h) {
        Some(slot) => {
            m.threads[slot].priority = p;
            ThunkResult::stdcall(1, 2)
        }
        None => {
            m.set_last_error(ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE);
            ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 2)
        }
    }
}

fn get_thread_priority(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let h = m.arg_u32(0);
    match thread_slot(m, h) {
        Some(slot) => ThunkResult::stdcall(m.threads[slot].priority as u32, 1),
        None => ThunkResult::stdcall(0x7FFF_FFFF, 1),
    }
}

/// `Sleep(ms)`: always yields (also for 0); returns once `ms` host milliseconds have passed.
fn sleep(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let ms = m.arg_u32(0);
    match m.thread().block_since {
        None => ThunkResult::Block,
        Some(t0) => {
            if ms == 0 || (ms != INFINITE && m.now_ms().saturating_sub(t0) >= ms as u64) {
                ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 1)
            } else {
                ThunkResult::Block
            }
        }
    }
}

fn sleep_ex(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    match sleep(m) {
        ThunkResult::Return { .. } => ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 2),
        r => r,
    }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- objects

/// Create (or open, if `name` exists) a named object. Sets LastError = ERROR_ALREADY_EXISTS when opened.
fn create_named(m: &mut Machine, name: Option<String>, obj: KernelObject) -> u32 {
    if let Some(n) = &name {
        if let Some(h) = m.handles.open_named(n) {
            m.set_last_error(ERROR_ALREADY_EXISTS);
            return h;
        }
    }
    m.set_last_error(0);
    m.handles.insert_named(obj, name)
}

fn open_named(m: &mut Machine, name: Option<String>, nargs: u32) -> ThunkResult {
    let h = name.and_then(|n| m.handles.open_named(&n)).unwrap_or(0);
    if h == 0 {
        m.set_last_error(ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND);
    }
    ThunkResult::stdcall(h, nargs)
}

/// `CreateEventA(sa, manual, initial, name)`.
fn create_event_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (manual, initial, name) = (m.arg_u32(1) != 0, m.arg_u32(2) != 0, m.arg_str(3));
    let h = create_named(m, name, KernelObject::Event { manual_reset: manual, signaled: initial });
    ThunkResult::stdcall(h, 4)
}

fn open_event_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let name = m.arg_str(2);
    open_named(m, name, 3)
}

fn with_event(m: &mut Machine, f: impl FnOnce(&mut bool)) -> u32 {
    let h = m.arg_u32(0);
    match m.handles.get_mut(h) {
        Some(KernelObject::Event { signaled, .. }) => {
            f(signaled);
            1
        }
        _ => {
            m.set_last_error(ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE);
            0
        }
    }
}

fn set_event(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let r = with_event(m, |s| *s = true);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(r, 1)
}

fn reset_event(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let r = with_event(m, |s| *s = false);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(r, 1)
}

fn pulse_event(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let h = m.arg_u32(0);
    if m.pulse_event(h) {
        ThunkResult::stdcall(1, 1)
    } else {
        m.set_last_error(ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE);
        ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 1)
    }
}

/// `CreateMutexA(sa, initial_owner, name)`.
fn create_mutex_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (own, name) = (m.arg_u32(1) != 0, m.arg_str(2));
    let tid = m.current_tid();
    let obj = KernelObject::Mutex { owner: own.then_some(tid), recursion: own as u32 };
    let h = create_named(m, name, obj);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(h, 3)
}

fn open_mutex_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let name = m.arg_str(2);
    open_named(m, name, 3)
}

fn release_mutex(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let h = m.arg_u32(0);
    let tid = m.current_tid();
    match m.handles.get_mut(h) {
        Some(KernelObject::Mutex { owner, recursion }) if *owner == Some(tid) => {
            *recursion = recursion.saturating_sub(1);
            if *recursion == 0 {
                *owner = None;
            }
            ThunkResult::stdcall(1, 1)
        }
        Some(KernelObject::Mutex { .. }) => {
            m.set_last_error(ERROR_NOT_OWNER);
            ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 1)
        }
        _ => {
            m.set_last_error(ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE);
            ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 1)
        }
    }
}

/// `CreateSemaphoreA(sa, initial, max, name)`.
fn create_semaphore_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (initial, max, name) = (m.arg_i32(1), m.arg_i32(2), m.arg_str(3));
    if max <= 0 || initial < 0 || initial > max {
        m.set_last_error(ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER);
        return ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 4);
    }
    let h = create_named(m, name, KernelObject::Semaphore { count: initial, max });
    ThunkResult::stdcall(h, 4)
}

fn open_semaphore_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let name = m.arg_str(2);
    open_named(m, name, 3)
}

/// `ReleaseSemaphore(h, n, *prev)`.
fn release_semaphore(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (h, n, prevp) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_i32(1), m.arg_u32(2));
    let r = match m.handles.get_mut(h) {
        Some(KernelObject::Semaphore { count, max }) => {
            if n <= 0 || *count as i64 + n as i64 > *max as i64 {
                Err(ERROR_TOO_MANY_POSTS)
            } else {
                let prev = *count;
                *count += n;
                Ok(prev)
            }
        }
        _ => Err(ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE),
    };
    match r {
        Ok(prev) => {
            if prevp != 0 {
                m.mem.write_u32(prevp, prev as u32);
            }
            ThunkResult::stdcall(1, 3)
        }
        Err(e) => {
            m.set_last_error(e);
            ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 3)
        }
    }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- waitable timers

/// `CreateWaitableTimerA(sa, manual_reset, name)`.
fn create_waitable_timer_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (manual, name) = (m.arg_u32(1) != 0, m.arg_str(2));
    let h = create_named(m, name, KernelObject::Timer { manual_reset: manual, signaled: false, due_ms: None, period_ms: 0 });
    ThunkResult::stdcall(h, 3)
}

fn open_waitable_timer_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let name = m.arg_str(2);
    open_named(m, name, 3)
}

/// `SetWaitableTimer(h, *due (LARGE_INTEGER, 100 ns; <0 relative, >=0 absolute FILETIME), period_ms,
/// completion_routine, arg, resume)`. Completion routines (APCs) are not supported (logged).
fn set_waitable_timer(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (h, pdue, period, apc) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1), m.arg_i32(2), m.arg_u32(3));
    let due = m.mem.read_u64(pdue) as i64;
    let now = m.now_ms();
    let delay_ms = if due < 0 {
        (-due) as u64 / 10_000
    } else {
        let now_ft = s3_runtime::hosttime::now_filetime() as i64;
        (due - now_ft).max(0) as u64 / 10_000
    };
    if apc != 0 {
        m.log(s3_runtime::LogLevel::Warn, "SetWaitableTimer: completion routine ignored");
    }
    match m.handles.get_mut(h) {
        Some(KernelObject::Timer { signaled, due_ms, period_ms, .. }) => {
            *signaled = false;
            *due_ms = Some(now + delay_ms);
            *period_ms = period.max(0) as u32;
            ThunkResult::stdcall(1, 6)
        }
        _ => {
            m.set_last_error(ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE);
            ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 6)
        }
    }
}

fn cancel_waitable_timer(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let h = m.arg_u32(0);
    match m.handles.get_mut(h) {
        Some(KernelObject::Timer { due_ms, .. }) => {
            *due_ms = None;
            ThunkResult::stdcall(1, 1)
        }
        _ => {
            m.set_last_error(ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE);
            ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 1)
        }
    }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- waits

fn wait_result(m: &mut Machine, r: WaitPoll, nargs: u32) -> ThunkResult {
    match r {
        WaitPoll::Ready(i) => ThunkResult::stdcall(WAIT_OBJECT_0 + i, nargs),
        WaitPoll::Timeout => ThunkResult::stdcall(WAIT_TIMEOUT, nargs),
        WaitPoll::Failed => {
            m.set_last_error(ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE);
            ThunkResult::stdcall(WAIT_FAILED, nargs)
        }
        WaitPoll::Pending => ThunkResult::Block,
    }
}

fn wait_single(m: &mut Machine, nargs: u32) -> ThunkResult {
    let (h, ms) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1));
    let h = if h == CURRENT_THREAD { m.threads[m.cur].handle } else { h };
    let r = m.poll_wait(&[h], false, ms);
    wait_result(m, r, nargs)
}

fn wait_for_single_object(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    wait_single(m, 2)
}

fn wait_for_single_object_ex(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    wait_single(m, 3)
}

fn wait_multiple(m: &mut Machine, nargs: u32) -> ThunkResult {
    let (n, p, all, ms) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1), m.arg_u32(2) != 0, m.arg_u32(3));
    if n == 0 || n > MAXIMUM_WAIT_OBJECTS {
        m.set_last_error(ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER);
        return ThunkResult::stdcall(WAIT_FAILED, nargs);
    }
    let hs: Vec<u32> = (0..n).map(|i| m.mem.read_u32(p + 4 * i)).collect();
    let r = m.poll_wait(&hs, all, ms);
    wait_result(m, r, nargs)
}

fn wait_for_multiple_objects(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    wait_multiple(m, 4)
}

fn wait_for_multiple_objects_ex(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    wait_multiple(m, 5)
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- critical sections

const CS_LOCK_COUNT: u32 = 4;
const CS_RECURSION: u32 = 8;
const CS_OWNER: u32 = 12;

fn init_cs(m: &mut Machine, cs: u32, spin: u32) {
    m.mem.write_u32(cs, 0);
    m.mem.write_u32(cs + CS_LOCK_COUNT, u32::MAX);
    m.mem.write_u32(cs + CS_RECURSION, 0);
    m.mem.write_u32(cs + CS_OWNER, 0);
    m.mem.write_u32(cs + 16, 0);
    m.mem.write_u32(cs + 20, spin);
}

fn initialize_critical_section(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let cs = m.arg_u32(0);
    init_cs(m, cs, 0);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 1)
}

fn initialize_critical_section_spin(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (cs, spin) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1));
    init_cs(m, cs, spin);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(1, 2)
}

/// Try to take `cs` for the running thread. Returns true on success.
fn cs_try_take(m: &mut Machine, cs: u32) -> bool {
    let tid = m.current_tid();
    let slot = m.cur;
    if m.threads[slot].cs_granted && m.threads[slot].wait_cs == cs {
        // Ownership was handed over by LeaveCriticalSection (owner/recursion already written).
        m.threads[slot].cs_granted = false;
        m.threads[slot].wait_cs = 0;
        return true;
    }
    let owner = m.mem.read_u32(cs + CS_OWNER);
    if owner == 0 {
        m.mem.write_u32(cs + CS_OWNER, tid);
        m.mem.write_u32(cs + CS_RECURSION, 1);
        m.mem.write_u32(cs + CS_LOCK_COUNT, 0);
        m.threads[slot].wait_cs = 0;
        return true;
    }
    if owner == tid {
        let r = m.mem.read_u32(cs + CS_RECURSION);
        m.mem.write_u32(cs + CS_RECURSION, r + 1);
        let l = m.mem.read_u32(cs + CS_LOCK_COUNT);
        m.mem.write_u32(cs + CS_LOCK_COUNT, l.wrapping_add(1));
        return true;
    }
    // Owner thread gone (exited while holding it)? Take it over instead of deadlocking.
    let owner_alive = m
        .threads
        .iter()
        .any(|t| t.tid == owner && !matches!(t.state, ThreadState::Exited(_)));
    if !owner_alive {
        m.log(s3_runtime::LogLevel::Warn, &format!("critical section {cs:#x}: owner {owner:#x} is gone; taking it"));
        m.mem.write_u32(cs + CS_OWNER, tid);
        m.mem.write_u32(cs + CS_RECURSION, 1);
        m.mem.write_u32(cs + CS_LOCK_COUNT, 0);
        m.threads[slot].wait_cs = 0;
        return true;
    }
    false
}

fn enter_critical_section(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let cs = m.arg_u32(0);
    if cs_try_take(m, cs) {
        return ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 1);
    }
    m.thread().wait_cs = cs;
    ThunkResult::Block
}

fn try_enter_critical_section(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let cs = m.arg_u32(0);
    let ok = cs_try_take(m, cs);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(ok as u32, 1)
}

fn leave_critical_section(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let cs = m.arg_u32(0);
    let tid = m.current_tid();
    if m.mem.read_u32(cs + CS_OWNER) != tid {
        return ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 1);
    }
    let r = m.mem.read_u32(cs + CS_RECURSION).saturating_sub(1);
    if r > 0 {
        m.mem.write_u32(cs + CS_RECURSION, r);
        let l = m.mem.read_u32(cs + CS_LOCK_COUNT);
        m.mem.write_u32(cs + CS_LOCK_COUNT, l.wrapping_sub(1));
        return ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 1);
    }
    // Hand over to the next blocked waiter (search after the current slot for fairness).
    let n = m.threads.len();
    let cur = m.cur;
    let next = (1..=n).map(|k| (cur + k) % n).find(|&s| {
        let t = &m.threads[s];
        s != cur && t.state == ThreadState::Blocked && t.wait_cs == cs && !t.cs_granted
    });
    match next {
        Some(s) => {
            let ntid = m.threads[s].tid;
            m.threads[s].cs_granted = true;
            m.mem.write_u32(cs + CS_OWNER, ntid);
            m.mem.write_u32(cs + CS_RECURSION, 1);
            m.mem.write_u32(cs + CS_LOCK_COUNT, 0);
        }
        None => {
            m.mem.write_u32(cs + CS_OWNER, 0);
            m.mem.write_u32(cs + CS_RECURSION, 0);
            m.mem.write_u32(cs + CS_LOCK_COUNT, u32::MAX);
        }
    }
    ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 1)
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- TLS

#[derive(Default)]
struct TlsState {
    used: u64,
}

fn tls_alloc(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let st = m.state::<TlsState>();
    let idx = {
        let mut s = st.borrow_mut();
        let free = (0..teb::TLS_SLOT_COUNT).find(|i| s.used & (1u64 << i) == 0);
        if let Some(i) = free {
            s.used |= 1u64 << i;
        }
        free
    };
    match idx {
        Some(i) => {
            // New slots read as 0 in every thread.
            let tebs: Vec<u32> = m.threads.iter().map(|t| t.teb).collect();
            for t in tebs {
                m.mem.write_u32(t + teb::TLS_SLOTS + 4 * i, 0);
            }
            ThunkResult::stdcall(i, 0)
        }
        None => {
            m.set_last_error(8);
            ThunkResult::stdcall(0xFFFF_FFFF, 0)
        }
    }
}

fn tls_free(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let i = m.arg_u32(0);
    if i >= teb::TLS_SLOT_COUNT {
        m.set_last_error(ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER);
        return ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 1);
    }
    let st = m.state::<TlsState>();
    st.borrow_mut().used &= !(1u64 << i);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(1, 1)
}

fn tls_get_value(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let i = m.arg_u32(0);
    if i >= teb::TLS_SLOT_COUNT {
        m.set_last_error(ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER);
        return ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 1);
    }
    let t = m.threads[m.cur].teb;
    let v = m.mem.read_u32(t + teb::TLS_SLOTS + 4 * i);
    m.set_last_error(0);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(v, 1)
}

fn tls_set_value(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (i, v) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1));
    if i >= teb::TLS_SLOT_COUNT {
        m.set_last_error(ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER);
        return ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 2);
    }
    let t = m.threads[m.cur].teb;
    m.mem.write_u32(t + teb::TLS_SLOTS + 4 * i, v);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(1, 2)
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- handles

/// `DuplicateHandle(src_proc, src, dst_proc, *dst, access, inherit, options)`.
fn duplicate_handle(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (src, pdst, opts) = (m.arg_u32(1), m.arg_u32(3), m.arg_u32(6));
    let tid = m.current_tid();
    let h = match src {
        CURRENT_THREAD => Some(m.handles.insert(KernelObject::Thread { tid })),
        CURRENT_PROCESS => Some(m.handles.insert(KernelObject::Process)),
        h => m.handles.duplicate(h),
    };
    let Some(h) = h else {
        m.set_last_error(ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE);
        return ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 7);
    };
    if pdst != 0 {
        m.mem.write_u32(pdst, h);
    }
    if opts & 1 != 0 {
        // DUPLICATE_CLOSE_SOURCE
        let _ = m.handles.close(src);
    }
    ThunkResult::stdcall(1, 7)
}

fn close_handle(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let h = m.arg_u32(0);
    if h == CURRENT_PROCESS || h == CURRENT_THREAD {
        return ThunkResult::stdcall(1, 1);
    }
    if super::kernel32_file::is_std_handle(h) {
        return ThunkResult::stdcall(1, 1);
    }
    match m.handles.close(h) {
        Ok(_) => ThunkResult::stdcall(1, 1),
        Err(()) => {
            m.set_last_error(ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE);
            ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 1)
        }
    }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- interlocked

fn interlocked_increment(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let p = m.arg_u32(0);
    let v = m.mem.read_u32(p).wrapping_add(1);
    m.mem.write_u32(p, v);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(v, 1)
}

fn interlocked_decrement(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let p = m.arg_u32(0);
    let v = m.mem.read_u32(p).wrapping_sub(1);
    m.mem.write_u32(p, v);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(v, 1)
}

fn interlocked_exchange(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (p, v) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1));
    let old = m.mem.read_u32(p);
    m.mem.write_u32(p, v);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(old, 2)
}

fn interlocked_exchange_add(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (p, v) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1));
    let old = m.mem.read_u32(p);
    m.mem.write_u32(p, old.wrapping_add(v));
    ThunkResult::stdcall(old, 2)
}

fn interlocked_compare_exchange(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (p, x, c) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1), m.arg_u32(2));
    let old = m.mem.read_u32(p);
    if old == c {
        m.mem.write_u32(p, x);
    }
    ThunkResult::stdcall(old, 3)
}
```

```rs
//! kernel32 tests: hand-assembled guest snippets (iced-x86 code_asm) for threads/waits/SEH, and direct thunk
//! calls (`Machine::call_guest` on the thunk address) for the rest. No game bytes involved.

use iced_x86::code_asm::*;
use s3_mem::layout;
use s3_runtime::{Machine, NullHost, SliceResult, StopReason};

const CODE: u32 = 0x0040_1000;
const DATA: u32 = 0x0048_0000;

fn tmpdir(tag: &str) -> std::path::PathBuf {
    let d = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("s3k32-test-{}-{}", tag, std::process::id()));
    let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&d);
    std::fs::create_dir_all(d.join("game")).unwrap();
    std::fs::create_dir_all(d.join("data")).unwrap();
    d
}

fn machine(tag: &str) -> (Machine, std::path::PathBuf) {
    let d = tmpdir(tag);
    let mut host = NullHost::new(d.join("game"), d.join("data"));
    host.quiet = true;
    let mut m = Machine::new(Box::new(host)).unwrap();
    super::register(&mut m.registry);
    m.mem.alloc_region(Some(layout::IMAGE_BASE), 0x10_0000, s3_mem::RegionKind::Image, (0, 0)).unwrap();
    m.setup_process(layout::IMAGE_BASE, 0x10_0000, CODE, 0x10_0000, "TEST.EXE");
    (m, d)
}

fn k(m: &Machine, name: &str) -> u32 {
    m.registry.lookup("kernel32.dll", name).unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("{name} not registered"))
}

fn load(m: &mut Machine, at: u32, build: impl FnOnce(&mut CodeAssembler)) {
    let mut a = CodeAssembler::new(32).unwrap();
    build(&mut a);
    let bytes = a.assemble(at as u64).unwrap();
    m.mem.write_bytes(at, &bytes);
}

/// `call kernel32!name` (via ecx; clobbers ecx).
fn call(a: &mut CodeAssembler, addr: u32) {
    a.mov(ecx, addr).unwrap();
    a.call(ecx).unwrap();
}

fn run_to_stop(m: &mut Machine) -> StopReason {
    let t0 = std::time::Instant::now();
    while t0.elapsed().as_secs() < 20 {
        match m.run_slice(1_000_000) {
            SliceResult::Stopped => return m.stop_reason().unwrap().clone(),
            SliceResult::Idle => std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(1)),
            SliceResult::Ran(_) => {}
        }
    }
    panic!("did not stop");
}

/// A machine with one idle thread, for calling thunks directly with `api`.
fn direct(tag: &str) -> (Machine, std::path::PathBuf) {
    let (mut m, d) = machine(tag);
    load(&mut m, CODE, |a| {
        a.nop().unwrap();
    });
    let slot = m.create_thread(CODE, 0, 0x1_0000, false).unwrap();
    m.cur = slot;
    (m, d)
}

fn api(m: &mut Machine, name: &str, args: &[u32]) -> u32 {
    let t = k(m, name);
    m.cur = 0;
    let r = m.call_guest(t, args);
    assert!(!m.is_stopped(), "{name}: {:?}", m.stop_reason());
    r
}

fn cstr(m: &mut Machine, s: &str) -> u32 {
    let p = m.mem.alloc(s.len() as u32 + 1);
    m.mem.write_cstr(p, s);
    p
}

#[test]
fn thread_event_handoff() {
    let (mut m, _d) = machine("ev");
    let (ce, se, ws, ct, ex) =
        (k(&m, "CreateEventA"), k(&m, "SetEvent"), k(&m, "WaitForSingleObject"), k(&m, "CreateThread"), k(&m, "ExitProcess"));
    let tb = CODE + 0x400;
    // main: ev = CreateEvent(0,0,0,0) -> [DATA]; CreateThread(tb); Wait(ev); Wait(thread); Exit([DATA+4])
    load(&mut m, CODE, |a| {
        a.push(0).unwrap();
        a.push(0).unwrap();
        a.push(0).unwrap();
        a.push(0).unwrap();
        call(a, ce);
        a.mov(dword_ptr(DATA), eax).unwrap();
        a.push(0).unwrap();
        a.push(0).unwrap();
        a.push(5).unwrap();
        a.push(tb).unwrap();
        a.push(0).unwrap();
        a.push(0).unwrap();
        call(a, ct);
        a.mov(esi, eax).unwrap();
        a.push(0xFFFF_FFFFu32 as i32).unwrap();
        a.push(dword_ptr(DATA)).unwrap();
        call(a, ws);
        a.push(0xFFFF_FFFFu32 as i32).unwrap();
        a.push(esi).unwrap();
        call(a, ws);
        a.push(dword_ptr(DATA + 4)).unwrap();
        call(a, ex);
    });
    // thread: spin, [DATA+4] = param*10, SetEvent, return
    load(&mut m, tb, |a| {
        let mut l = a.create_label();
        a.mov(edx, 50_000).unwrap();
        a.set_label(&mut l).unwrap();
        a.dec(edx).unwrap();
        a.jnz(l).unwrap();
        a.mov(eax, dword_ptr(esp + 4)).unwrap();
        a.imul_3(eax, eax, 10).unwrap();
        a.mov(dword_ptr(DATA + 4), eax).unwrap();
        a.push(dword_ptr(DATA)).unwrap();
        call(a, se);
        a.xor(eax, eax).unwrap();
        a.ret_1(4).unwrap();
    });
    m.create_thread(CODE, 0, 0x1_0000, false).unwrap();
    m.quantum = 5_000;
    assert_eq!(run_to_stop(&mut m), StopReason::Exited(50));
}

#[test]
fn wait_timeout_and_multiple() {
    let (mut m, _d) = direct("wt");
    let ev = api(&mut m, "CreateEventA", &[0, 1, 0, 0]);
    let sem = api(&mut m, "CreateSemaphoreA", &[0, 0, 2, 0]);
    let t0 = m.now_ms();
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "WaitForSingleObject", &[ev, 30]), 0x102);
    assert!(m.now_ms() - t0 >= 30);
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "WaitForSingleObject", &[sem, 0]), 0x102);
    let arr = m.mem.alloc(8);
    m.mem.write_u32(arr, sem);
    m.mem.write_u32(arr + 4, ev);
    api(&mut m, "SetEvent", &[ev]);
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "WaitForMultipleObjects", &[2, arr, 0, 0]), 1);
    // manual-reset stays signaled
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "WaitForSingleObject", &[ev, 0]), 0);
    // wait-all needs the semaphore too
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "WaitForMultipleObjects", &[2, arr, 1, 0]), 0x102);
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "ReleaseSemaphore", &[sem, 1, 0]), 1);
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "WaitForMultipleObjects", &[2, arr, 1, 0]), 0);
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "ReleaseSemaphore", &[sem, 3, 0]), 0, "over max");
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "WaitForSingleObject", &[0x7777, 0]), 0xFFFF_FFFF);
    // named objects
    let name = cstr(&mut m, "S3Event");
    let e1 = api(&mut m, "CreateEventA", &[0, 0, 0, name]);
    let e2 = api(&mut m, "CreateEventA", &[0, 0, 0, name]);
    assert_ne!(e1, e2);
    assert_eq!(m.last_error(), 183);
    api(&mut m, "SetEvent", &[e1]);
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "WaitForSingleObject", &[e2, 0]), 0);
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "WaitForSingleObject", &[e1, 0]), 0x102, "auto-reset consumed through the alias");
    // mutex recursion
    let mx = api(&mut m, "CreateMutexA", &[0, 1, 0]);
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "WaitForSingleObject", &[mx, 0]), 0);
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "ReleaseMutex", &[mx]), 1);
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "ReleaseMutex", &[mx]), 1);
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "ReleaseMutex", &[mx]), 0);
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "CloseHandle", &[mx]), 1);
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "CloseHandle", &[mx]), 0);
}

#[test]
fn critical_section_mutual_exclusion() {
    let (mut m, _d) = machine("cs");
    let (ic, ec, lc, sl, ct, ws, ex) = (
        k(&m, "InitializeCriticalSection"),
        k(&m, "EnterCriticalSection"),
        k(&m, "LeaveCriticalSection"),
        k(&m, "Sleep"),
        k(&m, "CreateThread"),
        k(&m, "WaitForSingleObject"),
        k(&m, "ExitProcess"),
    );
    let csa = DATA + 0x100;
    let (counter, inside, errors) = (DATA, DATA + 4, DATA + 8);
    let worker = CODE + 0x400;
    // worker: 200 x { Enter; if [inside] errors++; inside=1; Sleep(0); counter++; inside=0; Leave }
    load(&mut m, worker, |a| {
        let mut top = a.create_label();
        let mut ok = a.create_label();
        a.push(ebx).unwrap();
        a.mov(ebx, 200).unwrap();
        a.set_label(&mut top).unwrap();
        a.push(csa).unwrap();
        call(a, ec);
        a.cmp(dword_ptr(inside), 0).unwrap();
        a.je(ok).unwrap();
        a.inc(dword_ptr(errors)).unwrap();
        a.set_label(&mut ok).unwrap();
        a.mov(dword_ptr(inside), 1).unwrap();
        a.push(0).unwrap();
        call(a, sl);
        a.inc(dword_ptr(counter)).unwrap();
        a.mov(dword_ptr(inside), 0).unwrap();
        a.push(csa).unwrap();
        call(a, lc);
        a.dec(ebx).unwrap();
        a.jnz(top).unwrap();
        a.pop(ebx).unwrap();
        a.xor(eax, eax).unwrap();
        a.ret_1(4).unwrap();
    });
    load(&mut m, CODE, |a| {
        a.push(csa).unwrap();
        call(a, ic);
        for reg in [esi, edi] {
            a.push(0).unwrap();
            a.push(0).unwrap();
            a.push(0).unwrap();
            a.push(worker).unwrap();
            a.push(0).unwrap();
            a.push(0).unwrap();
            call(a, ct);
            a.mov(reg, eax).unwrap();
        }
        for reg in [esi, edi] {
            a.push(0xFFFF_FFFFu32 as i32).unwrap();
            a.push(reg).unwrap();
            call(a, ws);
        }
        a.mov(eax, dword_ptr(counter)).unwrap();
        a.imul_3(edx, dword_ptr(errors), 1000).unwrap();
        a.add(eax, edx).unwrap();
        a.push(eax).unwrap();
        call(a, ex);
    });
    m.create_thread(CODE, 0, 0x1_0000, false).unwrap();
    m.quantum = 300;
    assert_eq!(run_to_stop(&mut m), StopReason::Exited(400));
    assert_eq!(m.mem.read_u32(csa + 12), 0, "released");
}

#[test]
fn seh_raise_unwind_and_continue() {
    let (mut m, _d) = machine("seh");
    let (re, ru, ex) = (k(&m, "RaiseException"), k(&m, "RtlUnwind"), k(&m, "ExitProcess"));
    let outer_h = CODE + 0x300;
    let inner_h = CODE + 0x380;
    let cont = CODE + 0x200;
    let counter = DATA;
    // main: outer frame; inner frame; RaiseException(0xE0001234, NONCONTINUABLE); never returns
    load(&mut m, CODE, |a| {
        a.push(outer_h).unwrap();
        a.push(dword_ptr(0).fs()).unwrap();
        a.mov(dword_ptr(0).fs(), esp).unwrap();
        a.push(inner_h).unwrap();
        a.push(dword_ptr(0).fs()).unwrap();
        a.mov(dword_ptr(0).fs(), esp).unwrap();
        a.push(0).unwrap();
        a.push(0).unwrap();
        a.push(1).unwrap();
        a.push(0xE000_1234u32 as i32).unwrap();
        call(a, re);
        a.push(99).unwrap();
        call(a, ex);
    });
    // continuation: esp = outer frame; pop it; exit(42 + counter*1 + [DATA+4])
    load(&mut m, cont, |a| {
        a.pop(dword_ptr(0).fs()).unwrap();
        a.add(esp, 4).unwrap();
        a.mov(eax, 42).unwrap();
        a.add(eax, dword_ptr(counter)).unwrap();
        a.add(eax, dword_ptr(DATA + 4)).unwrap();
        a.push(eax).unwrap();
        call(a, ex);
    });
    // outer handler: if unwinding -> return 1; else [DATA+4]=code==E0001234 ? 100 : 0; RtlUnwind(frame,0,rec,0);
    // esp = frame; jmp cont
    load(&mut m, outer_h, |a| {
        let mut unw = a.create_label();
        let mut no = a.create_label();
        a.mov(eax, dword_ptr(esp + 4)).unwrap();
        a.test(dword_ptr(eax + 4), 6).unwrap();
        a.jnz(unw).unwrap();
        a.cmp(dword_ptr(eax), 0xE000_1234u32 as i32).unwrap();
        a.jne(no).unwrap();
        a.mov(dword_ptr(DATA + 4), 100).unwrap();
        a.set_label(&mut no).unwrap();
        a.mov(ebx, dword_ptr(esp + 8)).unwrap();
        a.push(0).unwrap();
        a.push(eax).unwrap();
        a.push(0).unwrap();
        a.push(ebx).unwrap();
        call(a, ru);
        a.mov(esp, ebx).unwrap();
        a.mov(eax, cont).unwrap();
        a.jmp(eax).unwrap();
        a.set_label(&mut unw).unwrap();
        a.mov(eax, 1).unwrap();
        a.ret().unwrap();
    });
    // inner handler: count unwind calls, always continue search
    load(&mut m, inner_h, |a| {
        let mut skip = a.create_label();
        a.mov(eax, dword_ptr(esp + 4)).unwrap();
        a.test(dword_ptr(eax + 4), 2).unwrap();
        a.jz(skip).unwrap();
        a.inc(dword_ptr(counter)).unwrap();
        a.set_label(&mut skip).unwrap();
        a.mov(eax, 1).unwrap();
        a.ret().unwrap();
    });
    m.create_thread(CODE, 0, 0x1_0000, false).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(run_to_stop(&mut m), StopReason::Exited(143));
}

#[test]
fn raise_exception_continue_execution_returns() {
    let (mut m, _d) = machine("sehc");
    let (re, ex) = (k(&m, "RaiseException"), k(&m, "ExitProcess"));
    let h = CODE + 0x300;
    load(&mut m, CODE, |a| {
        a.push(h).unwrap();
        a.push(dword_ptr(0).fs()).unwrap();
        a.mov(dword_ptr(0).fs(), esp).unwrap();
        a.mov(esi, 7).unwrap();
        a.push(0).unwrap();
        a.push(0).unwrap();
        a.push(0).unwrap();
        a.push(0x4000_0001).unwrap();
        call(a, re);
        // returns here; esi preserved, handler set [DATA]
        a.pop(dword_ptr(0).fs()).unwrap();
        a.add(esp, 4).unwrap();
        a.add(esi, dword_ptr(DATA)).unwrap();
        a.push(esi).unwrap();
        call(a, ex);
    });
    load(&mut m, h, |a| {
        a.mov(dword_ptr(DATA), 30).unwrap();
        a.xor(eax, eax).unwrap();
        a.ret().unwrap();
    });
    m.create_thread(CODE, 0, 0x1_0000, false).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(run_to_stop(&mut m), StopReason::Exited(37));
}

#[test]
fn pulse_event_releases_waiter() {
    let (mut m, _d) = machine("pulse");
    let (ce, pe, ws, ct, sl, ex) = (
        k(&m, "CreateEventA"),
        k(&m, "PulseEvent"),
        k(&m, "WaitForSingleObject"),
        k(&m, "CreateThread"),
        k(&m, "Sleep"),
        k(&m, "ExitProcess"),
    );
    let tb = CODE + 0x400;
    load(&mut m, CODE, |a| {
        a.push(0).unwrap();
        a.push(0).unwrap();
        a.push(1).unwrap();
        a.push(0).unwrap();
        call(a, ce);
        a.mov(dword_ptr(DATA), eax).unwrap();
        for v in [0, 0, 0, tb as i32, 0, 0] {
            a.push(v).unwrap();
        }
        call(a, ct);
        a.mov(esi, eax).unwrap();
        a.push(20).unwrap();
        call(a, sl);
        a.push(dword_ptr(DATA)).unwrap();
        call(a, pe);
        a.push(2000).unwrap();
        a.push(esi).unwrap();
        call(a, ws); // 0 if the thread finished
        a.mov(edi, eax).unwrap();
        a.push(0).unwrap();
        a.push(dword_ptr(DATA)).unwrap();
        call(a, ws); // event not signaled after pulse -> 0x102
        a.add(eax, edi).unwrap();
        a.push(eax).unwrap();
        call(a, ex);
    });
    load(&mut m, tb, |a| {
        a.push(0xFFFF_FFFFu32 as i32).unwrap();
        a.push(dword_ptr(DATA)).unwrap();
        call(a, ws);
        a.ret_1(4).unwrap();
    });
    m.create_thread(CODE, 0, 0x1_0000, false).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(run_to_stop(&mut m), StopReason::Exited(0x102));
}

#[test]
fn sleep_tls_timer() {
    let (mut m, _d) = direct("tls");
    let t0 = api(&mut m, "GetTickCount", &[]);
    api(&mut m, "Sleep", &[40]);
    assert!(api(&mut m, "GetTickCount", &[]) - t0 >= 40);
    let i = api(&mut m, "TlsAlloc", &[]);
    assert!(i < 64);
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "TlsGetValue", &[i]), 0);
    api(&mut m, "TlsSetValue", &[i, 0x1234]);
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "TlsGetValue", &[i]), 0x1234);
    assert_ne!(api(&mut m, "TlsAlloc", &[]), i);
    // waitable timer: due -10 ms relative, period 15 ms
    let t = api(&mut m, "CreateWaitableTimerA", &[0, 0, 0]);
    let due = m.mem.alloc(8);
    m.mem.write_u64(due, (-100_000i64) as u64);
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "SetWaitableTimer", &[t, due, 15, 0, 0, 0]), 1);
    let start = m.now_ms();
    for _ in 0..3 {
        assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "WaitForSingleObject", &[t, 1000]), 0);
    }
    let el = m.now_ms() - start;
    assert!(el >= 10 + 2 * 15 - 2, "elapsed {el}");
    api(&mut m, "CancelWaitableTimer", &[t]);
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "WaitForSingleObject", &[t, 20]), 0x102);
    // QPC strictly increases
    let (a, b) = (m.mem.alloc(8), m.mem.alloc(8));
    api(&mut m, "QueryPerformanceCounter", &[a]);
    api(&mut m, "QueryPerformanceCounter", &[b]);
    assert!(m.mem.read_u64(b) > m.mem.read_u64(a));
}

#[test]
fn files_through_vfs() {
    let (mut m, d) = direct("files");
    let game = d.join("game");
    std::fs::create_dir_all(game.join("Map").join("User")).unwrap();
    std::fs::write(game.join("Map").join("User").join("Test.MAP"), b"hello world").unwrap();
    std::fs::create_dir_all(game.join("Gfx")).unwrap();
    std::fs::write(game.join("Gfx").join("Big.dat"), vec![0xAB; 200_000]).unwrap();

    // read a game file case-insensitively
    let p = cstr(&mut m, "c:\\s3\\map\\user\\test.map");
    let h = api(&mut m, "CreateFileA", &[p, 0x8000_0000, 1, 0, 3, 0x80, 0]);
    assert_ne!(h, 0xFFFF_FFFF);
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "GetFileSize", &[h, 0]), 11);
    let buf = m.mem.alloc(64);
    let nread = m.mem.alloc(4);
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "SetFilePointer", &[h, 6, 0, 0]), 6);
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "ReadFile", &[h, buf, 64, nread, 0]), 1);
    assert_eq!(m.mem.read_u32(nread), 5);
    assert_eq!(m.mem.read_cstr(buf), "world");
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "CloseHandle", &[h]), 1);

    // write a new file (goes to the overlay), relative to the current directory
    let sub = cstr(&mut m, "Save");
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "CreateDirectoryA", &[sub, 0]), 1);
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "SetCurrentDirectoryA", &[sub]), 1);
    let cur = m.mem.alloc(260);
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "GetCurrentDirectoryA", &[260, cur]), 10);
    assert_eq!(m.mem.read_cstr(cur), "C:\\S3\\Save");
    let f = cstr(&mut m, "game1.sav");
    let h = api(&mut m, "CreateFileA", &[f, 0x4000_0000, 0, 0, 2, 0x80, 0]);
    assert_ne!(h, 0xFFFF_FFFF);
    m.mem.write_cstr(buf, "SAVEDATA");
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "WriteFile", &[h, buf, 8, nread, 0]), 1);
    api(&mut m, "CloseHandle", &[h]);
    assert_eq!(std::fs::read(d.join("data/overlay/Save/game1.sav")).unwrap(), b"SAVEDATA");
    assert!(!game.join("Save").exists(), "game dir untouched");

    // find
    let pat = cstr(&mut m, "C:\\S3\\Map\\User\\*.map");
    let fd = m.mem.alloc(320);
    let fh = api(&mut m, "FindFirstFileA", &[pat, fd]);
    assert_ne!(fh, 0xFFFF_FFFF);
    assert_eq!(m.mem.read_cstr(fd + 44), "Test.MAP");
    assert_eq!(m.mem.read_u32(fd + 32), 11);
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "FindNextFileA", &[fh, fd]), 0);
    assert_eq!(m.last_error(), 18);
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "FindClose", &[fh]), 1);

    // move + delete of a game file use whiteouts
    let a = cstr(&mut m, "C:\\S3\\Map\\User\\Test.map");
    let b = cstr(&mut m, "C:\\S3\\Map\\User\\Renamed.map");
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "MoveFileA", &[a, b]), 1);
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "GetFileAttributesA", &[a]), 0xFFFF_FFFF);
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "GetFileAttributesA", &[b]), 0x20);
    assert!(game.join("Map/User/Test.MAP").exists(), "game dir untouched");
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "DeleteFileA", &[b]), 1);
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "GetFileAttributesA", &[b]), 0xFFFF_FFFF);
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "DeleteFileA", &[b]), 0);
    assert_eq!(m.last_error(), 2);

    // memory mapping
    let g = cstr(&mut m, "GFX\\big.DAT");
    let root = cstr(&mut m, "C:\\S3");
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "SetCurrentDirectoryA", &[root]), 1);
    let h = api(&mut m, "CreateFileA", &[g, 0x8000_0000, 1, 0, 3, 0x80, 0]);
    assert_ne!(h, 0xFFFF_FFFF);
    let mh = api(&mut m, "CreateFileMappingA", &[h, 0, 2, 0, 0, 0]);
    assert_ne!(mh, 0);
    let v = api(&mut m, "MapViewOfFile", &[mh, 4, 0, 0, 0]);
    assert_ne!(v, 0);
    assert_eq!(m.mem.read_u8(v), 0xAB);
    assert_eq!(m.mem.read_u8(v + 199_999), 0xAB);
    assert_eq!(m.mem.read_u8(v + 200_000), 0);
    let v2 = api(&mut m, "MapViewOfFile", &[mh, 4, 0, 0x1_0000, 0x100]);
    assert_eq!(m.mem.read_u8(v2 + 0xFF), 0xAB);
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "UnmapViewOfFile", &[v]), 1);
    assert_eq!(m.mem.read_u8(v), 0, "unmapped range is zero again");
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "UnmapViewOfFile", &[v2]), 1);
    api(&mut m, "CloseHandle", &[mh]);
    api(&mut m, "CloseHandle", &[h]);
}

#[test]
fn process_and_strings() {
    let (mut m, _d) = direct("proc");
    let buf = m.mem.alloc(512);
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "GetModuleFileNameA", &[0, buf, 260]), 14);
    assert_eq!(m.mem.read_cstr(buf), "C:\\S3\\TEST.EXE");
    m.mem.write_u32(buf, 148);
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "GetVersionExA", &[buf]), 1);
    assert_eq!((m.mem.read_u32(buf + 4), m.mem.read_u32(buf + 8), m.mem.read_u32(buf + 16)), (4, 10, 1));
    // MultiByteToWideChar / WideCharToMultiByte (cp1252 umlaut + euro)
    let s = m.mem.alloc(16);
    m.mem.write_bytes(s, &[b'M', 0xFC, 0x80, 0]);
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "MultiByteToWideChar", &[0, 0, s, 0xFFFF_FFFF, 0, 0]), 4);
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "MultiByteToWideChar", &[0, 0, s, 0xFFFF_FFFF, buf, 16]), 4);
    assert_eq!(m.mem.read_u16(buf + 2), 0xFC);
    assert_eq!(m.mem.read_u16(buf + 4), 0x20AC);
    let out = m.mem.alloc(16);
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "WideCharToMultiByte", &[0, 0, buf, 0xFFFF_FFFF, out, 16, 0, 0]), 4);
    assert_eq!(m.mem.read_cstr_bytes(out), vec![b'M', 0xFC, 0x80]);
    // GetLocaleInfoA
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "GetLocaleInfoA", &[0x409, 0x1004, buf, 16]), 5);
    assert_eq!(m.mem.read_cstr(buf), "1252");
    // LCMapStringA upper
    let lo = cstr(&mut m, "abc");
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "LCMapStringA", &[0x409, 0x200, lo, 3, buf, 16]), 3);
    assert_eq!(&m.mem.read_bytes(buf, 3), b"ABC");
    // lstrcmpiA
    let up = cstr(&mut m, "ABC");
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "lstrcmpiA", &[lo, up]), 0);
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "lstrlenA", &[lo]), 3);
    // system time sanity
    api(&mut m, "GetSystemTime", &[buf]);
    let y = m.mem.read_u16(buf);
    assert!((2020..2100).contains(&y));
    // GetProcAddress of the waitable timer API through the module handle
    let kn = cstr(&mut m, "KERNEL32.dll");
    let hk = api(&mut m, "GetModuleHandleA", &[kn]);
    let fname = cstr(&mut m, "CreateWaitableTimerA");
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "GetProcAddress", &[hk, fname]), k(&m, "CreateWaitableTimerA"));
    // memory
    let la = api(&mut m, "LocalAlloc", &[0x40, 100]);
    assert_ne!(la, 0);
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "IsBadReadPtr", &[la, 100]), 0);
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "IsBadReadPtr", &[0x100, 4]), 1);
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "LocalFree", &[la]), 0);
}

/// Save/load round trip as S3.EXE does it (save-load task, 2026-11-05): `CreateDirectoryA("Save")` on a game dir
/// that already has `Save\Multi` (GOG install) -> ERROR_ALREADY_EXISTS; `slot N.sav` probes fail with
/// ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND; the save is created with GENERIC_READ|WRITE + CREATE_ALWAYS in the overlay; the Load Game
/// screen lists `Save\*.sav` (overlay) and `Save\Multi\*.mps` from the game dir stays visible.
#[test]
fn save_slots_overlay_and_game_dir() {
    let (mut m, d) = direct("saves");
    let game = d.join("game");
    std::fs::create_dir_all(game.join("Save").join("Multi")).unwrap();
    std::fs::write(game.join("Save").join("Multi").join("abc.146.mps"), b"mp").unwrap();

    let save = cstr(&mut m, "C:\\S3\\Save");
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "CreateDirectoryA", &[save, 0]), 0);
    assert_eq!(m.last_error(), 183);
    let multi = cstr(&mut m, "C:\\S3\\Save\\Multi");
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "CreateDirectoryA", &[multi, 0]), 0);
    assert_eq!(m.last_error(), 183);

    let slot = cstr(&mut m, "C:\\S3\\Save\\slot 1.sav");
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "CreateFileA", &[slot, 0x8000_0000, 1, 0, 3, 0x80, 0]), 0xFFFF_FFFF);
    assert_eq!(m.last_error(), 2);
    let h = api(&mut m, "CreateFileA", &[slot, 0xC000_0000, 0, 0, 2, 0x80, 0]);
    assert_ne!(h, 0xFFFF_FFFF);
    let buf = m.mem.alloc(16);
    let n = m.mem.alloc(4);
    m.mem.write_cstr(buf, "S3SAVE");
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "WriteFile", &[h, buf, 6, n, 0]), 1);
    // the game rewinds and patches the header (checksum) before closing
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "SetFilePointer", &[h, 0, 0, 0]), 0);
    m.mem.write_cstr(buf, "s");
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "WriteFile", &[h, buf, 1, n, 0]), 1);
    api(&mut m, "CloseHandle", &[h]);
    assert_eq!(std::fs::read(d.join("data/overlay/Save/slot 1.sav")).unwrap(), b"s3SAVE");

    // Load Game list: *.sav (case-insensitive pattern), the Multi folder from the game dir is still there.
    let fd = m.mem.alloc(320);
    let pat = cstr(&mut m, "C:\\S3\\SAVE\\*.SAV");
    let fh = api(&mut m, "FindFirstFileA", &[pat, fd]);
    assert_ne!(fh, 0xFFFF_FFFF);
    assert_eq!(m.mem.read_cstr(fd + 44), "slot 1.sav");
    assert_ne!(m.mem.read_u32(fd + 20) | m.mem.read_u32(fd + 24), 0, "last write time set");
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "FindNextFileA", &[fh, fd]), 0);
    api(&mut m, "FindClose", &[fh]);
    let pat = cstr(&mut m, "C:\\S3\\Save\\Multi\\*.mps");
    let fh = api(&mut m, "FindFirstFileA", &[pat, fd]);
    assert_ne!(fh, 0xFFFF_FFFF);
    assert_eq!(m.mem.read_cstr(fd + 44), "abc.146.mps");
    api(&mut m, "FindClose", &[fh]);
    let pat = cstr(&mut m, "C:\\S3\\Save\\*");
    let fh = api(&mut m, "FindFirstFileA", &[pat, fd]);
    let mut names = vec![m.mem.read_cstr(fd + 44)];
    while api(&mut m, "FindNextFileA", &[fh, fd]) == 1 {
        names.push(m.mem.read_cstr(fd + 44));
    }
    api(&mut m, "FindClose", &[fh]);
    assert_eq!(names, vec![".", "..", "Multi", "slot 1.sav"]);

    // reopen for reading (load) gets the overlay copy
    let h = api(&mut m, "CreateFileA", &[slot, 0x8000_0000, 1, 0, 3, 0x80, 0]);
    assert_ne!(h, 0xFFFF_FFFF);
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "GetFileSize", &[h, 0]), 6);
    api(&mut m, "CloseHandle", &[h]);
}

/// CreateThread's stack argument is the initial commit; the reserve stays the PE default (S3.EXE passes 0x1000
/// and later uses 256 KiB of locals on that thread).
#[test]
fn create_thread_stack_is_commit_not_reserve() {
    let (mut m, _d) = direct("stack");
    let tid = m.mem.alloc(4);
    let h = api(&mut m, "CreateThread", &[0, 0x1000, CODE, 0, 4, tid]);
    assert_ne!(h, 0);
    let t = m.threads.last().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(t.stack_top - t.stack_bottom, 0x10_0000, "PE reserve (1 MiB)");
    let h = api(&mut m, "CreateThread", &[0, 0x18_0000, CODE, 0, 4, tid]);
    assert_ne!(h, 0);
    let t = m.threads.last().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(t.stack_top - t.stack_bottom, 0x20_0000, "commit > reserve rounds up to 1 MiB");
}
```

`port/crates/s3-win32/src/kernel32_time.rs`:

```rs
//! kernel32: time (GetTickCount, QueryPerformanceCounter/Frequency, GetSystemTime/GetLocalTime, FILETIME
//! conversions, time zone).
//!
//! - `GetTickCount` = host monotonic ms (`Host::now_ms`, stops while the frontend pauses the game).
//! - `QueryPerformanceFrequency` = 1 MHz; the counter is host monotonic µs and strictly increases between calls
//!   (the blit benchmark at 0x5c4280 loops until it advances).
//! - Wall clock = host clock. Local time uses the host's current UTC offset; `GetTimeZoneInformation` reports
//!   that offset as the bias with no daylight rules (TIME_ZONE_ID_UNKNOWN).

use std::time::Instant;

use s3_runtime::hosttime::{now_filetime, utc_offset_secs};
use s3_runtime::{Machine, Registry, ThunkResult};

use super::DLL;

pub(crate) fn register(reg: &mut Registry) {
    reg.register(DLL, "GetTickCount", get_tick_count);
    reg.register(DLL, "QueryPerformanceCounter", query_performance_counter);
    reg.register(DLL, "QueryPerformanceFrequency", query_performance_frequency);
    reg.register(DLL, "GetSystemTime", get_system_time);
    reg.register(DLL, "GetLocalTime", get_local_time);
    reg.register(DLL, "GetSystemTimeAsFileTime", get_system_time_as_file_time);
    reg.register(DLL, "FileTimeToSystemTime", file_time_to_system_time);
    reg.register(DLL, "SystemTimeToFileTime", system_time_to_file_time);
    reg.register(DLL, "FileTimeToLocalFileTime", file_time_to_local_file_time);
    reg.register(DLL, "LocalFileTimeToFileTime", local_file_time_to_file_time);
    reg.register(DLL, "FileTimeToDosDateTime", file_time_to_dos_date_time);
    reg.register(DLL, "DosDateTimeToFileTime", dos_date_time_to_file_time);
    reg.register(DLL, "CompareFileTime", compare_file_time);
    reg.register(DLL, "GetTimeZoneInformation", get_time_zone_information);
}

#[derive(Default)]
struct QpcState {
    start: Option<Instant>,
    last: u64,
    /// Host microseconds at the last call (the counter advances by host time x game speed since then).
    last_host: u64,
}

fn get_tick_count(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    ThunkResult::stdcall(m.now_ms() as u32, 0)
}

fn query_performance_counter(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let p = m.arg_u32(0);
    let st = m.state::<QpcState>();
    let v = {
        let mut s = st.borrow_mut();
        let start = *s.start.get_or_insert_with(Instant::now);
        let host = start.elapsed().as_micros() as u64;
        let dt = host.saturating_sub(s.last_host);
        s.last_host = host;
        let scale = m.time_scale();
        let step = if scale == 1.0 { dt } else { (dt as f64 * scale) as u64 };
        let mut v = s.last + step;
        if v <= s.last {
            v = s.last + 1;
        }
        s.last = v;
        v
    };
    if p == 0 {
        return ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 1);
    }
    m.mem.write_u64(p, v);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(1, 1)
}

fn query_performance_frequency(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let p = m.arg_u32(0);
    if p == 0 {
        return ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 1);
    }
    m.mem.write_u64(p, 1_000_000);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(1, 1)
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- civil time

/// Days since 1970-01-01 -> (year, month 1..12, day 1..31). (H. Hinnant's algorithm.)
pub fn civil_from_days(z: i64) -> (i64, u32, u32) {
    let z = z + 719_468;
    let era = if z >= 0 { z } else { z - 146_096 } / 146_097;
    let doe = z - era * 146_097;
    let yoe = (doe - doe / 1460 + doe / 36_524 - doe / 146_096) / 365;
    let y = yoe + era * 400;
    let doy = doe - (365 * yoe + yoe / 4 - yoe / 100);
    let mp = (5 * doy + 2) / 153;
    let d = (doy - (153 * mp + 2) / 5 + 1) as u32;
    let m = if mp < 10 { mp + 3 } else { mp - 9 } as u32;
    (if m <= 2 { y + 1 } else { y }, m, d)
}

/// (year, month, day) -> days since 1970-01-01.
pub fn days_from_civil(y: i64, m: u32, d: u32) -> i64 {
    let y = if m <= 2 { y - 1 } else { y };
    let era = if y >= 0 { y } else { y - 399 } / 400;
    let yoe = y - era * 400;
    let mp = (m as i64 + 9) % 12;
    let doy = (153 * mp + 2) / 5 + d as i64 - 1;
    let doe = yoe * 365 + yoe / 4 - yoe / 100 + doy;
    era * 146_097 + doe - 719_468
}

/// SYSTEMTIME fields (wYear, wMonth, wDayOfWeek, wDay, wHour, wMinute, wSecond, wMilliseconds).
pub fn filetime_to_systemtime(ft: u64) -> [u16; 8] {
    let ms_total = (ft / 10_000) as i64 - (s3_runtime::hosttime::FILETIME_UNIX_EPOCH / 10_000) as i64;
    let days = ms_total.div_euclid(86_400_000);
    let rem = ms_total.rem_euclid(86_400_000);
    let (y, mo, d) = civil_from_days(days);
    let dow = (days + 4).rem_euclid(7); // 1970-01-01 was a Thursday (4)
    [
        y as u16,
        mo as u16,
        dow as u16,
        d as u16,
        (rem / 3_600_000) as u16,
        (rem / 60_000 % 60) as u16,
        (rem / 1000 % 60) as u16,
        (rem % 1000) as u16,
    ]
}

/// SYSTEMTIME -> FILETIME (None if out of range).
pub fn systemtime_to_filetime(st: &[u16; 8]) -> Option<u64> {
    let (y, mo, d, h, mi, s, ms) = (st[0], st[1], st[3], st[4], st[5], st[6], st[7]);
    if !(1601..=30827).contains(&y) || !(1..=12).contains(&mo) || !(1..=31).contains(&d) || h > 23 || mi > 59 || s > 59 || ms > 999 {
        return None;
    }
    let days = days_from_civil(y as i64, mo as u32, d as u32);
    let ms_total = days * 86_400_000 + h as i64 * 3_600_000 + mi as i64 * 60_000 + s as i64 * 1000 + ms as i64;
    let ft = (ms_total + (s3_runtime::hosttime::FILETIME_UNIX_EPOCH / 10_000) as i64) * 10_000;
    (ft >= 0).then_some(ft as u64)
}

fn write_st(m: &mut Machine, p: u32, st: &[u16; 8]) {
    for (i, v) in st.iter().enumerate() {
        m.mem.write_u16(p + 2 * i as u32, *v);
    }
}

fn read_st(m: &Machine, p: u32) -> [u16; 8] {
    let mut st = [0u16; 8];
    for (i, v) in st.iter_mut().enumerate() {
        *v = m.mem.read_u16(p + 2 * i as u32);
    }
    st
}

fn local_offset_ft() -> i64 {
    utc_offset_secs() as i64 * 10_000_000
}

fn get_system_time(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let p = m.arg_u32(0);
    let st = filetime_to_systemtime(now_filetime());
    write_st(m, p, &st);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 1)
}

fn get_local_time(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let p = m.arg_u32(0);
    let st = filetime_to_systemtime((now_filetime() as i64 + local_offset_ft()) as u64);
    write_st(m, p, &st);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 1)
}

fn get_system_time_as_file_time(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let p = m.arg_u32(0);
    m.mem.write_u64(p, now_filetime());
    ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 1)
}

fn file_time_to_system_time(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (f, s) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1));
    let ft = m.mem.read_u64(f);
    if ft >= 0x8000_0000_0000_0000 {
        m.set_last_error(87);
        return ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 2);
    }
    let st = filetime_to_systemtime(ft);
    write_st(m, s, &st);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(1, 2)
}

fn system_time_to_file_time(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (s, f) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1));
    let st = read_st(m, s);
    match systemtime_to_filetime(&st) {
        Some(ft) => {
            m.mem.write_u64(f, ft);
            ThunkResult::stdcall(1, 2)
        }
        None => {
            m.set_last_error(87);
            ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 2)
        }
    }
}

fn file_time_to_local_file_time(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (a, b) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1));
    let ft = m.mem.read_u64(a) as i64 + local_offset_ft();
    m.mem.write_u64(b, ft.max(0) as u64);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(1, 2)
}

fn local_file_time_to_file_time(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (a, b) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1));
    let ft = m.mem.read_u64(a) as i64 - local_offset_ft();
    m.mem.write_u64(b, ft.max(0) as u64);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(1, 2)
}

fn file_time_to_dos_date_time(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (f, pd, pt) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1), m.arg_u32(2));
    let st = filetime_to_systemtime(m.mem.read_u64(f));
    if !(1980..=2107).contains(&st[0]) {
        m.set_last_error(87);
        return ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 3);
    }
    let date = ((st[0] - 1980) << 9) | (st[1] << 5) | st[3];
    let time = (st[4] << 11) | (st[5] << 5) | (st[6] / 2);
    m.mem.write_u16(pd, date);
    m.mem.write_u16(pt, time);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(1, 3)
}

fn dos_date_time_to_file_time(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (date, time, f) = (m.arg_u32(0) as u16, m.arg_u32(1) as u16, m.arg_u32(2));
    let st = [(date >> 9) + 1980, (date >> 5) & 15, 0, date & 31, time >> 11, (time >> 5) & 63, (time & 31) * 2, 0];
    match systemtime_to_filetime(&st) {
        Some(ft) => {
            m.mem.write_u64(f, ft);
            ThunkResult::stdcall(1, 3)
        }
        None => ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 3),
    }
}

fn compare_file_time(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (a, b) = (m.mem.read_u64(m.arg_u32(0)), m.mem.read_u64(m.arg_u32(1)));
    ThunkResult::stdcall(a.cmp(&b) as i32 as u32, 2)
}

/// `GetTimeZoneInformation(TIME_ZONE_INFORMATION*)` (172 bytes). Returns TIME_ZONE_ID_UNKNOWN (0).
fn get_time_zone_information(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let p = m.arg_u32(0);
    m.mem.fill(p, 172, 0);
    let bias = -(utc_offset_secs() / 60);
    m.mem.write_u32(p, bias as u32);
    m.mem.write_wstr(p + 4, "Local Standard Time");
    m.mem.write_wstr(p + 88, "Local Daylight Time");
    ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 1)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn civil_roundtrip() {
        // 2026-11-05 12:34:56.789 UTC
        let st = [2026, 11, 4, 5, 12, 34, 56, 789];
        let ft = systemtime_to_filetime(&st).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(filetime_to_systemtime(ft), st); // 2026-11-05 is a Thursday (4)
        assert_eq!(filetime_to_systemtime(0)[..2], [1601, 1]);
        assert_eq!(days_from_civil(1970, 1, 1), 0);
        assert_eq!(civil_from_days(-1), (1969, 12, 31));
    }
}
```
