`port/crates/s3-win32/src/ole32.rs`:

```rs
//! `ole32.dll` HLE. COM: CoCreateInstance dispatches to factories registered in Machine::com (s3-dx registers DirectDraw/DirectPlay).
//!
//! `NAMES` lists every function we know the game can reach; all are declared (calling one without a handler
//! stops the machine with `UNIMPLEMENTED ole32.dll!Name`). Implement a function by writing a handler and
//! registering it in `register` (see docs/porting/architecture.md, "Adding an HLE function").

use s3_runtime::Registry;

#[allow(unused_imports)]
use s3_runtime::{Machine, ThunkResult};

/// DLL name as registered.
pub const DLL: &str = "ole32.dll";

/// Known exports (static imports of S3.EXE first).
pub const NAMES: &[&str] = &[
    "CoCreateGuid", "CoInitialize", "CoUninitialize", "CoCreateInstance", "CoInitializeEx",
    "CoTaskMemAlloc", "CoTaskMemFree", "OleInitialize", "OleUninitialize",
];

/// Declare all names and register implemented handlers.
pub fn register(reg: &mut Registry) {
    reg.declare_all(DLL, NAMES);
    reg.register(DLL, "CoInitialize", co_initialize);
    reg.register(DLL, "CoUninitialize", co_uninitialize);
    reg.register(DLL, "CoCreateInstance", co_create_instance);
    reg.register(DLL, "CoInitializeEx", co_initialize_ex);
    reg.register(DLL, "OleInitialize", co_initialize);
    reg.register(DLL, "OleUninitialize", co_uninitialize);
    reg.register(DLL, "CoCreateGuid", co_create_guid);
    reg.register(DLL, "CoTaskMemAlloc", co_task_mem_alloc);
    reg.register(DLL, "CoTaskMemFree", co_task_mem_free);
}

fn co_initialize_ex(_m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 2) // S_OK
}

/// CoCreateGuid(GUID*): random v4 GUID.
fn co_create_guid(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let p = m.arg_u32(0);
    if p == 0 {
        return ThunkResult::stdcall(0x8007_0057, 1); // E_INVALIDARG
    }
    let g = crate::rpcrt4::random_guid(m);
    m.mem.write_bytes(p, &g);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 1)
}

fn co_task_mem_alloc(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let n = m.arg_u32(0);
    let p = m.mem.alloc(n.max(1));
    ThunkResult::stdcall(p, 1)
}

fn co_task_mem_free(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let p = m.arg_u32(0);
    if p != 0 {
        m.mem.free(p);
    }
    ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 1)
}

fn co_initialize(_m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 1) // S_OK
}

fn co_uninitialize(_m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 0)
}

/// `CoCreateInstance(rclsid, pUnkOuter, dwClsContext, riid, ppv)`: looks the CLSID up in `Machine::com`
/// (factories registered by s3-dx etc.).
fn co_create_instance(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    use s3_runtime::com::{Guid, REGDB_E_CLASSNOTREG};
    let clsid = Guid::read(m, m.arg_u32(0));
    let iid = Guid::read(m, m.arg_u32(3));
    let ppv = m.arg_u32(4);
    let factory = m.com.factories.get(&clsid).map(|(n, f)| (n.clone(), *f));
    let hr = match factory {
        Some((name, f)) => match f(m, iid) {
            Ok(p) => {
                if ppv != 0 {
                    m.mem.write_u32(ppv, p);
                }
                m.log(s3_runtime::LogLevel::Debug, &format!("CoCreateInstance({name}, {iid}) -> {p:#x}"));
                0
            }
            Err(hr) => hr,
        },
        None => {
            m.log(s3_runtime::LogLevel::Warn, &format!("CoCreateInstance: class {clsid} not registered"));
            REGDB_E_CLASSNOTREG
        }
    };
    if hr != 0 && ppv != 0 {
        m.mem.write_u32(ppv, 0);
    }
    ThunkResult::stdcall(hr, 5)
}

```

`port/crates/s3-win32/src/registry_store.rs`:

```rs
//! Fake Windows registry for advapi32: an in-memory tree, prefilled with the game's defaults, persisted as JSON in
//! `data_dir/registry.json`.
//!
//! Load order (later wins): built-in defaults (docs/reverse-engineering/registry.md, no serial number) ->
//! `regs.cmd` of the user's GOG install parsed at runtime (gives `SingleNumber`; we never embed the serial) ->
//! `data_dir/registry.json` (values the game wrote earlier).
//!
//! Special rule (docs/reverse-engineering/wine-trace.md): the game rewrites `SingleNumber` *encrypted*, but the
//! GOG exe has its decoder NOPed, so a rewrite would break the next start. A write to `General\SingleNumber` is
//! ignored when a value already exists.

use std::collections::BTreeMap;
use std::path::Path;

pub const REG_NONE: u32 = 0;
pub const REG_SZ: u32 = 1;
pub const REG_EXPAND_SZ: u32 = 2;
pub const REG_BINARY: u32 = 3;
pub const REG_DWORD: u32 = 4;
pub const REG_MULTI_SZ: u32 = 7;

pub const HKEY_CLASSES_ROOT: u32 = 0x8000_0000;
pub const HKEY_CURRENT_USER: u32 = 0x8000_0001;
pub const HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE: u32 = 0x8000_0002;
pub const HKEY_USERS: u32 = 0x8000_0003;
pub const HKEY_CURRENT_CONFIG: u32 = 0x8000_0005;

/// Path of the game's main settings key.
pub const GENERAL_KEY: &str = r"HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\Software\BlueByte\Siedler3\1.0\General";
/// The malformed CLSID key that holds the serial XOR `Seed`.
pub const SEED_KEY: &str = r"HKEY_CLASSES_ROOT\CLSID\{0e9f8400-d9a5-11cf-8f4d00804880b189}";

/// One value.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct RegValue {
    pub name: String,
    pub kind: u32,
    pub data: Vec<u8>,
}

/// One key.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default)]
pub struct RegKey {
    pub name: String,
    /// Keyed by lower-case value name ("" = default value).
    pub values: BTreeMap<String, RegValue>,
    /// Keyed by lower-case subkey name.
    pub subkeys: BTreeMap<String, RegKey>,
}

/// Root key name for a predefined HKEY.
pub fn root_name(hkey: u32) -> Option<&'static str> {
    Some(match hkey {
        HKEY_CLASSES_ROOT => "HKEY_CLASSES_ROOT",
        HKEY_CURRENT_USER => "HKEY_CURRENT_USER",
        HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE => "HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE",
        HKEY_USERS => "HKEY_USERS",
        HKEY_CURRENT_CONFIG => "HKEY_CURRENT_CONFIG",
        _ => return None,
    })
}

fn canon_root(s: &str) -> String {
    match s.to_ascii_uppercase().as_str() {
        "HKLM" | "HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE" => "HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE".into(),
        "HKCU" | "HKEY_CURRENT_USER" => "HKEY_CURRENT_USER".into(),
        "HKCR" | "HKEY_CLASSES_ROOT" => "HKEY_CLASSES_ROOT".into(),
        "HKU" | "HKEY_USERS" => "HKEY_USERS".into(),
        "HKCC" | "HKEY_CURRENT_CONFIG" => "HKEY_CURRENT_CONFIG".into(),
        _ => s.to_string(),
    }
}

/// Split a key path into components (backslashes, empty parts dropped, root abbreviations expanded).
/// `Software\Wow6432Node\X` is folded to `Software\X` (32-bit view).
pub fn split_path(p: &str) -> Vec<String> {
    let mut v: Vec<String> = p.split('\\').filter(|s| !s.is_empty()).map(|s| s.to_string()).collect();
    if let Some(first) = v.first_mut() {
        *first = canon_root(first);
    }
    if v.len() >= 3 && v[1].eq_ignore_ascii_case("software") && v[2].eq_ignore_ascii_case("wow6432node") {
        v.remove(2);
    }
    v
}

impl RegValue {
    pub fn dword(name: &str, v: u32) -> Self {
        RegValue { name: name.into(), kind: REG_DWORD, data: v.to_le_bytes().to_vec() }
    }
    pub fn sz(name: &str, s: &str) -> Self {
        let mut d = s.as_bytes().to_vec();
        d.push(0);
        RegValue { name: name.into(), kind: REG_SZ, data: d }
    }
    pub fn binary(name: &str, d: Vec<u8>) -> Self {
        RegValue { name: name.into(), kind: REG_BINARY, data: d }
    }
    /// As DWORD (if 4 bytes).
    pub fn as_dword(&self) -> Option<u32> {
        if self.data.len() >= 4 {
            Some(u32::from_le_bytes([self.data[0], self.data[1], self.data[2], self.data[3]]))
        } else {
            None
        }
    }
    /// As string (strips the terminating NUL).
    pub fn as_str(&self) -> String {
        let end = self.data.iter().position(|&b| b == 0).unwrap_or(self.data.len());
        String::from_utf8_lossy(&self.data[..end]).into_owned()
    }
}

/// The registry tree (a synthetic root whose subkeys are `HKEY_*`).
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default)]
pub struct RegStore {
    pub root: RegKey,
    /// Set when something changed since the last save.
    pub dirty: bool,
}

impl RegStore {
    /// Empty store.
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        RegStore::default()
    }

    /// Store with the built-in defaults.
    pub fn with_defaults() -> Self {
        let mut s = RegStore::new();
        s.apply_defaults();
        s.dirty = false;
        s
    }

    pub fn key(&self, path: &[String]) -> Option<&RegKey> {
        let mut k = &self.root;
        for p in path {
            k = k.subkeys.get(&p.to_ascii_lowercase())?;
        }
        Some(k)
    }

    pub fn key_mut(&mut self, path: &[String]) -> Option<&mut RegKey> {
        let mut k = &mut self.root;
        for p in path {
            k = k.subkeys.get_mut(&p.to_ascii_lowercase())?;
        }
        Some(k)
    }

    /// Create (or open) a key; returns true if it was created.
    pub fn create_key(&mut self, path: &[String]) -> bool {
        let mut k = &mut self.root;
        let mut created = false;
        for p in path {
            let lk = p.to_ascii_lowercase();
            if !k.subkeys.contains_key(&lk) {
                created = true;
                k.subkeys.insert(lk.clone(), RegKey { name: p.clone(), ..Default::default() });
            }
            k = k.subkeys.get_mut(&lk).unwrap();
        }
        if created {
            self.dirty = true;
        }
        created
    }

    /// Delete a key (and its subtree). Returns false if missing.
    pub fn delete_key(&mut self, path: &[String]) -> bool {
        let Some((last, parent)) = path.split_last() else { return false };
        let removed = self.key_mut(parent).and_then(|k| k.subkeys.remove(&last.to_ascii_lowercase())).is_some();
        self.dirty |= removed;
        removed
    }

    pub fn get_value(&self, path: &[String], name: &str) -> Option<&RegValue> {
        self.key(path)?.values.get(&name.to_ascii_lowercase())
    }

    /// Set a value, creating the key.
    pub fn set_value(&mut self, path: &[String], v: RegValue) {
        self.create_key(path);
        let k = self.key_mut(path).unwrap();
        let lk = v.name.to_ascii_lowercase();
        if k.values.get(&lk) != Some(&v) {
            k.values.insert(lk, v);
            self.dirty = true;
        }
    }

    pub fn delete_value(&mut self, path: &[String], name: &str) -> bool {
        let r = self.key_mut(path).and_then(|k| k.values.remove(&name.to_ascii_lowercase())).is_some();
        self.dirty |= r;
        r
    }

    fn setp(&mut self, path: &str, v: RegValue) {
        self.set_value(&split_path(path), v);
    }

    /// Built-in defaults (from GOG `regs.cmd`, without the serial number) plus the serial XOR `Seed`.
    pub fn apply_defaults(&mut self) {
        let g = GENERAL_KEY;
        for (n, v) in [
            ("Resolution", 0),
            ("NoAlpha", 0),
            ("FogSpeed", 1),
            ("GDIMouse", 1),
            ("WaitVBlank", 1),
            ("ScrollMode", 0),
            ("ScrollSpeed", 5),
            ("SoundFormat", 1),
            ("CDAudio", 2),
            ("VideoFormat", 1),
            ("MessageLevel", 9),
            ("Intro", 1),
            ("Language", 9),
            ("Tips&Tricks", 1),
            ("Plus", 1),
            ("ClanFlag", 0),
            ("Mission", 1),
            ("FontSize", 15),
            ("Newbie", 0),
            ("Gold", 1),
            ("BuildHelp", 1),
            ("GameZoneSelection", 511),
            ("FirstLogon", 1),
            ("BannerId", 0),
            ("BannerSubId", 0),
        ] {
            self.setp(g, RegValue::dword(n, v));
        }
        self.setp(g, RegValue::sz("Font", "MS Sans Serif"));
        self.setp(g, RegValue::sz("Playername", "Player"));
        self.setp(r"HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\Software\BlueByte\Siedler3\1.0\Patches", RegValue::sz("Convert", "0"));
        // Any DWORD works (wine-trace.md); the serial dialog wrote 0x6a0f in the reference run.
        self.setp(SEED_KEY, RegValue::dword("Seed", 0x6a0f));
        self.create_key(&split_path(r"HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software"));
    }

    /// Apply `REG ADD` lines of a GOG `regs.cmd` (variables `%regpath%`, `%locpath%` are expanded; the install dir
    /// becomes `guest_game_dir`). Returns the number of values applied.
    pub fn apply_regs_cmd(&mut self, text: &str, guest_game_dir: &str) -> usize {
        let mut regpath = String::new();
        let mut n = 0;
        for raw in text.lines() {
            let line = raw.trim();
            let upper = line.to_ascii_uppercase();
            if let Some(rest) = upper.strip_prefix("SET REGPATH=").map(|_| &line[12..]) {
                regpath = rest.trim().trim_matches('"').to_string();
                continue;
            }
            if !upper.starts_with("REG ADD ") {
                continue;
            }
            let toks = tokenize(&line[8..]);
            if toks.is_empty() {
                continue;
            }
            let key = toks[0].replace("%regpath%", &regpath);
            let (mut name, mut kind, mut data) = (None::<String>, "REG_SZ".to_string(), String::new());
            let mut i = 1;
            while i < toks.len() {
                match toks[i].to_ascii_lowercase().as_str() {
                    "/v" if i + 1 < toks.len() => {
                        name = Some(toks[i + 1].clone());
                        i += 1;
                    }
                    "/ve" => name = Some(String::new()),
                    "/t" if i + 1 < toks.len() => {
                        kind = toks[i + 1].to_ascii_uppercase();
                        i += 1;
                    }
                    "/d" if i + 1 < toks.len() => {
                        data = toks[i + 1].clone();
                        i += 1;
                    }
                    _ => {}
                }
                i += 1;
            }
            let Some(name) = name else { continue };
            let data = data.replace("%locpath%", guest_game_dir).replace("\\\\", "\\");
            let v = match kind.as_str() {
                "REG_DWORD" => {
                    let d = data.trim();
                    let parsed = if let Some(h) = d.strip_prefix("0x") { u32::from_str_radix(h, 16).ok() } else { d.parse().ok() };
                    RegValue::dword(&name, parsed.unwrap_or(0))
                }
                "REG_BINARY" => RegValue::binary(&name, hex_decode(&data)),
                _ => RegValue::sz(&name, &data),
            };
            self.setp(&key, v);
            n += 1;
        }
        n
    }

    /// Serialize to JSON: `{ "KEY\\PATH": { "Value": {"type": "dword"|"sz"|"binary"|<n>, "data": ...} } }`.
    pub fn to_json(&self) -> String {
        let mut obj = serde_json::Map::new();
        fn walk(k: &RegKey, path: &mut Vec<String>, out: &mut serde_json::Map<String, serde_json::Value>) {
            if !path.is_empty() {
                let mut vals = serde_json::Map::new();
                for v in k.values.values() {
                    let j = match v.kind {
                        REG_DWORD if v.data.len() == 4 => serde_json::json!({"type": "dword", "data": v.as_dword().unwrap()}),
                        REG_SZ | REG_EXPAND_SZ => serde_json::json!({"type": if v.kind == REG_SZ {"sz"} else {"expand_sz"}, "data": v.as_str()}),
                        REG_BINARY => serde_json::json!({"type": "binary", "data": hex_encode(&v.data)}),
                        other => serde_json::json!({"type": other, "data": hex_encode(&v.data)}),
                    };
                    vals.insert(v.name.clone(), j);
                }
                out.insert(path.join("\\"), serde_json::Value::Object(vals));
            }
            for sk in k.subkeys.values() {
                path.push(sk.name.clone());
                walk(sk, path, out);
                path.pop();
            }
        }
        walk(&self.root, &mut Vec::new(), &mut obj);
        serde_json::to_string_pretty(&serde_json::Value::Object(obj)).unwrap_or_default()
    }

    /// Merge values from JSON produced by [`RegStore::to_json`].
    pub fn merge_json(&mut self, text: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
        let v: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(text).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        let obj = v.as_object().ok_or("registry json: not an object")?;
        for (key, vals) in obj {
            let path = split_path(key);
            self.create_key(&path);
            let Some(vals) = vals.as_object() else { continue };
            for (name, j) in vals {
                let ty = &j["type"];
                let data = &j["data"];
                let rv = match ty.as_str() {
                    Some("dword") => RegValue::dword(name, data.as_u64().unwrap_or(0) as u32),
                    Some("sz") => RegValue::sz(name, data.as_str().unwrap_or("")),
                    Some("expand_sz") => {
                        let mut r = RegValue::sz(name, data.as_str().unwrap_or(""));
                        r.kind = REG_EXPAND_SZ;
                        r
                    }
                    Some("binary") => RegValue::binary(name, hex_decode(data.as_str().unwrap_or(""))),
                    _ => RegValue {
                        name: name.clone(),
                        kind: ty.as_u64().unwrap_or(REG_BINARY as u64) as u32,
                        data: hex_decode(data.as_str().unwrap_or("")),
                    },
                };
                self.set_value(&path, rv);
            }
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    /// Defaults + `game_dir/regs.cmd` + `data_dir/registry.json`.
    pub fn load(game_dir: &Path, data_dir: &Path, guest_game_dir: &str) -> (RegStore, Vec<String>) {
        let mut notes = Vec::new();
        let mut s = RegStore::with_defaults();
        if let Some(p) = find_ci(game_dir, "regs.cmd") {
            if let Ok(b) = std::fs::read(&p) {
                let n = s.apply_regs_cmd(&String::from_utf8_lossy(&b), guest_game_dir);
                notes.push(format!("registry: applied {n} values from {}", p.display()));
            }
        } else {
            notes.push("registry: no regs.cmd in the game dir (the game will ask for the serial number)".into());
        }
        let jp = data_dir.join("registry.json");
        if let Ok(t) = std::fs::read_to_string(&jp) {
            match s.merge_json(&t) {
                Ok(()) => notes.push(format!("registry: loaded {}", jp.display())),
                Err(e) => notes.push(format!("registry: ignoring broken {}: {e}", jp.display())),
            }
        }
        s.dirty = false;
        (s, notes)
    }

    /// Write `data_dir/registry.json` if dirty.
    pub fn save(&mut self, data_dir: &Path) -> std::io::Result<()> {
        if !self.dirty {
            return Ok(());
        }
        std::fs::create_dir_all(data_dir)?;
        let tmp = data_dir.join("registry.json.tmp");
        std::fs::write(&tmp, self.to_json())?;
        std::fs::rename(&tmp, data_dir.join("registry.json"))?;
        self.dirty = false;
        Ok(())
    }
}

fn find_ci(dir: &Path, name: &str) -> Option<std::path::PathBuf> {
    std::fs::read_dir(dir).ok()?.flatten().find(|e| e.file_name().to_string_lossy().eq_ignore_ascii_case(name)).map(|e| e.path())
}

/// Split a cmd.exe argument string: double-quoted tokens (quotes removed) or whitespace-separated words.
fn tokenize(s: &str) -> Vec<String> {
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    let mut cur = String::new();
    let mut inq = false;
    let mut have = false;
    for c in s.chars() {
        match c {
            '"' => {
                inq = !inq;
                have = true;
            }
            c if c.is_whitespace() && !inq => {
                if have {
                    out.push(std::mem::take(&mut cur));
                    have = false;
                }
            }
            c => {
                cur.push(c);
                have = true;
            }
        }
    }
    if have {
        out.push(cur);
    }
    out
}

pub fn hex_encode(d: &[u8]) -> String {
    d.iter().map(|b| format!("{b:02x}")).collect()
}

pub fn hex_decode(s: &str) -> Vec<u8> {
    let s: Vec<u8> = s.bytes().filter(|b| b.is_ascii_hexdigit()).collect();
    s.chunks(2)
        .filter(|c| c.len() == 2)
        .map(|c| u8::from_str_radix(std::str::from_utf8(c).unwrap(), 16).unwrap())
        .collect()
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn defaults_and_case_insensitive() {
        let s = RegStore::with_defaults();
        let p = split_path(r"HKLM\SOFTWARE\Bluebyte\Siedler3\1.0\GENERAL");
        assert_eq!(s.get_value(&p, "resolution").unwrap().as_dword(), Some(0));
        assert_eq!(s.get_value(&p, "FONT").unwrap().as_str(), "MS Sans Serif");
        assert_eq!(s.get_value(&split_path(SEED_KEY), "Seed").unwrap().as_dword(), Some(0x6a0f));
        // 32-bit view folding.
        let w = split_path(r"HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\Software\Wow6432Node\BlueByte\Siedler3\1.0\General");
        assert_eq!(s.get_value(&w, "FontSize").unwrap().as_dword(), Some(15));
    }

    #[test]
    fn regs_cmd_parse() {
        let text = "@echo off\r\nSET regpath=\"HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\\SOFTWARE\\Bluebyte\\Siedler3\\1.0\\General\"\r\n\
            REG ADD %regpath% /v \"SingleNumber\" /t REG_SZ /d \"1111-2222\" /f /reg:32\r\n\
            REG ADD %regpath% /t REG_DWORD /v \"Resolution\" /d 2 /f /reg:32\r\n\
            REG ADD %regpath% /t REG_BINARY /v \"Campaigns\" /d 0a0bff /f /reg:32\r\n\
            SET regpath=\"HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\App Paths\\s3.exe\"\r\n\
            REG ADD %regpath% /t REG_SZ /ve /d \"%locpath%\\s3.exe\" /f /reg:32\r\n";
        let mut s = RegStore::with_defaults();
        assert_eq!(s.apply_regs_cmd(text, r"C:\S3"), 4);
        let g = split_path(GENERAL_KEY);
        assert_eq!(s.get_value(&g, "SingleNumber").unwrap().as_str(), "1111-2222");
        assert_eq!(s.get_value(&g, "Resolution").unwrap().as_dword(), Some(2));
        assert_eq!(s.get_value(&g, "Campaigns").unwrap().data, vec![0x0a, 0x0b, 0xff]);
        let ap = split_path(r"HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\App Paths\s3.exe");
        assert_eq!(s.get_value(&ap, "").unwrap().as_str(), r"C:\S3\s3.exe");
    }

    #[test]
    fn json_roundtrip() {
        let mut s = RegStore::with_defaults();
        let g = split_path(GENERAL_KEY);
        s.set_value(&g, RegValue::binary("Campaigns", vec![1, 2, 3]));
        s.set_value(&g, RegValue { name: "Multi".into(), kind: REG_MULTI_SZ, data: b"a\0b\0\0".to_vec() });
        let j = s.to_json();
        let mut t = RegStore::new();
        t.merge_json(&j).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(t.get_value(&g, "Campaigns").unwrap().data, vec![1, 2, 3]);
        assert_eq!(t.get_value(&g, "Playername").unwrap().as_str(), "Player");
        assert_eq!(t.get_value(&g, "multi").unwrap().kind, REG_MULTI_SZ);
        assert_eq!(t.get_value(&g, "GameZoneSelection").unwrap().as_dword(), Some(511));
    }
}
```

`port/crates/s3-win32/src/rpcrt4.rs`:

```rs
//! `rpcrt4.dll` HLE. UUID helpers (DirectPlay session GUIDs, CoCreateGuid strings).
//!
//! `NAMES` lists every function we know the game can reach; all are declared (calling one without a handler
//! stops the machine with `UNIMPLEMENTED rpcrt4.dll!Name`).

use s3_runtime::{LogLevel, Machine, Registry, ThunkResult};

/// DLL name as registered.
pub const DLL: &str = "rpcrt4.dll";

/// Known exports.
pub const NAMES: &[&str] = &["UuidToStringA", "RpcStringFreeA", "UuidCreate", "UuidFromStringA"];

/// Declare all names and register implemented handlers.
pub fn register(reg: &mut Registry) {
    reg.declare_all(DLL, NAMES);
    reg.register(DLL, "UuidToStringA", uuid_to_string_a);
    reg.register(DLL, "RpcStringFreeA", rpc_string_free_a);
    reg.register(DLL, "UuidCreate", uuid_create);
}

/// Lower-case "xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx" (no braces, like rpcrt4).
pub fn uuid_string(g: &[u8; 16]) -> String {
    let d1 = u32::from_le_bytes([g[0], g[1], g[2], g[3]]);
    let d2 = u16::from_le_bytes([g[4], g[5]]);
    let d3 = u16::from_le_bytes([g[6], g[7]]);
    format!(
        "{d1:08x}-{d2:04x}-{d3:04x}-{:02x}{:02x}-{:02x}{:02x}{:02x}{:02x}{:02x}{:02x}",
        g[8], g[9], g[10], g[11], g[12], g[13], g[14], g[15]
    )
}

/// UuidToStringA(const UUID*, RPC_CSTR*): allocates the string on the process heap.
fn uuid_to_string_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (u, out) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1));
    let mut g = [0u8; 16];
    if u != 0 {
        g.copy_from_slice(m.mem.slice(u, 16));
    }
    let s = uuid_string(&g);
    let p = m.mem.alloc(s.len() as u32 + 1);
    if p == 0 {
        return ThunkResult::stdcall(14, 2); // RPC_S_OUT_OF_MEMORY
    }
    m.mem.write_cstr(p, &s);
    m.mem.write_u32(out, p);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 2)
}

fn rpc_string_free_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let pp = m.arg_u32(0);
    if pp != 0 {
        let p = m.mem.read_u32(pp);
        if p != 0 {
            m.mem.free(p);
        }
        m.mem.write_u32(pp, 0);
    }
    ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 1)
}

/// Random version-4 GUID bytes.
pub fn random_guid(m: &mut Machine) -> [u8; 16] {
    #[derive(Default)]
    struct Rng(u64);
    let st = m.state::<Rng>();
    let mut r = st.borrow_mut();
    if r.0 == 0 {
        let t = std::time::SystemTime::now().duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH).map(|d| d.as_nanos() as u64).unwrap_or(1);
        r.0 = t ^ 0x9E37_79B9_7F4A_7C15;
    }
    let mut g = [0u8; 16];
    for chunk in g.chunks_mut(8) {
        // xorshift64*
        r.0 ^= r.0 >> 12;
        r.0 ^= r.0 << 25;
        r.0 ^= r.0 >> 27;
        chunk.copy_from_slice(&r.0.wrapping_mul(0x2545_F491_4F6C_DD1D).to_le_bytes());
    }
    g[7] = (g[7] & 0x0F) | 0x40;
    g[8] = (g[8] & 0x3F) | 0x80;
    g
}

fn uuid_create(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let p = m.arg_u32(0);
    let g = random_guid(m);
    m.mem.write_bytes(p, &g);
    m.log(LogLevel::Trace, "UuidCreate");
    ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 1)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    #[test]
    fn uuid_fmt() {
        let g = s3_runtime::Guid::parse("D7B70EE0-4340-11CF-B063-0020AFC2CD35");
        assert_eq!(super::uuid_string(&g.0), "d7b70ee0-4340-11cf-b063-0020afc2cd35");
    }
}
```

`port/crates/s3-win32/src/shell32.rs`:

```rs
//! `shell32.dll` HLE. ShellExecute (help pages, the 565to555 converter, web links): logged and refused.
//!
//! `NAMES` lists every function we know the game can reach; all are declared (calling one without a handler
//! stops the machine with `UNIMPLEMENTED shell32.dll!Name`).

use s3_runtime::{LogLevel, Machine, Registry, ThunkResult};

/// DLL name as registered.
pub const DLL: &str = "shell32.dll";

/// Known exports.
pub const NAMES: &[&str] = &["ShellExecuteExA", "ShellExecuteA", "SHGetSpecialFolderPathA"];

const SE_ERR_NOASSOC: u32 = 31;

/// Declare all names and register implemented handlers.
pub fn register(reg: &mut Registry) {
    reg.declare_all(DLL, NAMES);
    reg.register(DLL, "ShellExecuteExA", shell_execute_ex_a);
    reg.register(DLL, "ShellExecuteA", shell_execute_a);
    reg.register(DLL, "SHGetSpecialFolderPathA", sh_get_special_folder_path_a);
}

/// ShellExecuteExA(SHELLEXECUTEINFOA*): fails with SE_ERR_NOASSOC (hInstApp at +0x20).
fn shell_execute_ex_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let p = m.arg_u32(0);
    let (verb, file, params) = if p != 0 {
        let rd = |m: &Machine, o: u32| {
            let s = m.mem.read_u32(p + o);
            if s == 0 { String::new() } else { m.mem.read_cstr(s) }
        };
        (rd(m, 0x0C), rd(m, 0x10), rd(m, 0x14))
    } else {
        Default::default()
    };
    m.log(LogLevel::Warn, &format!("ShellExecuteExA({verb:?}, {file:?}, {params:?}) refused"));
    if p != 0 {
        m.mem.write_u32(p + 0x20, SE_ERR_NOASSOC);
    }
    m.set_last_error(1155); // ERROR_NO_ASSOCIATION
    ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 1)
}

/// ShellExecuteA(hwnd, verb, file, params, dir, show)
fn shell_execute_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let file = m.arg_str(2).unwrap_or_default();
    m.log(LogLevel::Warn, &format!("ShellExecuteA({file:?}) refused"));
    ThunkResult::stdcall(SE_ERR_NOASSOC, 6)
}

/// SHGetSpecialFolderPathA(hwnd, path, csidl, create): every folder is the game dir.
fn sh_get_special_folder_path_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let p = m.arg_u32(1);
    if p != 0 {
        m.mem.write_cstr(p, s3_runtime::GUEST_GAME_DIR);
    }
    ThunkResult::stdcall(1, 4)
}
```

`port/crates/s3-win32/src/user32.rs`:

```rs
//! `user32.dll` HLE: window classes, windows, per-thread message queues, input -> window messages, timers,
//! cursor, rectangles, `wsprintfA`, `DrawTextA` (via gdi32), `MessageBoxA` (logs, auto-answers).
//!
//! Model (see docs/porting/user32-gdi32.md):
//! - Every window belongs to the guest thread that created it; messages for it go to that thread's queue.
//!   Queues are created on demand (also by `PeekMessage(PM_NOREMOVE)`, the classic trick S3 uses).
//! - Host input (`m.input` event log) is turned into WM_MOUSEMOVE/LBUTTON*/RBUTTON*/KEY*/CHAR messages and posted to
//!   the thread owning the capture/active window. Mouse moves are coalesced. Coordinates: the screen is the
//!   display mode, windows sit at (0,0), client area = window rect (no non-client area; HYPOTHESIS that S3 does
//!   not care about its caption under exclusive full-screen DirectDraw).
//! - Sent messages (SendMessage, CreateWindowEx's WM_CREATE etc.) call the WndProc directly on the calling thread
//!   with `Machine::call_guest`, also for windows of other threads (HYPOTHESIS: good enough for S3).
//! - `GetMessageA`/`WaitMessage`/`MsgWaitForMultipleObjects` block (ThunkResult::Block) and are retried by the
//!   scheduler. Retrieval order: posted messages, WM_QUIT, WM_PAINT, WM_TIMER.
//! - The first visible top-level window gets WM_ACTIVATEAPP/WM_NCACTIVATE/WM_ACTIVATE/WM_SETFOCUS when shown, so the
//!   DirectX code believes it is in the foreground.

use std::collections::{BTreeMap, HashMap, VecDeque};

use s3_runtime::{LogLevel, Machine, MouseButton, Registry, ThunkResult};
use s3_runtime::cursor::{self, CursorState};
use s3_runtime::resources::ResId;
use std::sync::Arc;

use crate::gdi32::{self, Rect};

pub const DLL: &str = "user32.dll";

    "GetCursorPos", "MoveWindow", "GetClientRect", "wsprintfA", "SendMessageTimeoutA", "ReleaseDC",
    "MsgWaitForMultipleObjects", "PostThreadMessageA", "DispatchMessageA", "TranslateMessage",

    "PtInRect", "GetSystemMetrics", "LoadIconA", "wvsprintfA", "RegisterClassExA", "GetWindowLongA",
    "PostQuitMessage", "MessageBoxA", "DefWindowProcA", "EndPaint", "BeginPaint", "SetRect",
    "PeekMessageA", "SetWindowLongA", "GetMessageA", "CreateWindowExA", "ShowWindow",
    "DestroyWindow", "RegisterClassA", "RegisterWindowMessageA", "GetActiveWindow", "SetFocus",
    "GetFocus", "SetForegroundWindow", "UpdateWindow", "InvalidateRect", "ScreenToClient",
    "GetWindowRect", "SetCursorPos", "GetAsyncKeyState", "GetKeyState", "SetTimer", "KillTimer",

/// A queued message.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Msg {
    pub hwnd: u32,
    pub message: u32,
    pub wparam: u32,
    pub lparam: u32,
    pub time: u32,
    pub pt: (i32, i32),
}

impl Msg {
    fn write(&self, m: &mut Machine, p: u32) {
        m.mem.write_u32(p, self.hwnd);
        m.mem.write_u32(p + 4, self.message);
        m.mem.write_u32(p + 8, self.wparam);
        m.mem.write_u32(p + 12, self.lparam);
        m.mem.write_u32(p + 16, self.time);
        m.mem.write_u32(p + 20, self.pt.0 as u32);
        m.mem.write_u32(p + 24, self.pt.1 as u32);
    }
    fn read(m: &Machine, p: u32) -> Msg {
        Msg {
            hwnd: m.mem.read_u32(p),
            message: m.mem.read_u32(p + 4),
            wparam: m.mem.read_u32(p + 8),
            lparam: m.mem.read_u32(p + 12),
            time: m.mem.read_u32(p + 16),
            pt: (m.mem.read_u32(p + 20) as i32, m.mem.read_u32(p + 24) as i32),
        }
    }
}

/// Per-thread message queue.
#[derive(Debug, Default)]
pub struct Queue {
    pub msgs: VecDeque<Msg>,
    pub quit: Option<u32>,
    pub last_pos: (i32, i32),
    pub last_time: u32,
}

            next_timer_id: 0x7000,
            input_cursor: None,
            active: 0,
            focus: 0,
            capture: 0,
            cursor: 0,
            cursor_count: 0,
            clip: None,
            screen: (800, 600),
            reg_msgs: HashMap::new(),

            toggles: [false; 256],

fn us(m: &mut Machine) -> s3_runtime::Shared<UserState> {
    m.state::<UserState>()
}

/// Current screen (display mode) size.
pub fn screen_size(m: &mut Machine) -> (u32, u32) {
    us(m).borrow_mut().screen
}

/// Set the screen size (called by ddraw SetDisplayMode). Full-screen top-level windows are resized and every
/// top-level window gets WM_DISPLAYCHANGE (posted; HYPOTHESIS: Windows sends it synchronously).
pub fn set_screen_size(m: &mut Machine, w: u32, h: u32, bpp: u32) {
    let st = us(m);
    let mut s = st.borrow_mut();
    let old = s.screen;
    s.screen = (w, h);
    if old == (w, h) {
        return;
    }
    let now = m.now_ms() as u32;
    let mut posts = Vec::new();
    for win in s.windows.values_mut() {
        if win.style & WS_CHILD == 0 {
            if win.rect == Rect::new(0, 0, old.0 as i32, old.1 as i32) {
                win.rect = Rect::new(0, 0, w as i32, h as i32);
            }
            posts.push((win.owner_tid, win.hwnd));
        }
    }
    for (tid, hwnd) in posts {
        let q = s.queues.entry(tid).or_default();
        q.msgs.push_back(Msg { hwnd, message: WM_DISPLAYCHANGE, wparam: bpp, lparam: (h << 16) | (w & 0xFFFF), time: now, pt: (0, 0) });
    }
}

/// Post a message to a window's owner queue (for other HLE modules, e.g. MCI notifications). Returns false if the
/// window does not exist.
pub fn post_message(m: &mut Machine, hwnd: u32, msg: u32, wparam: u32, lparam: u32) -> bool {
    let now = m.now_ms() as u32;
    let pt = (m.input.mouse_x, m.input.mouse_y);
    let tid = m.current_tid();
    let st = us(m);
    let mut s = st.borrow_mut();
    let target = if hwnd == 0 {
        Some(tid)
    } else {
        s.windows.get(&hwnd).map(|w| w.owner_tid)
    };
    let Some(t) = target else { return false };
    s.queues.entry(t).or_default().msgs.push_back(Msg { hwnd, message: msg, wparam, lparam, time: now, pt });
    true
}
```
