```rs
    let s = cstr(&mut m, "x");
    // wsprintfA is cdecl: call_guest restores ESP anyway.
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "user32.dll", "wsprintfA", &[buf, fmt, s, 7]), 5);
    assert_eq!(m.mem.read_cstr(buf), "x=007");
}

#[test]
fn registry_api() {
    let (mut m, d) = direct("reg");
    let hk = m.mem.alloc(4);
    let key = cstr(&mut m, r"Software\BlueByte\Siedler3\1.0\General");
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "advapi32.dll", "RegOpenKeyExA", &[0x8000_0002, key, 0, 0xF003F, hk]), 0);
    let h = m.mem.read_u32(hk);
    let (ty, data, cb) = (m.mem.alloc(4), m.mem.alloc(64), m.mem.alloc(4));
    let name = cstr(&mut m, "FontSize");
    m.mem.write_u32(cb, 0);
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "advapi32.dll", "RegQueryValueExA", &[h, name, 0, ty, 0, cb]), 0);
    assert_eq!(m.mem.read_u32(cb), 4);
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "advapi32.dll", "RegQueryValueExA", &[h, name, 0, ty, data, cb]), 0);
    assert_eq!((m.mem.read_u32(ty), m.mem.read_u32(data)), (4, 15));
    let font = cstr(&mut m, "Font");
    m.mem.write_u32(cb, 3);
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "advapi32.dll", "RegQueryValueExA", &[h, font, 0, ty, data, cb]), 234, "ERROR_MORE_DATA");
    assert_eq!(m.mem.read_u32(cb), 14);
    let missing = cstr(&mut m, "NoFlip");
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "advapi32.dll", "RegQueryValueExA", &[h, missing, 0, ty, data, cb]), 2);
    // Writes persist to data_dir/registry.json.
    let res = cstr(&mut m, "Resolution");
    m.mem.write_u32(data, 1);
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "advapi32.dll", "RegSetValueExA", &[h, res, 0, 4, data, 4]), 0);
    let json = std::fs::read_to_string(d.join("data/registry.json")).unwrap();
    assert!(json.contains("\"Resolution\""), "{json}");
    // SingleNumber rewrite is ignored once a value exists.
    let sn = cstr(&mut m, "SingleNumber");
    let plain = cstr(&mut m, "PLAIN");
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "advapi32.dll", "RegSetValueExA", &[h, sn, 0, 1, plain, 6]), 0);
    let enc = cstr(&mut m, "ENCRYPTED");
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "advapi32.dll", "RegSetValueExA", &[h, sn, 0, 1, enc, 10]), 0);
    m.mem.write_u32(cb, 64);
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "advapi32.dll", "RegQueryValueExA", &[h, sn, 0, ty, data, cb]), 0);
    assert_eq!(m.mem.read_cstr(data), "PLAIN");
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "advapi32.dll", "RegCloseKey", &[h]), 0);
    // HKCR seed key exists (no serial prompt).
    let seed = cstr(&mut m, r"CLSID\{0e9f8400-d9a5-11cf-8f4d00804880b189}");
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "advapi32.dll", "RegOpenKeyExA", &[0x8000_0000, seed, 0, 0xF003F, hk]), 0);
    // Create + disposition.
    let newk = cstr(&mut m, r"Software\BlueByte\Siedler3\1.0\Patches");
    let disp = m.mem.alloc(4);
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "advapi32.dll", "RegCreateKeyExA", &[0x8000_0002, newk, 0, 0, 0, 0xF003F, 0, hk, disp]), 0);
    assert_eq!(m.mem.read_u32(disp), 2, "Patches exists by default");
    let user = m.mem.alloc(32);
    m.mem.write_u32(cb, 32);
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "advapi32.dll", "GetUserNameA", &[user, cb]), 1);
    assert_eq!(m.mem.read_cstr(user), "Player");
}

#[test]
fn gdi_text_on_surface_dc() {
    let (mut m, _d) = direct("gdi");
    let (w, h) = (120u32, 30u32);
    let pix = m.mem.alloc(w * h * 2);
    let hdc = s3_runtime::gdi::create_dc(&mut m, s3_runtime::DcTarget { addr: pix, pitch: w * 2, width: w, height: h, bpp: 16, rgb565: true });
    assert_ne!(hdc, 0);
    // LOGFONT "MS Sans Serif" height 15.
    let lf = m.mem.alloc(60);
    m.mem.write_u32(lf, 15);
    m.mem.write_u32(lf + 16, 400);
    m.mem.write_cstr(lf + 28, "MS Sans Serif");
    let font = api(&mut m, "gdi32.dll", "CreateFontIndirectA", &[lf]);
    assert_ne!(font, 0);
    api(&mut m, "gdi32.dll", "SelectObject", &[hdc, font]);
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "gdi32.dll", "SetBkMode", &[hdc, 1]), 2);
    api(&mut m, "gdi32.dll", "SetTextColor", &[hdc, 0x00FF_FFFF]);
    let tm = m.mem.alloc(56);
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "gdi32.dll", "GetTextMetricsA", &[hdc, tm]), 1);
    let th = m.mem.read_u32(tm) as i32;
    assert!((14..=16).contains(&th), "tmHeight {th}");
    let s = cstr(&mut m, "Settlers");
    let size = m.mem.alloc(8);
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "gdi32.dll", "GetTextExtentPoint32A", &[hdc, s, 8, size]), 1);
    let tw = m.mem.read_u32(size);
    assert!(tw > 30 && tw < 80, "width {tw}");
    // Clip to the left half: nothing may be drawn right of x=20.
    let rgn = api(&mut m, "gdi32.dll", "CreateRectRgn", &[0, 0, 20, 30]);
    api(&mut m, "gdi32.dll", "SelectClipRgn", &[hdc, rgn]);
    api(&mut m, "gdi32.dll", "TextOutA", &[hdc, 2, 2, s, 8]);
    let px = |m: &Machine, x: u32, y: u32| m.mem.read_u16(pix + (y * w + x) * 2);
    let lit_left = (0..20).flat_map(|x| (0..h).map(move |y| (x, y))).filter(|&(x, y)| px(&m, x, y) != 0).count();
    let lit_right = (20..w).flat_map(|x| (0..h).map(move |y| (x, y))).filter(|&(x, y)| px(&m, x, y) != 0).count();
    assert!(lit_left > 10, "text drawn");
    assert_eq!(lit_right, 0, "clip respected");
    api(&mut m, "gdi32.dll", "SelectClipRgn", &[hdc, 0]);
    api(&mut m, "gdi32.dll", "DeleteObject", &[rgn]);
    // DrawTextA DT_CENTER|DT_SINGLELINE|DT_VCENTER inside a rect + DT_CALCRECT.
    let rc = m.mem.alloc(16);
    for (i, v) in [60u32, 0, 120, 30].iter().enumerate() {
        m.mem.write_u32(rc + 4 * i as u32, *v);
    }
    let hgt = api(&mut m, "user32.dll", "DrawTextA", &[hdc, s, 0xFFFF_FFFF, rc, 0x25]);
    assert_eq!(hgt as i32, th);
    let lit = (60..w).flat_map(|x| (0..h).map(move |y| (x, y))).filter(|&(x, y)| px(&m, x, y) != 0).count();
    assert!(lit > 10);
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "user32.dll", "DrawTextA", &[hdc, s, 8, rc, 0x400 | 0x20]) as i32, th);
    assert_eq!(m.mem.read_u32(rc + 8) - m.mem.read_u32(rc), tw);
    // Opaque background fill via ExtTextOutA ETO_OPAQUE.
    api(&mut m, "gdi32.dll", "SetBkColor", &[hdc, 0x0000_00FF]);
    for (i, v) in [0u32, 25, 10, 30].iter().enumerate() {
        m.mem.write_u32(rc + 4 * i as u32, *v);
    }
    api(&mut m, "gdi32.dll", "ExtTextOutA", &[hdc, 0, 25, 2, rc, 0, 0, 0]);
    assert_eq!(px(&m, 5, 27), 0xF800, "red fill in RGB565");
    // Lines.
    let pen = api(&mut m, "gdi32.dll", "CreatePen", &[0, 1, 0x0000_FF00]);
    api(&mut m, "gdi32.dll", "SelectObject", &[hdc, pen]);
    api(&mut m, "gdi32.dll", "MoveToEx", &[hdc, 0, 0, 0]);
    api(&mut m, "gdi32.dll", "LineTo", &[hdc, 10, 0]);
    assert_eq!(px(&m, 9, 0), 0x07E0);
    s3_runtime::gdi::release_dc(&mut m, hdc);
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "gdi32.dll", "SetBkMode", &[hdc, 1]), 0, "DC gone after release");
}

#[test]
fn mci_cdaudio_and_avi() {
    let (mut m, d) = direct("mci");
    std::fs::create_dir_all(d.join("game/MUSIC")).unwrap();
    std::fs::write(d.join("game/MUSIC/Track05.ogg"), b"not really ogg").unwrap();
    let ret = m.mem.alloc(64);
    let send = |m: &mut Machine, s: &str| {
        let p = cstr(m, s);
        api(m, "winmm.dll", "mciSendStringA", &[p, ret, 64, 0])
    };
    assert_eq!(send(&mut m, r"open AVIVideo!.\S3\Add\001\01_00_00.dat alias test"), 0, "fake video opens");
    assert_eq!(send(&mut m, "status test window handle"), 0);
    assert_eq!(send(&mut m, "window test handle 65552"), 0);
    assert_eq!(send(&mut m, "play test window notify"), 0);
    assert_eq!(send(&mut m, "close test wait"), 0);
    assert_eq!(send(&mut m, "play nosuch"), 263);
    assert_eq!(send(&mut m, "open cdaudio alias cd"), 0);
    assert_eq!(send(&mut m, "status cd number of tracks"), 0);
    assert_eq!(m.mem.read_cstr(ret), "5");
    assert_eq!(send(&mut m, "set cd time format tmsf"), 0);
    assert_eq!(send(&mut m, "status cd mode"), 0);
    assert_eq!(m.mem.read_cstr(ret), "stopped");
    assert_eq!(send(&mut m, "play cd from 9"), 282, "out of range");
    assert_eq!(send(&mut m, "play cd from 5 to 6"), 262, "bad ogg -> hardware error");
    assert_eq!(send(&mut m, "close cd"), 0);
    // Command interface like S3.EXE 0x615740..0x615fe6.
    let p = m.mem.alloc(32);
    let ty = cstr(&mut m, "cdaudio");
    m.mem.write_u32(p + 8, ty);
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "_inmm.dll", "mciSendCommandA", &[0, 0x803, 0x2100, p]), 0);
    let dev = m.mem.read_u32(p + 4);
    assert_ne!(dev, 0);
    m.mem.write_u32(p + 4, 10);
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "_inmm.dll", "mciSendCommandA", &[dev, 0x80D, 0x400, p]), 0);
    m.mem.write_u32(p + 8, 3);
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "_inmm.dll", "mciSendCommandA", &[dev, 0x814, 0x100, p]), 0);
    assert_eq!(m.mem.read_u32(p + 4), 5);
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "_inmm.dll", "mciSendCommandA", &[dev, 0x808, 0, 0]), 0);
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "_inmm.dll", "mciSendCommandA", &[dev, 0x804, 0, 0]), 0);
    let buf = m.mem.alloc(128);
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "winmm.dll", "mciGetErrorStringA", &[266, buf, 128]), 1);
    assert!(m.mem.read_cstr(buf).contains("driver"));
}

#[test]
fn time_set_event_runs_callback_on_timer_thread() {
    let (mut m, _d) = machine("mmtimer");
    let (tse, ex) = (f(&m, "winmm.dll", "timeSetEvent"), f(&m, "kernel32.dll", "ExitProcess"));
    let cb = CODE + 0x400;
    // TimeProc(id, msg, user, dw1, dw2): [DATA] += 1; [DATA+4] = user
    load(&mut m, cb, |a| {
        a.inc(dword_ptr(DATA)).unwrap();
        a.mov(eax, dword_ptr(esp + 12)).unwrap();
        a.mov(dword_ptr(DATA + 4), eax).unwrap();
        a.ret_1(20).unwrap();
    });
    load(&mut m, CODE, |a| {
        let mut spin = a.create_label();
        a.push(1).unwrap(); // TIME_PERIODIC
        a.push(0x77).unwrap();
        a.push(cb).unwrap();
        a.push(0).unwrap();
        a.push(5).unwrap();
        call(a, tse);
        a.set_label(&mut spin).unwrap();
        a.cmp(dword_ptr(DATA), 3).unwrap();
        a.jb(spin).unwrap();
        a.push(dword_ptr(DATA + 4)).unwrap();
        call(a, ex);
    });
    m.create_thread(CODE, 0, 0x1_0000, false).unwrap();
    m.quantum = 20_000;
    assert_eq!(run_to_stop(&mut m), StopReason::Exited(0x77));
}

/// Decodes a real track of the local GOG install if present (runtime only, nothing is copied).
#[test]
fn music_decodes_local_gog_track() {
    let dir = std::path::Path::new(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")).join("../../../game-files/gog-s3-ultimate/MUSIC/Track02.ogg");
    if !dir.exists() {
        eprintln!("skipping: no local GOG install");
        return;
    }
    let ms = crate::audio_music::ogg_duration_ms(&dir).unwrap();
    assert!(ms > 30_000, "duration {ms}");
    let mut p = crate::audio_music::MusicPlayer::default();
    let path = dir.clone();
    p.set_resolver(Box::new(move |n| if n == 2 { Some(path.clone()) } else { None }));
    p.play(2, 3, 0).unwrap();
    let mut buf = vec![0i16; 22050 * 2];
    assert_eq!(p.mix(&mut buf, 2, 22050, 0), None);
    assert!(buf.iter().any(|&s| s != 0), "decoded audio is silent");
}

/// Integration r1: S3.EXE (0x4a8233) checks `SelectObject(CreateCompatibleDC(0), bitmap) != 0` and throws a C++
/// exception otherwise (-> "abnormal program termination" when opening the build menu).
#[test]
fn select_bitmap_into_memory_dc_returns_previous() {
    let (mut m, _d) = direct("gdi-memdc");
    let mdc = api(&mut m, "gdi32.dll", "CreateCompatibleDC", &[0]);
    assert_ne!(mdc, 0);
    let bmp = api(&mut m, "gdi32.dll", "CreateCompatibleBitmap", &[mdc, 16, 16]);
    assert_ne!(bmp, 0);
    let old = api(&mut m, "gdi32.dll", "SelectObject", &[mdc, bmp]);
    assert_ne!(old, 0, "first SelectObject(bitmap) must return the default bitmap");
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "gdi32.dll", "SelectObject", &[mdc, old]), bmp);
    assert_eq!(api(&mut m, "gdi32.dll", "SelectObject", &[mdc, bmp]), old);
}

/// A tap (s3run `--inject click`, Android touch) arrives as MouseMove + down + up in one batch. S3's UI needs exactly
/// WM_MOUSEMOVE, WM_LBUTTONDOWN, WM_LBUTTONUP at the tap position, in that order, for every tap: one tap = one
/// button press (the "first OK on the players screen is ignored" report was a miscount, see user32-gdi32.md).
#[test]
fn tap_gives_one_press_per_tap() {
    let (mut m, _d) = direct("tap");
    let hwnd = make_window(&mut m, 0);
    let msg = m.mem.alloc(28);
    while api(&mut m, "user32.dll", "PeekMessageA", &[msg, 0, 0, 0, 1]) != 0 {}
    let lp = 567 << 16 | 730;
    for round in 0..2 {
        m.input.push(HostEvent::MouseMove { x: 730, y: 567 });
        m.input.push(HostEvent::MouseButton { button: MouseButton::Left, down: true });
        m.input.push(HostEvent::MouseButton { button: MouseButton::Left, down: false });
        let mut got = Vec::new();
        while api(&mut m, "user32.dll", "PeekMessageA", &[msg, 0, 0, 0, 1]) != 0 {
            got.push((m.mem.read_u32(msg), m.mem.read_u32(msg + 4), m.mem.read_u32(msg + 8), m.mem.read_u32(msg + 12)));
        }
        // The second tap repeats at the same spot (as when OK buttons of consecutive screens share a position).
        assert_eq!(got, vec![(hwnd, 0x200, 0, lp), (hwnd, 0x201, 1, lp), (hwnd, 0x202, 0, lp)], "tap {round}");
    }
    // CRT lookups through GetProcAddress (were missing: logged "not declared").
    let un = cstr(&mut m, "USER32.dll");
    let hu = api(&mut m, "kernel32.dll", "LoadLibraryA", &[un]);
    let pn = cstr(&mut m, "GetLastActivePopup");
    let p = api(&mut m, "kernel32.dll", "GetProcAddress", &[hu, pn]);
    assert_ne!(p, 0);
    assert_eq!(m.call_guest(p, &[hwnd]), hwnd);
    let kn = cstr(&mut m, "KERNEL32.dll");
    let hk = api(&mut m, "kernel32.dll", "LoadLibraryA", &[kn]);
    let fname = cstr(&mut m, "IsProcessorFeaturePresent");
    let ipf = api(&mut m, "kernel32.dll", "GetProcAddress", &[hk, fname]);
    assert_ne!(ipf, 0);
    assert_eq!(m.call_guest(ipf, &[0]), 0, "PF_FLOATING_POINT_PRECISION_ERRATA");
    assert_eq!(m.call_guest(ipf, &[1]), 0, "PF_FLOATING_POINT_EMULATED");
    assert_eq!(m.call_guest(ipf, &[2]), 1, "PF_COMPARE_EXCHANGE_DOUBLE (CPUID CX8)");
    assert_eq!(m.call_guest(ipf, &[3]), 0, "no MMX (CPUID has no MMX bit)");
    assert_eq!(m.call_guest(ipf, &[8]), 1, "PF_RDTSC_INSTRUCTION_AVAILABLE");
}

/// S3.EXE renders in-game panel text (Save Game / Quit Game, tooltips) with DrawTextA into a 640x480x1 top-down
/// DIB section (white text on black, OPAQUE) and reads the bits as a mask. 1bpp pixels must be packed MSB first.
#[test]
fn draw_text_into_monochrome_dib() {
    let (mut m, _d) = direct("gdi-1bpp");
    let bmi = m.mem.alloc(48);
    m.mem.write_u32(bmi, 40);
    m.mem.write_u32(bmi + 4, 64);
    m.mem.write_u32(bmi + 8, (-16i32) as u32);
    m.mem.write_u16(bmi + 12, 1);
    m.mem.write_u16(bmi + 14, 1);
    m.mem.write_u32(bmi + 40, 0); // colour 0 black
    m.mem.write_u32(bmi + 44, 0xFF_FFFF); // colour 1 white
    let ppv = m.mem.alloc(4);
    let hb = api(&mut m, "gdi32.dll", "CreateDIBSection", &[0, bmi, 0, ppv, 0, 0]);
    assert_ne!(hb, 0);
    let bits = m.mem.read_u32(ppv);
    let mdc = api(&mut m, "gdi32.dll", "CreateCompatibleDC", &[0]);
    api(&mut m, "gdi32.dll", "SelectObject", &[mdc, hb]);
    api(&mut m, "gdi32.dll", "SetBkMode", &[mdc, 2]);
    api(&mut m, "gdi32.dll", "SetBkColor", &[mdc, 0]);
    api(&mut m, "gdi32.dll", "SetTextColor", &[mdc, 0xFF_FFFF]);
    let rc = m.mem.alloc(16);
    for (i, v) in [0u32, 0, 64, 16].iter().enumerate() {
        m.mem.write_u32(rc + 4 * i as u32, *v);
    }
    let s = cstr(&mut m, "Save");
    assert!(api(&mut m, "user32.dll", "DrawTextA", &[mdc, s, 4, rc, 0x15]) > 0);
    // stride = 8 bytes; some bits set, nothing written past the 16 rows.
    let set: u32 = (0..8 * 16).map(|i| m.mem.read_u8(bits + i).count_ones()).sum();
    assert!(set > 20, "text pixels in the mask: {set}");
    assert!(set < 64 * 16 / 2, "mostly background: {set}");
    let last_row: u32 = (0..8).map(|i| m.mem.read_u8(bits + 15 * 8 + i).count_ones()).sum();
    assert_eq!(last_row, 0);
}
```

`port/crates/s3-win32/src/wininet.rs`:

```rs
//! `wininet.dll` HLE. WinINet stubs: no internet access in the port; every call fails cleanly
//! (ERROR_INTERNET_CANNOT_CONNECT).
//!
//! `NAMES` lists every function we know the game can reach; all are declared (calling one without a handler
//! stops the machine with `UNIMPLEMENTED wininet.dll!Name`).

use s3_runtime::{LogLevel, Machine, Registry, ThunkResult};

/// DLL name as registered.
pub const DLL: &str = "wininet.dll";

/// Known exports.
pub const NAMES: &[&str] = &[
    "InternetOpenA", "InternetOpenUrlA", "InternetReadFile", "InternetCloseHandle",
    "InternetGetConnectedState", "InternetConnectA", "HttpOpenRequestA", "HttpSendRequestA",
];

const ERROR_INTERNET_CANNOT_CONNECT: u32 = 12029;

/// Declare all names and register implemented handlers.
pub fn register(reg: &mut Registry) {
    reg.declare_all(DLL, NAMES);
    let h: &[(&str, s3_runtime::Handler)] = &[
        ("InternetOpenA", fail_5),
        ("InternetOpenUrlA", fail_6),
        ("InternetReadFile", fail_4),
        ("InternetCloseHandle", ok_1),
        ("InternetGetConnectedState", get_connected_state),
        ("InternetConnectA", fail_8),
        ("HttpOpenRequestA", fail_8),
        ("HttpSendRequestA", fail_5),
    ];
    for (n, f) in h {
        reg.register(DLL, n, *f);
    }
}

macro_rules! fail {
    ($name:ident, $n:expr) => {
        fn $name(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
            m.set_last_error(ERROR_INTERNET_CANNOT_CONNECT);
            ThunkResult::stdcall(0, $n)
        }
    };
}
fail!(fail_4, 4);
fail!(fail_5, 5);
fail!(fail_6, 6);
fail!(fail_8, 8);

fn ok_1(_m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    ThunkResult::stdcall(1, 1)
}

fn get_connected_state(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let p = m.arg_u32(0);
    if p != 0 {
        m.mem.write_u32(p, 0);
    }
    m.log(LogLevel::Debug, "InternetGetConnectedState -> offline");
    ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 2)
}
```

`port/crates/s3-win32/src/winmm.rs`:

```rs
//! `winmm.dll` HLE (also serves `_inmm.dll`, the GOG wrapper S3.EXE imports): multimedia timers, MCI.
//!
//! - `timeSetEvent` timers run on a dedicated guest thread ("winmm timer thread", like Windows): its entry point is
//!   our thunk `winmm.dll!__s3port_timer_thread`, which blocks until a timer is due, then calls the guest
//!   `TimeProc(id, 0, user, 0, 0)` with `call_guest` (or sets/pulses the event for TIME_CALLBACK_EVENT_*).
//! - MCI `cdaudio` (commands and strings): `MUSIC\TrackNN.ogg` via `audio_music.rs`; MM_MCINOTIFY is posted to the
//!   callback window when the range ends. Every other device type (the intro / briefing `AVIVideo`) is a *fake
//!   video*: open/window/status succeed and `play` finishes at once (MM_MCINOTIFY successful), so the game moves
//!   on. Failing the open instead makes S3 show "Error during video play ... (Error code 266)" over the menu
//!   (observed 2026-11-05).

use std::collections::HashMap;

use s3_runtime::{KernelObject, LogLevel, Machine, Registry, ThunkResult};

use crate::audio_music::{ogg_duration_ms, MusicEvent, MusicPlayer};
use s3_runtime::audio::AudioStreams;

/// DLL name as registered.
pub const DLL: &str = "winmm.dll";

/// Known exports (static imports of S3.EXE first).
pub const NAMES: &[&str] = &[
    "mciGetErrorStringA", "timeGetTime", "timeBeginPeriod", "timeEndPeriod", "timeSetEvent",
    "timeKillEvent", "mciSendCommandA", "mciSendStringA", "timeGetDevCaps", "waveOutGetNumDevs",
    "mciGetDeviceIDA", "auxGetNumDevs", "joyGetNumDevs", "joyGetPosEx", "PlaySoundA",
    "sndPlaySoundA", "timeGetSystemTime", "joyGetDevCapsA", "auxSetVolume", "auxGetVolume",
];

const TIMER_THREAD: &str = "__s3port_timer_thread";

/// Declare all names and register implemented handlers.
pub fn register(reg: &mut Registry) {
    reg.declare_all(DLL, NAMES);
    reg.alias("_inmm.dll", DLL);
    let h: &[(&str, s3_runtime::Handler)] = &[
        ("timeGetTime", time_get_time),
        ("timeGetSystemTime", time_get_system_time),
        ("timeBeginPeriod", time_begin_period),
        ("timeEndPeriod", time_begin_period),
        ("timeGetDevCaps", time_get_dev_caps),
        ("timeSetEvent", time_set_event),
        ("timeKillEvent", time_kill_event),
        (TIMER_THREAD, timer_thread),
        ("mciSendCommandA", mci_send_command_a),
        ("mciSendStringA", mci_send_string_a),
        ("mciGetErrorStringA", mci_get_error_string_a),
        ("mciGetDeviceIDA", mci_get_device_id_a),
        ("waveOutGetNumDevs", ret1_0),
        ("auxGetNumDevs", ret0_0),
        ("joyGetNumDevs", ret0_0),
        ("joyGetPosEx", joy_unplugged_2),
        ("joyGetDevCapsA", joy_unplugged_3),
        ("auxSetVolume", aux_set_volume),
        ("auxGetVolume", aux_get_volume),
        ("PlaySoundA", play_sound_a),
        ("sndPlaySoundA", snd_play_sound_a),
    ];
    for (n, f) in h {
        reg.register(DLL, n, *f);
    }
}

fn ret0_0(_m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 0)
}
fn ret1_0(_m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    ThunkResult::stdcall(1, 0)
}
fn joy_unplugged_2(_m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    ThunkResult::stdcall(167, 2) // JOYERR_UNPLUGGED
}
fn joy_unplugged_3(_m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    ThunkResult::stdcall(167, 3)
}
fn play_sound_a(_m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    ThunkResult::stdcall(1, 3)
}
fn snd_play_sound_a(_m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    ThunkResult::stdcall(1, 2)
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- timers

fn time_get_time(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    ThunkResult::stdcall(m.now_ms() as u32, 0)
}

/// timeGetSystemTime(MMTIME*, cb): TIME_MS.
fn time_get_system_time(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let p = m.arg_u32(0);
    if p != 0 {
        m.mem.write_u32(p, 1); // TIME_MS
        m.mem.write_u32(p + 4, m.now_ms() as u32);
    }
    ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 2)
}

fn time_begin_period(_m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 1) // TIMERR_NOERROR
}

fn time_get_dev_caps(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let p = m.arg_u32(0);
    if p != 0 {
        m.mem.write_u32(p, 1);
        m.mem.write_u32(p + 4, 1_000_000);
    }
    ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 2)
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
struct MmTimer {
    id: u32,
    period: u32,
    next_due: u64,
    callback: u32,
    user: u32,
    flags: u32,
}

#[derive(Default)]
struct TimerState {
    timers: Vec<MmTimer>,
    next_id: u32,
    thread_tid: Option<u32>,
}

const TIME_PERIODIC: u32 = 1;
const TIME_CALLBACK_EVENT_SET: u32 = 0x10;
const TIME_CALLBACK_EVENT_PULSE: u32 = 0x20;

/// timeSetEvent(uDelay, uResolution, lpTimeProc, dwUser, fuEvent)
fn time_set_event(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (delay, cb, user, flags) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(2), m.arg_u32(3), m.arg_u32(4));
    let now = m.now_ms();
    let st = m.state::<TimerState>();
    let (id, need_thread) = {
        let mut s = st.borrow_mut();
        s.next_id += 1;
        let id = s.next_id;
        s.timers.push(MmTimer { id, period: delay.max(1), next_due: now + delay.max(1) as u64, callback: cb, user, flags });
        (id, s.thread_tid.is_none())
    };
    if need_thread {
        let Some(entry) = m.registry.lookup(DLL, TIMER_THREAD) else {
            return ThunkResult::Error("winmm timer thread thunk missing".into());
        };
        match m.create_thread(entry, 0, 0x1_0000, false) {
            Ok(slot) => {
                let tid = m.threads[slot].tid;
                st.borrow_mut().thread_tid = Some(tid);
                m.log(LogLevel::Info, &format!("winmm: timer thread created (tid {tid:#x})"));
            }
            Err(e) => return ThunkResult::Error(format!("winmm timer thread: {e}")),
        }
    }
    m.log(LogLevel::Debug, &format!("timeSetEvent({delay} ms, cb {cb:#x}, user {user:#x}, flags {flags:#x}) -> {id}"));
    ThunkResult::stdcall(id, 5)
}

fn time_kill_event(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let id = m.arg_u32(0);
    let st = m.state::<TimerState>();
    let mut s = st.borrow_mut();
    let before = s.timers.len();
    s.timers.retain(|t| t.id != id);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(if s.timers.len() != before { 0 } else { 97 /* MMSYSERR_INVALPARAM */ }, 1)
}

/// Body of the timer guest thread: fire due timers, then block. Never returns.
fn timer_thread(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let now = m.now_ms();
    let st = m.state::<TimerState>();
    let due: Vec<MmTimer> = {
        let mut s = st.borrow_mut();
        let mut due = Vec::new();
        s.timers.retain_mut(|t| {
            if t.next_due > now {
                return true;
            }
            due.push(t.clone());
            if t.flags & TIME_PERIODIC != 0 {
                // No catch-up bursts: schedule from now if we fell far behind.
                t.next_due = (t.next_due + t.period as u64).max(now.saturating_sub(t.period as u64 * 4));
                true
            } else {
                false
            }
        });
        due
    };
    for t in due {
        if t.flags & (TIME_CALLBACK_EVENT_SET | TIME_CALLBACK_EVENT_PULSE) != 0 {
            if let Some(KernelObject::Event { signaled, .. }) = m.handles.get_mut(t.callback) {
                *signaled = true;
            }
            // PULSE: waiters are released on their next retry; then it is reset by the auto-reset semantics.
        } else if t.callback != 0 {
            m.call_guest(t.callback, &[t.id, 0, t.user, 0, 0]);
        }
        if m.is_stopped() {
            break;
        }
    }
    ThunkResult::Block
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- MCI

pub const MM_MCINOTIFY: u32 = 0x3B9;
const MCI_NOTIFY_SUCCESSFUL: u32 = 1;
const MCI_NOTIFY_SUPERSEDED: u32 = 2;
const MCI_NOTIFY_ABORTED: u32 = 4;

const MCI_OPEN: u32 = 0x803;
const MCI_CLOSE: u32 = 0x804;
const MCI_PLAY: u32 = 0x806;
const MCI_SEEK: u32 = 0x807;
const MCI_STOP: u32 = 0x808;
const MCI_PAUSE: u32 = 0x809;
const MCI_INFO: u32 = 0x80A;
const MCI_GETDEVCAPS: u32 = 0x80B;
const MCI_SET: u32 = 0x80D;
const MCI_STATUS: u32 = 0x814;
const MCI_RESUME: u32 = 0x855;

const MCI_FLAG_NOTIFY: u32 = 0x1;
const MCI_FLAG_FROM: u32 = 0x4;
const MCI_FLAG_TO: u32 = 0x8;
const MCI_FLAG_TRACK: u32 = 0x10;

pub const MCIERR_INVALID_DEVICE_ID: u32 = 257;
pub const MCIERR_UNRECOGNIZED_COMMAND: u32 = 261;
pub const MCIERR_INVALID_DEVICE_NAME: u32 = 263;
pub const MCIERR_CANNOT_LOAD_DRIVER: u32 = 266;
pub const MCIERR_OUTOFRANGE: u32 = 282;
pub const MCIERR_UNSUPPORTED_FUNCTION: u32 = 274;
pub const MCIERR_HARDWARE: u32 = 262;

pub const MCI_FORMAT_MILLISECONDS: u32 = 0;
pub const MCI_FORMAT_MSF: u32 = 2;
pub const MCI_FORMAT_TMSF: u32 = 10;

const MCI_MODE_STOP: u32 = 525;
const MCI_MODE_PLAY: u32 = 526;
const MCI_MODE_PAUSE: u32 = 529;

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
struct MciDevice {
    alias: String,
    /// Fake video device (AVIVideo etc.): plays finish immediately.
    video: bool,
    time_format: u32,
    notify: Option<u32>,
}

#[derive(Default)]
struct MciState {
    devices: HashMap<u32, MciDevice>,
    next_id: u32,
    player: MusicPlayer,
    /// Device whose play is in progress (for notifications).
    playing_dev: Option<u32>,
    num_tracks: Option<u32>,
    external_mixer: bool,
    service_added: bool,
    resolver_set: bool,
}

fn mci(m: &mut Machine) -> s3_runtime::Shared<MciState> {
    m.state::<MciState>()
}

fn track_guest_path(n: u32) -> String {
    format!("{}\\MUSIC\\Track{:02}.ogg", s3_runtime::GUEST_GAME_DIR, n)
}

fn ensure_music(m: &mut Machine) {
    let st = mci(m);
    let (need_resolver, need_service) = {
        let s = st.borrow_mut();
        (!s.resolver_set, !s.service_added)
    };
    if need_resolver {
        let vfs_game = m.host.game_dir();
        let vfs_data = m.host.data_dir();
        let resolver = move |n: u32| {
            let v = s3_runtime::Vfs::new(vfs_game.clone(), vfs_data.clone());
            v.resolve_read(&track_guest_path(n))
        };
        let mut s = st.borrow_mut();
        s.player.set_resolver(Box::new(resolver));
        s.resolver_set = true;
        // Debug/test knob: S3_MUSIC_VOLUME=0..1 overrides the default CD music volume (0 isolates effects).
        if let Some(v) = std::env::var("S3_MUSIC_VOLUME").ok().and_then(|v| v.parse::<f32>().ok()) {
            s.player.volume = v.clamp(0.0, 1.0);
        }
        if s.num_tracks.is_none() {
            let mut max = 1;
            for n in 2..100 {
                if m.vfs.resolve_read(&track_guest_path(n)).is_some() {
                    max = n;
                }
            }
            s.num_tracks = Some(max);
            drop(s);
            m.log(LogLevel::Info, &format!("MCI cdaudio: {max} tracks (MUSIC\\TrackNN.ogg)"));
        }
    }
    if need_service {
        mci(m).borrow_mut().service_added = true;
        m.add_service("winmm-music", music_service);
    }
}

/// Let another mixer (DirectSound) own the host audio stream; it must then call [`mix_music`].
pub fn set_external_music_mixer(m: &mut Machine, external: bool) {
    mci(m).borrow_mut().external_mixer = external;
}

/// Add the current CD music into `out` (interleaved i16, `channels`, `rate`). Posts MCI notifications.
pub fn mix_music(m: &mut Machine, out: &mut [i16], rate: u32, channels: u16) {
    let now = m.now_ms();
    let st = mci(m);
    let ev = st.borrow_mut().player.mix(out, channels, rate, now);
    if ev == Some(MusicEvent::Finished) {
        finish_play(m, MCI_NOTIFY_SUCCESSFUL);
    }
}

/// Set the music volume (0..1).
pub fn set_music_volume(m: &mut Machine, v: f32) {
    mci(m).borrow_mut().player.volume = v.clamp(0.0, 1.0);
}

const OUT_RATE: u32 = 44100;
/// Music kept queued ahead in the shared mixer stream (more than the mixer's 250 ms max catch-up chunk).
const LEAD_MS: u64 = 300;
/// Id of the CD music stream in `s3_runtime::audio::AudioStreams` ("CDDA").
pub const MUSIC_STREAM_ID: u32 = 0x4344_4441;

/// Drop music that is queued but not yet mixed (stop / new play), so the old track does not linger.
fn flush_music_stream(m: &mut Machine) {
    m.state::<AudioStreams>().borrow_mut().streams.remove(&MUSIC_STREAM_ID);
}

/// Music producer: decodes ahead into the `AudioStreams` entry [`MUSIC_STREAM_ID`] (44100 Hz stereo, ~LEAD_MS
/// queued); the DirectSound mixer (s3-dx, the only `Host::queue_audio` producer) mixes it with the effects.
/// Earlier versions queued to `Host::queue_audio` directly, which interleaved music blocks *between* the
/// mixer's blocks (two producers -> twice as much audio as wall time, effects and music not overlapped).
fn music_service(m: &mut Machine) {
    let st = mci(m);
    {
        let s = st.borrow_mut();
        if s.external_mixer || !s.player.is_playing() {
            return;
        }
    }
    let streams = m.state::<AudioStreams>();
    let queued = streams.borrow_mut().streams.get(&MUSIC_STREAM_ID).map_or(0, |s| s.queued_frames());
    let want = (LEAD_MS * OUT_RATE as u64 / 1000) as usize;
    if queued + 512 > want {
        return;
    }
    let frames = want - queued;
    let mut buf = vec![0i16; frames * 2];
    mix_music(m, &mut buf, OUT_RATE, 2);
    let mut ex = streams.borrow_mut();
    let e = ex.streams.entry(MUSIC_STREAM_ID).or_default();
    e.rate = OUT_RATE;
    e.channels = 2;
    e.gain = 1.0;
    e.gain_set = true;
    e.samples.extend(buf);
}

/// End the current play: post MM_MCINOTIFY(code) if the play asked for notification.
fn finish_play(m: &mut Machine, code: u32) {
    let st = mci(m);
    let (dev, notify) = {
        let mut s = st.borrow_mut();
        let Some(dev) = s.playing_dev.take() else { return };
        let notify = s.devices.get_mut(&dev).and_then(|d| d.notify.take());
        (dev, notify)
    };
    if let Some(hwnd) = notify {
        m.log(LogLevel::Debug, &format!("MCI notify dev {dev} code {code} -> hwnd {hwnd:#x}"));
        crate::user32::post_message(m, hwnd, MM_MCINOTIFY, code, dev);
    }
}

fn open_device(m: &mut Machine, ty: &str, alias: Option<&str>) -> Result<u32, u32> {
    let t = ty.to_ascii_lowercase();
    if t.is_empty() {
        return Err(MCIERR_INVALID_DEVICE_NAME);
    }
    let video = t != "cdaudio";
    if video {
        m.log(LogLevel::Info, &format!("MCI open {ty:?}: fake video device (plays end immediately)"));
    } else {
        ensure_music(m);
    }
    let st = mci(m);
    let mut s = st.borrow_mut();
    s.next_id += 1;
    let id = s.next_id;
    s.devices.insert(id, MciDevice { alias: alias.unwrap_or(&t).to_string(), video, time_format: MCI_FORMAT_MSF, notify: None });
    Ok(id)
}

fn close_device(m: &mut Machine, id: u32) -> u32 {
    let playing = mci(m).borrow_mut().playing_dev == Some(id);
    if playing {
        mci(m).borrow_mut().player.stop();
        flush_music_stream(m);
        finish_play(m, MCI_NOTIFY_ABORTED);
    }
    if mci(m).borrow_mut().devices.remove(&id).is_some() {
        0
    } else {
        MCIERR_INVALID_DEVICE_ID
    }
}

/// Track number for a position in the device time format.
fn pos_to_track(fmt: u32, v: u32) -> u32 {
    match fmt {
        MCI_FORMAT_TMSF => v & 0xFF,
        _ => v, // HYPOTHESIS: only TMSF is used by S3 (0x615e60 sets it before playing)
    }
}

fn play(m: &mut Machine, dev: u32, from: Option<u32>, to: Option<u32>, notify: Option<u32>) -> u32 {
    let (fmt, ntracks, cur, video) = {
        let st = mci(m);
        let s = st.borrow_mut();
        let Some(d) = s.devices.get(&dev) else { return MCIERR_INVALID_DEVICE_ID };
        (d.time_format, s.num_tracks.unwrap_or(1), s.player.cur_track, d.video)
    };
    if video {
        if let Some(hwnd) = notify {
            m.log(LogLevel::Info, &format!("MCI video play: skipped, notifying hwnd {hwnd:#x}"));
            crate::user32::post_message(m, hwnd, MM_MCINOTIFY, MCI_NOTIFY_SUCCESSFUL, dev);
        }
        return 0;
    }
    // A new play supersedes the pending notification.
    finish_play(m, MCI_NOTIFY_SUPERSEDED);
    let from_t = from.map(|v| pos_to_track(fmt, v)).unwrap_or(if cur >= 2 { cur } else { 2 });
    let to_t = to.map(|v| {
        let t = pos_to_track(fmt, v);
        // TMSF "to" = start of track t -> play up to t-1; a non-zero MSF part means "into track t" (round up).
        if fmt == MCI_FORMAT_TMSF && (v >> 8) != 0 { t + 1 } else { t }
    });
    let to_t = to_t.unwrap_or(ntracks + 1).max(from_t + 1);
    if from_t < 1 || from_t > ntracks {
        return MCIERR_OUTOFRANGE;
    }
    let now = m.now_ms();
    flush_music_stream(m);
    let r = mci(m).borrow_mut().player.play(from_t, to_t, now);
    match r {
        Ok(()) => {
            m.log(LogLevel::Info, &format!("MCI cdaudio play tracks {from_t}..{to_t} (notify {notify:?})"));
            let st = mci(m);
            let mut s = st.borrow_mut();
            s.playing_dev = Some(dev);
            if let Some(d) = s.devices.get_mut(&dev) {
                d.notify = notify;
            }
            0
        }
        Err(e) => {
            m.log(LogLevel::Warn, &format!("MCI cdaudio play {from_t}: {e}"));
            MCIERR_HARDWARE
        }
    }
}

fn stop(m: &mut Machine, dev: u32) -> u32 {
    match mci(m).borrow_mut().devices.get(&dev) {
        None => return MCIERR_INVALID_DEVICE_ID,
        Some(d) if d.video => return 0,
        Some(_) => {}
    }
    let playing = mci(m).borrow_mut().playing_dev == Some(dev);
    if playing {
        mci(m).borrow_mut().player.stop();
        flush_music_stream(m);
        finish_play(m, MCI_NOTIFY_ABORTED);
    }
    0
}

fn track_length_ms(m: &mut Machine, track: u32) -> u32 {
    m.vfs.resolve_read(&track_guest_path(track)).and_then(|p| ogg_duration_ms(&p)).unwrap_or(0)
}

fn ms_to_msf(ms: u32) -> u32 {
    let frames = ms * 75 / 1000;
    let (mm, ss, ff) = (frames / (75 * 60), (frames / 75) % 60, frames % 75);
    mm | ss << 8 | ff << 16
}

/// Status item value.
fn status(m: &mut Machine, dev: u32, item: u32, track: Option<u32>) -> Result<u32, u32> {
    let (fmt, ntracks, playing, paused, cur, started) = {
        let st = mci(m);
        let s = st.borrow_mut();
        let Some(d) = s.devices.get(&dev) else { return Err(MCIERR_INVALID_DEVICE_ID) };
        if d.video {
            return Ok(match item {
                4 => MCI_MODE_STOP,
                5 | 7 => 1,
                6 => d.time_format,
                _ => 0,
            });
        }
        let playing = s.playing_dev == Some(dev) && s.player.track.is_some();
        (d.time_format, s.num_tracks.unwrap_or(1), playing, s.player.paused, s.player.cur_track, s.player.track_started_ms)
    };
    Ok(match item {
        1 => {
            // MCI_STATUS_LENGTH
            let ms = match track {
                Some(t) => track_length_ms(m, t),
                None => (2..=ntracks).map(|t| track_length_ms(m, t)).sum(),
            };
            if fmt == MCI_FORMAT_MILLISECONDS { ms } else { ms_to_msf(ms) }
        }
        2 => {
            // MCI_STATUS_POSITION
            let el = if playing { (m.now_ms() - started) as u32 } else { 0 };
            match fmt {
                MCI_FORMAT_TMSF => cur.max(1) | (ms_to_msf(el) << 8),
                MCI_FORMAT_MILLISECONDS => el,
                _ => ms_to_msf(el),
            }
        }
        3 => ntracks,
        4 => {
            if playing && paused {
                MCI_MODE_PAUSE
            } else if playing {
                MCI_MODE_PLAY
            } else {
                MCI_MODE_STOP
            }
        }
        5 | 7 => 1,      // media present / ready
        6 => fmt,        // time format
        8 => cur.max(1), // current track
        0x4001 => {
            // MCI_CDA_STATUS_TYPE_TRACK
            if track == Some(1) { 1089 } else { 1088 }
        }
        _ => return Err(MCIERR_UNSUPPORTED_FUNCTION),
    })
}

/// mciSendCommandA(IDDevice, uMsg, fdwCommand, dwParam)
fn mci_send_command_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (dev, msg, flags, p) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1), m.arg_u32(2), m.arg_u32(3));
    let notify_hwnd = if flags & MCI_FLAG_NOTIFY != 0 && p != 0 { Some(m.mem.read_u32(p) & 0xFFFF_FFFF) } else { None };
    let r = match msg {
        MCI_OPEN => {
            // MCI_OPEN_PARMSA {dwCallback, wDeviceID, lpstrDeviceType, lpstrElementName, lpstrAlias}
            let ty_p = m.mem.read_u32(p + 8);
            let ty = if flags & 0x1000 != 0 {
                // MCI_OPEN_TYPE_ID: low word = MCI_DEVTYPE_*
                if ty_p & 0xFFFF == 516 { "cdaudio".to_string() } else { format!("devtype{}", ty_p & 0xFFFF) }
            } else if flags & 0x2000 != 0 && ty_p != 0 {
                m.mem.read_cstr(ty_p)
            } else if flags & 0x200 != 0 {
                m.mem.read_cstr(m.mem.read_u32(p + 12))
            } else {
                String::new()
            };
            let alias = if flags & 0x400 != 0 { Some(m.mem.read_cstr(m.mem.read_u32(p + 16))) } else { None };
            match open_device(m, &ty, alias.as_deref()) {
                Ok(id) => {
                    m.mem.write_u32(p + 4, id);
                    m.log(LogLevel::Info, &format!("MCI_OPEN {ty:?} -> device {id}"));
                    0
                }
                Err(e) => e,
            }
        }
        MCI_CLOSE => close_device(m, dev),
        MCI_SET => {
            if flags & 0x400 != 0 {
                let f = m.mem.read_u32(p + 4);
                let st = mci(m);
                let mut s = st.borrow_mut();
                match s.devices.get_mut(&dev) {
                    Some(d) => {
                        d.time_format = f;
                        0
                    }
                    None => MCIERR_INVALID_DEVICE_ID,
                }
            } else if mci(m).borrow_mut().devices.contains_key(&dev) {
                0
            } else {
                MCIERR_INVALID_DEVICE_ID
            }
        }
        MCI_PLAY => {
            let from = if flags & MCI_FLAG_FROM != 0 { Some(m.mem.read_u32(p + 4)) } else { None };
            let to = if flags & MCI_FLAG_TO != 0 { Some(m.mem.read_u32(p + 8)) } else { None };
            play(m, dev, from, to, notify_hwnd)
        }
        MCI_STOP => stop(m, dev),
        MCI_PAUSE => {
            mci(m).borrow_mut().player.paused = true;
            0
        }
        MCI_RESUME => {
            mci(m).borrow_mut().player.paused = false;
            0
        }
        MCI_SEEK => stop(m, dev),
        MCI_STATUS => {
            // MCI_STATUS_PARMS {dwCallback, dwReturn, dwItem, dwTrack}
            let item = m.mem.read_u32(p + 8);
            let track = if flags & MCI_FLAG_TRACK != 0 { Some(m.mem.read_u32(p + 12)) } else { None };
            match status(m, dev, item, track) {
                Ok(v) => {
                    m.mem.write_u32(p + 4, v);
                    0
                }
                Err(e) => e,
            }
        }
        MCI_GETDEVCAPS => {
            if p != 0 {
                m.mem.write_u32(p + 4, 1);
            }
            0
        }
        MCI_INFO => MCIERR_UNSUPPORTED_FUNCTION,
        other => {
            m.log(LogLevel::Debug, &format!("mciSendCommandA: unsupported message {other:#x}"));
            MCIERR_UNRECOGNIZED_COMMAND
        }
    };
    if r != 0 {
        m.log(LogLevel::Debug, &format!("mciSendCommandA(dev {dev}, {msg:#x}, flags {flags:#x}) -> error {r}"));
    }
    ThunkResult::stdcall(r, 4)
}

/// A parsed MCI command string.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct MciCommand {
    pub verb: String,
    pub device: String,
    /// Remaining words (lower-case keywords; values kept as written).
    pub args: Vec<String>,
}

/// Parse "verb device args..." (quoted device names allowed).
pub fn parse_mci_string(s: &str) -> Option<MciCommand> {
    let mut words: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
    let mut cur = String::new();
    let mut inq = false;
    for c in s.trim().chars() {
        match c {
            '"' => inq = !inq,
            c if c.is_whitespace() && !inq => {
                if !cur.is_empty() {
                    words.push(std::mem::take(&mut cur));
                }
            }
            c => cur.push(c),
        }
    }
    if !cur.is_empty() {
        words.push(cur);
    }
    if words.len() < 2 {
        return None;
    }
    let verb = words.remove(0).to_ascii_lowercase();
    let device = words.remove(0);
    Some(MciCommand { verb, device, args: words })
}

impl MciCommand {
    fn has(&self, w: &str) -> bool {
        self.args.iter().any(|a| a.eq_ignore_ascii_case(w))
    }
    fn value_after(&self, w: &str) -> Option<&str> {
        let i = self.args.iter().position(|a| a.eq_ignore_ascii_case(w))?;
        self.args.get(i + 1).map(|s| s.as_str())
    }
    /// "status x number of tracks" -> "number of tracks".
    fn rest(&self) -> String {
        self.args.iter().map(|a| a.to_ascii_lowercase()).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(" ")
    }
}

/// Parse a position in TMSF ("3", "3:00:00:00") / ms / MSF text.
pub fn parse_position(s: &str, fmt: u32) -> Option<u32> {
    let parts: Vec<u32> = s.split(':').map(|p| p.trim().parse().ok()).collect::<Option<Vec<_>>>()?;
    Some(match fmt {
        MCI_FORMAT_TMSF => parts.iter().take(4).enumerate().fold(0, |acc, (i, v)| acc | (v & 0xFF) << (8 * i)),
        MCI_FORMAT_MSF => parts.iter().take(3).enumerate().fold(0, |acc, (i, v)| acc | (v & 0xFF) << (8 * i)),
        _ => parts[0],
    })
}

fn device_by_name(m: &mut Machine, name: &str) -> Option<u32> {
    let st = mci(m);
    let s = st.borrow_mut();
    s.devices.iter().find(|(_, d)| d.alias.eq_ignore_ascii_case(name)).map(|(id, _)| *id)
}

fn exec_mci_string(m: &mut Machine, cmd: &MciCommand, hwnd_cb: u32) -> Result<String, u32> {
    let notify = if cmd.has("notify") { Some(hwnd_cb) } else { None };
    if cmd.verb == "open" {
        let (ty, _elem) = match cmd.device.split_once('!') {
            Some((t, e)) => (t.to_string(), Some(e.to_string())),
            None => (cmd.value_after("type").map(|s| s.to_string()).unwrap_or(cmd.device.clone()), None),
        };
        let alias = cmd.value_after("alias").map(|s| s.to_string());
        let id = open_device(m, &ty, Some(alias.as_deref().unwrap_or(&cmd.device)))?;
        return Ok(id.to_string());
    }
    if cmd.verb == "close" && cmd.device.eq_ignore_ascii_case("all") {
        let ids: Vec<u32> = mci(m).borrow_mut().devices.keys().copied().collect();
        for id in ids {
            close_device(m, id);
        }
        return Ok(String::new());
    }
    let dev = device_by_name(m, &cmd.device).ok_or(MCIERR_INVALID_DEVICE_NAME)?;
    let fmt = mci(m).borrow_mut().devices.get(&dev).map(|d| d.time_format).unwrap_or(MCI_FORMAT_MSF);
    let err = |r: u32| if r == 0 { Ok(String::new()) } else { Err(r) };
    match cmd.verb.as_str() {
        "close" => err(close_device(m, dev)),
        "stop" | "seek" => err(stop(m, dev)),
        "pause" => {
            mci(m).borrow_mut().player.paused = true;
            Ok(String::new())
        }
        "resume" => {
            mci(m).borrow_mut().player.paused = false;
            Ok(String::new())
        }
        "play" => {
            let from = cmd.value_after("from").and_then(|v| parse_position(v, fmt));
            let to = cmd.value_after("to").and_then(|v| parse_position(v, fmt));
            err(play(m, dev, from, to, notify))
        }
        "set" => {
            let r = cmd.rest();
            if let Some(f) = r.strip_prefix("time format ") {
                let f = match f.trim() {
                    "tmsf" => MCI_FORMAT_TMSF,
                    "msf" => MCI_FORMAT_MSF,
                    "milliseconds" | "ms" => MCI_FORMAT_MILLISECONDS,
                    _ => return Err(MCIERR_OUTOFRANGE),
                };
                if let Some(d) = mci(m).borrow_mut().devices.get_mut(&dev) {
                    d.time_format = f;
                }
            }
            Ok(String::new())
        }
        "status" => {
            let r = cmd.rest().replace(" wait", "").replace(" notify", "");
            let (item, track) = if let Some(t) = r.strip_prefix("length track ") {
                (1, t.trim().parse().ok())
            } else if let Some(t) = r.strip_prefix("type track ") {
                (0x4001, t.trim().parse().ok())
            } else {
                let item = match r.trim() {
                    "window handle" => return Ok("0".into()),
                    "length" => 1,
                    "position" => 2,
                    "number of tracks" => 3,
                    "mode" => 4,
                    "media present" => 5,
                    "time format" => 6,
                    "ready" => 7,
                    "current track" => 8,
                    _ => return Err(MCIERR_UNSUPPORTED_FUNCTION),
                };
                (item, None)
            };
            let v = status(m, dev, item, track)?;
            Ok(match item {
                4 => match v {
                    MCI_MODE_PLAY => "playing".into(),
                    MCI_MODE_PAUSE => "paused".into(),
                    _ => "stopped".into(),
                },
                5 | 7 => "true".into(),
                6 => match v {
                    MCI_FORMAT_TMSF => "tmsf".into(),
                    MCI_FORMAT_MILLISECONDS => "milliseconds".into(),
                    _ => "msf".into(),
                },
                0x4001 => if v == 1088 { "audio".into() } else { "other".into() },
                1 | 2 if fmt != MCI_FORMAT_MILLISECONDS => {
                    let b = v.to_le_bytes();
                    if item == 2 && fmt == MCI_FORMAT_TMSF {
                        format!("{:02}:{:02}:{:02}:{:02}", b[0], b[1], b[2], b[3])
                    } else {
                        format!("{:02}:{:02}:{:02}", b[0], b[1], b[2])
                    }
                }
                _ => v.to_string(),
            })
        }
        "window" | "put" | "where" | "realize" | "update" | "cue" | "setaudio" | "setvideo" => Ok(String::new()),
        _ => Err(MCIERR_UNRECOGNIZED_COMMAND),
    }
}

/// mciSendStringA(lpszCommand, lpszReturnString, cchReturn, hwndCallback)
fn mci_send_string_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let s = m.arg_str(0).unwrap_or_default();
    let (ret, cch, hwnd) = (m.arg_u32(1), m.arg_u32(2), m.arg_u32(3));
    let r = match parse_mci_string(&s) {
        None => Err(MCIERR_UNRECOGNIZED_COMMAND),
        Some(c) => exec_mci_string(m, &c, hwnd),
    };
    m.log(LogLevel::Info, &format!("mciSendStringA({s:?}) -> {r:?}"));
    let (code, text) = match r {
        Ok(t) => (0, t),
        Err(e) => (e, String::new()),
    };
    if ret != 0 && cch > 0 {
        let b: Vec<u8> = text.bytes().take(cch as usize - 1).collect();
        m.mem.write_cstr_bytes(ret, &b);
    }
    ThunkResult::stdcall(code, 4)
}

/// Error text for an MCI error code.
pub fn mci_error_text(e: u32) -> &'static str {
    match e {
        0 => "The specified command was carried out.",
        MCIERR_INVALID_DEVICE_ID => "Invalid MCI device ID.",
        MCIERR_UNRECOGNIZED_COMMAND => "The driver cannot recognize the specified command.",
        MCIERR_HARDWARE => "The specified device is not ready.",
        MCIERR_INVALID_DEVICE_NAME => "The specified device is not open or is not recognized by MCI.",
        MCIERR_CANNOT_LOAD_DRIVER => "The specified device driver cannot be loaded (not supported by the port).",
        MCIERR_UNSUPPORTED_FUNCTION => "The MCI device driver does not support this command.",
        MCIERR_OUTOFRANGE => "The specified parameter value is out of range.",
        _ => "Unknown MCI error.",
    }
}

/// mciGetErrorStringA(fdwError, lpszErrorText, cchErrorText)
fn mci_get_error_string_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (e, buf, n) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1), m.arg_u32(2));
    if buf == 0 || n == 0 {
        return ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 3);
    }
    let b: Vec<u8> = mci_error_text(e).bytes().take(n as usize - 1).collect();
    m.mem.write_cstr_bytes(buf, &b);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(1, 3)
}

fn mci_get_device_id_a(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let name = m.arg_str(0).unwrap_or_default();
    let id = device_by_name(m, &name).unwrap_or(0);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(id, 1)
}

fn aux_set_volume(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let v = m.arg_u32(1);
    let l = (v & 0xFFFF) as f32 / 65535.0;
    set_music_volume(m, l);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 2)
}

fn aux_get_volume(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let p = m.arg_u32(1);
    let v = (mci(m).borrow_mut().player.volume * 65535.0) as u32;
    if p != 0 {
        m.mem.write_u32(p, v | v << 16);
    }
    ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 2)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn mci_string_parsing() {
        let c = parse_mci_string("open AVIVideo!.\\S3\\Add\\001\\01_00_00.dat alias test").unwrap();
        assert_eq!(c.verb, "open");
        assert_eq!(c.device, "AVIVideo!.\\S3\\Add\\001\\01_00_00.dat");
        assert_eq!(c.value_after("ALIAS"), Some("test"));
        let c = parse_mci_string("play cd from 3 to 4 notify").unwrap();
        assert!(c.has("notify"));
        assert_eq!(c.value_after("from"), Some("3"));
        let c = parse_mci_string("status \"my cd\" number of tracks").unwrap();
        assert_eq!(c.device, "my cd");
        assert_eq!(c.rest(), "number of tracks");
        assert!(parse_mci_string("close").is_none());
        assert_eq!(parse_position("3", MCI_FORMAT_TMSF), Some(3));
        assert_eq!(parse_position("3:01:02:00", MCI_FORMAT_TMSF), Some(3 | 1 << 8 | 2 << 16));
        assert_eq!(parse_position("1500", MCI_FORMAT_MILLISECONDS), Some(1500));
        assert_eq!(ms_to_msf(61_000), 1 | 1 << 8);
        assert_eq!(pos_to_track(MCI_FORMAT_TMSF, 0x0000_0007), 7);
    }
}
```

```rs
//! `wsock32.dll` HLE. WinSock 1.1 stubs: networking is not available in the port. `WSAStartup` fails with
//! WSASYSNOTREADY so the LAN/Internet code stays off (HYPOTHESIS: single player is unaffected); every socket call
//! fails with WSAENETDOWN. Pure helpers (htons, inet_addr, ...) work.
//!
//! `NAMES` lists every function we know the game can reach; all are declared (calling one without a handler
//! stops the machine with `UNIMPLEMENTED wsock32.dll!Name`).

use s3_runtime::{LogLevel, Machine, Registry, ThunkResult};

/// DLL name as registered.
pub const DLL: &str = "wsock32.dll";

/// Known exports.
pub const NAMES: &[&str] = &[
    "WSAStartup", "WSACleanup", "WSAGetLastError", "socket", "closesocket", "bind", "connect",
    "listen", "accept", "send", "recv", "sendto", "recvfrom", "select", "gethostname",
    "gethostbyname", "inet_addr", "inet_ntoa", "htons", "ntohs", "htonl", "ntohl", "ioctlsocket",
    "setsockopt", "getsockopt", "getsockname", "shutdown", "WSASetLastError", "__WSAFDIsSet",
];

const WSASYSNOTREADY: u32 = 10091;
const WSAENETDOWN: u32 = 10050;
const SOCKET_ERROR: u32 = 0xFFFF_FFFF;

/// Declare all names and register implemented handlers.
pub fn register(reg: &mut Registry) {
    reg.declare_all(DLL, NAMES);
    let h: &[(&str, s3_runtime::Handler)] = &[
        ("WSAStartup", wsa_startup),
        ("WSACleanup", ret0_0),
        ("WSAGetLastError", wsa_get_last_error),
        ("WSASetLastError", ret0_1),
        ("socket", fail_3),
        ("closesocket", fail_1),
        ("bind", fail_3),
        ("connect", fail_3),
        ("listen", fail_2),
        ("accept", fail_3),
        ("send", fail_4),
        ("recv", fail_4),
        ("sendto", fail_6),
        ("recvfrom", fail_6),
        ("select", fail_5),
        ("gethostname", gethostname),
        ("gethostbyname", null_1),
        ("inet_addr", inet_addr),
        ("inet_ntoa", inet_ntoa),
        ("htons", htons),
        ("ntohs", htons),
        ("htonl", htonl),
        ("ntohl", htonl),
        ("ioctlsocket", fail_3),
        ("setsockopt", fail_5),
        ("getsockopt", fail_5),
        ("getsockname", fail_3),
        ("shutdown", fail_2),
        ("__WSAFDIsSet", ret0_2),
    ];
    for (n, f) in h {
        reg.register(DLL, n, *f);
    }
}

fn ret0_0(_m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 0)
}
fn ret0_1(_m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 1)
}
fn ret0_2(_m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 2)
}
fn null_1(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    m.set_last_error(WSAENETDOWN);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 1)
}

macro_rules! fail {
    ($name:ident, $n:expr) => {
        fn $name(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
            m.set_last_error(WSAENETDOWN);
            ThunkResult::stdcall(SOCKET_ERROR, $n)
        }
    };
}
fail!(fail_1, 1);
fail!(fail_2, 2);
fail!(fail_3, 3);
fail!(fail_4, 4);
fail!(fail_5, 5);
fail!(fail_6, 6);

/// WSAStartup(wVersionRequested, lpWSAData): fails, networking is unavailable.
fn wsa_startup(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let p = m.arg_u32(1);
    if p != 0 {
        m.mem.fill(p, 400, 0);
        m.mem.write_u16(p, 0x0101);
        m.mem.write_u16(p + 2, 0x0101);
    }
    m.log(LogLevel::Info, "WSAStartup: networking not available in the port (WSASYSNOTREADY)");
    ThunkResult::stdcall(WSASYSNOTREADY, 2)
}

fn wsa_get_last_error(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let e = m.last_error();
    ThunkResult::stdcall(if e == 0 { WSAENETDOWN } else { e }, 0)
}

fn gethostname(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let (buf, len) = (m.arg_u32(0), m.arg_u32(1));
    if buf == 0 || len < 7 {
        return ThunkResult::stdcall(SOCKET_ERROR, 2);
    }
    m.mem.write_cstr(buf, "s3port");
    ThunkResult::stdcall(0, 2)
}

/// Parse a dotted IPv4 address into network byte order (as stored in memory).
pub fn parse_inet_addr(s: &str) -> Option<u32> {
    let parts: Vec<u8> = s.trim().split('.').map(|p| p.parse().ok()).collect::<Option<Vec<_>>>()?;
    if parts.len() != 4 {
        return None;
    }
    Some(u32::from_le_bytes([parts[0], parts[1], parts[2], parts[3]]))
}

fn inet_addr(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let s = m.arg_str(0).unwrap_or_default();
    ThunkResult::stdcall(parse_inet_addr(&s).unwrap_or(0xFFFF_FFFF), 1)
}

#[derive(Default)]
struct NtoaBuf(u32);

fn inet_ntoa(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let a = m.arg_u32(0).to_le_bytes();
    let st = m.state::<NtoaBuf>();
    let mut b = st.borrow_mut();
    if b.0 == 0 {
        b.0 = m.mem.alloc(16);
    }
    let p = b.0;
    drop(b);
    m.mem.write_cstr(p, &format!("{}.{}.{}.{}", a[0], a[1], a[2], a[3]));
    ThunkResult::stdcall(p, 1)
}

fn htons(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let v = m.arg_u32(0) as u16;
    ThunkResult::stdcall(v.swap_bytes() as u32, 1)
}

fn htonl(m: &mut Machine) -> ThunkResult {
    let v = m.arg_u32(0);
    ThunkResult::stdcall(v.swap_bytes(), 1)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    #[test]
    fn inet() {
        assert_eq!(super::parse_inet_addr("127.0.0.1"), Some(0x0100_007F));
        assert_eq!(super::parse_inet_addr("x"), None);
    }
}
```

```h
/* C API of libs3ios.a (crates/s3-ios/src/lib.rs), used by the Swift shell in port/ios.
 * All calls except s3ios_audio_pull come from the main thread. See docs/porting/ios.md. */
#ifndef S3IOS_H
#define S3IOS_H

#include <stdint.h>

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

typedef struct S3App S3App;
typedef struct S3AudioRing S3AudioRing;

/* What the shell should do after s3ios_tick. */
typedef struct S3Out {
    uint8_t redraw;    /* something new to show: display() the GL view */
    uint8_t keyboard;  /* soft keyboard: 0 no change, 1 show, 2 hide, 3 toggle */
    uint8_t quit;      /* the launcher's Quit was tapped */
    uint8_t in_game;   /* the game runs (not the launcher) */
    uint32_t haptic_ms; /* vibrate (0 = no) */
    uint8_t pick_folder; /* game folder: 1 show the folder picker, 2 use the app's own folder again */
} S3Out;

/* game_dir: the user's Settlers III files (Documents/Settlers3); data_dir: settings, logs (Documents/Data). */
S3App *s3ios_create(const char *game_dir, const char *data_dir);
void s3ios_destroy(S3App *app);
/* View size in pixels and the screen density. */
void s3ios_resize(S3App *app, uint32_t w, uint32_t h, uint32_t dpi);
/* The screen's maximum refresh rate (UIScreen.maximumFramesPerSecond). */
void s3ios_set_refresh(S3App *app, uint32_t hz);
/* Once per display refresh, before drawing. */
S3Out s3ios_tick(S3App *app);
/* Draw into the bound framebuffer (GLKView draw, its EAGLContext current). */
void s3ios_draw(S3App *app, uint32_t w, uint32_t h);
/* action: 0 down (first finger), 1 another finger down, 2 move, 3 a finger up (not the last), 4 last finger up,
 * 5 cancel. id/x/y: the acting finger (pixels); ids/xs/ys: all n fingers down (including the acting one). */
void s3ios_touch(S3App *app, int32_t action, int32_t id, float x, float y, int32_t n, const int32_t *ids,
                 const float *xs, const float *ys);
/* Typed character (Unicode scalar; 8 = backspace, 10/13 = return). */
void s3ios_text(S3App *app, uint32_t c);
/* Hardware key as a Windows virtual key code. */
void s3ios_key(S3App *app, uint32_t vk, uint8_t down);
/* Character a hardware key produced (after s3ios_key): WM_CHAR only. */
void s3ios_char(S3App *app, uint32_t c);
/* Game folder: a folder the user picked (external = 1, security-scoped access started) or the app's own (0). */
void s3ios_set_game_dir(S3App *app, const char *dir, uint8_t external);
/* 1 = the app goes to the background (the game pauses), 0 = back in the foreground. */
void s3ios_set_background(S3App *app, uint8_t background);

/* Audio for the audio unit's render thread: interleaved stereo int16 at 44100 Hz. */
const S3AudioRing *s3ios_audio_handle(S3App *app);
void s3ios_audio_pull(const S3AudioRing *ring, int16_t *out, uint32_t frames);
void s3ios_audio_release(const S3AudioRing *ring);

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif
```

`port/ios/Sources/S3Mobile/Core.swift`:

```swift
// The Rust core handle (one per process): paths, lifecycle, audio.

import AVFoundation
import CS3iOS
import Foundation
import UIKit

final class Core {
    static let shared = Core()

    let app: OpaquePointer
    let audio = AudioOut()
    private var background = false
    /// The app's own game folder.
    let appGameDir: URL
    /// A folder the user picked in the Files picker (outside the app, kept when the app is deleted), with its
    /// security-scoped access running.
    private var picked: URL?
    private static let bookmarkKey = "gameFolderBookmark"

    /// Documents/Settlers3: the user's Settlers III files (Files app, upload server), unless a folder was picked.
    /// Documents/Data: settings, logs (log.txt of the last run).
    private init() {
        let docs = FileManager.default.urls(for: .documentDirectory, in: .userDomainMask)[0]
        let game = docs.appendingPathComponent("Settlers3", isDirectory: true)
        let data = docs.appendingPathComponent("Data", isDirectory: true)
        try? FileManager.default.createDirectory(at: game, withIntermediateDirectories: true)
        try? FileManager.default.createDirectory(at: data, withIntermediateDirectories: true)
        appGameDir = game
        app = s3ios_create(game.path, data.path)
        audio.start(ring: s3ios_audio_handle(app))
        restorePickedFolder()
    }

    /// Re-open the folder picked in an earlier run (its bookmark).
    private func restorePickedFolder() {
        guard let data = UserDefaults.standard.data(forKey: Self.bookmarkKey) else { return }
        var stale = false
        guard let url = try? URL(resolvingBookmarkData: data, options: [], relativeTo: nil, bookmarkDataIsStale: &stale),
              url.startAccessingSecurityScopedResource() else {
            NSLog("s3: picked game folder no longer accessible; using the app folder")
            return
        }
        if stale, let fresh = try? url.bookmarkData(options: [], includingResourceValuesForKeys: nil, relativeTo: nil) {
            UserDefaults.standard.set(fresh, forKey: Self.bookmarkKey)
        }
        picked = url
        s3ios_set_game_dir(app, url.path, 1)
    }

    /// The user picked `url` in the folder picker: keep access (bookmark) and use it as the game folder.
    func usePickedFolder(_ url: URL) {
        guard url.startAccessingSecurityScopedResource() else {
            NSLog("s3: no access to the picked folder \(url.path)")
            return
        }
        picked?.stopAccessingSecurityScopedResource()
        picked = url
        if let data = try? url.bookmarkData(options: [], includingResourceValuesForKeys: nil, relativeTo: nil) {
            UserDefaults.standard.set(data, forKey: Self.bookmarkKey)
        }
        s3ios_set_game_dir(app, url.path, 1)
    }

    /// Back to the app's own game folder.
    func useAppFolder() {
        picked?.stopAccessingSecurityScopedResource()
        picked = nil
        UserDefaults.standard.removeObject(forKey: Self.bookmarkKey)
        s3ios_set_game_dir(app, appGameDir.path, 0)
    }

    func setBackground(_ bg: Bool) {
        guard bg != background else { return }
        background = bg
        s3ios_set_background(app, bg ? 1 : 0)
        if bg {
            audio.pause()
        } else {
            audio.resume()
        }
    }
}

/// Game sound: an AVAudioSourceNode pulling interleaved stereo int16 at 44100 Hz from the Rust ring and converting it
/// to the engine's float format.
final class AudioOut {
    private let engine = AVAudioEngine()
    private var node: AVAudioSourceNode?
    private var ring: OpaquePointer?
    private let scratch = UnsafeMutablePointer<Int16>.allocate(capacity: 16384 * 2)

    func start(ring: OpaquePointer?) {
        self.ring = ring
        let session = AVAudioSession.sharedInstance()
        try? session.setCategory(.soloAmbient)
        try? session.setActive(true)
        guard let fmt = AVAudioFormat(standardFormatWithSampleRate: 44100, channels: 2) else { return }
        let scratch = self.scratch
        let n = AVAudioSourceNode(format: fmt) { _, _, frameCount, abl -> OSStatus in
            let frames = Int(min(frameCount, 16384))
            if let r = ring {
                s3ios_audio_pull(r, scratch, UInt32(frames))
            } else {
                scratch.update(repeating: 0, count: frames * 2)
            }
            let bufs = UnsafeMutableAudioBufferListPointer(abl)
            for (ch, buf) in bufs.enumerated() {
                guard let out = buf.mData?.assumingMemoryBound(to: Float.self) else { continue }
                if bufs.count == 1 {
                    // Interleaved (not expected with the standard format).
                    for i in 0..<frames * 2 { out[i] = Float(scratch[i]) / 32768 }
                } else {
                    for i in 0..<frames { out[i] = Float(scratch[i * 2 + min(ch, 1)]) / 32768 }
                }
            }
            return noErr
        }
        node = n
        engine.attach(n)
        engine.connect(n, to: engine.mainMixerNode, format: fmt)
        do {
            try engine.start()
        } catch {
            NSLog("s3: audio engine start failed: \(error)")
        }
    }

    func pause() { engine.pause() }

    func resume() {
        try? AVAudioSession.sharedInstance().setActive(true)
        try? engine.start()
    }
}
```

`port/ios/Sources/S3Mobile/GameView.swift`:

```swift
// Full-screen GL view: draws through the Rust core (GLES via OpenGLES.framework), forwards touches, the soft
// keyboard (UIKeyInput) and hardware keys.

import CS3iOS
import GLKit
import UIKit
import UniformTypeIdentifiers

final class GameView: GLKView, UIKeyInput, UIDocumentPickerDelegate {
    private var link: CADisplayLink?
    /// Fingers down, in touch order: (touch, id).
    private var fingers: [(UITouch, Int32)] = []
    private var nextId: Int32 = 1
    private let haptic = UIImpactFeedbackGenerator(style: .medium)
    private var lastSize: (UInt32, UInt32, UInt32) = (0, 0, 0)

    override init(frame: CGRect) {
        let ctx = EAGLContext(api: .openGLES3) ?? EAGLContext(api: .openGLES2)!
        super.init(frame: frame, context: ctx)
        drawableColorFormat = .RGBA8888
        drawableDepthFormat = .formatNone
        drawableStencilFormat = .formatNone
        enableSetNeedsDisplay = false
        isMultipleTouchEnabled = true
        contentScaleFactor = UIScreen.main.nativeScale
        _ = Core.shared
        let l = CADisplayLink(target: self, selector: #selector(step))
        l.preferredFrameRateRange = CAFrameRateRange(minimum: 30, maximum: 120, preferred: 120)
        l.add(to: .main, forMode: .common)
        link = l
    }

    required init?(coder: NSCoder) { fatalError("not used") }

    private var pixelSize: (UInt32, UInt32) {
        let s = contentScaleFactor
        return (UInt32(max(1, (bounds.width * s).rounded())), UInt32(max(1, (bounds.height * s).rounded())))
    }

    /// Approximate density: 163 dpi per point scale on iPhones (132 on iPads).
    private var dpi: UInt32 {
        let perPoint: CGFloat = UIDevice.current.userInterfaceIdiom == .pad ? 132 : 163
        return UInt32(perPoint * UIScreen.main.scale)
    }

    override func layoutSubviews() {
        super.layoutSubviews()
        let (w, h) = pixelSize
        if (w, h, dpi) != lastSize {
            lastSize = (w, h, dpi)
            s3ios_resize(Core.shared.app, w, h, dpi)
            s3ios_set_refresh(Core.shared.app, UInt32(window?.screen.maximumFramesPerSecond ?? UIScreen.main.maximumFramesPerSecond))
        }
    }

    @objc private func step() {
        let out = s3ios_tick(Core.shared.app)
        if out.redraw != 0 {
            display()
        }
        if out.haptic_ms > 0 {
            haptic.impactOccurred(intensity: min(1.0, CGFloat(out.haptic_ms) / 40.0))
        }
        switch out.keyboard {
        case 1: _ = becomeFirstResponder()
        case 2: _ = resignFirstResponder()
        case 3: _ = isFirstResponder ? resignFirstResponder() : becomeFirstResponder()
        default: break
        }
        UIApplication.shared.isIdleTimerDisabled = out.in_game != 0
        switch out.pick_folder {
        case 1: showFolderPicker()
        case 2: Core.shared.useAppFolder()
        default: break
        }
        if out.quit != 0 {
            exit(0)
        }
    }

    // MARK: game folder picker

    private func showFolderPicker() {
        let picker = UIDocumentPickerViewController(forOpeningContentTypes: [.folder])
        picker.delegate = self
        picker.allowsMultipleSelection = false
        var vc = window?.rootViewController
        while let p = vc?.presentedViewController { vc = p }
        vc?.present(picker, animated: true)
    }

    func documentPicker(_ controller: UIDocumentPickerViewController, didPickDocumentsAt urls: [URL]) {
        if let url = urls.first {
            Core.shared.usePickedFolder(url)
        }
    }

    override func draw(_ rect: CGRect) {
        s3ios_draw(Core.shared.app, UInt32(drawableWidth), UInt32(drawableHeight))
    }

    // MARK: touches

    private func point(_ t: UITouch) -> (Float, Float) {
        let p = t.location(in: self)
        return (Float(p.x * contentScaleFactor), Float(p.y * contentScaleFactor))
    }

    private func send(_ action: Int32, _ t: UITouch, _ id: Int32, extra: (UITouch, Int32)? = nil) {
        var all = fingers
        if let e = extra { all.append(e) }
        var ids = all.map { $0.1 }
        var xs = all.map { point($0.0).0 }
        var ys = all.map { point($0.0).1 }
        let (x, y) = point(t)
        s3ios_touch(Core.shared.app, action, id, x, y, Int32(all.count), &ids, &xs, &ys)
    }

    override func touchesBegan(_ touches: Set<UITouch>, with event: UIEvent?) {
        for t in touches {
            let id = nextId
            nextId &+= 1
            let first = fingers.isEmpty
            fingers.append((t, id))
            send(first ? 0 : 1, t, id)
        }
    }

    override func touchesMoved(_ touches: Set<UITouch>, with event: UIEvent?) {
        guard let t = touches.first, let f = fingers.first(where: { $0.0 === t }) else { return }
        send(2, t, f.1)
    }

    override func touchesEnded(_ touches: Set<UITouch>, with event: UIEvent?) {
        for t in touches {
            guard let i = fingers.firstIndex(where: { $0.0 === t }) else { continue }
            let f = fingers.remove(at: i)
            send(fingers.isEmpty ? 4 : 3, t, f.1, extra: f)
        }
    }

    override func touchesCancelled(_ touches: Set<UITouch>, with event: UIEvent?) {
        guard let f = fingers.first else { return }
        send(5, f.0, f.1)
        fingers.removeAll()
    }

    // MARK: soft keyboard (UIKeyInput)

    override var canBecomeFirstResponder: Bool { true }
    var hasText: Bool { true }
    var keyboardType: UIKeyboardType = .asciiCapable
    var autocorrectionType: UITextAutocorrectionType = .no
    var autocapitalizationType: UITextAutocapitalizationType = .none
    var spellCheckingType: UITextSpellCheckingType = .no

    func insertText(_ text: String) {
        for u in text.unicodeScalars {
            s3ios_text(Core.shared.app, u.value)
        }
    }

    func deleteBackward() {
        s3ios_text(Core.shared.app, 8)
    }

    // MARK: hardware keyboard

    override func pressesBegan(_ presses: Set<UIPress>, with event: UIPressesEvent?) {
        if !forward(presses, down: true) { super.pressesBegan(presses, with: event) }
    }

    override func pressesEnded(_ presses: Set<UIPress>, with event: UIPressesEvent?) {
        if !forward(presses, down: false) { super.pressesEnded(presses, with: event) }
    }

    override func pressesCancelled(_ presses: Set<UIPress>, with event: UIPressesEvent?) {
        if !forward(presses, down: false) { super.pressesCancelled(presses, with: event) }
    }

    /// Hardware keys -> Windows virtual keys + the characters they type. Handled presses do not reach UIKeyInput,
    /// so nothing arrives twice.
    private func forward(_ presses: Set<UIPress>, down: Bool) -> Bool {
        var used = false
        for p in presses {
            guard let key = p.key, let vk = Self.vk(key.keyCode) else { continue }
            s3ios_key(Core.shared.app, vk, down ? 1 : 0)
            if down, key.modifierFlags.intersection([.command, .control]).isEmpty {
                if vk == 0x08 || vk == 0x0d {
                    s3ios_char(Core.shared.app, vk == 0x08 ? 8 : 13)
                } else {
                    for u in key.characters.unicodeScalars where u.value >= 0x20 && u.value < 0xF700 {
                        s3ios_char(Core.shared.app, u.value)
                    }
                }
            }
            used = true
        }
        return used
    }

    private static func vk(_ k: UIKeyboardHIDUsage) -> UInt32? {
        let r = k.rawValue
        switch r {
        case 0x04...0x1d: return UInt32(0x41 + (r - 0x04)) // A..Z
        case 0x1e...0x26: return UInt32(0x31 + (r - 0x1e)) // 1..9
        case 0x27: return 0x30 // 0
        case 0x28, 0x58: return 0x0d // return, keypad enter
        case 0x29: return 0x1b // escape
        case 0x2a: return 0x08 // backspace
        case 0x2b: return 0x09 // tab
        case 0x2c: return 0x20 // space
        case 0x3a...0x45: return UInt32(0x70 + (r - 0x3a)) // F1..F12
        case 0x49: return 0x2d // insert
        case 0x4a: return 0x24 // home
        case 0x4b: return 0x21 // page up
        case 0x4c: return 0x2e // delete
        case 0x4d: return 0x23 // end
        case 0x4e: return 0x22 // page down
        case 0x4f: return 0x27 // right
        case 0x50: return 0x25 // left
        case 0x51: return 0x28 // down
        case 0x52: return 0x26 // up
        case 0xe0, 0xe4: return 0x11 // control
        case 0xe1, 0xe5: return 0x10 // shift
        case 0xe2, 0xe6: return 0x12 // alt / option
        default: return nil
        }
    }
}
```

```swift
// S3 Mobile, iOS shell entry point (docs/porting/ios.md).
// The Rust core (libs3ios.a) does the launcher, the game and the drawing; this shell hosts it in UIKit.

import SwiftUI
import UIKit

@main
struct S3MobileApp: App {
    @Environment(\.scenePhase) private var phase

    var body: some Scene {
        WindowGroup {
            GameViewRepresentable()
                .ignoresSafeArea()
                .statusBarHidden(true)
                .persistentSystemOverlays(.hidden)
                .defersSystemGestures(on: .all)
        }
        .onChange(of: phase) { _, p in
            Core.shared.setBackground(p != .active)
        }
    }
}

/// The SwiftUI wrapper of the game view controller.
struct GameViewRepresentable: UIViewControllerRepresentable {
    func makeUIViewController(context: Context) -> GameViewController { GameViewController() }
    func updateUIViewController(_ vc: GameViewController, context: Context) {}
}

final class GameViewController: UIViewController {
    override func loadView() {
        view = GameView(frame: UIScreen.main.bounds)
    }

    override var prefersStatusBarHidden: Bool { true }
    override var prefersHomeIndicatorAutoHidden: Bool { true }
    override var preferredScreenEdgesDeferringSystemGestures: UIRectEdge { .all }
    override var supportedInterfaceOrientations: UIInterfaceOrientationMask { .landscape }
}
```
